He hath arisen and come once more, rejoined the band of those who live.
May he become the sire of sons, and of all men most fortunate.
He hath returned to consciousness, rejoined the living’s firm abodes,
For hundred leeches are in this, yea, and a thousand healing herbs.
The Gods, the Brāhman-priests, and plants observed the way to gather thee:
All deities described the way men gather thee upon the earth.
Let him who made it also heal: he, truly, is the deftest leech.
Pure, with a leech he verily shall give thee medicines that heal.

verses.sanskrit:
आगा॒दुद॑गाद॒यं जी॒वानां॒ व्रात॒मप्य॑गात् ।
अभू॑दु पु॒त्राणां॑ पि॒ता नृ॒णां च॒ भग॑वत्तमः ॥
verses.transliteration:
āgādudagādayaṃ jīvānāṃ vrātamapyagāt |
abhūdu putrāṇāṃ pitā nṛṇāṃ ca bhagavattamaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अधी॑ती॒रध्य॑गाद॒यमधि॑ जीवपु॒रा अ॑गान् ।
श॒तं ह्य॑स्य भि॒षजः॑ स॒हस्र॑मु॒त वी॒रुधः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
adhītīradhyagādayamadhi jīvapurā agān |
śataṃ hyasya bhiṣajaḥ sahasramuta vīrudhaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वास्ते॑ ची॒तिम॑विदन् ब्र॒ह्माण॑ उ॒त वी॒रुधः॑ ।
ची॒तिं ते॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अवि॑द॒न् भूम्या॒मधि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devāste cītimavidan brahmāṇa uta vīrudhaḥ |
cītiṃ te viśve devā avidan bhūmyāmadhi ||

verses.sanskrit:
यश्च॒कार॒ स निष्क॑र॒त् स ए॒व सुभि॑षक्तमः ।
स ए॒व तुभ्यं॑ भेष॒जानि॑ कृ॒णव॑द् भि॒षजा॒ शुचिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaścakāra sa niṣkarat sa eva subhiṣaktamaḥ |
sa eva tubhyaṃ bheṣajāni kṛṇavad bhiṣajā śuciḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
क्षे॒त्रि॒यात् त्वा॒ निरृ॑त्या जामिशं॒साद् द्रु॒हो मु॑ञ्चामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ पाशा॑त् ।
अ॒ना॒गसं॒ ब्रह्म॑णा त्वा कृणोमि शि॒वे ते॒ द्यावा॑ पृथि॒वी उ॒भे स्ता॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
kṣetriyāt tvā nirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt |
anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvā pṛthivī ubhe stām ||
verses.translation:
Absolution and benediction
From family sickness, kinsmen’s curse, Destruction, from Druh, from Varuna’s noose I free and save thee.
With spell and prayer I make thee pure and sinless: to thee be both, the Earth and Heaven, auspicious!
Gracious to thee be Agni with the Waters, let Soma with the Plants be kind and bless thee.
From family sickness, kinsmen’s curse, Destruction, from Druh, from Varuna’s noose I thus release thee.
May kind Wind strengthen thee in air’s mid-region, to thee may heaven’s four quarters be auspicious.
From family sickness, kinsmen’s curse, Destruction, from Druh, from Varuna’s curse I thus release thee.
These Goddesses, four regions of the heavens, on whom the Sun looks kindly, wives of Vāta—
From family sickness, kinsmen’s curse, Destruction, from Druh, from Varuna’s noose I thus release thee.
For long life, in the midst of these I set thee. Away pass Nirriti, away Consumption!
From family sickness, kinsmen’s curse, Destruction, from Druh, from Varuna’s noose I thus release thee.
Thou hast been freed from Phthisis and from trouble, from shame, and from the snare of Druh and Grain.
From family sickness, kinsmen’s curse, Destruction, from Druh, from Varuna’s noose I thus release thee.
Joy hast thou found, and left ill-will behind thee: thou hast attained the happy world of virtue.
From family sickness, kinsmen’s curse, Destruction, from Druh, from Varuna’s noose I thus release thee.
The Gods have freed from, sinfulness, redeeming the Sun, the Law from darkness and from Grāhi.
From family sickness, kinsmen’s curse, Destruction, from Druh, from Varuna’s noose I thus release thee.
With spell and prayer I make thee pure and sinless: to thee be both, the Earth and Heaven, auspicious!

verses.sanskrit:
शं ते॑ अ॒ग्निः स॒हाद्भिर॑स्तु॒ शं सो॑मः स॒हौष॑धीभिः ।
ए॒वाहं त्वां क्षे॑त्रि॒यान्निरृ॑त्या जामिशं॒साद् द्रु॒हो मु॑ञ्चामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ पाशा॑त् ।
अ॒ना॒गसं॒ ब्रह्म॑णा त्वा कृणोमि शि॒वे ते॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी उ॒भे स्ता॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ te agniḥ sahādbhirastu śaṃ somaḥ sahauṣadhībhiḥ |
evāhaṃ tvāṃ kṣetriyānnirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt |
anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं ते॒ वातो॑ अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ वयो॑ धा॒च्छं ते॑ भवन्तु प्र॒दिश॒श्चत॑स्रः ।
ए॒वाहं त्वां क्षे॑त्रि॒या॑न्निरृ॑त्या जामिशं॒साद् द्रु॒हो मु॑ञ्चामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ पाशा॑त् ।
अ॒ना॒गसं॒ ब्रह्म॑णा त्वा कृणोमि शि॒वे ते॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी उ॒भे स्ता॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ te vāto antarikṣe vayo dhācchaṃ te bhavantu pradiśaścatasraḥ |
evāhaṃ tvāṃ kṣetriyānnirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt |
anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मा या दे॒वीः प्र॒दिश॒श्चत॑स्रो॒ वात॑पत्नीर॒भि सूर्यो॑ वि॒चष्टे॑ ।
ए॒वाहं त्वां क्षे॑त्रि॒यान्निरृ॑ त्या जामिशं॒साद् द्रु॒हो मु॑ञ्चामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ पाशा॑त् ।
अ॒ना॒गसं॒ ब्रह्म॑णा त्वा कृणोमि शि॒वे ते॑ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी उ॒भे स्ता॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
imā yā devīḥ pradiśaścatasro vātapatnīrabhi sūryo vicaṣṭe |
evāhaṃ tvāṃ kṣetriyānnirṛ tyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt |
anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām ||

verses.sanskrit:
तासु॑ त्वा॒न्तर्ज॒रस्या द॑धामि॒ प्र यक्ष्म॑ एतु॒ निरृ॑तिः परा॒चैः ।
ए॒वाहं त्वां क्षे॑त्रि॒यान्निरृ॑त्या जामिशं॒साद् द्रु॒हो मु॑ञ्चामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ पाशा॑त् ।
अ॒ना॒गसं॒ ब्रह्म॑णा त्वा कृणोमि शि॒वे ते॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी उ॒भे स्ता॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tāsu tvāntarjarasyā dadhāmi pra yakṣma etu nirṛtiḥ parācaiḥ |
evāhaṃ tvāṃ kṣetriyānnirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt |
anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām ||

verses.sanskrit:
अमु॑क्था॒ यक्ष्मा॑द् दुरि॒ताद॑व॒द्याद् द्रु॒हः पाशा॒द् ग्राह्या॒श्चोद॑मुक्थाः ।
ए॒वाहं त्वां क्षे॑त्रि॒यान्निरृ॑त्या जामिशं॒साद् द्रु॒हो मु॑ञ्चामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ पाशा॑त् ।
अ॒ना॒गसं॒ ब्रह्म॑णा त्वा कृणोमि शि॒वे ते॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी उ॒भे स्ता॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
amukthā yakṣmād duritādavadyād druhaḥ pāśād grāhyāścodamukthāḥ |
evāhaṃ tvāṃ kṣetriyānnirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt |
anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām ||

verses.sanskrit:
अहा॒ अरा॑ति॒म॑विदः स्यो॒नमप्य॑भूर्भ॒द्रे सु॑कृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒के ।
ए॒वाहं त्वां क्षे॑त्रि॒यान्निरृ॑त्या जामिशं॒साद् द्रु॒हो मु॑ञ्चामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ पाशा॑त् ।
अ॒ना॒गसं॒ ब्रह्म॑णा त्वा कृणोमि शि॒वे ते॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी उ॒भे स्ता॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahā arātimavidaḥ syonamapyabhūrbhadre sukṛtasya loke |
evāhaṃ tvāṃ kṣetriyānnirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt |
anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām ||

verses.sanskrit:
सूर्य॑मृ॒तं तम॑सो॒ ग्राह्या॒ अधि॑ दे॒वा मुञ्च॑न्तो असृज॒न्निरेण॑सः ।
ए॒वाहं त्वां क्षे॑त्रि॒यान्निरृ॑त्या जामिशं॒साद् द्रु॒हो मु॑ञ्चामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ पाशा॑त् ।
अ॒ना॒गसं॒ ब्रह्म॑णा त्वा कृणोमि शि॒वे ते॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी उ॒भे स्ता॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sūryamṛtaṃ tamaso grāhyā adhi devā muñcanto asṛjannireṇasaḥ |
evāhaṃ tvāṃ kṣetriyānnirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt |
anāgasaṃ brahmaṇā tvā kṛṇomi śive te dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām ||

verses.sanskrit:
दूष्या॒ दूषि॑रसि हे॒त्या हे॒तिर॑सि मे॒न्या मे॒निर॑सि ।
आ॒प्नु॒हि श्रेयां॑स॒मति॑ स॒मं क्रा॑म ॥
verses.transliteration:
dūṣyā dūṣirasi hetyā hetirasi menyā menirasi |
āpnuhi śreyāṃsamati samaṃ krāma ||
verses.translation:
Counter-charm, with an amulet, against an enemy’s spell
Dart against dart, destroyer of destruction, thou art the missile sent to meet the missile.
Reach thy superior, thou; surpass thine equal.
Sraktya art thou, an Amulet art thou, a counter-charm of spells,
Reach thy superior, thou; surpass thine equal.
Use spells against the man we hate, against the man who hateth us.
Reach thy superior, thou; surpass thine equal.
A prince art thou, giver of speech, thou art our bodies’ strong defence.
Reach thy superior, thou; surpass thine equal.
Fulgent art thou, and splendid, thou art heavenly lustre, thou art light.
Reach thy superior, thou; surpass thine equal.

verses.sanskrit:
स्र॒क्त्योऽसि प्रतिस॒रोऽसि प्रत्यभि॒चर॑णोऽसि ।
आ॒प्नु॒हि श्रेयां॑स॒मति॑ स॒मं क्रा॑म ॥
verses.transliteration:
sraktyo'si pratisaro'si pratyabhicaraṇo'si |
āpnuhi śreyāṃsamati samaṃ krāma ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्रति॒ तम॒भि च॑र॒ यो॒ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि॒ यं व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मः ।
आ॒प्नु॒हि श्रेयां॑स॒मति॑ स॒मं क्रा॑म ॥
verses.transliteration:
prati tamabhi cara yo'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ |
āpnuhi śreyāṃsamati samaṃ krāma ||

verses.sanskrit:
सू॒रिर॑सि वर्चो॒धा अ॑सि तनू॒पानोऽसि ।
आ॒प्नु॒हि श्रेयां॑स॒मति॑ स॒मं क्रा॑म ॥
verses.transliteration:
sūrirasi varcodhā asi tanūpāno'si |
āpnuhi śreyāṃsamati samaṃ krāma ||

verses.sanskrit:
शु॒क्रोऽसि भ्रा॒जोऽसि॒ स्वऽरसि॒ ज्योति॑रसि ।
आ॒प्नु॒हि श्रेयां॑स॒मति॑ स॒मं क्रा॑म ॥
verses.transliteration:
śukro'si bhrājo'si sva'rasi jyotirasi |
āpnuhi śreyāṃsamati samaṃ krāma ||

verses.sanskrit:
द्यावा॑पृथिवी उ॒र्व॑१न्त॑रिक्षं॒ क्षेत्र॑स्य॒ पत्न्यु॑रुगा॒योऽद्भु॑तः ।
उ॒तान्तरिक्ष॑मु॒रु वात॑गोपं॒ त इ॒ह त॑प्यन्तां॒ मयि॑ त॒प्यमा॑ने ॥
verses.transliteration:
dyāvāpṛthivī urvantarikṣaṃ kṣetrasya patnyurugāyo'dbhutaḥ |
utāntarikṣamuru vātagopaṃ ta iha tapyantāṃ mayi tapyamāne ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for vengeance on a malicious rival worshipper
The spacious Firmament, and Earth and Heaven, the Field’s Queen, and the wonderful Wide-Strider,
Yea, the broad middle air which Vāta guardeth, may these now burn with heat while I am burning.
Listen to this, ye Gods who merit worship. Hymns here are sung for me by Bharadvāja.
Bound in the noose may he be doomed to trouble whoever mars this that our mind hath purposed.
Hear this my call, O Indra, Soma-drinker, as with a burning heart I oft invoke thee.
I smite, as ‘twere a tree felled with a hatchet, the man who marreth this my plan and purpose.
Together with thrice-eighty Sāma-singers, Angirases, and Vasus, and Ādityas,
May the felicity of the Fathers guard us. I seize that man with fire that Gods have kindled.
O Heaven and Earth, regard me with your favour, and, all ye Gods, stand on my side and help me.
Angirases, Fathers worthy of the Soma! woe fall on him who, caused the hateful outrage!
Whoever either scorns us, O ye Maruts, or blames devotion which we now are paying.
Let his own wicked deeds be fires to burn him. May Heaven consume the man who hates devotion.
Thy sevenfold vital breath, thine eight marrows I rend away with prayer.
With Agni as thine envoy, go, prepared, to Yama’s dwelling place.
In Jātavedas kindled flame I set the place assigned to thee.
Let fire consume thy body, and thy voice go to the general breath.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं दे॑वाः शृणुत॒ ये य॒ज्ञिया॒ स्थ भ॒रद्वा॑जो॒ मह्य॑मु॒क्थानि॑ शंसति ।
पाशे॒ स ब॒द्धो दु॑रि॒ते नि यु॑ज्यतां॒ यो अ॒स्माकं॒ मन॑ इ॒दं हि॒नस्ति॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ devāḥ śṛṇuta ye yajñiyā stha bharadvājo mahyamukthāni śaṃsati |
pāśe sa baddho durite ni yujyatāṃ yo asmākaṃ mana idaṃ hinasti ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दमि॑न्द्र शृणुहि सोमप॒ यत् त्वा॑ हृ॒दा शोच॑ता॒ जोह॑वीमि ।
वृ॒श्चामि॒ तं कुलि॑शेनेव वृ॒क्षं यो अ॒स्माकं॒ मन॑ इ॒दं हि॒नस्ति॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
idamindra śṛṇuhi somapa yat tvā hṛdā śocatā johavīmi |
vṛścāmi taṃ kuliśeneva vṛkṣaṃ yo asmākaṃ mana idaṃ hinasti ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒शी॒तिभि॑स्ति॒सृभिः॑ साम॒गेभि॑रादि॒त्येभि॒र्वसु॑भि॒रङ्गि॑रोभिः ।
इ॒ष्टा॒पू॒र्तम॑वतु नः पितॄ॒णामामुं द॑दे॒ हर॑सा॒ दैव्ये॑न ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśītibhistisṛbhiḥ sāmagebhirādityebhirvasubhiraṅgirobhiḥ |
iṣṭāpūrtamavatu naḥ pitṝṇāmāmuṃ dade harasā daivyena ||

verses.sanskrit:
द्यावा॑पृथिवी॒ अनु॒ मा दी॑धीथां॒ विश्वे॑ देवासो॒ अनु॒ मा र॑भध्वम् ।
अङ्गि॑रसः॒ पित॑रः॒ सोम्या॑सः पा॒पमार्छ॑त्वपका॒मस्य॑ क॒र्ता ॥
verses.transliteration:
dyāvāpṛthivī anu mā dīdhīthāṃ viśve devāso anu mā rabhadhvam |
aṅgirasaḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ pāpamārchatvapakāmasya kartā ||

verses.sanskrit:
अती॑व॒ यो म॑रुतो॒ मन्य॑ते नो॒ ब्रह्म॑ वा॒ यो निन्दि॑षत् क्रि॒यमा॑णम् ।
तपूं॑षि॒ तस्मै॑ वृजि॒नानि॑ सन्तु ब्रह्म॒द्विषं॒ द्यौर॑भि॒संत॑पाति ॥
verses.transliteration:
atīva yo maruto manyate no brahma vā yo nindiṣat kriyamāṇam |
tapūṃṣi tasmai vṛjināni santu brahmadviṣaṃ dyaurabhisaṃtapāti ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒प्त प्रा॒णान॒ष्टौ म॒न्यस्तांस्ते॑ वृश्चामि॒ ब्रह्म॑णा ।
अया॑ य॒मस्य॒ साद॑नम॒ग्निदू॑तो॒ अरं॑कृतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sapta prāṇānaṣṭau manyastāṃste vṛścāmi brahmaṇā |
ayā yamasya sādanamagnidūto araṃkṛtaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ द॑धामि ते प॒दं समि॑द्धे जा॒तवे॑दसि ।
अ॒ग्निः शरी॑रं वेवे॒ष्ट्वसुं॒ वागपि॑ गछतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā dadhāmi te padaṃ samiddhe jātavedasi |
agniḥ śarīraṃ veveṣṭvasuṃ vāgapi gachatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒युर्दा अ॑ग्ने ज॒रसं॑ वृणा॒नो घृ॒तप्र॑तीको घृ॒तपृ॑ष्ठो अग्ने ।
घृ॒तं पी॒त्वा मधु॒ चारु॒ गव्यं॑ पि॒तेव॑ पु॒त्रान॒भि र॑क्षतादि॒मम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
āyurdā agne jarasaṃ vṛṇāno ghṛtapratīko ghṛtapṛṣṭho agne |
ghṛtaṃ pītvā madhu cāru gavyaṃ piteva putrānabhi rakṣatādimam ||
verses.translation:
A youth’s Investiture ceremony (godānam)
Strength-giver, winning lengthened life, O Agni, with face and back shining with molten butter,
Drink thou the butter and fair milk and honey, and, as a sire his sons, keep this man safely.
For us surround him, cover him with splendour, give him long life, and death when age removes him.
The garment hath Brihaspati presented to Soma, to the King, to w rap about him.
Thou for our w eal hast clothed thee in the mantle: thou hast become our heifers’ guard from witchcraft.
Live thou a hundred full and plenteous autumns, and wrap thee in prosperity of riches.
Come hither, stand upon the stone: thy body shall become a stone.
The Universal Gods shall make thy life a hundred autumns long.
So may the Universal Gods protect thee, whom we divest of raiment worn aforetime.
So after thee, well-formed and growing stronger, be born a multitude of thriving brothers.

verses.sanskrit:
परि॑ धत्त ध॒त्त नो॒ वर्च॑से॒मं ज॒रामृ॑त्युं कृणुत दी॒र्घमायुः॑ ।
बृह॒स्पतिः॒ प्राय॑च्छ॒द् वास॑ ए॒तत् सोमा॑य॒ राज्ञे॒ परि॑धात॒वा उ॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pari dhatta dhatta no varcasemaṃ jarāmṛtyuṃ kṛṇuta dīrghamāyuḥ |
bṛhaspatiḥ prāyacchad vāsa etat somāya rājñe paridhātavā u ||

verses.sanskrit:
परी॒दं वासो॑ अधिथाः स्व॒स्तयेऽभू॑र्गृष्टी॒नाम॑भिशस्ति॒पा उ॑ ।
श॒तं च॒ जीव॑ श॒रदः॑ पुरू॒ची रा॒यश्च॒ पोष॑मुप॒संव्य॑यस्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
parīdaṃ vāso adhithāḥ svastaye'bhūrgṛṣṭīnāmabhiśastipā u |
śataṃ ca jīva śaradaḥ purūcī rāyaśca poṣamupasaṃvyayasva ||

verses.sanskrit:
एह्यश्मा॑न॒मा ति॒ष्ठाश्मा॑ भवतु ते त॒नूः ।
कृ॒ण्वन्तु॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वा आयु॑ष्टे श॒रदः॑ श॒तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ehyaśmānamā tiṣṭhāśmā bhavatu te tanūḥ |
kṛṇvantu viśve devā āyuṣṭe śaradaḥ śatam ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य॑ ते॒ वासः॑ प्रथमवा॒स्यं॑१ हरा॑म॒स्तं त्वा॒ विश्वे॑ऽवन्तु दे॒वाः ।
तं त्वा॒ भ्रात॑रः सु॒वृधा॒ वर्ध॑मान॒मनु॑ जातन्तां ब॒हवः॒ सुजा॑तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasya te vāsaḥ prathamavāsyaṃ harāmastaṃ tvā viśve'vantu devāḥ |
taṃ tvā bhrātaraḥ suvṛdhā vardhamānamanu jātantāṃ bahavaḥ sujātam ||

verses.sanskrit:
निः॒सालां धृ॒ष्णुं धि॒षण॑मेकवा॒द्यां जि॑घ॒त्स्वऽम् ।
सर्वा॒श्चण्ड॑स्य न॒प्त्योऽ ना॒शया॑मः स॒दान्वाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
niḥsālāṃ dhṛṣṇuṃ dhiṣaṇamekavādyāṃ jighatsva'm |
sarvāścaṇḍasya naptyo' nāśayāmaḥ sadānvāḥ ||
verses.translation:
A charm to banish vermin and noxious creatures
Forth from the hall the bold, the sharp, the greedy one, the single-voiced,
Sadānvās, and all progeny of Chanda we exterminate.
We drive you forth from cattle-shed, from axle, from within the wain,
Ye daughters of Magundi, we frighten and chase you from out homes.
Yonder let the Arāyis dwell, there where that house is down below.
Let utter indigence and all the Yātudhānis settle there.
May Bhūtapati drive away, and Indra, the Sadānvās hence.
Let Indra with his bolt quell those who sit upon our dwelling’s floor.
Whether ye be of farm and field, or whether ye be sent by men,
Or be ye sprung from Dasyu race, vanish, Sadānvās, and begone.
I have gone round their homes as runs a fleet-foot racer round the post,
And in all races conquered you. Vanish, Sadānvās, and begone.

verses.sanskrit:
निर्वो॑ गो॒ष्ठाद॑जामसि॒ निरक्षा॒न्निरु॑पान॒सात् ।
निर्वो॑ मगुन्द्या दुहितरो गृ॒हेभ्य॑श्चातयामहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
nirvo goṣṭhādajāmasi nirakṣānnirupānasāt |
nirvo magundyā duhitaro gṛhebhyaścātayāmahe ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒सौ यो अ॑ध॒राद् गृ॒हस्तत्र॑ सन्त्वरा॒य्यः ।
तत्र॑ से॒दिर्न्युऽच्यतु॒ सर्वा॑श्च यातुधा॒न्यः ॥
verses.transliteration:
asau yo adharād gṛhastatra santvarāyyaḥ |
tatra sedirnyu'cyatu sarvāśca yātudhānyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
भू॒त॒प॒तिर्निर॑ज॒त्विन्द्र॑श्चे॒तः स॒दान्वाः॑ ।
गृ॒हस्य॑ बु॒ध्न आसी॑ना॒स्ता इन्द्रो॒ वज्रे॒णाधि॑ तिष्ठतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhūtapatirnirajatvindraścetaḥ sadānvāḥ |
gṛhasya budhna āsīnāstā indro vajreṇādhi tiṣṭhatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
यदि॒ स्थ क्षे॑त्रि॒याणां॒ यदि॑ वा॒ पुरु॑षेषिताः ।
यदि॒ स्थ दस्यु॑भ्यो जा॒ता नश्य॑ते॒तः स॒दान्वाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadi stha kṣetriyāṇāṃ yadi vā puruṣeṣitāḥ |
yadi stha dasyubhyo jātā naśyatetaḥ sadānvāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
परि॒ धामा॑न्यासामा॒शुर्गाष्ठा॑मिवासरन् ।
अजै॑षं॒ सर्वा॑ना॒जीन्वो॒ नश्य॑ते॒तः स॒दान्वाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pari dhāmānyāsāmāśurgāṣṭhāmivāsaran |
ajaiṣaṃ sarvānājīnvo naśyatetaḥ sadānvāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: यथा॒ द्यौश्च॑ पृथि॒वी च॒ न बि॑भी॒तो न रिष्य॑तः । ए॒वा मे॑ प्राण॒ मा बि॑भेः ॥
verses.transliteration: yathā dyauśca pṛthivī ca na bibhīto na riṣyataḥ | evā me prāṇa mā bibheḥ ||
verses.translation:
A charm against fear
As Heaven and Earth are not afraid, and never suffer loss or harm,
Even so, my spirit, fear not thou.
As Day and Night are not afraid, nor ever suffer loss or harm,
Even so, my spirit, fear not thou.
As Sun and Moon are not afraid, nor ever suffer loss or harm.
Even so. my spirit, fear not thou.
As Brāhmanhood and Princely Power fear not, nor suffer loss, or harm,
Even so, my spirit, fear not thou.
As Truth and Falsehood have no fear, nor ever suffer loss or harm,
Even so, my spirit, fear not thou.
As What Hath Been and What Shall Be fear not, nor suffer loss or harm,
Even so, my spirit, fear not thou.

verses.sanskrit: यथाह॑श्च॒ रात्री॑ च॒ न बि॑भी॒तो न रिष्य॑तः । ए॒वा मे॑ प्राण॒ मा बि॑भेः ॥
verses.transliteration: yathāhaśca rātrī ca na bibhīto na riṣyataḥ | evā me prāṇa mā bibheḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: यथा॒ सूर्य॑श्च च॒न्द्रश्च॒ न बि॑भी॒तो न रिष्य॑तः । ए॒वा मे॑ प्राण॒ मा बि॑भेः ॥
verses.transliteration: yathā sūryaśca candraśca na bibhīto na riṣyataḥ | evā me prāṇa mā bibheḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: यथा॒ ब्रह्म॑ च क्ष॒त्रं च॒ न बि॑भी॒तो न रिष्य॑तः । ए॒वा मे॑ प्राण॒ मा बि॑भेः ॥
verses.transliteration: yathā brahma ca kṣatraṃ ca na bibhīto na riṣyataḥ | evā me prāṇa mā bibheḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: यथा॑ स॒त्यं चानृ॑तं च॒ न बि॑भी॒तो न रिष्य॑तः । ए॒वा मे॑ प्राण॒ मा बि॑भेः ॥
verses.transliteration: yathā satyaṃ cānṛtaṃ ca na bibhīto na riṣyataḥ | evā me prāṇa mā bibheḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: यथा॑ भू॒तं च॒ भव्यं॑ च॒ न बि॑भी॒तो न रिष्य॑तः । ए॒वा मे॑ प्राण॒ मा बि॑भेः ॥
verses.transliteration: yathā bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca na bibhīto na riṣyataḥ | evā me prāṇa mā bibheḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: प्राणा॑पानौ मृ॒त्योर्मा॑ पातं॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: prāṇāpānau mṛtyormā pātaṃ svāhā ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for general protection
Guard me from death, Inhaling and Exhaling! All bliss to you!
Guard me from overhearing, Earth and Heaven! All hail to you!
Do thou, O Sūrya, with thine eye protect me! All hail to thee!
Agni Vaisvānara, with all Gods preserve me! All hail to thee!
Preserve me with all care. O All-Sustainer! All hail to thee!

verses.sanskrit: द्यावा॑पृथिवी॒ उप॑श्रुत्या मा पातं॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: dyāvāpṛthivī upaśrutyā mā pātaṃ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: सूर्य॒ चक्षु॑षा मा पाहि॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: sūrya cakṣuṣā mā pāhi svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ वैश्वानर॒ विश्वै॑र्मा दे॒वैः पा॑हि॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: agne vaiśvānara viśvairmā devaiḥ pāhi svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: विश्वं॑भर॒ विश्वे॑न मा॒ भर॑सा पाहि॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: viśvaṃbhara viśvena mā bharasā pāhi svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: ओजो॒ऽस्योजो॑ मे दाः॒ स्वाहा॑  ॥
verses.transliteration: ojo'syojo me dāḥ svāhā  ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to an amulet for health and strength
Power art thou, give me power. All hail!
Might art thou, give me might. All hail!
Strength art thou, give me strength. All hail!
Life art thou, give me life. All hail!
Ear art thou, give me hearing! Hail!
Eye art thou, give me eyes. All hail!
Shield art thou, shield me well. All hail

verses.sanskrit: सहो॑ऽसि॒ सहो॑ मे दाः स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: saho'si saho me dāḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: बल॑मसि॒ बलं॑ मे दाः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: balamasi balaṃ me dāḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: आयु॑र॒स्यायु॑र्मे दाः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: āyurasyāyurme dāḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्र॑मसि॒ श्रोत्रं॑ मे दाः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: śrotramasi śrotraṃ me dāḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: चक्षु॑रसि॒ चक्षु॑र्मे दाः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: cakṣurasi cakṣurme dāḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: प॒रि॒पाण॑मसि परि॒पाणं॑ मे दाः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: paripāṇamasi paripāṇaṃ me dāḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: भ्रा॒तृ॒व्य॒क्षय॑णमसि भ्रातृव्य॒चात॑नं मे दाः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhrātṛvyakṣayaṇamasi bhrātṛvyacātanaṃ me dāḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation:
A charm against enemies, goblins, and other evil creatures
Destruction of the foe art thou, give me the scaring of my foes.
All hail!
The rival’s ruiner art thou, give me to drive my rivals off. All hail!
Arāyis’ ruiner art thou, give me to drive Arāyis off. All hail!
Pisa-chas’ ruiner art thou, give me to drive Pisāchas off. All hail!
Sadānvās’ ruiner art thou, give me to drive Sadānvās off. All hail!

verses.sanskrit: स॒प॒त्न॒क्षय॑णमसि सपत्न॒चात॑नं मे दाः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: sapatnakṣayaṇamasi sapatnacātanaṃ me dāḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: अ॒रा॒य॒क्षय॑णमस्यराय॒चात॑नं मे दाः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: arāyakṣayaṇamasyarāyacātanaṃ me dāḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: पि॒शा॒च॒क्षय॑णमसि पिशाच॒चात॑नं मे दाः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: piśācakṣayaṇamasi piśācacātanaṃ me dāḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: स॒दा॒न्वा॒क्षय॑णमसि सदान्वा॒चात॑नं मे दाः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: sadānvākṣayaṇamasi sadānvācātanaṃ me dāḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ यत् ते॒ तप॒स्तेन॒ तं प्रति॑ तप॒ यो॒३स्मान् द्वेष्टि॒ यं व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मः ॥
verses.transliteration: agne yat te tapastena taṃ prati tapa yosmān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to Agni for aid against an enemy
Burn thou, O Agni, with that heat of thine against the man who hates us, whom we hate.
Flame thou, O Agni, with that flame of thine against the man who hates us, whom we hate.
Shine out, O Agni, with that sheen of thine against the man who hates us, whom we hate.
Blaze thou, O Agni, with that blaze of thine against the man who hates us, whom we hate.
O Agni, with the splendour that is thine darken the man who hates us, whom we hate.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ यत् ते॒ हर॒स्तेन॒ तं प्रति॑ हर॒ यो॒३स्मान् द्वेष्टि॒ यं व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मः ॥
verses.transliteration: agne yat te harastena taṃ prati hara yosmān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ यत् ते॒ऽर्चिस्तेन॒ तं प्रत्य॑र्च॒ यो॒३स्मान् द्वेष्टि॒ यं व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मः ॥
verses.transliteration: agne yat te'rcistena taṃ pratyarca yosmān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: आपो॒ यद् व॒स्तेज॒स्तेन॒ तम॑ते॒जसं॑ कृणुत॒ यो॒३स्मान् द्वेष्टि॒ यं व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मः ॥
verses.transliteration: āpo yad vastejastena tamatejasaṃ kṛṇuta yosmān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
शेर॑भक॒ शेर॑भ॒ पुन॑र्वो यन्तु या॒तवः॒ पुन॑र्हे॒तिः कि॑मीदिनः ।
यस्य॒ स्थ तम॑त्त॒ यो वः॒ प्राहै॒त् तम॑त्त॒ स्वा मां॒सान्य॑त्त ॥
verses.transliteration:
śerabhaka śerabha punarvo yantu yātavaḥ punarhetiḥ kimīdinaḥ |
yasya stha tamatta yo vaḥ prāhait tamatta svā māṃsānyatta ||
verses.translation:
A charm against the magic arts of fiends
O Serabhaka, Serabha, back fall your arts of witchery! Back,
Kimidins! let your weapon fall.
Eat your possessor; eat ye him who sent you forth;
Srvridhaka, O Sevridha, back fall your arts of witchery! Back,
Kimidins! let your weapon fall, etc.
O Mroka, Anumroka, back return your arts of witchery! Back,
Kimidins! let your weapon fall, etc.
O Sarpa, Anusarpa, back return your arts of witchery! Back, ‘i Kimidins! let your weapon fall, etc.
Back fall your witcheries, Jūrni! back your weapon, ye Kimidinis, etc.
Back fall your spells, Upabdi! back your weapon, ye Kimidinis, etc.
Back fall your witchcrafts, Arjuni! your weapon, ye Kimidinis, etc,
Back, O, Bharūji! fall your charms, your weapon, ye Kimidinis.
Eat your possessor; eat ye him who sent you forth; eat your own flesh.

verses.sanskrit:
शेवृ॑धक॒ शेवृ॑ध॒ पुन॑र्वो यन्तु या॒तवः॒ पुन॑र्हे॒तिः कि॑मीदिनः ।
यस्य॒ स्थ तम॑त्त॒ यो वः प्राहै॒त् तम॑त्त॒ स्वा मां॒सान्य॑त्त ॥

भरू॑जि पुन॑र्वो यन्तु या॒तवः॒ पुन॑र्हे॒तिः कि॑मीदिनीः ।

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॑ दे॒वी पृ॑श्निप॒र्ण्यशं॒ निरृ॑त्या अकः ।
उ॒ग्रा हि क॑ण्व॒जम्भ॑नी॒ ताम॑भक्षि॒ सह॑स्वतीम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no devī pṛśniparṇyaśaṃ nirṛtyā akaḥ |
ugrā hi kaṇvajambhanī tāmabhakṣi sahasvatīm ||
verses.translation:
A charm against fiends who cause abortion
The Goddess Prisniparni hath blest us, and troubled Nirriti.
Fierce crusher of the Kanvas she: her have I gained, the mighty one.
Victorious in the olden time this Prisniparni was brought forth:
With her I cleave, as ‘twere a bird’s, the head of the Detestables.
The hateful fiend who drinks the blood, and him who take away the growth,
The Kanva who devours the germ, quell, Prisniparni! and! destroy.
Drive and imprison in a hill these Kanvas harassers of life:
Follow them Prisniparni, thou Goddess, like fire consuming. them.
Drive thou away these Kanvas, drive the harassers of life afar.
Whither the shades of darkness go, I send the fiends who feed on flesh.

verses.sanskrit:
सह॑माने॒यं प्र॑थ॒मा पृ॑श्निप॒र्ण्यऽजायत ।
तया॒हं दु॒र्णाम्नां॒ शिरो॑ वृ॒श्चामि॑ श॒कुने॑रिव ॥
verses.transliteration:
sahamāneyaṃ prathamā pṛśniparṇya'jāyata |
tayāhaṃ durṇāmnāṃ śiro vṛścāmi śakuneriva ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒राय॑मसृ॒क्पावा॑नं॒ यश्च॑ स्फा॒तिं जिही॑र्षति ।
ग॒र्भा॒दं कण्वं॑ नाशय॒ पृश्नि॑पर्णि॒ सह॑स्व च ॥
verses.transliteration:
arāyamasṛkpāvānaṃ yaśca sphātiṃ jihīrṣati |
garbhādaṃ kaṇvaṃ nāśaya pṛśniparṇi sahasva ca ||

verses.sanskrit:
गि॒रिमे॑नाँ॒ आ वे॑शय॒ कण्वा॑न् जीवित॒योप॑नान् ।
तांस्त्वं दे॑वि पृश्निपर्ण्य॒ग्निरि॑वानु॒दह॑न्निहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
girimenām̐ ā veśaya kaṇvān jīvitayopanān |
tāṃstvaṃ devi pṛśniparṇyagnirivānudahannihi ||

verses.sanskrit:
परा॑च एना॒न् प्र णु॑द॒ कण्वा॑न् जीवित॒योप॑नान् ।
तमां॑सि॒ यत्र॒ गच्छ॑न्ति॒ तत् क्र॒व्यादो॑ अजीगमम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
parāca enān pra ṇuda kaṇvān jīvitayopanān |
tamāṃsi yatra gacchanti tat kravyādo ajīgamam ||

verses.sanskrit:
एह य॑न्तु प॒शवो॒ ये प॑रे॒युर्वा॒युर्येषां॑ सहचा॒रं जु॒जोष॑ ।
त्वष्टा॒ येषां॑ रूप॒धेया॑नि वेदा॒स्मिन् तान् गो॒ष्ठे स॑वि॒ता नि य॑छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
eha yantu paśavo ye pareyurvāyuryeṣāṃ sahacāraṃ jujoṣa |
tvaṣṭā yeṣāṃ rūpadheyāni vedāsmin tān goṣṭhe savitā ni yachatu ||
verses.translation:
A benediction on homeward coming cattle
Let them come home, the cattle that have wandered, whom Vāyu hath delighted to attend on,
Whose forms and figures are well known to Tvashtar. These cows let Savitar drive within this stable.
Let the beasts stream together to this cow-pen. Brihaspati who knoweth lead them hither!
Let Sinivāli guide the foremost homeward. When they have come, Anumati! enclose them.
Together stream the cattle! stream together horses and the men!
Hitherward press all growth of grain! I offer sacrifice with mixt oblation.
I pour together milk of kine, with butter blending strength and juice.
Well sprinkled be our men, as true to me as cows are to their herd!
Hither I bring the milk of cows, hither have brought the juice of corn.
Hitherward have our men been brought, hitherward to this house our wives.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मं गो॒ष्ठं प॒शवः॒ सं स्र॑वन्तु॒ बृह॒स्पति॒रा न॑यतु प्रजा॒नन् ।
सि॒नी॒वा॒ली न॑य॒त्वाग्र॑मेषामाज॒ग्मुषो॑ अनुमते॒ नि य॑छ ॥
verses.transliteration:
imaṃ goṣṭhaṃ paśavaḥ saṃ sravantu bṛhaspatirā nayatu prajānan |
sinīvālī nayatvāgrameṣāmājagmuṣo anumate ni yacha ||

verses.sanskrit:
सं सं स्र॑वन्तु प॒शवः॒ समश्वाः॒ समु॒ पूरु॑षाः ।
सं धा॒न्यऽस्य॒ या स्फा॒तिः सं॑स्रा॒व्येऽण ह॒विषा॑ जुहोमि ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ saṃ sravantu paśavaḥ samaśvāḥ samu pūruṣāḥ |
saṃ dhānya'sya yā sphātiḥ saṃsrāvye'ṇa haviṣā juhomi ||

verses.sanskrit:
सं सि॑ञ्चामि॒ गवां॑ क्षी॒रं समाज्ये॑न॒ बलं॒ रसम् ।
संसि॑क्ता अ॒स्माकं॑ वी॒रा ध्रु॒वा गावो॒ मयि॒ गोप॑तौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ siñcāmi gavāṃ kṣīraṃ samājyena balaṃ rasam |
saṃsiktā asmākaṃ vīrā dhruvā gāvo mayi gopatau ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ ह॑रामि॒ गवां॑ क्षी॒रमाहा॑र्षं धा॒न्यं॑१ रस॑म् ।
आहृ॑ता अ॒स्माकं॑ वी॒रा आ पत्नी॑रि॒दमस्त॑कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā harāmi gavāṃ kṣīramāhārṣaṃ dhānyaṃ rasam |
āhṛtā asmākaṃ vīrā ā patnīridamastakam ||

verses.sanskrit:
नेच्छत्रुः॒ प्राशं॑ जयाति॒ सह॑मानाभि॒भूर॑सि ।
प्राशं॒ प्रति॑प्राशो जह्यर॒सान् कृ॑न्वोषधे ॥
verses.transliteration:
necchatruḥ prāśaṃ jayāti sahamānābhibhūrasi |
prāśaṃ pratiprāśo jahyarasān kṛnvoṣadhe ||
verses.translation:
A charm against an opponent in debate
Let not the enemy win the cause! Strong and predominant art thou.
Refute mine adversary’s speech. Render them dull and flat, O Plant.
The strong-winged bird discovered thee, the boar unearthed thee with his snout.
Refute mine adversary’s speech. Render them dull and flat, O Plant.
Yea, Indra laid thee on his arm, to cast the Asuras to the ground.
Refute mine adversary’s speech. Render them dull and flat, O Plant.
Indra devoured the Pātā plant that he might lay the Asuras low.
Refute mine adversary’s speech! Render them dull and flat, O Plant.
With this I overcome my foes as Indra overcame the wolves.
Refute mine adversary’s speech! Render them dull and flat, O Plant.
O Rudra, Lord of Healing Balms, dark-crested, skilful in thy work!—
Refute mine adversary’s speech. Render them dull and flat, O Plant.
Indra, defeat the speech of him who meets us with hostility.
Comfort us with thy power and might. Make me superior in debate.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒प॒र्णस्त्वान्व॑विन्दत् सूक॒रस्त्वा॑खनन्न॒सा ।
प्राशं॒ प्रति॑प्राशो जह्यर॒सान् कृ॑ण्वोषधे ॥
verses.transliteration:
suparṇastvānvavindat sūkarastvākhanannasā |
prāśaṃ pratiprāśo jahyarasān kṛṇvoṣadhe ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रो॑ ह चक्रे त्वा बा॒हावसु॑रेभ्य॒ स्तरी॑तवे ।
प्राशं॒ प्रति॑प्राशो जह्यर॒सान् कृ॑ण्वोषधे ॥
verses.transliteration:
indro ha cakre tvā bāhāvasurebhya starītave |
prāśaṃ pratiprāśo jahyarasān kṛṇvoṣadhe ||

verses.sanskrit:
पा॒टामिन्द्रो॒ व्याऽश्ना॒दसु॑रेभ्य॒ स्तरी॑तवे ।
प्राशं॒ प्रति॑प्राशो जह्यर॒सान् कृ॑ण्वोषधे ॥
verses.transliteration:
pāṭāmindro vyā'śnādasurebhya starītave |
prāśaṃ pratiprāśo jahyarasān kṛṇvoṣadhe ||

verses.sanskrit:
तया॒हं शत्रू॑न्त्साक्ष॒ इन्द्रः॑ सालावृ॒काँ इ॑व ।
प्राशं॒ प्रति॑प्राशो जह्यर॒सान् कृ॑ण्वोषधे ॥
verses.transliteration:
tayāhaṃ śatrūntsākṣa indraḥ sālāvṛkām̐ iva |
prāśaṃ pratiprāśo jahyarasān kṛṇvoṣadhe ||

verses.sanskrit:
रुद्र॒ जला॑षभेषज॒ नील॑शिखण्ड॒ कर्म॑कृत् ।
प्राशं॒ प्रति॑प्राशो जह्यर॒सान् कृ॑ण्वोषधे ॥
verses.transliteration:
rudra jalāṣabheṣaja nīlaśikhaṇḍa karmakṛt |
prāśaṃ pratiprāśo jahyarasān kṛṇvoṣadhe ||

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य॒ प्राशं॒ त्वं ज॑हि॒ यो न॑ इन्द्राभि॒दास॑ति ।
अधि॑ नो ब्रूहि॒ शक्ति॑भिः प्रा॒शि मामुत्त॑रं कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration:
tasya prāśaṃ tvaṃ jahi yo na indrābhidāsati |
adhi no brūhi śaktibhiḥ prāśi māmuttaraṃ kṛdhi ||

verses.sanskrit:
तुभ्य॑मे॒व ज॑रिमन् वर्धताम॒यं मेमम॒न्ये मृ॒त्यवो॑ हिंसिषुः श॒तं ये॑ ।
मा॒तेव॒ पु॒त्रं प्रम॑ना उ॒पस्थे॑ मि॒त्र ए॑नं मि॒त्रिया॑त् पा॒त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tubhyameva jariman vardhatāmayaṃ memamanye mṛtyavo hiṃsiṣuḥ śataṃ ye |
māteva putraṃ pramanā upasthe mitra enaṃ mitriyāt pātvaṃhasaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for a boy’s long and happy life
This Child, Old Age! shall grow to meet thee only: none of the hundred other deaths shall harm him.
From trouble caused by friends let Mitra guard him, as a kind mother guards the son she nurses.
Mitra or Varuna the foe-destroyer, accordant, grant him death in course of nature!
Thus Agni, Hotar-priest, skilled in high statutes, declareth all the deities’ generations.
Thou art the Lord of all terrestrial cattle, of cattle born and to be born hereafter.
Let not breath drawn or breath emitted fail him. Let not his friends, let not his foemen slay him.
Let Heaven thy father and let Earth thy mother, accordant, give thee death in course of nature,
That thou mayst live on Aditi’s bosom, guarded, a hundred winters, through thy respirations.
Lead him to life, O Agni, and to splendour, this dear child,
Varuna! and thou King Mitra!
Give him protection, Aditi! as a mother; All Gods, that his be life of long duration;

verses.sanskrit:
मि॒त्र एनं॒ वरु॑णो वा रि॒शादा॑ ज॒रामृ॑त्युं कृणुतां संविदा॒नौ ।
तद॒ग्निर्होता॑ व॒युना॑नि विद्वान् विश्वा॑ दे॒वानां॒ जनि॑मा विवक्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
mitra enaṃ varuṇo vā riśādā jarāmṛtyuṃ kṛṇutāṃ saṃvidānau |
tadagnirhotā vayunāni vidvān viśvā devānāṃ janimā vivakti ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमी॑शिषे पशू॒नां पार्थि॑वानां॒ ये जा॒ता उ॒त वा॒ ये ज॒नित्राः॑ ।
मेमं प्रा॒णो हा॑सी॒न्मो अ॑पा॒नो मेमं मि॒त्रा व॑धिषु॒र्मो अ॒मित्राः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvamīśiṣe paśūnāṃ pārthivānāṃ ye jātā uta vā ye janitrāḥ |
memaṃ prāṇo hāsīnmo apāno memaṃ mitrā vadhiṣurmo amitrāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
द्यौष्ट्वा॑ पि॒ता पृ॑थि॒वी मा॒ता ज॒रामृ॑त्युं कृणुतां संविदा॒ने ।
यथा॒ जीवा॒ अदि॑तेरु॒पस्थे॑ प्राणापा॒नाभ्यां॑ गुपि॒तः श॒तं हिमाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
dyauṣṭvā pitā pṛthivī mātā jarāmṛtyuṃ kṛṇutāṃ saṃvidāne |
yathā jīvā aditerupasthe prāṇāpānābhyāṃ gupitaḥ śataṃ himāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मम॑ग्ने॒ आयु॑षे॒ वर्च॑से नय प्रि॒यं रेतो॑ वरुण मित्रराजन् ।
मा॒तेवा॑स्मा अदिते॒ शर्म॑ यच्छ॒ विश्वे॑ देवा ज॒रद॑ष्टि॒र्य॑थास॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
imamagne āyuṣe varcase naya priyaṃ reto varuṇa mitrarājan |
mātevāsmā adite śarma yaccha viśve devā jaradaṣṭiryathāsat ||

verses.sanskrit:
पार्थि॑वस्य॒ रसे॑ देवा॒ भग॑स्य त॒न्वो॒३ बले॑ ।
आ॒यु॒ष्यऽम॒स्मा अ॒ग्निः सूर्यो वर्च॒ आ धा॒द् बृह॒स्पतिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pārthivasya rase devā bhagasya tanvo bale |
āyuṣya'masmā agniḥ sūryo varca ā dhād bṛhaspatiḥ ||
verses.translation:
A benediction on a sick man
Gods, give him all that earth hath best with bodily strength and happy fate.
Agni and Sūrya grant him life, Brihaspati give him eminence!
Bestow thou life on him, O Jātavedas. Store him with future progeny, O Tvashtar.
Send him, O Savitar, full growth of riches. Let this thy servant live a hundred autumns.
May this our prayer bring strength and goodly offspring. Give, both of you one-minded, strength and riches.
Let him with might win fields and victory, Indra! setting beneath his feet the rest, his rivals.
As Indra’s gift, by Varuna instructed the fierce one came to us sent by the Maruts.
Let him, O Heaven and Earth, rest in your bosom. Let him not hunger, let him not be thirsty.
Ye twain endowed with vigour, grant him vigour. Ye who are rich in milk, give milk to feed him.
These twain have given him vigour, Earth and Heaven, and all the Gods, the Maruts, and the Waters.
With health-bestowing drops thine heart I comfort: all-bright again, and undiseased, enjoy them.
Drest in like robes let these two drink the mixture, wearing the Asvins’ form as an illusion.
Erst Indra, wounded, made this strengthening portion, eternal food: thine is it, here presented.
With this live full of vigour through the autumns. Let not thy strength be drained. Leeches have helped thee.

verses.sanskrit:
आयु॑र॒स्मै धे॑हि जातवेदः प्रजां त्व॑ष्टरधि॒निधे॑ह्य॒स्मै ।
रा॒यस्पोषं॑ सवित॒रा सु॑वा॒स्मै श॒तं जी॑वाति श॒रद॒स्तवा॒यम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
āyurasmai dhehi jātavedaḥ prajāṃ tvaṣṭaradhinidhehyasmai |
rāyaspoṣaṃ savitarā suvāsmai śataṃ jīvāti śaradastavāyam ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒शीर्ण॒ ऊर्ज॑मु॒त सौ॑प्रजा॒स्त्वं दक्षं॑ धत्तं॒ द्रवि॑णं॒ सचे॑तसौ ।
जयं॒ क्षेत्रा॑णि॒ सह॑सा॒यमि॑न्द्र कृण्वा॒नो अ॒न्यानध॑रान्त्स॒पत्ना॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
āśīrṇa ūrjamuta sauprajāstvaṃ dakṣaṃ dhattaṃ draviṇaṃ sacetasau |
jayaṃ kṣetrāṇi sahasāyamindra kṛṇvāno anyānadharāntsapatnān ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रे॑ण द॒त्तो वरु॑णेन शि॒ष्टो म॒रुद्भि॑रु॒ग्रः प्रहि॑तो न॒ आग॑न् ।
ए॒ष वां॑ द्यावापृथिवी उ॒पस्थे॒ मा क्षु॑ध॒न्मा तृ॑षत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indreṇa datto varuṇena śiṣṭo marudbhirugraḥ prahito na āgan |
eṣa vāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī upasthe mā kṣudhanmā tṛṣat ||

verses.sanskrit:
ऊर्ज॑मस्मा ऊर्जस्वती धत्तं॒ पयो॑ अस्मै पयस्वती धत्तम् ।
ऊर्ज॑म॒स्मै द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॑धातां॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वा म॒रुत॒ ऊर्ज॒मापः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ūrjamasmā ūrjasvatī dhattaṃ payo asmai payasvatī dhattam |
ūrjamasmai dyāvāpṛthivī adhātāṃ viśve devā maruta ūrjamāpaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
शि॒वाभि॑ष्टे॒ हृद॑यं तर्पयाम्यनमी॒वो मो॑दिषीष्ठाः सु॒वर्चाः॑ ।
स॒वा॒सिनौ॑ पिबतां म॒न्थमे॒तम॒श्विनो॑ रू॒पं प॑रि॒धाय॑ मा॒याम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śivābhiṣṭe hṛdayaṃ tarpayāmyanamīvo modiṣīṣṭhāḥ suvarcāḥ |
savāsinau pibatāṃ manthametamaśvino rūpaṃ paridhāya māyām ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑ ए॒तां स॑सृजे विद्धो अग्र॑ ऊ॒र्जां स्व॒धाम॒जरां॒ सा त॑ ए॒षा ।
तया॒ त्वं जी॑व श॒रदः॑ सु॒वर्चा॒ मा त॒ आ सु॑स्रोद् भि॒षज॑स्ते अक्रन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indra etāṃ sasṛje viddho agra ūrjāṃ svadhāmajarāṃ sā ta eṣā |
tayā tvaṃ jīva śaradaḥ suvarcā mā ta ā susrod bhiṣajaste akran ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथे॒दं भूम्या॒ अधि॒ तृणं॒ वातो॑ मथा॒य॑ति ।
ए॒वा म॑थ्नामि ते मनो॒ यथा॒ मां का॒मिन्यसो॒ यथा॒ मन्नाप॑गा॒ असः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathedaṃ bhūmyā adhi tṛṇaṃ vāto mathāyati |
evā mathnāmi te mano yathā māṃ kāminyaso yathā mannāpagā asaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A man’s love-charm
As the wind shake this Tuft of Grass hither and thither on the ground.
So do I stir and shake thy mind, that thou mayst be in love with me, my darling, never to depart.
Ye, Asvins, lead together, ye unite and bring the loving pair.
Now have the fortunes of you twain, now have your vows and spirits met.
When eagles, calling out aloud, are screaming in the joy of health,
Then to my calling let her come, as to the arrow’s neck the shaft.
Let what is inward turn outside, let what is outward be within:
Seize and possess, O Plant, the mind of maidens rich in every charm.
Seeking a husband she hath come! and I came longing for a wife:
Even as a loudly-neighing steed may fate and fortune have I met.

verses.sanskrit:
सं चेन्नया॑थो अश्विना का॒मिना॒ सं च॒ वक्ष॑थः ।
सं वां॒ भगा॑सो अग्मत॒ सं चि॒त्तानि॒ समु॑ व्र॒ता ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ cennayātho aśvinā kāminā saṃ ca vakṣathaḥ |
saṃ vāṃ bhagāso agmata saṃ cittāni samu vratā ||

verses.sanskrit:
यत् सु॑प॒र्णा वि॑व॒क्षवो॑ अनमी॒वा वि॑व॒क्षवः॑ ।
तत्र॑ मे गछता॒द्धवं॑ श॒ल्य इ॑व॒ कुल्म॑लं॒ यथा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yat suparṇā vivakṣavo anamīvā vivakṣavaḥ |
tatra me gachatāddhavaṃ śalya iva kulmalaṃ yathā ||

verses.sanskrit:
यदन्त॑रं॒ तद् बाह्यं॒ यद् बाह्यं॒ तदन्त॑रम् ।
क॒न्याऽनां वि॒श्वरू॑पाणां॒ मनो॑ गृभायौषधे ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadantaraṃ tad bāhyaṃ yad bāhyaṃ tadantaram |
kanyā'nāṃ viśvarūpāṇāṃ mano gṛbhāyauṣadhe ||

verses.sanskrit:
एयम॑ग॒न् पति॑कामा॒ जनि॑कामो॒ऽहमाग॑मम् ।
अश्वः॒ कनि॑क्रद॒द् यथा॒ भगे॑ना॒हं स॒हाग॑मम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
eyamagan patikāmā janikāmo'hamāgamam |
aśvaḥ kanikradad yathā bhagenāhaṃ sahāgamam ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ या म॒ही दृ॒षत् क्रिमे॒र्विश्व॑स्य॒ तर्ह॑णी ।
तया॑ पिनष्मि॒ सं क्रिमी॑न् दृ॒षदा॒ खल्वाँ॑ इव ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrasya yā mahī dṛṣat krimerviśvasya tarhaṇī |
tayā pinaṣmi saṃ krimīn dṛṣadā khalvām̐ iva ||
verses.translation:
A charm against all sorts of worms
With Indra’s mighty millstone, that which crushes worms of every sort,
I bray and bruise the worms to bits like vetches on the grinding stone.
The Seen and the Invisible, and the Kurūru have I crushed:
Alāndus, and all Chhalunas, we bruise to pieces with our spell.
I kill Alāndus with a mighty weapon: burnt or not burnt they now have lost their vigour .
Left or not left, I with the spell subdue them: let not a single worm remain uninjured.
The worm that lives within the ribs, within the bowels, in the head.
Avaskava and Borer, these we bruise to pieces with the spell.
Worms that are found on mountains, in the forests, that live in plants, in cattle, in the waters,
Those that have made their way within our bodies,—these I destroy, the worms’ whole generation.

verses.sanskrit:
दृ॒ष्टम॒दृष्ट॑मतृह॒मथो॑ कु॒रूरु॑मतृहम् ।
अ॒ल्गण्डू॒न्त्सर्वा॑न् छ॒लुना॒न् क्रिमी॒न् वच॑सा जम्भयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭamatṛhamatho kurūrumatṛham |
algaṇḍūntsarvān chalunān krimīn vacasā jambhayāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ल्गण्डू॑न् हन्मि मह॒ता व॒धेन॑ दू॒ना अदू॑ना अर॒सा अ॑भूवन् ।
शि॒ष्टानशि॑ष्टा॒न् नि ति॑रामि वा॒चा यथा॒ क्रिमी॑णां॒ नकि॑रु॒च्छिषा॑तै ॥
verses.transliteration:
algaṇḍūn hanmi mahatā vadhena dūnā adūnā arasā abhūvan |
śiṣṭānaśiṣṭān ni tirāmi vācā yathā krimīṇāṃ nakirucchiṣātai ||

verses.sanskrit:
अन्वा॑न्त्र्यं शीर्ष॒ण्य॑१मथो॒ पार्ष्टे॑यं॒ क्रिमी॑न् ।
अ॒व॒स्क॒वं व्य॑ध्व॒रं क्रिमी॒न् वच॑सा जम्भयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
anvāntryaṃ śīrṣaṇyamatho pārṣṭeyaṃ krimīn |
avaskavaṃ vyadhvaraṃ krimīn vacasā jambhayāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये क्रिम॑यः॒ पर्व॑तेशु॒ वने॒ष्वोष॑धीषु प॒शुष्व॒प्स्व॑१न्तः ।
ये अ॒स्माकं॑ त॒न्वऽमाविवि॒शुः सर्वं॒ तद्ध॑न्मि॒ जनि॑म॒ क्रिमी॑णाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye krimayaḥ parvateśu vaneṣvoṣadhīṣu paśuṣvapsvantaḥ |
ye asmākaṃ tanva'māviviśuḥ sarvaṃ taddhanmi janima krimīṇām ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒द्यन्ना॑दि॒त्यः क्रिमी॑न् हन्तु नि॒म्रोच॑न् हन्तु र॒श्मिभिः॑ ।
ये अ॒न्तः क्रिम॑यो॒ गवि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
udyannādityaḥ krimīn hantu nimrocan hantu raśmibhiḥ |
ye antaḥ krimayo gavi ||
verses.translation:
A charm against worms or bots in cows
Uprising let the Sun destroy, and when he sinketh, with his beams.
The Worms that live within the cow.
The four-eyed worm, of every shape, the variegated, and the white I break and crush the creature’s ribs, and tear away its head besides.
Like Atri I destroy you, Worms! in Kanva’s, Jamadagni’s way:
I bray and bruise the creeping things to pieces with Agastya’s• spell.
Slain is the sovran of these Worms, yea, their controlling lord is slain:
Slain is the Worm, his mother slain, brother and sister both are slain.
Slain are his ministers, and slain his followers and retinue:
Yes, those that seemed the tiniest things, the Worms have all been put to death.
I break in pieces both thy horns wherewith thou pushest here and there:
I cleave and rend the bag which holds the venom which is stored in thee.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒श्वरू॑पं चतुर॒क्षं क्रिमिं॑ सा॒रङ्ग॒मर्जु॑नम् ।
शृ॒णाम्य॑स्य पृ॒ष्टीरपि॑ वृश्चामि॒ यच्छिरः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvarūpaṃ caturakṣaṃ krimiṃ sāraṅgamarjunam |
śṛṇāmyasya pṛṣṭīrapi vṛścāmi yacchiraḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒त्रि॒वद् वः॑ क्रिमयो हन्मि कण्व॒वज्ज॑मदग्नि॒वत् ।
अ॒गस्त्य॑स्य॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ सं पि॑नष्म्य॒हं क्रिमी॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
atrivad vaḥ krimayo hanmi kaṇvavajjamadagnivat |
agastyasya brahmaṇā saṃ pinaṣmyahaṃ krimīn ||

verses.sanskrit:
ह॒तो राजा॒ क्रिमी॑णामु॒तैषां॑ स्थ॒पति॑र्ह॒तः ।
ह॒तो ह॒तमा॑ता॒ क्रिमि॑र्ह॒तभ्रा॑ता ह॒तस्व॑सा ॥
verses.transliteration:
hato rājā krimīṇāmutaiṣāṃ sthapatirhataḥ |
hato hatamātā krimirhatabhrātā hatasvasā ||

verses.sanskrit:
ह॒तासो॑ अस्य वे॒शसो॑ ह॒तासः॒ परि॑वेशसः ।
अथो॒ ये क्षु॑ल्ल॒का इ॑व॒ सर्वे॒ ते क्रिम॑यो ह॒ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
hatāso asya veśaso hatāsaḥ pariveśasaḥ |
atho ye kṣullakā iva sarve te krimayo hatāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र ते॑ शृणामि॒ शृङ्गे॒ याभ्यां॑ वितुदा॒यसि॑ ।
भि॒नाद्मि॑ ते कु॒षुम्भं॒ यस्ते॑ विष॒धानः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra te śṛṇāmi śṛṅge yābhyāṃ vitudāyasi |
bhinādmi te kuṣumbhaṃ yaste viṣadhānaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒क्षीभ्यां॑ ते॒ नासि॑काभ्यां॒ कर्णा॑भ्यां छुबु॑का॒दधि॑ ।
यक्ष्मं॑ शीर्ष॒ण्यं ऽ म॒स्तिष्का॑ज्जि॒ह्वाया॒ वि वृ॑हामि ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
akṣībhyāṃ te nāsikābhyāṃ karṇābhyāṃ chubukādadhi |
yakṣmaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ ' mastiṣkājjihvāyā vi vṛhāmi te ||
verses.translation:
From both thy nostrils, from both eyes, from both thine ears, and from thy chin,
Forth from thy brain and tongue I root Consumption seated in thy head.
Forth from the neck and from the nape, from dorsal vertebrae and spine.
From arms and shoulder-blades I root Consumption seated in thine arms.
Forth from thy heart and from thy lungs, from thy gall-bladder and thy sides,
From kidneys, spleen and liver thy Consumption we eradicate.
From bowels and intestines, from the rectum and the belly, I Extirpate thy Consumption, from flanks, navel and mesentery.
Forth from thy thighs and from thy knees, heels and the fore-parts of thy feet.
Forth from thy loins and hips I draw Consumption setted in thy loins.
Forth from thy marrows and thy bones, forth from thy tendons and thy veins I banish thy Consumption, from thy hands, thy fingers, and thy nails.
In every member, every hair, in every joint wherein it lies,
We with the exorcising spell of Kasyapa drive far away Con-sumption settled in thy skin.

verses.sanskrit:
ग्री॒वाभ्य॑स्त उ॒ष्णिहा॑भ्यः॒ कीक॑साभ्यो अनू॒क्याऽत् ।
यक्ष्मं॑ दोष॒ण्य॑१मंसा॑भ्यां बा॒हुभ्यां॒ वि वृ॑हामि ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
grīvābhyasta uṣṇihābhyaḥ kīkasābhyo anūkyā't |
yakṣmaṃ doṣaṇyamaṃsābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ vi vṛhāmi te ||

verses.sanskrit:
हृद॑यात् ते॒ परि॑ क्लो॒म्नो हली॑क्ष्णात् पा॒र्श्वाभ्या॑म् ।
यक्ष्मं॒ मत॑स्नाभ्यां प्ली॒ह्नो य॒क्नस्ते॒ वि वृ॑हामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
hṛdayāt te pari klomno halīkṣṇāt pārśvābhyām |
yakṣmaṃ matasnābhyāṃ plīhno yaknaste vi vṛhāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒न्त्रेभ्य॑स्ते॒ गुदा॑भ्यो वनि॒ष्ठोरु॒दरा॒दधि॑ ।
यक्ष्मं॑ कु॒क्षिभ्यां॑ प्ला॒शेर्नाभ्या॒ वि वृ॑हामि ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
āntrebhyaste gudābhyo vaniṣṭhorudarādadhi |
yakṣmaṃ kukṣibhyāṃ plāśernābhyā vi vṛhāmi te ||

verses.sanskrit:
ऊ॒रुभ्यां॑ ते अष्ठी॒वद्भ्यां॒ पार्ष्णिभ्यां॒ प्रप॑दाभ्याम् ।
यक्ष्मं॑ भस॒द्यं॑१ श्रोणि॑भ्यां॒ भास॑दं॒ भंस॑सो॒ वि वृ॑हामि ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
ūrubhyāṃ te aṣṭhīvadbhyāṃ pārṣṇibhyāṃ prapadābhyām |
yakṣmaṃ bhasadyaṃ śroṇibhyāṃ bhāsadaṃ bhaṃsaso vi vṛhāmi te ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒स्थिभ्य॑स्ते म॒ज्जभ्यः॒ स्नाव॑भ्यो ध॒मनि॑भ्यः ।
यक्ष्मं॑ पा॒णिभ्या॑म॒ङ्गुलि॑भ्यो न॒खेभ्यो॒ वि वृ॑हामि ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
asthibhyaste majjabhyaḥ snāvabhyo dhamanibhyaḥ |
yakṣmaṃ pāṇibhyāmaṅgulibhyo nakhebhyo vi vṛhāmi te ||

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गे॑अङ्गे॒ लोम्नि॑लोम्नि॒ यस्ते॒ पर्व॑णिपर्वणि ।
यक्ष्मं॑ त्वचस्य ऽ ते व॒यं क॒श्यप॑स्य वीब॒र्हेण॒ विष्व॑ञ्चं॒ वि वृ॑हामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
aṅgeaṅge lomnilomni yaste parvaṇiparvaṇi |
yakṣmaṃ tvacasya ' te vayaṃ kaśyapasya vībarheṇa viṣvañcaṃ vi vṛhāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
य ईशे॑ पशु॒पतिः॑ पशू॒नां चतु॑ष्पदामु॒त यो द्वि॒पदा॑म् ।
निष्क्री॑तः॒ स य॒ज्ञियं॑ भा॒गमे॑तु रा॒यस्पोषा॒ यज॑मानं सचन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya īśe paśupatiḥ paśūnāṃ catuṣpadāmuta yo dvipadām |
niṣkrītaḥ sa yajñiyaṃ bhāgametu rāyaspoṣā yajamānaṃ sacantām ||
verses.translation:
A prayer accompanying an animal sacrifice
May this, of all the beasts that Pasupati rules, Lord of animals,. quadruped and biped,
Come, purchased, to the sacrificial portion. May growth of wealth attend the sacrificer.
Loosing the seed of future-time existence, give good success, O Gods, to him who worships.
May what is present, duly brought, the victim, go to the deities’ beloved region.
Those who are looking, deep in meditation, on the bound ani-mal with eye and spirit To them, the first, may Agni, God, give freedom, rejoicing in his creatures, Visvakarman.
Tame animals of every shape, though varied in colour, manifold. alike in nature To them, the first, may Vāyu, God, give freedom, Prajāpati. rejoicing in his creatures.
Let those who know receive before all others the vital breath proceeding from the body.
Go to the sky. Stay there with all thy members. By paths which Gods have travelled go to Svarga.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒मु॒ञ्चन्तो॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ रेतो॑ गा॒तुं ध॑त्त॒ यज॑मानाय देवाः ।
उ॒पाकृ॑तं शशमा॒नं यदस्था॑त् प्रि॒यं दे॒वाना॒मप्ये॑तु॒ पाथः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pramuñcanto bhuvanasya reto gātuṃ dhatta yajamānāya devāḥ |
upākṛtaṃ śaśamānaṃ yadasthāt priyaṃ devānāmapyetu pāthaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये ब॒ध्यमा॑न॒मनु॒ दीध्या॑ना अ॒न्वैक्ष॑न्त॒ मन॑सा॒ चक्षु॑षा च ।
अ॒ग्निष्टानग्रे॒ प्र मु॑मोक्तु दे॒वो वि॒श्वक॑र्मा प्र॒जया॑ संररा॒णः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye badhyamānamanu dīdhyānā anvaikṣanta manasā cakṣuṣā ca |
agniṣṭānagre pra mumoktu devo viśvakarmā prajayā saṃrarāṇaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये ग्रा॒म्याः प॒शवो॑ वि॒श्वरू॑पा विरू॑पाः सन्तो॑ बहु॒धैक॑रूपाः ।
वा॒युष्टानग्रे॒ प्र मु॑मोक्तु दे॒वः प्र॒जाप॑तिः प्र॒जया॑ संररा॒णः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye grāmyāḥ paśavo viśvarūpā virūpāḥ santo bahudhaikarūpāḥ |
vāyuṣṭānagre pra mumoktu devaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃrarāṇaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒जा॒नन्तः॒ प्रति॑ गृह्णन्तु॒ पूर्वे॑ प्रा॒णमङ्गे॑भ्यः॒ पर्या॒चर॑न्तम् ।
दिवं॑ गच्छ॒ प्रति॑ तिष्ठा॒ शरी॑रैः स्व॒र्गं या॑हि प॒थिभि॑र्देव॒यानैः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
prajānantaḥ prati gṛhṇantu pūrve prāṇamaṅgebhyaḥ paryācarantam |
divaṃ gaccha prati tiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ svargaṃ yāhi pathibhirdevayānaiḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये भ॒क्षय॑न्तो॒ न वसू॑न्यानृ॒धुर्यान॒ग्नयो॑ अ॒न्वत॑प्यन्त॒ धिष्ण्याः॑ ।
या तेषा॑मव॒या दुरि॑ष्टिः॒ स्विऽष्टिं न॒स्तां कृ॑णवद् वि॒श्वक॑र्मा ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye bhakṣayanto na vasūnyānṛdhuryānagnayo anvatapyanta dhiṣṇyāḥ |
yā teṣāmavayā duriṣṭiḥ svi'ṣṭiṃ nastāṃ kṛṇavad viśvakarmā ||
verses.translation:
Expiation for an imperfectly performed sacrifice
We who enjoying it have grown no richer, for whom the sacred altar-fires have sorrowed,
We who compounded with deficient worship,—may Visvakarman make our service prosper.
Rishis have called the sacrifice’s patron amerced through sin, sorrowing for his offspring.
Those drops of meath whereof the missed enjoyment,—may Visvakarman with those drops unite us.
Regarding niggard churls as Soma-drinkers, skilful in sacrifice, weak at the meeting,
Whatever sin the captive hath committed, do thou for weal release him, Visvakarman!
Awful are Rishis: unto them be homage, and to their eye and truthfulness of spirit!
Loud homage to Brihaspati, O mighty! Homage to thee, O Visvakarman! Guard us.
The eye of sacrifice, source, and beginning—with voice, ear, spirit unto him I offer.
To this our sacrifice wrought by Visvakarman may the Gods come gracious and kindlyhearted.

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञप॑ति॒मृष॑यः॒ एन॑साहु॒र्निर्भ॑क्तं प्र॒जा अ॑नुत॒प्यमा॑नम् ।
म॒थ॒व्या॒ऽन्त्स्तो॒कानप॒ यान् र॒राध॒ सं न॒ष्टेभिः॑ सृजतु वि॒श्वक॑र्मा ॥
verses.transliteration:
yajñapatimṛṣayaḥ enasāhurnirbhaktaṃ prajā anutapyamānam |
mathavyā'ntstokānapa yān rarādha saṃ naṣṭebhiḥ sṛjatu viśvakarmā ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒दा॒न्यान्त्सो॑म॒पान् मन्य॑मानो य॒ज्ञस्य॑ वि॒द्वान्त्स॑म॒ये न धीरः॑ ।
यदेन॑श्चकृ॒वान् ब॒द्ध ए॒ष तं वि॑श्वकर्म॒न् प्र मु॑ञ्चा स्व॒स्तये॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
adānyāntsomapān manyamāno yajñasya vidvāntsamaye na dhīraḥ |
yadenaścakṛvān baddha eṣa taṃ viśvakarman pra muñcā svastaye ||

verses.sanskrit:
घो॒रा ऋष॑यो॒ नमो॑ अस्त्वेभ्य॒श्चक्षु॒र्यदे॑षां॒ मन॑सश्च स॒त्यम् ।
बृह॒स्पत॑ये महिष द्यु॒मन्नमो॒ विश्व॑कर्म॒न् नम॑स्ते पा॒ह्य॑१स्मा॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ghorā ṛṣayo namo astvebhyaścakṣuryadeṣāṃ manasaśca satyam |
bṛhaspataye mahiṣa dyumannamo viśvakarman namaste pāhyasmān ||

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञस्य॒ चक्षुः॒ प्रभृ॑ति॒र्मुखं॑ च वा॒चा श्रोत्रे॑ण॒ मन॑सा जुहोमि ।
इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं वित॑तं वि॒श्वक॑र्म॒णा दे॒वा य॑न्तु सुमन॒स्यमा॑नाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yajñasya cakṣuḥ prabhṛtirmukhaṃ ca vācā śrotreṇa manasā juhomi |
imaṃ yajñaṃ vitataṃ viśvakarmaṇā devā yantu sumanasyamānāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ नो॑ अग्ने सुम॒तिं सं॑भ॒लो ग॑मेदि॒मां कु॑मा॒रीं स॒ह नो॒ भगे॑न ।
जु॒ष्टा व॒रेषु॒ सम॑नेषु व॒ल्गुरो॒षं पत्या॒ सौभ॑गमस्त्व॒स्यै ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā no agne sumatiṃ saṃbhalo gamedimāṃ kumārīṃ saha no bhagena |
juṣṭā vareṣu samaneṣu valguroṣaṃ patyā saubhagamastvasyai ||
verses.translation:
A charm to secure a husband for a marriageable girl
To please us may the suitor come, O Agni, seeking this maid and bringing us good fortune.
Approved by wooers, lovely in assemblies, may she be soon made happy with a husband.
As bliss beloved by Soma, dear to Prayer, and stored by Arya-man,
With the God Dhātar’s truthfulness I work the bridal oracle.
O Agni, may this woman find a husband. Then verily King Soma makes her happy.
May she bear sons, chief lady of the household, blessed and bearing rule beside her consort.
As this lair, Maghavan! that is fair to look on was dear to wild things as a pleasant dwelling,
So may this woman here be Bhaga’s darling. Loved by her lord and prizing his affection.
Mount up, embark on Bhaga’s ship, the full, the inexhaustible,
Thereon bring hitherward to us the lover whom thou fain wouldst wed.
Call out to him, O Lord of Wealth! Make thou the lover well-inclined.
Set each on thy right hand who is a lover worthy of her choice.
Here is the Bdellium and the gold, the Auksha and the bliss are here:
These bring thee to the husbands, so to find the man whom thou. wouldst have.
May Savitar lead and bring to thee the husband whom thy heart desires.
O Plant, be this thy gift to her!

verses.sanskrit:
सोम॑जुष्टं॒ ब्रह्म॑जुष्टमर्य॒म्णा संभृ॑तं॒ भग॑म् ।
धा॒तुर्दे॒वस्य॑ स॒त्येन॑ कृ॒णोमि॑ पति॒वेद॑नम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
somajuṣṭaṃ brahmajuṣṭamaryamṇā saṃbhṛtaṃ bhagam |
dhāturdevasya satyena kṛṇomi pativedanam ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒यम॑ग्ने॒ नारी॒ पतिं॑ विदेष्ट॒ सोमो॒ हि राजा॑ सु॒भगां॑ कृ॒णोति॑ ।
सुवा॑ना पु॒त्रान् महि॑षी भवाति ग॒त्वा पतिं॑ सु॒भगा॒ वि रा॑जतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
iyamagne nārī patiṃ videṣṭa somo hi rājā subhagāṃ kṛṇoti |
suvānā putrān mahiṣī bhavāti gatvā patiṃ subhagā vi rājatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॑ख॒रो म॑घवं॒श्चारु॑रे॒ष प्रि॒यो मृ॒गाणां॑ सु॒षदा॑ ब॒भूव॑ ।
ए॒वा भग॑स्य जु॒ष्टेयम॑स्तु॒ नारी॒ संप्रि॑या॒ पत्यावि॑राधयन्ती ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathākharo maghavaṃścārureṣa priyo mṛgāṇāṃ suṣadā babhūva |
evā bhagasya juṣṭeyamastu nārī saṃpriyā patyāvirādhayantī ||

verses.sanskrit:
भग॑स्य॒ नाव॒मा रो॑ह पू॒र्णामनु॑पदस्वतीम् ।
तयो॑पप्रता॑रय॒ यो वरः प्र॑तिका॒म्यः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhagasya nāvamā roha pūrṇāmanupadasvatīm |
tayopapratāraya yo varaḥ pratikāmyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ क्र॑न्दय धनपते व॒रमाम॑नसं कृणु ।
सर्वं॑ प्रदक्षि॒णं कृ॑णु॒ यो व॒रः प्र॑तिका॒म्यः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā krandaya dhanapate varamāmanasaṃ kṛṇu |
sarvaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛṇu yo varaḥ pratikāmyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं हिर॑ण्यं॒ गुल्गु॑ल्व॒यमौ॒क्षो अथो॒ भगः॑ ।
ए॒ते पति॑भ्य॒स्त्वाम॑दुः प्रतिका॒माय॒ वेत्त॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ hiraṇyaṃ gulgulvayamaukṣo atho bhagaḥ |
ete patibhyastvāmaduḥ pratikāmāya vettave ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ ते॑ नयतु सवि॒ता न॑यतु॒ पति॒र्यः प्र॑तिका॒म्यः ।
त्वम॑स्यै धेह्योषधे ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā te nayatu savitā nayatu patiryaḥ pratikāmyaḥ |
tvamasyai dhehyoṣadhe ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निर्नः॒ शत्रू॒न् प्रत्ये॑तु वि॒द्वान् प्र॑ति॒दह॑न्न॒भिश॑स्ति॒मरा॑तिम् ।
स सेनां॑ मोहयतु॒ परे॑षां॒ निर्ह॑स्तांश्च कृणवज्जा॒तवे॑दाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnirnaḥ śatrūn pratyetu vidvān pratidahannabhiśastimarātim |
sa senāṃ mohayatu pareṣāṃ nirhastāṃśca kṛṇavajjātavedāḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer or charm for the defeat and destruction of enemies in battle
Let the wise Agni go against our foemen, burning against ill-will and imprecation Let him bewilder our opponents’ army, Let Jātavedas smite and make them handless.
Mighty are ye for such a deed, O Maruts. Go forward, overcome them and destroy them.
The Vasus slew, and these were left imploring. Wise Agni as our messenger assail them!
O Maghavan, O Indra, thou who slayest fiends, and, Agni, thou,
Burn, both of you, against these men, the foeman’s host that threatens us.
Shot down the slope, with thy two tawny coursers, forth go thy bolt, destroying foes, O Indra!
Slay those who fly, slay those who stand and follow.
On every side fulfil these men’s intention.
Indra, bewilder thou the foemen’s army.
With Agni’s, Vāta’s furious rush drive them away to every side.
Let Indra daze their army. Let the Maruts slay it with their might.
Let Agni take their eyes away, and let the conquered host retreat.

verses.sanskrit:
यू॒यमु॒ग्रा म॑रुत ई॒दृशे॑ स्था॒भि प्रेत॑ मृ॒णत॒ सह॑ध्वम् ।
अमी॑मृण॒न् वस॑वो नाथि॒ता इ॒मे अ॒ग्निर्ह्येऽषां दू॒तः प्र॒त्येतु॑ वि॒द्वान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yūyamugrā maruta īdṛśe sthābhi preta mṛṇata sahadhvam |
amīmṛṇan vasavo nāthitā ime agnirhye'ṣāṃ dūtaḥ pratyetu vidvān ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒मि॒त्र॒से॒नां॑ मघवन्न॒स्मान् छ॑त्रूय॒तीम॒भि ।
यु॒वं तानि॑न्द्र वृत्रहन्न॒ग्निश्च॑ दहतं॒ प्रति॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
amitrasenāṃ maghavannasmān chatrūyatīmabhi |
yuvaṃ tānindra vṛtrahannagniśca dahataṃ prati ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्रसू॑त इन्द्र प्र॒वता॒ हरि॑भ्यां॒ प्र ते॒ वज्रः॑ प्रमृ॒णन्ने॑तु॒ शत्रू॑न् ।
ज॒हि प्र॒तीचो॑ अ॒नूचः॒ परा॑चो॒ विष्व॑क् स॒त्यं कृ॑णुहि चि॒त्तमे॑षाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prasūta indra pravatā haribhyāṃ pra te vajraḥ pramṛṇannetu śatrūn |
jahi pratīco anūcaḥ parāco viṣvak satyaṃ kṛṇuhi cittameṣām ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॒ सेनां॑ मोहया॒मित्रा॑णाम् ।
अ॒ग्नेर्वात॑स्य॒ ध्राज्या॒ तान् विषू॑चो॒ वि ना॑शय ॥
verses.transliteration:
indra senāṃ mohayāmitrāṇām |
agnervātasya dhrājyā tān viṣūco vi nāśaya ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रः॒ सेनां॑ मोहयतु म॒रुतो॑ घ्न॒न्त्वोज॑सा ।
चक्षूं॑स्य॒ग्निरा द॑त्तां॒ पुन॑रेतु॒ परा॑जिता ॥
verses.transliteration:
indraḥ senāṃ mohayatu maruto ghnantvojasā |
cakṣūṃsyagnirā dattāṃ punaretu parājitā ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निर्नो॑ दू॒तः प्र॒त्येतु॑ वि॒द्वान् प्र॑ति॒दह॑न्न॒भिश॑स्ति॒मरा॑तिम् ।
स चि॒त्तानि॑ मोहयतु॒ परे॑षां॒ निर्ह॑स्तांश्च कृणवज्जा॒तवे॑दाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnirno dūtaḥ pratyetu vidvān pratidahannabhiśastimarātim |
sa cittāni mohayatu pareṣāṃ nirhastāṃśca kṛṇavajjātavedāḥ ||
verses.translation:
A rifaccimento or recension of I
May Agni, he who knows, our envoy, meet them, burning against ill-will and imprecation.
May he bewilder our opponent’s senses. May Jātavedas smite and make them handless.
This Agni hath bewildered all the senses that were in your hearts:
Now let him blast you from your home, blast you away from every side.
Dazing their senses, Indra, come hitherward with the wish and will.
With Agni’s, Vāta’s furious rush drive them to every side away.
Vanish, ye hopes and plans of theirs, be ye confounded, all their thoughts!
Whatever wish is in their heart, do thou expel it utterly.
Bewildering the senses of our foemen, seize on their bodies and depart, O Apvā!
Go meet them, flame within their hearts and burn them. Smite thou the foes with darkness and amazement.
That army of our enemies, O Maruts, that comes against us with’ its might, contending—
Meet ye and strike it with unwelcome darkness so that not one. of them may know another.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यम॒ग्निर॑मूमुह॒द् यानि॑ चि॒त्तानि॑ वो हृ॒दि ।
वि वो॑ धम॒त्वोक॑सः॒ प्र वो॑ धमतु स॒र्वतः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ayamagniramūmuhad yāni cittāni vo hṛdi |
vi vo dhamatvokasaḥ pra vo dhamatu sarvataḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑ चि॒त्तानि॑ मो॒हय॑न्न॒र्वाङाकू॑त्या चर ।
अ॒ग्नेर्वात॑स्य॒ ध्राज्या॒ तान् विषू॑चो॒ वि ना॑शय ॥
verses.transliteration:
indra cittāni mohayannarvāṅākūtyā cara |
agnervātasya dhrājyā tān viṣūco vi nāśaya ||

verses.sanskrit:
व्याऽकूतय एषामि॒ताथो॑ चि॒त्तानि॑ मुह्यत ।
अथो॒ यद॒द्यैषां॑ हृदि तदे॑षां॒ परि॒ निर्ज॑हि ॥
verses.transliteration:
vyā'kūtaya eṣāmitātho cittāni muhyata |
atho yadadyaiṣāṃ hṛdi tadeṣāṃ pari nirjahi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒मीषां॑ चि॒त्तानि॑ प्रतिमो॒हय॑न्ती गृहा॒णाङ्गा॑न्यप्वे॒ परे॑हि ।
अ॒भि प्रेहि॒ निर्द॑ह हृ॒त्सु शोकै॒र्ग्राह्या॒मित्रां॒स्तम॑सा विध्य॒ शत्रू॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
amīṣāṃ cittāni pratimohayantī gṛhāṇāṅgānyapve parehi |
abhi prehi nirdaha hṛtsu śokairgrāhyāmitrāṃstamasā vidhya śatrūn ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒सौ या सेना॑ मरुतः॒ परे॑षाम॒स्मा॑नैत्य॒भ्योज॑सा॒ स्पर्ध॑माना ।
तां वि॑ध्यत॒ तम॒साप॑व्रतेन॒ यथै॑षाम॒न्यो अ॒न्यं न जा॒नात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
asau yā senā marutaḥ pareṣāmasmānaityabhyojasā spardhamānā |
tāṃ vidhyata tamasāpavratena yathaiṣāmanyo anyaṃ na jānāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॑चिक्रदत् स्व॒पा इ॒ह भु॑व॒दग्ने॒ व्यऽचस्व॒ रोद॑सी उरू॒ची ।
यु॒ञ्जन्तु॑ त्वा म॒रुतो॑ वि॒श्ववे॑दस॒ आमुं न॑य॒ नम॑सा रा॒तह॑व्यम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
acikradat svapā iha bhuvadagne vya'casva rodasī urūcī |
yuñjantu tvā maruto viśvavedasa āmuṃ naya namasā rātahavyam ||
verses.translation:
A charm for the restoration of an expelled king
Loudly he roared. Here let him labour deftly. Spread, Agni, over spacious earth and heaven.
Let Maruts who possesses all treasures yoke thee. Bring him who reverently paid oblations.
Though he be far away, let the red horses bring Indra, bring the sage to us and friendship,
Since with Sautrāmani Gods for him o’erpower Gāyatri, Brihatī, and hymn of praises.
King Varuna call thee hither from the waters! From hills and mountains Soma call thee hither!
Let Indra call thee hither to these people. Fly hither to these people as a falcon.
May the hawk bring the man who must be summoned, from far away, in alien land, an exile.
May both the Asvins make thy pathway easy. Come, and unite yourselves with him, ye Kinsmen.
Let thine opponents call thee back. Thy friends have chosen, thee again.
Indra and Agni, all the Gods have kept thy home amid the tribe.
He who disputes our calling thee, be he a stranger or akin.
Drive him, O Indra, far away, and do thou bring this man to us.

verses.sanskrit:
दू॒रे चि॒त् सन्त॑मरु॒षास॒ इन्द्र॒मा च्या॑वयन्तु स॒ख्याय॒ विप्र॑म् ।
यद् गा॑य॒त्रीं बृ॑ह॒तीम॒र्कम॑स्मै सौत्राम॒ण्या दधृ॑षन्त दे॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
dūre cit santamaruṣāsa indramā cyāvayantu sakhyāya vipram |
yad gāyatrīṃ bṛhatīmarkamasmai sautrāmaṇyā dadhṛṣanta devāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒द्भ्यस्त्वा॒ राजा॒ व॑रुणो ह्वयतु॒ सोम॑स्त्वा ह्वयतु॒ पर्व॑तेभ्यः ।
इन्द्र॑स्त्वा ह्वयतु वि॒ड्भ्य॑ आ॒भ्यः श्ये॒नो भू॒त्वा विश॒ आ प॑ते॒माः ॥
verses.transliteration:
adbhyastvā rājā varuṇo hvayatu somastvā hvayatu parvatebhyaḥ |
indrastvā hvayatu viḍbhya ābhyaḥ śyeno bhūtvā viśa ā patemāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
श्ये॒नो ह॒व्यं न॑य॒त्वा पर॑स्मादन्यक्षे॒त्रेअप॑रुद्धं॒ चर॑न्तम् ।
अ॒श्विना॒ पन्थां॑ कृणुतां सु॒गं त॑ इ॒मं स॑जाता अभि॒संवि॑शध्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śyeno havyaṃ nayatvā parasmādanyakṣetreaparuddhaṃ carantam |
aśvinā panthāṃ kṛṇutāṃ sugaṃ ta imaṃ sajātā abhisaṃviśadhvam ||

verses.sanskrit:
ह्वय॑न्तु त्वा प्रतिज॒नाः प्रति॑ मित्रा अ॑वृषत ।
इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्नी विश्वे॑ दे॒वास्ते वि॒शि क्षेम॑मदीधरन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
hvayantu tvā pratijanāḥ prati mitrā avṛṣata |
indrāgnī viśve devāste viśi kṣemamadīdharan ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ते॒ हवं वि॒वद॑त् सजा॒तो यश्च॒ निष्ट्यः॑ ।
अ॑पाञ्चमिन्द्र॒ तं कृ॒त्वाथे॒ममि॒हाव॑ गमय ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaste havaṃ vivadat sajāto yaśca niṣṭyaḥ |
apāñcamindra taṃ kṛtvāthemamihāva gamaya ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ त्वा॑ गन् रा॒ष्ट्रं स॒ह वर्च॒सोदि॑हि प्रा॑ङ्वि वि॒शां पति॑रेक॒राट् त्वं वि रा॑ज ।
सर्वा॑स्त्वा राजन् प्र॒दिशो॑ ह्वयन्तूप॒सद्यो॑ नम॒स्योऽ भवे॒ह ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā tvā gan rāṣṭraṃ saha varcasodihi prāṅvi viśāṃ patirekarāṭ tvaṃ vi rāja |
sarvāstvā rājan pradiśo hvayantūpasadyo namasyo' bhaveha ||
verses.translation:
A benediction at the election of a king
To thee hath come the kingship with its splendour: On! shine as lord, sole ruler of the people.
King! let all regions of the heavens invite thee. Here let men wait on thee and bow before thee.
The tribesmen shall elect thee for the Kingship, these five celestial regions shall elect thee.
Rest on the height and top of kingly power: thence as a mighty man award us treasures.
Kinsmen, inviting thee, shall go to meet thee, with thee go Agni as an active herald.
Let women and their sons be friendly-minded. Thou mighty one, shalt see abundant tribute.
First shall the Asvins, Varuna and Mitra, the Universal Gods, and Maruts call thee.
Then turn thy mind to giving gifts of treasures, thence, mighty one, distribute wealth among us.
Speed to us hither from the farthest distance. Propitious unto thee be Earth and Heaven.
Even so hath Varuna this King asserted, he who himself hath called thee: come thou hither.
Pass to the tribes of men. O Indra, Indra. Thou the Varunas hast been found accordant.
To his own place this one hath called thee, saying, Let him adore the Gods and guide the clansmen.
The Bounteous Paths in sundry forms and places, all in accord, have given thee room and comfort.
Let all of these in concert call thee hither. Live thy tenth decade here, a strong kind ruler.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वां विशो॑ वृणतां रा॒ज्याऽय॒ त्वामि॒माः प्र॒दिशः॒ पञ्च॑ दे॒वीः ।
वर्ष्म॑न् रा॒ष्ट्रस्य॑ क॒कुदि॑ श्रयस्व॒ ततो॑ न उ॒ग्रो वि भ॑जा॒ वसू॑नि ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvāṃ viśo vṛṇatāṃ rājyā'ya tvāmimāḥ pradiśaḥ pañca devīḥ |
varṣman rāṣṭrasya kakudi śrayasva tato na ugro vi bhajā vasūni ||

verses.sanskrit:
अच्छ॑ त्वा यन्तु ह॒विनः॑ सजा॒ता अ॒ग्निर्दू॒तो अ॑जि॒रः सं च॑रातै ।
जा॒याः पु॒त्राः सु॒मन॑सो भवन्तु ब॒हुं ब॒लिं प्रति॑ पश्यासा उ॒ग्रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
accha tvā yantu havinaḥ sajātā agnirdūto ajiraḥ saṃ carātai |
jāyāḥ putrāḥ sumanaso bhavantu bahuṃ baliṃ prati paśyāsā ugraḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्विना॒ त्वाग्रे॑ मि॒त्रावरु॑णो॒भा विश्वे॑ दे॒वा म॒रुत॑स्त्वा ह्वयन्तु ।
अधा॒ मनो॑ वसु॒देया॑य कृणुष्व॒ ततो॑ न उ॒ग्रो वि भ॑जा॒ वसू॑नि ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśvinā tvāgre mitrāvaruṇobhā viśve devā marutastvā hvayantu |
adhā mano vasudeyāya kṛṇuṣva tato na ugro vi bhajā vasūni ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ प्र द्र॑व पर॒मस्याः॑ परा॒वतः॑ शि॒वे ते॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी उ॒भे स्ता॑म् ।
तद॒यं राजा॒ वरु॑ण॒स्तथा॑ह॒ स त्वा॒यम॑ह्व॒त् स उपे॒दमेहि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā pra drava paramasyāḥ parāvataḥ śive te dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām |
tadayaṃ rājā varuṇastathāha sa tvāyamahvat sa upedamehi ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रे॑न्द्र मनु॒ष्याः॒३ परे॑हि॒ सं ह्यज्ञा॑स्था॒ वरु॑णैः संविदा॒नः ।
स त्वा॒यम॑ह्व॒त् स्वे स॒धस्थे॒ स दे॒वान् य॑क्ष॒त् स उ॑ कल्पया॒द् विशः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrendra manuṣyāḥ parehi saṃ hyajñāsthā varuṇaiḥ saṃvidānaḥ |
sa tvāyamahvat sve sadhasthe sa devān yakṣat sa u kalpayād viśaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
प॒थ्याऽ रे॒वती॑र्बहु॒धा विरू॑पाः॒ सर्वाः॑ सं॒गत्य॒ वरी॑यस्ते अक्रन् ।
तास्त्वा॒ सर्वाः॑ संविदा॒ना ह्व॑यन्तु दश॒मीमु॒ग्रः सु॒मना॑ वशे॒ह ॥
verses.transliteration:
pathyā' revatīrbahudhā virūpāḥ sarvāḥ saṃgatya varīyaste akran |
tāstvā sarvāḥ saṃvidānā hvayantu daśamīmugraḥ sumanā vaśeha ||

verses.sanskrit:
आयम॑गन् पर्णम॒णिर्ब॒ली बले॑न प्रमृ॒णन्त्स॒पत्ना॑न् ।
ओजो॑ दे॒वानां॒ पय॒ ओष॑धीनां॒ वर्च॑सा मा जिन्व॒त्वप्र॑यावन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
āyamagan parṇamaṇirbalī balena pramṛṇantsapatnān |
ojo devānāṃ paya oṣadhīnāṃ varcasā mā jinvatvaprayāvan ||
verses.translation:
A King’s address to an amulet which is to strengthen his authority
This Parna-Amulet hath come, strong and destroying with its strength my rivals.
The power of the Gods, the plants’ sweet essence, may it incite me ceaselessly with vigour.
O Parna-Amulet, in me set firmly might and opulence.
Within the compass of my rule may I be rooted and supreme.
That dear mysterious Amulet which Gods have set within the tree,
May the Gods grant to me to wear together with extended life.
As Indra’s gift, by Varuna instructed, Parna hath come, the mighty strength of Soma:
This would I, brightly shining, love and cherish for long life lasting through a hundred autumns.
The Parna-Charm hath come to me for great security from ill.
That I may be exalted, yea, above the wealth of Aryaman.
Sagacious builders of the car, cleaver and skilful artisans,—
Make all the men on every side, Parna, obedient to my will The kings and makers of the kings, troop-leaders, masters of the horse,
Make all the men on every side, Parna, obedient to my will.
Thou, Parna, art my body’s guard, man kin my birth to me a man.
With splendour of the circling year I bind thee on me, Amulet!

verses.sanskrit:
मयि॑ क्ष॒त्रं प॑र्णमणे॒ मयि॑ धारयताद् र॒यिम् ।
अ॒हं रा॒ष्ट्रस्या॑भीव॒र्गे नि॒जो भू॑यासमुत्त॒मः ॥
verses.transliteration:
mayi kṣatraṃ parṇamaṇe mayi dhārayatād rayim |
ahaṃ rāṣṭrasyābhīvarge nijo bhūyāsamuttamaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यं नि॑द॒धुर्वन॒स्पतौ॒ गुह्यं॑ दे॒वाः प्रि॒यं म॒णिम् ।
तम॒स्मभ्यं॑ स॒हायु॑षा दे॒वा द॑दतु॒ भर्त॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaṃ nidadhurvanaspatau guhyaṃ devāḥ priyaṃ maṇim |
tamasmabhyaṃ sahāyuṣā devā dadatu bhartave ||

verses.sanskrit:
सोम॑स्य प॒र्णः सह॑ उ॒ग्रमाग॒न्निन्द्रे॑ण द॒त्तो वरु॑णेन शि॒ष्टः ।
तं प्रि॑यासं ब॒हु रोच॑मानो दीर्घायु॒त्वाय॑ श॒तशा॑रदाय ॥
verses.transliteration:
somasya parṇaḥ saha ugramāgannindreṇa datto varuṇena śiṣṭaḥ |
taṃ priyāsaṃ bahu rocamāno dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ मा॑रुक्षत् पर्णम॒णिर्म॒ह्या अ॑रि॒ष्टता॑तये ।
यथा॒हमु॑त्त॒रोऽसा॑न्यर्य॒म्ण उ॒त सं॒विदः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā mārukṣat parṇamaṇirmahyā ariṣṭatātaye |
yathāhamuttaro'sānyaryamṇa uta saṃvidaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये धीवा॑नो रथका॒राः क॒र्मारा॒ ये म॑नी॒षिणः॑ ।
उ॒प॒स्तीन् प॑र्ण॒ मह्यं॒ त्वं सर्वा॑न् कृण्व॒भितो॒ जना॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye dhīvāno rathakārāḥ karmārā ye manīṣiṇaḥ |
upastīn parṇa mahyaṃ tvaṃ sarvān kṛṇvabhito janān ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये राजा॑नो राज॒कृतः॑ सू॒ता ग्रा॑म॒ण्यऽश्च॒ ये ।
उ॒प॒स्तीन् प॑र्ण॒ मह्यं॒ त्वं सर्वा॑न् कृण्व॒भितो॒ जनान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye rājāno rājakṛtaḥ sūtā grāmaṇya'śca ye |
upastīn parṇa mahyaṃ tvaṃ sarvān kṛṇvabhito janān ||

verses.sanskrit:
प॒र्णोऽसि तनू॒पानः॒ सयो॑निर्वी॒रो वी॒रेण॒ मया॑ ।
सं॒व॒त्स॒रस्य॒ तेज॑सा॒ तेन॒ बध्नामि त्वा मणे ॥
verses.transliteration:
parṇo'si tanūpānaḥ sayonirvīro vīreṇa mayā |
saṃvatsarasya tejasā tena badhnāmi tvā maṇe ||

verses.sanskrit:
पुमा॑न् पुंसः परि॑जातोऽश्व॒त्थः ख॑दि॒रादधि॑ ।
स ह॑न्तु॒ शत्रू॑न् माम॒कान् यान॒हं द्वेष्मि॒ ये च॒ माम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pumān puṃsaḥ parijāto'śvatthaḥ khadirādadhi |
sa hantu śatrūn māmakān yānahaṃ dveṣmi ye ca mām ||
verses.translation:
Address to an amulet which is to secure the defeat of the wearer’s enemies
Masculine springs from masculine, Asvattha grows from Kha-dira,
May it destroy mine enemies, who hate me and whom I detest.
Crush down my foes, Asvattha! Rend, O Burster, those who storm and rage,
With Indra, slayer of the fiends, with Mitra and with Varuna.
As thou hast rent and torn apart, Asvattha! in the mighty sea,
So rend asundar all those men who hate me and whom I detest.
Thou who like some victorious bull displayest thy surpassing might,
With thee, with thee, Asvattha! we would overcome our enemies.
Nirriti bind them with the bonds of Death which never may be loosed.
Mine enemies, Asvattha! those who hate me and whom I detest.
As thou, Asvastha!, mountest on the trees and overthrowest them,
So do thou break my foeman’s head asunder and o’erpower him.
Let them drift downward like a boat torn from the rope that fastened it.
There is no turning back for those whom He who Cleaves hath driven away.
With mental power I drive them forth, drive them with intellect and charm.
We banish and expel them with the branch of an Asvattha tree.

verses.sanskrit:
तान॑श्वत्थ॒ निः शृ॑णीहि॒ शत्रू॑न् वैबाध॒दोध॑तः ।
इन्द्रे॑ण वृत्र॒घ्ना मे॒दी मि॒त्रेण॒ वरु॑णेन च ॥
verses.transliteration:
tānaśvattha niḥ śṛṇīhi śatrūn vaibādhadodhataḥ |
indreṇa vṛtraghnā medī mitreṇa varuṇena ca ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॑श्वत्थ नि॒रभ॑नो॒ऽन्तर्म॑ह॒त्यऽर्ण॒वे ।
ए॒वा तान्त्सर्वा॒न् निर्भ॑ङ्ग्धि॒ यान॒हं द्वेष्मि॒ ये च॒ माम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathāśvattha nirabhano'ntarmahatya'rṇave |
evā tāntsarvān nirbhaṅgdhi yānahaṃ dveṣmi ye ca mām ||

verses.sanskrit:
यः सह॑मान॒श्चर॑सि सासहा॒न इव ऋष॒भः ।
तेना॑श्वत्थ॒ त्वया॑ व॒यं स॒पत्ना॑न्त्सहिषीमहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaḥ sahamānaścarasi sāsahāna iva ṛṣabhaḥ |
tenāśvattha tvayā vayaṃ sapatnāntsahiṣīmahi ||

verses.sanskrit:
सि॒नात्वे॑ना॒न् निरृ॑तिर्मृ॒त्योः पाशै॑रमो॒क्यैः ।
अश्व॑त्थ॒ शत्रू॑न् माम॒कान् यान॒हं द्वेष्मि॒ ये च॒ माम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sinātvenān nirṛtirmṛtyoḥ pāśairamokyaiḥ |
aśvattha śatrūn māmakān yānahaṃ dveṣmi ye ca mām ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॑श्वत्थ वानस्प॒त्याना॒रोह॑न् कृणु॒षेऽध॑रान् ।
ए॒वा मे॒ शत्रो॑र्मू॒र्धानं॒ विष्व॑ग् भिन्द्धि॒ सह॑स्व च ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathāśvattha vānaspatyānārohan kṛṇuṣe'dharān |
evā me śatrormūrdhānaṃ viṣvag bhinddhi sahasva ca ||

verses.sanskrit:
तेऽध॒राञ्चः॒ प्र प्ल॑वन्तां छि॒न्ना नौरि॑व॒ बन्ध॑नात् ।
न वै॑बा॒धप्र॑णुत्तानां॒ पुन॑रस्ति नि॒वर्त॑नम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
te'dharāñcaḥ pra plavantāṃ chinnā nauriva bandhanāt |
na vaibādhapraṇuttānāṃ punarasti nivartanam ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्रैणा॑न् नुदे॒ मन॑सा॒ प्र चि॒त्ते॑नो॒त ब्रह्म॑णा ।
प्रैणा॑न् वृ॒क्षस्य॒ शाख॑याश्व॒त्थस्य॑ नुदामहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
praiṇān nude manasā pra cittenota brahmaṇā |
praiṇān vṛkṣasya śākhayāśvatthasya nudāmahe ||

verses.sanskrit:
ह॒रि॒णस्य॑ रघु॒ष्यदोऽधि॑ शी॒र्षणि॑ भेष॒जम् ।
स क्षे॑त्रि॒यं वि॒षाण॑या विषू॒चीन॑मनीनशत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
hariṇasya raghuṣyado'dhi śīrṣaṇi bheṣajam |
sa kṣetriyaṃ viṣāṇayā viṣūcīnamanīnaśat ||
verses.translation:
A charm with an amulet of buck horn to drive away hereditary disease
The fleet-foot Roebuck wears upon his head a healing remedy.
Innate disease he drives away to all directions with his horn.
With his four feet the vigorous Buck hath bounded in pursuit of thee.
Unbind the chronic sickness, Horn! deeply inwoven in the heart.
That which shines younder, like a roof resting on four walls, down on us,—
Therewith from out thy body we drive all the chronic malady,
May those twin stars, auspicious, named Releasers, up in yonder sky.
Loose of the chronic malady the uppermost and lowest bond.
Water, indeed, hath power to heal, Water drives malady away.
May water—for it healeth all—free thee from permanent disease.
Hath some prepared decoction brought inveterate disease on thee,
I know the balm that healeth it: we drive the malady away.
What time the starlight disappears, what time the gleams of Dawn depart,
May evil fortune pass from us, the chronic sickness disappear.

verses.sanskrit:
अनु॑ त्वा हरि॒णो वृषा॑ प॒द्भिश्च॒तुर्भि॑रक्रमीत् ।
विषा॑णे॒ वि ष्य॑ गुष्पि॒तं यद॑स्य क्षेत्रि॒यं हृ॒दि ॥
verses.transliteration:
anu tvā hariṇo vṛṣā padbhiścaturbhirakramīt |
viṣāṇe vi ṣya guṣpitaṃ yadasya kṣetriyaṃ hṛdi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒दो यद॑व॒रोच॑ते॒ चतु॑ष्पक्षमिव च्छ॒दिः ।
तेना॑ ते॒ सर्वं॑ क्षेत्रि॒यमङ्गे॑भ्यो नाशयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ado yadavarocate catuṣpakṣamiva cchadiḥ |
tenā te sarvaṃ kṣetriyamaṅgebhyo nāśayāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒मू ये दि॒वि सु॒भगे॑ वि॒चृतौ॒ नाम॒ तार॑के ।
वि क्षे॑त्रि॒यस्य॑ मुञ्चतामध॒मं पाश॑मुत्त॒मम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
amū ye divi subhage vicṛtau nāma tārake |
vi kṣetriyasya muñcatāmadhamaṃ pāśamuttamam ||

verses.sanskrit:
आप॒ इद् वा उ॑ भेष॒जीरापो॑ अमीव॒चात॑नीः ।
आपो॒ विश्व॑स्य भेष॒जीस्तास्त्वा॑ मुञ्चन्तु क्षेत्रि॒यात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
āpa id vā u bheṣajīrāpo amīvacātanīḥ |
āpo viśvasya bheṣajīstāstvā muñcantu kṣetriyāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
यदा॑सु॒तेः क्रि॒यमा॑णायाः क्षेत्रि॒यं त्वा॑ व्यान॒शे ।
वेदा॒हं तस्य॑ भेष॒जं क्षे॑त्रि॒यं ना॑शयामि॒ त्वत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadāsuteḥ kriyamāṇāyāḥ kṣetriyaṃ tvā vyānaśe |
vedāhaṃ tasya bheṣajaṃ kṣetriyaṃ nāśayāmi tvat ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒प॒वा॒से नक्ष॑त्राणामपवा॒स उ॒षसा॑मु॒त ।
अपा॒स्मत् सर्वं॑ दुर्भू॒तमप॑ क्षेत्रि॒यमु॑च्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
apavāse nakṣatrāṇāmapavāsa uṣasāmuta |
apāsmat sarvaṃ durbhūtamapa kṣetriyamucchatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ या॑तु मि॒त्र ऋ॒तुभिः॒ कल्प॑मानः संवे॒शय॑न् पृथि॒वीमु॒स्रिया॑भिः ।
अथा॒स्मभ्यं॒ वरु॑णो वा॒युर॒ग्निर्बृ॒हद् रा॒ष्ट्रं सं॑वे॒श्यंऽ दधातु ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā yātu mitra ṛtubhiḥ kalpamānaḥ saṃveśayan pṛthivīmusriyābhiḥ |
athāsmabhyaṃ varuṇo vāyuragnirbṛhad rāṣṭraṃ saṃveśyaṃ' dadhātu ||
verses.translation:
A charm to secure the submission, love, and fidelity of kinsmen
Let Mitra come, arranging, with the Seasons, lulling the Earth to rest with gleams of splendour.
And so let Agni, Varuna, and Vāyu make our dominion tran-quil and exalted.
May Indra, Tvashtar hear my word with favour, may Dhātar,
Rāti, Savitar accept it.
I call the Goddess Aditi, heroes’ mother, that I may be the centre of my kinsmen.
Soma I call, and Savitar with homage, and all the Ādityas in the time of contest.
Long may this fire send forth its splendour, lighted by kinsmen uttering no word against me.
Here, verily, may you stay: go ye no farther. The strong Herd,
Lord of Increase, drive you hither!
To please this man may all the Gods together come unto you and be as dames who love him.
We bend together all your minds, your vows and purposes we bend.
We bend together you who stand apart with hopes opposed to ours.
I with my spirit seize and hold your spirits. Follow with thought and wish my thoughts and wishes.
I make your hearts the thralls of my dominion; on me attendant come thy way I guide you.

verses.sanskrit:
धा॒ता रा॒तिः स॑वि॒तेदं जु॑षन्ता॒मिन्द्र॒स्त्वष्टा॒ प्रति॑ हर्यन्तु मे॒ वचः॑ ।
हु॒वे दे॒वीमदि॑तिं॒ शूर॑पुत्रां सजा॒तानां॑ मध्यमे॒ष्ठा यथासा॑नि ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhātā rātiḥ savitedaṃ juṣantāmindrastvaṣṭā prati haryantu me vacaḥ |
huve devīmaditiṃ śūraputrāṃ sajātānāṃ madhyameṣṭhā yathāsāni ||

verses.sanskrit:
हु॒वे सोमं॑ सवि॒तारं॒ नमो॑भि॒र्विश्वा॑नादि॒त्याँ अ॒हमु॑त्तर॒त्वे ।
अ॒यम॒ग्निर्दी॑दायद् दी॒र्घमे॒व स॑जा॒तैरि॒द्धोऽप्र॑तिब्रुवद्भिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
huve somaṃ savitāraṃ namobhirviśvānādityām̐ ahamuttaratve |
ayamagnirdīdāyad dīrghameva sajātairiddho'pratibruvadbhiḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒हेद॑साथ॒ न प॒रो ग॑मा॒थेर्यो॑ गो॒पाः पु॑ष्ट॒पति॑र्व॒ आज॑त् ।
अ॒स्मै कामा॒योप॑ का॒मिनी॒र्विश्वे॑ वो दे॒वा उ॑प॒संय॑न्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
ihedasātha na paro gamātheryo gopāḥ puṣṭapatirva ājat |
asmai kāmāyopa kāminīrviśve vo devā upasaṃyantu ||

verses.sanskrit:
सं वो॒ मनां॑सि॒ सं व्र॒ता समाकू॑तीर्नमामसि ।
अ॒मी ये विव्र॑ता॒ स्थन॒ तान् वः॒ सं न॑मयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ vo manāṃsi saṃ vratā samākūtīrnamāmasi |
amī ye vivratā sthana tān vaḥ saṃ namayāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒हं गृ॑भ्णामि॒ मन॑सा॒ मनां॑सि॒ मम॑ चि॒त्तमनु॑ चि॒त्तेभि॒रेत॑ ।
मम॒ वशे॑षु॒ हृद॑यानि वः कृणोमि॒ मम॑ या॒तमनु॑वर्त्मान॒ एत॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahaṃ gṛbhṇāmi manasā manāṃsi mama cittamanu cittebhireta |
mama vaśeṣu hṛdayāni vaḥ kṛṇomi mama yātamanuvartmāna eta ||

verses.sanskrit:
क॒र्शफ॑स्य विश॒फस्य॒ द्यौः पि॒ता पृ॑थि॒वी मा॒ता ।
यथा॑भिच॒क्र दे॑वा॒स्तथाप॑ कृणुता॒ पुनः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
karśaphasya viśaphasya dyauḥ pitā pṛthivī mātā |
yathābhicakra devāstathāpa kṛṇutā punaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A charm against rheumatism (vishkondha)
Heaven is the sire, the mother Earth, of Karsapha and Visapha.
As ye have brought them hither, Gods! so do ye move therm hence away.
The bands hold fast without a knot: this is the way that Manu-used.
I make Vishkandha impotent as one emasculateth bulls.
Then to a tawny-coloured string the wise and skilful bind a brush.
Let bandages make impotent the strong and active Kābava.
Ye who move active in your strength like Gods with Asuras’ magic powers,
Even as the monkey scorns the dogs, Bandages! scorn the Kābava.
Yea, I will chide thee to thy shame, I will disgrace the Kābava.
Under our impracations ye, like rapid cars, shall pass away.
One and one hundred over earth are the Vishkandhas spread abroad.
Before these have they fetched thee forth. Vishkandha quelling Amulet.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्रे॒ष्माणो॑ अधारय॒न् तथा॒ तन्मनु॑ना कृ॒तम् ।
कृणोमि॒ वध्रि॒ विष्क॑न्धं मुष्काब॒र्हो गवा॑मिव ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśreṣmāṇo adhārayan tathā tanmanunā kṛtam |
kṛṇomi vadhri viṣkandhaṃ muṣkābarho gavāmiva ||

verses.sanskrit:
पि॒शङ्गे॒ सूत्रे॒ खृग॑लं॒ तदा ब॑ध्नन्ति वे॒धसः॑ ।
श्र॒व॒स्युं शुष्मं॑ काब॒वं वध्रिं॑ कृण्वन्तु ब॒न्धुरः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
piśaṅge sūtre khṛgalaṃ tadā badhnanti vedhasaḥ |
śravasyuṃ śuṣmaṃ kābavaṃ vadhriṃ kṛṇvantu bandhuraḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
येना॑ श्रवस्यव॒श्चर॑थ दे॒वा इ॑वासुरमा॒यया॑ ।
शुनां॑ क॒पिरि॑व॒ दूष॑णो॒ बन्धु॑रा काब॒वस्य॑ च ॥
verses.transliteration:
yenā śravasyavaścaratha devā ivāsuramāyayā |
śunāṃ kapiriva dūṣaṇo bandhurā kābavasya ca ||

verses.sanskrit:
दुष्ट्यै॒ हि त्वा॑ भ॒त्स्यामि॑ दूषयि॒ष्यामि॑ काब॒वम् ।
उदा॒शवो॒ रथा॑ इव श॒पथे॑भिः सरिष्यथ ॥
verses.transliteration:
duṣṭyai hi tvā bhatsyāmi dūṣayiṣyāmi kābavam |
udāśavo rathā iva śapathebhiḥ sariṣyatha ||

verses.sanskrit:
एक॑शतं॒ विष्क॑न्धानि॒ विष्ठि॑ता पृथि॒वीमनु॑ ।
तेषां॒ त्वामग्रे॒ उज्ज॑हरुर्म॒णिं वि॑ष्कन्ध॒दूष॑णम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ekaśataṃ viṣkandhāni viṣṭhitā pṛthivīmanu |
teṣāṃ tvāmagre ujjaharurmaṇiṃ viṣkandhadūṣaṇam ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒थ॒मा ह॒ व्युऽवास॒ सा धे॒नुर॑भवद् य॒मे ।
सा नः॒ पय॑स्वती दुहा॒मुत्त॑रामुत्तरां॒ समा॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prathamā ha vyu'vāsa sā dhenurabhavad yame |
sā naḥ payasvatī duhāmuttarāmuttarāṃ samām ||
verses.translation:
A new year prayer
The First hath dawned. With Yama may it be a cow to pour forth milk.
May she be rich in milk and stream for us through many a com-ing year.
May she whom Gods accept with joy, Night who approacheth. as a cow,
She who is Consort of the Year, bring us abundant happiness Thou whom with reverence we approach, O Night, as model of the Year,
Vouchsafe. us children long to live; bless us with increase of our wealth.
This same is she whose light first dawned upon us: she moves established in the midst of others:
