श॒ग्मा भ॑वन्तु म॒रुतो॑ नः स्यो॒नास्ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
payo dhenūnāṃ rasamoṣadhīnāṃ javamarvatāṃ kavayo ya invatha |
śagmā bhavantu maruto naḥ syonāste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पः स॑मु॒द्राद् दिव॒मुद् व॑हन्ति दि॒वस्पृ॑थि॒वीम॒भि ये सृ॒जन्ति॑ ।
ये अ॒द्भिरीशा॑ना म॒रुत॒श्चर॑न्ति ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
apaḥ samudrād divamud vahanti divaspṛthivīmabhi ye sṛjanti |
ye adbhirīśānā marutaścaranti te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये की॒लाले॑न त॒र्पय॑न्ति ये घृ॒तेन॒ ये वा॒ वयो॒ मेद॑सा संसृ॒जन्ति॑ ।
ये अ॒द्भिरीशा॑ना म॒रुतो॑ व॒र्षय॑न्ति॒ ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye kīlālena tarpayanti ye ghṛtena ye vā vayo medasā saṃsṛjanti |
ye adbhirīśānā maruto varṣayanti te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यदीदि॒दं मरु॑तो॒ मारु॑तेन॒ यदि॑ देवा॒ दैव्ये॑ने॒दृगार॑ ।
यू॒यमी॑शिध्वे वसव॒स्तस्य॒ निष्कृ॑ते॒स्ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadīdidaṃ maruto mārutena yadi devā daivyenedṛgāra |
yūyamīśidhve vasavastasya niṣkṛteste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ति॒ग्ममनी॑कं विदि॒तं सह॑स्व॒न्मारु॑तं॒ शर्धः॒ पृत॑नासू॒ग्रम् ।
स्तौमि॑ म॒रुतो॑ नाथि॒तो जो॑हवीमि॒ ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tigmamanīkaṃ viditaṃ sahasvanmārutaṃ śardhaḥ pṛtanāsūgram |
staumi maruto nāthito johavīmi te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
भवा॑शर्वौ म॒न्वे वां॒ तस्य॑ वित्तं॒ ययो॑र्वामि॒दं प्र॒दिशि॒ यद् वि॒रोच॑ते ।
याव॒स्ये॑शा॑थे द्वि॒पदो॒ यौ चतु॑ष्पद॒स्तौ नो॑ मुञ्चत॒मंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhavāśarvau manve vāṃ tasya vittaṃ yayorvāmidaṃ pradiśi yad virocate |
yāvasyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadastau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A hymn to Bhava and Sarva
I Reverence you—mark this—Bhava and Sarva, ye under whose control is this that shineth.
Lords of this world both quadruped and biped. Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.
Lords of all near and even of what is distant, famed as the best and skilfullest of archers,
Lords of this world both quadruped and biped, Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.
Thousand-eyed foe-destroyers, I invoke you, still praising you the strong, of wide dominion:
Lords of this world both quadruped and biped, Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.
Ye who of old wrought many a deed in concert, and showed among mankind unhappy omens;
Lords of this world both quadruped and biped, Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.
Ye from the stroke of whose destroying weapon not one among the Gods or men escapeth,
Lords of this world both quadruped and biped, Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.
Hurl your bolt, strong Gods, at the Yātudhāna, him who makes ready roots and deals in magic:
Lords of this world both quadruped and biped, Deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.
Comfort and aid us, ye strong Gods, in battles, at each Kimidin send your bolt of thunder.
I, suppliant, praise and ever call on Bhav and Sarva. Set us free from grief and trouble.

verses.sanskrit:
ययो॑रभ्यभ्व॒ उ॒त यद् दू॒रे चि॒द् यौ वि॑दि॒तावि॑षु॒भृता॒मसि॑ष्ठौ ।
याव॒स्येशा॑थे द्वि॒पदो॒ यौ चतु॑ष्पद॒स्तौ नो॑ मुञ्चत॒मंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yayorabhyabhva uta yad dūre cid yau viditāviṣubhṛtāmasiṣṭhau |
yāvasyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadastau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒ह॒स्रा॒क्षौ वृ॑त्र॒हना॑ हुवे॒हं दू॒रेग॑व्यूती स्तु॒वन्ने॑म्यु॒ग्रौ ।
याव॒स्येशा॑थे द्वि॒पदो॒ यौ चतु॑ष्पद॒स्तौ नो॑ मुञ्चत॒मंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sahasrākṣau vṛtrahanā huvehaṃ dūregavyūtī stuvannemyugrau |
yāvasyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadastau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यावा॑रे॒भाथे॑ ब॒हु सा॒कमग्रे॒ प्र चेद॑स्रा॑ष्ट्रमभि॒भां जने॑षु ।
याव॒स्येशा॑थे द्वि॒पदो॒ यौ चतु॑ष्पद॒स्तौ नो॑ मुञ्चत॒मंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāvārebhāthe bahu sākamagre pra cedasrāṣṭramabhibhāṃ janeṣu |
yāvasyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadastau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ययो॑र्व॒धान्नाप॒पद्य॑ते॒ कश्च॒नान्तर्दे॒वेषू॒त मानु॑षेषु ।
याव॒स्येशा॑थे द्वि॒पदो॒ यौ चतु॑ष्पद॒स्तौ नो॑ मुञ्चत॒मंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yayorvadhānnāpapadyate kaścanāntardeveṣūta mānuṣeṣu |
yāvasyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadastau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यः कृ॑त्या॒कृन्मू॑ल॒कृद् या॑तु॒धानो॒ नि तस्मि॑न् धत्तं॒ वज्र॑मु॒ग्रौ ।
याव॒स्येशा॑थे द्वि॒पदो॒ यौ चतु॑ष्पद॒स्तौ नो॑ मुञ्चत॒मंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaḥ kṛtyākṛnmūlakṛd yātudhāno ni tasmin dhattaṃ vajramugrau |
yāvasyeśāthe dvipado yau catuṣpadastau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अधि॑ नो ब्रूतं॒ पृत॑नासूग्रौ॒ सं वज्रे॑ण सृजतं॒ यः कि॑मी॒दी ।
स्तौमि॑ भवाश॒र्वौ ना॑थि॒तो॑ जो॑हवीमि॒ तौ नो॑ मुञ्चत॒मंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
adhi no brūtaṃ pṛtanāsūgrau saṃ vajreṇa sṛjataṃ yaḥ kimīdī |
staumi bhavāśarvau nāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
म॒न्वे वां॑ मित्रावरुणावृतावृधौ॒ सचे॑तसौ॒ द्रुह्व॑णो॒ यौ नु॒देथे॑ ।
प्र स॒त्यावा॑न॒मव॑थो॒ भरे॑षु॒ तौ नो॑ मुञ्चत॒मंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
manve vāṃ mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāvṛdhau sacetasau druhvaṇo yau nudethe |
pra satyāvānamavatho bhareṣu tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A hymn to Mitra-Varuna
You twain, O Mitra, Varuna, I honour, Lawstrengtheners, wise, who drive away oppressors.
Ye who protect the truthful in his battles, deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.
Ye the wise Gods who drive away oppressors, ye who protect the truthful in his battles,
Who come, men’s guards, to juice pressed forth by Babhru,. deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.
Mitra and Varuna who help Agasti, Atri, and Angiras, and Jamadagni,
Ye who help Kasyapa, who help Vasishtha, deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.
Mitra and Varuna, who help Syāvāsva, Atri, and Purumilha, and Vadhryasva,
Ye who help Vimada and Saptavadhri, deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.
Ye, Varuna, Mitra, who give aid to Kutsa, Gavishthira,
Bharadvāja, Visvāmitra,
Who help Kakshivan and give aid to Kanva, deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.
Ye, Mitra, Varuna, who help Trisoka, Medhātithi, and Usanā son of Kavi,
Ye, Gotama’s and Mudgala’s protectors, deliver us, ye twain, from grief and trouble.
Whose straight-reined car that keeps the track of goodness assails and ruins him who walks perversely I, suppliant, praise with constant invocation Mitra and Varuna.
Save us from affliction.

verses.sanskrit:
सचे॑तसौ॒ द्रुह्व॑णो॒ यौ नु॒देथे॒ प्र स॒त्यावा॑न॒मव॑थो॒ भरे॑षु ।
यौ गच्छ॑थो नृ॒चक्ष॑सौ ब॒भ्रुणा॑ सु॒तं तौ नो॑ मुञ्चत॒मंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sacetasau druhvaṇo yau nudethe pra satyāvānamavatho bhareṣu |
yau gacchatho nṛcakṣasau babhruṇā sutaṃ tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यावङ्गि॑रस॒मव॑थो॒ याव॒गस्तिं॒ मित्रा॑वरुणा ज॒मद॑ग्नि॒मत्रिम् ।
यौ क॒श्यप॒मव॑थो॒ यौ वसि॑ष्ठं॒ तौ नो॑ मुञ्चत॒मंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāvaṅgirasamavatho yāvagastiṃ mitrāvaruṇā jamadagnimatrim |
yau kaśyapamavatho yau vasiṣṭhaṃ tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यौ श्या॒वाश्व॒मव॑थो वाध्र्य॒श्वं मित्रा॑वरुणा पुरुमी॒ढमत्रिम् ।
यौ वि॑म॒दमव॑थः स॒प्तव॑ध्रिं॒ तौ नो॑ मुञ्चत॒मंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yau śyāvāśvamavatho vādhryaśvaṃ mitrāvaruṇā purumīḍhamatrim |
yau vimadamavathaḥ saptavadhriṃ tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो भ॒रद्वा॑जमव॑थो॒ यौ ग॒विष्ठि॑रं वि॒श्वामि॑त्रं वरुण मित्र॒ कुत्स॑म् ।
यौ क॒क्षीव॑न्त॒मव॑थः प्रोत कण्वं॒ तौ नो॑ मुञ्चत॒मंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo bharadvājamavatho yau gaviṣṭhiraṃ viśvāmitraṃ varuṇa mitra kutsam |
yau kakṣīvantamavathaḥ prota kaṇvaṃ tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यौ मेधा॑तिथि॒मव॑थो॒ यौ त्रि॒शोकं॒ मित्रा॑वरुणावु॒शनां॑ का॒व्यं यौ ।
यौ गोत॑म॒मव॑थः प्रोत मुद्ग॑लं तौ नो॑ मुञ्चत॒मंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yau medhātithimavatho yau triśokaṃ mitrāvaruṇāvuśanāṃ kāvyaṃ yau |
yau gotamamavathaḥ prota mudgalaṃ tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ययो॒ रथः॑ स॒त्यव॑र्त्म॒र्जुर॑श्मिर्मिथु॒या चर॑न्तमभि॒याति॑ दू॒षय॑न् ।
स्तौमि॑ मि॒त्रावरु॑णौ नाथि॒तो जो॑हवीमि॒ तौ नो॑ मुञ्चत॒मंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yayo rathaḥ satyavartmarjuraśmirmithuyā carantamabhiyāti dūṣayan |
staumi mitrāvaruṇau nāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒हं रु॒द्रेभि॒र्वसु॑भिश्चराम्य॒हमा॑दि॒त्यैरु॒त वि॒श्वदे॑वैः ।
अ॒हं मि॒त्रावरु॑णो॒भा बि॑भर्म्य॒हमि॑न्द्रा॒ग्नी अ॒हम॒श्विनो॒भा ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahaṃ rudrebhirvasubhiścarāmyahamādityairuta viśvadevaiḥ |
ahaṃ mitrāvaruṇobhā bibharmyahamindrāgnī ahamaśvinobhā ||
verses.translation:
A glorification of vāk or speech
I travel with the Rudras and the Vasus, with the Ādityas and All-Gods I wander.
I hold aloft both Varuna and Mitra, I hold aloft Indra and both the Asvins.
I am the Queen, the gatherer-up of treasures, most thoughtful, first of those who merit worship.
The Gods, making me enter many places, in diverse spots have set mine habitation.
I, verily, myself announce and utter the word that Gods, and men alike shall welcome.
I make the man I love exceeding mighty, make him a sage, a Rishi, and a Brāhman.
Through me alone all eat the food that feeds them, each man who sees, breathes, hears, the word out-spoken.
They know it not, but yet they dwell beside me. Hear, one and all, the truth as I declare it.
I bend the bow for Rudra that his arrow may strike and slay the hater of devotion.
I rouse and order battle for the people, and I have penetrated Earth and Heaven.
I cherish and sustain high-swelling Soma, and Tvashtar I support,
Pashan, and Bhaga.
I load with wealth the zealous sacrificer who pours the juice and offers his oblation.
On the world’s summit I bring forth the Father: my home is in the waters, in the ocean.
Thence I extend o’er all existing creatures, and touch even yonder heaven with my forehead.
I breathe a strong breath like the wind and tempest, the while I hold together all existence.
Beyond this wide earth and beyond the heavens I have become so mighty in my grandeur.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒हं राष्ट्री॑ सं॒गम॑नी॒ वसू॑नां चिकि॒तुषी॑ प्रथ॒मा य॒ज्ञिया॑नाम् ।
तां मा॑ दे॒वा व्य॑दधुः पुरु॒त्रा भूरि॑स्थात्रां॒ भूर्या॑वे॒शय॑न्तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahaṃ rāṣṭrī saṃgamanī vasūnāṃ cikituṣī prathamā yajñiyānām |
tāṃ mā devā vyadadhuḥ purutrā bhūristhātrāṃ bhūryāveśayantaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒हमे॒व स्व॒यमि॒दं व॑दामि॒ जुष्टं॑ दे॒वाना॑मुत मानु॑षाणाम् ।
यं का॒मये॒ तन्त॑मु॒ग्रं कृ॑णोमि॒ तं ब्र॒ह्माणं॒ तमृषिं॒ तं सु॑मे॒धाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahameva svayamidaṃ vadāmi juṣṭaṃ devānāmuta mānuṣāṇām |
yaṃ kāmaye tantamugraṃ kṛṇomi taṃ brahmāṇaṃ tamṛṣiṃ taṃ sumedhām ||

verses.sanskrit:
मया॒ सोऽन्न॑मत्ति॒ यो वि॒पश्य॑ति॒ यः प्रा॒णति॒ य ईं शृ॒णोत्यु॒क्तम् ।
अ॒म॒न्तवो॒ मां त उप॑ क्षियन्ति श्रु॒धि श्रु॑त श्रु॒द्धेयं॑ ते वदामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
mayā so'nnamatti yo vipaśyati yaḥ prāṇati ya īṃ śṛṇotyuktam |
amantavo māṃ ta upa kṣiyanti śrudhi śruta śruddheyaṃ te vadāmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒हं रु॒द्राय॒ धनु॒रा त॑नोमि ब्रह्म॒द्विषे॒ शर॑वे॒ हन्त॒वा उ॑ ।
अ॒हं जना॑य स॒मदं॑ कृणोम्य॒हं॑ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी आ वि॑वेश ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahaṃ rudrāya dhanurā tanomi brahmadviṣe śarave hantavā u |
ahaṃ janāya samadaṃ kṛṇomyahaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ā viveśa ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒हं सोम॑माह॒नसं॑ बिभर्म्य॒हं त्वष्टा॑रमु॒त पू॒षणं॒ भग॑म् ।
अ॒हं द॑धामि॒ द्रवि॑णा ह॒विष्म॑ते सुप्रा॒व्या॒३ यज॑मानाय सुन्व॒ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahaṃ somamāhanasaṃ bibharmyahaṃ tvaṣṭāramuta pūṣaṇaṃ bhagam |
ahaṃ dadhāmi draviṇā haviṣmate suprāvyā yajamānāya sunvate ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒हं सु॑वे पि॒तर॑मस्य मू॒र्धन् मम॒ योनि॑र॒प्स्व॑१न्तः स॑मु॒द्रे ।
ततो॒ वि ति॑ष्ठे॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वो॒तामूं द्यां व॒र्ष्मणोप॑ स्पृशामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahaṃ suve pitaramasya mūrdhan mama yonirapsvantaḥ samudre |
tato vi tiṣṭhe bhuvanāni viśvotāmūṃ dyāṃ varṣmaṇopa spṛśāmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒हमे॒व वात॑ इव॒ प्र वा॑म्या॒रभ॑माणा॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
प॒रो दि॒वा प॒र ए॒ना पृ॑थि॒व्यौताव॑ती महि॒म्ना सं ब॑भूव ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahameva vāta iva pra vāmyārabhamāṇā bhuvanāni viśvā |
paro divā para enā pṛthivyautāvatī mahimnā saṃ babhūva ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया॑ मन्यो स॒रथ॑मारु॒जन्तो हर्ष॑माणा हृषि॒तासो॑ मरुत्वन् ।
ति॒ग्मेष॑व॒ आयु॑धा सं॒शिशा॑ना॒ उप॒ प्र य॑न्तु॒ नरो॑ अ॒ग्निरू॑पाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvayā manyo sarathamārujanto harṣamāṇā hṛṣitāso marutvan |
tigmeṣava āyudhā saṃśiśānā upa pra yantu naro agnirūpāḥ ||
verses.translation:
A hymn to Manyu or Wrath
Borne on with thee, O Manyu girt by Maruts, let our brave men, impetuous, bursting forward,
March on, like flames of fire in form, exulting, with pointed arrows, sharpening their weapons.
Flashing like fire, be thou, O conquering Manyu, invoked, O victor, as our army’s leader.
Slay thou our foes, distribute their possession: show forth thy vigour, scatter those who hate us.
O Manyu, overcome those who assail us. On! breaking, slaying, crushing down the foemen.
They have not hindered thine impetuous vigour: mighty! sole born! reduce them to subjection.
Alone of many thou art worshipped, Manyu: sharpen the spirit of each clan for combat.
With thee to aid, O thou of perfect splendour, we raise the glorious battle-shout for conquest.
Unyielding, bringing victory like Indra, O Manyu be thou here our sovran ruler.
To thy dear name. O victor, we sing praises: we know the spring from which thou art come hither.
Twin-borne with power, destructive bolt of thunder the highest conquering might is thine, subduer!
Be friendly to us in thy spirit, Manyu! O much-invoked, in shock of mighty battle!
For spoil let Varuna and Manyu give us the wealth of both sides gathered and collected;
And let our enemies with stricken spirits, o’er-whelmed with. terror, sling away defeated.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निरि॑व मन्यो त्विषि॒तः स॑हस्व सेना॒नीर्नः॑ सहुरे हू॒त ए॑धि ।
ह॒त्वाय॒ शत्रू॒न् वि भ॑जस्व॒ वेद॒ ओजो॒ मिमा॑नो॒ वि मृधो॑ नुदस्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
agniriva manyo tviṣitaḥ sahasva senānīrnaḥ sahure hūta edhi |
hatvāya śatrūn vi bhajasva veda ojo mimāno vi mṛdho nudasva ||

verses.sanskrit:
सह॑स्व मन्यो अ॒भिमा॑तिम॒स्मै रु॒जन् मृ॒णन् प्र॑मृ॒णन् प्रेहि॒ शत्रू॑न् ।
उ॒ग्रं ते॒ पाजो॑ न॒न्वा रु॑रुध्रे व॒शी वशं॑ नयासा एकज॒ त्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sahasva manyo abhimātimasmai rujan mṛṇan pramṛṇan prehi śatrūn |
ugraṃ te pājo nanvā rurudhre vaśī vaśaṃ nayāsā ekaja tvam ||

verses.sanskrit:
एको॑ बहू॒नाम॑सि मन्य ईडि॒ता विशं॑विशं यु॒द्धाय॒ सं शि॑शाधि ।
अकृ॑त्तरु॒क् त्वया॑ यु॒जा व॒यं द्यु॒मन्तं॒ घोषं॑ विज॒याय॑ कृण्मसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
eko bahūnāmasi manya īḍitā viśaṃviśaṃ yuddhāya saṃ śiśādhi |
akṛttaruk tvayā yujā vayaṃ dyumantaṃ ghoṣaṃ vijayāya kṛṇmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒जे॒ष॒कृदिन्द्र॑ इवानवब्र॒वो॒३ऽस्माकं॑ मन्यो अधि॒पा भ॑वे॒ह ।
प्रि॒यं ते॒ नाम॑ सहुरे गृणीमसि वि॒द्मा तमुत्सं॒ यत॑ आब॒भूथ॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vijeṣakṛdindra ivānavabravo'smākaṃ manyo adhipā bhaveha |
priyaṃ te nāma sahure gṛṇīmasi vidmā tamutsaṃ yata ābabhūtha ||

verses.sanskrit:
आभू॑त्या सह॒जा व॑ज्र सायक॒ सहो॑ बिभर्षि सहभूत॒ उत्त॑रम् ।
क्रत्वा॑ नो मन्यो स॒ह मे॒द्येऽधि महाध॒नस्य पुरुहूत सं॒सृजि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ābhūtyā sahajā vajra sāyaka saho bibharṣi sahabhūta uttaram |
kratvā no manyo saha medye'dhi mahādhanasya puruhūta saṃsṛji ||

verses.sanskrit:
संसृ॑ष्टं धन॑मु॒भयं॑ स॒माकृ॑तम॒स्मभ्यं॑ धत्तां॒ वरु॑णश्च म॒न्युः ।
भियो॒ दधा॑ना॒ हॄदये॑षु॒ शत्र॑वः॒ परा॑जितासो अप॒ नि ल॑यन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃsṛṣṭaṃ dhanamubhayaṃ samākṛtamasmabhyaṃ dhattāṃ varuṇaśca manyuḥ |
bhiyo dadhānā hṝdayeṣu śatravaḥ parājitāso apa ni layantām ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ते॑ म॒न्योऽवि॑धद् वज्र सायक॒ सह॒ ओजः॒ पुष्य॑ति॒ विश्व॑मानु॒षक् ।
सा॒ह्याम॒ दास॒मार्यं॒ त्वया॑ यु॒जा व॒यं सह॑स्कृतेन॒ सह॑सा॒ सह॑स्वता ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaste manyo'vidhad vajra sāyaka saha ojaḥ puṣyati viśvamānuṣak |
sāhyāma dāsamāryaṃ tvayā yujā vayaṃ sahaskṛtena sahasā sahasvatā ||
verses.translation:
A hymn to Manyu
He who hath reverenced thee, Manyu, destructive bolt! breeds. for himself forthwith all conquering energy.
Arya and Dāsa will we conquer with thine aid, with thee the conqueror, with conquest conquest-sped.
Manyu was Indra, yea, the God was Manyu; Manyu was Hotar Varuna, Jātavedas.
The tribes of human lineage worship Manyu. Accordant, with thy fervour, Manyu! guard us.
Come hither, Manyu, mightier than the mighty: smite, with thy fervour, for ally, our foemen.
Slayer of foes, of Vritra, and of Dasyu, bring thou to us all kinds of wealth and treasure.
For thou art, Manyu, of surpassing vigour, fierce, queller of the foe, and self-existent,
Shared by all men, victorious, subduer: vouchsafe to us superior strength in battles.
I have departed still without a portion, wise God! according to thy will, the mighty.
I, feeble man, was wroth with thee, O Manyu. Come in thy proper form and give us vigour.
Come hither, I am all thine own: advancing, turn thou to me, victorious, all-bestowing.
Come to me, Manyu, wielder of the thunder: bethink thee of thy friend, and slay the Dasyus.
Approach, and on our right hand hold thy station, then let us slay a multitude of foemen.
The best of meath I offer to support thee: may we be first to drink thereof in quiet.

verses.sanskrit:
म॒न्युरिन्द्रो॑ म॒न्युरे॒वास॑ दे॒वो म॒न्युर्होता॒ वरु॑णो जा॒तवे॑दाः ।
म॒न्युर्विश॑ ईडते॒ मानु॑षी॒र्याः पा॒हि नो॑ मन्यो॒ तप॑सा स॒जोषाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
manyurindro manyurevāsa devo manyurhotā varuṇo jātavedāḥ |
manyurviśa īḍate mānuṣīryāḥ pāhi no manyo tapasā sajoṣāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भीऽहि मन्यो त॒वस॒स्तवी॑या॒न् तप॑सा यु॒जा वि ज॑हि॒ शत्रू॑न् ।
अ॒मि॒त्र॒हा वृ॑त्र॒हा द॑स्यु॒हा च॒ विश्वा॒ वसू॒न्या भ॑रा॒ त्वं नः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhī'hi manyo tavasastavīyān tapasā yujā vi jahi śatrūn |
amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhā ca viśvā vasūnyā bharā tvaṃ naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं हि म॑न्यो अ॒भिभू॑त्योजाः स्वयं॒भूर्भामो॑ अभिमातिषा॒हः ।
वि॒श्वच॑र्षणिः॒ सहु॑रिः॒ सही॑यान॒स्मास्वोजः॒ पृत॑नासु धेहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvaṃ hi manyo abhibhūtyojāḥ svayaṃbhūrbhāmo abhimātiṣāhaḥ |
viśvacarṣaṇiḥ sahuriḥ sahīyānasmāsvojaḥ pṛtanāsu dhehi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भा॒गः सन्नप॒ परे॑तो अस्मि॒ तव॒ क्रत्वा॑ तवि॒षस्य॑ प्रचेतः ।
तं त्वा॑ मन्यो अक्र॒तुर्जि॑हीडा॒हं स्वा त॒नूर्ब॑ल॒दावा॑ न॒ एहि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhāgaḥ sannapa pareto asmi tava kratvā taviṣasya pracetaḥ |
taṃ tvā manyo akraturjihīḍāhaṃ svā tanūrbaladāvā na ehi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यं ते॑ अ॒स्म्युप॑ न॒ एह्य॒र्वाङ् प्र॑तीची॒नः स॑हुरे विश्वदावन् ।
मन्यो॑ वज्रिन्न॒भि न॒ आ व॑वृत्स्व॒ हना॑व॒ दस्यूं॑रुत बो॑ध्या॒पेः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ayaṃ te asmyupa na ehyarvāṅ pratīcīnaḥ sahure viśvadāvan |
manyo vajrinnabhi na ā vavṛtsva hanāva dasyūṃruta bodhyāpeḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भि प्रेहि॑ दक्षिण॒तो भ॑वा॒ नोऽधा॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ जङ्घनाव॒ भूरि॑ ।
जु॒होमि॑ ते ध॒रुणं॒ मध्वो॒ अग्र॑मु॒भावु॑पां॒शु प्र॑थ॒मा पि॑बाव ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhi prehi dakṣiṇato bhavā no'dhā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūri |
juhomi te dharuṇaṃ madhvo agramubhāvupāṃśu prathamā pibāva ||

verses.sanskrit:
अप॑ नः॒ शोशु॑चद॒घमग्ने॑ शुशु॒ग्ध्या र॒यिम् ।
अप॑ नः॒ शोशु॑चद॒घम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
apa naḥ śośucadaghamagne śuśugdhyā rayim |
apa naḥ śośucadagham ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to Agni for protection and prosperity
Chasing our pain with splendid light, O Agni, shine thou wealth on us.
His lustre flash our pain away.
For goodly fields, for pleasant homes, for wealth we sacrifice to thee.
His lustre flash our pain away!
Best praiser of all these be he, and foremost be our noble chiefs.
His lustre flash our pain away!
So that thy worshipper and we, thine, Agni! in our sons may live.
His lustre flash our pain away!
As ever conquering Agni’s beams of splendour go to every side,
His lustre flash our pain away.
To every side thy face is turned, thou art triumphant everywhere.
His lustre flash our pain away!
O thou whose face looks every way, bear off our foes as in a ship.
His lustre flash our pain away!
As in a ship across the flood, transport us to felicity. His lustre flash our pain away

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒क्षे॒त्रि॒या सु॑गातु॒या व॑सू॒या च॑ यजामहे ।
अप॑ नः॒ शोशु॑चद॒घम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sukṣetriyā sugātuyā vasūyā ca yajāmahe |
apa naḥ śośucadagham ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र यद् भन्दि॑ष्ठ एषां॒ प्रास्माका॑सश्च सू॒रयः॑ ।
अप॑ नः॒ शोशु॑चद॒घम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra yad bhandiṣṭha eṣāṃ prāsmākāsaśca sūrayaḥ |
apa naḥ śośucadagham ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र यत् ते॑ अग्ने सू॒रयो॒ जाये॑महि॒ प्र ते॑ व॒यम् ।
अप॑ नः॒ शोशु॑चद॒घम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra yat te agne sūrayo jāyemahi pra te vayam |
apa naḥ śośucadagham ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र यद॒ग्नेः सह॑स्वतो वि॒श्वतो॒ यन्ति॑ भा॒नवः॑ ।
अप॑ नः॒ शोशु॑चद॒घम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra yadagneḥ sahasvato viśvato yanti bhānavaḥ |
apa naḥ śośucadagham ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं हि वि॑श्वतोमुख वि॒श्वतः॑ परि॒भूरसि॑ ।
अप॑ नः॒ शोशु॑चद॒घम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvaṃ hi viśvatomukha viśvataḥ paribhūrasi |
apa naḥ śośucadagham ||

verses.sanskrit:
द्विषो॑ नो विश्वतोमु॒खाति॑ ना॒वेव॑ पारय ।
अप॑ नः॒ शोशु॑चद॒घम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
dviṣo no viśvatomukhāti nāveva pāraya |
apa naḥ śośucadagham ||

verses.sanskrit:
स नः॒ सिन्धु॑मिव ना॒वाति॑ पर्ष स्व॒स्तये॑ ।
अप॑ नः॒ शोशु॑चद॒घम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa naḥ sindhumiva nāvāti parṣa svastaye |
apa naḥ śośucadagham ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मा॑स्य शी॒र्षं बृ॒हद॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठं वा॑मदे॒व्यमु॒दर॑मोद॒नस्य॑ ।
छन्दां॑सि प॒क्षौ मुख॑मस्य स॒त्यं वि॑ष्टा॒री जा॒तस्तप॒सोऽधि॑ य॒ज्ञः ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmāsya śīrṣaṃ bṛhadasya pṛṣṭhaṃ vāmadevyamudaramodanasya |
chandāṃsi pakṣau mukhamasya satyaṃ viṣṭārī jātastapaso'dhi yajñaḥ ||
verses.translation:
Glorification of the Vishtāri sacrifice
The head of this is prayer, its back the Brihat, Odanas’s belly is the Vāmadevya;
Its face reality, its sides the metre, Vishtāri sacrifice produced from fervour.
Boneless, cleansed, purified by him who cleanseth, they go res-plendent to the world of splendour.
Fire burneth not their organ of enjoyment: much pleasure have they in the world of Svarga.
Never doth want or evil fortune visit those who prepare oblation called Vishtāri.
He goes unto the Gods, he dwells with Yama, he joys among Gandharvas meet for Soma.
Yama robs not of generative vigour the men who dress oblation called Vishtāri.
Borne on his car, a charioteer, he travels: endowed with wings he soars beyond the heavens.
Strongest is this, performed, of sacrifices: he hath reached heaven who hath prepared Vishtāri.
The oval-fruited lotus spreads his fibre: there bloom the nelo-phar and water-lilies.
Abundant with their overflow of sweetness, these streams shall reach thee in the world of Svarga, whole lakes with lotus-blossom shall approach thee.
Full lakes of butter with their banks of honey, flowing with wine, and milk and curds and water Abundant with their overflow of sweetness, these streams shall reach thee in the world of Svarga, whole lakes with lotus-blossom shall approach thee.
I give four pitchers, in four several places, filled to the brim with milk and curds and water.
Abundant with their overflow of sweetness, these streams shall reach thee in the world of Svarga, whole lakes with lotus-blossom shall approach thee.
I part this Odana among the Brāhmans, Vishtāri, conquering worlds and reaching heaven.
Let me not lose it: swelling by its nature, be it my perfect Cow to grant all wishes!

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न॒स्थाः पू॒ताः पव॑नेन शु॒द्धाः शुच॑यः॒ शुचि॒मपि॑ यन्ति लो॒कम् ।
नैषां शि॒श्नं प्र द॑हति जा॒तवे॑दाः स्व॒र्गे लो॒के ब॒हु स्त्रैण॑मेषाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
anasthāḥ pūtāḥ pavanena śuddhāḥ śucayaḥ śucimapi yanti lokam |
naiṣāṃ śiśnaṃ pra dahati jātavedāḥ svarge loke bahu straiṇameṣām ||

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒ष्टा॒रिण॑मोद॒नं ये पच॑न्ति॒ नैना॒नव॑र्तिः सचते क॒दा च॒न ।
आस्ते॑ य॒म उप॑ याति दे॒वान्त्सं ग॑न्ध॒र्वैर्मदते सो॒म्येभिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
viṣṭāriṇamodanaṃ ye pacanti nainānavartiḥ sacate kadā cana |
āste yama upa yāti devāntsaṃ gandharvairmadate somyebhiḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒ष्टा॒रिण॑मोद॒नं ये पच॑न्ति॒ नैना॑न् य॒मः परि॑ मुष्णाति॒ रेतः॑ ।
र॒थी ह॑ भू॒त्वा र॑थ॒यान॑ ईयते प॒क्षी ह॑ भू॒त्वाति॒ दिवः॒ समे॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
viṣṭāriṇamodanaṃ ye pacanti nainān yamaḥ pari muṣṇāti retaḥ |
rathī ha bhūtvā rathayāna īyate pakṣī ha bhūtvāti divaḥ sameti ||

verses.sanskrit:
ष॒ य॒ज्ञानां॒ वित॑तो॒ वहि॑ष्ठो विष्टा॒रिणं॑ प॒क्त्वा दि॒वमा विवे॑श ।
आ॒ण्डीकं॑ कुमु॑दं॒ सं त॑नोति॒ बिसं॑ शा॒लूकं॒ शफ॑को मुला॒ली ।
ए॒तास्त्वा॒ धारा॒ उप॑ यन्तु॒ सर्वाः॑ स्व॒र्गे लो॒के मधु॑म॒त् पिन्व॑माना॒ उप॑ त्वा तिष्ठन्तु पुष्क॒रिणीः॒ सम॑न्ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṣa yajñānāṃ vitato vahiṣṭho viṣṭāriṇaṃ paktvā divamā viveśa |
āṇḍīkaṃ kumudaṃ saṃ tanoti bisaṃ śālūkaṃ śaphako mulālī |
etāstvā dhārā upa yantu sarvāḥ svarge loke madhumat pinvamānā upa tvā tiṣṭhantu puṣkariṇīḥ samantāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
घृ॒तह्र॑दा॒ मधु॑कूलाः॒ सुरो॑दकाः क्षी॒रेण॑ पू॒र्णा उ॑द॒केन॑ द॒ध्ना ।
ए॒तास्त्वा॒ धारा॒ उप॑ यन्तु॒ सर्वाः॑ स्व॒र्गे लो॒के मधु॑म॒त् पिन्व॑माना॒ उप॑ त्वा तिष्ठन्तु पुष्क॒रिणीः॒ सम॑न्ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ghṛtahradā madhukūlāḥ surodakāḥ kṣīreṇa pūrṇā udakena dadhnā |
etāstvā dhārā upa yantu sarvāḥ svarge loke madhumat pinvamānā upa tvā tiṣṭhantu puṣkariṇīḥ samantāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
च॒तुरः॑ कु॒म्भांश्च॑तु॒र्धा द॑दामि क्षी॒रेण॑ पू॒र्नाँ उ॑द॒केन॑ द॒ध्ना ।
ए॒तास्त्वा॒ धारा॒ उप॑ यन्तु॒ सर्वाः॑ स्व॒र्गे लो॒के मधु॑म॒त् पिन्व॑माना॒ उप॑ त्वा तिष्ठन्तु पुष्क॒रिणीः॒ सम॑न्ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
caturaḥ kumbhāṃścaturdhā dadāmi kṣīreṇa pūrnām̐ udakena dadhnā |
etāstvā dhārā upa yantu sarvāḥ svarge loke madhumat pinvamānā upa tvā tiṣṭhantu puṣkariṇīḥ samantāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒ममो॑द॒नं नि द॑धे ब्राह्म॒णेषु॑ विष्टा॒रिणं॑ लोक॒जितं॑ स्व॒र्ग॑म् ।
स मे॒ मा क्षे॑ष्ट स्व॒धया॒ पिन्व॑मानो वि॒श्वरू॑पा धे॒नुः का॑म॒दुघा॑ मे अस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
imamodanaṃ ni dadhe brāhmaṇeṣu viṣṭāriṇaṃ lokajitaṃ svargam |
sa me mā kṣeṣṭa svadhayā pinvamāno viśvarūpā dhenuḥ kāmadughā me astu ||

verses.sanskrit:
बयमो॑द॒नं प्र॑थम॒जा ऋ॒तस्य॑ प्र॒जाप॑ति॒स्तप॑सा ब्र॒ह्मणेऽप॑चत् ।
यो लो॒कानां॒ विधृ॑ति॒र्नाभि॒रेषा॒त् तेनौ॑द॒नेनाति॑ तराणि मृ॒त्युम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
bayamodanaṃ prathamajā ṛtasya prajāpatistapasā brahmaṇe'pacat |
yo lokānāṃ vidhṛtirnābhireṣāt tenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum ||
verses.translation:
Magnification of the Odana or oblation of milk and rice
Odana which Prajāpati, the firstborn of Order, dressed with fervour for the Brāhman, which guards the worlds from breaking atIthe centre,—I with this Odana will conquer Mrityu.
Whereby the World-Creators vanquished Mrityu, that which they found by fervour, toil and trouble,
That which prayer first made ready for the Brāhman,—I with this Odana will conquer Mrityu.
That which upholds the Earth, the all-sustainer, that which hath filled air’s middle realm with moisture,
Which, raised on high in grandeur, stablished heaven,—I with this Odana will conquer Mrityu.
From which the months with thirty spokes were moulded, from which the twelve-spoked year was formed and fashioned.
Which circling day and night have ne’er o’ertaken,—I with this Odana will conquer Mrityu.
Which hath become breath-giver, life-bestower; to which the worlds flow full of oil and fatness,
To whom belong all the refulgent regions,—I with this Odana will conquer Mrityu.
From which, matured, sprang Amrit into being, which hath become Gāyatris lord and ruler,
In which the perfect Vedas have been treasured,—I with this Odana will conquer Mrityu,
I drive away the hostile God-despiser: far off be those who are mine adversaries,
I dress Brahmaudana that winneth all things. May the Gods hear me who believe and trust them.

verses.sanskrit:
येनात॑रन् भूत॒कृतोऽति॑ मृ॒त्युं यम॒न्ववि॑द॒न् तप॑सा॒ श्रमे॑ण ।
यं प॒पाच॑ ब्र॒ह्मणे॒ ब्रह्म॒ पूर्वं॒ तेनौ॑द॒नेनाति॑ तराणि मृ॒त्युम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yenātaran bhūtakṛto'ti mṛtyuṃ yamanvavidan tapasā śrameṇa |
yaṃ papāca brahmaṇe brahma pūrvaṃ tenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो दा॒धार॑ पृथि॒वीं वि॒श्वभो॑जसं॒ यो अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒मापृ॑णा॒द् रसे॑न ।
यो अस्त॑भ्ना॒द् दिव॑मू॒र्ध्वो म॑हि॒म्ना तेनौ॑द॒नेनाति॑ तराणि मृ॒त्युम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo dādhāra pṛthivīṃ viśvabhojasaṃ yo antarikṣamāpṛṇād rasena |
yo astabhnād divamūrdhvo mahimnā tenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मा॒न्मासा॒ निर्मि॑तास्त्रिं॒शद॑राः संवत्स॒रो यस्मा॒न्निर्मि॑तो॒ द्वाद॑शारः ।
अ॒हो॒रा॒त्रा यं प॑रि॒यन्तो॒ नापुस्तेनौ॑दनेनाति॑ तराणि मृ॒त्युम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasmānmāsā nirmitāstriṃśadarāḥ saṃvatsaro yasmānnirmito dvādaśāraḥ |
ahorātrā yaṃ pariyanto nāpustenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum ||

verses.sanskrit:
यः प्रा॑ण॒दः प्रा॑ण॒दवा॑न् ब॒भूव॒ यस्मै॑ लो॒का घृ॒तव॑न्तः॒ क्षर॑न्ति ।
ज्योति॑ष्मतीः प्र॒दिशो॒ यस्य॒ सर्वा॒स्तेनौ॑द॒नेनाति॑ तराणि मृ॒त्युम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaḥ prāṇadaḥ prāṇadavān babhūva yasmai lokā ghṛtavantaḥ kṣaranti |
jyotiṣmatīḥ pradiśo yasya sarvāstenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मा॑त् प॒क्वाद॒मृतं॑ संब॒भूव॒ यो गा॑य॒त्र्या अधि॑पतिर्ब॒भूव॑ ।
यस्मि॒न् वेदा॒ निहि॑ता वि॒श्वरू॑पा॒स्तेनौ॑द॒नेनाति॑ तराणि मृ॒त्युम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasmāt pakvādamṛtaṃ saṃbabhūva yo gāyatryā adhipatirbabhūva |
yasmin vedā nihitā viśvarūpāstenaudanenāti tarāṇi mṛtyum ||

verses.sanskrit:
अव॑ बाधे द्वि॒षन्तं॑ देवपी॒युं स॒पत्ना॒ ये मेऽप॒ ते भ॑वन्तु ।
ब्र॒ह्मौ॒द॒नं वि॑श्व॒जितं॑ पचामि शृ॒ण्वन्तु॑ मे श्र॒द्दधा॑नस्य दे॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ava bādhe dviṣantaṃ devapīyuṃ sapatnā ye me'pa te bhavantu |
brahmaudanaṃ viśvajitaṃ pacāmi śṛṇvantu me śraddadhānasya devāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
तान्त्स॒त्यौजाः॒ प्र द॑हत्व॒ग्निर्वै॑श्वान॒रोवृषा॑ ।
यो नो॑ दुर॒स्याद् दिप्सा॒च्चाथो॒ यो नो॑ अराति॒यात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tāntsatyaujāḥ pra dahatvagnirvaiśvānarovṛṣā |
yo no durasyād dipsāccātho yo no arātiyāt ||
verses.translation:
A charm against fiends, human enemies, and other pests
Endowed with true strength, let the Bull, Agni Vaisvānara, burn them up.
Him who would pain and injure us, him who would treat us as a foe.
Him who, unharmed, would injure us, and him who, harmed, would do us harm,
I lay between the doubled fangs of Agni, of Vaisvānara.
Those who, what time the moon is dark, hunt with loud cry and answering shout,
Flesh-eaters, others who would harm,—all these I overcome with might.
I conquer the Pisāchas with my power, and take their wealth away.
All who would injure us I slay. Let mine intention have success.
With Gods who flee with him, and match their rapid motion with the Sun,
I with those animals who dwell in rivers and on hills am found.
I trouble the Pisāchas as the tiger plagues men rich in kine.
They, even as dogs when they have seen a lion, find no hiding-place.
Naught with Pisāchas can I do, with thieves, with roamers of the wood.
Pisāchas flee and vanish from each village as I enter it.
Into whatever village this mine awful power penetrates,
Thence the Pisāchas flee away, and plot no further mischief there.
Those who enrage me with their prate, as flies torment an elephant,
I deem unhappy creatures, like small insects troublesome to man.
Destruction seize upon the man, as with a cord they hold a horse,
The fool who is enraged with me! He is not rescued from the noose.

verses.sanskrit:
यो नो॒ दिप्स॒ददि॑प्सतो॒ दिप्स॑तो॒ यश्च॒ दिप्स॑ति ।
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रस्य॒ दंष्ट्र॑योर॒ग्नेरपि॑ दधामि॒ तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo no dipsadadipsato dipsato yaśca dipsati |
vaiśvānarasya daṃṣṭrayoragnerapi dadhāmi tam ||

verses.sanskrit:
य आ॑ग॒रे मृ॒गय॑न्ते प्रतिक्रो॒शेऽमावा॒स्ये ।
क्र॒व्यादो॑ अ॒न्यान् दिप्स॑तः॒ सर्वां॒स्तान्त्सह॑सा सहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya āgare mṛgayante pratikrośe'māvāsye |
kravyādo anyān dipsataḥ sarvāṃstāntsahasā sahe ||

verses.sanskrit:
सहे॑ पिशा॒चान्त्सह॑सैषां॒ द्रवि॑णं ददे ।
सर्वा॑न् दुरस्य॒तो ह॑न्मि॒ सं म॒ आकू॑तिरृद्यताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sahe piśācāntsahasaiṣāṃ draviṇaṃ dade |
sarvān durasyato hanmi saṃ ma ākūtirṛdyatām ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये दे॒वास्तेन॒ हास॑न्ते॒ सूर्ये॑ण मिमते ज॒वम् ।
न॒दीषु॒ पर्व॑तेषु॒ ये सं तैः प॒शुभि॑र्विदे ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye devāstena hāsante sūryeṇa mimate javam |
nadīṣu parvateṣu ye saṃ taiḥ paśubhirvide ||

verses.sanskrit:
तप॑नो अस्मि पिशा॒चानां॑ व्या॒घ्रो गोम॑तामिव ।
श्वानः॑ सिं॒हमि॑व दृ॒ष्ट्वा ते न वि॑न्दन्ते॒ न्यञ्च॑नम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tapano asmi piśācānāṃ vyāghro gomatāmiva |
śvānaḥ siṃhamiva dṛṣṭvā te na vindante nyañcanam ||

verses.sanskrit:
न पि॑शा॒चैः सं श॑क्नोमि॒ न स्ते॒नैर्न व॑न॒र्गुभिः॑ ।
पि॒शा॒चास्तस्मा॑न्नश्यन्ति॒ यम॒हं ग्राम॑मावि॒शे ॥
verses.transliteration:
na piśācaiḥ saṃ śaknomi na stenairna vanargubhiḥ |
piśācāstasmānnaśyanti yamahaṃ grāmamāviśe ||

verses.sanskrit:
यं ग्राम॑मावि॒शत॑ इ॒दमु॒ग्रं सहो॒ मम॑ ।
पि॒शा॒चास्तस्मा॑न्नश्यन्ति॒ न पा॒पमुप॑ जानते ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaṃ grāmamāviśata idamugraṃ saho mama |
piśācāstasmānnaśyanti na pāpamupa jānate ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये मा॑ क्रो॒धय॑न्ति लपि॒ता ह॒स्तिनं॑ म॒शका॑ इव ।
तान॒हं म॑न्ये॒ दुर्हि॑ता॒न् जने॒ अल्प॑शयूनिव ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye mā krodhayanti lapitā hastinaṃ maśakā iva |
tānahaṃ manye durhitān jane alpaśayūniva ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भि तं निरृ॑तिर्धत्ता॒मश्व॑मिवाश्वाभि॒धान्या॑ ।
म॒ल्वो यो मह्यं॒ क्रुध्य॑ति॒ स उ॒ पाशा॒न्नमु॑च्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhi taṃ nirṛtirdhattāmaśvamivāśvābhidhānyā |
malvo yo mahyaṃ krudhyati sa u pāśānnamucyate ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया॒ पूर्व॒मथ॑र्वाणो ज॒घ्नू रक्षां॑स्योषधे ।
त्वया॑ जघान क॒श्यप॒स्त्वया॒ कण्वो॑ अ॒गस्त्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvayā pūrvamatharvāṇo jaghnū rakṣāṃsyoṣadhe |
tvayā jaghāna kaśyapastvayā kaṇvo agastyaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A charm against Gandharvas and Apsarases
With thee, O Plant, in olden time Atharvans smote and slew the fiends.
Kasyapa smote with thee, with thee did Kanava and Agastya smite.
With thee we scare and drive away Gandharvas and Apsarases.
O Ajasringi, chase the fiends. Cause all to vanish with thy smell.
Let the Apsarases, puffed away, go to the river, to the ford,—
Guggulū, Pīlā, Naladi, Aukshagandhi, Pramandini.
Ye have become attentive since the Apsarases have past away.
Where great trees are, Asvatthas and Nyagrodhas with their leafy crests,
There where your swings are green and bright, and lutes and cymbals sound in tune,
‘Ye have become attentive since the Apsarases have past away.
Hither hath come this one, the most effectual of herbs and plants.
Let Ajasringi penetrate, Arāaki with sharpened horn.
From the Gandharva, dancing near, the lord of the Apsarases,
Wearing the tuft of hair, I take all manhood and virility.
With those dread hundred iron spears, the darts of Indra, let it pierce.
The Blyxa-fed Gandharvas, those who bring no sacrificial gift.
With those dread hundred golden spears, the darts of Indra, let it pierce.
The Blyxa-fed Gandharvas, those who bring no sacrificial gift.
O Plant, be thou victorious, crush the Pisāchas, one and all,
Blyxa-fed, shining in the floods, illumining the selfish ones.
Youthful, completely decked with hair, one monkey-like, one like a dog,—
So the Gandharva, putting on a lovely look, pursues a dame.
Him with an efficacious charm we scare and cause to vanish hence.
Your wives are the Apsarases, and ye, Gandharvas, are their lords.
Run ye, immortal ones, away: forbear to interfere with men!

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया॑ व॒यम॑प्स॒रसो॑ गन्ध॒र्वांस्चा॑तयामहे ।
अज॑शृ॒ङ्ग्यज॒ रक्षः॒ सर्वा॑न् ग॒न्धेन॑ नाशय ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvayā vayamapsaraso gandharvāṃscātayāmahe |
ajaśṛṅgyaja rakṣaḥ sarvān gandhena nāśaya ||

verses.sanskrit:
न॒दीं य॑न्त्वप्स॒रसो॒ऽपां ता॒रम॑वश्व॒सम् ।
गु॒ल्गु॒लूः पीला॑ नल॒द्यौ॒३क्षग॑न्धिः प्रमन्द॒नी ।
तत् परे॑ताप्सरसः॒ प्रति॑बुद्धा अभूतन ॥
verses.transliteration:
nadīṃ yantvapsaraso'pāṃ tāramavaśvasam |
gulgulūḥ pīlā naladyaukṣagandhiḥ pramandanī |
tat paretāpsarasaḥ pratibuddhā abhūtana ||

verses.sanskrit:
यत्रा॑श्व॒त्था न्य॒ग्रोधा॑ महावृ॒क्षाः शि॑ख॒ण्डिनः॑ ।
तत् परे॑ताप्सरसः॒ प्रति॑बुद्धा अभूतन ॥
verses.transliteration:
yatrāśvatthā nyagrodhā mahāvṛkṣāḥ śikhaṇḍinaḥ |
tat paretāpsarasaḥ pratibuddhā abhūtana ||

verses.sanskrit:
यत्र॑ वः प्रे॒ङ्खा हरि॑ता॒ अर्जु॑ना उ॒त यत्रा॑घा॒ताः क॑र्क॒र्यः सं॒वद॑न्ति ।
तत् परे॑ताप्सरसः॒ प्रति॑बुद्धा अभूतन ॥
verses.transliteration:
yatra vaḥ preṅkhā haritā arjunā uta yatrāghātāḥ karkaryaḥ saṃvadanti |
tat paretāpsarasaḥ pratibuddhā abhūtana ||

verses.sanskrit:
एयम॑ग॒न्नोष॑धीनां वी॒रुधां॑ वी॒र्याऽवती ।
अ॒ज॒शृ॒ङ्ग्यऽराट॒की ती॑क्ष्णशृ॒ङ्गी व्यृऽषतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
eyamagannoṣadhīnāṃ vīrudhāṃ vīryā'vatī |
ajaśṛṅgya'rāṭakī tīkṣṇaśṛṅgī vyṛ'ṣatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒नृत्य॑तः शिख॒ण्डिनो॑ गन्ध॒र्वस्या॑प्सराप॒तेः ।
भि॒नद्मि॑ मु॒ष्कावपि॑ यामि॒ शेपः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ānṛtyataḥ śikhaṇḍino gandharvasyāpsarāpateḥ |
bhinadmi muṣkāvapi yāmi śepaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
भी॒मा इन्द्र॑स्य हे॒तयः॑ श॒तमृ॒ष्टीर॑य॒स्मयीः॑ ।
ताभि॑र्हविर॒दान् ग॑न्ध॒र्वान॑वका॒दान् व्यृऽषतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhīmā indrasya hetayaḥ śatamṛṣṭīrayasmayīḥ |
tābhirhaviradān gandharvānavakādān vyṛ'ṣatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
भी॒मा इन्द्र॑स्य हे॒तयः॑ श॒तमृ॒ष्टीर्हि॑र॒ण्ययीः॑ ।
ताभि॑र्हविर॒दान् ग॑न्ध॒र्वान॑वका॒दान् व्युऽषतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhīmā indrasya hetayaḥ śatamṛṣṭīrhiraṇyayīḥ |
tābhirhaviradān gandharvānavakādān vyu'ṣatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒व॒का॒दान॑भिशो॒चान॒प्सु ज्यो॑तय माम॒कान् ।
पि॒शा॒चान्त्सर्वा॑नोषधे॒ प्र मृ॑णीहि॒ सह॑स्व च ॥
verses.transliteration:
avakādānabhiśocānapsu jyotaya māmakān |
piśācāntsarvānoṣadhe pra mṛṇīhi sahasva ca ||

verses.sanskrit:
स्वेवैकः॑ क॒पिरि॒वैकः॑ कुमा॒रः स॑र्वकेश॒कः ।
प्रियो दृश इ॑व भू॒त्वा ग॑न्ध॒र्वः स॑चते॒ स्त्रिय॑स्त॑मि॒तो ना॑शयामसि॒ ब्रह्म॑णा वी॒र्याऽवता ॥
verses.transliteration:
svevaikaḥ kapirivaikaḥ kumāraḥ sarvakeśakaḥ |
priyo dṛśa iva bhūtvā gandharvaḥ sacate striyastamito nāśayāmasi brahmaṇā vīryā'vatā ||

verses.sanskrit:
जा॒या इद् वो॑ अप्स॒रसो॒ गन्ध॑र्वाः॒ पत॑यो यू॒यम् ।
अप धावतामर्त्या॒ मर्त्या॒न् मा स॑चध्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
jāyā id vo apsaraso gandharvāḥ patayo yūyam |
apa dhāvatāmartyā martyān mā sacadhvam ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒द्भि॒न्द॒तीं सं॒जय॑न्तीमप्स॒रां सा॑धुदे॒विनी॑म् ।
ग्लहे॑ कृ॒तानि॑ कृण्वा॒नाम॑प्स॒रां तामि॒ह हु॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration:
udbhindatīṃ saṃjayantīmapsarāṃ sādhudevinīm |
glahe kṛtāni kṛṇvānāmapsarāṃ tāmiha huve ||
verses.translation:
A charm for success in gambling
Hither I call the Apsaras, victorious, who plays with skill,
Her who comes freely fort to view, who wins the stakes in games of dice.
Hither I call that Apsaras who scatters and who gathers up.
The Apsaras who plays with skill and takes her winnings in the game.
Dancing around us with the dice, winning the wager by her play.
May she obtain the stake for us and gain the victory with skill.
May she approach us full of strength: let them not win this wealth of ours.
Hither I call that Apsaras, the joyous, the delightful one—
Those nymphs who revel in the dice, who suffer grief and yield to wrath.
Who follow in their course the rays of Sūrya, or as a particle of light attend him.
Whose leader from afar, with store of riches, compasses quickly all the worlds and guards them.
Pleased, may he come to this our burnt oblation, together with the Air, enriched with treasure.
Together with the Air, O rich in treasure, guard here the white cow and the calf, O mighty!
Here are abundant drops for thee, come hither! Here is thy white calf, let thy mind be with us.
Together with the Air, O rich in treasure, keep the white calf in safety here, O mighty!
Here is the grass, here is the stall, here do we bind the calf. We are your masters, name by name. All Hail!

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒चि॒न्व॒तीमा॑कि॒रन्ती॑मप्स॒रां सा॑धुदे॒विनी॑म् ।
ग्लहे॑ कृ॒तानि॑ गृह्णा॒नाम॑प्स॒रां तामि॒ह हु॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration:
vicinvatīmākirantīmapsarāṃ sādhudevinīm |
glahe kṛtāni gṛhṇānāmapsarāṃ tāmiha huve ||

verses.sanskrit:
यायैः॑ परि॒नृत्य॑त्या॒ददा॑ना कृ॒तं ग्लहा॑त् ।
सा नः॑ कृ॒तानि॑ सीष॒ती प्र॒हामा॑प्नोतु मा॒यया॑ ।
सा नः॒ पय॑स्व॒त्यैतु॒ मा नो॑ जैषुरि॒दं धन॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāyaiḥ parinṛtyatyādadānā kṛtaṃ glahāt |
sā naḥ kṛtāni sīṣatī prahāmāpnotu māyayā |
sā naḥ payasvatyaitu mā no jaiṣuridaṃ dhanam ||

verses.sanskrit:
या अ॒क्षेषु॑ प्र॒मोद॑न्ते॒ शुचं॒ क्रोधं॑ च॒ बिभ्र॑ती ।
आ॒न॒न्दिनीं॑ प्रमो॒दिनी॑मप्स॒रां तामि॒ह हु॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration:
yā akṣeṣu pramodante śucaṃ krodhaṃ ca bibhratī |
ānandinīṃ pramodinīmapsarāṃ tāmiha huve ||

verses.sanskrit:
सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मीननु॒ याः स॒ञ्चर॑न्ति॒ मरी॑चीर्वा॒ या अ॑नुस॒ञ्चर॑न्ति ।
यासा॑मृष॒भो दू॑र॒तो वा॒जिनी॑वान्त्स॒द्यः सर्वाँन् लो॒कान् प॒र्यैति॒ रक्ष॑न् ।
स न॒ ऐतु॒ होम॑मि॒मं जु॑षा॒णो॒३ऽन्तरि॑क्षेण स॒ह वा॒जिनी॑वान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sūryasya raśmīnanu yāḥ sañcaranti marīcīrvā yā anusañcaranti |
yāsāmṛṣabho dūrato vājinīvāntsadyaḥ sarvām̐n lokān paryaiti rakṣan |
sa na aitu homamimaṃ juṣāṇo'ntarikṣeṇa saha vājinīvān ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न्तरि॑क्षेन स॒ह वा॑जिनीवन् क॒र्कीं व॒त्सामि॒ह र॑क्ष वाजिन् ।
इ॒मे ते॑ स्तो॒का ब॑हु॒ला एह्य॒र्वाङि॒यं ते॑ क॒र्कीह ते॒ मनो॑ऽस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
antarikṣena saha vājinīvan karkīṃ vatsāmiha rakṣa vājin |
ime te stokā bahulā ehyarvāṅiyaṃ te karkīha te mano'stu ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न्तरि॑क्षेण स॒ह वा॑जिनीवन् क॒र्कीं व॒त्सामि॒ह र॑क्ष वाजिन् ।
अ॒यं घा॒सो अ॒यं व्र॒ज इ॒ह व॒त्सां नि ब॑ध्नीमः ।
य॒था॒ना॒म व॑ ईश्महे॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
antarikṣeṇa saha vājinīvan karkīṃ vatsāmiha rakṣa vājin |
ayaṃ ghāso ayaṃ vraja iha vatsāṃ ni badhnīmaḥ |
yathānāma va īśmahe svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
पृ॒थि॒व्याम॒ग्नये॒ सम॑नम॒न्त्स आ॑र्ध्नोत् ।
यथा॑ पृथि॒व्याम॒ग्नये॑ स॒मन॑मन्ने॒वा मह्यं॑ सं॒नमः॒ सं न॑मन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
pṛthivyāmagnaye samanamantsa ārdhnot |
yathā pṛthivyāmagnaye samanamannevā mahyaṃ saṃnamaḥ saṃ namantu ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to various deities for health, wealth, and prosperity
Agni no earth kath had mine homage. May he bless me.
As I have bowed me down to Agni on the earth, so let the Favouring Graces bow them down to me.
Earth is the Cow, her calf is Agni. May she with her calf Agni yield me food, strength, all my wish, life first of all, and off-spring, plenty, wealth. All Hail!
Vāyu in air hath had mine homage. May he bless me.
As I have bowed me down to Vāyu in the air, so let the Favour-ing Graces bow them down to me.
Air is the Cow, her calf is Vāyu. May she with her calf Vāyu yield me food, strength, all my wish, life first of all, and off-spring, plenty, wealth. All Hail!
The Sun in heaven hath had my homage. May he bless me.
As I have bowed me down unto the Sun in heaven, so let the Favouring Graces bow them down to me.
Heaven is the Cow, her calf Āditya. May she yield with her calf the Sun food, strength, and all my wish, life first of all, and offspring, plenty, wealth. All Hail!
To Chandra in the quarters have I bowed me. May he bless me.
As unto Chandra in the quarters I have bent, so let the Favour-ing Graces bow them down to me.
The quarters are the Cows, their calf is Chandra. May they yield with their calf the Moon food, strength and all my wish, life first of all, and offspring, plenty, wealth. All Hail!
Agni moves having entered into Agni, the Rishis’ son, who guards from imprecations,
I offer unto thee with reverent worship. Let me not mar the Gods’ appointed service.
Skilled in all ways, O God, O Jātavedas, I offer what is cleansed by heart and spirit.
To all thy seven mouths, O Jātavedas. Do thou accept with pleasure my libation.

verses.sanskrit:
पृ॒थि॒वी धे॒नुस्तस्या॑ अ॒ग्निर्व॒त्सः ।
सा मे॒ऽग्निना॑ व॒त्सेनेष॒मूर्जं॒ कामं॑ दुहाम् ।
आयुः॑ प्रथ॒मं प्र॒जां पोषं॑ र॒यिं स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pṛthivī dhenustasyā agnirvatsaḥ |
sā me'gninā vatseneṣamūrjaṃ kāmaṃ duhām |
āyuḥ prathamaṃ prajāṃ poṣaṃ rayiṃ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे वा॒यवे॒ सम॑नम॒न्त्स आ॑र्ध्नोत् ।
यथा॒न्तरि॑क्षे वा॒यवे॑ स॒मन॑मन्ने॒वा मह्यं॑ सं॒नमः॒ सं न॑मन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
antarikṣe vāyave samanamantsa ārdhnot |
yathāntarikṣe vāyave samanamannevā mahyaṃ saṃnamaḥ saṃ namantu ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न्तरि॑क्षं धे॒नुस्तस्या॑ वा॒युर्व॒त्सः ।
सा मे॑ वा॒युना॑ व॒त्सेनेष॒मूर्जं॒ कामं॑ दुहाम् ।
आयुः॑ प्रथ॒मं प्र॒जां पोषं॑ र॒यिं स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
antarikṣaṃ dhenustasyā vāyurvatsaḥ |
sā me vāyunā vatseneṣamūrjaṃ kāmaṃ duhām |
āyuḥ prathamaṃ prajāṃ poṣaṃ rayiṃ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
दि॒व्याऽदि॒त्याय॒ सम॑नम॒न्त्स आ॑र्ध्नोत् ।
यथा॑ दि॒व्याऽदि॒त्याय॑ स॒मन॑मन्ने॒वा मह्यं॑ सं॒नमः॒ सं न॑मन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
divyā'dityāya samanamantsa ārdhnot |
yathā divyā'dityāya samanamannevā mahyaṃ saṃnamaḥ saṃ namantu ||

verses.sanskrit:
द्यैर्धे॒नुस्तस्या॑ आदि॒त्यो व॒त्सः ।
सा म॑ आदि॒त्येन॑ व॒त्सेने॑ष॒मूर्जं॒ कामं॑ दुहाम् ।
आयुः॑ प्रथ॒मं प्र॒जां पोषं॑ र॒यिं स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
dyairdhenustasyā ādityo vatsaḥ |
sā ma ādityena vatseneṣamūrjaṃ kāmaṃ duhām |
āyuḥ prathamaṃ prajāṃ poṣaṃ rayiṃ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
दि॒क्षु च॒न्द्राय॒ सम॑नम॒न्त्स आ॑र्ध्नोत् ।
यथा॑ दि॒क्षु च॒न्द्राय॑ स॒मन॑मन्ने॒वा मह्यं॑ सं॒नमः॒ सं न॑मन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
dikṣu candrāya samanamantsa ārdhnot |
yathā dikṣu candrāya samanamannevā mahyaṃ saṃnamaḥ saṃ namantu ||

verses.sanskrit:
दिशो॑ धे॒नव॒स्तासां॑ च॒न्द्रो व॒त्सः ।
ता मे॑ च॒न्द्रेण॑ व॒त्सेनेष॒मूर्जं॒ कामं॑ दुहाम् ।
आयुः॑ प्रथ॒मं प्र॒जां पोषं॑ र॒यिं स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
diśo dhenavastāsāṃ candro vatsaḥ |
tā me candreṇa vatseneṣamūrjaṃ kāmaṃ duhām |
āyuḥ prathamaṃ prajāṃ poṣaṃ rayiṃ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्नाव॒ग्निश्च॑रति॒ प्रवि॑ष्ट॒ ऋषी॑णां पु॒त्रो अ॑भिशस्ति॒पा उ॑ ।
न॒म॒स्का॒रेण॒ नम॑सा ते जुहोमि॒ मा दे॒वानां॑ मिथु॒या क॑र्म भा॒गम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnāvagniścarati praviṣṭa ṛṣīṇāṃ putro abhiśastipā u |
namaskāreṇa namasā te juhomi mā devānāṃ mithuyā karma bhāgam ||

verses.sanskrit:
हृ॒दा पू॒तं मन॑सा जातवेदो॒ विश्वा॑नि देव व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान् ।
स॒प्तास्या॑नि॒ तव॑ जातवेद॒स्तेभ्यो॑ जुहोमि॒ स जु॑षस्व ह॒व्यम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
hṛdā pūtaṃ manasā jātavedo viśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān |
saptāsyāni tava jātavedastebhyo juhomi sa juṣasva havyam ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये पु॒रस्ता॒ज्जुह्व॑ति जातवेदः॒ प्राच्या॑ दि॒शोऽभि॒दास॑न्त्य॒स्मान् ।
अ॒ग्निमृ॒त्वा ते परा॑ञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्र॒त्यगे॑नान् प्रतिस॒रेण॑ हन्मि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye purastājjuhvati jātavedaḥ prācyā diśo'bhidāsantyasmān |
agnimṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyagenān pratisareṇa hanmi ||
verses.translation:
A charm against rival worshippers
O Jātavedas, eastward sacrificers, as foes assail us from the eastern quarter.
May they, turned back, be pained for harming Agni. I drive them backward with mine incantation.
O Jātavedas, southward sacrificers as foes assail us from the southern quarter.
May they, turned back, be pained for harming Yama. I smite them backward with mine incantation.
O Jātavedas, westward sacrificers as foes assail us from the western quarter.
For harming Varuna be they turned and troubled! I smite them backward with mine incantation.
Jātavedas, northward sacrificers as foes assail us from the northern quarter.
For harming Soma be they turned and troubled! I smite them backward with mine incantation.
O Jātavedas, nether sacrificers, as foes assail us from the stead-fast quarter.
For harming Earth let them be turned and troubled. I smite them backward with mine incantation.
Those who pay sacrifice, O Jātavedas, from air assail us from the midway quarter.
For harming Vāyu be they turned and troubled! I smite them backward with mine incantation.
The sacrificers from above assail us, O Jātavedas, from the lofty quarter.
For wronging Sūrya be they turned and troubled! I smite them backward with mine incantation.
Those from all points assail us, Jātavedas, who sacrifice from intermediate regions.
For wronging Prayer let them be turned and troubled, I smite them backward with mine incantation.

verses.sanskrit:
ये द॑क्षिण॒तो जुह्व॑ति जातवेदो॒ दक्षि॑णाया दि॒शोऽभि॒दास॑न्त्य॒स्मान् ।
य॒ममृ॒त्वा ते परा॑ञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्र॒त्यगे॑नान् प्रतिस॒रेण॑ हन्मि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye dakṣiṇato juhvati jātavedo dakṣiṇāyā diśo'bhidāsantyasmān |
yamamṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyagenān pratisareṇa hanmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये प॒श्चाज्जुह्व॑ति जातवेदः प्र॒तीच्या॑ दि॒शोऽभि॒दास॑न्त्य॒स्मान् ।
वरु॑णमृ॒त्वा ते परा॑ञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्र॒त्यगे॑नान् प्रतिस॒रेण॑ हन्मि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye paścājjuhvati jātavedaḥ pratīcyā diśo'bhidāsantyasmān |
varuṇamṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyagenān pratisareṇa hanmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
य उ॑त्तर॒तो जुह्व॑ति जातवेद॒ उदी॑च्या दि॒शोऽभि॒दास॑न्त्य॒स्मान् ।
सोम॑मृ॒त्वा ते परा॑ञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्र॒त्यगे॑नान् प्रतिस॒रेण॑ हन्मि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya uttarato juhvati jātaveda udīcyā diśo'bhidāsantyasmān |
somamṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyagenān pratisareṇa hanmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये॒३धस्ता॒ज्जुह्व॑ति जातवेदो ध्रु॒वाया॑ दि॒शोऽभिदास॑न्त्य॒स्मान् ।
भूमि॑मृ॒त्वा ते परा॑ञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्र॒त्यगे॑नान् प्रतिस॒रेण॑ हन्मि ॥
verses.transliteration:
yedhastājjuhvati jātavedo dhruvāyā diśo'bhidāsantyasmān |
bhūmimṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyagenān pratisareṇa hanmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये॒३ऽन्तरि॑क्षा॒ज्जुह्व॑ति जातवेदो व्य॒ध्वाया॑ दि॒शोऽभि॒दास॑न्त्य॒स्मान् ।
वा॒युमृ॒त्वा ते परा॑ञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्र॒त्यगे॑नान् प्रतिस॒रेण॑ हन्मि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye'ntarikṣājjuhvati jātavedo vyadhvāyā diśo'bhidāsantyasmān |
vāyumṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyagenān pratisareṇa hanmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
य उ॒परि॑ष्टा॒ज्जुह्व॑ति जातवेद ऊ॒र्ध्वाया॑ दि॒शोऽभि॒दास॑न्त्य॒स्मान् ।
सूर्य॑मृ॒त्वा ते परा॑ञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्र॒त्यगे॑नान् प्रतिस॒रेण॑ हन्मि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya upariṣṭājjuhvati jātaveda ūrdhvāyā diśo'bhidāsantyasmān |
sūryamṛtvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyagenān pratisareṇa hanmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये दि॒शाम॑न्तर्दे॒शेभ्यो॒ जुह्व॑ति जातवेदः सर्वा॑भ्यो दि॒ग्भ्योऽभि॒दास॑न्त्य॒स्मान् ।
ब्रह्म॒र्त्वा ते परा॑ञ्चो व्यथन्तां प्र॒त्यगे॑नान् प्रतिस॒रेण॑ हन्मि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye diśāmantardeśebhyo juhvati jātavedaḥ sarvābhyo digbhyo'bhidāsantyasmān |
brahmartvā te parāñco vyathantāṃ pratyagenān pratisareṇa hanmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
ऋध॑ङ्मन्त्रो॒ योनिं॒ य आ॑ब॒भूवामता॑सु॒र्वर्ध॑मानः सु॒जन्मा॑ ।
अद॑ब्धासु॒र्भ्राज॑मा॒नोऽहे॑व त्रि॒तो ध॒र्ता दा॑धार॒ त्रीणि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛdhaṅmantro yoniṃ ya ābabhūvāmatāsurvardhamānaḥ sujanmā |
adabdhāsurbhrājamāno'heva trito dhartā dādhāra trīṇi ||
verses.translation:
A glorification of Trita and Varuna
He who with special plans and deathless spirit, waxing, well-born, hath come unto his birthplace,
As he who shines upholds the days, thus Trita, of pure life, bears the Three as their supporter.
He who, the first, approached the holy statutes makes, after, many beauteous forms and figures.
Eager to drink, his birth-place first he entered who understands the word when yet unspoken.
He who—the fluid gold, with radiant kinsmen—to fervent glow delivered up thy body,
On him both set names, that shall live for ever: to him the regions shall send robes to clothe him,
As these have gone to their primeval station, each gaining an imperishable dwelling,
May kissing mothers of the bards’ beloved bring the pole-draw-ing husband to the sister.
By holy wisdom I a sage, Far-Strider! offer to thee this lofty adoration.
This worship both the mighty eddying rivers, coming together to this station, heighten.
Seven are the pathways which the wise have fashioned: to one of these may come the troubled mortal.
On sure ground where the ways are parted standeth Life’s Pillar in the dwelling of the Highest.
Working, I go my way with deathless spirit: life, spirit, bodies have gone gladly thither.
Aye, Sakra also gives his gift of treasure as when the sacrificer meets with power.
Yea, the son asks dominion of his father: this they declared the noblest path to welfare.
Varuna, let them see thy revelations: display the wondrous shapes of times to follow.
Halt with the milk, its other half, thou minglest and with that half, strong! unbeguiled! increasest.
Let us exalt the gracious friend, the mighty, Varuna son of-Aditi, strength-giver.
We have told him the marvels sung by poets. The utterance of Heaven and Earth is truthful.

verses.sanskrit:
आ यो धर्मा॑णि प्रथ॒मः स॒साद॒ ततो॒ वपूं॑षि कृणुषे पु॒रूणि॑ ।
धा॒स्युर्योनिं॑ प्रथ॒म आ वि॑वे॒शा यो वाच॒मनु॑दितां चि॒केत॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā yo dharmāṇi prathamaḥ sasāda tato vapūṃṣi kṛṇuṣe purūṇi |
dhāsyuryoniṃ prathama ā viveśā yo vācamanuditāṃ ciketa ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ते॒ शोका॑य त॒न्वंऽ रि॒रेच॒ क्षर॒द्धिर॑ण्यं॒ शुच॒योऽनु॒ स्वाः ।
अत्रा॑ दधेते अ॒मता॑नि॒ नामा॒स्मे वस्त्रा॑णि॒ विश॒ एर॑यन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaste śokāya tanvaṃ' rireca kṣaraddhiraṇyaṃ śucayo'nu svāḥ |
atrā dadhete amatāni nāmāsme vastrāṇi viśa erayantām ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र यदे॒ते प्र॑त॒रं पू॒र्व्यं गुः सदः॑सद आ॒तिष्ठ॑न्तो अजु॒र्यम् ।
क॒विः शु॒षस्य॑ मा॒तरा॑ रिहा॒णे जा॒म्यै धुर्यं॒ पति॒मेर॑येथाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra yadete prataraṃ pūrvyaṃ guḥ sadaḥsada ātiṣṭhanto ajuryam |
kaviḥ śuṣasya mātarā rihāṇe jāmyai dhuryaṃ patimerayethām ||

verses.sanskrit:
तदू॒ षु ते॑ म॒हत् पृ॑थुज्म॒न् नमः॑ क॒विः काव्ये॑न कृणोमि ।
यत् स॒म्यञ्चा॑वभि॒यन्ता॑व॒भि क्षामत्रा॑ म॒ही रोध॑चक्रे वावृ॒धेते॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tadū ṣu te mahat pṛthujman namaḥ kaviḥ kāvyena kṛṇomi |
yat samyañcāvabhiyantāvabhi kṣāmatrā mahī rodhacakre vāvṛdhete ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒प्त म॒र्यादाः॑ क॒वय॑स्ततक्षु॒स्तासा॒मिदेका॑म॒भ्यंऽहु॒रो गा॑त् ।
आ॒योर्ह॑ स्क॒म्भ उप॑मस्य नी॒डे प॒थां वि॑स॒र्गे ध॒रुणे॑षु तस्थौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sapta maryādāḥ kavayastatakṣustāsāmidekāmabhyaṃ'huro gāt |
āyorha skambha upamasya nīḍe pathāṃ visarge dharuṇeṣu tasthau ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒तामृता॑सु॒र्व्रत॑ एमि कृ॒न्वन्नसु॑रा॒त्मा त॒न्व॑१स्तत् सु॒मद्गुः॑ ।
उ॒त वा॑ श॒क्रो रत्नं॒ दधा॑त्यू॒र्जया॑ वा॒ यत् सच॑ते हवि॒र्दाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
utāmṛtāsurvrata emi kṛnvannasurātmā tanvastat sumadguḥ |
uta vā śakro ratnaṃ dadhātyūrjayā vā yat sacate havirdāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒त पु॒त्रः पि॒तरं॑ क्ष॒त्रमी॑डे ज्ये॒ष्ठं म॒र्याद॑मह्वयन्त्स्व॒स्तये॑ ।
दर्श॒न् नु ता व॑रुण॒ यास्ते॑ वि॒ष्ठा आ॒वर्व्र॑ततः कृणवो॒ वपूं॑षि ॥
verses.transliteration:
uta putraḥ pitaraṃ kṣatramīḍe jyeṣṭhaṃ maryādamahvayantsvastaye |
darśan nu tā varuṇa yāste viṣṭhā āvarvratataḥ kṛṇavo vapūṃṣi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒र्धम॒र्धेन॒ पय॑सा पृणक्ष्य॒र्धेन॑ शुष्म वर्धसे अमुर ।
अविं॑ वृधाम श॒ग्मियं॒ सखा॑यं॒ वरु॑णं पु॒त्रमदि॑त्या इषि॒रम् ।
क॒वि॒श॒स्तान्य॑स्मै॒ वपूं॑ष्यवोचाम॒ रोद॑सी सत्य॒वाचा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ardhamardhena payasā pṛṇakṣyardhena śuṣma vardhase amura |
aviṃ vṛdhāma śagmiyaṃ sakhāyaṃ varuṇaṃ putramadityā iṣiram |
kaviśastānyasmai vapūṃṣyavocāma rodasī satyavācā ||

verses.sanskrit:
तदिदा॑स॒ भुव॑नेषु॒ ज्येष्ठं॒ यतो॑ यज्ञ उ॒ग्र स्त्वे॒षनृ॑म्णः ।
स॒द्यो ज॑ज्ञा॒नो नि रि॑णाति॒ शत्रू॒ननु॒ यदे॑नं॒ मद॑न्ति॒ विश्व॒ ऊमाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tadidāsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhaṃ yato yajña ugra stveṣanṛmṇaḥ |
sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūnanu yadenaṃ madanti viśva ūmāḥ ||
verses.translation:
A glorification of Indra
In all the worlds That was the best and highest whence sprang the Mighty One of splendid valour.
As soon as born he overcomes his foemen, when those rejoice in him who bring him succour.
Grown mighty in his strength, with ample vigour, he as a foe strikes fear into the Dāsa,
Eager to win the breathing and the breathless: All sang thy praise at banquet and oblation.
All concentrate on thee their mental vigour what time these, twice or thrice, are thine assistants,
Blend what is sweeter than the sweet with sweetness win quickly with our meath that meath in battle.
If verily in every war the sages joy and exult in thee who win-nest treasures,
With mightier power, strong God, extend thy firmness: let not malevolent Kaokas harm thee.
Proudly we put our trust in thee in battles, when we behold great wealth the prize of combat.
I with my words impel thy weapons onward, and sharpen with my prayer thy vital vigour.
Thou in that house, the highest or the lowest, which thy protec-tion guards, bestowest riches.
Establish ye the ever-wandering mother, and bring full many deeds to their completion.
Praise in the height Him who hath many pathways, courageous, strongest, Aptya of the Aptyas Through strength he shows himself of ample power: pattern of Prithivī, he fights and conquers.
Brihaddiva, the foremost of light-winners, hath made these holy prayers, this strength for Indra.
Free Lord, he rules the mighty fold of cattle, winning, aglow, even all the billowy waters.
Thus hath Brihaddiva, the great Atharvan, spoken to Indra as himself in person.
Two sisters free from stain, the Mātarivans, with power impel him onward and exalt him.

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒वृ॒धा॒नः शव॑सा॒ भूर्यो॑जाः॒ शत्रु॑र्दा॒साय॑ भि॒यसं॑ दधाति ।
अव्य॑नच्च व्य॒नच्च॒ सस्नि॒ सं ते॑ नवन्त॒ प्रभृ॑ता॒ मदे॑षु ॥
verses.transliteration:
vāvṛdhānaḥ śavasā bhūryojāḥ śatrurdāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti |
avyanacca vyanacca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣu ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्वे क्रतु॒मपि॑ पृञ्चन्ति॒ भूरि॒ द्विर्यदे॒ते त्रिर्भव॒न्त्यूमाः॑ ।
स्वा॒दोः स्वा॒दीयः॑ स्वा॒दुना॑ सृजा॒ सम॒दः सु मधु॒ मधु॑ना॒भि यो॑धीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tve kratumapi pṛñcanti bhūri dviryadete trirbhavantyūmāḥ |
svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā samadaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यदि॑ चि॒न्नु त्वा॒ धना॒ जय॑न्तं॒ रणे॑रणे अनु॒मद॑न्ति॒ विप्राः॑ ।
ओजी॑यः शुष्मिन्त्स्थि॒रमा त॑नुष्व॒ मा त्वा॑ दभन् दु॒रेवा॑सः क॒शोकाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadi cinnu tvā dhanā jayantaṃ raṇeraṇe anumadanti viprāḥ |
ojīyaḥ śuṣmintsthiramā tanuṣva mā tvā dabhan durevāsaḥ kaśokāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया॑ व॒यं शा॑शद्महे॒ रणे॑षु प्र॒पश्य॑न्तो यु॒धेन्या॑नि॒ भूरि॑ ।
चो॒दया॑मि त॒ आयु॑धा॒ वचो॑भिः॒ सं ते॑ शिशामि॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ वयां॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvayā vayaṃ śāśadmahe raṇeṣu prapaśyanto yudhenyāni bhūri |
codayāmi ta āyudhā vacobhiḥ saṃ te śiśāmi brahmaṇā vayāṃsi ||

verses.sanskrit:
नि तद् द॑धि॒षेऽव॑रे॒ परे॑ च॒ यस्मि॒न्नावि॒थाव॑सा दुरो॒णे ।
आ स्था॑पयत मा॒तरं॑ जिग॒त्नुमत॑ इन्वत॒ कर्व॑राणि॒ भूरि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ni tad dadhiṣe'vare pare ca yasminnāvithāvasā duroṇe |
ā sthāpayata mātaraṃ jigatnumata invata karvarāṇi bhūri ||

verses.sanskrit:
स्तु॒ष्व व॑र्ष्मन् पुरु॒वर्त्मा॑नं॒ समृभ्वा॑णमि॒नत॑ममा॒प्तमा॒प्त्याना॑म् ।
आ द॑र्शति॒ शव॑सा॒ भूर्यो॑जाः॒ प्र स॑क्षति प्रति॒मानं॑ पृथि॒व्याः ॥
verses.transliteration:
stuṣva varṣman puruvartmānaṃ samṛbhvāṇaminatamamāptamāptyānām |
ā darśati śavasā bhūryojāḥ pra sakṣati pratimānaṃ pṛthivyāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मा ब्रह्म॑ बृ॒हद्दि॑वः कृणव॒दिन्द्रा॑य शू॒षम॑ग्रि॒यः स्व॒र्षाः ।
म॒हो गो॒त्रस्य॑ क्षयति स्व॒राजा॒ तुर॑श्चि॒द् विश्व॑मर्णव॒त् तप॑स्वान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
imā brahma bṛhaddivaḥ kṛṇavadindrāya śūṣamagriyaḥ svarṣāḥ |
maho gotrasya kṣayati svarājā turaścid viśvamarṇavat tapasvān ||

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒वा म॒हान् बृ॒हद्दि॑वो॒ अथ॒र्वावो॑च॒त् स्वां त॒न्व॑१मिन्द्र॑मे॒व ।
स्वसा॑रौ मात॒रिभ्व॑री अरि॒प्रे हि॒न्वन्ति॑ चैने॒ शव॑सा व॒र्ध॑य॑न्ति च ॥
verses.transliteration:
evā mahān bṛhaddivo atharvāvocat svāṃ tanvamindrameva |
svasārau mātaribhvarī aripre hinvanti caine śavasā vardhayanti ca ||

verses.sanskrit:
ममा॑ग्ने॒ वर्चो॑ विह॒वेष्व॑स्तु व॒यं त्वेन्धा॑नास्त॒न्वंऽपुषेम ।
मह्यं॑ नमन्तां प्र॒दिश॒श्चत॑स्रस्त्वयाध्य॑क्षेण॒ पृत॑ना जयेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
mamāgne varco vihaveṣvastu vayaṃ tvendhānāstanvaṃ'puṣema |
mahyaṃ namantāṃ pradiśaścatasrastvayādhyakṣeṇa pṛtanā jayema ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to Agni, Indra, and other deities for victory and prosperity
Let strength be mine while I invoke thee, Agni! enkindling thee may we support our bodies.
May the four regions bend and bow before me: with thee for guardian may we win the combat.
Baffling the range of our opponents, Agni! guard us as our protector round about us.
Down the steep slope go they who hate us, backward, and let their thought who watch at home be ruined.
May all the Gods be on my side in battle, the Maruts led by Indra, Vishnu, Agni.
Mine be the middle air’s extended region, and may the Wind blow favouring these my wishes.
For me let them present all mine oblations, and let my mind’s intention be accomplished.
May I be guiltless of the least transgression: may all the Gods come hither and protect me.
May the Gods grant me riches, may the blessing and invocation of the Gods assist me.
This boon shall the celestial Hotars win us: may we, unwound-ed, have brave heroes round us.
Ye six divine Expanses, give us freedom. Here, all ye Gods, acquit yourselves like heroes.
Let not calamity or curse o’ertake us, nor deeds of wickedness that merit hatred.
Do ye three Goddesses give ample shelter and all success to us ourselves and children.
Let us not lose our children or our bodies: let us not benefit the foe, King Soma!
Foodful and much-invoked, at this our calling may the far-reaching Bull grant us wide shelter.
Lord of bay coursers, Indra, bless our children: harm us not, give us not as prey to others.
Lord of the world, Creator and Disposer, may the God Savitar who quells assailants,
May the Ādityas, Rudras, both the Asvins, Gods, guard the sacrificer from destruction.
Let those who are our foemen stay afar from us: with Indra and with Agni we will drive them off.
The Ādityas and the Rudras, over us on high, have made me strong, a thinker, and a sovran lord.
Yea, we call Indra hitherward, the winner of wealth in battle and of kine and horses.
May he mark this our worship when we call him, Lord of bay steeds, thou art our friend and comrade.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॑ म॒न्युं प्र॑तिनु॒दन् परे॑षां॒ त्वं नो॑ गो॒पाः परि॑ पाहि वि॒श्वतः॑ ।
अपा॑ञ्चो यन्तु नि॒वता॑ दुर॒स्यवो॒ऽमैषां॑ चि॒त्तं प्र॒बुधां॒ वि ने॑शत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne manyuṃ pratinudan pareṣāṃ tvaṃ no gopāḥ pari pāhi viśvataḥ |
apāñco yantu nivatā durasyavo'maiṣāṃ cittaṃ prabudhāṃ vi neśat ||

verses.sanskrit:
मम॑ दे॒वा वि॑ह॒वे स॑न्तु॒ सर्व॒ इन्द्र॑वन्तो म॒रुतो॒ विष्णु॑र॒ग्निः ।
ममा॒न्तरि॑क्षमु॒रुलो॑कमस्तु॒ मह्यं॒ वातः॑ पवतां॒ कामा॑या॒स्मै ॥
verses.transliteration:
mama devā vihave santu sarva indravanto maruto viṣṇuragniḥ |
mamāntarikṣamurulokamastu mahyaṃ vātaḥ pavatāṃ kāmāyāsmai ||

verses.sanskrit:
मह्यं॑ यजन्तां॒ मम॒ यानी॒ष्टाकू॑तिः स॒त्या मन॑सो मे अस्तु ।
एनो॒ मा नि गां॑ कत॒मच्च॒नाहं विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अ॒भि र॑क्षन्तु मे॒ह ॥
verses.transliteration:
mahyaṃ yajantāṃ mama yānīṣṭākūtiḥ satyā manaso me astu |
eno mā ni gāṃ katamaccanāhaṃ viśve devā abhi rakṣantu meha ||

verses.sanskrit:
मयि॑ दे॒वा द्रवि॑ण॒मा य॑जन्तां॒ मय्या॒शीर॑स्तु॒ मयि॑ दे॒वहू॑तिः ।
दै॒वाः होता॑रः सनिषन्न ए॒तदरि॑ष्टाः स्याम त॒न्वाऽसु॒वीराः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
mayi devā draviṇamā yajantāṃ mayyāśīrastu mayi devahūtiḥ |
daivāḥ hotāraḥ saniṣanna etadariṣṭāḥ syāma tanvā'suvīrāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
दैवीः॑ षडुर्वीरु॒रु नः॑ कृणोत॒ विश्वे॑ देवास इ॒ह मा॑दयध्वम् ।
मा नो॑ विददभि॒भा मो अश॑स्ति॒र्मा नो विदद् वृजि॒ना द्वेष्या॒ या ॥
verses.transliteration:
daivīḥ ṣaḍurvīruru naḥ kṛṇota viśve devāsa iha mādayadhvam |
mā no vidadabhibhā mo aśastirmā no vidad vṛjinā dveṣyā yā ||

verses.sanskrit:
ति॒स्रो दे॑वी॒र्महि॑ नः॒ शर्म॑ यछत प्र॒जायै॑ नस्त॒न्वे॒३यच्च॑ पु॒ष्टम् ।
मा हा॑स्महि प्र॒जया॒ मा त॒नूभि॒र्मा र॑धाम द्विष॒ते सो॑म राजन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tisro devīrmahi naḥ śarma yachata prajāyai nastanveyacca puṣṭam |
mā hāsmahi prajayā mā tanūbhirmā radhāma dviṣate soma rājan ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒रु॒व्यचा॑ नो महि॒षः शर्म॑ यछत्व॒स्मिन् हवे॑ पुरुहू॒तः पु॑रु॒क्षु ।
स नः॑ प्र॒जायै॑ हर्यश्व मृ॒डेन्द्र॒ मा नो॑ रीरिषो॒ मा परा॑ दाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
uruvyacā no mahiṣaḥ śarma yachatvasmin have puruhūtaḥ purukṣu |
sa naḥ prajāyai haryaśva mṛḍendra mā no rīriṣo mā parā dāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
धा॒ता वि॑धा॒ता भुव॑नस्य॒ यस्पति॑र्दे॒वः स॑वि॒ताभि॑मातिषा॒हः ।
आ॒दि॒त्या रु॒द्रा अ॒श्विनो॒भा दे॒वाः पा॑न्तु यज॑मानं निरृ॒थात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhātā vidhātā bhuvanasya yaspatirdevaḥ savitābhimātiṣāhaḥ |
ādityā rudrā aśvinobhā devāḥ pāntu yajamānaṃ nirṛthāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये नः॑ स॒पत्ना॒ अप॒ ते भ॑वन्त्विन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्या॒मव॑ बाधामह एनान् ।
आ॒दि॒त्या रु॒द्रा उ॑परि॒स्पृशो॑ न उ॒ग्रं चे॒त्तार॑मधिरा॒जम॑क्रत ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye naḥ sapatnā apa te bhavantvindrāgnibhyāmava bādhāmaha enān |
ādityā rudrā uparispṛśo na ugraṃ cettāramadhirājamakrata ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒र्वाञ्च॒मिन्द्र॑म॒मुतो॑ हवामहे॒ यो गो॒जिद् ध॑न॒जिद॑श्व॒जिद् यः ।
इ॒मं नो॑ य॒ज्ञं वि॑ह॒वे शृ॑णोत्व॒स्माक॑मभूर्हर्यश्व मे॒दी ॥
verses.transliteration:
arvāñcamindramamuto havāmahe yo gojid dhanajidaśvajid yaḥ |
imaṃ no yajñaṃ vihave śṛṇotvasmākamabhūrharyaśva medī ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो गि॒रिष्वजा॑यथा वी॒रुधां॒ बल॑वत्तमः ।
कुष्ठेहि॑ तक्मनाशन त॒क्मानं॑ ना॒शय॑न्नि॒तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo giriṣvajāyathā vīrudhāṃ balavattamaḥ |
kuṣṭhehi takmanāśana takmānaṃ nāśayannitaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A charm against fever and other ailments
Thou who wast born on mountains, thou most mighty of all plants that grow.
Thou Banisher of Fever, come, Kushtha! make Fever pass away.
Brought from the Snowy Mountain, born on the high hill where eagles breed,
Men seek to buy thee when they hear: for Fever’s Banisher they know.
In the third heaven above us stands the Asvattha tree, the seat of Gods.
There the Gods sought the Kushtha Plant, embodiment of end-less life.
There moved through heaven a golden ship, a ship with cordage wrought of Gold.
There the Gods won the Kushtha Plant, the blossom of eternal life.
They sailed on pathways paved with gold, the oars they piled were wrought of gold:
All golden were the ships wherein they carried Kushtha down to earth.
O Kushtha, bring thou hitherward this man of mine, restore his health,
Yes, free him from disease for me.
Thou art descended from thee Gods, Soma’s benignant friend art thou,
Befriend my breath and vital air be gracious unto this mine eye.
Sprung, northward, from the Snowy Hill thou art conveyed to eastern men.
There they deal out among themselves Kushtha’s most noble qualities.
Most excellent, indeed, art thou, Kushtha! most noble is thy sire.
Make all Consumption pass away and render Fever powerless.
Malady that affects the head, eye-weakness, bodily defect—
All this let Kushtha heal and cure: aye, godlike is the vigorous power.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒प॒र्ण॒सुव॑ने गि॒रौ जा॒तं हि॒मव॑त॒स्परि॑ ।
धनै॑र॒भि श्रु॒त्वा य॑न्ति वि॒दुर्हि त॑क्म॒नाश॑नम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
suparṇasuvane girau jātaṃ himavataspari |
dhanairabhi śrutvā yanti vidurhi takmanāśanam ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्व॒त्थो दे॑व॒सद॑नस्तृ॒तीय॑स्यामि॒तो दि॒वि ।
तत्रा॒मृत॑स्य चक्ष॑णं दे॒वाः कुष्ठ॑मवन्वत ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśvattho devasadanastṛtīyasyāmito divi |
tatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇaṃ devāḥ kuṣṭhamavanvata ||

verses.sanskrit:
हि॒र॒ण्ययी॒ नौर॑चर॒द्धिर॑ण्यबन्धना दि॒वि ।
तत्रा॒मृत॑स्य॒ पुष्पं॑ दे॒वाः कुष्ठ॑मवन्वत ॥
verses.transliteration:
hiraṇyayī nauracaraddhiraṇyabandhanā divi |
tatrāmṛtasya puṣpaṃ devāḥ kuṣṭhamavanvata ||

verses.sanskrit:
हि॒र॒ण्ययाः॒ पन्था॑न आस॒न्नरि॑त्राणि हिर॒ण्यया॑ ।
नावो॑ हिर॒ण्ययी॑रास॒न् याभिः॒ कुष्ठं॑ नि॒राव॑हन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
hiraṇyayāḥ panthāna āsannaritrāṇi hiraṇyayā |
nāvo hiraṇyayīrāsan yābhiḥ kuṣṭhaṃ nirāvahan ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मं मे॑ कुष्ठ॒ पूरु॑षं॒ तमा व॑ह॒ तं निष्कु॑रु ।
तमु॑ मे अग॒दं कृ॑धि ॥
verses.transliteration:
imaṃ me kuṣṭha pūruṣaṃ tamā vaha taṃ niṣkuru |
tamu me agadaṃ kṛdhi ||

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वेभ्यो॒ अधि॑ जा॒तोऽसि॒ सोम॑स्यासि॒ सखा॑ हि॒तः ।
स प्रा॒णाय॑ व्या॒नाय॒ च॑क्षुषे मे अ॒स्मै मृ॑ड ॥
verses.transliteration:
devebhyo adhi jāto'si somasyāsi sakhā hitaḥ |
sa prāṇāya vyānāya cakṣuṣe me asmai mṛḍa ||

verses.sanskrit:
उद॑ङ् जा॒तो हि॒मव॑तः॒ स प्रा॒च्यां नी॑यसे॒ जन॑म् ।
तत्र॑ कुष्ठ॑स्य॒ नामा॑न्युत्त॒मानि॒ वि भे॑जिरे ॥
verses.transliteration:
udaṅ jāto himavataḥ sa prācyāṃ nīyase janam |
tatra kuṣṭhasya nāmānyuttamāni vi bhejire ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒त्त॒मो नाम॑ कुष्ठस्युत्त॒मो नाम॑ ते पि॒ता ।
यक्ष्मं॑ च॒ सर्वं॑ ना॒शय॑ त॒क्मानं॑ चार॒सं कृ॑धि ॥
verses.transliteration:
uttamo nāma kuṣṭhasyuttamo nāma te pitā |
yakṣmaṃ ca sarvaṃ nāśaya takmānaṃ cārasaṃ kṛdhi ||

verses.sanskrit:
शी॒र्षा॒म॒यमु॑पह॒त्याम॒क्ष्योस्त॒न्वो॒३रपः॑ ।
कुष्ठ॒स्तत् सर्वं॒ निष्क॑र॒द् दैवं॑ समह॒ वृष्ण्य॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śīrṣāmayamupahatyāmakṣyostanvorapaḥ |
kuṣṭhastat sarvaṃ niṣkarad daivaṃ samaha vṛṣṇyam ||

verses.sanskrit:
रात्री॑ मा॒ता नभः॑ पि॒तार्य॒मा ते॑ पिताम॒हः ।
सि॒ला॒ची नाम॒ वा अ॑सि॒ सा दे॒वाना॑मसि॒ स्वसा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
rātrī mātā nabhaḥ pitāryamā te pitāmahaḥ |
silācī nāma vā asi sā devānāmasi svasā ||
verses.translation:
A charm to mend a broken bone
Aryaman is thy grandsire, Night thy mother, and the Cloud thy sire.
Thy name is called Silāchi. Thou, thyself, art sister of the Gods.
Whoever drinketh thee hath life: thou savest and protectest man.
As nursing mother of mankind, thou takest all upon thy lap.
Thou clingest close to every tree, as a fond damsel clasps her love.
Thy name is called The Conqueror, She who Stands Fast, The Rescuer.
Whatever wound the arrow, or the staff, or violence inflicts,
Thereof thou art the remedy: as such restore this man to health.
Thou springest from blest Plaxa, or Asvattha, Dhava, Khadira,
Parna, or blest Nyagrodha, so come thou to use, Arundhatī!
Gold-coloured, bringing happy fate, most lovely, brilliant as the Sun,
Mayst thou, O Healing! come unto the fracture: Healing is thy name.
Gold-coloured, bringing happy fate, odorous, hairy-bodied one,
The sister of the Waters art thou, Lākshā! and thy soul is Wind.
Silāchi is thy name: thy sire, O goat-brown! is a damsel’s son.
Thou hast been sprinkled by the mouth of Yama’s tawny-coloured horse.
Issuing from the horse’s blood away she glided to the trees.
Become a winged water-brook, and come to us, Arundhatī!

verses.sanskrit:
यस्त्वा॒ पिब॑ति॒ जीव॑ति॒ त्राय॑से॒ पुरु॑षं॒ त्वम् ।
भ॒र्त्री हि शश्व॑ता॒मसि॒ जना॑नां च॒ न्यञ्च॑नी ॥
verses.transliteration:
yastvā pibati jīvati trāyase puruṣaṃ tvam |
bhartrī hi śaśvatāmasi janānāṃ ca nyañcanī ||

verses.sanskrit:
वृ॒क्षंवृ॑क्ष॒मा रो॑हसि वृष॒ण्यन्ती॑व क॒न्यला॑ ।
जय॑न्ती प्रत्या॒तिष्ठ॑न्ती॒ स्पर॑णी॒ नाम॒ वा अ॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration:
vṛkṣaṃvṛkṣamā rohasi vṛṣaṇyantīva kanyalā |
jayantī pratyātiṣṭhantī sparaṇī nāma vā asi ||

verses.sanskrit:
यद् द॒ण्डेन॒ यदिष्वा॒ यद् वारु॒र्हर॑सा कृ॒तम् ।
तस्य॒ त्वम॑सि॒ निष्कृ॑तिः॒ सेमं निष्कृ॑धि॒ पूरु॑षम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yad daṇḍena yadiṣvā yad vārurharasā kṛtam |
tasya tvamasi niṣkṛtiḥ semaṃ niṣkṛdhi pūruṣam ||

verses.sanskrit:
भ॒द्रात् प्ल॒क्षान्निस्ति॑ष्ठस्यश्व॒त्थात् ख॑दि॒राद्ध॒वात् ।
भ॒द्रान्न्य॒ग्रोधा॑त् प॒र्णात् सा न॒ एह्य॑रुन्धति ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhadrāt plakṣānnistiṣṭhasyaśvatthāt khadirāddhavāt |
bhadrānnyagrodhāt parṇāt sā na ehyarundhati ||

verses.sanskrit:
हिर॑ण्यवर्णे॒ सुभ॑गे॒ सूर्य॑वर्णे॒ वपु॑ष्टमे ।
रु॒तं ग॑छासि निष्कृते॒ निष्कृ॑ति॒र्नाम॒ वा अ॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration:
hiraṇyavarṇe subhage sūryavarṇe vapuṣṭame |
rutaṃ gachāsi niṣkṛte niṣkṛtirnāma vā asi ||

verses.sanskrit:
हिर॑ण्यवर्णे॒ सुभ॑गे॒ शुष्मे॒ लोम॑शवक्षने ।
अ॒पाम॑सि॒ स्वसा॒ लाक्षे॒ वातो॑ हा॒त्मा ब॑भूव ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
hiraṇyavarṇe subhage śuṣme lomaśavakṣane |
apāmasi svasā lākṣe vāto hātmā babhūva te ||

verses.sanskrit:
सि॒ला॒ची नाम॑ कानी॒नोऽज॑बभ्रु पि॒ता तव॑ ।
अश्वो॑ य॒मस्य॒ यः श्या॒वस्तस्य॑ हा॒स्नास्यु॑क्षि॒ता ॥
verses.transliteration:
silācī nāma kānīno'jababhru pitā tava |
aśvo yamasya yaḥ śyāvastasya hāsnāsyukṣitā ||

verses.sanskrit:
अश्व॑स्या॒स्नः संप॑तिता॒ सा वृ॒क्षां अ॒भि सि॑ष्यदे ।
स॒रा प॑त॒त्रिणी॑ भू॒त्वा सा न॒ एह्य॑रुन्धति ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśvasyāsnaḥ saṃpatitā sā vṛkṣāṃ abhi siṣyade |
sarā patatriṇī bhūtvā sā na ehyarundhati ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्म॑ जज्ञा॒नं प्र॑थ॒मं पु॒रस्ता॒द् वि सी॑म॒तः सु॒रुचो॑ वे॒न आ॑वः ।
स बु॒ध्न्याऽ उप॒मा अ॑स्य वि॒ष्ठाः स॒तश्च॒ योनि॒मस॑तश्च॒ वि वः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahma jajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastād vi sīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ |
sa budhnyā' upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ sataśca yonimasataśca vi vaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for protection and prosperity
Eastward at first the prayer was generated: Vena disclosed bright flashes from the summit,
Disclosed his deepest nearest revelations, womb of the non-existent and existent.
None have attained to those of old, those who wrought holy acts for you,
Let them not harm our heroes here. Therefore I set before you this.
Sweet-tongued, exhaustless, they have sent their voices down together in heaven’s vault that pours a thousand streams.
His wildly-restless warders never close an eye: in every place the snarers stand to bind men fast.
Speed forward, conquering all foes, to win the spoil,
Thou comest on thy haters with a surging sea. Thy name is Fragile. The thirteenth month is Indra’s home.
Through this now hast thou sent thy gifts. All hail!
With sharpened arms and missiles, kind and friendly, be gracious unto us, Soma and Rudra!
Through this hast thou been left in want. All hail!
With sharpened arms and missiles, kind and friendly, be gracious unto us, Soma and Rudra!
Through this hast thou committed faults. All hail!
With sharpened arms and missiles, kind and friendly, be gracious unto us, Soma and Rudra!
Free us from trouble, free us from dishonour, accept our wor-ship, give us life immortal.
O missile of the eye, missile of spirit, thou missile of devotion and of fervour!
Thou art the weapon shot against the weapon. Let those be weaponless who sin against us.
Make with thy weapon weaponless, O Agni, all wicked men who deal with us as foemen with eye, with thought, with spirit, or intention.
Thou art the house of Indra. I betake me to thee, I enter thee with all my cattle,
With all my people and with all my body, with all my soul, with mine entire possessions.
Thou art the guard of Indra. I betake me to thee, etc.
Thou art the shield of Indra. I betake me to thee, etc.
Indra’s protection art thou. I betake me to thee, I enter thee with all my cattle.
With all my people and with all my body, with all my soul, with mine entire possessions.

verses.sanskrit:
अना॑प्ता॒ ये वः॑ प्रथ॒मा यानि॒ कर्मा॑णि चक्रि॒रे ।
वी॒रान् नो॒ अत्र मा द॑भ॒न् तद् व॑ ए॒तत् पु॒रो द॑धे ॥
verses.transliteration:
anāptā ye vaḥ prathamā yāni karmāṇi cakrire |
vīrān no atra mā dabhan tad va etat puro dadhe ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒हस्र॑धार ए॒व ते सम॑स्वरन् दि॒वो नाके॒ मधु॑जिह्वा अस॒श्चतः॑ ।
तस्य॒ स्पशो॒ न नि मि॑षन्ति॒ भूर्ण॑यः प॒देप॑दे पा॒शिनः॑ सन्ति॒ सेत॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration:
sahasradhāra eva te samasvaran divo nāke madhujihvā asaścataḥ |
tasya spaśo na ni miṣanti bhūrṇayaḥ padepade pāśinaḥ santi setave ||

verses.sanskrit:
पर्यू॒ षु प्र ध॑न्वा॒ वाज॑सातये॒ परि॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ स॒क्षणिः॑ ।
द्वि॒षस्तदध्य॑र्ण॒वेने॑यसे सनिस्र॒सो नामा॑सि त्रयोद॒शो मास॒ इन्द्र॑स्य गृ॒हः ॥
verses.transliteration:
paryū ṣu pra dhanvā vājasātaye pari vṛtrāṇi sakṣaṇiḥ |
dviṣastadadhyarṇaveneyase sanisraso nāmāsi trayodaśo māsa indrasya gṛhaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
न्वे॒३तेना॑रात्सीरसौ॑ स्वाहा॑ ।
ति॒ग्मायु॑धौ ति॒ग्महे॑ती सु॒शेवौ॒ सोमा॑रुद्रावि॒ह सु मृ॑डतं नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
nvetenārātsīrasau svāhā |
tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevau somārudrāviha su mṛḍataṃ naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अवै॒तेना॑रात्सीरसौ॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
ति॒ग्मायु॑धौ ति॒ग्महे॑ती सु॒शेवौ॒ सोमा॑रुद्रावि॒ह सु मृ॑डतं नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
avaitenārātsīrasau svāhā |
tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevau somārudrāviha su mṛḍataṃ naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अपै॒तेना॑रात्सीरसौ॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
ति॒ग्मायु॑धौ ति॒ग्महे॑ती सु॒शेवौ॒ सोमा॑रुद्रावि॒ह सु मृ॑डतं नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
apaitenārātsīrasau svāhā |
tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevau somārudrāviha su mṛḍataṃ naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: मु॒मु॒क्तम॒स्मान् दु॑रि॒ताद॑व॒द्याज्जु॒षेथां य॒ज्ञम॒मृत॑म॒स्मासु॑ धत्तम् ॥
verses.transliteration: mumuktamasmān duritādavadyājjuṣethāṃ yajñamamṛtamasmāsu dhattam ||

verses.sanskrit:
चक्षु॑षो हेते॒ मन॑सो हेते॒ ब्रह्म॑णो हेते॒ तप॑सश्च हेते ।
मे॒न्या मे॒निर॑स्यमे॒नय॒स्ते स॑न्तु॒ ये॒३स्माँ अ॑भ्यघा॒यन्ति॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
cakṣuṣo hete manaso hete brahmaṇo hete tapasaśca hete |
menyā menirasyamenayaste santu yesmām̐ abhyaghāyanti ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो॒३ऽस्मांश्चक्षु॑षा॒ मन॑सा॒ चित्त्याकू॑त्या च॒ यो अ॑घा॒युर॑भि॒दासा॑त् ।
त्वं तान॑ग्ने मे॒न्यामे॒नीन् कृ॑णु॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo'smāṃścakṣuṣā manasā cittyākūtyā ca yo aghāyurabhidāsāt |
tvaṃ tānagne menyāmenīn kṛṇu svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑स्य गृ॒होऽसि । तं त्वा॒ प्र प॑द्ये॒ तं त्वा॒ प्र वि॑शामि॒ सर्व॑गुः॒
सर्व॑पूरु॒षः सर्वा॑त्मा॒ सर्व॑तनूः स॒ह यन्मेऽस्ति॒ तेन॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrasya gṛho'si | taṃ tvā pra padye taṃ tvā pra viśāmi sarvaguḥ
sarvapūruṣaḥ sarvātmā sarvatanūḥ saha yanme'sti tena ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ शर्मा॑सि ।तं त्वा॒ प्र प॑द्ये॒ तं त्वा॒ प्र वि॑शामि॒ सर्व॑गुः॒
सर्व॑पूरु॒षः सर्वा॑त्मा॒ सर्व॑तनूः स॒ह यन्मेऽस्ति॒ तेन॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrasya śarmāsi |taṃ tvā pra padye taṃ tvā pra viśāmi sarvaguḥ
sarvapūruṣaḥ sarvātmā sarvatanūḥ saha yanme'sti tena ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ वर्मा॑सि ।तं त्वा॒ प्र प॑द्ये॒ तं त्वा॒ प्रवि॑शामि॒ सर्व॑गुः॒
सर्व॑पूरु॒षः सर्वा॑त्मा॒ सर्व॑तनूः स॒ह यन्मेऽस्ति॒ तेन॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrasya varmāsi |taṃ tvā pra padye taṃ tvā praviśāmi sarvaguḥ
sarvapūruṣaḥ sarvātmā sarvatanūḥ saha yanme'sti tena ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ वरू॑थमसि । तं त्वा॒ प्र प॑द्ये॒ तं त्वा॒ प्रवि॑शामि॒ सर्व॑गुः॒
सर्व॑पूरु॒षः सर्वा॑त्मा॒ सर्व॑तनूः स॒ह यन्मेऽस्ति॒ तेन॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrasya varūthamasi | taṃ tvā pra padye taṃ tvā praviśāmi sarvaguḥ
sarvapūruṣaḥ sarvātmā sarvatanūḥ saha yanme'sti tena ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ नो॑ भर॒ मा परि॑ ष्ठा अराते॒ मा नो॑ रक्षी॒र्दक्षि॑णां नी॒यमा॑नाम् ।
नमो॑ वी॒र्त्साया॒ अस॑मृद्धये॒ नमो॑ अ॒स्त्वरा॑तये ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā no bhara mā pari ṣṭhā arāte mā no rakṣīrdakṣiṇāṃ nīyamānām |
namo vīrtsāyā asamṛddhaye namo astvarātaye ||
verses.translation:
A charm to deprecate Arāti or Malignity
Bring thou to us, bar not the way, Arāti! Stay not the guerdon that is being brought us.
Homage be paid to Failure, to Misfortune, and Malignity.
The man whom thou preferrest, O Arāti, he who prates to us—
This man of thine, we reverence. Baffle not thou my heart’s desire,
May our desire which Gods have roused fulfil itself by day and night.
We seek to win Arāti: to Arāti be our homage paid.
We, suppliant, call on Bhaga, on Sarasvati, Anumati,
Pleasant words have I spoken, sweet as honey is, at invocations of the Gods.
The portion that I crave with speech intelligent and full of power,
May faith, presented with the gift of tawny Soma, find to-day.
Do not thou make our words or wishes fruitless. Let the twain Indra Agni, bring us treasures.
All, fain to-day to give us gifts, welcome Arāti with your love.
Misfortune! go thou far away: we turn thy harmful dart aside.
I know thee well, Arāti! as oppressor, one who penetrates.
Oft, coming as a naked girl thou hauntest people in their sleep,
Baffling the thought, Arāti! and the firm intention of a man.
To her the mighty vast in size, who penetrates all points of space,
To her mine homage have I paid, Nirriti with her golden hair.
Auspicious, with her golden hue, pillowed on gold, the mighty one To this Arāti clad in robes of gold mine homage have I paid.

verses.sanskrit:
यम॑राते पुरोध॒त्से पुरु॑षं परिरा॒पिण॑म् ।
नम॑स्ते॒ तस्मै॑ कृण्मो॒ मा व॒निं व्य॑थयी॒र्मम॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yamarāte purodhatse puruṣaṃ parirāpiṇam |
namaste tasmai kṛṇmo mā vaniṃ vyathayīrmama ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र णो॑ व॒निर्दे॒वकृ॑ता॒ दिवा॒ नक्तं॑ च कल्पताम् ।
अरा॑तिमनु॒प्रेमो॑ व॒यं नमो॑ अ॒स्त्वरा॑तये ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra ṇo vanirdevakṛtā divā naktaṃ ca kalpatām |
arātimanupremo vayaṃ namo astvarātaye ||

verses.sanskrit:
सर॑स्वती॒मनु॑मतिं॒ भगं॒ यन्तो॑ हवामहे ।
वाचं॑ जु॒ष्टां मधु॑मतीमवादिषं दे॒वानां॑ दे॒वहू॑तिषु ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarasvatīmanumatiṃ bhagaṃ yanto havāmahe |
vācaṃ juṣṭāṃ madhumatīmavādiṣaṃ devānāṃ devahūtiṣu ||

verses.sanskrit:
यं याचा॑म्य॒हं वा॒चा सर॑स्वत्या मनो॒युजा॑ ।
श्र॒द्धा तम॒द्य वि॑न्दतु द॒त्ता सोमे॑न ब॒भ्रुणा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaṃ yācāmyahaṃ vācā sarasvatyā manoyujā |
śraddhā tamadya vindatu dattā somena babhruṇā ||

verses.sanskrit:
मा व॒निं मा वाचं॑ नो॒ वीर्त्सी॑रु॒भावि॑न्द्रा॒ग्नी आ भ॑रतां नो॒ वसू॑नि ।
सर्वे॑ नो अ॒द्य दित्स॒न्तोऽरा॑तिं॒ प्रति॑ हर्यत ॥
verses.transliteration:
mā vaniṃ mā vācaṃ no vīrtsīrubhāvindrāgnī ā bharatāṃ no vasūni |
sarve no adya ditsanto'rātiṃ prati haryata ||

verses.sanskrit:
प॒रोऽपे॑ह्यसमृद्धे॒ वि ते॑ हे॒तिं न॑यामसि ।
वेद॑ त्वा॒हं नि॒मीव॑न्तीं नितु॒दन्ती॑मराते ॥
verses.transliteration:
paro'pehyasamṛddhe vi te hetiṃ nayāmasi |
veda tvāhaṃ nimīvantīṃ nitudantīmarāte ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒त न॒ग्ना बोभु॑वती स्वप्न॒या स॑चसे॒ जन॑म् ।
अरा॑ते चि॒त्तं वीर्त्स॒न्त्याकू॑तिं॒ पुरु॑षस्य च ॥
verses.transliteration:
uta nagnā bobhuvatī svapnayā sacase janam |
arāte cittaṃ vīrtsantyākūtiṃ puruṣasya ca ||

verses.sanskrit:
या म॑ह॒ती म॒होन्मा॑ना॒ विश्वा॒ आशा॑ व्यान॒शे ।
तस्यै॑ हिरण्यके॒श्यै निरृ॑त्या अकरं॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yā mahatī mahonmānā viśvā āśā vyānaśe |
tasyai hiraṇyakeśyai nirṛtyā akaraṃ namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
हिर॑ण्यवर्णा सु॒भगा॒ हिर॑ण्यकशिपुर्म॒ही ।
तस्यै॒ हिर॑ण्यद्राप॒येऽरा॑त्या अकरं॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hiraṇyavarṇā subhagā hiraṇyakaśipurmahī |
tasyai hiraṇyadrāpaye'rātyā akaraṃ namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
वै॒क॒ङ्क॒तेने॒ध्मेन॑ दे॒वेभ्य॒ आज्यं॑ वह ।
अग्ने॒ ताँ इ॒ह मा॑दय॒ सर्व॑ आ य॑न्तु मे॒ हव॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vaikaṅkatenedhmena devebhya ājyaṃ vaha |
agne tām̐ iha mādaya sarva ā yantu me havam ||
verses.translation:
A charm for the discomfiture and destruction of hostile priests
