With fuel of Vikankata bring molten butter to the Gods.
O Agni, make them joyful here: let them all come unto my call.
O Indra, come unto my call, This will I do. So hear it thou.
Let these exertions for the sake of Indra guide my wish aright.
Therewith, O Jātavedas, Lord of Bodies! may we win us strength.
Whatever plot from yonder, O ye Gods, that godless man would frame,
Let not the Gods come to his call, nor Agni bear his offering up.
Come, ye, come hither to my call.
Run, ye Fxertions, farther on By Indra’s order smite and slay.
As a wolf worrieth a sheep, so let not him escape from you while life remains. Stop fast his breath.
The Brāhman whom those yonder have appointed priest, for injury,
He, Indra! is beneath thy feet. I cast him to the God of Death.
If they have issued forth, strongholds of Gods, and made their shield of prayer,
Gaining protection for their lives, protection round about, make all their instigation powerless.
Exertions which that man hath made, Exertions which he yet will make Turn them, O Indra, back again, O Vritra-slayer, back again on him that they may kill that man.
As Indra, having seized him, set his foot upon Udvāchana,
Even so for all the coming years I cast those men beneath my feet.
Here, Indra Vritra-slayer, in thy strength pierce thou their vital. parts.
Here, even here, attack them, O Indra. Thine own dear friend am I.
Indra, we closely cling to thee. May we be in thy favouring grace.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रा या॑हि मे॒ हव॑मि॒दं क॑रिष्यामि॒ तच्छृ॑णु ।
इ॒म ऐ॒न्द्रा अ॑तिस॒रा आकू॑तिं॒ सं न॑मन्तु मे ।
तेभिः॑ शकेम वी॒र्यं१ जात॑वेद॒स्तनू॑वशिन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrā yāhi me havamidaṃ kariṣyāmi tacchṛṇu |
ima aindrā atisarā ākūtiṃ saṃ namantu me |
tebhiḥ śakema vīryaṃ jātavedastanūvaśin ||

verses.sanskrit:
यद॒साव॒मुतो॑ देवा अदे॒वः संश्चिकी॑र्षति ।
मा तस्या॒ग्निर्ह॒व्यं वा॑क्षी॒द्धवं॑ दे॒वा अ॑स्य॒ मोप॑ गु॒र्ममै॒व हव॒मेत॑न ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadasāvamuto devā adevaḥ saṃścikīrṣati |
mā tasyāgnirhavyaṃ vākṣīddhavaṃ devā asya mopa gurmamaiva havametana ||

verses.sanskrit:
अति॑ धावतातिसरा॒ इन्द्र॑स्य॒ वच॑सा हत ।
अविं॒ वृक॑ इव मथ्नीत॒ स वो॒ जीव॒न्मा मो॑चि प्रा॒णम॒स्यापि॑ नह्यत ॥
verses.transliteration:
ati dhāvatātisarā indrasya vacasā hata |
aviṃ vṛka iva mathnīta sa vo jīvanmā moci prāṇamasyāpi nahyata ||

verses.sanskrit:
यम॒मी पु॑रोदधि॒रे ब्र॒ह्माण॒मप॑भूतये ।
इन्द्र॒ स ते॑ अधस्प॒दं तं प्रत्य॑स्यामि मृ॒त्यवे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yamamī purodadhire brahmāṇamapabhūtaye |
indra sa te adhaspadaṃ taṃ pratyasyāmi mṛtyave ||

verses.sanskrit:
यदि॑ प्रे॒युर्देव॑पु॒रा ब्रह्म॒ वर्मा॑णि चक्रि॒रे ।
त॒नू॒पानं॑ परि॒पाणं॑ कृण्वा॒ना यदु॑पोचि॒रे सर्वं॒ तद॑र॒सं कृ॑धि ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadi preyurdevapurā brahma varmāṇi cakrire |
tanūpānaṃ paripāṇaṃ kṛṇvānā yadupocire sarvaṃ tadarasaṃ kṛdhi ||

verses.sanskrit:
यान॒साव॑तिस॒रांश्च॒कार॑ कृ॒णव॑च्च॒ यान् ।
त्वं तानि॑न्द्र वृत्रहन् प्र॒तीचः॒ पुन॒रा कृ॑धि॒ यथा॒मुं तृ॒णहां॒ जन॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yānasāvatisarāṃścakāra kṛṇavacca yān |
tvaṃ tānindra vṛtrahan pratīcaḥ punarā kṛdhi yathāmuṃ tṛṇahāṃ janam ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथेन्द्र॑ उ॒द्वाच॑नं ल॒ब्ध्वा च॒क्रे अ॑धस्प॒दम् ।
कृ॒ण्वे॒३ऽहमध॑रां॒स्तथा॒मूञ्छ॑श्व॒तीभ्यः॒ समा॑भ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathendra udvācanaṃ labdhvā cakre adhaspadam |
kṛṇve'hamadharāṃstathāmūñchaśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अत्रै॑नानिन्द्र वृत्रहन्नु॒ग्रो मर्म॑णि विध्य ।
अत्रै॒वैना॑न॒भि ति॒ष्ठेन्द्र मे॒द्य॑१हं तव॑ ।
अनु॑ त्वे॒न्द्रा र॑भामहे॒ स्याम॑ सुम॒तौ तव॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
atrainānindra vṛtrahannugro marmaṇi vidhya |
atraivainānabhi tiṣṭhendra medyahaṃ tava |
anu tvendrā rabhāmahe syāma sumatau tava ||
dive svāhā ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to Heaven and Earth for protection and assistance
All hail to Heaven!
All hail to Earth!
All hail to Air!
All hail to Air!
All hail to Heaven!
All hail to Eartht!
Mine eye is Sīirya and my breath is Vāta, Air is my soul and Prithivī my body.
I verily who never have been conquered give up my life toe Heaven and Earth for keeping.
Exalt my life, my strength, my deed and action; increase my understanding and my vigour.
Be ye my powerful keepers, watch and guard me, ye mistresses of life and life’s creators!
Dwell ye within me, and forbear to harm me.

verses.transliteration: pṛthivyai svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: अ॒न्तरि॑क्षाय॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: antarikṣāya svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: अ॒न्तरि॑क्षाय॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: antarikṣāya svāhā ||
divesvāhā ||
pṛthivyai svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
सूर्यो॑ मे॒ चक्षु॒र्वातः॑ प्रा॒णो॒३न्तरि॑क्षमा॒त्मा पृ॑थि॒वी शरी॑रम् ।
अ॒स्तृ॒तो नामा॒हम॒य म॑स्मि॒ स आ॒त्मानं॒ नि द॑धे॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्यां॑ गोपी॒थाय॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sūryo me cakṣurvātaḥ prāṇontarikṣamātmā pṛthivī śarīram |
astṛto nāmāhamaya masmi sa ātmānaṃ ni dadhe dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ gopīthāya ||

verses.sanskrit:
उदायु॒रुद् बल॒मुत् कृ॒तमुत् कृ॒त्यामुन्म॑नी॒षामुदि॑न्द्रि॒यम् ।
आयु॑ष्कृ॒दायु॑ष्पत्नी॒ स्वधा॑वन्तौ गो॒पा मे॑ स्तं गोपा॒यतं॑ मा ।
आ॒त्म॒सदौ॑ मे स्तं॒ मा॑ हिंसिष्टम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
udāyurud balamut kṛtamut kṛtyāmunmanīṣāmudindriyam |
āyuṣkṛdāyuṣpatnī svadhāvantau gopā me staṃ gopāyataṃ mā |
ātmasadau me staṃ mā hiṃsiṣṭam ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्म॒व॒र्म मे॑ऽसि॒ यो मा॒ प्राच्या॑ दि॒शोऽघा॒युर॑भि॒दासा॑त् ।
ए॒तत् स ऋ॑च्छात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśmavarma me'si yo mā prācyā diśo'ghāyurabhidāsāt |
etat sa ṛcchāt ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to the presiding deities of the four quarters for protection
Thou art my wall of stone against the sinner who fights against me from the eastern quarter.
May he encounter it!
Thou art my wall of stone against the sinner who fights against me from the southern quarter.
May he encounter it!
Thou art my wall of stone against the sinner who fights against me from the western quarter.
May he encounter it!
Thou art my wall of stone against the sinner who fights against me from northern quarter.
May he encounter it!
Thou art my wall of stone against the sinner who fights against me from the stedfast region.
May he encounter it!
Thou art my wall of stone against the sinner who fights against Lme from the lofty region!
May he encounter it!
Thou art my wall of stone against the sinner who from points intermediate fights against me.
May he encounter it!
With Brihat I invoke the mind, with Mātarisvan both the breaths,
The eye from Sūrya, and the ear from Air, the body from the Earth.
We, with Sarasvati who suits the mind, call Speech to come to us.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्म॒व॒र्म मे॑ऽसि॒ यो मा॒ दक्षि॑णाया दि॒शोऽघा॒युर॑भि॒दासा॑त् ।
ए॒तत् स ऋ॑च्छात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśmavarma me'si yo mā dakṣiṇāyā diśo'ghāyurabhidāsāt |
etat sa ṛcchāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्म॒व॒र्म मे॑ऽसि॒ यो मा॑ प्र॒तीच्या॑ दि॒शोऽघा॒युर॑भि॒दासा॑त् ।
ए॒तत् स ऋ॑च्छात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśmavarma me'si yo mā pratīcyā diśo'ghāyurabhidāsāt |
etat sa ṛcchāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्म॒व॒र्म मे॑ऽसि॒ यो मोदी॑च्या दि॒शोऽघा॒युर॑भि॒दासा॑त् ।
ए॒तत् स ऋ॑च्छात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśmavarma me'si yo modīcyā diśo'ghāyurabhidāsāt |
etat sa ṛcchāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्म॒व॒र्म मे॑ऽसि॒ यो मा॑ ध्रु॒वाया॑ दि॒शोऽघा॒युर॑भि॒दासा॑त् ।
ए॒तत् स ऋ॑च्छात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśmavarma me'si yo mā dhruvāyā diśo'ghāyurabhidāsāt |
etat sa ṛcchāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्म॒व॒र्म मे॑ऽसि॒ यो मो॒र्ध्वाया॒ दि॒शोऽघा॒युर॑भि॒दासा॑त् ।
ए॒तत् स ऋ॑च्छात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśmavarma me'si yo mordhvāyā diśo'ghāyurabhidāsāt |
etat sa ṛcchāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्म॒व॒र्म मे॑ऽसि॒ यो मा॑ दि॒शाम॑न्तर्दे॒शेभ्यो॑ऽघा॒युर॑भि॒दासा॑त् ।
ए॒तत् स ऋ॑च्छात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśmavarma me'si yo mā diśāmantardeśebhyo'ghāyurabhidāsāt |
etat sa ṛcchāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
बृ॒ह॒ता मन॒ उप॑ ह्वये मात॒रिश्व॑ना प्राणापा॒नौ ।
सूर्या॒च्चक्षु॑र॒न्तरि॑क्षा॒च्छ्रोत्रं॑ पृथि॒व्याः शरी॑रम् ।
सर॑स्वत्या॒ वाच॒मुप॑ ह्वयामहे मनो॒युजा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
bṛhatā mana upa hvaye mātariśvanā prāṇāpānau |
sūryāccakṣurantarikṣācchrotraṃ pṛthivyāḥ śarīram |
sarasvatyā vācamupa hvayāmahe manoyujā ||

verses.sanskrit:
क॒थं म॒हे असु॑रायाब्रवीरि॒ह क॒थं पि॒त्रे हर॑ये त्वे॒षनृ॑म्णः ।
पृश्निं॑ वरुण॒ दक्षि॑णां ददा॒वान् पुन॑र्मघ॒ त्वं मन॑साचिकित्सीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
kathaṃ mahe asurāyābravīriha kathaṃ pitre haraye tveṣanṛmṇaḥ |
pṛśniṃ varuṇa dakṣiṇāṃ dadāvān punarmagha tvaṃ manasācikitsīḥ ||
verses.translation:
A dialogue between Atharvan and Varuna
How, terrible in might, hast thou here spoken to the great God, how to the gold-hued Father!
Thy mind watched, greedy Varuna! to recover the brindled cow thou hadst bestowed as guerdon.
Not through desire do I revoke my present: I bring this brind-led cow to contemplate her.
Now by what lore, by what inherent nature, knowest thou all things that exist, Atharvan?
Truly I am profound in wisdom, truly I know by nature all existing creatures.
No Dāsa by his greatness, not an Arya, may violate the law that I will stablish.
None, self-dependent Varuna! existeth wiser than thou or sager by his wisdom.
Thou knowest well all these created beings: even the man of wondrous powers fears thee.
O self-dependent Varuna, wise director, thou knowest verily all generations.
What is, unerring one! beyond this region? What more remote than that which is most distant?
One thing there is beyond this air, and something beyond that one, most hard to reach, remotest.
I, Varuna, who know, to thee declare it. Let churls be mighty in the lower regions. Let Dāsas sink into the earth beneath them.
Many reproaches, Varuna, dost thou utter against the misers. who revoke their presents.
Be not thou added to that crowd of niggards: let not men call thee an illiberal giver.
Let not men call me an illiberal giver. I give thee back the brindled cow, O singer.
Attend in every place where men inhabit, with all thy powers, the hymn that tells my praises.
Let hymns of praise ascend to thee, uplifted in every place of human habitation.
But give me now the gift thou hast not given. Thou art my friend for ever firm and faithful.
One origin, Varuna! one bond unites us I know the nature of that common kinship.
I give thee now the gift that I retracted. I am thy friend for ever firm and faithful.
God, giving life unto the god who lauds me, Sage strengthener of the sage who sings my praises.
Thou, self-dependent Varuna! hast begotten the kinsman of the Gods, our sire Atharvan.
On him bestow most highly-lauded riches. Thou art our friend, high over all, our kinsman.

verses.sanskrit:
न कामे॑न॒ पुन॑र्मघो भवामि॒ सं च॑क्षे॒ कं पृश्नि॑मे॒तामुपा॑जे ।
केन॒ नु त्वम॑थर्व॑न् काव्ये॑न॒ केन॑ जा॒तेना॑सि जा॒तवे॑दाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
na kāmena punarmagho bhavāmi saṃ cakṣe kaṃ pṛśnimetāmupāje |
kena nu tvamatharvan kāvyena kena jātenāsi jātavedāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒त्यम॒हं ग॑भी॒रः काव्ये॑न स॒त्यं जा॒तेना॑स्मि जा॒तवे॑दाः ।
न मे॑ दा॒सो नार्यो॑ महि॒त्वा व्र॒तं मी॑माय॒ यद॒हं ध॑रि॒ष्ये ॥
verses.transliteration:
satyamahaṃ gabhīraḥ kāvyena satyaṃ jātenāsmi jātavedāḥ |
na me dāso nāryo mahitvā vrataṃ mīmāya yadahaṃ dhariṣye ||

verses.sanskrit:
न त्वद॒न्यः क॒वित॑रो॒ न मे॒धया॒ धीर॑तरो वरुण स्वधावन् ।
त्वं ता विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि वेत्थ॒ स चि॒न्नु त्वज्जनो॑ मा॒यी बि॑भाय ॥
verses.transliteration:
na tvadanyaḥ kavitaro na medhayā dhīrataro varuṇa svadhāvan |
tvaṃ tā viśvā bhuvanāni vettha sa cinnu tvajjano māyī bibhāya ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं ह्य॑१ङ्ग व॑रुण स्वधाव॒न् विश्वा॒ वेत्थ॒ जनि॑म सुप्रणीते ।
किं रज॑स ए॒ना प॒रो अ॒न्यद॑स्त्ये॒ना किं परे॒णाव॑रममुर ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvaṃ hyaṅga varuṇa svadhāvan viśvā vettha janima supraṇīte |
kiṃ rajasa enā paro anyadastyenā kiṃ pareṇāvaramamura ||

verses.sanskrit:
एकं॒ रज॑स ए॒ना प॒रो अ॒न्यद॑स्त्ये॒ना प॒र एके॑न दु॒र्णशं॑ चिद॒र्वाक् ।
तत् ते॑ वि॒द्वान् वरु॑ण॒ प्र ब्र॑वीम्य॒धोव॑चसः प॒णयो॑ भवन्तु नी॒चैर्दा॒सा उप॑ सर्पन्तु॒ भूमि॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ekaṃ rajasa enā paro anyadastyenā para ekena durṇaśaṃ cidarvāk |
tat te vidvān varuṇa pra bravīmyadhovacasaḥ paṇayo bhavantu nīcairdāsā upa sarpantu bhūmim ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं ह्य१ङ्ग व॑रुण॒ ब्रवी॑षि॒ पुन॑र्मघेष्वव॒द्यानि॒ भूरि॑ ।
मो षु प॒णींर॒भ्ये॒३ताव॑तो भू॒न्मा त्वा॑ वोचन्नरा॒धसं॒ जना॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvaṃ hyaṅga varuṇa bravīṣi punarmagheṣvavadyāni bhūri |
mo ṣu paṇīṃrabhyetāvato bhūnmā tvā vocannarādhasaṃ janāsaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
मा मा॑ वोचन्नरा॒धसं॒ जना॑सः॒ पुन॑स्ते॒ पृश्निं॑ जरितर्ददामि ।
स्तो॒त्रं मे॒ विश्व॒मा या॑हि॒ शची॑भिर॒न्तर्विश्वा॑सु॒ मानु॑षीषु दि॒क्षु ॥
verses.transliteration:
mā mā vocannarādhasaṃ janāsaḥ punaste pṛśniṃ jaritardadāmi |
stotraṃ me viśvamā yāhi śacībhirantarviśvāsu mānuṣīṣu dikṣu ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ ते॑ स्तोत्राण्युद्य॑तानि यन्त्व॒न्तर्विश्वा॑सु॒ मानु॑षीषु दि॒क्षु ।
दे॒हि नु मे॒ यन्मे॒ अद॑त्तो॒ असि॒ युज्यो॑ मे स॒प्तप॑दः॒ सखा॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā te stotrāṇyudyatāni yantvantarviśvāsu mānuṣīṣu dikṣu |
dehi nu me yanme adatto asi yujyo me saptapadaḥ sakhāsi ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒मा नौ॒ बन्धु॑र्वरुण स॒मा जा वेदा॒हं तद् यन्ना॑वे॒षा स॒मा जा ।
ददा॑मि॒ तद् यत् ते अद॑त्तो॒ अस्मि॒ युज्य॑स्ते स॒प्तप॑दः॒ सखा॑स्मि ॥
verses.transliteration:
samā nau bandhurvaruṇa samā jā vedāhaṃ tad yannāveṣā samā jā |
dadāmi tad yat te adatto asmi yujyaste saptapadaḥ sakhāsmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वो दे॒वाय॑ गृण॒ते व॑यो॒धा विप्रो॒ विप्रा॑य स्तुव॒ते सु॑मे॒धाः ।
अजी॑जनो॒ हि व॑रुण स्वधाव॒न्नथ॑र्वाणं पि॒तरं॑ दे॒वब॑न्धुम् ।
तस्मा॑ उ॒ राधः॑ कृणुहि सुप्रश॒स्तं सखा॑ नो असि पर॒मं च॒ बन्धुः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devo devāya gṛṇate vayodhā vipro viprāya stuvate sumedhāḥ |
ajījano hi varuṇa svadhāvannatharvāṇaṃ pitaraṃ devabandhum |
tasmā u rādhaḥ kṛṇuhi supraśastaṃ sakhā no asi paramaṃ ca bandhuḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
समि॑द्धो अ॒द्य मनु॑षो दुरो॒णे दे॒वो दे॒वान् य॑जसि जातवेदः ।
आ च॒ वह॑ मित्रमहश्चिकि॒त्वान्त्वं दू॒तः क॒विर॑सि॒ प्रचे॑ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
samiddho adya manuṣo duroṇe devo devān yajasi jātavedaḥ |
ā ca vaha mitramahaścikitvāntvaṃ dūtaḥ kavirasi pracetāḥ ||
verses.translation:
An Apri or propitiatory hymn
Thou in the house of man this day enkindled worshippest Gods as God, O Jātavedas.
Observant, bright as Mitra, bring them hither. Thou art a sapient and foreknowing envoy.
Tanùnapāt, fair-tongued! with sweet meath balming the baths and ways of Order, make them pleasant.
Bear to the Gods our sacrifice, exalting with holy thoughts our hymns of praise and worship.
Invoked, deserving prayer and adoration, O Agni, come accor dant with the Vasus.
Thou art, O youthful Lord, the Gods’ Invoker, so, best of sacri-ficers, bring them quickly.
By rule the Sacred Grass is scattered eastward, a robe to clothe this earth when dawns are breaking.
Widely it spreads around and far extended, fair for the Gods and bringing peace and freedom,
Let the expansive Doors be widely opened, like wives who deck their beauty for their husbands.
Lofty, celestial, all-impelling Portals, admit the Gods and give them easy entrance!
Pouring sweet dews let holy Night and Morning, each close to each, be seated at their station,—
Lofty, celestial Dames with gold to deck them, assuming all their fair and radiant beauty.
Come the first two celestial sweet-voiced Hotars, arranging sacrifice for man to worship,
As singers who inspire us in assemblies, showing the eastern light with their direction!
Let Bhārati come quickly to our worship and Ilā showing like a human being.
So let Sarasvati and both her fellows, deft Goddesses, on this fair grass be seated.
Hotar more skilled in sacrifice, bring hither with speed to-day God Tvashar, thou who knowest,
Even him who formed these two, the Earth and Heaven, the Parents, with their forms, and every creature.
Bring thou to our oblations which thou balmest the companies of Gods in ordered season.
Agni, Vanaspati, the Immolator sweeten our offered gifts with meath and butter!
Agni as soon as he was born made ready the sacrifice and was the Gods’ preceder.
May the Gods eat our offering consecrated according to this true Priest’s voice and guidance.

verses.sanskrit:
तनू॑नपात् प॒थ ऋ॒तस्य॒ याना॒न् मध्वा॑ सम॒ञ्जन्त्स्व॑दया सुजिह्व ।
मन्मा॑नि धी॒भिरु॒त य॒ज्ञमृ॒न्धन् दे॑व॒त्रा च॑ कृणुह्यध्व॒रं नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tanūnapāt patha ṛtasya yānān madhvā samañjantsvadayā sujihva |
manmāni dhībhiruta yajñamṛndhan devatrā ca kṛṇuhyadhvaraṃ naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒जुह्वा॑न॒ ईड्यो॒ बन्द्य॒श्चा या॑ह्यग्ने॒ वसु॑भिः स॒जोषाः॑ ।
त्वं दे॒वाना॑मसि यह्व॒ होता॒ स ए॑नान् यक्षीषि॒तो यजी॑यान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ājuhvāna īḍyo bandyaścā yāhyagne vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ |
tvaṃ devānāmasi yahva hotā sa enān yakṣīṣito yajīyān ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒चीनं॑ ब॒र्हिः प्र॒दिशा॑ पृथि॒व्या वस्तो॑र॒स्या वृ॑ज्यते॒ अग्रे॒ अह्ना॑म् ।
व्युऽप्रथते वित॒रं वरी॑यो दे॒वेभ्यो॒ अदि॑तये स्यो॒नम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prācīnaṃ barhiḥ pradiśā pṛthivyā vastorasyā vṛjyate agre ahnām |
vyu'prathate vitaraṃ varīyo devebhyo aditaye syonam ||

verses.sanskrit:
व्यच॑स्वतीरुर्वि॒या वि श्र॑यन्तां॒ पति॑भ्यो॒ न जन॑यः॒ शुम्भ॑मानाः ।
देवी॑र्द्वारो बृहतीर्विश्वमिन्वा दे॒वेभ्यो॑ भवत सुप्राय॒णाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
vyacasvatīrurviyā vi śrayantāṃ patibhyo na janayaḥ śumbhamānāḥ |
devīrdvāro bṛhatīrviśvaminvā devebhyo bhavata suprāyaṇāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ सुष्वय॑न्ती यज॒ते उ॒पाके॑ उ॒षासा॒नक्ता॑ सदतां॒ नि योनौ॑ ।
दि॒व्ये योष॑णे बृह॒ती सु॑रु॒क्मे अधि॒ श्रियं॑ शुक्र॒पिशं॒ दधा॑ने ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā suṣvayantī yajate upāke uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau |
divye yoṣaṇe bṛhatī surukme adhi śriyaṃ śukrapiśaṃ dadhāne ||

verses.sanskrit:
दैव्या॒ होता॑रा प्रथ॒मा सुवाचा॒ मिमा॑ना य॒ज्ञं मनु॑षो॒ यज॑ध्यै ।
प्र॒चो॒दय॑न्ता वि॒दथे॑षु का॒रू प्रा॒चीनं॒ ज्योतिः॑ प्र॒दिशा॑ दि॒शन्ता॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
daivyā hotārā prathamā suvācā mimānā yajñaṃ manuṣo yajadhyai |
pracodayantā vidatheṣu kārū prācīnaṃ jyotiḥ pradiśā diśantā ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ नो॑ यज्ञं भार॑ती॒ तूय॑मे॒त्विडा॑ मनु॒ष्वदि॒ह चे॒तय॑न्ती ।
ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्ब॒र्हिरेदं स्यो॒नं सर॑स्वतीः॒ स्वप॑सः सदन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā no yajñaṃ bhāratī tūyametviḍā manuṣvadiha cetayantī |
tisro devīrbarhiredaṃ syonaṃ sarasvatīḥ svapasaḥ sadantām ||

verses.sanskrit:
य इ॒मे द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी जनि॑त्री रू॒पैरपिं॑श॒द् भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
तम॒द्य हो॑तरिषि॒तो यजी॑यान् दे॒वं त्वष्टा॑रमि॒हय॑क्षि वि॒द्वान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī janitrī rūpairapiṃśad bhuvanāni viśvā |
tamadya hotariṣito yajīyān devaṃ tvaṣṭāramihayakṣi vidvān ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒पाव॑सृज॒ त्मन्या॑ सम॒ञ्जन् दे॒वानां॒ पाथ॑ ऋतु॒था ह॒वींषि॑ ।
वन॒स्पतिः॑ शमि॒ता दे॒वो अ॒ग्निः स्वद॑न्तु ह॒व्यं मधु॑ना घृ॒तेन॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
upāvasṛja tmanyā samañjan devānāṃ pātha ṛtuthā havīṃṣi |
vanaspatiḥ śamitā devo agniḥ svadantu havyaṃ madhunā ghṛtena ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒द्यो जा॒तो व्यऽमिमीत य॒ज्ञम॒ग्निर्दे॒वाना॑मभवत् पुरो॒गाः ।
अ॒स्य होतुः॑ प्र॒शिष्यृ॒तस्य॑ वा॒चि स्वाहा॑कृतं ह॒विर॑दन्तु दे॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sadyo jāto vya'mimīta yajñamagnirdevānāmabhavat purogāḥ |
asya hotuḥ praśiṣyṛtasya vāci svāhākṛtaṃ haviradantu devāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
द॒दिर्हि मह्यं॒ वरु॑णो दि॒वः क॒विर्वचो॑भिरु॒ग्रैर्नि रि॑णामि ते वि॒षम् ।
खा॒तमखा॑तमु॒त स॒क्तम॑ग्रभ॒मिरे॑व॒ धन्व॒न् नि ज॑जास ते वि॒षम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
dadirhi mahyaṃ varuṇo divaḥ kavirvacobhirugrairni riṇāmi te viṣam |
khātamakhātamuta saktamagrabhamireva dhanvan ni jajāsa te viṣam ||
verses.translation:
A charm against snakes
Varuna, Sage of heaven, hath given me the gift: with spells of mighty power I draw thy poison out.
Dug up, not dug, adherent, I have seized it fast: low hath thy venom sunk like water in the sands.
All the non-fluid portion of thy venom, I receive in these.
I take thy middlemost, thy highest, lowest juice: may it be spent and lest by reason of thy fear.
Strong is my cry like thunder with the rainy cloud: with power-ful incantation let thy strength be stayed.
I, with the men to aid, have seized that juice of his; as light from out the gloom, let Sūrya rise on high I with this eye destroy thine eye, and with this poison conquer thine.
Live not, O Snake, but die the death: back go thy venom on thyself.
Listen to me, Black Snakes and hateful creatures, Lurker-inGrass, Karait, and Brown, and Spotty,
Approach not near the house my friend inhabits: give warning, and rest quiet with your poison.
Even as the cord that strings the bow, I slacken, as it were, the cars.
Of the All-conquering serpent’s wrath, of the fierce rage of Black, and Brown, Taimāta, and Apodaka.
And Āligi and Viligi, their father and the mother too,—
What will ye do? Your venomed sap, we know, is utterly powerless.
Daughter of Urugūlā, she-fiend whom the black, skinned mother bare—
All female serpents poison who crept swiftly near is impotent.
Dwelling beside the mountain’s slope, the quick-eared porcupine exclaimed:
Of all these she-snakes homed in earth the poison is most powerless.
Tābuva or not Tābuva, thou verily art not Tābuva: poison is killed by Tābuva.
Tastuva or not Tastuva, thou verily art not Tastuva: poison is killed by Tastuva.

verses.sanskrit:
यत् ते॒ अपो॑दकं वि॒षं तत् त॑ ए॒तास्व॑ग्रभम् ।
गृ॒ह्णामि॑ ते मध्य॒ममु॑त्त॒मं रस॑मु॒ताव॒मं भि॒यसा॑ नेश॒दादु॑ ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
yat te apodakaṃ viṣaṃ tat ta etāsvagrabham |
gṛhṇāmi te madhyamamuttamaṃ rasamutāvamaṃ bhiyasā neśadādu te ||

verses.sanskrit:
वृषा॑ मे॒ रवो॒ नभ॑सा॒ न त॑न्य॒तुरु॒ग्रेण॑ ते॒ वच॑सा बाध॒ आदु॑ ते ।
अ॒हं तम॑स्य॒ नृभि॑रग्रभं॒ रसं॒ तम॑स इव॒ ज्योति॒रुदे॑तु॒ सूर्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vṛṣā me ravo nabhasā na tanyaturugreṇa te vacasā bādha ādu te |
ahaṃ tamasya nṛbhiragrabhaṃ rasaṃ tamasa iva jyotirudetu sūryaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
चक्षु॑षा ते॒ चक्षु॑र्हन्मि वि॒षेण॑ हन्मि ते वि॒षम् ।
अहे॑ म्रि॒यस्व॒ मा जी॑वीः प्र॒त्यग॒भ्येऽतु त्वा वि॒षम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
cakṣuṣā te cakṣurhanmi viṣeṇa hanmi te viṣam |
ahe mriyasva mā jīvīḥ pratyagabhye'tu tvā viṣam ||

verses.sanskrit:
कैरा॑त पृश्न॒ उप॑तृण्य॒ बभ्र॒ आ मे॑ शृणु॒तासि॑ता॒ अली॑काः ।
मा मे॒ सख्युः॑ स्ता॒मान॒मपि॑ ष्ठाताश्रा॒वय॑न्तो॒ नि वि॒षे र॑मध्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
kairāta pṛśna upatṛṇya babhra ā me śṛṇutāsitā alīkāḥ |
mā me sakhyuḥ stāmānamapi ṣṭhātāśrāvayanto ni viṣe ramadhvam ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒सि॒तस्य॑ तैमा॒तस्य॑ ब॒भ्रोरपो॑दकस्य च ।
सा॒त्रा॒सा॒हस्या॒हं म॒न्योरव॒ ज्यामि॑व॒ धन्व॑नो॒ वि मु॑ञ्चामि॒ रथाँ॑ इव ॥
verses.transliteration:
asitasya taimātasya babhrorapodakasya ca |
sātrāsāhasyāhaṃ manyorava jyāmiva dhanvano vi muñcāmi rathām̐ iva ||

verses.sanskrit:
आलि॑गी च॒ विलि॑गी च पि॒ता च॑ माता॒ च॑ ।
वि॒द्म वः॑ स॒र्वतो॒ ब॑न्ध्वर॑साः॒ किं क॑रिष्यथ ॥
verses.transliteration:
āligī ca viligī ca pitā ca mātā ca |
vidma vaḥ sarvato bandhvarasāḥ kiṃ kariṣyatha ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒रु॒गूला॑या दुहि॒ता जा॒ता दा॒स्यसि॑क्न्या ।
प्र॒तङ्कं॑ द॒द्रुषी॑णां॒ सर्वा॑सामर॒सं वि॒षम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
urugūlāyā duhitā jātā dāsyasiknyā |
prataṅkaṃ dadruṣīṇāṃ sarvāsāmarasaṃ viṣam ||

verses.sanskrit:
क॒र्णा श्वा॒वित् तद॑ब्रवीद् गि॒रेर॑वचरन्ति॒का ।
याः काश्चे॒माः ख॑नि॒त्रिमा॒स्तासा॑मर॒सत॑मं वि॒ष॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
karṇā śvāvit tadabravīd gireravacarantikā |
yāḥ kāścemāḥ khanitrimāstāsāmarasatamaṃ viṣam ||

verses.sanskrit:
ता॒बुवं॒ न ता॒बुवं॒ न घेत् त्वम॑सि ता॒बुव॑म् ।
ता॒बुवे॑नार॒सं वि॒षम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tābuvaṃ na tābuvaṃ na ghet tvamasi tābuvam |
tābuvenārasaṃ viṣam ||

verses.sanskrit:
त॒स्तुवं॒ न त॒स्तुवं॒ न घेत् त्वम॑सि त॒स्तुव॑म् ।
त॒स्तुवे॑नार॒सं वि॒षम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tastuvaṃ na tastuvaṃ na ghet tvamasi tastuvam |
tastuvenārasaṃ viṣam ||

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒प॒र्णस्त्वान्व॑विन्दत् सूक॒रस्त्वा॑खन्न॒सा ।
दिप्सौ॑षधे॒ त्वं दिप्स॑न्त॒मव॑ कृत्या॒कृतं॑ जहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
suparṇastvānvavindat sūkarastvākhannasā |
dipsauṣadhe tvaṃ dipsantamava kṛtyākṛtaṃ jahi ||
verses.translation:
A charm against witchcraft
An eagle found thee: with his snout a wild boar dug thee from the earth.
Harm thou, O Plant, the mischievous, and drive the sorcerer away.
Beat thou the Yātudhānas back, drive thou away the sorcerer;
And chase afar, O Plant, the man who fain would do us injury.
As ‘twere a strip cut round from skin of a white-footed an-telope,
Bind, like a golden chain, O God, his witchcraft on the sorcerer.
Take thou his sorcery by the hand, and to the sorcerer lead it back.
Lay it before him, face to face, that it may kill the sorcerer.
Back on the wizard fall his craft, upon the curser light his curse!
Let witchcraft, like a well-naved car, roll back upon the sorcerer.
Whoso, for other’s harm hath dealt-woman or man-in magic arts,
To him we lead the sorcery back, even as a courser with a rope.
Now whether thou hast been prepared by Gods or been pre-pared by men,
We, with our Indra at our side to aid us, lead thee back again.
Agni, victorious in fight, subdue the armies of our foes!
Back on the sorcerer we cast his sorcery, and beat it home.
Thou who hast piercing weapons, pierce him who hath wrought it; conquer him.
We do not sharpen thee to slay the man who hath not practised it.
Go as a son goes to his sire: bite as a trampled viper bites.
As one who flies from bonds, go back, O Witchcraft, to the sorcerer.
Even as the timid antelope or hind from her assailant flees,
So swiftly let the sorcery o’ertake and reach the sorcerer.
Straighter than any arrow let it fly against him, Heaven and Earth.
So let that witchcraft seize again the wizard like a beast of chase.
Let it go contrary like flame, like water following its course.
Let witchcraft, like a well-naved car, roll back upon the sorcerer.

verses.sanskrit:
अव॑ जहि यातु॒धाना॒नव॑ कृत्या॒कृतं॑ जहि ।
अथो॒ योअ॒स्मान् दिप्स॑ति॒ तमु॒ त्वं ज॑ह्योषधे ॥
verses.transliteration:
ava jahi yātudhānānava kṛtyākṛtaṃ jahi |
atho yoasmān dipsati tamu tvaṃ jahyoṣadhe ||

verses.sanskrit:
रिश्य॑स्येव परीशा॒सं प॑रि॒कृत्य॒ परि॑ त्व॒चः ।
कृ॒त्यां कृ॑त्या॒कृते॑ देवा नि॒ष्कमि॑व॒ प्रति॑ मुञ्चत ॥
verses.transliteration:
riśyasyeva parīśāsaṃ parikṛtya pari tvacaḥ |
kṛtyāṃ kṛtyākṛte devā niṣkamiva prati muñcata ||

verses.sanskrit:
पुनः॑ कृ॒त्यां कृ॑त्या॒कृते॑ हस्त॒गृह्य॒ परा॑ णय ।
स॒म॒क्षम॑स्मा॒ आ धे॑हि॒ यथा॑ कृत्या॒कृतं॒ हन॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
punaḥ kṛtyāṃ kṛtyākṛte hastagṛhya parā ṇaya |
samakṣamasmā ā dhehi yathā kṛtyākṛtaṃ hanat ||

verses.sanskrit:
कृ॒त्याः स॑न्तु कृत्या॒कृते॑ श॒पथः॑ शपथीय॒ते ।
सु॒खो रथ॑ इव वर्ततां कृ॒त्या कृ॑त्या॒कृतं॒ पुनः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
kṛtyāḥ santu kṛtyākṛte śapathaḥ śapathīyate |
sukho ratha iva vartatāṃ kṛtyā kṛtyākṛtaṃ punaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यदि॒ स्त्री यदि॑ वा॒ पुमा॑न् कृ॒त्यां च॒कार॑ पा॒प्मने॑ ।
तामु॒ तस्मै॑ नयाम॒स्यश्व॑मिवाश्वाभि॒धान्या॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadi strī yadi vā pumān kṛtyāṃ cakāra pāpmane |
tāmu tasmai nayāmasyaśvamivāśvābhidhānyā ||

verses.sanskrit:
यदि॒ वासि॑ दे॒वकृ॑ता॒ यदि॑ वा॒ पुरु॑षैः कृ॒ता ।
तां त्वा॒ पुन॑र्णयाम॒सीन्द्रे॑ण स॒युजा॑ व॒यम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadi vāsi devakṛtā yadi vā puruṣaiḥ kṛtā |
tāṃ tvā punarṇayāmasīndreṇa sayujā vayam ||

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॑ पृतनाषा॒ट् पृत॑नाः सहस्व ।
पुनः॑ कृ॒त्यां कृ॑त्या॒कृते॑ प्रति॒हर॑णेन हरामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne pṛtanāṣāṭ pṛtanāḥ sahasva |
punaḥ kṛtyāṃ kṛtyākṛte pratiharaṇena harāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
कृत॑व्यधनि॒ विध्य॒ तं यश्च॒कार॒ तमिज्ज॑हि ।
न त्वामच॑क्रुषे व॒यं व॒धाय॒ सं शि॑शीमहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
kṛtavyadhani vidhya taṃ yaścakāra tamijjahi |
na tvāmacakruṣe vayaṃ vadhāya saṃ śiśīmahi ||

verses.sanskrit:
पु॒त्र इ॑व पि॒तरं॑ गच्छ स्व॒ज इ॑वा॒भिष्ठि॑तो दश ।
ब॒न्धमि॑वावक्रा॒मी ग॑च्छ॒ कृत्ये॑ कृत्या॒कृतं॒ पुनः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
putra iva pitaraṃ gaccha svaja ivābhiṣṭhito daśa |
bandhamivāvakrāmī gaccha kṛtye kṛtyākṛtaṃ punaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
उदे॒णीव॑ वार॒ण्यऽभि॒स्कन्दं॑ मृ॒गीव॑ ।
कृ॒त्या क॒र्तार॑मृच्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
udeṇīva vāraṇya'bhiskandaṃ mṛgīva |
kṛtyā kartāramṛcchatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
इष्वा॒ ऋजी॑यः पततु॒ द्यावा॑पृथिवी॒ तं प्रति॑ ।
सा तं मृ॒गमि॑व गृह्णतु कृ॒त्या कृ॑त्या॒कृतं॒ पुनः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
iṣvā ṛjīyaḥ patatu dyāvāpṛthivī taṃ prati |
sā taṃ mṛgamiva gṛhṇatu kṛtyā kṛtyākṛtaṃ punaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निरि॑वैतु प्रति॒कूल॑मनु॒कूल॑मिवोद॒कम् ।
सु॒खो रथ॑ इव वर्ततां कृ॒त्या कृ॑त्या॒कृतं॒ पुनः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnirivaitu pratikūlamanukūlamivodakam |
sukho ratha iva vartatāṃ kṛtyā kṛtyākṛtaṃ punaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
एका॑ च मे॒ दश॑ च मे ऽपव॒क्तार॑ ओषधे ।
ऋत॑जात॒ ऋता॑वरि॒ मधु॑ मे मधु॒ला क॑रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ekā ca me daśa ca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe |
ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A charm for general prosperity
Plant! I have those who shall avert the threatened danger, ten and one.
O sacred Plant, produced aright! make sweetness, sweet thy self, for me.
Twenty and two, O Plant, have I who shall avert the threatened ill.
O sacred Plant, produced aright! make sweetness, sweet thyself, for me.

verses.sanskrit:
द्वे च॑ मे विंश॒तिश्च॑ मे ऽपव॒क्तार॑ ओषधे ।
ऋत॑जात॒ ऋता॑वरि॒ मधु॑ मे मधु॒ला क॑रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
dve ca me viṃśatiśca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe |
ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ति॒स्रश्च॑ मे त्रिं॒शच्च॑ मे ऽपव॒क्तार॑ ओषधे ।
ऋत॑जात॒ ऋता॑वरि॒ मधु॑ मे मधु॒ला क॑रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tisraśca me triṃśacca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe |
ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
चत॑स्रश्च मे चत्वारिं॒शच्च॑ मे ऽपव॒क्तार॑ ओषधे ।
ऋत॑जात॒ ऋता॑वरि॒ मधु॑ मे मधु॒ला क॑रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
catasraśca me catvāriṃśacca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe |
ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
प॒ञ्च च॑ मे पञ्चा॒शच्च॑ मे ऽपव॒क्तार॑ ओषधे ।
ऋत॑जात॒ ऋता॑वरि॒ मधु॑ मे मधु॒ला क॑रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
pañca ca me pañcāśacca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe |
ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
षट् च॑ मे ष॒ष्टिश्च॑ मे ऽपव॒क्तार॑ ओषधे ।
ऋत॑जात॒ ऋता॑वरि॒ मधु॑ मे मधु॒ला क॑रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṣaṭ ca me ṣaṣṭiśca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe |
ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒प्त च॑ मे सप्त॒तिश्च॑ मे ऽपव॒क्तार॑ ओषधे ।
ऋत॑जात॒ ऋता॑वरि॒ मधु॑ मे मधु॒ला क॑रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sapta ca me saptatiśca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe |
ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ष्ट च॑ मेऽशी॒तिश्च॑ मे ऽपव॒क्तार॑ ओषधे ।
ऋत॑जात॒ ऋता॑वरि॒ मधु॑ मे मधु॒ला क॑रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
aṣṭa ca me'śītiśca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe |
ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
नव॑ च मे नव॒तिश्च॑ मे ऽपव॒क्तार॑ ओषधे ।
ऋत॑जात॒ ऋता॑वरि॒ मधु॑ मे मधु॒ला क॑रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
nava ca me navatiśca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe |
ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
दश॑ च मे श॒तं च मे॑ ऽपव॒क्तार॑ ओषधे ।
ऋत॑जात॒ ऋता॑वरि॒ मधु॑ मे मधु॒ला क॑रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
daśa ca me śataṃ ca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe |
ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
श॒तं च॑ मे स॒हस्रं॑ चापव॒क्तार॑ ओषधे ।
ऋत॑जात॒ ऋता॑वरि॒ मधु॑ मे मधु॒ला क॑रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śataṃ ca me sahasraṃ cāpavaktāra oṣadhe |
ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: यद्ये॑कवृ॒षोऽसि॑ सृ॒जार॒सोऽसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yadyekavṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si ||
verses.translation:
A charm for the increase of cattle
Bull! if thou art the single bull, beget. Thou hast no vital sap.

verses.sanskrit: यदि॑ द्विवृ॒षोऽसि॑ सृ॒जार॒सोऽसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi dvivṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si ||

verses.sanskrit: यदि॑ त्रिवृ॒षोऽसि॑ सृ॒जार॒सोऽसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi trivṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si ||

verses.sanskrit: यदि॑ चतुर्वृ॒षोऽसि॑ सृ॒जार॒सोऽसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi caturvṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si ||

verses.sanskrit: यदि॑ पञ्चवृ॒षोऽसि॑ सृ॒जार॒सोऽसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi pañcavṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si ||

verses.sanskrit: यदि॑ षड्-वृ॒षोऽसि॑ सृ॒जार॒सोऽसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi ṣaḍ-vṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si ||

verses.sanskrit: यदि॑ सप्तवृ॒षोऽसि॑ सृ॒जार॒सोऽसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi saptavṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si ||

verses.sanskrit: यद्य॑ष्टवृ॒षोऽसि॑ सृ॒जार॒सोऽसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yadyaṣṭavṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si ||

verses.sanskrit: यदि॑ नववृ॒षोऽसि॑ सृ॒जार॒सोऽसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi navavṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si ||

verses.sanskrit: यदि॑ दशवृ॒षोऽसि॑ सृ॒जार॒सोऽसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi daśavṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si ||

verses.sanskrit: यद्ये॑काद॒शोऽसि॒ सोऽपो॑दको ऽसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yadyekādaśo'si so'podako 'si ||

verses.sanskrit:
तेऽवदन् प्रथ॒मा ब्र॑ह्मकिल्बि॒षेऽकू॑पारः सलि॒लो मा॑त॒रिश्वा॑ ।
वी॒डुह॑रा॒स्तप॑ उ॒ग्रं म॑यो॒भूरापो॑ दे॒वीः प्र॑थम॒जा ऋ॒तस्य॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
te'vadan prathamā brahmakilbiṣe'kūpāraḥ salilo mātariśvā |
vīḍuharāstapa ugraṃ mayobhūrāpo devīḥ prathamajā ṛtasya ||
verses.translation:
The abduction and restoration of a Brāhman’s wife
These first, the boundless Sea, and Mātarisvan, fierce glowing Fire, the Strong, the Bliss-bestower,
And heavenly Floods, first-born by holy Order, exclaimed against the outrage on a Brāhman.
King Soma first of all, without reluctance, made restitution of the Brāhman’s consort.
Mitra and Varuna were the inviters: Agni as Hotar took her hand and led her.
The man, her pledge, must by the hand be taken when he hath cried, She is a Brāhman’s consort.
She stayed not for a herald to conduct her: thus is the kingdom of a ruler guarded.
She whom they call the star with loosened tresses, descending as. misfortune on the village,
The Brāhman’s consort, she disturbs the kingdom where hath appeared the hare with fiery flashing.
Active in duty serves the Brahmachāri: he is a member of the Gods’ own body.
Through him Brihaspati obtained his consort, as the Gods gained the ladle brought by Soma.
Thus spake of her those Gods of old, Seven Rishis, who sate them down to their austere devotion:
Dire is a Brāhman’s wife led home by others: in the supremest heaven she plants confusion.
When infants die, untimely born, when herds of cattle waste away,
When heroes strike each other dead, the Brāhman’s wife destroyeth them.
Even if ten former husbands—none a Brāhman—had espoused a dame,
And then a Brāhman took her hand, he is her husband, only he,
Not Vaisya, not Rājanya, no, the Brāhman is indeed her lord:
This Sūrya in his course proclaims to the Five Races of man-kind.
So then the Gods restored her, so men gave the woman back again.
Princes who kept their promises restored the Brāhman’s wedded wife.
Having restored the Brāhman’s wife, and freed them, with Gods’ aid, from sin,
They shared the fulness of the earth and worn themselves ex-tended sway.
No lovely wife who brings her dower in hundreds rests upon his bed,
Within whose kingdom is detained, through want of sense, a Brāhman’s dame.
No broad-browed calf with wide-set ears is ever in his homestead born.
Within whose kingdom is detained, through want of sense, a Brāhman’s dame.
No steward, golden-necklaced, goes before the meat-trays of the man.
Within whose kingdom is detained, through want of sense, a Brāhman’s dame.
No black-eared courser, white of hue, moves proudly, harnessed to his car,
In whose dominion is detained, through want of sense, a Brāhman’s dame.
No lily grows with oval bulbs, no lotus-pool is in his field,
In whose dominion is detained, through senseless love, a Brāhman’s dame.
The men whose task it is to milk drain not the brindled cow for him,
In whose dominion is detained, through senseless love, a Brāhman’s dame.
His milch-cow doth not profit one, his draught-ox masters not the yoke,
Wherever, severed from his wife, a Brāhman spends the mourn-ful night.

verses.sanskrit:
सोमो॒ राजा॑ प्रथ॒मो ब्र॑ह्मजा॒यां पुनः॒ प्राय॑च्छ॒दहृ॑णीयमानः ।
अ॒न्व॒र्ति॒ता वरु॑णो मि॒त्र आ॑सीद॒ग्निर्होता॑ हस्त॒गृह्या नि॑नाय ॥
verses.transliteration:
somo rājā prathamo brahmajāyāṃ punaḥ prāyacchadahṛṇīyamānaḥ |
anvartitā varuṇo mitra āsīdagnirhotā hastagṛhyā nināya ||

verses.sanskrit:
हस्ते॑नै॒व ग्रा॒ह्यऽआ॒धिर॑स्या ब्रह्मजा॒येति॒ चेदवो॑चत् ।
न दू॒ताय॑ प्र॒हेया॑ तस्थ ए॒षा तथा॑ रा॒ष्ट्रं गु॑पि॒तं क्ष॒त्रिय॑स्य ॥
verses.transliteration:
hastenaiva grāhya'ādhirasyā brahmajāyeti cedavocat |
na dūtāya praheyā tastha eṣā tathā rāṣṭraṃ gupitaṃ kṣatriyasya ||

verses.sanskrit:
यामा॒हुस्तार॑कै॒षा वि॑के॒शीति॑ दु॒च्छुनां॒ ग्राम॑मव॒पद्य॑मानाम् ।
सा ब्र॑ह्मजा॒या वि दु॑नोति रा॒ष्ट्रं यत्र॒ प्रापा॑दि श॒श उ॑ल्कु॒षीमा॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāmāhustārakaiṣā vikeśīti ducchunāṃ grāmamavapadyamānām |
sā brahmajāyā vi dunoti rāṣṭraṃ yatra prāpādi śaśa ulkuṣīmān ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्र॒ह्म॒चा॒री च॑रति॒ वेवि॑ष॒द् विषः॒ स दे॒वानां॑ भव॒त्येक॒मङ्ग॑म् ।
तेन॑ जा॒या मन्व॑विन्द॒द् बृह॒स्पतिः॒ सोमे॑न नी॒तां जु॒ह्वं१ न दे॑वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmacārī carati veviṣad viṣaḥ sa devānāṃ bhavatyekamaṅgam |
tena jāyā manvavindad bṛhaspatiḥ somena nītāṃ juhvaṃ na devāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वा वा ए॒तस्या॑मवदन्त॒ पूर्वे॑ सप्तऋ॒षय॒स्तप॑सा॒ ये नि॑षे॒दुः ।
भी॒मा जा॒या ब्रा॑ह्म॒णस्याप॑नीता दु॒र्धां द॑धाति पर॒मेव्योऽमन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
devā vā etasyāmavadanta pūrve saptaṛṣayastapasā ye niṣeduḥ |
bhīmā jāyā brāhmaṇasyāpanītā durdhāṃ dadhāti paramevyo'man ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये गर्भा॑ अव॒पद्य॑न्ते॒ जग॒द् यच्चा॑पलु॒प्यते॑ ।
वी॒रा ये तृ॒ह्यन्ते॑ मि॒थो ब्र॑ह्मजा॒या हि॑नस्ति॒ तान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye garbhā avapadyante jagad yaccāpalupyate |
vīrā ye tṛhyante mitho brahmajāyā hinasti tān ||

verses.sanskrit:
उत यत् पत॑यो॒ दश॑ स्त्रि॒याः पूर्वे॒ अब्रा॑ह्मणाः ।
ब्र॒ह्माचेद्धस्त॒मग्र॑ही॒त् स ए॒व पति॑रेक॒धा ॥
verses.transliteration:
uta yat patayo daśa striyāḥ pūrve abrāhmaṇāḥ |
brahmāceddhastamagrahīt sa eva patirekadhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रा॒ह्म॒ण ए॒व पति॒र्न रा॑ज॒न्यो॒३ न वैश्यः॑ ।
तत् सूर्यः॑ प्रब्रु॒वन्ने॑ति प॒ञ्चभ्यो॑ मान॒वेभ्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
brāhmaṇa eva patirna rājanyo na vaiśyaḥ |
tat sūryaḥ prabruvanneti pañcabhyo mānavebhyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
पुन॒र्वै दे॒वा अ॑ददुः॒ पुन॑र्मनु॒ष्या अददुः ।
राजा॑नः स॒त्यं गृ॑ह्णा॒ना ब्र॑ह्मजा॒यां पुन॑र्ददुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
punarvai devā adaduḥ punarmanuṣyā adaduḥ |
rājānaḥ satyaṃ gṛhṇānā brahmajāyāṃ punardaduḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
पु॒न॒र्दाय॑ ब्रह्मजा॒यां कृ॒त्वा दे॒वैर्नि॑किल्बि॒षम् ।
ऊर्जं॑ पृथि॒व्या भ॒क्त्वोरु॑गा॒यमुपा॑सते ॥
verses.transliteration:
punardāya brahmajāyāṃ kṛtvā devairnikilbiṣam |
ūrjaṃ pṛthivyā bhaktvorugāyamupāsate ||

verses.sanskrit:
नास्य॑ जा॒या श॑तवा॒ही क॑ल्या॒णी तल्प॒मा श॑ये ।
यस्मि॑न् रा॒ष्ट्रे नि॑रु॒ध्यते॑ ब्रह्मजा॒याचि॑त्त्या ॥
verses.transliteration:
nāsya jāyā śatavāhī kalyāṇī talpamā śaye |
yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā ||

verses.sanskrit:
न वि॑क॒र्णः पृ॒थुशि॑रा॒स्तस्मि॒न् वेश्म॑नि जायते ।
यस्मि॑न् रा॒ष्ट्रे नि॑रु॒ध्यते॑ ब्रह्मजा॒याचि॑त्त्या ॥
verses.transliteration:
na vikarṇaḥ pṛthuśirāstasmin veśmani jāyate |
yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā ||

verses.sanskrit:
नास्य॑ क्ष॒त्ता नि॒ष्कग्री॑वः सू॒नाना॑मेत्यग्र॒तः ।
यस्मि॑न् रा॒ष्ट्रे नि॑रु॒ध्यते॑ ब्रह्मजा॒याचि॑त्त्या ॥
verses.transliteration:
nāsya kṣattā niṣkagrīvaḥ sūnānāmetyagrataḥ |
yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā ||

verses.sanskrit:
नास्य॑ श्वे॒तः कृ॑ष्ण॒कर्णो॑ धु॒रि यु॒क्तो म॑हीयते ।
यस्मि॑न् रा॒ष्ट्रे नि॑रु॒ध्यते॑ ब्रह्मजा॒याचि॑त्त्या ॥
verses.transliteration:
nāsya śvetaḥ kṛṣṇakarṇo dhuri yukto mahīyate |
yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā ||

verses.sanskrit:
नास्य॒ क्षेत्रे॑ पुष्क॒रिणी॒ नाण्डीकं॑ जायते॒ बिस॑म् ।
यस्मि॑न् रा॒ष्ट्रे नि॑रु॒ध्यते॑ ब्रह्मजा॒याचि॑त्त्या ॥
verses.transliteration:
nāsya kṣetre puṣkariṇī nāṇḍīkaṃ jāyate bisam |
yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā ||

verses.sanskrit:
नास्मै॒ पृश्निं॒ वि दु॑हन्ति॒ येऽस्या॒ दोह॑मु॒पास॑ते ।
यस्मि॑न् रा॒ष्ट्रे नि॑रु॒ध्यते॑ ब्रह्मजा॒याचि॑त्त्या ॥
verses.transliteration:
nāsmai pṛśniṃ vi duhanti ye'syā dohamupāsate |
yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā ||

verses.sanskrit:
नास्य॑ धे॒नुः क॑ल्या॒णी नान॒ड्वान्त्स॑हते॒ धुर॑म् ।
विजा॑नि॒र्यत्र॑ ब्रह्म॒णो रात्रिं॒ वस॑ति पा॒पया॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
nāsya dhenuḥ kalyāṇī nānaḍvāntsahate dhuram |
vijāniryatra brahmaṇo rātriṃ vasati pāpayā ||

verses.sanskrit:
नैतां ते॑ दे॒वा अ॑ददु॒स्तुभ्यं॑ नृपते॒ अत्त॑वे ।
मा ब्रा॑ह्म॒णस्य॑ राजन्य॒ गां जि॑घत्सो अना॒द्याम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
naitāṃ te devā adadustubhyaṃ nṛpate attave |
mā brāhmaṇasya rājanya gāṃ jighatso anādyām ||
verses.translation:
The wickedness of oppressing and robbing Brāhmans
The Gods, O Prince, have not bestowed this cow on thee to eat thereof.
Seek not, Rājanya, to devour the Brāhman’s cow which none may eat.
A base Rājanya, spoiled at dice, and ruined by himself, may eat.
The Brāhman’s cow and think, To-day and not tomorrow, let me live!
The Brāhman’s cow is like a snake, charged with due poison, clothed with skin.
Rājanya! bitter to the taste is she, and none may eat of her.
She takes away his strength, she mars his splendour, she ruins everything like fire enkindled.
That man drinks poison of the deadly serpent who counts the Brāhman as mere food to feed him.
Whoever smites him, deeming him a weakling-blasphemer, coveting his wealth through folly Indra sets fire alight within his bosom. He who acts thus is loathed by Earth and Heaven.
No Brāhman must be injured, safe as fire from him who loves himself.
For Soma is akin to him and Indra guards him from the curse.
The fool who eats the Brāhmans’ food and thinks it pleasant to the taste,
Eats, but can ne’er digest, the cow that bristles with a hundred barbs,
His voice an arrow’s neck, his tongue a bowstring, his windpipes fire-enveloped heads of arrows,
With these the Brāhman pierces through blasphemers, with God-sped bows that quell the hearts within them.
Keen arrows have the Brāhmans, armed with missiles: the shaft, when they discharge it, never faileth.
Pursuing him with fiery zeal and anger, they pierce the foeman even from a distance.
They who, themselves ten hundred, were the rulers of a thousand men,
The Vaitahavyas, were destroyed for that they ate a Brāhman’s cow.
The cow, indeed, when she was slain o’erthrew those Vaitahavyas, who Cooked the last she-goat that remained of Kesaraprābandhā’s flock.
One and a hundred were the folk, those whom the earth shook off from her:
When they had wronged the Brāhman race they perished incon-ceivably.
Among mankind the Gods’ despiser moveth: he hath drunk poison, naught but bone is left him.
Who wrongs the kinsman of the Gods, the Brāhman, gains not the sphere to which the Fathers travelled.
Agni, in sooth, is called our guide, Soma is called our next of kin.
Indra quells him who curses us. Sages know well that this is so.
Prince! like a poisoned arrow, like a deadly snake, O lord of kine!
Dire is the Brāhman’s arrow: he pierces his enemies therewith.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒क्षद्रु॑ग्धो राज॒न्यः पा॒प आ॑त्मपराजि॒तः ।
स ब्रा॑ह्म॒णस्य॒ गाम॑द्याद॒द्य जी॑वानि॒ माश्वः ॥
verses.transliteration:
akṣadrugdho rājanyaḥ pāpa ātmaparājitaḥ |
sa brāhmaṇasya gāmadyādadya jīvāni māśvaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
आवि॑ष्टिता॒घवि॑षा पृदा॒कूरि॑व॒ चर्म॑णा ।
सा ब्रा॑ह्म॒णस्य॑ राजन्य तृ॒ष्टैषा गौर॑ना॒द्या ॥
verses.transliteration:
āviṣṭitāghaviṣā pṛdākūriva carmaṇā |
sā brāhmaṇasya rājanya tṛṣṭaiṣā gauranādyā ||

verses.sanskrit:
निर्वै क्ष॒त्रं नय॑ति॒ हन्ति॒ वर्चो॒ऽग्निरि॒वार॑ब्धो॒ वि दु॑नोति॒ सर्व॑म् ।
यो ब्रा॑ह्म॒णं मन्य॑ते॒ अन्न॑मे॒व स वि॒षस्य॑ पिबति तैमा॒तस्य॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
nirvai kṣatraṃ nayati hanti varco'gnirivārabdho vi dunoti sarvam |
yo brāhmaṇaṃ manyate annameva sa viṣasya pibati taimātasya ||

verses.sanskrit:
य ए॑नं॒ हन्ति॑ मृ॒दुं मन्य॑मानो देवपी॒युर्धन॑कामो॒ न चि॒त्तात् ।
सं तस्येन्द्रो॒ हृद॑ये॒ऽग्निमि॑न्धे उ॒भे ए॑नं द्विष्टो॒ नभ॑सी॒ चर॑न्तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya enaṃ hanti mṛduṃ manyamāno devapīyurdhanakāmo na cittāt |
saṃ tasyendro hṛdaye'gnimindhe ubhe enaṃ dviṣṭo nabhasī carantam ||

verses.sanskrit:
न ब्रा॑ह्म॒णो हिं॑सित॒व्यो॒३ऽग्निः प्रि॒यत॑नोरिव ।
सोमो॒ ह्यऽस्य दाया॒द इन्द्रो॑ अस्याभिशस्ति॒पाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
na brāhmaṇo hiṃsitavyo'gniḥ priyatanoriva |
somo hya'sya dāyāda indro asyābhiśastipāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
श॒तापा॑ष्ठां॒ नि गि॑रति॒ तां न श॑क्नोति निः॒खिद॑म् ।
अन्नं॒ यो ब्र॒ह्मणां॑ म॒ल्वः स्वा॒द्व॑१द्मीति॒ मन्य॑ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
śatāpāṣṭhāṃ ni girati tāṃ na śaknoti niḥkhidam |
annaṃ yo brahmaṇāṃ malvaḥ svādvadmīti manyate ||

verses.sanskrit:
जिह्वा॒ ज्या भव॑ति॒ कुल्म॑लं॒ वाङ्ना॑डी॒का दन्ता॒स्तप॑सा॒भिदि॑ग्धाः ।
ते भि॑र्ब्रह्मा वि॑ध्यति देवपी॒यून् हृ॑द्ब॒लैर्धनु॑र्भिर्दे॒वजू॑तैः ॥
verses.transliteration:
jihvā jyā bhavati kulmalaṃ vāṅnāḍīkā dantāstapasābhidigdhāḥ |
te bhirbrahmā vidhyati devapīyūn hṛdbalairdhanurbhirdevajūtaiḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ती॒क्ष्णेष॑वो ब्राह्म॒णा हे॑ति॒मन्तो॒ यामस्य॑न्ति शर॒व्यां॒३ न सा मृषा॑ ।
अ॒नु॒हाय॒ तप॑सा म॒न्युना॑ चो॒त दू॒रादव॑ भिन्दन्त्येनम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tīkṣṇeṣavo brāhmaṇā hetimanto yāmasyanti śaravyāṃ na sā mṛṣā |
anuhāya tapasā manyunā cota dūrādava bhindantyenam ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये स॒हस्र॒मरा॑ज॒न्नासन् दशश॒ता उ॒त ।
ते ब्रा॑ह्म॒णस्य॒ गां ज॒ग्ध्वा वै॑तह॒व्याः परा॑भवन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye sahasramarājannāsan daśaśatā uta |
te brāhmaṇasya gāṃ jagdhvā vaitahavyāḥ parābhavan ||

verses.sanskrit:
गौरे॒व तान् ह॒न्यमा॑ना वैतह॒व्याँ अवा॑तिरत् ।
ये केस॑रप्राबन्धायाश्चर॒माजा॒मपे॑चिरन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
gaureva tān hanyamānā vaitahavyām̐ avātirat |
ye kesaraprābandhāyāścaramājāmapeciran ||

verses.sanskrit:
एक॑शतं॒ ता ज॒नता॒ या भूमि॒र्व्यऽधूनुत ।
प्र॒जां हिं॑सि॒त्वा ब्राह्म॑णीमसंभ॒व्यं परा॑भवन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ekaśataṃ tā janatā yā bhūmirvya'dhūnuta |
prajāṃ hiṃsitvā brāhmaṇīmasaṃbhavyaṃ parābhavan ||

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒व॒पी॒युश्च॑रति॒ मर्त्ये॑षु गरगी॒र्णो भ॑व॒त्यस्थि॑भूयान् ।
यो ब्रा॑ह्म॒णं दे॒वब॑न्धुं हि॒नस्ति॒ न स पि॑तृ॒याण॒मप्ये॑ति लो॒कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
devapīyuścarati martyeṣu garagīrṇo bhavatyasthibhūyān |
yo brāhmaṇaṃ devabandhuṃ hinasti na sa pitṛyāṇamapyeti lokam ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निर्वै नः॑ पदवा॒यः सोमो॑ दाया॒द उ॑च्यते ।
ह॒न्ताभिश॒स्तेन्द्र॒स्तथा॒ तद् वे॒धसो॑ विदुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnirvai naḥ padavāyaḥ somo dāyāda ucyate |
hantābhiśastendrastathā tad vedhaso viduḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इषु॑रिव दि॒ग्धा नृ॑पते पृदा॒कूरि॑व गोपते ।
सा ब्रा॑ह्म॒णस्येषु॑र्घो॒रा तया॑ विध्यति॒ पीय॑तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
iṣuriva digdhā nṛpate pṛdākūriva gopate |
sā brāhmaṇasyeṣurghorā tayā vidhyati pīyataḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ति॒मा॒त्रम॑वर्धन्त॒ नोदि॑व॒ दिव॑मस्पृशन् ।
भृगुं॑ हिंसि॒त्वा सृञ्ज॑या वैतह॒व्याः परा॑भवन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
atimātramavardhanta nodiva divamaspṛśan |
bhṛguṃ hiṃsitvā sṛñjayā vaitahavyāḥ parābhavan ||
verses.translation:
The wickedness of robbing or insulting Brāhmans
The sons of Vitahavya, the Srinjayas, waxed exceeding strong.
They well-nigh touched the heavens, but they wronged Bhrigu and were overthrown.
When men pierced Brihatsāman through, the Brāhman, son of Angiras,
The ram with teeth in both his jaws, the sheep, devoured their progeny.
If men have spat upon, or shot their rheum upon a Brāhman, they.
Sit in the middle of a stream running with blood, devouring hair.
While yet the Brāhman’s cow which men are dressing quivers in her throe:
She mars the kingdom’s splendour: there no vigorous hero springs to life.
Terrible is her cutting-up: her bitter flesh is cast away,
And it is counted sin among the Fathers if her milk is drunk.
If any King who deems himself mighty would eat a Brāhman up,
Rent and disrupted is that realm wherein a Brāhman is oppres-sed.
She grows eight-footed, and four-eyed, four-eared, four-jawed, two-faced, two-tongued,
And shatters down the kingdom of the man who doth the Brāhman wrong.
As water swamps a leaky ship so ruin overflows that realm.
Misfortune smites the realm wherein a Brāhman suffers scath and harm.
The very trees repel the man, and drive him from their sheltering shade,
Whoever claims, O Nārada, the treasure that a Brāhman owns.
That wealth, King Varuna hath said, is poison by the Gods prepared.
None hath kept watch to guard his realm who hath devoured a Brāhman’s cow.
Those nine-and-ninety people whom Earth shook and cast away from her,
When they had wronged the Brāhman race were ruined incon-ceivably.
Oppressor of the Brāhmans! thus the Gods have spoken and declared,
The step-effacing wisp they bind upon the dead shall be thy couch.
Oppressor of the Brāhmans! tears wept by the man who suffers wrong,
These are the share of water which the Gods have destined to be thine.
The share of water which the Gods have destined to be thine, is that,
Oppressor of the priest! wherewith men lave the corpse and wet the beard.
The rain of Mitra-Varuna falls not on him who wrongs the priest.
To him no counsel brings success: he wins, no friend to do his will.

verses.sanskrit:
ये बृ॒हत्सा॑मानमाङ्गिर॒समार्प॑यन् ब्राह्म॒णं जनाः॑ ।
पेत्व॒स्तेषा॑मुभ॒याद॒मवि॑स्तो॒कान्या॑वयत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye bṛhatsāmānamāṅgirasamārpayan brāhmaṇaṃ janāḥ |
petvasteṣāmubhayādamavistokānyāvayat ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये ब्रा॑ह्म॒णं प्र॒त्यष्ठी॑व॒न् ये वा॑स्मिञ्छु॒ल्कमी॑षि॒रे ।
अ॒स्नस्ते मध्ये॑ कु॒ल्यायाः॒ केशा॒न् खाद॑न्त आसते ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye brāhmaṇaṃ pratyaṣṭhīvan ye vāsmiñchulkamīṣire |
asnaste madhye kulyāyāḥ keśān khādanta āsate ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्र॒ह्म॒ग॒वी प॒च्यमा॑ना॒ याव॒त् साभि वि॒जङ्ग॑हे ।
तेजो॑ रा॒ष्ट्रस्य॒ निर्ह॑न्ति॒ न वी॒रो जा॑यते॒ वृषा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmagavī pacyamānā yāvat sābhi vijaṅgahe |
tejo rāṣṭrasya nirhanti na vīro jāyate vṛṣā ||

verses.sanskrit:
क्रू॒रम॑स्या आ॒शस॑नं तृ॒ष्टं पि॑शि॒तम॑स्यते ।
क्षी॒रं यद॑स्याः पी॒यते॒ तद् वै पि॒तृषु॒ किल्बि॑षम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
krūramasyā āśasanaṃ tṛṣṭaṃ piśitamasyate |
kṣīraṃ yadasyāḥ pīyate tad vai pitṛṣu kilbiṣam ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒ग्रो राजा॒ मन्य॑मानो ब्राह्म॒णं यो जिघ॑त्सति ।
परा॑ तत् सि॑च्यते रा॒ष्ट्रं ब्रा॑ह्म॒णो यत्र॑ जी॒यते॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ugro rājā manyamāno brāhmaṇaṃ yo jighatsati |
parā tat sicyate rāṣṭraṃ brāhmaṇo yatra jīyate ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ष्टाप॑दी चतुर॒क्षी चतुः॑श्रोत्रा॒ चतु॑र्हनुः ।
द्व्याऽस्या॒ द्विजि॑ह्वा भू॒त्वा सा रा॒ष्ट्रमव॑ धूनुते ब्रह्म॒ज्यस्य॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
aṣṭāpadī caturakṣī catuḥśrotrā caturhanuḥ |
dvyā'syā dvijihvā bhūtvā sā rāṣṭramava dhūnute brahmajyasya ||

verses.sanskrit:
तद् वै रा॒ष्ट्रमा स्र॑वति॒ नावं॑ भि॒न्नामि॑वोद॒कम् ।
ब्र॒ह्माणं॒ यत्र॒ हिंस॑न्ति॒ तद् रा॒ष्ट्रं ह॑न्ति दु॒च्छुना॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tad vai rāṣṭramā sravati nāvaṃ bhinnāmivodakam |
brahmāṇaṃ yatra hiṃsanti tad rāṣṭraṃ hanti ducchunā ||

verses.sanskrit:
तं वृ॒क्षा अप॑ सेधन्ति छा॒यां नो॒ मोप॑गा॒ इति॑ ।
यो ब्रा॑ह्म॒णस्य॒ सद् धन॑म॒भि ना॑रद॒ मन्य॑ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
taṃ vṛkṣā apa sedhanti chāyāṃ no mopagā iti |
yo brāhmaṇasya sad dhanamabhi nārada manyate ||

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒षमे॒तद् दे॒वकृ॑तं॒ राजा॒ वरु॑णोऽब्रवीत् ।
न ब्रा॑ह्म॒णस्य॒ गां ज॒ग्ध्वा रा॒ष्ट्रे जा॑गार॒ कश्च॒न ॥
verses.transliteration:
viṣametad devakṛtaṃ rājā varuṇo'bravīt |
na brāhmaṇasya gāṃ jagdhvā rāṣṭre jāgāra kaścana ||

verses.sanskrit:
नवै॒व ता न॑व॒तयो॒ या भूमि॒र्व्यऽधूनुत ।
प्र॒जां हिं॑सि॒त्वा ब्राह्म॑णीमसंभ॒व्यं परा॑भवन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
navaiva tā navatayo yā bhūmirvya'dhūnuta |
prajāṃ hiṃsitvā brāhmaṇīmasaṃbhavyaṃ parābhavan ||

verses.sanskrit:
यां मृ॒ताया॑नुब॒ध्नन्ति॑ कू॒द्यंऽ पद॒योप॑नीम् ।
तद् वै ब्र॑ह्मज्य ते दे॒वा उ॑प॒स्तर॑णमब्रुवन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāṃ mṛtāyānubadhnanti kūdyaṃ' padayopanīm |
tad vai brahmajya te devā upastaraṇamabruvan ||

verses.sanskrit:
अश्रू॑णि॒ कृप॑मानस्य॒ यानि॑ जी॒तस्य॑ वावृ॒तुः ।
तं वै ब्र॑ह्मज्य ते दे॒वा अ॒पां भा॒गम॑धारयन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśrūṇi kṛpamānasya yāni jītasya vāvṛtuḥ |
taṃ vai brahmajya te devā apāṃ bhāgamadhārayan ||

verses.sanskrit:
येन॑ मृ॒तं स्न॒पय॑न्ति॒ श्मश्रू॑णि॒ येनोन्दते॑ ।
तं वै ब्र॑ह्मज्य ते दे॒वा अ॒पां भा॒गम॑धारयन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yena mṛtaṃ snapayanti śmaśrūṇi yenondate |
taṃ vai brahmajya te devā apāṃ bhāgamadhārayan ||

verses.sanskrit:
न व॒र्षं मै॑त्रावरु॒णं ब्र॑ह्म॒ज्यम॒भि व॑र्षति ।
नास्मै॒ समि॑तिः कल्पते॒ न मि॒त्रं न॑यते॒ वश॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
na varṣaṃ maitrāvaruṇaṃ brahmajyamabhi varṣati |
nāsmai samitiḥ kalpate na mitraṃ nayate vaśam ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒च्चैर्घो॑षो दुन्दु॒भिः स॑त्वना॒यन् वा॑नस्प॒त्यः संभृ॑त उ॒स्रिया॑भिः ।
वाचं॑ क्षुणुवा॒नो द॒मय॑न्त्स॒पत्ना॑न्त्सिं॒ह इ॑व जे॒ष्यन्न॒भि तंस्तनीहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
uccairghoṣo dundubhiḥ satvanāyan vānaspatyaḥ saṃbhṛta usriyābhiḥ |
vācaṃ kṣuṇuvāno damayantsapatnāntsiṃha iva jeṣyannabhi taṃstanīhi ||
verses.translation:
A hymn to the War-drum to secure victory
Formed out of wood, compact with straps of leather, loud is the:
War-drum as he plays the hero.
Whetting thy voice and vanquishing opponents, roar at them like a lion fain to conquer!
The fastened frame hath roared as ‘twere a lion, like a bull bel-lowing to meet the heifer.
Thou art a bull, thine enemies are weaklings: thine is the foe-subduing strength of Indra.
Like a bull marked by strength among the cattle, roar seeking kine and gathering up the booty.
Pierce through our adversaries’ heart with sorrow, and let our routed foes desert their hamlets.
Victorious in the battle, loudly roaring, seizing what may be seized, look all around thee.
Utter, O Drum, thy heavenly voice with triumph. Bring, as a priest, our enemies’ possessions.
Hearing the Drum’s far-reaching voice resounding, let the foe’s dame, waked by the roar, afflicted,
Grasping her son, run forward in her terror amid the conflict of the deadly weapons.
Thou, first of all, O Drum, thy voice shalt utter: over the ridge of earth speak forth exultant.
Crunching with might the army of the foemen, declare thy message pleasantly and clearly.
Loud be thy roar between the earth and heaven. Swift let thy sounds go forth in all directions.
Neigh at them, thunder, set in opposition, song-maker, good ally that friends may conquer.
He shall send forth his voice whom art hath fashioned. Make thou the weapons of our warriors bristle.
With Indra for ally call out our heroes, and with thy friends scatter and chase the foemen Resonant, roaring, with thy powerful weapons, warning, and heard by troops in many places,
Knowing all rules and winning us advantage, deal fame to many where two kings are fighting.
Bent on advantage, mightier, gaining treasures, victor in war, the spell hath made thee keener.
As, in the press, the stone to stalks of Soma, thus, Drum! go dancing to our foes’ possessions.
Foe-conqueror, victor, vanquishing opponents, seeker of booty, mastering, destroying.
Speak out as a skilled speaker tells his counsel, speak strength to us that we may win the battle.
Shaker of things unshaken, readiest corner to battles; conquer-ing foes, resistless leader,
Guarded by Indra, watching our assemblies, go quickly, breaker of their hearts who hate us.

verses.sanskrit:
सिं॒ह इ॑वास्तानीद् द्रु॒वयो॒ विब॑द्धोऽभि॒क्रन्द॑न्नृष॒भो वा॑सि॒तामि॑व ।
वृषा॒ त्वं वध्र॑यस्ते स॒पत्ना॑ ऐ॒न्द्रस्ते॒ शुष्मो॑ अभिमातिषा॒हः ॥
verses.transliteration:
siṃha ivāstānīd druvayo vibaddho'bhikrandannṛṣabho vāsitāmiva |
vṛṣā tvaṃ vadhrayaste sapatnā aindraste śuṣmo abhimātiṣāhaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
वृषे॑व यू॒थे सह॑सा विदा॒नो ग॒व्यन्न॒भि रु॑व संधनाजित् ।
शु॒चा वि॑ध्य॒ हृद॑यं॒ परे॑षां हि॒त्वा ग्रामा॒न् प्रच्यु॑ता यन्तु॒ शत्र॑वः ॥
verses.transliteration:
vṛṣeva yūthe sahasā vidāno gavyannabhi ruva saṃdhanājit |
śucā vidhya hṛdayaṃ pareṣāṃ hitvā grāmān pracyutā yantu śatravaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
सं॒जय॒न् पृत॑ना ऊ॒र्ध्वमा॑यु॒र्गृह्या॑ गृह्णा॒नो ब॑हु॒धा वि च॑क्ष्व ।
दैवीं॒ वाचं॑ दुन्दुभ॒ आ गु॑रस्व वे॒धाः शत्रू॑णा॒मुप॑ भरस्व॒ वेदः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃjayan pṛtanā ūrdhvamāyurgṛhyā gṛhṇāno bahudhā vi cakṣva |
daivīṃ vācaṃ dundubha ā gurasva vedhāḥ śatrūṇāmupa bharasva vedaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
दु॒न्दु॒भेर्वाचं॒ प्रय॑तां॒ वद॑न्तीमाशृण्व॒ती ना॑थि॒ता घोष॑बुद्धा ।
नारी॑ पु॒त्रं धा॑वतु हस्त॒गह्या॑मि॒त्री भी॒ता स॑म॒रे व॒धाना॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
dundubhervācaṃ prayatāṃ vadantīmāśṛṇvatī nāthitā ghoṣabuddhā |
nārī putraṃ dhāvatu hastagahyāmitrī bhītā samare vadhānām ||

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वो॑ दुन्दुभे॒ प्र व॑दासि॒ वाचं॒ भूम्याः॑ पृ॒ष्ठे व॑द॒ रोच॑मानः ।
अ॒मि॒त्र॒से॒नाम॑भि॒जञ्ज॑भानो द्यु॒मद् व॑द दुन्दुभे सू॒नृता॑वत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pūrvo dundubhe pra vadāsi vācaṃ bhūmyāḥ pṛṣṭhe vada rocamānaḥ |
amitrasenāmabhijañjabhāno dyumad vada dundubhe sūnṛtāvat ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न्त॒रेमे नभ॑सी॒ घोषो॑ अस्तु॒ पृथ॑क् ते ध्व॒नयो॑ यन्तु॒ शीभ॑म् ।
अ॒भि क्र॑न्द स्त॒नयो॒त्पिपा॑नः श्लोक॒कृन्मि॑त्र॒तूर्या॑य स्व॒र्धी ॥
verses.transliteration:
antareme nabhasī ghoṣo astu pṛthak te dhvanayo yantu śībham |
abhi kranda stanayotpipānaḥ ślokakṛnmitratūryāya svardhī ||

verses.sanskrit:
धी॒भिः कृ॒तः प्र व॑दाति॒ वाच॒मुद्ध॑र्षय॒ सत्व॑ना॒मायु॑धानि ।
इन्द्र॑मेदी॒ सत्व॑नो॒ नि ह्व॑यस्व मि॒त्रैर॒मित्राँ॒ अव॑ जङ्घनीहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhībhiḥ kṛtaḥ pra vadāti vācamuddharṣaya satvanāmāyudhāni |
indramedī satvano ni hvayasva mitrairamitrām̐ ava jaṅghanīhi ||

verses.sanskrit:
सं॒क्रन्दनः॑ प्रव॒दो धृ॒ष्णुषे॑णः प्रवेद॒कृद् ब॑हु॒धा ग्रा॑मघो॒षी ।
श्रेयो॑ वन्वा॒नो व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान् की॒र्तिं ब॒हुभ्यो॒ वि ह॑र द्विरा॒जे ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃkrandanaḥ pravado dhṛṣṇuṣeṇaḥ pravedakṛd bahudhā grāmaghoṣī |
śreyo vanvāno vayunāni vidvān kīrtiṃ bahubhyo vi hara dvirāje ||

verses.sanskrit:
श्रेयः॑केतो वसु॒जित् सहीयान्त्संग्राम॒जित् संशि॑तो॒ ब्रह्म॑णासि ।
अं॒शूनि॑व॒ ग्रावा॑धि॒षव॑णे॒ अद्रि॑र्ग॒व्य॑न् दु॑न्दु॒भेऽधि॑ नृत्य॒ वेदः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
śreyaḥketo vasujit sahīyāntsaṃgrāmajit saṃśito brahmaṇāsi |
aṃśūniva grāvādhiṣavaṇe adrirgavyan dundubhe'dhi nṛtya vedaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
श॒त्रू॒षाण् नी॒षाड॑भिमातिषा॒हो ग॒वेष॑णः॒ सह॑मान उ॒द्भित् ।
वा॒ग्वीव॒ मन्त्रं॒ प्र भ॑रस्व॒ वाचं॒ सांग्रा॑मजित्या॒येष॒मुद् व॑दे॒ह ॥
verses.transliteration:
śatrūṣāṇ nīṣāḍabhimātiṣāho gaveṣaṇaḥ sahamāna udbhit |
vāgvīva mantraṃ pra bharasva vācaṃ sāṃgrāmajityāyeṣamud vadeha ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒च्यु॒त॒च्युत् स॒मदो॒ गमि॑ष्ठो॒ मृधो॒ जेता॑ पुरए॒तायो॒ध्यः ।
इन्द्रे॑ण गु॒प्तो वि॒दथा॑ नि॒चिक्य॑द्धृ॒द्द्योत॑नो द्विष॒तां या॑हि॒ शीभ॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
acyutacyut samado gamiṣṭho mṛdho jetā puraetāyodhyaḥ |
indreṇa gupto vidathā nicikyaddhṛddyotano dviṣatāṃ yāhi śībham ||

verses.sanskrit:
विहृ॑दयं वैमन॒स्यं वदा॒मित्रे॑षु दुन्दुभे ।
वि॒द्वे॒षं कश्म॑शं भ॒यम॒मित्रे॑षु॒ नि द॑ध्म॒स्यवैनान् दुन्दुभे जहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
vihṛdayaṃ vaimanasyaṃ vadāmitreṣu dundubhe |
vidveṣaṃ kaśmaśaṃ bhayamamitreṣu ni dadhmasyavainān dundubhe jahi ||
verses.translation:
A hymn to the War-drum and various deities for victory
Speak to our enemies, O Drum, discouragement and wild dismay.
We bring upon our foemen fear and discord and discomfiture.
Drum! drive these enemies away.
When sacrificial butter hath been offered, let our foemen flee.
Through consternation, terrified, trembling in mind and eye and heart.
Wrought out of wood, compact with straps of leather, dear to all the clan,
Bedewed with sacrificial oil, speak terror to our enemies.
As the wild creatures of the wood flee in their terror from a man,
Even so do thou, O Drum, roar out against our foes to frighten them, and then bewilder thou their thoughts.
As, when the wolf approaches, goats and sheep run sorely terrified,
Even so do thou, O Drum, roar out against our foes to frighten them, and then bewilder thou their thoughts.
As birds of air, day after day, fly in wild terror from the hawk, as from a roaring lion’s voice,
Even so do thou, O Drum, roar out against our foes to frighten them, and then bewilder thou their thoughts.
May all the deities whose might controls the fortune of the fray Frighten away our enemies with Drum and skin of antelope.
Let those our enemies who go yonder in their battalions shake.
In fear at shadows and the sounds of feet which Indra sporteth with.
To all the quarters of the sky let clang of bowstrings and our Drums.
Cry out to hosts of foes that go discomfited in serried ranks.
Āditya, take their sight away! Follow them close, ye motes of light.
Let them cleave fast to foot-bound hosts when strength of arm hath past away.
Do ye, O mighty Maruts, sons of Prisni, crush down, with Indra for ally, our foemen.
King Soma. Varuna, great God and sovran, Indra too, aye,
Death,—
May these embattled Gods, brilliant as Sūrya—All hail!—one-minded conquer those who hate us.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒द्वेप॑माना॒ मन॑सा॒ चक्षु॑षा॒ हृद॑येन च ।
धाव॑न्तु॒ बिभ्य॑तो॒ऽमित्राः॑ प्रत्रा॒सेनाज्ये॑ हु॒ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
udvepamānā manasā cakṣuṣā hṛdayena ca |
dhāvantu bibhyato'mitrāḥ pratrāsenājye hute ||

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒न॒स्प॒त्यः संभृ॑त उ॒स्रिया॑भिर्वि॒श्वगो॑त्र्यः ।
प्र॒त्रा॒सम॒मित्रे॑भ्यो व॒दाज्ये॑ना॒भिघा॑रितः ॥
verses.transliteration:
vānaspatyaḥ saṃbhṛta usriyābhirviśvagotryaḥ |
pratrāsamamitrebhyo vadājyenābhighāritaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॑ मृ॒गाः सं॑वि॒जन्त॑ आर॒ण्याः पुरु॑षा॒दधि॑ ।
ए॒वा त्वं दु॑न्दुभे॒ऽमित्रा॑न॒भि क्र॑न्द॒ प्र त्रा॑स॒याथो॑ चि॒त्तानि॑ मोहय ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā mṛgāḥ saṃvijanta āraṇyāḥ puruṣādadhi |
evā tvaṃ dundubhe'mitrānabhi kranda pra trāsayātho cittāni mohaya ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॒ वृका॑दजा॒वयो॒ धाव॑न्ति ब॒हु बिभ्य॑तीः ।
ए॒वा त्वं दु॑न्दुभे॒ऽमित्रा॑न॒भि क्र॑न्द॒ प्र त्रा॑स॒याथो॑ चि॒त्तानि॑ मोहय ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā vṛkādajāvayo dhāvanti bahu bibhyatīḥ |
evā tvaṃ dundubhe'mitrānabhi kranda pra trāsayātho cittāni mohaya ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॑ श्ये॒नात् प॑त॒त्रिणः॑ संवि॒जन्ते॒ अह॑र्दिवि सिं॒हस्य॑ स्त॒नथो॒र्यथा॑ ।
ए॒वा त्वं दु॑न्दुभे॒ऽमित्रा॑न॒भि क्र॑न्द॒ प्र त्रा॑स॒याथो॑ चि॒त्तानि॑ मोहय ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā śyenāt patatriṇaḥ saṃvijante ahardivi siṃhasya stanathoryathā |
evā tvaṃ dundubhe'mitrānabhi kranda pra trāsayātho cittāni mohaya ||

verses.sanskrit:
परा॒मित्रा॑न् दुन्दु॒भिना॑ हरि॒णस्या॒जिने॑न च ।
सर्वे॑ दे॒वा अ॑तित्रस॒न् ये सं॑ग्रा॒मस्येशते ॥
verses.transliteration:
parāmitrān dundubhinā hariṇasyājinena ca |
sarve devā atitrasan ye saṃgrāmasyeśate ||

verses.sanskrit:
यैरिन्द्रः॑ प्र॒क्रीड॑ते पद्घो॒षैश्छा॒यया॑ स॒ह ।
तैर॒मित्रा॑स्त्रसन्तु नो॒ऽमी ये यन्त्य॑नीक॒शः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yairindraḥ prakrīḍate padghoṣaiśchāyayā saha |
tairamitrāstrasantu no'mī ye yantyanīkaśaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ज्या॒घो॒षा दु॑न्दु॒भयो॒ भि क्रो॑शन्तु॒ या दिशः॑ ।
सेनाः॒ परा॑जिता य॒तीर॒मित्रा॑णामनीक॒शः ॥
verses.transliteration:
jyāghoṣā dundubhayo bhi krośantu yā diśaḥ |
senāḥ parājitā yatīramitrāṇāmanīkaśaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
आदि॑त्य॒ चक्षु॒रा द॑त्स्व॒ मरी॑च॒योऽनु॑ धावत ।
प॒त्स॒ङ्गिनी॒रा स॑जन्तु॒ विग॑ते बाहुवी॒र्येऽ ॥
verses.transliteration:
āditya cakṣurā datsva marīcayo'nu dhāvata |
patsaṅginīrā sajantu vigate bāhuvīrye' ||

verses.sanskrit:
यू॒यमु॒ग्रा म॑रुतः पृश्निमातर॒ इन्द्रे॑ण यु॒जा प्र मृ॑णीत॒ शत्रू॑न् ।
सोमो॒ राजा॒ वरु॑णो॒ राजा॑ महादे॒व उ॒त मृ॒त्युरिन्द्रः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yūyamugrā marutaḥ pṛśnimātara indreṇa yujā pra mṛṇīta śatrūn |
somo rājā varuṇo rājā mahādeva uta mṛtyurindraḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒ता दे॑वसे॒नाः सूर्य॑केतवः॒ सचे॑तसः ।
अ॒मित्रा॑न् नो जयन्तु॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
etā devasenāḥ sūryaketavaḥ sacetasaḥ |
amitrān no jayantu svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निस्त॒क्मान॒मप॑ बाधतामि॒तः सोमो॒ ग्रावा॒ वरु॑णः पू॒तद॑क्षाः ।
वेदि॑र्ब॒र्हिः स॒मिधः॒ शोशु॑चाना॒ अप॒ द्वेषां॑स्यमु॒या भ॑वन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnistakmānamapa bādhatāmitaḥ somo grāvā varuṇaḥ pūtadakṣāḥ |
vedirbarhiḥ samidhaḥ śośucānā apa dveṣāṃsyamuyā bhavantu ||
verses.translation:
A charm against fever
Hence, filled with holy strength let Agni, Soma, and Varuna, the Press-stone, and the Altar.
And Grass, and glowing Fuel banish Fever. Let hateful things stay at a distance yonder.
And thou thyself who makest all men yellow, consuming them with burning heat like Agni,
Thou, Fever! then be weak and ineffective. Pass hence into the realms below or vanish.
Endowed with universal power! send Fever down-ward, far away,
The spotty, like red-coloured dust, sprung from a spotty ancestor.
When I have paid obeisance to Fever I send him downward forth.
So let Sakambhara’s boxer go again to the Mahāvrishas.
His mansions are the Mūjavans, and the Mahāvrishas his home,
Thou, Fever, ever since thy birth hast lived among the Bahlikas.
Fever, snake, limbless one, speak out! Keep thyself far away fi om us.
Seek thou a wanton Dāst girl and strike her with thy thunder-bolt.
Go, Fever, to the Mūjavans, or, farther, to the Bahlikas.
Seek a lascivious Sara girl and seem to shake her through and through.
Go hence and eat thy kinsmen the Mahāvrishas and Mūjavans.
These or those foreign regions we proclaim to Fever for his home.
In a strange land thou joyest not; subdued, thou wilt be kind to us.
Fever is eager to depart, and to the Bahlikas will go,
Since thou now cold, now burning hot, with cough besides, hast made us shake,
Terrible, Fever, are thy darts: forbear to injure us with these.
Take none of these to be thy friends, Cough, or Consumption or Decline:
Never come thence again to us! O Fever, thus I counsel thee.
Go, Fever, with Consumption, thy brother, and with thy sister,
Cough.
And with thy nephew Herpes, go away unto that alien folk.
Chase Fever whether cold or hot, brought by the summer or the rains,
Tertian, intermittent, or autumnal, or continual.
We to Gandhāris, Mūjavans, to Angas and to Magadhas.
Hand over Fever as it were a servant and a thing of price.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यं यो विश्वा॒न् हरि॑तान् कृ॒णोष्यु॑च्छो॒चय॑न्न॒ग्निरि॑वाभिदु॒न्वन् ।
अधा॒ हि त॑क्मन्नर॒सो हि भू॒या अधा॒ न्यऽङ्ङध॒राङ् वा॒ परे॑हि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ayaṃ yo viśvān haritān kṛṇoṣyucchocayannagnirivābhidunvan |
adhā hi takmannaraso hi bhūyā adhā nya'ṅṅadharāṅ vā parehi ||

verses.sanskrit:
यः प॑रु॒षः पा॑रुषे॒योऽवध्वं॒स इ॑वारु॒णः ।
त॒क्मानं॑ विश्वधावीर्याध॒राञ्चं॒ परा॑ सुवा ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaḥ paruṣaḥ pāruṣeyo'vadhvaṃsa ivāruṇaḥ |
takmānaṃ viśvadhāvīryādharāñcaṃ parā suvā ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ध॒राञ्चं॒ प्र हि॑णोमि॒ नमः॑ कृ॒त्वा त॒क्मने॑ ।
श॒क॒म्भ॒रस्य॑ मुष्टि॒हा पुन॑रेतु महावृ॒षान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
adharāñcaṃ pra hiṇomi namaḥ kṛtvā takmane |
śakambharasya muṣṭihā punaretu mahāvṛṣān ||

verses.sanskrit:
ओको॑ अस्य॒ मूज॑वन्त॒ ओको॑ अस्य महावृ॒षाः ।
याव॑ज्जा॒तस्त॑क्मं॒स्तावा॑नसि॒ बल्हि॑केषु न्योच॒रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
oko asya mūjavanta oko asya mahāvṛṣāḥ |
yāvajjātastakmaṃstāvānasi balhikeṣu nyocaraḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
तक्म॒न् व्याऽल॒ वि ग॑द॒ व्यऽङ्ग॒ भूरि॑ यावय ।
दा॒सीं नि॒ष्टक्व॑रीमिछ॒ तां वज्रे॑ण॒ सम॑र्पय ॥
verses.transliteration:
takman vyā'la vi gada vya'ṅga bhūri yāvaya |
dāsīṃ niṣṭakvarīmicha tāṃ vajreṇa samarpaya ||

verses.sanskrit:
तक्म॒न् मूज॑वतो गच्छ॒ बल्हि॑कान् वा परस्त॒राम् ।
शू॒द्रामि॑च्छ प्रफ॒र्व्यं॑१ तां त॑क्म॒न् वीऽव धूनुहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
takman mūjavato gaccha balhikān vā parastarām |
śūdrāmiccha prapharvyaṃ tāṃ takman vī'va dhūnuhi ||

verses.sanskrit:
म॒हा॒वृ॒षान् मूज॑वतो॒ बन्ध्व॑द्धि प॒रेत्य॑ ।
प्रैतानि॑ त॒क्मने॑ ब्रूमो अन्यक्षे॒त्राणि॒ वा इ॒मा ॥
verses.transliteration:
mahāvṛṣān mūjavato bandhvaddhi paretya |
praitāni takmane brūmo anyakṣetrāṇi vā imā ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न्य॒क्षे॒त्रे न र॑मसे व॒शी सन्मृ॑डयासि नः ।
अभू॑दु॒ प्रार्थ॑स्त॒क्मा स ग॑मिष्यति॒ बल्हि॑कान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
anyakṣetre na ramase vaśī sanmṛḍayāsi naḥ |
abhūdu prārthastakmā sa gamiṣyati balhikān ||

verses.sanskrit:
यत् त्वं शी॒तोऽथो॑ रू॒रः स॒ह का॒सावे॑पयः ।
भी॒मास्ते॑ तक्मन् हे॒तय॒स्ताभिः॑ स्म॒ परि॑ वृङ्ग्धि नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yat tvaṃ śīto'tho rūraḥ saha kāsāvepayaḥ |
bhīmāste takman hetayastābhiḥ sma pari vṛṅgdhi naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
मा स्मै॒तान्त्सखी॑न् कुरुथा ब॒लासं॑ का॒समु॑द्यु॒गम् ।
मास्मातो॒ऽर्वाङैः पुन॒स्तत् त्वा॑ तक्म॒न्नुप॑ ब्रुवे ॥
verses.transliteration:
mā smaitāntsakhīn kuruthā balāsaṃ kāsamudyugam |
māsmāto'rvāṅaiḥ punastat tvā takmannupa bruve ||

verses.sanskrit:
तक्म॒न् भ्रात्रा॑ ब॒लासे॑न॒ स्वस्रा॒ कासि॑कया स॒ह ।
पा॒प्मा भ्रातृ॑व्येण स॒ह गछा॒मुमर॑णं॒ जन॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
takman bhrātrā balāsena svasrā kāsikayā saha |
pāpmā bhrātṛvyeṇa saha gachāmumaraṇaṃ janam ||

verses.sanskrit:
तृती॑यकं वितृती॒यं स॑द॒न्दिमु॒त शा॑र॒दम् ।
त॒क्मानं॑ शी॒तं रू॒रं ग्रैष्मं॑ नाशय॒ वार्षि॑कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tṛtīyakaṃ vitṛtīyaṃ sadandimuta śāradam |
takmānaṃ śītaṃ rūraṃ graiṣmaṃ nāśaya vārṣikam ||

verses.sanskrit:
ग॒न्धारि॑भ्यो॒ मूज॑व॒द्भ्योऽङ्गे॑भ्यो म॒गधे॑भ्यः ।
प्रै॒ष्यन् जन॑मिव शेव॒धिं त॒क्मानं॒ परि॑ दद्मसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
gandhāribhyo mūjavadbhyo'ṅgebhyo magadhebhyaḥ |
praiṣyan janamiva śevadhiṃ takmānaṃ pari dadmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
ओते॑ मे॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी ओता॑ दे॒वी सर॑स्वती ।
ओतौ॑ म॒ इन्द्र॑श्चा॒ग्निश्च॒ क्रिमिं॑ जम्भयता॒मिति॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ote me dyāvāpṛthivī otā devī sarasvatī |
otau ma indraścāgniśca krimiṃ jambhayatāmiti ||
verses.translation:
A charm against parasitic worms
I have called Heaven and Earth to aid, have called divine Sarasvati,
Indra and Agni have I called: Let these destroy the worm, I prayed.
O Indra, Lord of Treasures, kill the worms that prey upon this boy.
All the malignant spirits have been smitten by my potent spell. We utterly destroy the worm, the worm that creeps around the eyes.
The worm that crawls about the nose, the worm that gets bet-ween the teeth.
Two of like colour, two unlike, two coloured black, two coloured red.
The tawny and the tawny-eared, Vulture and Wolf, all these are killed.
Worms that are white about the sides, those that are black with black-hued arms,
All that show various tints and hues, these worms we utterly destroy.
Eastward the Sun is mounting, seen of all, destroying thing unseen,
Crushing and killing all the worms invisible and visible.
Let the Yevāshas, Kaskashas, Ejatkas, Sipavitnukas,
Let both the worm that we can see, and that we see not, be destroyed.
Slain the Yevāsha of the worms, slain too is the Nadaniman.
I have reduced them all to dust like vetches with the pounding-stone.
The worm Sāranga, white of hue, three-headed, with a triple hump,
I split and tear his ribs away, I wrench off every head he has.
I kill you, worms, as Atri, as Kanva and Jamadagni killed.
I crush the worms to pieces with a spell that erst Agastya used.
The King of worms hath been destroyed, he who was lord of these is slain.
Slain is the worm whose mother, whose brother and sister have been slain.
Destroyed are his dependants, who those dwell around him are destroyed,
And all the worms that seem to be the little ones are done to death Of every worm and insect, of the female and the male alike,
I crush the head to pieces with a stone and burn the face with fire.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒स्येन्द्र॑ कुमा॒रस्य॒ क्रिमी॑न् धनपते जहि ।
ह॒ता विश्वा॒ अरा॑तय उ॒ग्रेण॒ वच॑सा॒ मम॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
asyendra kumārasya krimīn dhanapate jahi |
hatā viśvā arātaya ugreṇa vacasā mama ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो अ॒क्ष्यौऽपरि॒सर्प॑ति॒ यो नासे॑ परि॒सर्प॑ति ।
द॒तां यो मध्यं॒ गच्छ॑ति॒ तं क्रिमिं॑ जम्भयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo akṣyau'parisarpati yo nāse parisarpati |
datāṃ yo madhyaṃ gacchati taṃ krimiṃ jambhayāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
सरू॑पौ॒ द्वौ विरू॑पौ॒ द्वौ कृ॒ष्णौ द्वौ रोहि॑तौ॒ द्वौ ।
ब॒भ्रुश्च॑ ब॒भ्रुक॑र्णश्च॒ गृध्रः॒ कोक॑श्च॒ ते ह॒ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarūpau dvau virūpau dvau kṛṣṇau dvau rohitau dvau |
babhruśca babhrukarṇaśca gṛdhraḥ kokaśca te hatāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये क्रिम॑यः शिति॒कक्षा॒ ये कृ॒ष्णाः शि॑ति॒बाह॑वः ।
ये के च॑ वि॒श्वरू॑पा॒स्तान् क्रिमी॑न् जम्भयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye krimayaḥ śitikakṣā ye kṛṣṇāḥ śitibāhavaḥ |
ye ke ca viśvarūpāstān krimīn jambhayāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
उत् पु॒रस्ता॒त् सूर्य॑ एति वि॒श्वदृ॑ष्टो अदृष्ट॒हा ।
दृ॒ष्टांश्च॒ घ्नन्न॒दॄष्टां॑श्च॒ सर्वां॑श्च प्रमृ॒णन् क्रिमी॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ut purastāt sūrya eti viśvadṛṣṭo adṛṣṭahā |
dṛṣṭāṃśca ghnannadṝṣṭāṃśca sarvāṃśca pramṛṇan krimīn ||

verses.sanskrit:
येवा॑षासः॒ कष्क॑षास एज॒त्काः शि॑पवित्नु॒काः ।
दृ॒ष्टांश्च॑ ह॒न्यतां॑ क्रिमि॑रु॒तादृष्ट॑श्च हन्यताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yevāṣāsaḥ kaṣkaṣāsa ejatkāḥ śipavitnukāḥ |
dṛṣṭāṃśca hanyatāṃ krimirutādṛṣṭaśca hanyatām ||

verses.sanskrit:
ह॒तो येवा॑षः॒ क्रिमी॑णां ह॒तो न॑दनि॒मोत ।
सर्वा॒न् नि म॑ष्म॒षाक॑रं दृ॒षदा॒ खल्वाँ॑ इव ॥
verses.transliteration:
hato yevāṣaḥ krimīṇāṃ hato nadanimota |
sarvān ni maṣmaṣākaraṃ dṛṣadā khalvām̐ iva ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्रि॒शी॒र्षाणं॑ त्रिक॒कुदं॒ क्रिमिं॑ सा॒रङ्ग॒मर्जु॑नम् ।
शृ॒णाम्य॑स्य पृ॒ष्टीरपि॑ वृश्चामि॒ यच्छिरः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
triśīrṣāṇaṃ trikakudaṃ krimiṃ sāraṅgamarjunam |
śṛṇāmyasya pṛṣṭīrapi vṛścāmi yacchiraḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒त्रि॒वद् वः॑ क्रिमयो हन्मि कण्व॒वज्ज॑मदग्नि॒वत् ।
अ॒गस्त्य॑स्य॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ सं पि॑नष्म्य॒हं क्रिमी॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
atrivad vaḥ krimayo hanmi kaṇvavajjamadagnivat |
agastyasya brahmaṇā saṃ pinaṣmyahaṃ krimīn ||

verses.sanskrit:
ह॒तो राजा॒ क्रिमी॑णामु॒तैषां॑ स्थ॒पति॑र्ह॒तः ।
ह॒तो ह॒तमा॑ता॒ क्रिमि॑र्ह॒तभ्रा॑ता ह॒तस्व॑सा ॥
verses.transliteration:
hato rājā krimīṇāmutaiṣāṃ sthapatirhataḥ |
hato hatamātā krimirhatabhrātā hatasvasā ||

verses.sanskrit:
ह॒तासो॑ अस्य वे॒शसो॑ ह॒तासः॒ परि॑वेशसः ।
अथो॒ ये क्षु॑ल्ल॒का इ॑व॒ सर्वे॒ ते क्रिम॑यो ह॒ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
hatāso asya veśaso hatāsaḥ pariveśasaḥ |
atho ye kṣullakā iva sarve te krimayo hatāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वे॑षां च॒ क्रिमी॑णां॒ सर्वा॑सां च क्रि॒मीना॑म् ।
भि॒नद्म्यश्म॑ना॒ शिरो॒ दहा॑म्य॒ग्निना॒ मुख॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarveṣāṃ ca krimīṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ ca krimīnām |
bhinadmyaśmanā śiro dahāmyagninā mukham ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒वि॒ता प्र॑स॒वाना॒मधि॑पतिः॒ स मा॑वतु ।
अ॒स्मिन् ब्रह्म॑ण्य॒स्मिन् कर्म॑ण्य॒स्यां पु॑रो॒धाया॑म॒स्यां प्र॑ति॒ष्ठाया॑म॒स्यां
चित्त्या॑म॒स्यामाकू॑त्याम॒स्यामा॒शिष्य॒स्यां दे॒वहू॑त्यां॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
savitā prasavānāmadhipatiḥ sa māvatu |
asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ
cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā ||
verses.translation:
A priest’s prayer for protection and assistance
Savitar, Lord of furthering aids, protect me, in this my prayer, in this mine act, in this my sacerdotal charge, in this perfor-mance, in this thought, in this my plan and wish, in this my calling on the Gods! All hail!
May Agni, Lord of forest trees, protect, me, in, etc.
May Heaven and Earth, the Queens of bounties, save me.
May Varuna, the Lord of waters, save me.
May Mitra-Varuna, Lords of rain, preserve me.
Lords of the mountains, may the Maruts save me.
May, Soma, Lord of plants and herbs, protect me.
May Vāyu, Lord of middle air, protect me.
May Sūrya, sovran Lord of eyes, protect me.
May the Moon, Lord of constellations, save me.
May Indra who is Lord of heaven protect me.
The Maruts’ father, Lord of cattle, save me.
May Mrityu, Lord of living creatures, save me.
May Yama, Regent of the Fathers, save me.
May the Forefathers of old time protect me.
May Fathers of succeeding ages save me.
Next may the Fathers of our fathers save me, in this my prayer,. in this mine act, in this my sacerdotal charge, in this perfor-mance, in this thought, in this my plan and wish, in this my calling on the Gods! All hail!

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निर्वन॒स्पती॑ना॒मधि॑पतिः॒ स मा॑वतु ।
अ॒स्मिन् ब्रह्म॑ण्य॒स्मिन् कर्म॑ण्य॒स्यां पु॑रो॒धाया॑म॒स्यां प्र॑ति॒ष्ठाया॑म॒स्यां
चित्त्या॑म॒स्यामाकू॑त्याम॒स्यामा॒शिष्य॒स्यां दे॒वहू॑त्यां॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥

verses.sanskrit:

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒युर॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒स्याधि॑पतिः॒ स मा॑वतु ।
अ॒स्मिन् ब्रह्म॑ण्य॒स्मिन् कर्म॑ण्य॒स्यां पु॑रो॒धाया॑म॒स्यां प्र॑ति॒ष्ठाया॑म॒स्या॑

verses.transliteration:
vāyurantarikṣasyādhipatiḥ sa māvatu |
asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyā

verses.sanskrit:
सूर्य॒श्चक्षु॑षा॒मधि॑पतिः॒ स मा॑वतु ।

च॒न्द्रमा॒ नक्ष॑त्राणा॒मधि॑पतिः॒ स मा॑वतु ।

asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ
cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रो॑ दि॒वोऽधि॑पतिः॒ स मा॑वतु ।
अ॒स्मिन् ब्रह्म॑ण्य॒स्मिन् कर्म॑ण्य॒स्यां पु॑रो॒धाया॑म॒स्यां प्र॑ति॒ष्ठाया॑म॒स्यां

asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ
cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
म॒रुतां॑ पि॒ता प॑शू॒नामधि॑पतिः॒ स मा॑वतु ।
अ॒स्मिन् ब्रह्म॑ण्य॒स्मिन् कर्म॑ण्य॒स्यां पु॑रो॒धाया॑म॒स्यां प्र॑ति॒ष्ठाया॑म॒स्यां

cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:

अ॒स्मिन् ब्रह्म॑ण्य॒स्मिन् कर्म॑ण्य॒स्यां पु॑रो॒धाया॑म॒स्यां प्र॑ति॒ष्ठाया॑म॒स्यां

verses.sanskrit:

अ॒स्मिन् ब्रह्म॑ण्य॒स्मिन् कर्म॑ण्य॒स्यां पु॑रो॒धाया॑म॒स्यां प्र॑तिष्ठाया॑मस्यां
चित्त्या॑म॒स्यामाकू॑त्याम॒स्यामा॒शिष्य॒स्यां दे॒वहू॑त्यां॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:

asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ
cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
पर्व॑ताद् दि॒वो योने॒रङ्गा॑दङ्गात् स॒माभृ॑तम् ।
शेपो॒ गर्भ॑स्य रेतो॒धाः सरौ॑ प॒र्णमि॒वा द॑धत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
parvatād divo yoneraṅgādaṅgāt samābhṛtam |
śepo garbhasya retodhāḥ sarau parṇamivā dadhat ||
verses.translation:
A charm to facilitate conception
Let the man, sower of the germ, lay, as a feather on a shaft.
Limb drawn from limb, whate’er is culled from cloud and from the womb of heaven.
Even as this broad earth received the germ of all the things that be,
Thus within thee I lay the germ. I call thee, Earth, to strengthen it.
O Sinivāli, set the germ, set thou the germ, Sarasvati! In thee let both the Asvins, crowned with lotuses, bestow the germ.
Let Mitra-Varuna and God Brihaspati lay the germ in thee.
Indra and Agni lay the germ, Dhātar bestow the germ in thee.
Let Vishnu form and mould the womb, let Tvashtar duly shape the forms,
Prajāpati infuse the stream, and Dhātar lay for thee the germ.
Drink thou the procreative draught well-known to Varuna the King,
Known to divine Sarasvati, and Indra slayer of the foe.
Thou art the germ of plants and herbs, thou art the germ of forest trees,
The germ of each existing thing, so here, O Agni, lay the germ.
Rise up, put forth thy manly strength, and lay thy germ within the womb.
A bull art thou with vigorous strength: for progeny we bring thee near.
Prepare thee, Bārhatsāmā, let the germ be laid within thy side.
The Soma-drinking Gods have given a son to thee, thy son and mine.
O Dhātar, thou Disposer, lay within the body of this dame.
A male germ with the noblest form, for her, in the tenth month, to bear.Tvashtar, celestial artist, lay within the body of this dame.
A male germ with the noblest form for her in the tenth month to bear.
Savitar, vivifier, lay within the body of this dame A male germ with the noblest form for her in the tenth month to bear.
O Lord of Life, Prajāpati, within this woman’s body lay A male germ with the noblest form for her in the tenth month to bear.

verses.sanskrit:
यथे॒यं पृ॑थि॒वी म॒ही भू॒तानां॒ गर्भ॑माद॒धे ।
ए॒वा द॑धामि ते॒ गर्भं॒ तस्मै॒ त्वामव॑से हुवे ॥
verses.transliteration:
yatheyaṃ pṛthivī mahī bhūtānāṃ garbhamādadhe |
evā dadhāmi te garbhaṃ tasmai tvāmavase huve ||

verses.sanskrit:
गर्भं॑ धेहि सिनीवालि॒ गर्भं॒ धेहि सरस्वति ।
गर्भं॑ ते अ॒श्विनो॒भा ध॑त्तां॒ पुष्क॑रस्रजा ॥
verses.transliteration:
garbhaṃ dhehi sinīvāli garbhaṃ dhehi sarasvati |
garbhaṃ te aśvinobhā dhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā ||

verses.sanskrit:
गर्भं॑ ते मि॒त्रावरु॑णौ॒ गर्भं॑ दे॒वो बृह॒स्पतिः॑ ।
गर्भं॑ त॒ इन्द्र॑श्चा॒ग्निश्च॒ गर्भं॑ धा॒ता द॑धातु ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
garbhaṃ te mitrāvaruṇau garbhaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ |
garbhaṃ ta indraścāgniśca garbhaṃ dhātā dadhātu te ||

verses.sanskrit:
विष्णु॒र्योनिं॑ कल्पयतु॒ त्वष्टा॑ रू॒पाणि॑ पिंशतु ।
आ सि॑ञ्चतु प्र॒जाप॑तिर्धा॒ता गर्भं॑ दधातु ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
viṣṇuryoniṃ kalpayatu tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi piṃśatu |
ā siñcatu prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te ||

verses.sanskrit:
यद् वेद॒ राजा॒ वरु॑णो॒ यद् वा॑ दे॒वी सर॑स्वती ।
यदिन्द्रो॑ वृत्र॒हा वेद॒ तद् ग॑र्भ॒कर॑णं पिब ॥
verses.transliteration:
yad veda rājā varuṇo yad vā devī sarasvatī |
yadindro vṛtrahā veda tad garbhakaraṇaṃ piba ||

verses.sanskrit:
गर्भो॑ अ॒स्योष॑धीनां॒ गर्भो॒ वन॒स्पती॑नाम् ।
गर्भो॒ विश्व॑स्य भू॒तस्य॒ सो अ॑ग्ने॒ गर्भ॒मेह धाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
garbho asyoṣadhīnāṃ garbho vanaspatīnām |
garbho viśvasya bhūtasya so agne garbhameha dhāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अधि॑ स्कन्द वी॒रय॑स्व॒ गर्भ॒मा धे॑हि॒ योन्या॑म् ।
वृषा॑सि वृष्ण्यावन् प्र॒जायै॒ त्वा न॑यामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
adhi skanda vīrayasva garbhamā dhehi yonyām |
vṛṣāsi vṛṣṇyāvan prajāyai tvā nayāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
वि जि॑हीष्व बार्हत्सामे॒ गर्भ॑स्ते॒ योनि॒मा श॑याम् ।
अदु॑ष्टे दे॒वाः पु॒त्रं सो॑म॒पा उ॑भया॒विन॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vi jihīṣva bārhatsāme garbhaste yonimā śayām |
aduṣṭe devāḥ putraṃ somapā ubhayāvinam ||

verses.sanskrit:
धातः॒ श्रेष्ठे॑न रू॒पेणा॒स्या नार्या॑ गवी॒न्योः ।
पुमां॑सं पु॒त्रमा धे॑हि दश॒मे मा॒सि सूत॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhātaḥ śreṣṭhena rūpeṇāsyā nāryā gavīnyoḥ |
pumāṃsaṃ putramā dhehi daśame māsi sūtave ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्वष्टः॒ श्रेष्ठे॑न रू॒पेणा॒स्या नार्या॑ गवी॒न्योः ।
पुमां॑सं पु॒त्रमा धे॑हि दश॒मे मा॒सि सूत॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvaṣṭaḥ śreṣṭhena rūpeṇāsyā nāryā gavīnyoḥ |
pumāṃsaṃ putramā dhehi daśame māsi sūtave ||

verses.sanskrit:
सवि॑तः॒ श्रेष्ठे॑न रू॒पेणा॒स्या नार्या॑ गवी॒न्योः ।
पुमां॑सं पु॒त्रमा धे॑हि दश॒मे मा॒सि सूत॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration:
savitaḥ śreṣṭhena rūpeṇāsyā nāryā gavīnyoḥ |
pumāṃsaṃ putramā dhehi daśame māsi sūtave ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्रजा॑पते॒ श्रेष्ठे॑न रू॒पेणा॒स्या नार्या॑ गवी॒न्योः ।
पुमां॑सं पु॒त्रमा धे॑हि दश॒मे मा॒सि सूत॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration:
prajāpate śreṣṭhena rūpeṇāsyā nāryā gavīnyoḥ |
pumāṃsaṃ putramā dhehi daśame māsi sūtave ||
