अ॒मित्रा॒ येऽत्र॑ नः॒ सन्ति॒ तान॑ग्न॒ आ द्या॒ त्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
idamādānamakaraṃ tapasendreṇa saṃśitam |
amitrā ye'tra naḥ santi tānagna ā dyā tvam ||

verses.sanskrit:
ऐना॑न् द्यतामिन्द्रा॒ग्नी सोमो॑ राजा॑ च मे॒दिनौ॑ ।
इन्द्रो॑ म॒रुत्वा॑ना॒दान॑म॒मित्रे॑भ्यः कृणोतु नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ainān dyatāmindrāgnī somo rājā ca medinau |
indro marutvānādānamamitrebhyaḥ kṛṇotu naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॒ मनो॑ मनस्के॒तः॑ प॑रा॒पत॑त्याशु॒मत् ।
ए॒वा त्वं कासे॒ प्र प॑त॒ मन॒सोऽनु॑ प्रवा॒य्यऽम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā mano manasketaḥ parāpatatyāśumat |
evā tvaṃ kāse pra pata manaso'nu pravāyya'm ||
verses.translation:
A charm to cure cough
Rapidly as the fancy flies forth with conceptions of the mind.
So following the fancy’s flight, O Cough, flee rapidly away.
Rapidly as an arrow flies away with keenly-sharpened point,
So swiftly flee away, O Cough, over the region of the earth!
Rapidly as the beams of light, the rays of Sūrya, fly away,
So, Cough! fly rapidly away over the current of the sea!

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॒ बाणः॒ सुसं॑शितः परा॒पत॑त्याशु॒मत् ।
ए॒वा त्वं कासे॒ प्र प॑त पृथि॒व्या अनु॑ सं॒वत॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā bāṇaḥ susaṃśitaḥ parāpatatyāśumat |
evā tvaṃ kāse pra pata pṛthivyā anu saṃvatam ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॒ सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मयः॑ परा॒पत॑न्त्याशु॒मत् ।
ए॒वा त्वं कासे॒ प्र प॑त समु॒द्रस्यानु॑ विक्ष॒रम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā sūryasya raśmayaḥ parāpatantyāśumat |
evā tvaṃ kāse pra pata samudrasyānu vikṣaram ||

verses.sanskrit:
आय॑ने ते प॒राय॑णे दूर्वा॑ रोहतु पु॒ष्पिणीः॑ ।
उत्सो॑ वा॒ तत्र॒ जाय॑तां ह्रदो वा॑ पु॒ण्डरी॑कवान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
āyane te parāyaṇe dūrvā rohatu puṣpiṇīḥ |
utso vā tatra jāyatāṃ hrado vā puṇḍarīkavān ||
verses.translation:
A charm to protect a house from fire
Let flowery Dūrvā grass grow up about thine exit and approach.
There let a spring of water rise, or lake with blooming lotuses.
This is the place where waters meet, here is the gathering of the flood.
Our home is set amid the lake: turn thou thy jaws away from it.
O House, we compass thee about with coolness to envelop thee.
Cool as a lake be thou to us. Let Agni bring us healing balm!

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पामि॒दं न्यय॑नं समु॒द्रस्य॑ नि॒वेश॑नम् ।
मध्ये॑ ह्र॒दस्य॑ नो गृ॒हाः प॑रा॒चीना॒ मुखा॑ कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration:
apāmidaṃ nyayanaṃ samudrasya niveśanam |
madhye hradasya no gṛhāḥ parācīnā mukhā kṛdhi ||

verses.sanskrit:
हि॒मस्य॑ त्वा ज॒रायु॑णा॒ शाले॒ परि॑ व्ययामसि ।
शी॒तह्र॑दा॒ हि नो॒ भुवो॒ऽग्निष्कृ॑णोतु भेष॒जम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
himasya tvā jarāyuṇā śāle pari vyayāmasi |
śītahradā hi no bhuvo'gniṣkṛṇotu bheṣajam ||

verses.sanskrit:
विश्व॑जित् त्रायमा॒णायै॑ मा॒ परि॑ देहि ।
त्राय॑माणे द्वि॒पाच्च॒ सर्वं॑ नो॒ रक्ष॒ चतु॑ष्पा॒द् यच्च॑ नः॒ स्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvajit trāyamāṇāyai mā pari dehi |
trāyamāṇe dvipācca sarvaṃ no rakṣa catuṣpād yacca naḥ svam ||
verses.translation:
A charm to protect men and cattle
Entrust me, Visvajit, to Trāyamānā.
Guard, Trāyamānā, all our men, guard all our wealth of quadrupeds.
To Visvajit entrust me, Trāyamānā.
O Visvajit, guard all our men, etc.
To Visvajit entrust me, O Kalyāni.
Guard, O Kalyāni, all our men, etc. To Sarvavid entrust me, O Kalyāni.
O Sarvavid, guard all our men, guard all our wealth of quadrupeds.

verses.sanskrit:
त्राय॑माणे विश्व॒जिते॑ मा॒ परि॑ देहि ।
विश्व॑जिद् द्वि॒पाच्च॒ सर्वं॑ नो॒ रक्ष॒ चतु॑ष्पाद् यच्च॑ नः॒ स्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
trāyamāṇe viśvajite mā pari dehi |
viśvajid dvipācca sarvaṃ no rakṣa catuṣpād yacca naḥ svam ||

verses.sanskrit:
विश्व॑जित् कल्या॒ण्यैऽ मा॒ परि॑ देहि ।
कल्या॑णि द्वि॒पाच्च॒ सर्वं॑ नो॒ रक्ष॒ चतु॑ष्पाद् यच्च॑ नः॒ स्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvajit kalyāṇyai' mā pari dehi |
kalyāṇi dvipācca sarvaṃ no rakṣa catuṣpād yacca naḥ svam ||

verses.sanskrit:
कल्या॑णि सर्व॒विदे॑ मा॒ परि॑ देहि ।
सर्व॑विद् द्वि॒पाच्च॒ सर्वं॑ नो॒ रक्ष॒ चतु॑ष्पाद् यच्च॑ नः॒ स्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
kalyāṇi sarvavide mā pari dehi |
sarvavid dvipācca sarvaṃ no rakṣa catuṣpād yacca naḥ svam ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं नो॑ मेधे प्रथ॒मा गोभि॒रश्वे॑भि॒रा ग॑हि ।
त्वं सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिभि॒स्त्वं नो॑ असि य॒ज्ञिया॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvaṃ no medhe prathamā gobhiraśvebhirā gahi |
tvaṃ sūryasya raśmibhistvaṃ no asi yajñiyā ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for wisdom
Intelligence, come first to us with store of horses and of kine!
Thou with the rays of Sūrya art our worshipful and holy one.
The first, devout Intelligence, lauded by sages, sped by prayer,
Drunk by Brahmachāris, for the favour of the Gods I call.
That excellent Intelligence which Ribhus know, and Asuras,
Intelligence which sages know, we cause to enter into me.
Do thou, O Agni, make me wise this day with that Intelligence.
Which the creative ishis, which the men endowed with wisdom knew.
Intelligence at eve, at morn, Intelligence at noon of day,
With the Sun’s beams, and by our speech we plant in us Intelligence.

verses.sanskrit:
मे॒धाम॒हं प्र॑थ॒मां ब्रह्म॑ण्वतीं॒ ब्रह्म॑जूता॒मृषि॑ष्टुताम् ।
प्रपी॑तां ब्रह्मचा॒रिभि॑र्दे॒वाना॒मव॑से हुवे ॥
verses.transliteration:
medhāmahaṃ prathamāṃ brahmaṇvatīṃ brahmajūtāmṛṣiṣṭutām |
prapītāṃ brahmacāribhirdevānāmavase huve ||

verses.sanskrit:
यां मे॒धामृ॒भवो॑ वि॒दुर्यां मे॒धामसु॑रा वि॒दुः ।
ऋष॑यो भ॒द्रां मे॒धां यां वि॒दुस्तां मय्या वे॑शयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāṃ medhāmṛbhavo viduryāṃ medhāmasurā viduḥ |
ṛṣayo bhadrāṃ medhāṃ yāṃ vidustāṃ mayyā veśayāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
यामृष॑यो भूत॒कृतो॑ मे॒धां मे॑धा॒विनो॑ वि॒दुः ।
तया॒ माम॒द्य मे॒धयाग्ने॑ मेधा॒विनं॑ कृणु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāmṛṣayo bhūtakṛto medhāṃ medhāvino viduḥ |
tayā māmadya medhayāgne medhāvinaṃ kṛṇu ||

verses.sanskrit:
मे॒धां सा॒यं मे॒धां प्रा॒तर्मे॒धां म॒ध्यन्दि॑नं॒ परि॑ ।
मे॒धां सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिभि॒र्वच॒सा वे॑शयामहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
medhāṃ sāyaṃ medhāṃ prātarmedhāṃ madhyandinaṃ pari |
medhāṃ sūryasya raśmibhirvacasā veśayāmahe ||

verses.sanskrit:
पि॒प्प॒ली क्षि॑प्तभेष॒ज्यू॒३ताति॑विद्धभेष॒जी ।
तां दे॒वाः सम॑कल्पयन्नि॒यं जीवि॑त॒वा अल॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pippalī kṣiptabheṣajyūtātividdhabheṣajī |
tāṃ devāḥ samakalpayanniyaṃ jīvitavā alam ||
verses.translation:
A charm to heal punctured wounds
The Berry heals the missile’s rent, it heals the deeply-piercing wound.
The Gods prepared and fashioned it. This hath sufficient power for life.
When from their origin they came, the Berries spake among themselves:
The man whom we shall find alive shall never suffer injury. Asuras buried thee in earth: the Gods again uplifted thee.
Healer of sickness caused by wounds and healer of the missile’s rent.

verses.sanskrit:
पि॒प्प॒ल्यः॑१ सम॑वदन्ताय॒तीर्जन॑ना॒दधि॑ ।
यं जी॒वम॒श्नवा॑महै॒ न स रि॑ष्याति॒ पूरु॑षः ॥
verses.transliteration:
pippalyaḥ samavadantāyatīrjananādadhi |
yaṃ jīvamaśnavāmahai na sa riṣyāti pūruṣaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
असु॑रास्त्वा॒ न्यऽखनन् दे॒वास्त्वोद॑वप॒न् पुनः॑ ।
वा॒तीकृ॑तस्य भेष॒जीमथो॑ क्षि॒प्तस्य॑ भेष॒जीम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
asurāstvā nya'khanan devāstvodavapan punaḥ |
vātīkṛtasya bheṣajīmatho kṣiptasya bheṣajīm ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒त्नो हि कमीड्यो॑ अध्व॒रेषु॑ स॒नाच्च॒ होता॒ नव्य॑श्च सत्सि ।
स्वां चा॑ग्ने त॒न्वं पि॒प्राय॑स्वा॒स्मभ्यं॑ च॒ सौभ॑ग॒मा य॑जस्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
pratno hi kamīḍyo adhvareṣu sanācca hotā navyaśca satsi |
svāṃ cāgne tanvaṃ piprāyasvāsmabhyaṃ ca saubhagamā yajasva ||
verses.translation:
A benediction on a new-born child
Yea, ancient, meet for praise at sacrifices, ever and now thou sittest down as Hotar.
And now, O Agni, make thy person friendly, and win felicity for us by worship.
Neath Jyaishthaghni and Yama’s Two Releasers this child was born: preserve him from uprooting.
He shall conduct him safe past all misfortunes to lengthened life that lasts a hundred autumns.
Born on the Tiger’s day was he, a hero, the Constellations’ child, born brave and manly.
Let him not wound, when grown in strength, his father, nor disregard his mother, her who bare him.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ये॒ष्ठ॒घ्न्यं जा॒तो वि॒चृतो॑र्य॒मस्य॑ मूल॒बर्ह॑णा॒त् परि॑ पाह्येनम् ।
अत्ये॑नं नेषद् दुरि॒तानि॒ विश्वा॑ दीर्घायु॒त्वाय॑ श॒तशा॑रदाय ॥
verses.transliteration:
jyeṣṭhaghnyaṃ jāto vicṛtoryamasya mūlabarhaṇāt pari pāhyenam |
atyenaṃ neṣad duritāni viśvā dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya ||

verses.sanskrit:
व्या॒घ्रेऽह्न्य॑जनिष्ट वी॒रो न॑क्षत्र॒जा जाय॑मानः सु॒वीरः॑ ।
स मा व॑धीत् पि॒तरं॒ वर्ध॑मानो॒ मा मा॒तरं॒ प्र मि॑नी॒ज्जनि॑त्रीम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vyāghre'hnyajaniṣṭa vīro nakṣatrajā jāyamānaḥ suvīraḥ |
sa mā vadhīt pitaraṃ vardhamāno mā mātaraṃ pra minījjanitrīm ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मं मे॑ अग्ने॒ पुरु॑षं मुमुग्ध्य॒यं यो ब॒द्धः सुय॑तो॒ लाल॑पीति ।
अतोऽधि॑ ते कृणवद् भाग॒धेयं॑ य॒दानु॑न्मदि॒तोऽस॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
imaṃ me agne puruṣaṃ mumugdhyayaṃ yo baddhaḥ suyato lālapīti |
ato'dhi te kṛṇavad bhāgadheyaṃ yadānunmadito'sati ||
verses.translation:
A charm for insanity
Unbind and loose for me this man, O Agni, who bound and well restrained is chattering folly. Afterward he will offer thee thy portion when he hath been delivered from his madness.
Let Agni gently soothe thy mind when fierce excitement troubles it.
Well-skilled I make a medicine that thou no larger mayst be mad.
Insane through sin against the Gods, or maddened by a demon’s power—
Well-skilled I make a medicine to free thee from insanity.
May the Apsarases release, Indra and Bhaga let thee go.
May all the Gods deliver thee that thou no longer mayst be mad.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निष्टे॒ नि श॑मयतु॒ यदि॑ ते॒ मन॒ उद्यु॑तम् ।
कृ॒णोमि॑ वि॒द्वान् भे॑ष॒जं यदानु॑न्मदि॒तोऽस॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration:
agniṣṭe ni śamayatu yadi te mana udyutam |
kṛṇomi vidvān bheṣajaṃ yadānunmadito'sasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वै॒न॒सादुन्म॑दित॒मुन्म॑त्तं॒ रक्ष॑स॒स्परि॑ ।
कृ॒णोमि॑ वि॒द्वान् भे॑ष॒जं यदानु॑न्मदि॒तोऽस॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
devainasādunmaditamunmattaṃ rakṣasaspari |
kṛṇomi vidvān bheṣajaṃ yadānunmadito'sati ||

verses.sanskrit:
पुन॑स्त्वा दुरप्स॒रसः॒ पुन॒रिन्द्रः॒ पुन॒र्भगः॑ ।
पुन॑स्त्वा दु॒र्विश्वे॑ दे॒वा यथानु॑न्मदि॒तोऽस॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration:
punastvā durapsarasaḥ punarindraḥ punarbhagaḥ |
punastvā durviśve devā yathānunmadito'sasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
मा ज्ये॒ष्ठं व॑धीद॒यम॑ग्न ए॒षां मू॑ल॒बर्ह॑णा॒त् परि॑ पाह्येनम् ।
स ग्राह्याः॒ पाशा॒न् वि चृ॑त प्रजा॒नन् तुभ्यं॑ दे॒वा अनु॑ जानन्तु॒ विश्वे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
mā jyeṣṭhaṃ vadhīdayamagna eṣāṃ mūlabarhaṇāt pari pāhyenam |
sa grāhyāḥ pāśān vi cṛta prajānan tubhyaṃ devā anu jānantu viśve ||
verses.translation:
A health-charm for man, woman, and son
Let not this one, O Agni, wound the highest of these: preserve thou him from utter ruin.
Knowing the way do thou untie the nooses of the she-fiend: let all the Gods approve thee.
Rend thou the; bonds of these asunder, Agni! the, threefold noose whereby the three were fastened.
Knowing the way untie the she-fiend’s nooses: free all, the son, the father, and the mother.
The elder brother’s bonds, still left unwedded, fettered in every limb and bound securely,
Loose these, for they are bonds for loosing: Pūshan, turn woes away upon the babe-destroyer.

verses.sanskrit:
उन्मु॑ञ्च॒ पाशां॒स्त्वम॑ग्न ए॒षां त्रय॑स्त्रि॒भिरुत्सि॑ता॒ येभि॒रास॑न् ।
स ग्राह्याः॒ पाशा॒न् वि चृ॑त प्रजा॒नन् पि॑तापु॒त्रौ मा॒तरं॑ मुञ्च॒ सर्वा॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
unmuñca pāśāṃstvamagna eṣāṃ trayastribhirutsitā yebhirāsan |
sa grāhyāḥ pāśān vi cṛta prajānan pitāputrau mātaraṃ muñca sarvān ||

verses.sanskrit:
येभिः॒ पाशैः॒ परि॑वित्तो॒ विब॒द्धोऽङ्गे॑अङ्ग॒ आर्पि॑त॒ उत्सि॑तश्च ।
वि ते मु॑च्यन्तं वि॒मुचो॒ हि सन्ति॑ भ्रूण॒घ्नि पू॑षन् दुरि॒तानि॑ मृक्ष्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
yebhiḥ pāśaiḥ parivitto vibaddho'ṅgeaṅga ārpita utsitaśca |
vi te mucyantaṃ vimuco hi santi bhrūṇaghni pūṣan duritāni mṛkṣva ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्रि॒ते दे॒वा अ॑मृजतै॒तदेन॑स्त्रि॒त ए॑नन्मनु॒ष्येऽषु ममृजे ।
ततो॒ यदि॑ त्वा॒ ग्राहि॑रान॒शे तां ते॑ दे॒वा ब्रह्म॑णा नाशयन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
trite devā amṛjataitadenastrita enanmanuṣye'ṣu mamṛje |
tato yadi tvā grāhirānaśe tāṃ te devā brahmaṇā nāśayantu ||
verses.translation:
A charm to banish the fiend Grāhi
This sin the Gods wiped off and laid on Trita, and Trita wiped it off on human beings.
Thence if the female fiend hath made thee captive, the Gods by prayer shall banish her and free thee.
Enter the particles of light and vapours, go to the rising fogs or mists, O Evil!
Hence! vanish in the foams of rivers. Pūshan, wipe woes away upon the babe-destroyer!
Stored in twelve separate places lies what Trita hath wiped away, the sins of human beings.
Thence if the female fiend hath made thee captive, the Gods by prayer shall banish her and free thee.

verses.sanskrit:
मरी॑चीर्धू॒मान् प्र वि॒शानु॑ पाप्मन्नुदा॒रान् गच्छो॒त वा॑ नीहा॒रान् ।
न॒दीनां॒ फेनाँ॒ अनु॒ तान् वि न॑श्य भ्रूण॒घ्नि पू॑षन् दुरि॒तानि॑ मृक्ष्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
marīcīrdhūmān pra viśānu pāpmannudārān gacchota vā nīhārān |
nadīnāṃ phenām̐ anu tān vi naśya bhrūṇaghni pūṣan duritāni mṛkṣva ||

verses.sanskrit:
द्वा॒द॒श॒धा निहि॑तं त्रि॒तस्याप॑मृष्टं मनुष्यैन॒सानि॑ ।
ततो॒ यदि॑ त्वा॒ ग्राहि॑रान॒शे तां ते॑ दे॒वा ब्रह्म॑णा नाशयन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
dvādaśadhā nihitaṃ tritasyāpamṛṣṭaṃ manuṣyainasāni |
tato yadi tvā grāhirānaśe tāṃ te devā brahmaṇā nāśayantu ||

verses.sanskrit:
यद् दे॑वा देव॒हेड॑नं॒ देवा॑सश्चकृ॒मा व॒यम् ।
आदि॑त्या॒स्तस्मा॑न्नो यू॒यमृ॒तस्य॒र्तेन॑ मुञ्चत ॥
verses.transliteration:
yad devā devaheḍanaṃ devāsaścakṛmā vayam |
ādityāstasmānno yūyamṛtasyartena muñcata ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for pardon of faults and errors in sacrificing
Whatever God-provoking wrong we priests have done, O Deities.
Therefrom do ye deliver us, Ādityas! by the right of Law.
Here set us free, O holy ones, Ādityas, by the right of Law.
When striving, bringing sacrifice, we failed to offer it aright.
With ladle full of fatness we, worshippers, pouring holy oil,
Striving, have failed, O all ye Gods, against our will, to offer it.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒तस्य॒र्ते॑ना॑दित्या॒ यज॑त्रा मु॒ञ्चते॒ह नः॑ ।
य॒ज्ञं यद् य॑ज्ञवाहसः॒ शिक्ष॑न्तो॒ नोप॑शेकि॒म ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛtasyartenādityā yajatrā muñcateha naḥ |
yajñaṃ yad yajñavāhasaḥ śikṣanto nopaśekima ||

verses.sanskrit:
मेद॑स्वता॒ यज॑मानाः स्रु॒चाज्या॑नि॒ जुह्व॑तः ।
अ॒का॒मा वि॑श्वे वो देवाः॒ शिक्ष॑न्तो॒ नोप॑ शेकि॒म ॥
verses.transliteration:
medasvatā yajamānāḥ srucājyāni juhvataḥ |
akāmā viśve vo devāḥ śikṣanto nopa śekima ||

verses.sanskrit:
यद् वि॒द्वांसो॒ यदवि॑द्वांस॒ एनां॑सि चकृ॒मा व॒यम् ।
यू॒यं न॒स्तस्मा॑न्मुञ्चत॒ विश्वे॑ देवाः सजोषसः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yad vidvāṃso yadavidvāṃsa enāṃsi cakṛmā vayam |
yūyaṃ nastasmānmuñcata viśve devāḥ sajoṣasaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for forgiveness of sins
Whatever wrong we wittingly or in our ignorance have done,
Do ye deliver us therefrom, O all ye Gods, of one accord.
If I, a sinner, when awake or sleeping have committed sin,
Free me therefrom as from a stake, from present and from future guilt.
As one unfastened from a stake, or cleansed by bathing after toil,
As butter which the sieve hath cleansed, so all shall purge me from the sin.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि॒ जाग्र॒द् यदि॒ स्वप॒न्नेन॑ एन॒स्योऽक॑रम् ।
भू॒तं मा॒ तस्मा॒द् भव्यं॑ च द्रुप॒दादि॑व मुञ्चताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadi jāgrad yadi svapannena enasyo'karam |
bhūtaṃ mā tasmād bhavyaṃ ca drupadādiva muñcatām ||

verses.sanskrit:
द्रु॒प॒दादि॑व मुमुचा॒नः स्वि॒न्नः स्ना॒त्वा मला॑दिव ।
पू॒तं प॒वित्रे॑णे॒वाज्यं॒ विश्वे॑ शुम्भन्तु॒ मैन॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
drupadādiva mumucānaḥ svinnaḥ snātvā malādiva |
pūtaṃ pavitreṇevājyaṃ viśve śumbhantu mainasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यद् या॒मं च॒क्रुर्नि॒खन॑न्तो॒ अग्रे॒ कार्षी॑वणा अन्न॒विदो॒ न वि॒द्यया॑ ।
वै॒व॒स्व॒ते राज॑नि॒ तज्जु॑हो॒म्यथ॑ य॒ज्ञियं॒ मधु॑मदस्तु॒ नोऽन्न॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yad yāmaṃ cakrurnikhananto agre kārṣīvaṇā annavido na vidyayā |
vaivasvate rājani tajjuhomyatha yajñiyaṃ madhumadastu no'nnam ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for pardon of sin against mother, father, son, or brother
The wealth which husbandmen aforetime, digging, like men who find their food with knowledge, buried,
This to the King, Vivasvān’s son, I offer, Sweet be our food and fit for sacrificing!
May he, Vaivasvata, prepare our portion; May he whose share is mead with mead besprinkle.
Our sin in hasty mood against our mother, or guilt whereby a sire is wronged and angered.
Whether this sin into our heart hath entered regarding mother, father, son or brother,
Auspicious be to us the zeal and spirit of all the fathers who are here among us.

verses.sanskrit:
वै॒व॒स्व॒तः कृ॑णवद् भाग॒धेयं॒ मधु॑भागो॒ मधु॑ना॒ सं सृ॑जाति ।
मा॒तुर्यदेन॑ इषि॒तं न॒ आग॒न् यद् वा॑ पि॒ताप॑राद्धो जिही॒डे ॥
verses.transliteration:
vaivasvataḥ kṛṇavad bhāgadheyaṃ madhubhāgo madhunā saṃ sṛjāti |
māturyadena iṣitaṃ na āgan yad vā pitāparāddho jihīḍe ||

verses.sanskrit:
यदी॒दं मा॒तुर्यदि॑ पि॒तुर्नः॒ परि॒ भ्रातुः॑ पु॒त्राच्चेत॑स॒ एन॒ आग॑न् ।
याव॑न्तो अ॒स्मान् पि॒तरः॒ सच॑न्ते॒ तेषां॒ सर्वे॑षां शि॒वो अ॑स्तु म॒न्युः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadīdaṃ māturyadi piturnaḥ pari bhrātuḥ putrāccetasa ena āgan |
yāvanto asmān pitaraḥ sacante teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ śivo astu manyuḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒प॒मित्य॒मप्र॑तीत्तं॒ यदस्मि॑ य॒मस्य॒ येन॑ ब॒लिना॒ चरा॑मि ।
इ॒दं तद॑ग्ने अनृ॒णो भ॑वामि॒ त्वं पाशा॑न् वि॒चृतं॑ वेत्थ॒ सर्वा॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
apamityamapratīttaṃ yadasmi yamasya yena balinā carāmi |
idaṃ tadagne anṛṇo bhavāmi tvaṃ pāśān vicṛtaṃ vettha sarvān ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for freedom from debt
That which I eat, a debt which still is owing, the tribute due to Yama, which supports me, Thereby may I be free from debt, O Agni. Thou knowest how to rend all bonds asunder.
Still dwelling here we give again this present; we send it forth, the living from the living.
Throwing away the grain whence I have eaten, thereby shall I be free from debt, O Agni.
May we be free in this world and that yonder, in the third world may we be unindebted.
May we, debt-free, abide in all the pathways, in all the worlds which Gods and Fathers visit.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒हैव सन्तः॒ प्रति॑ दद्म एनज्जी॒वा जी॒वेभ्यो॒ नि ह॑राम एनत् ।
अ॒प॒मित्य॑ धा॒न्यं॑१ यज्ज॒घसा॒हमि॒दं तद॑ग्ने अनृ॒णो भ॑वामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ihaiva santaḥ prati dadma enajjīvā jīvebhyo ni harāma enat |
apamitya dhānyaṃ yajjaghasāhamidaṃ tadagne anṛṇo bhavāmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒नृ॒णा अ॒स्मिन्न॑नृ॒णाः पर॑स्मिन् तृ॒तीये॑ लो॒के अ॑नृ॒णाः स्या॑म ।
ये दे॑व॒यानाः॑ पितृ॒याणा॑श्च लो॒काः सर्वा॑न् प॒थो अ॑नृ॒णा आ क्षि॑येम ॥
verses.transliteration:
anṛṇā asminnanṛṇāḥ parasmin tṛtīye loke anṛṇāḥ syāma |
ye devayānāḥ pitṛyāṇāśca lokāḥ sarvān patho anṛṇā ā kṣiyema ||

verses.sanskrit:
यद्धस्ता॑भ्यां चकृ॒म किल्बि॑षाण्य॒क्षानां॑ ग॒त्नुमु॑प॒लिप्स॑मानाः ।
उ॒ग्रं॒प॒श्ये उ॑ग्र॒जितौ॒ तद॒द्याप्स॒रसा॒वनु॑ दत्तामृ॒णं नः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaddhastābhyāṃ cakṛma kilbiṣāṇyakṣānāṃ gatnumupalipsamānāḥ |
ugraṃpaśye ugrajitau tadadyāpsarasāvanu dattāmṛṇaṃ naḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for pardon of cheating at play
If we have sinned with both our hands, desiring to take the host of dice for our possession,
May both Apsarases to-day forgive us that debt, the fiercely-conquering, fiercely-looking.
Stern viewers of their sins who rule the people, forgive us what hash happened as we gambled.
Not urging us to pay the debt we owed him, he with a cord hath gone to Yama’s kingdom.
My creditor, the man whose wife I visit, he, Gods! whom I approach with supplication,
Let not these men dominate me in speaking. Mind this, ye two Apsarases, Gods’ Consorts!

verses.sanskrit:
उग्रं॑पश्ये॒ राष्ट्र॑भृ॒त् किल्बि॑षाणि॒ यद॒क्षवृ॑त्त॒मनु॑ दत्तं न ए॒तत् ।
ऋ॒णान्नो॒ नर्णमेर्त्स॑मानो य॒मस्य॑ लो॒के अधि॑रज्जु॒रा॑यत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ugraṃpaśye rāṣṭrabhṛt kilbiṣāṇi yadakṣavṛttamanu dattaṃ na etat |
ṛṇānno narṇamertsamāno yamasya loke adhirajjurāyat ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मा॑ ऋ॒णं यस्य॑ जा॒यामु॒पैमि॒ यं याच॑मानो अ॒भ्यैमि॑ देवाः ।
ते वाचं॑ वादिषु॒र्मोत्त॑रां॒ मद्देव॑पत्नी॒ अप्स॑रसा॒वधी॑तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasmā ṛṇaṃ yasya jāyāmupaimi yaṃ yācamāno abhyaimi devāḥ |
te vācaṃ vādiṣurmottarāṃ maddevapatnī apsarasāvadhītam ||

verses.sanskrit:
यददी॑व्यन्नृ॒णम॒हं कृ॒णोम्यदा॑स्यन्नग्न उ॒त सं॑गृ॒णामि॑ ।
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रो नो॑ अधि॒पा वसि॑ष्ठ॒ उदिन्न॑याति सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadadīvyannṛṇamahaṃ kṛṇomyadāsyannagna uta saṃgṛṇāmi |
vaiśvānaro no adhipā vasiṣṭha udinnayāti sukṛtasya lokam ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for release from debts incurred without intention of payment
The debt which I incur, not gaming, Agni! and, not intending to repay, acknowledge, That may Vaisvānara, the best, our sovran, carry away into the world of virtue.
I cause Vaisvānara to know, confessing the debt whose payment to the Gods is promised.
He knows to tear asunder all these nooses: so may we dwell with him the gentle-minded.
Vaisvānara the Purifier purge me when I oppose their hope and break my promise,
Unknowing in my heart. With supplication, whatever guilt there is in that, I banish.

verses.sanskrit:
वै॒श्वा॒न॒राय॒ प्रति॑ वेदयामि॒ यद्यृ॒णं सं॑ग॒रो दे॒वता॑सु ।
स ए॒तान् पाशा॑न् वि॒चृतं॑ वेद॒ सर्वा॒नथ॑ प॒क्वेन॑ स॒ह सं भ॑वेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
vaiśvānarāya prati vedayāmi yadyṛṇaṃ saṃgaro devatāsu |
sa etān pāśān vicṛtaṃ veda sarvānatha pakvena saha saṃ bhavema ||

verses.sanskrit:
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रः प॑वि॒ता मा॑ पुनातु॒ यत् सं॑ग॒रम॑भि॒धावा॑म्या॒शाम् ।
अना॑जान॒न् मन॑सा॒ याच॑मानो॒ यत् तत्रैनो॒ अप॒ तत् सु॑वामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
vaiśvānaraḥ pavitā mā punātu yat saṃgaramabhidhāvāmyāśām |
anājānan manasā yācamāno yat tatraino apa tat suvāmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
यद॒न्तरि॑क्षं पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्यां यन्मा॒तरं॑ पि॒तरं॑ वा जिहिंसि॒म ।
अ॒यं तस्मा॒द् गार्ह॑पत्यो नो अ॒ग्निरुदिन्न॑याति सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadantarikṣaṃ pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ yanmātaraṃ pitaraṃ vā jihiṃsima |
ayaṃ tasmād gārhapatyo no agnirudinnayāti sukṛtasya lokam ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for pardon of sins and felicity hereafter
If we have injured Air, or Earth, or Heaven, if we have wronged our Mother or our Father,
May Agni Gārhapatya here absolve us, and bear us up into the world of virtue.
Earth is our Mother, Aditi our birth-place: our brother Air save us from imprecation!
Dyaus, Father, save us, from the world of Fathers! My world not lost, may I approach my kindred.
There where our virtuous friends, who left behind them their bodily infirmities, are happy,
Free from distortion of the limbs and lameness, may we behold, in heaven, our sons and parents.

verses.sanskrit:
भूमि॑र्मा॒तादि॑तिर्नो ज॒नित्रं॒ भ्राता॒न्तरि॑क्षम॒भिश॑स्त्या नः ।
द्यौर्नः॑ पि॒ता पित्र्या॒च्छं भ॑वाति जा॒मिमृ॒त्वा माव॑ पत्सि लो॒कात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhūmirmātāditirno janitraṃ bhrātāntarikṣamabhiśastyā naḥ |
dyaurnaḥ pitā pitryācchaṃ bhavāti jāmimṛtvā māva patsi lokāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
यत्रा॑ सु॒हार्दः॑ सु॒कृतो॒ मद॑न्ति वि॒हाय॒ रोगं॑ त॒न्वः॑१ स्वायाः॑ ।
अश्लो॑णा॒ अङ्गै॒रह्रु॑ताः स्व॒र्गे तत्र॑ पश्येम पि॒तरौ॑ च पु॒त्रान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yatrā suhārdaḥ sukṛto madanti vihāya rogaṃ tanvaḥ svāyāḥ |
aśloṇā aṅgairahrutāḥ svarge tatra paśyema pitarau ca putrān ||

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒षाणा॒ पाशा॒न् वि ष्याध्य॒स्मद् य उ॑त्त॒मा अ॑ध॒मा वा॑रु॒णा ये ।
दु॒ष्वप्न्यं॑ दुरि॒तं नि ष्वा॒स्मदथ॑ गच्छेम सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
viṣāṇā pāśān vi ṣyādhyasmad ya uttamā adhamā vāruṇā ye |
duṣvapnyaṃ duritaṃ ni ṣvāsmadatha gacchema sukṛtasya lokam ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for happiness in heaven
Spreading them out, untie the snares that hold us, Varuna’s bonds, the upper and the lower.
Drive from us evil dream, drive off misfortune; then let us go in-to the world of virtue.
If thou art bound with cord or tied to timber, fixt in the earth, or by a word imprisoned,
Our Agni Gārhapatya here shall free thee, and lead thee up into the world of virtue.
The two auspicious stars whose name is called Releasers have gone up.
Send Amrit hither, let it come freeing the captive from his bonds!
Open thyself, make room: from bonds thou shalt release the prisoner.
Freed, like an infant newly born, dwell in all pathways where thou wilt.

verses.sanskrit:
यद् दारु॑णि ब॒ध्यसे॒ यच्च॒ रज्ज्वां॒ यद् भूम्यां॑ ब॒ध्यसे॒ यच्च॑ वा॒चा ।
अ॒यं तस्मा॒द् गार्ह॑पत्यो नो अ॒ग्निरुदिन्न॑याति सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yad dāruṇi badhyase yacca rajjvāṃ yad bhūmyāṃ badhyase yacca vācā |
ayaṃ tasmād gārhapatyo no agnirudinnayāti sukṛtasya lokam ||

verses.sanskrit:
उद॑गातां॒ भग॑वती वि॒चृतौ॒ नाम॒ तार॑के ।
प्रेहामृत॑स्य यच्छतां॒ प्रैतु॑ बद्धक॒मोच॑नम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
udagātāṃ bhagavatī vicṛtau nāma tārake |
prehāmṛtasya yacchatāṃ praitu baddhakamocanam ||

verses.sanskrit:
वि जि॑हीष्व लो॒कं कृ॑णु ब॒न्धान्मु॑ञ्चासि॒ बद्ध॑कम् ।
योन्या॑ इव॒ प्रच्यु॑तो॒ गर्भः॑ प॒थः सर्वां॒ अनु॑ क्षिय ॥
verses.transliteration:
vi jihīṣva lokaṃ kṛṇu bandhānmuñcāsi baddhakam |
yonyā iva pracyuto garbhaḥ pathaḥ sarvāṃ anu kṣiya ||

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒तं भा॒गं परि॑ ददामि वि॒द्वान् विश्व॑कर्मन् प्रथम॒जा ऋ॒तस्य॑ ।
अ॒स्माभि॑र्द॒त्तं ज॒रसः॑ प॒रस्ता॒दच्छि॑न्नं॒ तन्तु॒मनु॒ सं त॑रेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
etaṃ bhāgaṃ pari dadāmi vidvān viśvakarman prathamajā ṛtasya |
asmābhirdattaṃ jarasaḥ parastādacchinnaṃ tantumanu saṃ tarema ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for happiness in heaven
This portion I who understand deliver to Visvakarman first-born son of Order.
So may we follow to the end, unbroken, beyond old age, the thread which we have given.
This long-drawn thread some follow who have offered in order-ed course oblation to the Fathers:
Some, offering and giving to the friendless, if they can give: herein they find their heaven.
3, Stand on my side and range yourselves in order, ye two! The faithful reach this world of Svarga. When your dressed food hath been bestowed on Agni, to guard it, wife and husband, come together!
Dwelling with zeal I mount in spirit after the lofty sacrifice as it departeth.
Agni, may we, beyond decay, invited, in the third heaven, feast and enjoy the banquet.
These women here, cleansed, purified, and holy, I place at rest singly, in hands of Brāhmans.
May Indra, Marut-girt, grant me the blessing I long for as I pour you this libation.

verses.sanskrit:
त॒तं तन्तु॒मन्वेके॑ तरन्ति॒ येषां॑ द॒त्तं पित्र्य॒माय॑नेन ।
अ॒ब॒न्ध्वेके॒ दद॑तः प्र॒यच्छ॑न्तो॒ दातुं॒ चेच्छिक्षा॒न्त्स स्व॒र्ग ए॒व ॥
verses.transliteration:
tataṃ tantumanveke taranti yeṣāṃ dattaṃ pitryamāyanena |
abandhveke dadataḥ prayacchanto dātuṃ cecchikṣāntsa svarga eva ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न्वार॑भेथामनु॒संर॑भेथामे॒तं लो॒कं श्र॒द्दधा॑नाः सचन्ते ।
यद् वां॑ प॒क्वं परि॑विष्टम॒ग्नौ तस्य॒ गुप्त॑ये दम्पती॒ सं श्र॑येथाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
anvārabhethāmanusaṃrabhethāmetaṃ lokaṃ śraddadhānāḥ sacante |
yad vāṃ pakvaṃ pariviṣṭamagnau tasya guptaye dampatī saṃ śrayethām ||

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञं यन्तं॒ मन॑सा बृ॒हन्त॑म॒न्वारो॑हामि॒ तप॑सा॒ सयो॑निः ।
उप॑हूता अग्ने ज॒रसः॑ प॒रस्ता॑त् तृ॒तीये॒ नाके॑ सध॒मादं॑ मदेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
yajñaṃ yantaṃ manasā bṛhantamanvārohāmi tapasā sayoniḥ |
upahūtā agne jarasaḥ parastāt tṛtīye nāke sadhamādaṃ madema ||

verses.sanskrit:
शु॒द्धाः पू॒ता यो॒षितो॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑ इ॒मा ब्र॒ह्मणां॒ हस्ते॑षु प्रपृ॒थक् सा॑दयामि ।
यत्का॑म इ॒दम॑भिषि॒ञ्चामि॑ वो॒ऽहमिन्द्रो॑ म॒रुत्वा॒न्त्स ददातु॒ तन्मे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
śuddhāḥ pūtā yoṣito yajñiyā imā brahmaṇāṃ hasteṣu prapṛthak sādayāmi |
yatkāma idamabhiṣiñcāmi vo'hamindro marutvāntsa dadātu tanme ||

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒तं स॑धस्थाः॒ परि॑ वो ददामि॒ यं शे॑व॒धिमा॒वहा॑ज्जा॒तवे॑दाः ।
अ॒न्वा॒ग॒न्ता यज॑मानः स्व॒स्ति तं स्म॑ जानीत पर॒मे व्योऽमन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
etaṃ sadhasthāḥ pari vo dadāmi yaṃ śevadhimāvahājjātavedāḥ |
anvāgantā yajamānaḥ svasti taṃ sma jānīta parame vyo'man ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for happiness in heaven
Ye who are present, unto you I offer this treasure brought to us by Jātavedas Happily will the sacrificer follow: do ye acknowledge him in highest heaven.
Do ye acknowledge him in highest heaven: ye know the world here present in assembly.
In peace will he who sacrifices follow: show him the joy which comes from pious actions.
Gods are the Fathers, and the Fathers Gods. I am the very man I am.
I cook, I give, I offer up oblation. From what I gave let me not be disparted.
O King, take thou thy stand in heaven, there also let that gift be placed. Recognize, King, the gift which we have given, and be gracious,
God!

verses.sanskrit:
जा॒नी॒त स्मै॑नं पर॒मे व्योऽम॒न् देवाः॒ सध॑स्था वि॒द लो॒कमत्र॑ ।
अ॒न्वा॒ग॒न्ता यज॑मानः स्व॒स्तीऽष्टापू॒र्तं स्म॑ कृणुता॒विर॑स्मै ॥
verses.transliteration:
jānīta smainaṃ parame vyo'man devāḥ sadhasthā vida lokamatra |
anvāgantā yajamānaḥ svastī'ṣṭāpūrtaṃ sma kṛṇutāvirasmai ||

verses.sanskrit:
देवाः॒ पित॑रः॒ पित॑रो॒ देवाः॑ ।
यो अस्मि॒ सो अ॑स्मि ॥
verses.transliteration:
devāḥ pitaraḥ pitaro devāḥ |
yo asmi so asmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
स प॑चामि॒ स द॑दामि॒ ।
स य॑जे॒ स द॒त्तान्मा यू॑षम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa pacāmi sa dadāmi |
sa yaje sa dattānmā yūṣam ||

verses.sanskrit:
नाके॑ राज॑न् प्रति॑ तिष्ठ॒ तत्रै॒तत् प्रति॑ तिष्ठतु ।
वि॒द्धि पू॒र्तस्य॑ नो राज॒न्त्स दे॑व सु॒मना॑ भव ॥
verses.transliteration:
nāke rājan prati tiṣṭha tatraitat prati tiṣṭhatu |
viddhi pūrtasya no rājantsa deva sumanā bhava ||

verses.sanskrit:
दि॒वो नु मां बृ॑ह॒तो अ॒न्तरि॑क्षाद॒पां स्तो॒को अ॒भ्यऽपप्तद् रसे॑न ।
समि॑न्द्रि॒येण॒ पय॑सा॒हम॑ग्ने॒ छन्दो॑भिर्य॒ज्ञैः सु॒कृतां॑ कृ॒तेन॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
divo nu māṃ bṛhato antarikṣādapāṃ stoko abhya'paptad rasena |
samindriyeṇa payasāhamagne chandobhiryajñaiḥ sukṛtāṃ kṛtena ||
verses.translation:
An Omen from the sky
From the high firmament, yea, out of heaven a water-drop with dew on me hath fallen.
I, Agni! share the merit of the pious, with vigour, milk, and hymns and sacrifices.
If from a tree that fruit hath fallen downward if, aught from air that is vāyu.
Where it hath touched my body or my garment, thence may the Waters drive Destruction backward.
It is a fragrant ointment, happy fortune, sheen all of gold, yea, purified from blemish.
Spread over us are all purifications. Death and Malignity shall not subdue us.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि॑ वृ॒क्षाद॒भ्यप॑प्त॒त् फलं॒ तद् यद्य॒न्तरि॑क्षा॒त् स उ॑ वा॒युरे॒व ।
यत्रास्पृ॑क्षत् त॒न्वो॒३यच्च॒ वास॑स॒ आपो॑ नुदन्तु॒ निरृ॑तिं परा॒चैः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadi vṛkṣādabhyapaptat phalaṃ tad yadyantarikṣāt sa u vāyureva |
yatrāspṛkṣat tanvoyacca vāsasa āpo nudantu nirṛtiṃ parācaiḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भ्यञ्ज॑नं सुर॒भि सा समृ॑द्धि॒र्हिर॑ण्यं॒ वर्च॒स्तदु॑ पू॒त्रिम॑मे॒व ।
सर्वा॑ प॒वित्रा॒ वित॒ताध्य॒स्मत् तन्मा ता॑री॒न्निरृ॑ति॒र्मो अरा॑तिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhyañjanaṃ surabhi sā samṛddhirhiraṇyaṃ varcastadu pūtrimameva |
sarvā pavitrā vitatādhyasmat tanmā tārīnnirṛtirmo arātiḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
वन॑स्पते वी॒ड्वऽङ्गो॒ हि भू॒या अ॒स्मत्स॑खा प्र॒तर॑णः सु॒वीरः॑ ।
गोभिः॒ संन॑द्धो असि वी॒डय॑स्वास्था॒ता ते॑ जयतु॒ जेत्वा॑नि ॥
verses.transliteration:
vanaspate vīḍva'ṅgo hi bhūyā asmatsakhā prataraṇaḥ suvīraḥ |
gobhiḥ saṃnaddho asi vīḍayasvāsthātā te jayatu jetvāni ||
verses.translation:
Glorification of a war-chariot
Mayst thou, O Tree, be firm indeed in body, our friend that furthers us, a goodly hero.
Put forth thy strength, compact with thongs of leather, and let thy rider win all spoils of battle.
Its mighty strength was borrowed from the heaven and earth: its conquering force was brought from sovrans of the wood.
Honour with sacrifice the Car like Indra’s bolt, the Car girt round with straps, the vigour of the floods.
Thou bolt of Indra, vanguard of the Maruts, close knit to Varuna and child of Mitra,
As such, accepting gifts which here we offer, receive, O godlike Chariot, these oblations.

verses.sanskrit:
दि॒वस्पृ॑थि॒व्याः पर्योज॒ उद्भृ॑तं॒ वन॒स्पति॑भ्यः॒ पर्याभृ॑तं॒ सहः॑ ।
अ॒पामो॒ज्मानं॒ परि॒ गोभि॒रावृ॑त॒मिन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्रं॑ ह॒विषा॒ रथं॑ यज ॥
verses.transliteration:
divaspṛthivyāḥ paryoja udbhṛtaṃ vanaspatibhyaḥ paryābhṛtaṃ sahaḥ |
apāmojmānaṃ pari gobhirāvṛtamindrasya vajraṃ haviṣā rathaṃ yaja ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॒स्यौजो॑ म॒रुता॒मनी॑कं मि॒त्रस्य॒ गर्भो॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ नाभिः॑ ।
स इ॒मां नो॑ ह॒व्यदा॑तिं जुषा॒णो देव॑ रथ॒ प्रति॑ ह॒व्या गृभाय ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrasyaujo marutāmanīkaṃ mitrasya garbho varuṇasya nābhiḥ |
sa imāṃ no havyadātiṃ juṣāṇo deva ratha prati havyā gṛbhāya ||

verses.sanskrit:
उप॑ श्वासय पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्यां पु॑रु॒त्रा ते॑ वन्वतां॒ विष्ठि॑तं जग॑त् ।
स दु॑न्दुभे स॒जूरिन्द्रे॑ण दे॒वैर्दू॒राद् दवी॑यो॒ अप॑ सेध॒ शत्रू॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
upa śvāsaya pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ purutrā te vanvatāṃ viṣṭhitaṃ jagat |
sa dundubhe sajūrindreṇa devairdūrād davīyo apa sedha śatrūn ||
verses.translation:
Glorification of the war drum
Send forth thy voice aloud through earth and heaven, and let the world in all its breadth regard thee.
O Drum, accordant with the Gods and Indra, drive thou afar, yea, very far, our foemen.
Thunder out strength and fill us full of vigour, yea, thunder forth and drive away misfortunes.
Drive hence, O Drum, drive thou away mischances. Thou art the fist of Indra, show thy firmness.
Conquer those yonder and let these be victors. Let the Drum speak aloud as battle’s signal.
Let our men, winged with horses, fly together. Let our car-warriors, Indra! be triumphant.

verses.sanskrit:
आ क्र॑न्दय॒ बल॒मोजो॑ न॒ आ धा॑ अ॒भि ष्ट॑न दुरि॒ता बाध॑मानः ।
अप॑ सेध दुन्दुभे दु॒च्छुना॑मि॒त इन्द्र॑स्य मु॒ष्टिर॑सि वी॒डय॑स्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā krandaya balamojo na ā dhā abhi ṣṭana duritā bādhamānaḥ |
apa sedha dundubhe ducchunāmita indrasya muṣṭirasi vīḍayasva ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्रामूं ज॑या॒भी॒३मे ज॑यन्तु केतु॒मद् दु॑न्दुभिर्वा॑वदीतु ।
समश्व॑पर्णाः पतन्तु नो॒ नरो॒ऽस्माक॑मिन्द्र र॒थिनो॑ जयन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
prāmūṃ jayābhīme jayantu ketumad dundubhirvāvadītu |
samaśvaparṇāḥ patantu no naro'smākamindra rathino jayantu ||

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒द्र॒धस्य॑ ब॒लास॑स्य॒ लोहि॑तस्य वनस्पते ।
वि॒सल्प॑कस्योषधे॒ मोच्छि॑षः पिशि॒तं च॒न ॥
verses.transliteration:
vidradhasya balāsasya lohitasya vanaspate |
visalpakasyoṣadhe mocchiṣaḥ piśitaṃ cana ||
verses.translation:
A charm to banish various diseases
Of abscess, of decline, of inflammation of the eyes. O Plant,
Of penetrating pain, thou Herb, let not a particle remain.
Those nerves of thine, Consumption! which stand closely hidden in thy groin I know the balm for that disease: the magic cure is Sipudru.
We draw from thee piercing pain that penetrates and racks thy limbs,
That pierces ears, that pierces eyes, the abscess, and the heart’s disease.
Downward and far away from thee we banish that unknown. decline.

verses.sanskrit:
यौ ते॑ बलास॒ तिष्ठ॑तः॒ कक्षे॑ मु॒ष्कावप॑श्रितौ ।
वेदा॒हं तस्य॑ भेष॒जं ची॒पुद्रु॑रभि॒चक्ष॑णम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yau te balāsa tiṣṭhataḥ kakṣe muṣkāvapaśritau |
vedāhaṃ tasya bheṣajaṃ cīpudrurabhicakṣaṇam ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो अङ्ग्यो॒ यः कर्ण्यो॒ यो अ॒क्ष्योर्वि॒सल्प॑कः ।
वि वृ॑हामो वि॒सल्प॑कं विद्र॒धं हृ॑दयाम॒यम् ।
परा॒ तमज्ञा॑तं॒ यक्ष्म॑मध॒राञ्चं॑ सुवामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo aṅgyo yaḥ karṇyo yo akṣyorvisalpakaḥ |
vi vṛhāmo visalpakaṃ vidradhaṃ hṛdayāmayam |
parā tamajñātaṃ yakṣmamadharāñcaṃ suvāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
श॒क॒धूमं॒ नक्ष॑त्राणि॒ यद् राजा॑न॒मकु॑र्वत ।
भ॒द्रा॒हम॑स्मै॒ प्राय॑च्छन्नि॒दं रा॒ष्ट्रमसा॒दिति॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
śakadhūmaṃ nakṣatrāṇi yad rājānamakurvata |
bhadrāhamasmai prāyacchannidaṃ rāṣṭramasāditi ||
verses.translation:
A charm for fair weather
What time the heavenly bodies chose the Weather Prophet as their King,
They brought him favouring weather, and, Let this be his do-main, they said.
May we have weather fair at noon, May we have weather fair at eve,
Fair weather when the morning breaks, fair weather when the night is come.
Fair weather to the day and night, and to the stars and sun and moon.
Give favourable weather thou, King, Weather Prophet, unto us.
Be worship ever paid to thee, O Weather Prophet, King of Star s,
Who gavest us oo weather in the evening and by night and day!

verses.sanskrit:
भ॒द्रा॒हं नो॑ म॒ध्यंदि॑ने भद्रा॒हं सा॒यम॑स्तु नः ।
भ॒द्रा॒हं नो॒ अह्नां॑ प्रा॒ता रात्री॑ भद्रा॒हम॑स्तु नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhadrāhaṃ no madhyaṃdine bhadrāhaṃ sāyamastu naḥ |
bhadrāhaṃ no ahnāṃ prātā rātrī bhadrāhamastu naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒हो॒रा॒त्राभ्यां॒ नक्ष॑त्रेभ्यः सूर्याचन्द्र॒मसा॑भ्याम् ।
भ॒द्रा॒हम॒स्मभ्यं॑ राज॒न्छक॑धूम॒ त्वं कृ॑धि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahorātrābhyāṃ nakṣatrebhyaḥ sūryācandramasābhyām |
bhadrāhamasmabhyaṃ rājanchakadhūma tvaṃ kṛdhi ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो नो॑ भद्रा॒हमक॑रः सा॒यं नक्त॒मथो॒ दिवा॑ ।
तस्मै॑ ते नक्षत्रराज॒ शक॑धूम॒ सदा॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo no bhadrāhamakaraḥ sāyaṃ naktamatho divā |
tasmai te nakṣatrarāja śakadhūma sadā namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
भगे॑न मा शांश॒पेन॑ सा॒कमिन्द्रे॑ण मे॒दिना॑ ।
कृ॒णोमि॑ भ॒गिनं॒ माप॑ द्रा॒न्त्वरा॑तयः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhagena mā śāṃśapena sākamindreṇa medinā |
kṛṇomi bhaginaṃ māpa drāntvarātayaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A charm for success and happiness
With fortune of the Sisu tree—with Indra as my friend to aid I give myself a happy fate. Fly and begone, Malignities!
That splendour and felicity wherewith thou hast excelled the trees Give me therewith a happy fate. Fly and begone, Malignities Blind fortune, with reverted leaves that is deposited in trees—
Give me therewith a happy fate. Fly and begone, Malignities.

verses.sanskrit:
येन॑ वृ॒क्षाँ अ॒भ्यभ॑वो॒ भगे॑न॒ वर्च॑सा स॒ह ।
तेन॑ मा भ॒गिनं॑ कृ॒ण्वप॑ द्रा॒न्त्वरा॑तयः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yena vṛkṣām̐ abhyabhavo bhagena varcasā saha |
tena mā bhaginaṃ kṛṇvapa drāntvarātayaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो अ॒न्धो यः पु॑नःस॒रो भगो॑ वृ॒क्षेष्वाहि॑तः ।
तेन॑ मा भ॒गिनं॑ कृ॒ण्वप॑ द्रा॒न्त्वरा॑तयः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo andho yaḥ punaḥsaro bhago vṛkṣeṣvāhitaḥ |
tena mā bhaginaṃ kṛṇvapa drāntvarātayaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
र॒थ॒जितां॑ राथजिते॒यीना॑मप्स॒रसा॑म॒यं स्म॒रः ।
देवाः॒ प्र हि॑णुत स्म॒रम॒सौ मामनु॑ शोचतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
rathajitāṃ rāthajiteyīnāmapsarasāmayaṃ smaraḥ |
devāḥ pra hiṇuta smaramasau māmanu śocatu ||
verses.translation:
A woman’s love-charm
This is the Apsarases’ love-spell, the conquering, resistless ones’.
Send the spell forth, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.
I pray, may he remember me, think of me, loving and beloved.
Send forth the spell, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.
That he may think of me, that I may never, never think of him,.
Send forth the spell, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.
Madden him, Maruts, madden him. Madden him, madden him,
O Air.
Madden him, Agni, madden him. Let him consume with love of me.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒सौ मे॑ स्मरता॒दिति॑ प्रि॒यो मे॑ स्मरता॒दिति॑ ।
देवाः॒ प्र हि॑णुत स्म॒रम॒सौ मामनु॑ शोचतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
asau me smaratāditi priyo me smaratāditi |
devāḥ pra hiṇuta smaramasau māmanu śocatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॒ मम॒ स्मरा॑द॒सौ नामुष्या॒हं क॒दा च॒न ।
देवाः॒ प्र हि॑णुत स्म॒रम॒सौ मामनु॑ शोचतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā mama smarādasau nāmuṣyāhaṃ kadā cana |
devāḥ pra hiṇuta smaramasau māmanu śocatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
उन्मा॑दयत मरुत॒ उद॑न्तरिक्ष मादय ।
अग्न॒ उन्मा॑दया॒ त्वम॒सौ मामनु॑ शोचतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
unmādayata maruta udantarikṣa mādaya |
agna unmādayā tvamasau māmanu śocatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
नि शी॑र्ष॒तो नि प॑त्त॒त आ॒ध्यो॒३ नि ति॑रामि ते ।
देवाः प्र हि॑णुत स्म॒रम॒सौ मामनु॑ शोचतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
ni śīrṣato ni pattata ādhyo ni tirāmi te |
devāḥ pra hiṇuta smaramasau māmanu śocatu ||
verses.translation:
A woman’s love-charm
Down upon thee, from head to foot, I draw the pangs of long-ing love.
Send forth the charm, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.
Assent to this, O Heavenly Grace! Celestial Purpose, guide it well!
Send forth the charm, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.
If thou shouldst run three leagues away, five leagues, a horse’s daily stage,
Thence thou shalt come to me again and be the father of our sons.

verses.sanskrit:
अनु॑म॒तेऽन्वि॒दं म॑न्य॒स्वाकू॑ते॒ समि॒दं नमः॑ ।
देवाः॒ प्र हि॑णुत स्म॒रम॒सौ मामनु॑ शोचतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
anumate'nvidaṃ manyasvākūte samidaṃ namaḥ |
devāḥ pra hiṇuta smaramasau māmanu śocatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
यद् धाव॑सि त्रियोज॒नं प॑ञ्चयोज॒नमाश्वि॑नम् ।
तत॒स्त्वं पुन॒राय॑सि पु॒त्राणां॑ नो असः पि॒ता ॥
verses.transliteration:
yad dhāvasi triyojanaṃ pañcayojanamāśvinam |
tatastvaṃ punarāyasi putrāṇāṃ no asaḥ pitā ||

verses.sanskrit:
यं दे॒वाः स्म॒रमसि॑ञ्चन्न॒प्स्व१न्तः शोशु॑चानं स॒हाध्या ।
तं ते॑ तपामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धर्म॑णा ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaṃ devāḥ smaramasiñcannapsvantaḥ śośucānaṃ sahādhyā |
taṃ te tapāmi varuṇasya dharmaṇā ||
verses.translation:
The same
The Philter, burning with the pangs of yearning love, which Gods have poured within the bosom of the floods,
That spell for thee I heat by Varuna’s decree.
The charm which, burning with the pangs of love, the General Gods have poured within the bosom of the floods,
That spell for thee I heat by Varuna’s decree.
The Philter, burning with the pangs of longing, which Indrāni hath effused within the waters’ depth,
That spell for thee I heat by Varuna’s decree.
The charm, aglow with longing, which Indra and Agni have effused within the bosom of the floods,
That spell for thee I heat by Varuna’s decree.
The charm aglow with longing which Mitra and Varuna have poured within the bosom of the floods,
That spell for thee I heat by Varuna’s decree.

verses.sanskrit:
यं विश्वे॑ दे॒वाः स्म॒रमसि॑ञ्चन्न॒प्स्व१न्तः शोशु॑चानं स॒हाध्या ।
तं ते॑ तपामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धर्म॑णा ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaṃ viśve devāḥ smaramasiñcannapsvantaḥ śośucānaṃ sahādhyā |
taṃ te tapāmi varuṇasya dharmaṇā ||

verses.sanskrit:
यमि॑न्द्रा॒णी स्म॒रमसि॑ञ्चद॒प्स्व॑१न्तः शोशु॑चानं स॒हाध्या ।
तं ते॑ तपामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धर्म॑णा ॥
verses.transliteration:
yamindrāṇī smaramasiñcadapsvantaḥ śośucānaṃ sahādhyā |
taṃ te tapāmi varuṇasya dharmaṇā ||

verses.sanskrit:
यमि॑न्द्रा॒ग्नी स्म॒रमसि॑ञ्चताम॒प्स्व॑१न्तः शोशु॑चानं स॒हाध्या ।
तं ते॑ तपामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धर्म॑णा ॥
verses.transliteration:
yamindrāgnī smaramasiñcatāmapsvantaḥ śośucānaṃ sahādhyā |
taṃ te tapāmi varuṇasya dharmaṇā ||

verses.sanskrit:
यं मि॒त्रावरु॑णौ स्म॒रमसि॑ञ्चताम॒प्स्व॑१न्तः शोशु॑चानं स॒हाध्या ।
तं ते॑ तपामि॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धर्म॑णा ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaṃ mitrāvaruṇau smaramasiñcatāmapsvantaḥ śośucānaṃ sahādhyā |
taṃ te tapāmi varuṇasya dharmaṇā ||

verses.sanskrit:
य इ॒मां दे॒वो मेख॑लामाब॒बन्ध॒ यः सं॑न॒नाह॒ य उ॑ नो यु॒योज॑ ।
यस्य॑ दे॒वस्य॑ प्र॒शिषा॒ चरा॑मः॒ स पा॒रमि॑च्छा॒त् स स उ॑ नो॒ वि मु॑ञ्चात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya imāṃ devo mekhalāmābabandha yaḥ saṃnanāha ya u no yuyoja |
yasya devasya praśiṣā carāmaḥ sa pāramicchāt sa sa u no vi muñcāt ||
verses.translation:
A glorification of the sacred girdle
By the direction of that God we journey, he will seek means to save and he will free us;
The God who hath engirt us with this Girdle, he who hath fast-ened it, and made us ready.
Thou, weapon of the Rishis, art adored and served with sacrifice.
First tasting of the votive milk, Zone, be a hero-slayer thou!
As I am now Death’s Brahmachāri claiming out of the living world a man for Yama,
So with Austerity and Prayer and Fervour I bind this Girdle round the man before me.
She hath become, Faith’s daughter, sprung from Fervour, the sister of the world-creating Rishis;
As such, O Girdle, give us thought and wisdom, give us religious zeal and mental vigour.
Thou whom primeval Rishis girt about them, they who made the world,
As such do thou encircle me, O Girdle, for long days of life.

verses.sanskrit:
आहु॑तास्य॒भिहु॑त॒ ऋषी॑णाम॒स्यायु॑धम् ।
पूर्वा॑ व्र॒तस्य॑ प्राश्न॒ती वी॑र॒घ्नी भ॑व मेखले ॥
verses.transliteration:
āhutāsyabhihuta ṛṣīṇāmasyāyudham |
pūrvā vratasya prāśnatī vīraghnī bhava mekhale ||

verses.sanskrit:
मृ॒त्योर॒हं ब्र॑ह्मचा॒री यदस्मि॑ नि॒र्याच॑न् भू॒तात् पुरु॑षं य॒माय॑ ।
तम॒हं ब्रह्म॑णा॒ तप॑सा॒ श्रमे॑णा॒नयै॑नं॒ मेख॑लया सिनामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
mṛtyorahaṃ brahmacārī yadasmi niryācan bhūtāt puruṣaṃ yamāya |
tamahaṃ brahmaṇā tapasā śrameṇānayainaṃ mekhalayā sināmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
श्र॒द्धाया॑ दुहि॒ता तप॒सोऽधि॑ जा॒ता स्वस॒ ऋषी॑णां भूत॒कृतां॑ ब॒भूव॑ ।
सा नो॑ मेखले म॒तिमा धे॑हि मे॒धामथो॑ नो धेहि॒ तप॑ इन्द्रि॒यं च॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
śraddhāyā duhitā tapaso'dhi jātā svasa ṛṣīṇāṃ bhūtakṛtāṃ babhūva |
sā no mekhale matimā dhehi medhāmatho no dhehi tapa indriyaṃ ca ||

verses.sanskrit:
यां त्वा॒ पूर्वे॑ भूत॒कृत॒ ऋष॑यः परिबेधि॒रे ।
सा त्वं परि॑ ष्वजस्व॒ मां दी॑र्घायु॒त्वाय॑ मेखले ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāṃ tvā pūrve bhūtakṛta ṛṣayaḥ paribedhire |
sā tvaṃ pari ṣvajasva māṃ dīrghāyutvāya mekhale ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यं वज्र॑स्तर्पयतामृ॒तस्यावा॑स्य रा॒ष्ट्रमप॑ हन्तु जीवि॒तम् ।
शृ॒णातु॑ ग्री॒वाः प्र शृ॑णातू॒ष्णिहा॑ वृ॒त्रस्ये॑व॒ शची॒पतिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ayaṃ vajrastarpayatāmṛtasyāvāsya rāṣṭramapa hantu jīvitam |
śṛṇātu grīvāḥ pra śṛṇātūṣṇihā vṛtrasyeva śacīpatiḥ ||
verses.translation:
A priest’s prayer for power to punish wrong-doers
This Thunderbolt shall take its fill of Order, scare life away and overthrow the kingdom.
Tear necks in pieces. rend napes asunder, even as the Lord of Might the neck of Vritra.
Down, down beneath the conquerors, let him not rise, concealed in earth, but lie downsmitten with the bolt.
Seek out the fierce oppressor, yea, strike only the oppressor dead. Down on the fierce oppressor’s head strike at full length, O Thunderbolt!

verses.sanskrit:
अध॑रोऽधर॒ उत्त॑रेभ्यो गू॒ढः पृ॑थि॒व्या मोत् सृपत् ।
वज्रे॒णाव॑हतः शयाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
adharo'dhara uttarebhyo gūḍhaḥ pṛthivyā mot sṛpat |
vajreṇāvahataḥ śayām ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो जि॒नाति॒ तमन्वि॑च्छ यो जि॒नाति॒ तमिज्ज॑हि ।
जि॒न॒तो व॑ज्र॒ त्वं सी॒मन्त॑म॒न्वञ्च॒मनु॑ पातय ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo jināti tamanviccha yo jināti tamijjahi |
jinato vajra tvaṃ sīmantamanvañcamanu pātaya ||

verses.sanskrit:
यद॒श्नामि॒ बलं॑ कुर्व इ॒त्थं वज्र॒मा द॑दे ।
स्क॒न्धान॒मुष्य॑ शा॒तय॑न् वृ॒त्रस्ये॑व॒ शची॒पतिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadaśnāmi balaṃ kurva itthaṃ vajramā dade |
skandhānamuṣya śātayan vṛtrasyeva śacīpatiḥ ||
verses.translation:
A priest’s fulmination against an enemy
Whate’er I eat I turn to strength, and thus I grasp the Thunder-bolt,
Rending the shoulders of that man as Indra shattered Vritra’s neck.
I drink together what I drink, even as the sea that swallows all.
Drinking the life-breath of that man, we drink that man and swallow him.
Whate’er I eat I swallow up, even as the sea that swallows all.
Swallowing that man’s vital breath, we swallow him completely up.

verses.sanskrit:
यत् पिबा॑मि॒ सं पि॑बामि समु॒द्र इ॑व संपि॒बः ।
प्रा॒णान॒मुष्य॑ सं॒पाय॒ सं पि॑बामो अ॒मुं व॒यम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yat pibāmi saṃ pibāmi samudra iva saṃpibaḥ |
prāṇānamuṣya saṃpāya saṃ pibāmo amuṃ vayam ||

verses.sanskrit:
यद् गिरा॑मि॒ सं गि॑रामि समु॒द्र इ॑व संगि॒रः ।
प्रा॒णान॒मुष्य॑ सं॒गीर्य॒ सं गि॑रामो अ॒मुं व॒यम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yad girāmi saṃ girāmi samudra iva saṃgiraḥ |
prāṇānamuṣya saṃgīrya saṃ girāmo amuṃ vayam ||

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी दे॒व्यामधि॑ जा॒ता पृ॑थि॒व्याम॑स्योषधे ।
तां त्वा॑ नितत्नि॒ केशे॑भ्यो॒ दृंह॑णाय खनामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
devī devyāmadhi jātā pṛthivyāmasyoṣadhe |
tāṃ tvā nitatni keśebhyo dṛṃhaṇāya khanāmasi ||
verses.translation:
A charm to promote the growth of hair
Born from the bosom of wide Earth the Goddess, godlike Plant, art thou:
So we, Nitatnī! dig thee up to strengthen and fix fast the hair.
Make the old firm, make new hair spring, lengthen what has already grown.
Thy hair where it is falling off, and with the roots is torn away,
I wet and sprinkle with the Plant, the remedy for all disease.

verses.sanskrit: दृंह॑ प्र॒त्नान् ज॒नयाजा॑तान् जा॒तानु॒ वर्षी॑यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṃha pratnān janayājātān jātānu varṣīyasaskṛdhi ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ते॒ केशो॑ऽव॒पद्य॑ते॒ समू॑लो॒ यश्च॑ वृ॒श्चते॑ ।
इ॒दं तं वि॒श्वभे॑षज्या॒भि षि॑ञ्चामि वी॒रुधा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaste keśo'vapadyate samūlo yaśca vṛścate |
idaṃ taṃ viśvabheṣajyābhi ṣiñcāmi vīrudhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
यां ज॒मद॑ग्नि॒रख॑नद् दुहि॒त्रे के॑श॒वर्ध॑नीम् ।
तां वी॒तह॑व्य॒ आभ॑र॒दसि॑तस्य गृ॒हेभ्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāṃ jamadagnirakhanad duhitre keśavardhanīm |
tāṃ vītahavya ābharadasitasya gṛhebhyaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A charm to promote the growth of hair
The Plant which Jamadagni dug to make his daughter’s locks. grow long,
This same hath Vitahavya brought to us from Asita’s abode.
They might be measured with a rein, meted with both extended arms.
Let the black locks spring thick and strong and grow like reeds upon thy head.
Strengthen the roots, prolong the points, lengthen the middle part, O Plant.
Let the black locks spring thick and strong and grow like reeds upon thy head.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भीशु॑ना॒ मेया॑ आसन् व्या॒मेना॑नु॒मेयाः॑ ।
केशा॑ न॒डा इ॑व वर्धन्तां शी॒र्ष्णस्ते॑ असि॒ताः परि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhīśunā meyā āsan vyāmenānumeyāḥ |
keśā naḍā iva vardhantāṃ śīrṣṇaste asitāḥ pari ||

verses.sanskrit:
दृंह॑ मूल॒माग्रं॑ यच्छ॒ वि मध्यं॑ यामयौषधे ।
केशा॑ न॒डा इ॑व वर्धन्तां शी॒र्ष्णस्ते॑ असि॒ताः परि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
dṛṃha mūlamāgraṃ yaccha vi madhyaṃ yāmayauṣadhe |
keśā naḍā iva vardhantāṃ śīrṣṇaste asitāḥ pari ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं वी॒रुधां॒ श्रेष्ठ॑तमाभिश्रु॒तास्यो॑षधे ।
इ॒मं मे॑ अ॒द्य पुरु॑षं क्ली॒बमो॑प॒शिनं॑ कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvaṃ vīrudhāṃ śreṣṭhatamābhiśrutāsyoṣadhe |
imaṃ me adya puruṣaṃ klībamopaśinaṃ kṛdhi ||
verses.translation:
A woman’s imprecation on her unfaithful lover
O Plant, thy fame is spread abroad as best of all the herbs that grow.
Unman for me to-day this man that he may wear the horn of hair.
Make him a eunuch with a horn, set thou the crest upon his-head.
Let Indra with two pressing-stones deprive him of his manly strength.
I have unmanned thee, eunuch! yea, impotent! made thee-impotent, and robbed thee, weakling! of thy strength.
Upon his head we set the horn, we set the branching ornament.
Duas tuas venas, a Diis factas, in quibus stat vigor virilis, paxillo ligneo in testiculis ob istam mulierem tibi findo.
Ut mulieres mattam (tegetem) facturae arundinem lapide findunt, sic fascinum tuum cum testiculis ob istam mulierem findo.

verses.sanskrit:
क्ली॒बं कृ॑ध्योप॒शिन॒मथो॑ कुरी॒रिणं॑ कृधि ।
अथा॒स्येन्द्रो॒ ग्राव॑भ्यामु॒भे भि॑नत्त्वा॒ण्ड्यौऽ ॥
verses.transliteration:
klībaṃ kṛdhyopaśinamatho kurīriṇaṃ kṛdhi |
athāsyendro grāvabhyāmubhe bhinattvāṇḍyau' ||

verses.sanskrit:
क्लीब॑ क्ली॒बं त्वा॑करं॒ वध्रे॒ वध्रिं॑ त्वाकर॒मर॑सार॒सं त्वा॑करम् ।
कु॒रीर॑मस्य शी॒र्षणि॒ कुम्बं॑ चाधि॒निद॑ध्मसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
klība klībaṃ tvākaraṃ vadhre vadhriṃ tvākaramarasārasaṃ tvākaram |
kurīramasya śīrṣaṇi kumbaṃ cādhinidadhmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये ते॑ ना॒ड्यौऽदे॒वकृ॑ते॒ ययो॒स्तिष्ठ॑ति॒ वृष्ण्य॑म् ।
ते ते॑ भिनद्मि॒ शम्य॑या॒मुष्या॒ अधि॑ मु॒ष्कयोः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye te nāḍyau'devakṛte yayostiṣṭhati vṛṣṇyam |
te te bhinadmi śamyayāmuṣyā adhi muṣkayoḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॑ न॒डं क॒शिपु॑ने॒ स्त्रियो॑ भि॒न्दन्त्यश्म॑ना ।
ए॒वा भि॑नद्मि ते॒ शेपो॒ऽमुष्या॒ अधि॑ मु॒ष्कयोः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā naḍaṃ kaśipune striyo bhindantyaśmanā |
evā bhinadmi te śepo'muṣyā adhi muṣkayoḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
न्य॒स्ति॒का रु॑रोहिथ सुभगं॒कर॑णी॒ मम॑ ।
श॒तं तव॑ प्रता॒नास्त्रय॑स्त्रिंशन्निता॒नाः ॥
तया॑ सहस्रप॒र्ण्या हृद॑यं शोषयामि ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
nyastikā rurohitha subhagaṃkaraṇī mama |
śataṃ tava pratānāstrayastriṃśannitānāḥ ||
tayā sahasraparṇyā hṛdayaṃ śoṣayāmi te ||
verses.translation:
A woman’s love-charm
Thou hast grown up, a source of joy to bless me with pros-perity.
A hundred are thy tendrils, three-and-thirty thy descending shoots.
With this that bears a thousand leaves I dry thy heart and wither it.
Let thy heart wither for my love and let thy month be dry for me.
Parch and dry up with longing, go with lips that love of me hath dried.
Drive us together, tawny! fair! a go-between who wakens love.
Drive us together, him and me, and give us both one heart and mind.
Even as his mouth is parched who finds no water for his burn-ing thirst,
So parch and burn with longing, go with lips that love of me hath dried.
Even as the Mungoose bites and rends and then restores the wounded snake,
So do thou, Mighty one, restore the fracture of our severed love.

verses.sanskrit:
शुष्य॑तु॒ मयि॑ ते॒ हृद॑य॒मथो॑ शुष्यत्वा॒स्यऽम् ।
अथो॒ नि शु॑ष्य॒ मां कामे॒नाथो॒ शुष्का॑स्या चर ॥
verses.transliteration:
śuṣyatu mayi te hṛdayamatho śuṣyatvāsya'm |
atho ni śuṣya māṃ kāmenātho śuṣkāsyā cara ||

verses.sanskrit:
सं॒वन॑नी समुष्प॒ला बभ्रु॒ कल्या॑णि॒ सं नु॑द ।
अमूं च॒ मां च॒ सं नु॑द समा॒नं हृद॑यं कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃvananī samuṣpalā babhru kalyāṇi saṃ nuda |
amūṃ ca māṃ ca saṃ nuda samānaṃ hṛdayaṃ kṛdhi ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथो॑द॒कमप॑पुषोऽप॒शुष्य॑त्या॒स्यऽम् ।
ए॒वा नि शु॑ष्य॒ मां कामे॒नाथो॒ शुष्का॑स्या चर ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathodakamapapuṣo'paśuṣyatyāsya'm |
evā ni śuṣya māṃ kāmenātho śuṣkāsyā cara ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॑ नकु॒लो वि॒च्छिद्य॑ सं॒दधा॒त्यहिं॒ पुनः॑ ।
ए॒वा काम॑स्य॒ विच्छि॑न्नं॒ सं धे॑हि वीर्यावति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā nakulo vicchidya saṃdadhātyahiṃ punaḥ |
evā kāmasya vicchinnaṃ saṃ dhehi vīryāvati ||

verses.sanskrit:
यौ व्या॒घ्रवव॑रूढौ जिघ॑त्सतः पि॒तरं॑ मा॒तरं॑ च ।
यौ दन्तौ ब्रह्मणस्पते शि॒वौ कृ॑णु जातवेदः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yau vyāghravavarūḍhau jighatsataḥ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca |
yau dantau brahmaṇaspate śivau kṛṇu jātavedaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A blessing on a child’s first two teeth
Two tigers have grown up who long to eat the mother and the sire:
Soothe, Brāhmanaspati, and thou, O Jātavedas, both these teeth.
Let rice and barley be your food, eat also beans and sesamum.
This is the share allotted you, to be your portion, ye two Teeth.
Harm not your mother and your sire.
Both fellow teeth have been invoked, gentle and bringing happi-ness.
Else whither let the fierceness of your nature turn away, O Teeth! Harm not your mother or your sire.

verses.sanskrit:
व्री॒हिम॑त्तं॒ यव॑मत्त॒मथो॒ माष॒मथो॒ तिल॑म् ।
ए॒ष वां॑ भा॒गो निहि॑तो रत्न॒धेया॑य दन्तौ॒ मा हिं॑सिष्टं पि॒तरं॑ मा॒तरं॑ च ॥
verses.transliteration:
vrīhimattaṃ yavamattamatho māṣamatho tilam |
eṣa vāṃ bhāgo nihito ratnadheyāya dantau mā hiṃsiṣṭaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca ||

verses.sanskrit:
उप॑हूतौ स॒युजौ॑ स्यो॒नौ दन्तौ॑ सुम॒ङ्गलौ॑ ।
अ॒न्यत्र॑ वां घो॒रं त॒न्वः॑१ परै॑तु दन्तौ॒ मा हिं॑सिष्टं पि॒तरं॑ मा॒तरं॑ च ॥
verses.transliteration:
upahūtau sayujau syonau dantau sumaṅgalau |
anyatra vāṃ ghoraṃ tanvaḥ paraitu dantau mā hiṃsiṣṭaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca ||

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒युरे॑नाः स॒माक॑र॒त् त्वष्टा॒ पोषा॑य ध्रियताम् ।
इन्द्र॑ आभ्यो॒ अधि॑ ब्रवद् रु॒द्रो भू॒म्ने चि॑कित्सतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
vāyurenāḥ samākarat tvaṣṭā poṣāya dhriyatām |
indra ābhyo adhi bravad rudro bhūmne cikitsatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
लोहि॑तेन॒ स्वधि॑तिना मिथु॒नं कर्ण॑योः कृधि ।
अक॑र्ताम॒श्विना॒ लक्ष्म॒ तद॑स्तु प्र॒जया॑ ब॒हु ॥
verses.transliteration:
lohitena svadhitinā mithunaṃ karṇayoḥ kṛdhi |
akartāmaśvinā lakṣma tadastu prajayā bahu ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॑ च॒क्रुर्दे॑वासु॒रा यथा॑ मनु॒ष्याऽउ॒त ।
ए॒वा स॑हस्रपो॒षाय॑ कृणु॒तं लक्ष्मा॑श्विना ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā cakrurdevāsurā yathā manuṣyā'uta |
evā sahasrapoṣāya kṛṇutaṃ lakṣmāśvinā ||

verses.sanskrit:
उच्छ्र॑यस्व ब॒हुर्भ॑व॒ स्वेन॒ मह॑सा यव ।
मृ॒णी॒हि विश्वा॒ पात्रा॑णि॒ मा त्वा॑ दि॒व्याशनि॑र्वधीत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ucchrayasva bahurbhava svena mahasā yava |
mṛṇīhi viśvā pātrāṇi mā tvā divyāśanirvadhīt ||
verses.translation:
Spring high, O Barley, and become much through thine own magnificence: Burst all the vessels; let the bolt from heaven forbear to strike thee down.
As we invite and call to thee, Barley, a God who heareth us,
Raise thyself up like heaven on high and be exhaustless as the sea.
Exhaustless let thine out-turns be, exhaustless be thy gathered heaps,
Exhaustless be thy givers, and exhaustless those who eat of thee.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒शृ॒ण्वन्तं॒ यवं॑ दे॒वं यत्र॑ त्वाच्छा॒वदा॑मसि ।
तदुच्छ्र॑यस्व॒ द्यौरि॑व समु॒द्र इ॑वै॒ध्यक्षि॑तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
āśṛṇvantaṃ yavaṃ devaṃ yatra tvācchāvadāmasi |
taducchrayasva dyauriva samudra ivaidhyakṣitaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अक्षि॑तास्त उप॒सदोऽक्षि॑ताः सन्तु रा॒शयः॑ ।
पृ॒णन्तो॒ अक्षि॑ताः सन्त्व॒त्तारः॑ स॒न्त्वक्षि॑ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
akṣitāsta upasado'kṣitāḥ santu rāśayaḥ |
pṛṇanto akṣitāḥ santvattāraḥ santvakṣitāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
धी॒ती वा॒ ये अन॑यन् वा॒चो अग्रं॒ मन॑सा वा॒ येऽव॑दन्नृ॒ तानि॑ ।
तृ॒तीये॑न॒ ब्रह्म॑णा वावृ॒धा॒नास्तु॒रीये॑णामन्वत॒ नाम॑ धे॒नोः ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhītī vā ye anayan vāco agraṃ manasā vā ye'vadannṛ tāni |
tṛtīyena brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānāsturīyeṇāmanvata nāma dhenoḥ ||
verses.translation:
Glorification of the power of prayer and to Agni
They who by thought have guided all that Speech hath best, or they who with their heart have uttered words of truth,
Made stronger by the strength which the third prayer bestows, have by the fourth prayer learned the nature of the Cow.
Well knows this son his sire, he knows his mother well: he hath been son, and he hath been illiberal.
He hath encompassed heaven, and air’s mid-realm, and sky; he hath become this All; he hath come nigh to us.

verses.sanskrit:
स वे॑द पु॒त्रः पि॒तरं॒ स मा॒तरं॒ स सू॒नुर्भु॑व॒त् स भु॑व॒त् पुन॑र्मघः ।
स द्यामौ॑र्णोद॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ स्वः॑१ स इ॒दं विश्व॑मभवत् स आभ॑वत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa veda putraḥ pitaraṃ sa mātaraṃ sa sūnurbhuvat sa bhuvat punarmaghaḥ |
sa dyāmaurṇodantarikṣaṃ svaḥ sa idaṃ viśvamabhavat sa ābhavat ||

verses.sanskrit:
अथ॑र्वाणं पि॒तरं॑ दे॒वब॑न्धुं मा॒तुर्गर्भं॑ पि॒तुरसुं॒ युवा॑नम् ।
य इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं मन॑सा चि॒केत॒ प्र णो॑ वोच॒स्तमि॒हेह ब्र॑वः ॥
verses.transliteration:
atharvāṇaṃ pitaraṃ devabandhuṃ māturgarbhaṃ piturasuṃ yuvānam |
ya imaṃ yajñaṃ manasā ciketa pra ṇo vocastamiheha bravaḥ ||
verses.translation:
Praise of Atharvan
Invoke for us, proclaim in sundry places, the kinsman of the Gods, our sire Atharvan,
His mother’s germ, his father’s breath, the youthful, who with his mind hath noticed this oblation.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒या वि॒ष्ठा ज॒नय॒न् कर्व॑राणि॒ स हि घृणि॑रु॒रुर्वरा॑य गा॒तुः ।
स प्र॒त्युदै॑द् ध॒रुणं॒ मध्वो॒ अग्रं॒ स्वया॑ त॒न्वाऽत॒न्वऽमैरयत ॥
verses.transliteration:
ayā viṣṭhā janayan karvarāṇi sa hi ghṛṇirururvarāya gātuḥ |
sa pratyudaid dharuṇaṃ madhvo agraṃ svayā tanvā'tanva'mairayata ||

verses.sanskrit:
एक॑या च द॒शभि॑श्चा सुहुते॒ द्वाभ्या॑मि॒ष्टये॑ विंश॒त्या च॑ ।
ति॒सृभि॑श्च॒ वह॑से त्रिं॒शता॑ च वि॒युग्भि॑र्वाय इ॒ह ता वि मु॑ञ्च ॥
verses.transliteration:
ekayā ca daśabhiścā suhute dvābhyāmiṣṭaye viṃśatyā ca |
tisṛbhiśca vahase triṃśatā ca viyugbhirvāya iha tā vi muñca ||
verses.translation:
To Vāyu God of the Wind
With thine eleven teams, to aid our wishes, yea, with thy two-and-twenty teams, O Vāyu,
With all thy three-and-thirty teams for drawing, here loose these teams, thou who art prompt to listen!

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञेन॑ य॒ज्ञम॑यजन्त दे॒वास्तानि॒ धर्मा॑णि प्रथ॒मान्या॑सन् ।
ते ह॒ नाकं॑ महि॒मानः॑ सचन्त॒ यत्र॒ पूर्वे॑ सा॒ध्याः सन्ति॑ दे॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yajñena yajñamayajanta devāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan |
te ha nākaṃ mahimānaḥ sacanta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ ||
verses.translation:
A glorification of sacrifice
The Gods adored the Sacrifice with worship: these were the statutes of primeval ages.
Those mighty ones attained the cope of heaven, there where the Sādhyas, Gods of old, are dwelling.
Sacrifice was, was manifest among us: it sprang to life and then in time grew stronger.
Then it became thedeities’ lord and ruler: may it bestow on us abundant riches.
Where the Gods worshipped Gods with their oblation, worship-ped immortals with immortal spirit, There in the loftiest heaven may we be happy, and look upon that light when Sūrya rises.
With their oblation, Purusha, the Gods performed a sacrifice.
A sacrifice more potent still they paid with the invoking hymn.
With dog the Gods, perplexed, have paid oblation, and with cow’s limbs in sundry sacrifices.
Invoke for us, in many a place declare him who with his mind. hath noticed this our worship.

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञो ब॑भूव॒ स आ ब॑भूव॒ स प्र ज॑ज्ञे॒ स उ॑ वावृधे॒ पुनः॑ ।
स दे॒वाना॒मधि॑पतिर्बभूव॒ सो अ॒स्मासु॒ द्रवि॑ण॒मा द॑धातु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yajño babhūva sa ā babhūva sa pra jajñe sa u vāvṛdhe punaḥ |
sa devānāmadhipatirbabhūva so asmāsu draviṇamā dadhātu ||

verses.sanskrit:
यद् दे॒वा दे॒वान् ह॒विषाय॑ज॒न्ताम॑र्त्या॒न् मन॒साम॑र्त्येन ।
मदे॑म॒ तत्र॑ पर॒मे व्योऽम॒न् पश्ये॑म॒ तदुदि॑तौ॒ सूर्य॑स्य ॥
verses.transliteration:
yad devā devān haviṣāyajantāmartyān manasāmartyena |
madema tatra parame vyo'man paśyema taduditau sūryasya ||

verses.sanskrit:
यत् पुरु॑षेण ह॒विषा॑ य॒ज्ञं दे॒वा अत॑न्वत ।
अस्ति॒ नु तस्मा॒दोजी॑यो॒ यद् विहव्ये॑नेजि॒रे ॥
verses.transliteration:
yat puruṣeṇa haviṣā yajñaṃ devā atanvata |
asti nu tasmādojīyo yad vihavyenejire ||

verses.sanskrit:
मु॒ग्धा दे॒वा उ॒त शुनाय॑जन्तो॒त गोरङ्गैः॑ पुरु॒धाय॑जन्त ।
य इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं मन॑सा चि॒केत॒ प्र णो॑ वोच॑स्तमि॑हेह ब्र॑वः ॥
verses.transliteration:
mugdhā devā uta śunāyajantota goraṅgaiḥ purudhāyajanta |
ya imaṃ yajñaṃ manasā ciketa pra ṇo vocastamiheha bravaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अदि॑ति॒र्द्यौरदि॑तिर॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒मदि॑तिर्मा॒ता स पि॒ता स पु॒त्रः ।
विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अदि॑तिः॒ पञ्च॒ जना॒ अदि॑तिर्जा॒तमदि॑ति॒र्जनि॑त्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
aditirdyauraditirantarikṣamaditirmātā sa pitā sa putraḥ |
viśve devā aditiḥ pañca janā aditirjātamaditirjanitvam ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to Aditi for help and protection
Aditi is sky, and air’s mid-region, Aditi is the father, son, and mother,
Aditi all the Gods and the Five Nations, Aditi what is now and what is future.
We call for help the Queen of Law and Order, great mother of all those whose ways are righteous,
Far-spread, unwasting strong in her dominion, Aditi wisely lead-ing, well protecting.
Sinless may we ascend, for weal, the vessel, rowed with good oars, divine, that never leaketh,
Earth, our strong guard, incomparable Heaven, Aditi wisely lead-ing, well protecting.
Let us bring hither, in pursuit of riches, Aditi with our word, the mighty mother,
Her in whose lap the spacious air is lying: may she afford us triply-guarding shelter!

verses.sanskrit:
म॒हीमू॒ षु मा॒तरं॑ सुव्र॒ताना॑मृ॒तस्य॒ पत्नी॒मव॑से हवामहे ।
तु॒वि॒क्ष॒त्राम॒जर॑न्तीमुरू॒चीं सु॒शर्मा॑ण॒मदि॑तिं सु॒प्रणी॑तिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
mahīmū ṣu mātaraṃ suvratānāmṛtasya patnīmavase havāmahe |
tuvikṣatrāmajarantīmurūcīṃ suśarmāṇamaditiṃ supraṇītim ||

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒त्रामा॑णं पृथि॒वीं द्याम॑ने॒हसं॑ सु॒शर्मा॑ण॒मदि॑तिं सु॒प्रणी॑तिम् ।
दैवीं॒ नावं॑ स्वरि॒त्रामना॑गसो॒ अस्र॑वन्ती॒मा रु॑हेमा स्व॒स्तये॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sutrāmāṇaṃ pṛthivīṃ dyāmanehasaṃ suśarmāṇamaditiṃ supraṇītim |
daivīṃ nāvaṃ svaritrāmanāgaso asravantīmā ruhemā svastaye ||

verses.sanskrit:
वाज॑स्य॒ नु प्र॑स॒वे मा॒तरं॑ म॒हीमदि॑तिं॒ नाम॒ वच॑सा करामहे ।
यस्या॑ उ॒पस्थ॑ उ॒र्व॑१न्तरि॑क्षं॒ सा नः॒ शर्म॑ त्रि॒वरू॑थं॒ नि य॑च्छात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vājasya nu prasave mātaraṃ mahīmaditiṃ nāma vacasā karāmahe |
yasyā upastha urvantarikṣaṃ sā naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ ni yacchāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
दितेः॑ पु॒त्राणा॒मदि॑तेरकारिष॒मव॑ दे॒वानां॑ बृह॒ताम॑न॒र्मणा॑म् ।
तेषां॒ हि धाम॑ गभि॒षक् स॑मु॒द्रियं॒ नैना॒न् नम॑सा प॒रो अ॑स्ति॒ कश्च॒न ॥
verses.transliteration:
diteḥ putrāṇāmaditerakāriṣamava devānāṃ bṛhatāmanarmaṇām |
teṣāṃ hi dhāma gabhiṣak samudriyaṃ nainān namasā paro asti kaścana ||
verses.translation:
Praise of the Ādityas
I have sung praise to Diti’s sons and Aditi’s, those very lofty and invulnerable Gods.
For far within the depths of ocean is their home and in the wor-ship paid them none excelleth these.

verses.sanskrit:
भ॒द्रादधि॒ श्रेयः॒ प्रेहि॒ बृह॒स्पतिः॑ पुरए॒ता ते॑ अस्तु ।
अथे॒मम॒स्या वर॒ आ पृ॑थि॒व्या आ॒रेश॑त्रुं कृणुहि॒ सर्व॑वीरम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhadrādadhi śreyaḥ prehi bṛhaspatiḥ puraetā te astu |
athemamasyā vara ā pṛthivyā āreśatruṃ kṛṇuhi sarvavīram ||
verses.translation:
Godspeed to a departing traveller
Go forward on thy way from good to better: Brihaspati pre-cede thy steps and guide thee!
Place this man here, within this earth’s enclosure, afar from foes with all his men about him.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रप॑थे प॒थाम॑जनिष्ट पू॒षा प्रप॑थे दि॒वः प्रप॑थे पृथि॒व्याः ।
उ॒भे अ॒भि प्रि॒यत॑मे स॒धस्थे॒ आ च॒ परा॑ च चरति प्रजा॒नन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prapathe pathāmajaniṣṭa pūṣā prapathe divaḥ prapathe pṛthivyāḥ |
ubhe abhi priyatame sadhasthe ā ca parā ca carati prajānan ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to Pūshan for protection and the recovery of lost property
Pūshan was born to move on distant pathways, on roads remote from earth, remote from heaven.
To both most lovely places of assembly he travels and returns with perfect knowledge.
Pūshan knows all these realms: may he conduct us by ways that are most free from fear and danger.
Giver of blessings, glowing, all heroic, may he the wise and watchful go before us.
We are thy praisers here, O Pūshan: never let us be injured under thy protection.
From out the distance, far and wide, may Pūshan stretch his right hand forth.
Let him drive back our lost to us, let us return with what is lost.

verses.sanskrit:
पू॒षेमा आशा॒ अनु॑ वेद॒ सर्वाः॑ सो अ॒स्माँ अभ॑यतमेन नेषत् ।
स्व॒स्ति॒दा आघृ॑णिः॒ सर्व॑वी॒रोऽप्र॑युच्छन् पु॒र ए॑तु प्रजा॒नन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pūṣemā āśā anu veda sarvāḥ so asmām̐ abhayatamena neṣat |
svastidā āghṛṇiḥ sarvavīro'prayucchan pura etu prajānan ||

verses.sanskrit:
पूष॒न्तव॑ व्र॒ते व॒यं न रि॑ष्येम क॒दा च॒न ।
स्तो॒तार॑स्त इ॒ह स्म॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration:
pūṣantava vrate vayaṃ na riṣyema kadā cana |
stotārasta iha smasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
परि॑ पू॒षा प॒रस्ता॒द्धस्तं॑ दधातु॒ दक्षि॑णम् ।
पुन॑र्नो न॒ष्टमाज॑तु॒ सं न॒ष्टेन॑ गमेमहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
pari pūṣā parastāddhastaṃ dadhātu dakṣiṇam |
punarno naṣṭamājatu saṃ naṣṭena gamemahi ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ते॒ स्तनः॑ शश॒युर्यो म॑यो॒भूर्यः सु॑म्न॒युः सु॒हवो॒ यः सु॒दत्रः॑ ।
येन॒ विश्वा॒ पुष्य॑सि॒ वार्या॑णि॒ सर॑स्वति॒ तमि॒ह धात॑वे कः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaste stanaḥ śaśayuryo mayobhūryaḥ sumnayuḥ suhavo yaḥ sudatraḥ |
yena viśvā puṣyasi vāryāṇi sarasvati tamiha dhātave kaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for the favour of Sarasvati
That breast of thine, exhaustless and delightful, good to invoke, beneficent, free giver.
Wherewith thou feedest all things that are choicest, bring that,
Sarasvati, that we may drain it.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ते॒ स्तनः॑ शश॒युर्यो म॑यो॒भूर्यः सु॑म्न॒युः सु॒हवो॒ यः सु॒दत्रः॑ ।
येन॒ विश्वा॒ पुष्य॑सि॒ वार्या॑णि॒ सर॑स्वति॒ तमि॒ह धात॑वे कः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaste stanaḥ śaśayuryo mayobhūryaḥ sumnayuḥ suhavo yaḥ sudatraḥ |
yena viśvā puṣyasi vāryāṇi sarasvati tamiha dhātave kaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to protect corn from lightning and drought
That far-spread thunder, sent from thee, which cometh on all this world, a high celestial signal Strike not, O God, our growing corn with lightning, not kill it with the burning rays of Sūrya.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒भा च॑ मा॒ समि॑तिश्चावतां प्र॒जाप॑तेर्दुहि॒तरौ॑ संविदा॒ने ।
येना॑ सं॒गच्छा॒ उप॑ मा॒ स शि॑क्षा॒च्चारु॑ वदानि पितरः॒ संग॑तेषु ॥
verses.transliteration:
sabhā ca mā samitiścāvatāṃ prajāpaterduhitarau saṃvidāne |
yenā saṃgacchā upa mā sa śikṣāccāru vadāni pitaraḥ saṃgateṣu ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for influence at deliberative and religious meetings
In concord may Prajapati’s two daughters, Gathering and As-sembly, both protect me.
May every man I meet respect and aid me. Fair be my words,
O Fathers, at the meetings.
We know thy name, O Conference: thy name is interchange of talk.
Let all the company who join the Conference agree with me.
Of these men seated here I make the splendour and the lore mine own.
Indra, make me conspicuous in all this gathered company.
Whether your thoughts are turned away, or bound and fastened here or there,
We draw them hitherward again: let your mind firmly rest on me.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒द्म ते॑ सभे॒ नाम॑ न॒रिष्टा॒ नाम॒ वा अ॑सि ।
ये ते॒ के च॑ सभा॒सद॒स्ते मे॑ सन्तु॒ सवा॑चसः ॥
verses.transliteration:
vidma te sabhe nāma nariṣṭā nāma vā asi |
ye te ke ca sabhāsadaste me santu savācasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒षाम॒हं स॒मासी॑नानां॒ वर्चो॑ वि॒ज्ञान॒मा द॑दे ।
अ॒स्याः सर्व॑स्याः सं॒सदो॒ मामि॑न्द्र भ॒गिनं॑ कृणु ॥
verses.transliteration:
eṣāmahaṃ samāsīnānāṃ varco vijñānamā dade |
asyāḥ sarvasyāḥ saṃsado māmindra bhaginaṃ kṛṇu ||

verses.sanskrit:
यद् वो॒ मनः॒ परा॑गतं॒ यद् ब॒द्धमि॒ह वे॒ह वा॑ ।
तद् व॒ आ व॑र्तयामसि॒ मयि॑ वो रमतां॒ मनः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yad vo manaḥ parāgataṃ yad baddhamiha veha vā |
tad va ā vartayāmasi mayi vo ramatāṃ manaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॒ सूर्यो॒ नक्ष॑त्राणामु॒द्यंस्तेजां॑स्याद॒दे ।
ए॒वा स्त्री॒णां च॑ पुं॒सां च॑ द्विष॒तां वर्च॒ आ द॑दे ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā sūryo nakṣatrāṇāmudyaṃstejāṃsyādade |
evā strīṇāṃ ca puṃsāṃ ca dviṣatāṃ varca ā dade ||
verses.translation:
A charm to win superiority over foes and rivals
As the Sun, rising, taketh to himself the brightness of the stars,.
So I assume the glory of women and men mine enemies.
All ye amang my rivals who behold me as I come to you,
I seize the glory of my foes as the Sun, rising, theirs who sleep.

verses.sanskrit:
याव॑न्तो मा स॒पत्ना॑नामा॒यन्तं॑ प्रति॒पश्य॑थ ।
उ॒द्यन्त्सूर्य॑ इव सु॒प्तानां॑ द्विष॒तां वर्च॒ आ द॑दे ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāvanto mā sapatnānāmāyantaṃ pratipaśyatha |
udyantsūrya iva suptānāṃ dviṣatāṃ varca ā dade ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भि त्यं दे॒वं स॑वि॒तार॑मो॒ण्योः क॒विक्र॑तुम् ।
अर्चा॑मि स॒त्यस॑वं रत्न॒धाम॒भि प्रि॒यं म॒तिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhi tyaṃ devaṃ savitāramoṇyoḥ kavikratum |
arcāmi satyasavaṃ ratnadhāmabhi priyaṃ matim ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to Savitar for prosperity
I praise this God, parent of heaven and earth, exceeding wiser possessed of real energy, giver of treasure, thinker dear to all,.
Whose splendour is sublime, whose light shone brilliant in crea-tion, who, wise, and goldenhanded, in his beauty made the sky.
As thou, God! quickening, for our ancient father, sentest him height above and room about him,
So unto us, O Savitar, send treasures, abundant, day by day, in shape of cattle.
Savitar, God, our household friend, most precious, hath sent our fathers life and power and riches.
Let him drink Soma and rejoice when worshipped. Under his law even the Wanderer travels.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒र्ध्वा यस्या॒मति॒र्भा अदि॑द्युत॒त् सवी॑मनि ।
हिर॑ण्यपाणिरमिमीत सु॒क्रतुः॑ कृ॒पात् स्वः ॥
verses.transliteration:
urdhvā yasyāmatirbhā adidyutat savīmani |
hiraṇyapāṇiramimīta sukratuḥ kṛpāt svaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
सावी॒र्हि दे॑व प्रथ॒माय॑ पि॒त्रे व॒र्ष्माण॑मस्मै वरि॒माण॑मस्मै ।
अथा॒स्मभ्यं॑ सवित॒र्वार्या॑णि दि॒वोदि॑व॒ आ सु॑वा॒ भूरि॑ प॒श्वः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sāvīrhi deva prathamāya pitre varṣmāṇamasmai varimāṇamasmai |
athāsmabhyaṃ savitarvāryāṇi divodiva ā suvā bhūri paśvaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
दमू॑ना दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता वरे॑ण्यो॒ दध॒द् रत्नं॒ दक्षं पि॒तृभ्य॒ आयूं॑षि ।
पिबा॒त् सोमं॑ म॒मद॑देनमि॒ष्टे परि॑ज्मा चित् क्रमते अस्य॒ धर्म॑णि ॥
verses.transliteration:
damūnā devaḥ savitā vareṇyo dadhad ratnaṃ dakṣaṃ pitṛbhya āyūṃṣi |
pibāt somaṃ mamadadenamiṣṭe parijmā cit kramate asya dharmaṇi ||

verses.sanskrit:
तां स॑वितः स॒त्यस॑वां सुचि॒त्रामाहं वृ॑णे सुम॒तिं वि॒श्ववा॑राम् ।
याम॑स्य॒ कण्वो॒ अदु॑ह॒न् प्रपी॑नां स॒हस्र॑धारां महि॒षो भगा॑य ॥
verses.transliteration:
tāṃ savitaḥ satyasavāṃ sucitrāmāhaṃ vṛṇe sumatiṃ viśvavārām |
yāmasya kaṇvo aduhan prapīnāṃ sahasradhārāṃ mahiṣo bhagāya ||
verses.translation:
A charm to win divine favour and felicity
I choose, O Savitar, that glorious favour, with fruitful energy and every blessing,
Even this one’s teeming cow, erst milked by Kanva, thousand-streamed, milked for happiness by the mighty.

verses.sanskrit:
बृह॑स्पते॒ सवि॑तर्व॒र्धयै॑नं ज्यो॒तयै॑नं मह॒ते सौभ॑गाय ।
संशि॑तं चित् संत॒रं सं शि॑शाधि॒ विश्व॑ एन॒मनु॑ मदन्तु दे॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bṛhaspate savitarvardhayainaṃ jyotayainaṃ mahate saubhagāya |
saṃśitaṃ cit saṃtaraṃ saṃ śiśādhi viśva enamanu madantu devāḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for prosperity
Increase this man Brihaspati! Illume him, O Savitar, for high and happy fortune.
Sharpen him thoroughly though already sharpened: with glad acclaim let all the Gods receive him.

verses.sanskrit:
धा॒ता द॑धातु नो र॒यिमीशा॑नो॒ जग॑त॒स्पतिः॑ ।
स नः॑ पू॒र्णेन॑ यच्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhātā dadhātu no rayimīśāno jagataspatiḥ |
sa naḥ pūrṇena yacchatu ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for wealth and children
May the Ordainer give us wealth, Lord, ruler of the world of life: with full hand may he give to us.
May Dhātar grant the worshipper henceforth imperishable life.
May we obtain the favour of the God who giveth every boon.
To him may Dhātar grant all kinds of blessings who, craving children, serves him in his dwelling.
Him may the Gods invest with life eternal, yea, all the Gods and Aditi accordant.
May this our gift please Savitar, Rāti, Dhātar, Prajāpati, and Agni Lord of Treasures.
May Tvashtar, Vishnu, blessing him with children, give store ot riches to the sacrificer.

verses.sanskrit:
धा॒ता द॑धातु दा॒शुषे॒ प्राचीं॑ जी॒वातु॒क्षि॑ताम् ।
व॒यं दे॒वस्य॑ धीमहि सुम॒तिं वि॒श्वरा॑धसः ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhātā dadhātu dāśuṣe prācīṃ jīvātukṣitām |
vayaṃ devasya dhīmahi sumatiṃ viśvarādhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
धा॒ता विश्वा॒ वार्या॑ दधातु प्र॒जाका॑माय दा॒शुषे॑ दुरो॒णे ।
तस्मै॑ दे॒वाअ॒मृतं॒ सं व्य॑यन्तु॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अदि॑तिः स॒जोषाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhātā viśvā vāryā dadhātu prajākāmāya dāśuṣe duroṇe |
tasmai devāamṛtaṃ saṃ vyayantu viśve devā aditiḥ sajoṣāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
धा॒ता रा॒तिः स॑वि॒तेदं जु॑षन्तां प्र॒जाप॑तिर्नि॒धिप॑तिर्नो अ॒ग्निः ।
त्वष्टा॒ विष्णुः॑ प्र॒जया॑ संररा॒णो यज॑मानाय॒ द्रवि॑णं दधातु ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhātā rātiḥ savitedaṃ juṣantāṃ prajāpatirnidhipatirno agniḥ |
tvaṣṭā viṣṇuḥ prajayā saṃrarāṇo yajamānāya draviṇaṃ dadhātu ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र न॑भस्व पृथिवि भि॒न्द्धी॒३दं दि॒व्यं नभः॑ ।
उ॒द्नो दि॒व्यस्य॑ नो धात॒रीशा॑नो॒ वि ष्या॒ दृति॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra nabhasva pṛthivi bhinddhīdaṃ divyaṃ nabhaḥ |
udno divyasya no dhātarīśāno vi ṣyā dṛtim ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for rain
Burst open, Prithvi, and cleave asunder this celestial cloud.
Untie, O Dhātar—for thou canst—the bottle of the breast of heaven.
Let not the Sun’s heat burn, nor cold destroy her. Let Earth with all her quickening drops burst open.
Even for her the waters flow, and fatness: where Soma is even there is bliss for ever.

verses.sanskrit:
न घ्रंस्त॑ताप॒ न हि॒मो ज॑घान॒ प्र न॑भतां पृथि॒वी जी॒रदा॑नुः ।
आप॑श्चिदस्मै घृ॒तमित् क्ष॑रन्ति॒ यत्र॒ सोमः॒ सद॒मित् तत्र॑ भ॒द्रम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
na ghraṃstatāpa na himo jaghāna pra nabhatāṃ pṛthivī jīradānuḥ |
āpaścidasmai ghṛtamit kṣaranti yatra somaḥ sadamit tatra bhadram ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒जाप॑तिर्जनयति प्र॒जा इ॒मा धा॒ता द॑धातु सुमन॒स्यमा॑नः ।
सं॒जा॒ना॒नाः संम॑नसः॒ सयो॑नयो॒ मयि॑ पु॒ष्टं पु॑ष्ट॒पति॑र्दधातु ॥
verses.transliteration:
prajāpatirjanayati prajā imā dhātā dadhātu sumanasyamānaḥ |
saṃjānānāḥ saṃmanasaḥ sayonayo mayi puṣṭaṃ puṣṭapatirdadhātu ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for prosperity
Prajapati engenders earthly creatures: may the benevolent Ordainer form them,
Having one common womb, and mind, and spirit. He who is.
Lord of Plenty give me plenty!

verses.sanskrit:
अन्व॒द्य नोऽनु॑मतिर्य॒ज्ञं दे॒वेषु॑ मन्यताम् ।
अ॒ग्निश्च॑ हव्य॒वाह॑नो॒ भव॑तां दा॒शुषे॒ मम॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
anvadya no'numatiryajñaṃ deveṣu manyatām |
agniśca havyavāhano bhavatāṃ dāśuṣe mama ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for prosperity and happiness
Anumati approve to-day our sacrifice among the Gods!
May Agni bear mine offerings away for me the worshipper.
Do thou, Anumati! approve, and grant us health and happiness.
Accept the offered sacrifice, and, Goddess, give us progeny.
May he approving in return accord us wealth inexhaustible with store of children.
Never may we be subject to his anger, but rest in his benevo-lence and mercy.
Thy name is easy to invoke, good leader! approved, Anumati and rich in bounty.
Source of all bonds! fill up therewith our worship, and, Blest One! grant us wealth with goodly heroes.
Anumati hath come to this our worship well-formed to give good lands and valiant heroes:
For her kind care hath blessed us. God-protected, may she assist the sacrifice we offer.
Anumati became this All, whatever standeth or walketh, every-thing that moveth.
May we enjoy thy gracious love, O Goddess. Regard us, O Anu-mati, with favour.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्विद॑नुमते॒ त्वं मंस॑से॒ शं च॑ नस्कृधि ।
जुष॒स्व॑ ह॒व्यमाहु॑तं प्र॒जां दे॑वि ररास्व नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
anvidanumate tvaṃ maṃsase śaṃ ca naskṛdhi |
juṣasva havyamāhutaṃ prajāṃ devi rarāsva naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अनु॑ मन्यतामनु॒मन्य॑मानः प्र॒जाव॑न्तं र॒यिमक्षी॑यमाणम् ।
तस्य॑ व॒यं हेड॑सि॒ मापि॑ भूम सुमृडी॒के अ॑स्य सुम॒तौ स्या॑म ॥
verses.transliteration:
anu manyatāmanumanyamānaḥ prajāvantaṃ rayimakṣīyamāṇam |
tasya vayaṃ heḍasi māpi bhūma sumṛḍīke asya sumatau syāma ||

verses.sanskrit:
यत् ते॒ नाम॑ सु॒हवं॑ सुप्रणी॒तेऽनु॑मते॒ अनु॑मतं सु॒दानु॑ ।
तेना॑ नो य॒ज्ञं पि॑पृहि विश्ववारे र॒यिं नो॑ धेहि सुभगे सु॒वीर॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yat te nāma suhavaṃ supraṇīte'numate anumataṃ sudānu |
tenā no yajñaṃ pipṛhi viśvavāre rayiṃ no dhehi subhage suvīram ||

verses.sanskrit:
एमं य॒ज्ञमनु॑मतिर्जगाम सुक्षे॒त्रता॑यै सुवी॒रता॑यै सुजा॑तम् ।
भ॒द्रा ह्यऽस्याः॒ प्रम॑तिर्ब॒भूव॒ सेमं य॒ज्ञम॑वतु दे॒वगो॑पा ॥
verses.transliteration:
emaṃ yajñamanumatirjagāma sukṣetratāyai suvīratāyai sujātam |
bhadrā hya'syāḥ pramatirbabhūva semaṃ yajñamavatu devagopā ||

verses.sanskrit:
अनु॑मतिः॒ सर्व॑मि॒दं ब॑भूव॒ यत् तिष्ठ॑ति॒ चर॑ति॒ यदु॑ च॒ विश्व॒मेज॑ति ।
तस्या॑स्ते देवि सुम॒तौ स्या॒मानु॑मते॒ अनु॒ हि मंस॑से नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
anumatiḥ sarvamidaṃ babhūva yat tiṣṭhati carati yadu ca viśvamejati |
tasyāste devi sumatau syāmānumate anu hi maṃsase naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒मेत॒ विश्वे॒ वच॑सा॒ पतिं॑ दि॒व एको॑ वि॒भूरति॑थि॒र्जना॑नाम् ।
स पू॒र्व्यो नूत॑नमा॒विवा॑सत् तं व॑र्त॒निरनु॑ वावृत॒ एक॒मित् पु॒रु ॥
verses.transliteration:
sameta viśve vacasā patiṃ diva eko vibhūratithirjanānām |
sa pūrvyo nūtanamāvivāsat taṃ vartaniranu vāvṛta ekamit puru ||
verses.translation:
A funeral stanza
With prayer come all together to the Lord of Heaven: he is the peerless one, far-reaching, guest of men.
He, God of ancient time, hath gained a recent thrall; to him alone is turned the path which all must tread.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒यं स॒हस्र॒मा नो॑ दृ॒शे क॑वी॒नां म॒तिर्ज्योति॒र्विध॑र्मणि ॥
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ sahasramā no dṛśe kavīnāṃ matirjyotirvidharmaṇi ||
verses.translation:
To Savitar, or Yama invested with Savitar’s attributes
Unto a thousand sages he hath given sight: thought, light is he in ranging all.
The Bright One hath sent forth the Dawns, a closely gathered band,
Immaculate, unanimous, brightly refulgent in their homes.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्र॒ध्नः स॒मीची॑रु॒षसः॒ समै॑रयन् ।
अ॒रे॒पसः॒ सचे॑तसः॒ स्वस॑रे मन्यु॒मत्त॑माश्चि॒ते गोः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bradhnaḥ samīcīruṣasaḥ samairayan |
arepasaḥ sacetasaḥ svasare manyumattamāścite goḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
दौष्व॑प्न्यं दौर्जी॑वित्यं॒ रक्षो॑ अ॒भ्वऽमरा॒य्यः ।
दु॒र्णाम्नीः॒ सर्वा॑ दु॒र्वाच॒स्ता अ॒स्मन्ना॑शयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
dauṣvapnyaṃ daurjīvityaṃ rakṣo abhva'marāyyaḥ |
durṇāmnīḥ sarvā durvācastā asmannāśayāmasi ||
verses.translation:
A charm to banish fiends and troubles
The fearful dream, and indigence, the monster, the malignant hags.
All female fiends of evil name and wicked tongue we drive afar.

verses.sanskrit:
यन्न॒ इन्द्रो॒ अख॑न॒द् यद॒ग्निर्विश्वे॑ दे॒वा म॒रुतो॒ यत् स्व॒र्काः ।
तद॒स्मभ्यं॑ सवि॒ता स॒त्यध॑र्मा प्र॒जाप॑ति॒रनु॑मति॒र्नि य॑च्छात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yanna indro akhanad yadagnirviśve devā maruto yat svarkāḥ |
tadasmabhyaṃ savitā satyadharmā prajāpatiranumatirni yacchāt ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for riches
What treasure hath been dug for us by Indra, by Agni, Visve-devas, tuneful Maruts,
On us may Savitar whose laws are faithful, Prajāpati, and Heavenly Grace bestow it.

verses.sanskrit:
ययो॒रोज॑सा स्कभि॒ता रजां॑सि॒ यौ वीर्यौऽर्वी॒रत॑मा॒ शवि॑ष्ठा ।
यौ पत्ये॑ते॒ अप्र॑तीतौ॒ सहो॑भि॒र्विष्णु॑मग॒न् वरु॑णं पू॒र्वहू॑तिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yayorojasā skabhitā rajāṃsi yau vīryau'rvīratamā śaviṣṭhā |
yau patyete apratītau sahobhirviṣṇumagan varuṇaṃ pūrvahūtiḥ ||
verses.translation:
Praise of Vishnu and Varuna
The early morning prayer hath come to Vishnu and Varuna,
Lords through might, whom none hath equalled,
Gods by whose power the realms of air were stablished, strongest and most heroic in their vigour.
The early prayer hath ever come to Vishnu and Varuna by that God’s high power and statute.
In whose control is all this world that shineth, all that hath powers to see and all that breatheth.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ये॒दं प्र॒दिशि॒ यद् वि॒रोच॑ते॒ प्र चान॑ति॒ वि च॒ चष्टे॒ शची॑भिः ।
पु॒रा दे॒वस्य॒ धर्म॑णा॒ सहो॑भि॒र्विष्णु॑मग॒न् वरु॑णं पू॒र्वहू॑तिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasyedaṃ pradiśi yad virocate pra cānati vi ca caṣṭe śacībhiḥ |
purā devasya dharmaṇā sahobhirviṣṇumagan varuṇaṃ pūrvahūtiḥ ||
