verses.sanskrit:
विष्णो॒र्नु कं॒ प्रा वो॑चं वी॒र्याऽणि॒ यः पार्थि॑वानि विम॒मे रजां॑सि ।
यो अस्क॑भाय॒दुत्त॑रं स॒धस्थं॑ विचक्रमा॒णस्त्रे॒धोरु॑गा॒यः ॥
verses.transliteration:
viṣṇornu kaṃ prā vocaṃ vīryā'ṇi yaḥ pārthivāni vimame rajāṃsi |
yo askabhāyaduttaraṃ sadhasthaṃ vicakramāṇastredhorugāyaḥ ||
verses.translation:
Praise of Vishnu
I will declare the mighty deeds of Vishnu, of him who measured out the earthly regions,
Who propped the highest place of congregation, thrice setting down his footstep, widely striding.
Loud boast doth Vishnu make of this achievement, like some wild beast, dread, prowling, mountain-roaming.
May he approach us from the farthest distance.
Thou within whose three wide-extended paces all worlds and creatures have their habitation,
Drink oil, thou homed in oil! promote the sacrificer more and more.
Through all this world strode Vishnu: thrice his foot he planted, and the whole Was gathered in his footstep’s dust.
Vishnu the guardian, he whom none deceiveth, made three steps, thenceforth.
Establishing these high decrees.
Look ye on Vishnu’s works, whereby the friend of Indra, close-allied,
Hath let his holy ways be seen.
The princes evermore behold that loftiest place where Vishnu is,
Like an extended eye in heaven,
From heaven, O Vishnu, or from earth, O Vishnu, or from the great far-spreading air’s midregion,
Fill both thy hands full of abundant treasures, and from the right and left bestow them freely.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र तद् विष्णु॑ स्तवते वी॒र्याऽणि मृ॒गो न भी॒मः कु॑च॒रो गि॑रि॒ष्ठाः ।
प॒रा॒वत॒ आ ज॑गम्या॒त् पर॑स्याः ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra tad viṣṇu stavate vīryā'ṇi mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ |
parāvata ā jagamyāt parasyāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्यो॒रुषु॑ त्रि॒षु वि॒क्रम॑नेष्वधिक्षि॒यन्ति॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
उ॒रु वि॑ष्णो॒ वि क्र॑मस्वो॒रु क्षया॑य नस्कृधि ।
घृ॒तं घृ॑तयोने पिब॒ प्रप्र॑ य॒ज्ञप॑तिं तिर ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaneṣvadhikṣiyanti bhuvanāni viśvā |
uru viṣṇo vi kramasvoru kṣayāya naskṛdhi |
ghṛtaṃ ghṛtayone piba prapra yajñapatiṃ tira ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं विष्णु॒र्वि च॑क्रमे त्रे॒धा नि द॑धे प॒दा ।
समू॑ढमस्य पांसु॒रे ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ viṣṇurvi cakrame tredhā ni dadhe padā |
samūḍhamasya pāṃsure ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्रीणि॑ प॒दा वि च॑क्रमे॒ विष्णु॑र्गो॒पा अदा॑भ्यः ।
इ॒तो धर्मा॑णि धा॒रय॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
trīṇi padā vi cakrame viṣṇurgopā adābhyaḥ |
ito dharmāṇi dhārayan ||

verses.sanskrit:
विष्णोः॒ कर्मा॑णि पश्यत॒ यतो॑ व्र॒तानि॑ पस्प॒शे ।
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ युज्यः॒ सखा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe |
indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
तद् विष्णोः॑ पर॒मं प॒दं सदा॑ पश्यन्ति सू॒रयः॑ ।
दि॒वीऽव॒ चक्षु॒रात॑तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ |
divī'va cakṣurātatam ||

verses.sanskrit:
दि॒वो वि॑ष्ण उ॒त वा॑ पृथि॒व्या म॒हो वि॑ष्ण उ॒रोर॒न्तरि॑क्षात् ।
हस्तौ॑ पृणस्व ब॒हुभि॑र्व॒सव्यै॑रा॒प्रय॑च्छ॒ दक्षि॑णा॒दोत स॒व्यात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
divo viṣṇa uta vā pṛthivyā maho viṣṇa urorantarikṣāt |
hastau pṛṇasva bahubhirvasavyairāprayaccha dakṣiṇādota savyāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
इडै॒वास्मां अनु॑ वस्तां व्र॒तेन॒ यस्याः॑ प॒दे पु॒नते॑ देव॒यन्तः॑ ।
घृ॒तप॑दी॒ शक्व॑री॒ सोम॑पृ॒ष्ठोप॑ य॑ज्ञम॑स्थित वैश्वदे॒वी ॥
verses.transliteration:
iḍaivāsmāṃ anu vastāṃ vratena yasyāḥ pade punate devayantaḥ |
ghṛtapadī śakvarī somapṛṣṭhopa yajñamasthita vaiśvadevī ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to Ida, Goddess of devotion
May Idā with her statute dwell beside us, she in whose place the pious purge and cleanse them.
She, mighty, Soma-decked, whose foot drops fatness, meet for All-Gods, hath come to aid our worship.

verses.sanskrit:
वे॒दः स्व॒स्तिर्द्रु॑घ॒णः स्व॒स्तिः प॑र॒शुर्वेदिः॑ पर॒शुर्नः॑ स्व॒स्ति ।
ह॒वि॒ष्कृतो॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑ य॒ज्ञका॑मा॒स्ते दे॒वासो॑ य॒ज्ञमि॒मं जु॑षन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vedaḥ svastirdrughaṇaḥ svastiḥ paraśurvediḥ paraśurnaḥ svasti |
haviṣkṛto yajñiyā yajñakāmāste devāso yajñamimaṃ juṣantām ||
verses.translation:
Praise of the sacrificial utensils
Blest be the Broom, may the Mace bring a blessing, and may the Altar and the Hatchet bless us.
Worshipful Gods, may they accept this worship, lovers of sacri-fice, and sacrificers.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ना॑विष्णू॒ महि॒ तद् वां॑ महि॒त्व पा॒थो घृ॒तस्य॒ गुह्य॑स्य॒ नाम॑ ।
दमे॑दमे स॒प्त रत्ना॒ दधा॑नौ॒ प्रति॑ वां जि॒ह्वा घृ॒तमा च॑रण्यात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnāviṣṇū mahi tad vāṃ mahitva pātho ghṛtasya guhyasya nāma |
damedame sapta ratnā dadhānau prati vāṃ jihvā ghṛtamā caraṇyāt ||
verses.translation:
To Agni and Vishnu
This is your glorious might, Agni and Vishnu! Ye drink the essence of the mystic butter.
Placing in every home seven costly treasures. Let your tongue stretch to take the offered fatness.
Ye love the great law, Agni Vishnu! joying, ye feast on mystic essences of butter,
Exalted in each house with fair laudation. Let your tongue stretch to take the offered fatness.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ना॑विष्णू॒ महि॒ धाम॑ प्रि॒यं॑ वां॑ वी॒थो घृ॒तस्य॒ गुह्या॑ जुषा॒णौ ।
दमे॑दमे सुष्टु॒त्या वा॑वृधा॒नौ प्रति॑ वां जि॒ह्वा घृ॒तमुच्च॑रण्यात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnāviṣṇū mahi dhāma priyaṃ vāṃ vītho ghṛtasya guhyā juṣāṇau |
damedame suṣṭutyā vāvṛdhānau prati vāṃ jihvā ghṛtamuccaraṇyāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
स्वाक्तं॑ मे॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी स्वाक्तं॑ मि॒त्रो अ॑कर॒यम् ।
स्वाक्तं॑ मे॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिः॒ स्वाक्तं॑ सवि॒ता क॑रत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
svāktaṃ me dyāvāpṛthivī svāktaṃ mitro akarayam |
svāktaṃ me brahmaṇaspatiḥ svāktaṃ savitā karat ||
verses.translation:
A charm to be used when the eyes are anointed
Heaven, Earth, and Mitra here have caused mine eyes to be-anointed well,
Savitar, Brāhmanaspati take care that they be duly balmed!

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रो॒तिभि॑र्बहु॒लाभि॑र्नो अ॒द्य या॑वच्छ्रे॒ष्ठाभि॑र्मघवन्छूर जिन्व ।
यो नो॒ द्वेष्ट्यध॑र॒ सस्प॑दीष्ट॒ यमु॑ द्वि॒ष्मस्तमु॑ प्रा॒णो ज॑हातु ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrotibhirbahulābhirno adya yāvacchreṣṭhābhirmaghavanchūra jinva |
yo no dveṣṭyadhara saspadīṣṭa yamu dviṣmastamu prāṇo jahātu ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for the overthrow of enemies
Rouse us to-day O Indra, Maghavan, hero, with thy best pos-sible and varied succours,
May he who hateth us fall low beneath us, and him whom we detest let life abandon.

verses.sanskrit:
उप॑ प्रि॒यं पनि॑प्नतं युवा॑नमाहुती॒वृध॑म् ।
अग॑न्म॒ बिभ्र॑तो॒ नमो॑ दी॒र्घमायुः॑ कृणोतु मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
upa priyaṃ panipnataṃ yuvānamāhutīvṛdham |
aganma bibhrato namo dīrghamāyuḥ kṛṇotu me ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to Agni for long life
We bringing homage have approached the friend who seeks our wondering praise,
Young, strengthener of the sacrifice. May he bestow long life on me.

verses.sanskrit:
सं मा॑ सिञ्चन्तु म॒रुतः॒ सं पू॒षा सं बृह॒स्पतिः॑ ।
सं मा॒यम॒ग्निः सि॑ञ्चतु प्र॒जया॑ च॒ धने॑न च दी॒र्घमायुः॑ कृणोतु मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ mā siñcantu marutaḥ saṃ pūṣā saṃ bṛhaspatiḥ |
saṃ māyamagniḥ siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca dīrghamāyuḥ kṛṇotu me ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for long life, children, and riches
Let Pūshan, let the Maruts, let Brihaspati pour forth on me;
This present Agni pour on me children and riches in a stream!
May he bestow long life on me.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॑ जा॒तान् प्र णु॑दा मे स॒पत्ना॒न् प्रत्यजा॑तान् जातवेदो नुदस्व ।
अ॒ध॒स्प॒दं कृ॑णुष्व॒ ये पृ॑त॒न्यवोऽना॑गस॒स्ते व॒यमदि॑तये स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne jātān pra ṇudā me sapatnān pratyajātān jātavedo nudasva |
adhaspadaṃ kṛṇuṣva ye pṛtanyavo'nāgasaste vayamaditaye syāma ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for freedom from sin and the overthrow of enemies
Agni, drive off my rivals born and living, repel those yet unborn,
O Jātavedas.
Cast down beneath my feet mine adversaries. In Aditi’s regard may we be sinless.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रान्यान्त्स॒पत्ना॒न्त्सह॑सा॒ सह॑स्व॒ प्रत्यजा॑तान् जातवेदो नुदस्व ।
इ॒दं रा॒ष्ट्रं पि॑पृ॒हि सौभ॑गाय॒ विश्व॑ एन॒मनु॑ मदन्तु दे॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
prānyāntsapatnāntsahasā sahasva pratyajātān jātavedo nudasva |
idaṃ rāṣṭraṃ pipṛhi saubhagāya viśva enamanu madantu devāḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for the prosperity of a King and his kingdom
Subdue with conquering might his other rivals, those yet unborn repel, O Jātavedas.
For great felicity protect this kingdom, and in this man let all the Gods be joyful.
Hae quot tibi sunt venae atque arteriae harum omnium os tibi lapide occlusi.
Uteri tui summam partem inferam facio: ne tibi soboles neque filius eveniat. Sterilem et infecundam te facio: lapidem tuum, operimentum facio.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मा यास्ते॑ श॒तं हि॒राः स॒हस्रं॑ ध॒मनी॑रु॒त ।
तासां॑ ते॒ सर्वा॑साम॒हमश्म॑ना॒ बिल॒मप्य॑धाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
imā yāste śataṃ hirāḥ sahasraṃ dhamanīruta |
tāsāṃ te sarvāsāmahamaśmanā bilamapyadhām ||

verses.sanskrit:
परं॒ योने॒रव॑रं ते कृणोमि॒ मा त्वा॑ प्र॒जाभि भू॒न्मोत सूनुः॑ ।
अ॒स्वं॑१ त्वाप्र॑जसं कृणो॒म्यश्मा॑नं ते अपि॒धानं कृणोमि ॥
verses.transliteration:
paraṃ yoneravaraṃ te kṛṇomi mā tvā prajābhi bhūnmota sūnuḥ |
asvaṃ tvāprajasaṃ kṛṇomyaśmānaṃ te apidhānaṃ kṛṇomi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒क्ष्यौऽनौ॒ मधु॑संकाशे॒ अनी॑कं नौ स॒मञ्ज॑नम् ।
अ॒न्तः कृ॑ष्णुष्व॒ मां हृ॒दि मन॒ इन्नौ॑ स॒हास॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
akṣyau'nau madhusaṃkāśe anīkaṃ nau samañjanam |
antaḥ kṛṣṇuṣva māṃ hṛdi mana innau sahāsati ||
verses.translation:
A charm to be pronounced by bride and bridegroom
Sweet are the glances of our eyes, our faces are as smooth as balm,
Within thy bosom harbour me; one spirit dwell in both of us!

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भि त्वा॒ मनु॑जातेन॒ दधा॑मि॒ मम॒ वास॑सा ।
यथासो॒ मम॒ केव॑लो॒ नान्यासां॑ की॒र्तया॑श्च॒न ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhi tvā manujātena dadhāmi mama vāsasā |
yathāso mama kevalo nānyāsāṃ kīrtayāścana ||
verses.translation:
A nuptial charm to be spoken by the bride
With this my robe, inherited from Manu, I envelop thee,
So that thou mayst be all mine own and give no thought to other dames.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं ख॑नामि भेष॒जं मां॑प॒श्यम॑भिरोरु॒दम् ।
प॒रा॒य॒तो नि॒वर्त॑नमाय॒तः प्र॑ति॒नन्द॑नम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ khanāmi bheṣajaṃ māṃpaśyamabhirorudam |
parāyato nivartanamāyataḥ pratinandanam ||
verses.translation:
A maiden’s love-charm
I dig this Healing Herb that makes my lover look on me and weep;
That bids the parting friend return and kindly greets him as he comes.
This Herb wherewith the Asuri drew Indra downward from the Gods,
With this same Herb I draw thee close that I may be most dear to thee.
Thou art the peer of Soma, yea, thou art the equal of the Sun, The peer of all the Gods art thou: therefore we call thee hither— ward.
I am the speaker here, not thou: speak thou where the assembly meets.
Thou shalt be mine and only mine, and never mention other dames.
If thou art far away beyond the rivers, far away from men,
This Herb shall seem to bind thee fast and bring thee back my prisoner.

verses.sanskrit:
येना॑ निच॒क्र आ॑सु॒रीन्द्रं॑ दे॒वेभ्य॒स्परि॑ ।
तेना॒ नि कु॑र्वे॒ त्वाम॒हं यथा॒ तेऽसा॑नि॒ सुप्रि॑या ॥
verses.transliteration:
yenā nicakra āsurīndraṃ devebhyaspari |
tenā ni kurve tvāmahaṃ yathā te'sāni supriyā ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒तीची॒ सोम॑मसि प्र॒तीच्यु॒त सूर्य॑म् ।
प्र॒तीची॒ विश्वा॑न् दे॒वान् तां त्वा॒च्छाव॑दामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
pratīcī somamasi pratīcyuta sūryam |
pratīcī viśvān devān tāṃ tvācchāvadāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒हं व॑दामि॒ नेत् त्वं स॒भाया॒मह॒ त्वं वद॑ ।
ममेदस॒स्त्वं केव॑लो॒ नान्यासां॑ की॒र्तया॑श्च॒न ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahaṃ vadāmi net tvaṃ sabhāyāmaha tvaṃ vada |
mamedasastvaṃ kevalo nānyāsāṃ kīrtayāścana ||

verses.sanskrit:
यदि॒ वासि॑ तिरोज॒नं यदि॑ वा न॒द्यऽस्ति॒रः ।
इ॒यं ह॒ मह्यं॒ त्वामोष॑धिर्ब॒द्ध्वेव॒ न्यान॑यत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadi vāsi tirojanaṃ yadi vā nadya'stiraḥ |
iyaṃ ha mahyaṃ tvāmoṣadhirbaddhveva nyānayat ||

verses.sanskrit:
दि॒व्यं सु॑प॒र्णं प॑य॒सं बृ॒हन्त॑म॒पां गर्भं॑ वृष॒भमोष॑धीनाम् ।
अ॒भी॒प॒तो वृ॒ष्ट्या त॒र्पय॑न्त॒मा नो॑ गो॒ष्ठे र॑यि॒ष्ठां स्था॑पयाति ॥
verses.transliteration:
divyaṃ suparṇaṃ payasaṃ bṛhantamapāṃ garbhaṃ vṛṣabhamoṣadhīnām |
abhīpato vṛṣṭyā tarpayantamā no goṣṭhe rayiṣṭhāṃ sthāpayāti ||
verses.translation:
A sacrificial charm for rain and prosperity
May he establish in our home the master of riches, gladdening with rain in season,
Mighty, strong-winged, celestial, dropping moisture, Bull of the plants and embryo of waters.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य॑ व्र॒तं प॒शवो॒ यन्ति॒ सर्वे॒ यस्य॑ व्र॒त उ॑प॒तिष्ठ॑न्त॒ आपः॑ ।
यस्य॑ व्र॒ते पु॑ष्ट॒पति॒र्निवि॑ष्ट॒स्तं सर॑स्वन्त॒मव॑से हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasya vrataṃ paśavo yanti sarve yasya vrata upatiṣṭhanta āpaḥ |
yasya vrate puṣṭapatirniviṣṭastaṃ sarasvantamavase havāmahe ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for prosperity
We call Sarasvān, under whose protection all cattle wander, to preserve and aid us,
Him in whose ordinance abide the waters, to whose command the Lord of Plenty listens.
Abiding here let us invoke Sarasvān, the seat of riches, glorious, wealth-increaser,
Him who inclines and gives to him who worships, the rich pos-sessor and the Lord of Fulness.

verses.sanskrit:
आ प्र॒त्यञ्चं॑ दा॒शुषे॑ दा॒श्वंसं॒ सर॑स्वन्तं पुष्ट॒पतिं॑ रयि॒ष्ठाम् ।
रा॒यस्पोषं॑ श्रव॒स्युं वसा॑ना इ॒ह हुवेम॒ सद॑नं रयी॒णाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā pratyañcaṃ dāśuṣe dāśvaṃsaṃ sarasvantaṃ puṣṭapatiṃ rayiṣṭhām |
rāyaspoṣaṃ śravasyuṃ vasānā iha huvema sadanaṃ rayīṇām ||

verses.sanskrit:
अति॒ धन्वा॒न्यत्य॒पस्त॑तर्द श्ये॒नो नृ॒चक्षा॑ अवसानद॒र्शः ।
तर॒न् विश्वा॒न्यव॑रा॒ रजां॒सीन्द्रे॑ण॒ सख्या॑ शि॒व आ ज॑गम्यात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ati dhanvānyatyapastatarda śyeno nṛcakṣā avasānadarśaḥ |
taran viśvānyavarā rajāṃsīndreṇa sakhyā śiva ā jagamyāt ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for prosperity
Observing men, and viewing home, the Falcon hath cleft his swift way over wastes and waters.
May he, with Indra for a friend, auspicious, traversing all air’s lower realms, come hither.
The heavenly Falcon, viewing men, well-pinioned, strength-giver, hundred-footed, hundrednested,
Shall give us treasure which was taken from us. May it be rich in food among our Fathers.

verses.sanskrit:
श्ये॒नो नृ॒चक्षा॑ दि॒व्यः सु॑प॒र्णः स॒हस्र॑पाच्छ॒तयो॑निर्वयो॒धाः ।
स नो॒ नि य॑च्छाद् वसु॒ यत् परा॑भृतम॒स्माक॑मस्तु पि॒तृषु॑ स्व॒धाव॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śyeno nṛcakṣā divyaḥ suparṇaḥ sahasrapācchatayonirvayodhāḥ |
sa no ni yacchād vasu yat parābhṛtamasmākamastu pitṛṣu svadhāvat ||

verses.sanskrit:
सोमा॑रुद्रा॒ वि वृ॑हतं॒ विषू॑ची॒ममी॑ वा॒ या नो॒ गय॑मावि॒वेश॑ ।
बाधे॑थां दू॒रं निरृ॑तिं परा॒चैः कृ॒तं चि॒देनः॒ प्र मु॑मुक्तम॒स्मत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
somārudrā vi vṛhataṃ viṣūcīmamī vā yā no gayamāviveśa |
bādhethāṃ dūraṃ nirṛtiṃ parācaiḥ kṛtaṃ cidenaḥ pra mumuktamasmat ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for delivery from sin and sickness
Scatter and drive away, Soma and Rudra, the sickness that hath come within our dwelling,
Afar into the distance chase Destruction, and even from commit-ted sin release us.
Lay on our bodies, O ye twain, O Soma and Rudra, all those balms that heal diseases.
Set free and draw away the sin committed, which we have still inherent in our persons.

verses.sanskrit:
सोमा॑रुद्रा यु॒वमे॒तान्य॒स्मद् विश्वा॑ त॒नूषु॑ भेष॒जानि॑ धत्तम् ।
अव॑ स्यतं मु॒ञ्चतं॒ यन्नो॒ अस॑त् त॒नूषु॑ ब॒द्धं कृ॒तमेनो॑ अ॒स्मत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
somārudrā yuvametānyasmad viśvā tanūṣu bheṣajāni dhattam |
ava syataṃ muñcataṃ yanno asat tanūṣu baddhaṃ kṛtameno asmat ||

verses.sanskrit:
शि॒वास्त॒ एका॒ अशि॑वास्त॒ एकाः॒ सर्वा॑ बिभर्षि सुमन॒स्यमा॑नः ।
ति॒स्रो वाचो॒ निहि॑ता अ॒न्तर॒स्मिन् तासा॒मेका॒ वि प॑पा॒तानु॒ घोष॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śivāsta ekā aśivāsta ekāḥ sarvā bibharṣi sumanasyamānaḥ |
tisro vāco nihitā antarasmin tāsāmekā vi papātānu ghoṣam ||
verses.translation:
A charm against lightning
Some of thy words bode weal and some misfortune: thou scat-terest them all with friendly feeling.
Deep within this three words are laid: among them one hath flown off even as the sound was uttered.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒भा जि॑ग्यथु॒र्न परा॑ जयेथे॒ न परा॑ जिग्ये कत॒रश्च॒नैन॑योः ।
इन्द्र॑श्च विष्णो॒ यदप॑स्पृधेथां त्रे॒धा स॒हस्रं॒ वि तदै॑रयेथाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ubhā jigyathurna parā jayethe na parā jigye kataraścanainayoḥ |
indraśca viṣṇo yadapaspṛdhethāṃ tredhā sahasraṃ vi tadairayethām ||
verses.translation:
In praise of Indra and Vishnu
Ye twain have conquered, and have not been vanquished: not either of the pair hath been defeated.
Ye, Indra Vishnu, when ye fought your battle; produced this infinite with three divisions.

verses.sanskrit:
जना॑द् विश्वज॒नीना॑त् सिन्धु॒तस्पर्याभृ॑तम् ।
दू॒रात् त्वा॑ मन्य॒ उद्भृ॑तमी॒र्ष्याया॒ नाम॑ भेष॒जम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
janād viśvajanīnāt sindhutasparyābhṛtam |
dūrāt tvā manya udbhṛtamīrṣyāyā nāma bheṣajam ||
verses.translation:
A charm against jealousy
Brought hitherward from Sindhu, from a folk of every mingled race,
Fetched from afar, thou art I deem, a balm that cureth. jealousy.
As one with water quencheth fire, so calm this lover’s jealousy,
Like heat of fire that burneth here, or flame that rageth through the wood.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्नेरि॑वास्य॒ दह॑तो दा॒वस्य॒ दह॑तः॒ पृथ॑क् ।
ए॒तामे॒तस्ये॒र्ष्यामु॒द्राग्निमि॑व शमय ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnerivāsya dahato dāvasya dahataḥ pṛthak |
etāmetasyerṣyāmudrāgnimiva śamaya ||

verses.sanskrit:
सिनी॑वालि॒ पृथु॑ष्टुके॒ या दे॒वाना॒मसि॒ स्वसा॑ ।
जु॒षस्व॑ ह॒व्यमाहु॑तं प्र॒जां दे॑वि दिदिड्ढि नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sinīvāli pṛthuṣṭuke yā devānāmasi svasā |
juṣasva havyamāhutaṃ prajāṃ devi didiḍḍhi naḥ ||
verses.translation:
A charm for offspring and prosperity
O broad-tressed Sinivāli, thou who art the sister of the Gods,
Accept the offered sacrifice, and, Goddess, grant us progeny.
Present the sacrifice to her, to Sinivāli, Queen of men, Beauti-ful-fingered, lovely-armed, prolific, bearing many a child.
Thou who as Queen of men art Indra’s equal, a Goddess coming with a thousand tresses,
To thee our sacrifices are performed, O Consort of Vishnu Goddess, urge thy Lord to bounty!

verses.sanskrit:
या सु॑बा॒हुः स्व॑ङ्गु॒रिः सु॒षूमा॑ बहु॒सूव॑री ।
तस्यै॑ वि॒श्पत्न्यै॑ ह॒विः सि॑नीवा॒ल्यै जु॑होतन ॥
verses.transliteration:
yā subāhuḥ svaṅguriḥ suṣūmā bahusūvarī |
tasyai viśpatnyai haviḥ sinīvālyai juhotana ||

verses.sanskrit:
या वि॒श्पत्नीन्द्र॒मसि॑ प्र॒तीची॑ स॒हस्र॑स्तुकाभि॒यन्ती॑ दे॒वी ।
विष्णोः॑ पत्नि॒ तुभ्यं॑ रा॒ता ह॒वींषि॒ पतिं॑ देवि॒ राध॑से चोदयस्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
yā viśpatnīndramasi pratīcī sahasrastukābhiyantī devī |
viṣṇoḥ patni tubhyaṃ rātā havīṃṣi patiṃ devi rādhase codayasva ||

verses.sanskrit:
कु॒हूं दे॒वीं सु॒कृतं॑ विद्म॒नाप॑सम॒स्मिन् य॒ज्ञे सु॒हवा॑ जोहवीमि ।
सा नो॑ र॒यिं वि॒श्ववा॑रं॒ नि यच्छाद् ददा॑तु वी॒रं श॒तदा॑यमु॒क्थ्यऽम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
kuhūṃ devīṃ sukṛtaṃ vidmanāpasamasmin yajñe suhavā johavīmi |
sā no rayiṃ viśvavāraṃ ni yacchād dadātu vīraṃ śatadāyamukthya'm ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for wealth and birth of a son
Oft in this sacrifice with favoured cry I call Kuhū, beneficent Goddess, skilled in all her works.
May she vouchsafe us wealth with every boon, and give a, hero meet for praise who gives a hundred gifts.
Kuhl), the Queen of Gods and immortality, called to assist, enjoy this sacrifice of’ ours!
Let her, desirous of our worship, hear to-day: may she, intelligent, give increase of our wealth.

verses.sanskrit:
कु॒हूर्दे॒वाना॑म॒मृत॑स्य॒ पत्नी॒ हव्या॑ नो अस्य ह॒विषो॑ जुषेत ।
शृ॒णोतु॑ य॒ज्ञमु॑श॒ती नो॑ अ॒द्य रा॒यस्पोषं॑ चिकि॒तुषी॑ दधातु ॥
verses.transliteration:
kuhūrdevānāmamṛtasya patnī havyā no asya haviṣo juṣeta |
śṛṇotu yajñamuśatī no adya rāyaspoṣaṃ cikituṣī dadhātu ||

verses.sanskrit:
रा॒काम॒हं सु॒हवा॑ सुष्टु॒ती हु॑वे शृ॒णोतु॑ नः सु॒भगा॑ बोध॑तु॒ त्मना॑ ।
सीव्य॒त्वपः॑ सू॒च्याच्छिद्यमानया॒ ददा॑तु वी॒रं श॒तदा॑यमु॒क्थ्यऽम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
rākāmahaṃ suhavā suṣṭutī huve śṛṇotu naḥ subhagā bodhatu tmanā |
sīvyatvapaḥ sūcyācchidyamānayā dadātu vīraṃ śatadāyamukthya'm ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for prosperity and the birth of a son
I call on Rākā with hair laud and reverent cry: may she, auspicious, hear us and herself observe.
With never-breaking needle may she sew her work, and send a glorious man who gives a hundred gifts.
All thy kind favours, Rākā! lovely in their form, wherewith thou grantest treasures to the man who gives,
With these come thou to us this day benevolent, O blessed one, bestowing wealth of thousand sorts.

verses.sanskrit:
यास्ते॑ राके सुम॒तयः॑ सु॑पेश॑सो॒ याभि॒र्ददा॑सि दा॒शुषे॒ वसू॑नि ।
ताभि॑र्नो अ॒द्य सु॒मना॑ उ॒पाग॑हि सहस्रापो॒षं सु॑भगे॒ ररा॑णा ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāste rāke sumatayaḥ supeśaso yābhirdadāsi dāśuṣe vasūni |
tābhirno adya sumanā upāgahi sahasrāpoṣaṃ subhage rarāṇā ||

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वानां॒ पत्नी॑रुश॒तीर॑वन्तु नः॒ प्राव॑न्तु नस्तु॒जये॒ वाज॑सातये ।
याः पार्थि॑वासो॒ या अ॒पामपि॑ व्र॒ते ता नो॑ देवीः सु॒हवाः॒ शर्म॑ यच्छन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
devānāṃ patnīruśatīravantu naḥ prāvantu nastujaye vājasātaye |
yāḥ pārthivāso yā apāmapi vrate tā no devīḥ suhavāḥ śarma yacchantu ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for children and booty
May the Gods’ Consorts aid us of their own free will, help us to offspring and the winning of the spoil.
May Goddesses who quickly listen shelter us, both those on earth and they within the waters’ realm.
May the Dames, wives of Gods, enjoy our presents, Rāt, Asvini Indrāni and Agnāyi;
May Rodasi and Varunāni hear us, and Goddesses come at the matrons’ season.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒त ग्ना व्य॑न्तु दे॒वप॑त्नीरिन्द्रा॒ण्य॑१ग्नाय्य॒श्विनी॒ राट् ।
आ रोद॑सी वरुणा॒नी शृ॑णोतु॒ व्यन्तु॑ दे॒वीर्य ऋ॒तुर्जनी॑नाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
uta gnā vyantu devapatnīrindrāṇyagnāyyaśvinī rāṭ |
ā rodasī varuṇānī śṛṇotu vyantu devīrya ṛturjanīnām ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॑ वृ॒क्षम॒शनि॑र्वि॒श्वाहा॒ हन्त्य॑प्र॒ति ।
ए॒वाहम॒द्य कि॑त॒वान॒क्षैर्ब॑ध्यासमप्र॒ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā vṛkṣamaśanirviśvāhā hantyaprati |
evāhamadya kitavānakṣairbadhyāsamaprati ||
verses.translation:
A gambler’s prayer for success in gaming
As evermore the lightning flash strikes, irresistible, the tree,
So, irresistible, may I conquer the gamblers with the dice.
From every side, from hale and sick, impotent to defend them-selves,
May all the fortune of the folk as winnings pass into my hands.
I pray to Agni, him who guards his treasure: here, won by homage, may he pile our winnings.
As ‘twere with racing cars I bring my presents: duly with reverence, let me laud the Maruts.
With thee to aid us may we win the treasure: do thou assist our side in every battle.
Give us wide room and easy way, O Indra; break down, O Maghavan, the foemen’s valour.
I have completely cleaned thee out, won from thee what thou keptest back.
As a wolf tears and rends a sheep, so do I tear thy stake away.
Yea, by superior play one gains advantage: in time he piles his spoil as doth a gambler.
He overwhelms with wealth’s inherent powers the devotee who keeps not back his riches.
May we all, much-invoked! repel with cattle want that brings sin, hunger with store of barley.
May we uninjured, first among the princes, obtain possessions by our own exertions.
My right hand holds my winnings fast, and in my left is victory.
I would that I were winner of cattle and horses, wealth and gold.
Dice, give me play that bringeth fruit as ‘twere a cow with flowing milk!
And, as the bowstring binds, the bow, unite me with a stream of gains.

verses.sanskrit:
तु॒राणा॒मतु॑राणां वि॒शामव॑र्जुषीणाम् ।
स॒मैतु॑ वि॒श्वतो॒ भगो॑ अन्तर्ह॒स्तं कृ॒तं मम॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
turāṇāmaturāṇāṃ viśāmavarjuṣīṇām |
samaitu viśvato bhago antarhastaṃ kṛtaṃ mama ||

verses.sanskrit:
ईडे॑ अग्निं स्वाव॑सुं॒ नमो॑भिरि॒ह प्र॑स॒क्तो वि च॑यत् कृ॒तं नः ।
रथै॑रिव॒ प्र भ॑रे वा॒जय॑द्भिः प्रदक्षि॒णं म॒रुतां॒ स्तोम॑मृध्याम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
īḍe agniṃ svāvasuṃ namobhiriha prasakto vi cayat kṛtaṃ naḥ |
rathairiva pra bhare vājayadbhiḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ marutāṃ stomamṛdhyām ||

verses.sanskrit:
व॒यं ज॑येम॒ त्वया॑ यु॒जा वृत॑म॒स्माक॒मंश॒मुद॑वा॒ भरे॑भरे ।
अ॒स्मभ्य॑मिन्द्र॒ वरी॑यः सु॒गं कृ॑धि॒ प्र शत्रू॑णां मघव॒न् वृष्ण्या॑ रुज ॥
verses.transliteration:
vayaṃ jayema tvayā yujā vṛtamasmākamaṃśamudavā bharebhare |
asmabhyamindra varīyaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi pra śatrūṇāṃ maghavan vṛṣṇyā ruja ||

verses.sanskrit:
अजै॑षं त्वा॒ संलि॑खित॒मजै॑षमु॒त सं॒रुध॑म् ।
अविं॒ वृको॒ यथा॒ मथ॑दे॒वा म॑थ्नामि ते कृ॒तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ajaiṣaṃ tvā saṃlikhitamajaiṣamuta saṃrudham |
aviṃ vṛko yathā mathadevā mathnāmi te kṛtam ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒त प्र॒हामति॑दीवा जयति कृ॒तमि॑व श्व॒घ्नी वि चि॑नोति का॒ले ।
यो दे॒वका॑मो॒ न धनं रु॒णद्धि॒ समित् तं रा॒यः सृ॑जति स्व॒धाभिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
uta prahāmatidīvā jayati kṛtamiva śvaghnī vi cinoti kāle |
yo devakāmo na dhanaṃ ruṇaddhi samit taṃ rāyaḥ sṛjati svadhābhiḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
गोभि॑ष्टरे॒माम॑तिं दु॒रेवां॒ यवे॑न वा॒ क्षुधं॑ पुरुहूत॒ विश्वे॑ ।
व॒यं राज॑सु प्रथ॒मा धना॒न्यरि॑ष्टासो वृज॒नीभि॑र्जयेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena vā kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśve |
vayaṃ rājasu prathamā dhanānyariṣṭāso vṛjanībhirjayema ||

verses.sanskrit:
कृ॒तं मे॒ दक्षि॑णे॒ हस्ते॑ ज॒यो मे॑ स॒व्य आहि॑तः ।
गो॒जिद् भू॑यासमश्व॒जिद् ध॑नंज॒यो हि॑रण्य॒जित् ॥
verses.transliteration:
kṛtaṃ me dakṣiṇe haste jayo me savya āhitaḥ |
gojid bhūyāsamaśvajid dhanaṃjayo hiraṇyajit ||

verses.sanskrit:
अक्षाः॒ फल॑वतीं॒ द्युवं॑ द॒त्त गां क्षी॒रिणी॑मिव ।
सं मा॑ कृ॒तस्य॒ धार॑या॒ धनुः॒ स्नाव्ने॑व नह्यत ॥
verses.transliteration:
akṣāḥ phalavatīṃ dyuvaṃ datta gāṃ kṣīriṇīmiva |
saṃ mā kṛtasya dhārayā dhanuḥ snāvneva nahyata ||

verses.sanskrit:
बृह॒स्पति॑र्नः॒ परि॑ पातु प॒श्चादु॒तोत्त॑रस्मा॒दध॑रादघा॒योः ।
इन्द्रः॑ पु॒रस्ता॑दु॒त म॑ध्य॒तो नः॒ सखा॒ सखि॑भ्यो॒ वरी॑यः॒ कृणोतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ |
indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varīyaḥ kṛṇotu ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for Brihaspati’s and Indra’s protection
Brihaspati protect us from the sinner, from rearward, from above, and from below us!
May Indra from the front and from the centre, as friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.

verses.sanskrit:
सं॒ज्ञानं॑ नः॒ स्वेभिः॑ सं॒ज्ञान॒मर॑णेभिः ।
सं॒ज्ञान॑मश्विना यु॒वमि॒हास्मासु॒ नि य॑च्छतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃjñānaṃ naḥ svebhiḥ saṃjñānamaraṇebhiḥ |
saṃjñānamaśvinā yuvamihāsmāsu ni yacchatam ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for peace and concord
Give us agreement with our own, with strangers give us unity:
Do ye, O Asvins, in this place join us in sympathy and love.
May we agree in mind, agree in purpose: let us not fight against the heavenly spirit.
Around us rise no din of frequent slaughter, nor Indra’s arrow fly, for day is present!

verses.sanskrit:
सं जा॑नामहै॒ मन॑सा॒ सं चि॑कि॒त्वा मा यु॑ष्महि॒ मन॑सा॒ दैव्ये॑न ।
मा घोषा॒ उत् स्थु॑र्बहु॒ले वि॒निर्ह॑ते॒ मेषुः॑ पप्त॒दिन्द्र॒स्याह॒न्याग॑ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ jānāmahai manasā saṃ cikitvā mā yuṣmahi manasā daivyena |
mā ghoṣā ut sthurbahule vinirhate meṣuḥ paptadindrasyāhanyāgate ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒मु॒त्र॒भूया॒दधि॒ यद् य॒मस्य॒ बृह॑स्पतेर॒भिश॑स्तेर॑मुञ्चः ।
प्रत्यौ॑हताम॒श्विना॑ मृ॒त्युम॒स्मद् दे॒वाना॑मग्ने भि॒षजा॒ शची॑भिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
amutrabhūyādadhi yad yamasya bṛhaspaterabhiśasteramuñcaḥ |
pratyauhatāmaśvinā mṛtyumasmad devānāmagne bhiṣajā śacībhiḥ ||
verses.translation:
A charm to recover a sick man at the point of death
As thou, Brihaspati, from the curse hast saved us, from dwel-ling yonder in the realm of Yama,
The Asvins, leeches of the Gods, O Agni, have chased Death far from us with mighty powers.
Move both together; do not leave the body. Let both the breathings stay for thee united.
Waxing in strength live thou a hundred autumns. Thy noblest guardian and thy lord is Agni.
Return, thy life now vanished into distance! Return, the breath thou drawest and exhalest!
Agni hath snatched it from Destruction’s bosom: into thyself again I introduce it.
Let not the vital breath he draws forsake him, let not his expiration part and leave him.
I give him over to the Seven Rishis: let them conduct him to old age in safety.
Enter him, both ye breaths, like two draught-oxen entering their stall.
Let him, the treasure of old age, still wax in strength, uninjured,. here.
I send thee back thy vital breath; I drive Consumption far from thee,
May Agni here, most excellent, sustain our life on every side.
From out the depth of darkness, we, ascending to the highest heaven,
Have come to the sublimest light, to Sūrya, God among the.
Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
सं क्रा॑मतं॒ मा ज॑हीतं॒ शरी॑रं प्राणापा॒नौ ते॑ स॒युजा॑वि॒ह स्ता॑म् ।
श॒तं जी॑व श॒रदो॒ वर्ध॑मानो॒ऽग्निष्टे॑ गो॒पा अ॑धि॒पा वसि॑ष्ठः ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ krāmataṃ mā jahītaṃ śarīraṃ prāṇāpānau te sayujāviha stām |
śataṃ jīva śarado vardhamāno'gniṣṭe gopā adhipā vasiṣṭhaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
आयु॒र्यत् ते॒ अति॑हितं परा॒चैर॑पा॒नः प्रा॒णः पुन॒रा तावि॑ताम् ।
अ॒ग्निष्टदाहा॒र्निरृ॑तेरु॒पस्था॒त् तदा॒त्मनि॒ पुन॒रा वे॑शयामि ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
āyuryat te atihitaṃ parācairapānaḥ prāṇaḥ punarā tāvitām |
agniṣṭadāhārnirṛterupasthāt tadātmani punarā veśayāmi te ||

verses.sanskrit:
मेमं प्रा॒णो हा॑सी॒न्मो अ॑पा॒नोऽव॒हाय॒ परा॑ गात् ।
स॒प्त॒र्षिभ्य॑ एनं॒ परि॑ ददामि॒ त ए॑नं स्व॒स्ति ज॒रसे॑ वहन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
memaṃ prāṇo hāsīnmo apāno'vahāya parā gāt |
saptarṣibhya enaṃ pari dadāmi ta enaṃ svasti jarase vahantu ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र वि॑शतं प्राणापानावन॒ड्वाहा॑विव व्र॒जम् ।
अ॒यं ज॑रि॒म्णः शे॑व॒धिररि॑ष्ट इ॒ह व॑र्धताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra viśataṃ prāṇāpānāvanaḍvāhāviva vrajam |
ayaṃ jarimṇaḥ śevadhirariṣṭa iha vardhatām ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ ते॑ प्रा॒णं सु॑वामसि॒ परा॒ यक्ष्मं॑ सुवामि ते ।
आयु॑र्नो वि॒श्वतो॑ दधद॒यम॒ग्निर्वरे॑ण्यः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā te prāṇaṃ suvāmasi parā yakṣmaṃ suvāmi te |
āyurno viśvato dadhadayamagnirvareṇyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
उद् व॒यं तम॑स॒स्परि॒ रोह॑न्तो॒ नाक॑मुत्त॒मम् ।
दे॒वं दे॑व॒त्रा सूर्य॒मग॑न्म॒ ज्योति॑रुत्त॒मम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ud vayaṃ tamasaspari rohanto nākamuttamam |
devaṃ devatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam ||

verses.sanskrit:
ऋचं॒ साम॑ यजामहे॒ याभ्यां॒ कर्मा॑णि कु॒र्वते॑ ।
ए॒ते सद॑सि राजतो य॒ज्ञं दे॒वेषु॑ यच्छतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛcaṃ sāma yajāmahe yābhyāṃ karmāṇi kurvate |
ete sadasi rājato yajñaṃ deveṣu yacchataḥ ||
verses.translation:
A charm to obtain knowledge of the Veda
We worship holy Verse and Song, by which they carry out their acts,
Shining in order’s seat these twain present the sacrifice to Gods.
As I have asked about Verse, Song, Sacrifice, strength, force,.
Yajus-text,
So never let this lore that I have sought forsake me, Lord of Might!

verses.sanskrit:
ऋचं॒ साम॒ यदप्रा॑क्षं ह॒विरोजो॑ यजु॒र्बल॑म् ।
ए॒ष मा॒ तस्मा॒न्मा हिं॑सी॒द् वेदः॑ पृ॒ष्टः श॑चीपते ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛcaṃ sāma yadaprākṣaṃ havirojo yajurbalam |
eṣa mā tasmānmā hiṃsīd vedaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ śacīpate ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये ते॒ पन्था॒नोऽव॑ दि॒वो येभि॒र्विश्व॒मैर॑यः ।
तेभिः॑ सुम्न॒या धे॑हि नो वसो ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye te panthāno'va divo yebhirviśvamairayaḥ |
tebhiḥ sumnayā dhehi no vaso ||
verses.translation:
A charm to ensure a prosperous journey
Thy downward paths from heaven, whereby thou hast raised all the world to life,
Give us in gracious love, good Lord!

verses.sanskrit:
तिर॑श्चिराजेरसि॒तात् पृदा॑कोः॒ परि॒ संभृ॑तम् ।
तत् क॒ङ्कप॑र्वणो वि॒षमि॒यं वी॒रुद॑नीनशत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tiraścirājerasitāt pṛdākoḥ pari saṃbhṛtam |
tat kaṅkaparvaṇo viṣamiyaṃ vīrudanīnaśat ||
verses.translation:
A charm against poisonous bites and stings
Whether it came from viper, from black snake or snake with transverse stripes,
Or Kankaparvan’s bite, this herb hath made the poison power-less.
Honey-born, honey-dropping, rich in honey, honeysweet, this herb,
Is medicine that heals the wound and kills the gnat that bites and stings.
Whatever bit, or sucked thy blood, we summon thence away from thee The ineffectual poison of the little sharply-stinging gnat.
Thou here who crookest wicked jaws, thou tortuous, jointless, limbless thing,
These jaws thou, Brāhmanaspati! shalt bend together like a reed.
This scorpion here that creeps along, low on the ground and powerless—
I have removed his poison and then utterly demolished him.
No strength in thy two arms hast thou, nor in thy head, nor in thy waist:
Then what is that small thing thou so viciously bearest in thy tail?
The emmets make a meal of thee and peahens tear and mangle thee:
All ye are crying out, In sooth the scorpion’s poison hath no strength.
Thou creature who inflictest wounds both with thy mouth and with thy tail,
No poison in thy mouth hast thou: what at thy tail’s root will there be?

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒यं वी॒रुन्मधु॑जाता मधु॒श्चुन्म॑धु॒ला म॒धूः ।
सा विह्रु॑तस्य भेष॒ज्यथो॑ मशक॒जम्भ॑नी ॥
verses.transliteration:
iyaṃ vīrunmadhujātā madhuścunmadhulā madhūḥ |
sā vihrutasya bheṣajyatho maśakajambhanī ||

verses.sanskrit:
यतो॑ द॒ष्टं यतो॑ धी॒तं तत॑स्ते॒ निर्ह्व॑यामसि ।
अ॒र्भस्य॑ तृप्रदं॒शिनो॑ म॒शक॑स्यार॒सं वि॒षम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yato daṣṭaṃ yato dhītaṃ tataste nirhvayāmasi |
arbhasya tṛpradaṃśino maśakasyārasaṃ viṣam ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यं यो व॒क्रो विप॑रु॒र्व्यऽङ्गो॒ मुखा॑नि व॒क्रा वृ॑जि॒ना कृ॒णोषि॑ ।
तानि॒ त्वं ब्र॑ह्मणस्पत इ॒षीका॑मिव॒ सं न॑मः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ayaṃ yo vakro viparurvya'ṅgo mukhāni vakrā vṛjinā kṛṇoṣi |
tāni tvaṃ brahmaṇaspata iṣīkāmiva saṃ namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒र॒सस्य॑ श॒र्कोट॑स्य नी॒चीन॑स्योप॒सर्प॑तः ।
वि॒षं ह्य॑१स्यादि॒ष्यथो॑ एनमजीजभम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
arasasya śarkoṭasya nīcīnasyopasarpataḥ |
viṣaṃ hyasyādiṣyatho enamajījabham ||

verses.sanskrit:
न ते॑ बा॒ह्वोर्बल॑मस्ति॒ न शी॒र्षे नोत म॑ध्य॒तः ।
अथ॒ किं पा॒पया॑मु॒या पुच्छे॑ बिभर्ष्यर्भ॒कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
na te bāhvorbalamasti na śīrṣe nota madhyataḥ |
atha kiṃ pāpayāmuyā pucche bibharṣyarbhakam ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒दन्ति॑ त्वा पि॒पीलि॑का॒ वि वृ॑श्चन्ति मयू॒र्यः ।
सर्वे॑ भल ब्रवाथ॒ शार्को॑टमर॒सं वि॒षम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
adanti tvā pipīlikā vi vṛścanti mayūryaḥ |
sarve bhala bravātha śārkoṭamarasaṃ viṣam ||

verses.sanskrit:
य उ॒भाभ्यां॑ प्र॒हर॑सि॒ पुच्छे॑न चा॒स्येऽन च ।
आ॒स्ये॒३ न ते॑ वि॒षं किमु॑ ते पुच्छ॒धाव॑सत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya ubhābhyāṃ praharasi pucchena cāsye'na ca |
āsye na te viṣaṃ kimu te pucchadhāvasat ||

verses.sanskrit:
यदा॒शसा॒ वद॑तो मे विचुक्षु॒भे यद् याच॑मानस्य॒ चर॑तो॒ जनाँ॒ अनु॑ ।
यदा॒त्मनि॑ त॒न्वोऽमे॒ विरि॑ष्टं॒ सर॑स्वती॒ तदा पृ॑णद् घृ॒तेन॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadāśasā vadato me vicukṣubhe yad yācamānasya carato janām̐ anu |
yadātmani tanvo'me viriṣṭaṃ sarasvatī tadā pṛṇad ghṛtena ||
verses.translation:
A charm for some physical disorder
Whatever trouble hath disturbed and shaken me—I speak with hope, I move, imploring, ‘mid the folk What harm my body in myself hath suffered, now let Sarasvati relieve with fatness.
Seven flow for him, the youth on whom the Maruts wait: the sons have taught the Father everlasting laws.
Both worlds are his: both shine belonging unto him. Both move together: both, as his possession thrive.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒प्त क्ष॑रन्ति॒ शिश॑वे म॒रुत्व॑ते पि॒त्रे पु॒त्रासो॒ अप्य॑वीवृतन्नृ॒तानि॑ ।
उ॒भे इद॑स्यो॒भे अ॑स्य राजत उ॒भे य॑तेते उ॒भे अस्य पुष्यतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sapta kṣaranti śiśave marutvate pitre putrāso apyavīvṛtannṛtāni |
ubhe idasyobhe asya rājata ubhe yatete ubhe asya puṣyataḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रा॑वरुणा सुतपावि॒मं सु॒तं सोमं॑ पिबतं॒ मद्यं॑ धृतव्रतौ ।
यु॒वो रथो॑ अध्व॒रो दे॒ववी॑तये॒ प्रति॒ स्वस॑र॒मुप॑ यातु पी॒तये॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrāvaruṇā sutapāvimaṃ sutaṃ somaṃ pibataṃ madyaṃ dhṛtavratau |
yuvo ratho adhvaro devavītaye prati svasaramupa yātu pītaye ||
verses.translation:
An invitation to Indra and Varuna
True to laws, Indra Varuna, drinkers of the juice, quaff this pressed Soma which shall give you rapturous joy!
Let sacrifice, your car, to entertain the Gods, approach its rest-ing-place that they may drink thereof.
O Indra Varuna, drink your fill, ye heroes, of this effectual and sweetest Soma.
This juice was shed by us that ye might quaff it. On this trimmed grass be seated and rejoice you.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रा॑वरुणा॒ मधु॑मत्तमस्य॒ वृष्णः॒ सोम॑स्य वृष॒णा वृ॑षेथाम् ।
इ॒दं वा॒मन्धः॒ परि॑षिक्तमा॒सद्या॒स्मिन् ब॒र्हिषि॑ मादयेथाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrāvaruṇā madhumattamasya vṛṣṇaḥ somasya vṛṣaṇā vṛṣethām |
idaṃ vāmandhaḥ pariṣiktamāsadyāsmin barhiṣi mādayethām ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो नः॒ शपा॒दश॑पतः॒ शप॑तो॒ यश्च॑ नः॒ शपा॑त् ।
वृ॒क्ष इ॑व वि॒द्युता॑ ह॒त आ मूला॒दनु॑ शुष्यतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo naḥ śapādaśapataḥ śapato yaśca naḥ śapāt |
vṛkṣa iva vidyutā hata ā mūlādanu śuṣyatu ||
verses.translation:
An imprecation
Like a tree struck by lightning may the man be withered from the root.
Who curseth us who curse not him, or, when we curse him. curseth us.

verses.sanskrit:
ऊर्जं॒ बिभ्र॑द् वसु॒वनिः॑ सुमे॒धा अघो॑रेण॒ चक्षु॑षा मि॒त्रिये॑ण ।
गृ॒हानैमि॑ सु॒मना॒ वन्द॑मानो॒ रम॑ध्वं॒ मा बि॑भीत॒ मत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ūrjaṃ bibhrad vasuvaniḥ sumedhā aghoreṇa cakṣuṣā mitriyeṇa |
gṛhānaimi sumanā vandamāno ramadhvaṃ mā bibhīta mat ||
verses.translation:
A parting traveller’s address to the houses of his village
I, prudent, bringing power, a treasure-winner, with amicable eye that strikes no terror,
Come, praising and kind-thoughted, to these houses: be not afraid of me, be glad and joyful.
Let these delightful Houses that are rich in power and store of milk,
Replete with wealth and standing firm, become aware of our approach.
These Houses we invoke, whereon the distant exile sets his thought,
Wherein dwells many a friendly heart: let them beware of our approach.
Thus greeted, ye of ample wealth, friends who enjoy delightful sweets.
Be ever free from hunger, free from thirst! Ye Houses, fear us not.
Kind greeting to the cattle here, kind greeting to the goats and sheep!
Then, of the food within our homes, kind greeting to the plea-sant drink!
Full of refreshment, full of charms, of laughter and felicity,
Be ever free from hunger, free from thirst! Ye Houses, fear us not.
Stay here, and come not after me: prosper in every form and shape.
With happy fortune will I come! Grow more abundant still through me!

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मे गृ॒हा म॑यो॒भुव॒ ऊर्ज॑स्वन्तः॒ पय॑स्वन्तः ।
पू॒र्णा वा॒मेन॒ तिष्ठ॑न्त॒स्ते नो॑ जानन्त्वाय॒तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ime gṛhā mayobhuva ūrjasvantaḥ payasvantaḥ |
pūrṇā vāmena tiṣṭhantaste no jānantvāyataḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
येषा॑म॒ध्येति॑ प्र॒वस॒न् येषु॑ सौमन॒सो ब॒हुः ।
गृ॒हानुप॑ ह्वयामहे॒ ते नो॑ जानन्त्वाय॒तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yeṣāmadhyeti pravasan yeṣu saumanaso bahuḥ |
gṛhānupa hvayāmahe te no jānantvāyataḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
उप॑हूता॒ भूरि॑धनाः॒ सखा॑यः स्वा॒दुसं॑मुदः ।
अ॒क्षु॒ध्या अ॑तृ॒ष्या स्त॒ गृहा॒ मास्मद् बि॑भीतन ॥
verses.transliteration:
upahūtā bhūridhanāḥ sakhāyaḥ svādusaṃmudaḥ |
akṣudhyā atṛṣyā sta gṛhā māsmad bibhītana ||

verses.sanskrit:
उप॑हूता इ॒ह गाव॒ उप॑हूता अजा॒वयः॑ ।
अथो॒ अन्न॑स्य की॒लाल॒ उप॑हूतो गृ॒हेषु॑ नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
upahūtā iha gāva upahūtā ajāvayaḥ |
atho annasya kīlāla upahūto gṛheṣu naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
सू॒नृता॑वन्तः सु॒भगा॒ इरा॑वन्तो हसामु॒दाः ।
अ॒तृ॒ष्या अ॑क्षु॒ध्या स्त॒ गृहा॒ मास्मद् बि॑भीतन ॥
verses.transliteration:
sūnṛtāvantaḥ subhagā irāvanto hasāmudāḥ |
atṛṣyā akṣudhyā sta gṛhā māsmad bibhītana ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒हैव स्त॒ मानु॑ गात॒ विश्वा॑ रू॒पाणि॑ पुष्यत ।
ऐष्या॑मि भ॒द्रेणा॑ स॒ह भूयां॑सो भवता॒ मया॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ihaiva sta mānu gāta viśvā rūpāṇi puṣyata |
aiṣyāmi bhadreṇā saha bhūyāṃso bhavatā mayā ||

verses.sanskrit:
यद॑ग्ने॒ तप॑सा॒ तप॑ उपत॒प्याम॑हे॒ तपः॑ ।
प्रि॒याः श्रु॒तस्य॑ भूया॒स्मायु॑ष्मन्तः सुमे॒धसः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadagne tapasā tapa upatapyāmahe tapaḥ |
priyāḥ śrutasya bhūyāsmāyuṣmantaḥ sumedhasaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for sacred knowledge and its fruits
Since, Agni, with our fervent zeal we undergo austerity,
May we be dear to Sacred Lore, may we be wise and live long lives.
Agni, we practise acts austere, we undergo austerity.
So listening to Holy Lore may we grow wise and full of days.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ तप॑स्तप्यामह॒ उप॑ तप्यामहे॒ तपः॑ ।
श्रु॒तानि॑ शृ॒ण्वन्तो॑ व॒यमायु॑ष्मन्तः सुमे॒धसः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne tapastapyāmaha upa tapyāmahe tapaḥ |
śrutāni śṛṇvanto vayamāyuṣmantaḥ sumedhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यम॒ग्निः सत्प॑तिर्वृ॒द्धवृ॑ष्णो र॒थीव॑ प॒त्तीन॑जयत् पु॒रोहि॑तः ।
नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्यां निहि॑तो॒ दवि॑द्युतदधस्प॒दं कृ॑णुतां॒ ये पृ॑त॒न्यवः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ayamagniḥ satpatirvṛddhavṛṣṇo rathīva pattīnajayat purohitaḥ |
nābhā pṛthivyāṃ nihito davidyutadadhaspadaṃ kṛṇutāṃ ye pṛtanyavaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for the overthrow of enemies
Like a car-warrior, Agni here, grown mighty, Lord of the brave,
Chief Priest, hath conquered footmen.
Laid on earth’s centre he hath flashed and glittered. Low may he lay our enemies beneath us.

verses.sanskrit:
पृ॒त॒ना॒जितं॒ सह॑मानम॒ग्निमु॒क्थ्यैर्ह॑वामहे पर॒मात् स॒धस्था॑त् ।
स नः॑ पर्ष॒दति॑ दु॒र्गाणि॒ विश्वा॒ क्षाम॑द् दे॒वोऽति॑ दुरि॒तान्य॒ग्निः ॥
verses.transliteration:
pṛtanājitaṃ sahamānamagnimukthyairhavāmahe paramāt sadhasthāt |
sa naḥ parṣadati durgāṇi viśvā kṣāmad devo'ti duritānyagniḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for deliverance from affliction
We call with lauds from his most lofty dwelling victorious Agni, conqueror in battles.
May he conveyus over all distresses, may the God Agni bear us past our troubles.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं यत् कृ॒ष्णः श॒कुनि॑रभिनि॒ष्पत॒न्नपी॑पतत् ।
आपो॑ मा॒ तस्मा॒त् सर्व॑स्माद् दुरि॒तात् पा॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ yat kṛṣṇaḥ śakunirabhiniṣpatannapīpatat |
āpo mā tasmāt sarvasmād duritāt pāntvaṃhasaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A charm to avert an evil omen
From all that woe and trouble may the Waters save and rescue me,
Whate’er the Raven, black of hue, flying out hither ward, hath dropped.
May Agni Gārhapatya save and set me free from all this guilt.
Which the black Raven with thy mouth, O Nirriti, hath wiped away.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं यत् कृ॒ष्णः श॒कुनि॑र॒वामृ॑क्षन्निरृते ते॒ मुखे॑न ।
अ॒ग्निर्मा॒ तस्मा॒देन॑सो॒ गार्ह॑पत्यः॒ प्र मु॑ञ्चतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ yat kṛṣṇaḥ śakuniravāmṛkṣannirṛte te mukhena |
agnirmā tasmādenaso gārhapatyaḥ pra muñcatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒ती॒चीन॑फलो॒ हि त्वमपा॑मार्ग रु॒रोहि॑थ ।
सर्वा॒न् मच्छ॒पथाँ अधि॒ वरी॑यो यावया इ॒तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
pratīcīnaphalo hi tvamapāmārga rurohitha |
sarvān macchapathām̐ adhi varīyo yāvayā itaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A charm against imprecation and threatened evils
With retroverted fruit hast thou, O Apāmārga, sprung and grown.
Hence into distance most remote drive every curse away from, me.
Whatever evil we have done, whatever vile or sinful act,
With thee, O Apāmārga, who lookest all ways, we wipe it off.
If with the cripple we have lived, whose teeth are black and nails deformed,
With thee, O Apāmārga, we wipe all that ill away from us.

verses.sanskrit:
यद् दु॑ष्कृ॒तं यच्छम॑लं॒ यद् वा चेरि॒म पा॒पया॑ ।
त्वया॒ तद् वि॑श्वतोमु॒खापा॑मा॒र्गाप॑ मृज्महे ॥
verses.transliteration:
yad duṣkṛtaṃ yacchamalaṃ yad vā cerima pāpayā |
tvayā tad viśvatomukhāpāmārgāpa mṛjmahe ||

verses.sanskrit:
श्या॒वद॑ता कुन॒खिना॑ ब॒ण्डेन॒ यत् स॒हासि॒म ।
अपा॑मार्ग॒ त्वया॑ व॒यं सर्वं॒ तदप॑ मृज्महे ॥
verses.transliteration:
śyāvadatā kunakhinā baṇḍena yat sahāsima |
apāmārga tvayā vayaṃ sarvaṃ tadapa mṛjmahe ||

verses.sanskrit:
यद्य॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ यदि॒ वात॒ आस॒ यदि॑ वृ॒क्षेषु॒ यदि॒ वोल॑पेषु ।
यदश्र॑वन् प॒शव॑ उ॒द्यमा॑नं॒ तद् ब्राह्म॑णं॒ पुन॑र॒स्मानु॒पैतु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadyantarikṣe yadi vāta āsa yadi vṛkṣeṣu yadi volapeṣu |
yadaśravan paśava udyamānaṃ tad brāhmaṇaṃ punarasmānupaitu ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to Vāk
If it was in the wind or air’s mid-region, if it was in the trees or in the bushes,
To meet whose utterance forth streamed the cattle, may that.
Celestial Power again approach us.

verses.sanskrit:
पुन॒र्मैत्वि॑न्द्रि॒यं पुन॑रा॒त्मा द्रवि॑णं॒ ब्राह्म॑णं च ।
पुन॑र॒ग्नयो॒ धिष्ण्या॑ यथास्था॒म क॑ल्पयन्तामि॒हैव ॥
verses.transliteration:
punarmaitvindriyaṃ punarātmā draviṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca |
punaragnayo dhiṣṇyā yathāsthāma kalpayantāmihaiva ||
verses.translation:
A priest’s prayer to the Agnayo Dhishnyāh
May sense return to me again, and spirit, return my Sacred Power and my possessions!
Again let fires, aflame on lesser altars, each duly stationed, here succeed and prosper.

verses.sanskrit:
सर॑स्वति व्र॒तेषु॑ ते दि॒व्येषु॑ देवि॒ धाम॑सु ।
जु॒षस्व॑ ह॒व्यमाहु॑तं प्र॒जां दे॑वि ररास्व नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarasvati vrateṣu te divyeṣu devi dhāmasu |
juṣasva havyamāhutaṃ prajāṃ devi rarāsva naḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for children and prosperity
Sarasvati, in thy decrees, Goddess, in thy celestial laws,
Accept the offered sacrifice, and, Goddess, grant us progeny.
Here is, Sarasvati, thy fat libation, this sacrifice passing to the mouth of Fathers.
These most auspicious offerings have ascended to thee: through, these may we be full of sweetness.
Be kind and most auspicious, be gracious to us, Sarasvati, May we be ever in thy sight.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं ते॑ ह॒व्यं घृ॒तव॑त् सरस्वती॒दं पि॑तॄ॒णां ह॒विरा॒स्यं॑१ यत् ।
इ॒मानि॑ त उदि॒ता शंत॑मानि॒ तेभि॑र्व॒यं मधु॑मन्तः स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ te havyaṃ ghṛtavat sarasvatīdaṃ pitṝṇāṃ havirāsyaṃ yat |
imāni ta uditā śaṃtamāni tebhirvayaṃ madhumantaḥ syāma ||

verses.sanskrit:
शि॒वा नः॒ शंत॑मा भव सुमृडी॒का स॑रस्वति ।
मा ते॑ युयोम सं॒दृशः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
śivā naḥ śaṃtamā bhava sumṛḍīkā sarasvati |
mā te yuyoma saṃdṛśaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॒ वातो॑ वातु॒ शं न॑स्तपतु॒ सूर्यः॑ ।
अहा॑नि॒ शं भ॑वन्तु नः॒ शं रात्री॒ प्रति॑ धीयतां॒
शमु॒षा नो॒ व्युऽच्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no vāto vātu śaṃ nastapatu sūryaḥ |
ahāni śaṃ bhavantu naḥ śaṃ rātrī prati dhīyatāṃ
śamuṣā no vyu'cchatu ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for prosperity
May the wind kindly breathe on us, may the Sun warm us. pleasantly.
May days pass happily for us, may night draw near delightfully, may dawn break joyfully for us!

verses.sanskrit:
यत् किं चा॒सौ मन॑सा॒ यच्च॑ वा॒चा य॒ज्ञैर्जु॒होति॑ ह॒विषा॒ यजु॑षा ।
तन्मृ॒त्युना॒ निरृ॑तिः संविदा॒ना पु॒रा स॒त्यादाहु॑तिं हन्त्वस्य ॥
verses.transliteration:
yat kiṃ cāsau manasā yacca vācā yajñairjuhoti haviṣā yajuṣā |
tanmṛtyunā nirṛtiḥ saṃvidānā purā satyādāhutiṃ hantvasya ||
verses.translation:
A charm to frustrate an enemy’s sacrifice
Whatever sacrifice that man performeth with voice, mind, sacred formula, oblation,
May, in accord with Death, Destruction ruin his offering before it gain fulfilment.
For him may sorcerers, Destruction, demons strike and prevent fulfilment through their falsehood.
Let Gods, by Indra sent, destroy his butter, and let his sacrifice be ineffective.
Let the two Sovrans, swift to come, like falcons swooping on their prey,
Destroy the butter of the foe whoever plots to injure us.
I seize thine arms and draw them back, I bind a bandage on thy mouth.
I with the anger of the God Agni have killed thy sacrifice.
Behind thy back I tie thine arms, I bind a bandage on thy mouth:
With the terrific Agni’s wrath have I destroyed thy sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
या॒तु॒धाना॒ निरृ॑ति॒रादु॒ रक्ष॒स्ते अ॑स्य घ्न॒न्त्वनृ॑तेन स॒त्यम् ।
इन्द्रे॑षिता दे॒वा आज्य॑मस्य मथ्नन्तु॒ मा तत् सं पा॑दि॒ यद॒सौ जु॒होति॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yātudhānā nirṛtirādu rakṣaste asya ghnantvanṛtena satyam |
indreṣitā devā ājyamasya mathnantu mā tat saṃ pādi yadasau juhoti ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒जि॒रा॒धि॒रा॒जौ श्ये॒नौ सं॑पा॒तिना॑विव ।
आज्यं॑ पृतन्य॒तो ह॑तां॒ यो नः॒ कश्चा॑भ्यघा॒यति॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ajirādhirājau śyenau saṃpātināviva |
ājyaṃ pṛtanyato hatāṃ yo naḥ kaścābhyaghāyati ||

verses.sanskrit:
अपा॑ञ्चौ त उ॒भौ बा॒हू अपि॑ नह्याम्या॒स्यऽम् ।
अ॒ग्नेर्दे॒वस्य॑ म॒न्युना॒ तेन॑ तेऽवधिषं ह॒विः ॥
verses.transliteration:
apāñcau ta ubhau bāhū api nahyāmyāsya'm |
agnerdevasya manyunā tena te'vadhiṣaṃ haviḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अपि॑ नह्यामि ते बा॒हू अपि॑ नह्याम्या॒स्यऽम् ।
अ॒ग्नेर्घो॒रस्य॑ म॒न्युना॒ तेन॑ तेऽवधिषं ह॒विः ॥
verses.transliteration:
api nahyāmi te bāhū api nahyāmyāsya'm |
agnerghorasya manyunā tena te'vadhiṣaṃ haviḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
परि॑ त्वाग्ने॒ पुरं॑ व॒यं विप्रं॑ सहस्य धीमहि ।
धृ॒षद् व॑र्णं दि॒वेदि॑वे ह॒न्तारं॑ भङ्गु॒राव॑तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
pari tvāgne puraṃ vayaṃ vipraṃ sahasya dhīmahi |
dhṛṣad varṇaṃ divedive hantāraṃ bhaṅgurāvataḥ ||
verses.translation:
In praise of Agni
We set thee round us as a fort, victorious Agni! thee a sage,
Bold in thy colour day by day, destroyer of the treacherous foe.

verses.sanskrit:
उत् ति॑ष्ठ॒ताव॑ पश्य॒तेन्द्र॑स्य भा॒गमृ॒त्विय॑म् ।
यदि॑ श्रा॒तं॑ जु॒होत॑न॒ यद्यश्रा॑तं म॒मत्त॑न ॥
verses.transliteration:
ut tiṣṭhatāva paśyatendrasya bhāgamṛtviyam |
yadi śrātaṃ juhotana yadyaśrātaṃ mamattana ||
verses.translation:
An invitation to Indra
Rise up and look upon the share of Indra fixt by ritual use.
Whether ye poured libation dressed or took delight in it un-cooked.
Libation is prepared. Come to us, Indra: the Sun hath travelled over half his journey.
Friends with their treasures sit around thee, waiting like heads of houses for their wandering chieftain.
Dressed in the udder and on fire, I fancy; well dressed, I fancy, is this new oblation.
Quaff thickened milk of noon’s libation, Indra, well pleased, O Thunderer, famed for many an exploit!

verses.sanskrit:
श्रा॒तं ह॒विरो ष्वि॑न्द्र॒ प्र या॑हि ज॒गाम॒ सूरो॒ अध्व॑नो॒ वि मध्य॑म् ।
परि॑ त्वासते नि॒धिभिः॒ सखा॑यः कुल॒पा न व्रा॑जप॒तिं चर॑न्तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrātaṃ haviro ṣvindra pra yāhi jagāma sūro adhvano vi madhyam |
pari tvāsate nidhibhiḥ sakhāyaḥ kulapā na vrājapatiṃ carantam ||

verses.sanskrit:
श्रा॒तं म॑न्य॒ ऊध॑नि श्रा॒तम॒ग्नौ सुशृ॑तं मन्ये॒ तदृ॒तं नवी॑यः ।
माध्य॑न्दिनस्य॒ सव॑नस्य द॒ध्नः पिबे॑न्द्र वज्रिन् पुरु॒कृज्जु॑षा॒णः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrātaṃ manya ūdhani śrātamagnau suśṛtaṃ manye tadṛtaṃ navīyaḥ |
mādhyandinasya savanasya dadhnaḥ pibendra vajrin purukṛjjuṣāṇaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
समि॑द्धो अ॒ग्निर्वृ॑षणा र॒थी दि॒वस्त॒प्तो घ॒र्मो दु॑ह्यते वामि॒षे मधु॑ ।
व॒यं हि वां॑ पुरु॒दमा॑सो अश्विना॒ हवा॑महे सध॒मादे॑षु का॒रवः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
samiddho agnirvṛṣaṇā rathī divastapto gharmo duhyate vāmiṣe madhu |
vayaṃ hi vāṃ purudamāso aśvinā havāmahe sadhamādeṣu kāravaḥ ||
verses.translation:
An invitation to the Asvins
Inflamed is Agni, Heroes! charioteer of heaven. The caldron boils: the meath is drained to be your food.
For we, O Asvins, singers sprung from many a house, invite you to be present at our banquetings.
Asvins, the fire is all aglow: your caldron hath been heated;. come!
Here, even now, O Heroes, are the milch-kine milked. The priests, ye mighty ones! rejoice.
Pure with the Gods is sacrifice with cry of Hail! That is the Asvins’ cup whence Gods are wont to drink.
Yea, the Immortal Ones accept it, one and all, and come to kiss that cup with the Gandharva’s mouth.
Milk, molten butter offered when the mornings break,—this is your portion, Asvins! Come ye hitherward.
Lords of the brave, balm-lovers, guards of sacrifice, drink ye the warm libation in the light of heaven.
Let the warm drink approach you with its Hotar-priest: let the Adhvaryu come to you with store of milk.
Come, O ye Asvins, taste the meath that hath been drained, drink of the milk provided by this radiant cow.
Come hither, quickly come, thou milker of the kine; into the caldron pour milk of the radiant cow.
Most precious Savitar hath looked upon the heaven. After Dawn’s going-forth he sends his light abroad.
I invocate this milch-cow good for milking, so that the milker, deft of hand, may milk her.
May Savitar give goodliest stimulation. The caldron hath been warmed. Let him proclaim it.
She, sovran of all treasures, is come hither yearning in spirit for her calf, and lowing.
May this cow yield her milk for both the Asvins, and may she prosper to our great advantage.
As dear house-friend, guest welcome in the dwelling, to this our sacrifice come thou who knowest.
And, Agni, having scattered all assailants, bring to us the posses-sions of our foemen.
Show thyself strong for mighty bliss, O Agni! Most excellent be thine effulgent splendours!
Make easy to maintain our household lordship, and overcome the might of those who hate us.
Fortunate mayst thou be with goodly pasture, and may we also be exceeding wealthy.
Feed on the grass, O Cow, at every season, and, coming hither, drink the limpid water.

verses.sanskrit:
समि॑द्धो अ॒ग्निर॑श्विना त॒प्तो वां॑ घ॒र्म आ ग॑तम् ।
दु॒ह्यन्ते॑ नू॒नं वृ॑षणे॒ह धे॒नवो॒ दस्रा॒ मद॑न्ति वे॒धसः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
samiddho agniraśvinā tapto vāṃ gharma ā gatam |
duhyante nūnaṃ vṛṣaṇeha dhenavo dasrā madanti vedhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
स्वाहा॑कृतः॒ शुचि॑र्दे॒वेषु॑ य॒ज्ञो यो अ॒श्विनो॑श्चम॒सो दे॑व॒पानः॑ ।
तमु॒ विश्वे॑ अ॒मृता॑सो जुषा॒णा ग॑न्ध॒र्वस्य॒ प्रत्या॒स्ना रि॑हन्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
svāhākṛtaḥ śucirdeveṣu yajño yo aśvinoścamaso devapānaḥ |
tamu viśve amṛtāso juṣāṇā gandharvasya pratyāsnā rihanti ||

verses.sanskrit:
यदु॒स्रिया॒स्वाहु॑तं घृ॒तं पयो॒ऽयं स वा॑मश्विना भा॒ग आ ग॑तम् ।
माध्वी॑ धर्तारा विदथस्य सत्पती त॒प्तं घ॒र्मं पि॑बतं रोच॒ने दि॒वः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadusriyāsvāhutaṃ ghṛtaṃ payo'yaṃ sa vāmaśvinā bhāga ā gatam |
mādhvī dhartārā vidathasya satpatī taptaṃ gharmaṃ pibataṃ rocane divaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
त॒प्तो वां॑ घ॒र्मो न॑क्षतु॒ स्वहो॑ता॒ प्र वा॑मध्व॒र्युश्च॑रतु॒ पय॑स्वान् ।
मधो॑र्दु॒ग्धस्या॑श्विना त॒नाया॑ वी॒तं पा॒तं पय॑स उ॒स्रिया॑याः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tapto vāṃ gharmo nakṣatu svahotā pra vāmadhvaryuścaratu payasvān |
madhordugdhasyāśvinā tanāyā vītaṃ pātaṃ payasa usriyāyāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
उप॑ द्रव॒ पय॑सा गोधुगो॒षमा घ॒र्मे सि॑ञ्च॒ पय॑ उ॒स्रिया॑याः ।
वि नाक॑मख्यत् सवि॒ता वरे॑ण्योऽनुप्र॒याण॑मुषसो॒ वि रा॑जति ॥
verses.transliteration:
upa drava payasā godhugoṣamā gharme siñca paya usriyāyāḥ |
vi nākamakhyat savitā vareṇyo'nuprayāṇamuṣaso vi rājati ||

verses.sanskrit:
उप॑ ह्वये सु॒दुघां॑ धे॒नुमे॒तां सु॒हस्तो॑ गो॒धुगु॒त दो॑हदेनाम् ।
श्रेष्ठं॑ स॒वं स॑वि॒ता सा॑विषन्नो॒ऽभीऽद्धो घ॒र्मस्तदु॒ षु प्र वो॑चत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
upa hvaye sudughāṃ dhenumetāṃ suhasto godhuguta dohadenām |
śreṣṭhaṃ savaṃ savitā sāviṣanno'bhī'ddho gharmastadu ṣu pra vocat ||

verses.sanskrit:
हि॒ङ्कृ॒ण्व॒ती व॑सु॒पत्नी॒ वसू॑नां व॒त्समि॒च्छन्ती॒ मन॑सा॒ न्याग॑न् ।
दु॒हाम॒श्विभ्यां॒ पयो॑ अ॒घ्न्येयं सा व॑र्धतां मह॒ते सौभ॑गाय ॥
verses.transliteration:
hiṅkṛṇvatī vasupatnī vasūnāṃ vatsamicchantī manasā nyāgan |
duhāmaśvibhyāṃ payo aghnyeyaṃ sā vardhatāṃ mahate saubhagāya ||

verses.sanskrit:
जुष्टो॒ दमू॑ना॒ अति॑थिर्दुरो॒ण इ॒मं नो॑ य॒ज्ञमुप॑ याहि वि॒द्वान् ।
विश्वा॑ अग्ने अभि॒युजो॑ वि॒हत्य॑ शत्रूय॒तामा भ॑रा॒ भोज॑नानि ॥
verses.transliteration:
juṣṭo damūnā atithirduroṇa imaṃ no yajñamupa yāhi vidvān |
viśvā agne abhiyujo vihatya śatrūyatāmā bharā bhojanāni ||

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ शर्ध॑ मह॒ते सौभ॑गाय॒ तव॑ द्यु॒म्नान्यु॑त्त॒मानि॑ सन्तु ।
सं जा॑स्प॒त्यं सु॒यम॒मा कृ॑णुष्व शत्रूय॒ताम॒भि ति॑ष्ठा॒ महां॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne śardha mahate saubhagāya tava dyumnānyuttamāni santu |
saṃ jāspatyaṃ suyamamā kṛṇuṣva śatrūyatāmabhi tiṣṭhā mahāṃsi ||

verses.sanskrit:
सू॒य॒व॒साद् भग॑वती॒ हि भू॒या अधा॑ व॒यं भग॑वन्तः स्याम ।
अ॒द्धि तृण॑मघ्न्ये विश्व॒दानीं॒ पिब॑ शु॒द्धमु॑द॒कमा॒चर॑न्ती ॥
verses.transliteration:
sūyavasād bhagavatī hi bhūyā adhā vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma |
addhi tṛṇamaghnye viśvadānīṃ piba śuddhamudakamācarantī ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒प॒चितां॒ लोहि॑नीनां कृ॒ष्णा मा॒तेति॑ शुश्रुम ।
मुने॑र्दे॒वस्य॒ मूले॑न॒ सर्वा॑ विध्यामि॒ ता अ॒हम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
apacitāṃ lohinīnāṃ kṛṣṇā māteti śuśruma |
munerdevasya mūlena sarvā vidhyāmi tā aham ||
verses.translation:
A charm to cure pustules, sores, or scrofulous swellings (apachitas)
Black is the mother, we have heard, from whom the red-hued Pustules sprang.
With the divine ascetic’s root I pierce and penetrate them all.
I pierce the foremost one of these, I perforate the middlemost,
And here I cut the hindermost asunder like a lock of hair.
With spell that Tvashtar sent to us I have dispelled thy jealousy.
We mitigate and pacify the anger that thou feltest, Lord!
Lord of religious rites, by law, anointed, shine thou forth here for ever friendly-minded.
So may we all with children, Jātavedas! worship and humbly wait on thee enkindled.

verses.sanskrit:
विध्या॑म्यासां प्रथ॒मां विध्या॑म्यु॒त म॑ध्य॒माम् ।
इ॒दं ज॑घ॒न्याऽमासा॒मा च्छि॑नद्मि॒ स्तुका॑मिव ॥
verses.transliteration:
vidhyāmyāsāṃ prathamāṃ vidhyāmyuta madhyamām |
idaṃ jaghanyā'māsāmā cchinadmi stukāmiva ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्वा॒ष्ट्रेणा॒हं वच॑सा॒ वि त॑ ई॒र्ष्याम॑मीमदम् ।
अथो॒ यो म॒न्युष्टे॑ पते॒ तमु॑ ते शमयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvāṣṭreṇāhaṃ vacasā vi ta īrṣyāmamīmadam |
atho yo manyuṣṭe pate tamu te śamayāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
व्र॒तेन॒ त्वं व्र॑तपते॒ सम॑क्तो वि॒श्वाहा॑ सु॒मना॑ दीदिही॒ह ।
तं त्वा॑ व॒यं जा॑तवेदः॒ समि॑द्धं प्र॒जाव॑न्त॒ उप॑ सदेम॒ सर्वे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vratena tvaṃ vratapate samakto viśvāhā sumanā dīdihīha |
taṃ tvā vayaṃ jātavedaḥ samiddhaṃ prajāvanta upa sadema sarve ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒जाव॑तीः सू॒यव॑से रु॒शन्तीः॑ शु॒द्धा अ॒पः सु॑प्रपा॒णे पिब॑न्तीः ।
मा व॑ स्ते॒न ई॑शत॒ माघशं॑सः॒ परि॑ वो रु॒द्रस्य॑ हे॒तिर्वृ॑णक्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
prajāvatīḥ sūyavase ruśantīḥ śuddhā apaḥ suprapāṇe pibantīḥ |
mā va stena īśata māghaśaṃsaḥ pari vo rudrasya hetirvṛṇaktu ||
verses.translation:
A blessing on cows
Let not a thief or wicked man possess you: let not the dart of Rudra come anear you,
Prolific, shining in the goodly pasture, drinking at pleasant pools the limpid water.
Ye know the place and rest content, close-gathered, called by many a name. Come to me,
Goddesses, with Gods Bedew with streams of fatness us, this cattle-pen, and all this place.

verses.sanskrit:
प॒द॒ज्ञा स्थ॒ रम॑तयः॒ संहि॑ता वि॒श्वना॑म्नीः ।
उप॑ मा देवीर्दे॒वेभि॒रेत॑ ।
इ॒मं गो॒ष्ठमि॒दं सदो॑ घृ॒तेना॒स्मान्त्समु॑क्षत ॥
verses.transliteration:
padajñā stha ramatayaḥ saṃhitā viśvanāmnīḥ |
upa mā devīrdevebhireta |
imaṃ goṣṭhamidaṃ sado ghṛtenāsmāntsamukṣata ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ सु॒स्रसः॑ सु॒स्रसो॒ अस॑तीभ्यो॒ अस॑त्तराः ।
से हो॑रर॒सत॑रा लव॒णाद् विक्ले॑दीयसीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā susrasaḥ susraso asatībhyo asattarāḥ |
se horarasatarā lavaṇād vikledīyasīḥ ||
verses.translation:
A charm to cure scrofulous pustules and scrofula
Rapidly dropping, quick to drop, more evil than the evil ones,
More sapless than a dried-up bone, swifter than salt to melt away.
Pustules that rise upon the neck, Pustules upon the shoulder-joints,
Pustules that, falling of themselves, spring up on every twofold limb:
I have expelled and banished all Scrofula harboured in the head,
And that which bores the breast-bone through, and that which settles in the sole.
Scrofula flies borne on by wings: it penerates and holds the man.
Here is the cure of either kind, the chronic and the transient.
We know thine origin, Scrofula! know whence thou, Scrofula, art born.
How hast thou then struck this man here, him in whose house we sacrifice?
Boldly drink Soma from the beaker, Indra! hero in war for treasure! Vritra-slayer.
Fill thyself full at the mid-day libation: thyself possessing riches grant us riches.

verses.sanskrit:
या ग्रैव्या॑ अप॒चितोऽथो॒ या उ॑पप॒क्ष्याः ।
वि॒जाम्नि॒ या अ॑प॒चितः॑ स्वयं॒स्रसः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yā graivyā apacito'tho yā upapakṣyāḥ |
vijāmni yā apacitaḥ svayaṃsrasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यः कीक॑साः प्रशृ॒णाति॑ तली॒द्यऽमव॒तिष्ठ॑ति ।
निर्हा॒स्तं सर्वं॑ जा॒यान्यं॒ यः कश्च॑ क॒कुदि॑ श्रि॒तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaḥ kīkasāḥ praśṛṇāti talīdya'mavatiṣṭhati |
nirhāstaṃ sarvaṃ jāyānyaṃ yaḥ kaśca kakudi śritaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
प॒क्षी जा॒यान्यः॑ पतति॒ स आ वि॑शति॒ पूरु॑षम् ।
तदक्षि॑तस्य भेष॒जमु॒भयोः॒ सुक्ष॑तस्य च ॥
verses.transliteration:
pakṣī jāyānyaḥ patati sa ā viśati pūruṣam |
tadakṣitasya bheṣajamubhayoḥ sukṣatasya ca ||

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒द्म वै ते॑ जायान्य॒ जानं॒ यतो॑ जायान्य॒ जाय॑से ।
क॒थं ह॒ तत्र॒ त्वं ह॑नो॒ यस्य॑ कृ॒ण्मो ह॒विर्गृ॒हे ॥
verses.transliteration:
vidma vai te jāyānya jānaṃ yato jāyānya jāyase |
kathaṃ ha tatra tvaṃ hano yasya kṛṇmo havirgṛhe ||

verses.sanskrit:
धृ॒षत् पि॑ब क॒लशे॒ सोम॑मिन्द्र वृत्र॒हा शू॑र सम॒रे वसू॑नाम् ।
माध्य॑न्दिने॒ सव॑न॒ आ वृ॑षस्व रयि॒ष्ठानो॑ र॒यिम॒स्मासु॑ धेहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhṛṣat piba kalaśe somamindra vṛtrahā śūra samare vasūnām |
mādhyandine savana ā vṛṣasva rayiṣṭhāno rayimasmāsu dhehi ||

verses.sanskrit:
सांत॑पना इ॒दं ह॒विर्मरु॑त॒स्तज्जु॑जुष्टन ।
अ॒स्माको॒ती रि॑शादसः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sāṃtapanā idaṃ havirmarutastajjujuṣṭana |
asmākotī riśādasaḥ ||
verses.translation:
An incantation against an enemy
Ye Maruts, full of fiery heat, accept this offering brought for you To help us, ye who slay the foe.
Maruts, the man who filled with rage against us beyond our thoughts would harm us, O ye Vasus,
May he be tangled in the toils of Mischief: smite ye him down with your most flaming weapon.
Each year come, friends to man, the tuneful Maruts, dwelling in spacious mansions, trooped together.
Exhilarating, gladdening full of fiery heat, may they deliver us from binding bonds of sin.

verses.sanskrit:
यो नो॒ मर्तो॑ मरुतो दुर्हृणा॒युस्ति॒रश्चि॒त्तानि॑ वसवो॒ जिघां॑सति ।
द्रु॒हः पाशा॒न् प्रति॑ मुञ्चतां॒ सस्तपि॑ष्ठेन॒ तप॑सा हन्तना॒ तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo no marto maruto durhṛṇāyustiraścittāni vasavo jighāṃsati |
druhaḥ pāśān prati muñcatāṃ sastapiṣṭhena tapasā hantanā tam ||

verses.sanskrit:
संव॒त्स॒रीणा॑ म॒रुतः॑ स्व॒र्का उ॒रुक्ष॑याः॒ सग॑णा॒ मानु॑षासः ।
ते अ॒स्मत् पाशा॒न् प्र मु॑ञ्च॒न्त्वेन॑सः सांतप॒ना म॑त्स॒रा मा॑दयि॒ष्णवः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃvatsarīṇā marutaḥ svarkā urukṣayāḥ sagaṇā mānuṣāsaḥ |
te asmat pāśān pra muñcantvenasaḥ sāṃtapanā matsarā mādayiṣṇavaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
वि ते॑ मुञ्चामि रश॒नां वि योक्त्रं॒ वि नि॒योज॑नम् ।
इ॒हैव त्वमज॑स्र एध्यग्ने ॥
verses.transliteration:
vi te muñcāmi raśanāṃ vi yoktraṃ vi niyojanam |
ihaiva tvamajasra edhyagne ||
verses.translation:
A charm for a prince’s prosperity
I free thee from the cord, I loose the bond, I loose the fastening.
Even here, perpetual, Agni, wax thou strong.
I with celestial prayer appoint thee, Agni, maintainer of this man in princely powers.
Here brightly shine for us with wealth: declare thou to Gods this favoured giver of oblations.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒स्मै क्ष॒त्राणि॑ धा॒रय॑न्तमग्ने यु॒नज्मि॑ त्वा॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ दैव्ये॑न ।
दी॒दि॒ह्य॑१स्मभ्यं॒ द्रवि॑णे॒ह भ॒द्रं प्रेमं वो॑चो हवि॒र्दां दे॒वता॑सु ॥
verses.transliteration:
asmai kṣatrāṇi dhārayantamagne yunajmi tvā brahmaṇā daivyena |
dīdihyasmabhyaṃ draviṇeha bhadraṃ premaṃ voco havirdāṃ devatāsu ||

verses.sanskrit:
यत् ते॑ दे॒वा अकृ॑ण्वन् भाग॒धेय॒ममा॑वास्ये सं॒वस॑न्तो महि॒त्वा ।
तेना॑ नो य॒ज्ञं पि॑पृहि विश्ववारे र॒यिं नो॑ धेहि सुभगे सु॒वीर॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yat te devā akṛṇvan bhāgadheyamamāvāsye saṃvasanto mahitvā |
tenā no yajñaṃ pipṛhi viśvavāre rayiṃ no dhehi subhage suvīram ||
verses.translation:
A hymn to the New Moon
Night of the New-born Moon, whatever fortune the Gods who dwell with greatness have assigned thee,
Therewith fulfil our sacrifice, all-baunteous! Blessed One, grant us wealth with manly offspring.
I am the New Moon’s Night, the good and pious are my in-habitants, these dwell within me.
In me have Gods of both the spheres, and Sādhyas, with Indra as their chief, all met together.
The Night hath come, the gatherer of treasures, bestowing strength, prosperity, and riches.
To New Moon’s Night let us present oblation: pouring out strength, with milk hath she come hither.
Night of New Moon! ne’er hath been born another than thou embracing all these forms and natures,
May we have what we longed for when we brought thee obla-tions: may we be the lords of riches.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒हमे॒वास्म्य॑मावा॒स्या॒३ मामा व॑सन्ति सु॒कृतो॒ मयी॒मे ।
मयि॑ दे॒वा उ॒भये॑ सा॒ध्याश्चेन्द्र॑ज्येष्ठाः॒ सम॑गच्छन्त॒ सर्वे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahamevāsmyamāvāsyā māmā vasanti sukṛto mayīme |
mayi devā ubhaye sādhyāścendrajyeṣṭhāḥ samagacchanta sarve ||

verses.sanskrit:
आग॒न् रात्री॑ सं॒गम॑नी॒ वसू॑ना॒मूर्जं॑ पु॒ष्टं वस्वा॑वे॒शय॑न्ती ।
अ॒मा॒वा॒स्याऽयै ह॒विषा॑ विधे॒मोर्जं॒ दुहा॑ना॒ पय॑सा न॒ आग॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
āgan rātrī saṃgamanī vasūnāmūrjaṃ puṣṭaṃ vasvāveśayantī |
amāvāsyā'yai haviṣā vidhemorjaṃ duhānā payasā na āgan ||

verses.sanskrit:
अमा॑वास्ये न त्वदे॒तान्य॒न्यो विश्वा॑ रू॒पाणि॑ परि॒भूर्ज॑जान ।
यत् का॑मास्ते जुहु॒मस्तन्नो॑ अस्तु व॒यं स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयि॒णाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
amāvāsye na tvadetānyanyo viśvā rūpāṇi paribhūrjajāna |
yat kāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayiṇām ||

verses.sanskrit:
पू॒र्णा प॒श्चादु॒त पू॒र्णा पु॒रस्ता॒दुन्म॑ध्य॒तः पौ॑र्णमा॒सी जि॑गाय ।
तस्यां॑ दे॒वैः सं॒वस॑न्तो महि॒त्वा नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठे समि॒षा म॑देम ॥
verses.transliteration:
pūrṇā paścāduta pūrṇā purastādunmadhyataḥ paurṇamāsī jigāya |
tasyāṃ devaiḥ saṃvasanto mahitvā nākasya pṛṣṭhe samiṣā madema ||
verses.translation:
A hymn to the Full Moon
Full in the front, full rearward, from the middle the Full Moon’s Night hath conquered in the battle.
In her: may we, dwelling with Gods and greatness, feast in the height of heaven, on strengthening viands.
To him, the Full Moon’s mighty Bull, we pay our solemn sacri-fice.
May he bestow upon us wealth unwasting, inexhaustible.
No one but thou, Prajāpati, none beside thee, pervading, gave to all these forms their being.
Grant us our hearts’ desire when we invoke thee: may we have store of riches in possession.
First was the Full Moon meet for adoration among the days and in the nights’ deep darkness.
Into thy heaven, O Holy One, have entered those pious men who honour thee with worship.

verses.sanskrit:
वृ॒ष॒भं वा॒जिनं॑ व॒यं पौ॑र्णमा॒सं य॑जामहे ।
स नो॑ ददा॒त्वक्षि॑तां र॒यिमनु॑पदस्वतीम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vṛṣabhaṃ vājinaṃ vayaṃ paurṇamāsaṃ yajāmahe |
sa no dadātvakṣitāṃ rayimanupadasvatīm ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्रजा॑पते॒ न त्वदे॒तान्य॒न्यो विश्वा॑ रू॒पाणि॑ परि॒भूर्ज॑जान ।
यत् का॑मास्ते जुहु॒मस्तन्नो॑ अस्तु व॒यं स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयी॒णाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prajāpate na tvadetānyanyo viśvā rūpāṇi paribhūrjajāna |
yat kāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||

verses.sanskrit:
पौ॒र्ण॒मा॒सी प्र॑थ॒मा य॒ज्ञिया॑सी॒दह्नां॒ रात्री॑णामतिशर्व॒रेषु॑ ।
ये त्वां य॒ज्ञैर्य॑ज्ञिये अ॒र्धय॑न्त्य॒मी ते नाके॑ सु॒कृतः॒ प्रवि॑ष्टाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
paurṇamāsī prathamā yajñiyāsīdahnāṃ rātrīṇāmatiśarvareṣu |
ye tvāṃ yajñairyajñiye ardhayantyamī te nāke sukṛtaḥ praviṣṭāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
पू॒र्वा॒प॒रं च॑रतो मा॒ययै॒तौ शिशू॒ क्रीड॑न्तौ॒ परि॑ यातोऽर्ण॒वम् ।
विश्वा॒न्यो भुव॑ना वि॒चष्ट॑ ऋ॒तूँर॒न्यो वि॒दध॑ज्जायसे॒ नवः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pūrvāparaṃ carato māyayaitau śiśū krīḍantau pari yāto'rṇavam |
viśvānyo bhuvanā vicaṣṭa ṛtūm̐ranyo vidadhajjāyase navaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A hymn to the New Moon
Forward and backward by their wondrous power move these two youths, disporting, round the ocean.
One views all living things, and thou, the other, art born again arranging times and seasons.
Thou art re-born for ever new: thou marchest, ensign of days, in forefront of the mornings.
Marching thou dealest to the Gods their portion. Thou lengthe-nest, Moon! the days of man’s existence.
O spray of Soma, Lord of Wars! all-perfect verily art thou.
Make me all-perfect, Beauteous One! in riches and in progeny.
Thou art the New Moon, fair to see, thou art complete in every part.
May I be perfect, fully blest in every way in steeds and kine, in children, cattle, home, and wealth.
Inflate thee with his vital breath who hathes us and whom we detest.
May we grow rich in steeds and kine, in children, cattle, houses, wealth.
With that unwasting stalk which Gods, unwasting Gods, in-crease and eat,
May Varuna, Brihaspati, and Indra, the Lords and Guardians of the world, increase us.

verses.sanskrit:
नवो॑नवो भवसि॒ जाय॑मा॒नोऽह्नां॑ के॒तुरु॒षसा॑मे॒ष्यग्र॑म् ।
भा॒गं दे॒वेभ्यो॒ वि द॑धास्या॒यन् प्र च॑न्द्रमस्तिरसे दी॒र्घमायुः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
navonavo bhavasi jāyamāno'hnāṃ keturuṣasāmeṣyagram |
bhāgaṃ devebhyo vi dadhāsyāyan pra candramastirase dīrghamāyuḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
सोम॑स्यांशो युधां प॒तेऽनू॑नो॒ नाम॒ वा अ॑सि ।
अनू॑नं दर्श मा कृधि प्र॒जया॑ च॒ धने॑न च ॥
verses.transliteration:
somasyāṃśo yudhāṃ pate'nūno nāma vā asi |
anūnaṃ darśa mā kṛdhi prajayā ca dhanena ca ||

verses.sanskrit:
द॒र्शोऽसि दर्श॒तोऽसि॒ सम॑ग्रोऽसि॒ सम॑न्तः ।
सम॑ग्रः॒ सम॑न्तो भूयासं॒ गोभि॒रश्वैः॑ प्र॒जया॑ प॒शुभि॑र्गृहैर्धने॑न ॥
verses.transliteration:
darśo'si darśato'si samagro'si samantaḥ |
samagraḥ samanto bhūyāsaṃ gobhiraśvaiḥ prajayā paśubhirgṛhairdhanena ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो॒३ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि॒ यं व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तस्य॒ त्वं प्रा॒णेना प्या॑यस्व ।
आ व॒यं प्या॑सिषीमहि॒ गोभि॒रश्वैः॑ प्र॒जया॑ प॒शुभि॑र्गृ॒हैर्धने॑न ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmastasya tvaṃ prāṇenā pyāyasva |
ā vayaṃ pyāsiṣīmahi gobhiraśvaiḥ prajayā paśubhirgṛhairdhanena ||

verses.sanskrit:
यं दे॒वा अं॒शुमा॑प्या॒यय॑न्ति॒ यमक्षि॑त॒मक्षि॑ता भ॒क्षय॑न्ति ।
तेना॒स्मानिन्द्रो॒ वरु॑णो॒ बृह॒स्पति॒रा प्या॑ययन्तु॒ भुव॑नस्य गो॒पाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaṃ devā aṃśumāpyāyayanti yamakṣitamakṣitā bhakṣayanti |
tenāsmānindro varuṇo bṛhaspatirā pyāyayantu bhuvanasya gopāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भ्यऽर्चत सुष्टु॒तिं गव्य॑मा॒जिम॒स्मासु॑ भ॒द्रा द्रवि॑णानि धत्त ।
इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं न॑यत दे॒वता॑ नो घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॒ मधु॑मत् पवन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhya'rcata suṣṭutiṃ gavyamājimasmāsu bhadrā draviṇāni dhatta |
imaṃ yajñaṃ nayata devatā no ghṛtasya dhārā madhumat pavantām ||
verses.translation:
In praise of Agni
Sing with fair laud the combat for the cattle. Bestow upon us excellent possessions.
Lead to the Gods the sacrifice we offer: let streams of oil flow pure and full of sweetness.
Agni I first appropriate with power, with splendour, and with might.
I give myself children and lengthened life, with Hail! take Agni to myself.
Even here do thou, O Agni, stablish wealth: let not oppressors injure thee by thinking of thee first.
Light be thy task of ruling, Agni, with, thy power: may he who worships thee wax strong, invincible.
Agni hath looked upon the spring of Morning, looked on the days, the earliest Jātavedas.
So, following the gleams of Morning, Sūrya hath entered heaven and earth as his possession.
Agni hath looked upon the spring of Mornings, looked on the days, the earliest Jātavedas.
So he in countless places hath extended, full against heaven and earth, the beams of Sūrya.
Butter to thee in heaven thy home, O Agni! Manu this day hath kindled thee with butter.
Let the Celestial Daughters bring thee butter: Let cows pour butter forth for thee, O Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
मय्यग्रे॑ अ॒ग्निं गृ॑ह्णामि स॒ह क्ष॒त्रेण॒ वर्च॑सा॒ बले॑न ।
मयि॑ प्र॒जां मय्यायु॑र्दधामि॒ स्वाहा॒ मय्य॒ग्निम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
mayyagre agniṃ gṛhṇāmi saha kṣatreṇa varcasā balena |
mayi prajāṃ mayyāyurdadhāmi svāhā mayyagnim ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒हैवाग्ने॒ अधि॑ धारया र॒यिं मा त्वा॒ नि क्र॒न् पूर्व॑चित्ता निका॒रिणः॑ ।
क्ष॒त्रेणा॑ग्ने सु॒यम॑मस्तु॒ तुभ्य॑मुपस॒त्ता व॑र्धतां ते॒ अनि॑ष्टृतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ihaivāgne adhi dhārayā rayiṃ mā tvā ni kran pūrvacittā nikāriṇaḥ |
kṣatreṇāgne suyamamastu tubhyamupasattā vardhatāṃ te aniṣṭṛtaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अन्व॒ग्निरु॒षसा॒मग्र॑मख्य॒दन्वहा॑नि प्रथ॒मो जा॒तवे॑दाः ।
अनु॒ सूर्य॑ उ॒षसो॒ अनु॑ र॒श्मीननु॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी आ वि॑वेश ॥
verses.transliteration:
anvagniruṣasāmagramakhyadanvahāni prathamo jātavedāḥ |
anu sūrya uṣaso anu raśmīnanu dyāvāpṛthivī ā viveśa ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्रत्य॒ग्निरु॒षसा॒मग्र॑मख्य॒त् प्रत्यहा॑नि प्रथ॒मो जा॒तवे॑दाः ।
प्रति॒ सूर्य॑स्य पुरु॒धा च॑ र॒श्मीन् प्रति॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी आ त॑तान ॥
verses.transliteration:
pratyagniruṣasāmagramakhyat pratyahāni prathamo jātavedāḥ |
prati sūryasya purudhā ca raśmīn prati dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatāna ||

verses.sanskrit:
घृ॒तं ते॑ अग्ने दि॒व्ये स॒धस्थे॑ घृ॒तेन॒ त्वां मनु॑र॒द्या समि॑न्धे ।
घृ॒तं ते॑ दे॒वीर्न॒प्त्य॑१आ व॑हन्तु घृ॒तं तुभ्यं॑ दुह्रतां॒ गावो॑ अग्ने ॥
verses.transliteration:
ghṛtaṃ te agne divye sadhasthe ghṛtena tvāṃ manuradyā samindhe |
ghṛtaṃ te devīrnaptyaā vahantu ghṛtaṃ tubhyaṃ duhratāṃ gāvo agne ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒प्सु ते॑ राजन् वरुण गृ॒हो हि॑र॒ण्ययो॑ मि॒थः ।
ततो॑ धृ॒तव्र॑तो॒ राजा॒ सर्वा॒ धामा॑नि मुञ्चतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
apsu te rājan varuṇa gṛho hiraṇyayo mithaḥ |
tato dhṛtavrato rājā sarvā dhāmāni muñcatu ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for deliverance from sin and other evils
Stablished amid the waters is, King Varuna, thy golden home.
Thence let the Sovran who maintains the statutes loose all bind-ing cords.
Hence free thou us, King Varuna, from each successive bond and tie.
As we have cried, O Varuna! have said, The Waters, they are kine, thence set us free, O Varuna.
Loosen the bonds, O Varuna, that hold us, loosen the bond. above, between, and under.
So before Aditi may we be sinless under thy favouring auspices,
Āditya!
Varuna, free us from all snares that bind us, Varuna’s bonds, the upper and the lower.
Drive from us evil dream, drive off misfortune: then let us pass into the world of virtue.

verses.sanskrit:
धाम्नो॑धाम्नो राजन्नि॒तो व॑रुण मुञ्च नः ।
यदापो॑ अ॒घ्न्या इति॒ वरु॒णेति॒ यदू॑चि॒म ततो॑ वरुण मुञ्च नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhāmnodhāmno rājannito varuṇa muñca naḥ |
yadāpo aghnyā iti varuṇeti yadūcima tato varuṇa muñca naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
उदु॑त्त॒मं व॑रुण॒ पाश॑म॒स्मदवा॑ध॒मं वि म॑ध्य॒मं श्र॑थाय ।
अधा॑ व॒यमा॑दित्य व्र॒ते तवाना॑गसो॒ अदि॑तये स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration:
uduttamaṃ varuṇa pāśamasmadavādhamaṃ vi madhyamaṃ śrathāya |
adhā vayamāditya vrate tavānāgaso aditaye syāma ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्रास्मत् पाशा॑न् वरुण मुञ्च॒ सर्वा॒न् य उ॑त्त॒मा अ॑ध॒मा वा॑रु॒णा ये ।
दु॒ष्वप्न्यं॑ दुरि॒तं नि ष्वा॒स्मदथ॑ गच्छेम सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prāsmat pāśān varuṇa muñca sarvān ya uttamā adhamā vāruṇā ye |
duṣvapnyaṃ duritaṃ ni ṣvāsmadatha gacchema sukṛtasya lokam ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ना॒धृ॒ष्यो जा॒तवे॑दा॒ अम॑र्त्यो वि॒राड॑ग्ने क्षत्र॒भृद् दी॑दिही॒ह ।
विश्वा॒ अमी॑वाः प्रमु॒ञ्चन् मानु॑षीभिः शि॒वाभि॑र॒द्य परि॑ पाहि नो॒ गय॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
anādhṛṣyo jātavedā amartyo virāḍagne kṣatrabhṛd dīdihīha |
viśvā amīvāḥ pramuñcan mānuṣībhiḥ śivābhiradya pari pāhi no gayam ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for protection
Holder of sway, shine here refulgent, Agni! invincible immortal Jātavedas.
With succours friendly to mankind, auspicious, driving away all maladies, guard our dwelling.
Thou, Indra, lord and leader of the people, wast born for lovely strength and high dominion.
Thou dravest off the folk who were unfriendly, and madest for the Gods wide room and freedom.
Like a dread wild beast roaming on the mountain, may he. approach us from the farthest distance.
Whetting thy bolt and thy sharp blade, O Indra, crush down our foes and scatter those who hate us.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑ क्ष॒त्रम॒भि वा॒ममोजोऽजा॑यथा वृषभ चर्षणी॒नाम् ।
अपा॑नुदो॒ जन॑ममित्रा॒यन्त॑मु॒रुं दे॒वेभ्यो॑ अकृणोरु लो॒कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indra kṣatramabhi vāmamojo'jāyathā vṛṣabha carṣaṇīnām |
apānudo janamamitrāyantamuruṃ devebhyo akṛṇoru lokam ||

verses.sanskrit:
मृ॒गो न भी॒मः कु॑च॒रो गि॑रि॒ष्ठाः प॑रा॒वत॒ आ ज॑गम्या॒त् पर॑स्याः ।
सृ॒कं सं॒शाय॑ प॒विमि॑न्द्र ति॒ग्मं वि शत्रू॑न् ताढि॒ वि मृघो॑ नुदस्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ parāvata ā jagamyāt parasyāḥ |
sṛkaṃ saṃśāya pavimindra tigmaṃ vi śatrūn tāḍhi vi mṛgho nudasva ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्यमू॒ षु वा॒जिनं॑ दे॒वजू॑तं॒ सहो॑वानं तरु॒तारं॒ रथा॑नाम् ।
अरि॑ष्टनेमिं पृतना॒जिमा॒शुं स्व॒स्तये॒ तार्क्ष्य॑मि॒हा हु॑वेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
tyamū ṣu vājinaṃ devajūtaṃ sahovānaṃ tarutāraṃ rathānām |
ariṣṭanemiṃ pṛtanājimāśuṃ svastaye tārkṣyamihā huvema ||
verses.translation:
A charm to ensure victory in battle
This very mighty one whom Gods urge onward, the conqueror of cars, ever triumphant,
Swift, fleet to battle, with uninjured fellies, even Tārkshya for our weal will we call hither.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रा॒तार॒मिन्द्र॑मवि॒तार॒मिन्द्रं॒ हवे॑हवे सु॒हवं॒ शूर॒मिन्द्र॑म् ।
हु॒वे नु श॒क्रं पु॑रुहू॒तमिन्द्रं॑ स्व॒स्ति न॒ इन्द्रो॑ म॒घवा॑न् कृणोतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
trātāramindramavitāramindraṃ havehave suhavaṃ śūramindram |
huve nu śakraṃ puruhūtamindraṃ svasti na indro maghavān kṛṇotu ||
verses.translation:
The same
Indra the rescuer, Indra the helper, Indra the brave who hears each invocation,
Sakra I call, Indra invoked of many. May Indra Maghavan pros-per and bless us.

verses.sanskrit:
यो अ॒ग्नौ रु॒द्रो यो अ॒प्स्व॑१न्तर्य ओष॑धीर्वी॒रुध॑ आवि॒वेश॑ ।
य इ॒मा विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि चाक्लृ॒प तस्मै॑ रु॒द्राय॒ नमो॑ अस्त्व॒ग्नये ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo agnau rudro yo apsvantarya oṣadhīrvīrudha āviveśa |
ya imā viśvā bhuvanāni cāklṛpa tasmai rudrāya namo astvagnaye ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to Rudra as Agni
To Rudra in the fire, to him who dwells in floods, to Rudra who hath entered into herbs and plants,
To him who formed and fashioned all these worlds, to him this Rudra, yea, to Agni, reverence be paid!

verses.sanskrit:
अपे॒ह्यरि॑र॒स्यरि॒र्वा अ॑सि । वि॒षे वि॒षम॑पृक्था वि॒षमिद् वा अ॑पृक्थाः ।
अहि॑मे॒वाभ्यपे॑हि॒ तं ज॑हि ॥
verses.transliteration:
apehyarirasyarirvā asi | viṣe viṣamapṛkthā viṣamid vā apṛkthāḥ |
ahimevābhyapehi taṃ jahi ||
verses.translation:
A charm to cure a snake-bite
Depart! thou art a foe, a foe. Poison with poison hast thou mixt, yea, verily poison hast thou mixt.
Go to the serpent: strike him dead.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पो दि॒व्या अ॑चायिषं॒ रसे॑न॒ सम॑पृक्ष्महि ।
पय॑स्वानग्न॒ आग॑मं॒ तं मा॒ सं सृ॑ज॒ वर्च॑सा ॥
verses.transliteration:
apo divyā acāyiṣaṃ rasena samapṛkṣmahi |
payasvānagna āgamaṃ taṃ mā saṃ sṛja varcasā ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for purification and prosperity
The heavenly Waters have I ranged: we have been sated with their dew.
Here, Agni, bearing milk, am I. Endow me with the gift of strength.
Endow me with the gift of strength, with children, and a length-ened life.
May the Gods mark this prayer of mine, may Indra with the Rishis mark.
Ye Waters, wash away this stain and whatsoever taint be here,
Each sinful wrong that I have done and every harmless curse of mine.
Thou art the wood, may I succeed! fuel, may I be glorified! splendour, give splendour unto me.

verses.sanskrit:
सं मा॑ग्ने॒ वर्च॑सा सृज॒ सं प्र॒जया॒ समायु॑षा ।
वि॒द्युर्मे॑ अ॒स्य दे॒वा इन्द्रो॑ विद्यात् सह ऋषि॑भिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ māgne varcasā sṛja saṃ prajayā samāyuṣā |
vidyurme asya devā indro vidyāt saha ṛṣibhiḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दमा॑पः॒ प्र व॑हताव॒द्यं च॒ मलं॑ च॒ यत् ।
यच्चा॑भिदु॒द्रोहानृ॑तं॒ यच्च॑ शे॒पे अ॒भीरु॑णम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
idamāpaḥ pra vahatāvadyaṃ ca malaṃ ca yat |
yaccābhidudrohānṛtaṃ yacca śepe abhīruṇam ||

verses.sanskrit:
एधो॑ऽस्येधिषी॒य स॒मिद॑सि॒ समे॑धिषीय ।
तेजो॑ऽसि॒ तेजो॒ मयि॑ धेहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
edho'syedhiṣīya samidasi samedhiṣīya |
tejo'si tejo mayi dhehi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अपि॑ वृश्च पुराण॒वद् व्र॒तते॑रिव गुष्पि॒तम् ।
ओजो॑ दा॒स्यस्य॑ दम्भय ॥
verses.transliteration:
api vṛśca purāṇavad vratateriva guṣpitam |
ojo dāsyasya dambhaya ||
verses.translation:
A charm against a rival in love
Tear thou asunder, as of old, like tangles of a creeping plant.
Demolish thou the Dāsa’s might.
May we with Indra’s help divide the gathered treasure of the foe.
I, by the law of Varuna, bring down thy pride and wantonness.
Ut virga abeat et feminis innocua fiat, (virga) membri humidi, membri quod verberat penetratque, id quod tentum est laxa, id quod sursum tentum est deorsum tende.

verses.sanskrit:
व॒यं तद॑स्य॒ सम्भृ॑तं॒ वस्विन्द्रे॑ण॒ वि भ॑जामहै ।
म्ला॒पया॑मि भ्र॒जः शि॒भ्रं वरु॑णस्य व्र॒तेन॑ ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
vayaṃ tadasya sambhṛtaṃ vasvindreṇa vi bhajāmahai |
mlāpayāmi bhrajaḥ śibhraṃ varuṇasya vratena te ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॒ शेपो॑ अ॒पाया॑तै स्त्री॒षु चास॒दना॑वयाः ।
अ॒व॒स्थस्य॑ क्न॒दीव॑तः शाङ्-कु॒रस्य॑ नितो॒दिनः॑ ।
यदात॑त॒मव॒ तत् त॑नु॒ यदुत्त॑तं॒ नि तत् त॑नु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā śepo apāyātai strīṣu cāsadanāvayāḥ |
avasthasya knadīvataḥ śāṅ-kurasya nitodinaḥ |
yadātatamava tat tanu yaduttataṃ ni tat tanu ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रः॑ सु॒त्रामा॒ स्ववाँ॒ अवो॑भिः सुमृडी॒को भ॑वतु वि॒श्ववे॑दाः ।
बाध॑तां॒ द्वेषो॒ अभ॑यं नः कृणोतु सु॒वीर्य॑स्य॒ पत॑यः स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration:
indraḥ sutrāmā svavām̐ avobhiḥ sumṛḍīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ |
bādhatāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ naḥ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||
verses.translation:
A Prayer for protection
May Indra with his help, Lord of all treasures, be unto us a careful protector.
Drive off our foes and give us peace and safety. May we be lords of goodly store of heroes.

verses.sanskrit:
स सु॒त्रामा॒ स्ववाँ॒ इन्द्रो॑ अ॒स्मदा॒राच्चि॒द् द्वेषः॑ सनु॒तर्यु॑योतु ।
तस्य॑ व॒यं सु॑म॒तौ य॒ज्ञिय॒स्यापि॑ भ॒द्रे सौ॑मन॒से स्या॑म ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa sutrāmā svavām̐ indro asmadārāccid dveṣaḥ sanutaryuyotu |
tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma ||
verses.translation:
A Prayer for protection
May this rich Indra as our good protector keep even far away the men who hate us.
May we enjoy his favour, his the holy: may we enjoy his blessed loving-kindness.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रे॑ण म॒न्युना॑ व॒यम॒भि ष्या॑म पृतन्य॒तः ।
घ्नन्तो॑ वृ॒त्राण्य॑प्र॒ति ॥
