Rich in prosperity, rich in milk, founded and built upon the earth,
Injure not thy receivers, House who holdest food of every sort!’
Grass-covered, clad with straw, the house, like Night, gives rest to man and beast.
Thou standest, built upon the earth, like a she-elephant, borne on feet.
I loosen and remove from thee thy covering formed by mats of reed.
What Varuna hath firmly closed Mitra shall ope at early morn.
May Indra, Agni, deathless Gods, protect the house where Soma dwells,
House that was founded with the prayer, built and erected by the wise.
Nest upon nest hath been imposed, compartment on compart-ment laid:
There man shall propagate his kind, and there shall everything born.
Within the house constructed with two side-posts, or with four, or six.
Built with eight side-posts, or with ten, lies Agni like a babe unborn.
Turned to thee, House! I come to thee, innocent, turned to welcome me:
For Fire and Water are within, the first chief door of sacrifice.
Water that kills Consumption, free from all Consumption, here I bring.
With Agni, the immortal one, I enter and possess the house.
Lay thou no cord or noose on us: a weighty burthen, still be light!
Withersoever be our will, O House, we bear thee like a bride.
Now from the east side of the house to the Great Power be homage paid!
Hail to the Gods whose due is Hail!
Now from the south side of the house, etc.
Now from the west side of the house, etc.
Now from the north side of the house, etc.
So from the mansion’s every side to the Great Power be homage paid!
Hail to the Gods whose due is Hail!

verses.sanskrit:
यत् ते॑ न॒द्धं वि॑श्ववारे॒ पाशो॑ ग्र॒न्थिश्च॒ यः कृ॒तः ।
बृह॒स्पति॑रिवा॒हं ब॒लं वा॒चा वि स्रं॑सयामि॒ तत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yat te naddhaṃ viśvavāre pāśo granthiśca yaḥ kṛtaḥ |
bṛhaspatirivāhaṃ balaṃ vācā vi sraṃsayāmi tat ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ य॑याम॒ सं ब॑बर्ह ग्र॒न्थींश्च॑कार ते दृ॒ढान् ।
परूं॑षि वि॒द्वांछस्ते॒वेन्द्रे॑ण॒ वि चृ॑तामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā yayāma saṃ babarha granthīṃścakāra te dṛḍhān |
parūṃṣi vidvāṃchastevendreṇa vi cṛtāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
वं॒शानां॑ ते॒ नह॑नानां प्राणा॒हस्य॒ तृण॑स्य च ।
प॒क्षाणां॑ विश्ववारे ते न॒द्धानि॒ वि चृ॑तामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
vaṃśānāṃ te nahanānāṃ prāṇāhasya tṛṇasya ca |
pakṣāṇāṃ viśvavāre te naddhāni vi cṛtāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
सं॒दं॒शानां॑ पल॒दानां॒ परि॑ष्वञ्जल्यस्य च ।
इ॒दं मान॑स्य॒ पत्न्या॑ न॒द्धानि॒ वि चृ॑तामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃdaṃśānāṃ paladānāṃ pariṣvañjalyasya ca |
idaṃ mānasya patnyā naddhāni vi cṛtāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
यानि॑ ते॒ऽन्तः शि॒क्याऽन्याबे॒धू र॒ण्याऽय॒ कम् ।
प्र ते॒ तानि॑ चृतामसि शि॒वा मान॑स्य॒ पत्नि॑ न॒ उद्धि॑ता त॒न्वेऽ भव ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāni te'ntaḥ śikyā'nyābedhū raṇyā'ya kam |
pra te tāni cṛtāmasi śivā mānasya patni na uddhitā tanve' bhava ||

verses.sanskrit:
ह॒वि॒र्धान॑मग्नि॒शालं॒ पत्नी॑नां॒ सद॑नं॒ सदः॑ ।
सदो॑ दे॒वाना॑मसि देवि शाले ॥
verses.transliteration:
havirdhānamagniśālaṃ patnīnāṃ sadanaṃ sadaḥ |
sado devānāmasi devi śāle ||

verses.sanskrit:
अक्षु॑मोप॒शं वित॑तं सहस्रा॒क्षं वि॑षू॒वति॑ ।
अव॑नद्धम॒भिहि॑तं॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ वि चृ॑तामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
akṣumopaśaṃ vitataṃ sahasrākṣaṃ viṣūvati |
avanaddhamabhihitaṃ brahmaṇā vi cṛtāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्त्वा॑ शाले प्रतिगृ॒ह्णाति॒ येन॒ चासि॑ मि॒ता त्वम् ।
उ॒भौ मा॑नस्य पत्नि॒ तौ जीव॑तां ज॒रद॑ष्टी ॥
verses.transliteration:
yastvā śāle pratigṛhṇāti yena cāsi mitā tvam |
ubhau mānasya patni tau jīvatāṃ jaradaṣṭī ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒मुत्रै॑न॒मा ग॑च्छताद् दृ॒ढा न॒द्धा परि॑ष्कृता ।
यस्या॑स्ते विचृ॒ताम॒स्यङ्ग॑मङ्गं॒ परु॑ष्परुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
amutrainamā gacchatād dṛḍhā naddhā pariṣkṛtā |
yasyāste vicṛtāmasyaṅgamaṅgaṃ paruṣparuḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्त्वा॑ शाले निमि॒माय॑ संज॒भार॒ वन॒स्पती॑न् ।
प्र॒जायै॑ चक्रे त्वा शाले परमे॒ष्ठी प्र॒जाप॑तिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yastvā śāle nimimāya saṃjabhāra vanaspatīn |
prajāyai cakre tvā śāle parameṣṭhī prajāpatiḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
नम॒स्तस्मै॒ नमो॑ दा॒त्रे शाला॑पतये च कृण्मः ।
नमो॒ऽग्नये॑ प्र॒चर॑ते॒ पुरु॑षाय च ते॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
namastasmai namo dātre śālāpataye ca kṛṇmaḥ |
namo'gnaye pracarate puruṣāya ca te namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
गोभ्यो॒ अश्वे॑भ्यो॒ नमो॒ यच्छाला॑यां वि॒जाय॑ते ।
विजा॑वति॒ प्रजा॑वति॒ वि ते॒ पाशां॑श्चृतामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
gobhyo aśvebhyo namo yacchālāyāṃ vijāyate |
vijāvati prajāvati vi te pāśāṃścṛtāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निम॒न्तश्छा॑दयसि॒ पुरु॑षान् प॒शुभिः॑ स॒ह ।
विजा॑वति॒ प्रजा॑वति॒ वि ते॒ पाशां॑श्चृतामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnimantaśchādayasi puruṣān paśubhiḥ saha |
vijāvati prajāvati vi te pāśāṃścṛtāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न्त॒रा द्यां च॑ पृथि॒वीं च॒ यद् व्यच॒स्तेन॒ शालां॒ प्रति॑ गृह्णामि त इ॒माम् ।
यद॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ रज॑सो वि॒मानं॒ तत् कृ॑ण्वे॒ऽहमु॒दरं॑ शेव॒धिभ्यः॑ ।
तेन॒ शालां॒ प्रति॑ गृह्णामि॒ तस्मै॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
antarā dyāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ ca yad vyacastena śālāṃ prati gṛhṇāmi ta imām |
yadantarikṣaṃ rajaso vimānaṃ tat kṛṇve'hamudaraṃ śevadhibhyaḥ |
tena śālāṃ prati gṛhṇāmi tasmai ||

verses.sanskrit:
ऊर्ज॑स्वती॒ पय॑स्वती पृथि॒व्यां निमि॑ता मि॒ता ।
वि॒श्वा॒न्नं बिभ्र॑ती शाले॒ मा हिं॑सीः प्रतिगृह्ण॒तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ūrjasvatī payasvatī pṛthivyāṃ nimitā mitā |
viśvānnaṃ bibhratī śāle mā hiṃsīḥ pratigṛhṇataḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
तृणै॒रावृ॑ता पल॒दान् वसा॑ना॒ रात्री॑व॒ शाला॒ जग॑तो नि॒वेश॑नी ।
मि॒ता पृ॑थि॒व्यां ति॑ष्ठसि ह॒स्तिनी॑व प॒द्वती॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tṛṇairāvṛtā paladān vasānā rātrīva śālā jagato niveśanī |
mitā pṛthivyāṃ tiṣṭhasi hastinīva padvatī ||

verses.sanskrit:
इट॑स्य ते॒ वि चृ॑ता॒म्यपि॑नद्धमपोर्णु॒वन् ।
वरु॑णेन॒ समु॑ब्जितां मि॒त्रः प्रा॒तर्व्युऽब्जतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
iṭasya te vi cṛtāmyapinaddhamaporṇuvan |
varuṇena samubjitāṃ mitraḥ prātarvyu'bjatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्म॑णा॒ शालां॒ निमि॑तां क॒विभि॒र्निमि॑तां मि॒ताम् ।
इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्नी र॑क्षतां॒ शाला॑म॒मृतौ॑ सो॒म्यं सदः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmaṇā śālāṃ nimitāṃ kavibhirnimitāṃ mitām |
indrāgnī rakṣatāṃ śālāmamṛtau somyaṃ sadaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
कु॒लायेऽधि॑ कु॒लायं॒ कोशे॒ कोशः॒ समु॑ब्जितः ।
तत्र॒ मर्तो॒ वि जा॑यते॒ यस्मा॒द् विश्वं॑ प्र॒जाय॑ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
kulāye'dhi kulāyaṃ kośe kośaḥ samubjitaḥ |
tatra marto vi jāyate yasmād viśvaṃ prajāyate ||

verses.sanskrit:
या द्विप॑क्षा॒ चतु॑ष्पक्षा॒ षट् प॑क्षा॒ या नि॑मी॒यते॑ ।
अ॒ष्टाप॑क्षां॒ दश॑पक्षां॒ शालां॒ मान॑स्य॒ पत्नी॑म॒ग्निर्गर्भ॑ इ॒वा श॑ये ॥
verses.transliteration:
yā dvipakṣā catuṣpakṣā ṣaṭ pakṣā yā nimīyate |
aṣṭāpakṣāṃ daśapakṣāṃ śālāṃ mānasya patnīmagnirgarbha ivā śaye ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒तीचीं॑ त्वा प्रती॒चीनः॒ शाले॒ प्रैम्यहिं॑सतीम् ।
अ॒ग्निर्ह्य॑१न्तराप॑श्च॒र्तस्य॑ प्रथ॒मा द्वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
pratīcīṃ tvā pratīcīnaḥ śāle praimyahiṃsatīm |
agnirhyantarāpaścartasya prathamā dvāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मा आपः॒ प्र भ॑राम्यय॒क्ष्मा य॑क्ष्म॒नाश॑नीः ।
गृ॒हानुप॒ प्र सी॑दाम्य॒मृते॑न स॒हाग्निना॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
imā āpaḥ pra bharāmyayakṣmā yakṣmanāśanīḥ |
gṛhānupa pra sīdāmyamṛtena sahāgninā ||

verses.sanskrit:
मा नः॒ पाशं॒ प्रति॑ मुचो गु॒रुर्भा॒रो ल॒घुर्भ॑व ।
व॒धूमि॑व त्वा शाले यत्र॒कामं॑ भरामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
mā naḥ pāśaṃ prati muco gururbhāro laghurbhava |
vadhūmiva tvā śāle yatrakāmaṃ bharāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit: प्राच्या॑ दि॒शः शाला॑या॒ नमो॑ महि॒म्ने स्वाहा॑ दे॒वेभ्यः॑ स्वा॒ह्येऽभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: prācyā diśaḥ śālāyā namo mahimne svāhā devebhyaḥ svāhye'bhyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: दक्षि॑णाया दि॒शः शाला॑या॒ नमो॑ महि॒म्ने स्वाहा॑ दे॒वेभ्यः॑ स्वा॒ह्येऽभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāyā diśaḥ śālāyā namo mahimne svāhā devebhyaḥ svāhye'bhyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒तीच्या॑ दि॒शः शाला॑या॒ नमो॑ महि॒म्ने स्वाहा॑ दे॒वेभ्यः॑ स्वा॒ह्येऽभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: pratīcyā diśaḥ śālāyā namo mahimne svāhā devebhyaḥ svāhye'bhyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: उदी॑च्या दि॒शः शाला॑या॒ नमो॑ महि॒म्ने स्वाहा॑ दे॒वेभ्यः॑ स्वा॒ह्येऽभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: udīcyā diśaḥ śālāyā namo mahimne svāhā devebhyaḥ svāhye'bhyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: ध्रु॒वाया॑ दि॒शः शाला॑या॒ नमो॑ महि॒म्ने स्वाहा॑ दे॒वेभ्यः॑ स्वा॒ह्येऽभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: dhruvāyā diśaḥ śālāyā namo mahimne svāhā devebhyaḥ svāhye'bhyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वाया॑ दि॒शः शाला॑या॒ नमो॑ महि॒म्ने स्वाहा॑ दे॒वेभ्यः॑ स्वा॒ह्येऽभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvāyā diśaḥ śālāyā namo mahimne svāhā devebhyaḥ svāhye'bhyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: दि॒शोदि॑शः॒ शाला॑या॒ नमो॑ महि॒म्ने स्वाहा॑ दे॒वेभ्यः॑ स्वा॒ह्येऽभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: diśodiśaḥ śālāyā namo mahimne svāhā devebhyaḥ svāhye'bhyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
सा॒ह॒स्रस्त्वे॒ष ऋ॑ष॒भः पय॑स्वा॒न् विश्वा॑ रू॒पाणि॑ व॒क्षणा॑सु॒ बिभ्र॑त् ।
भ॒द्रं दा॒त्रे यज॑मानाय॒ शीक्ष॑न् बार्हस्प॒त्य उ॒स्रिय॒स्तन्तु॒माता॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sāhasrastveṣa ṛṣabhaḥ payasvān viśvā rūpāṇi vakṣaṇāsu bibhrat |
bhadraṃ dātre yajamānāya śīkṣan bārhaspatya usriyastantumātān ||
verses.translation:
A glorification of the typical sacrificial bull
The Bull, fierce, thousandfold, filled full of vigour, bearing within his flanks all forms and natures,
Brihaspati’s Steer, hath stretched the thread, bestowing bliss on the worshipper, the liberal giver.
He who at first became the Waters’ model, a match for everyone, like Earth the Goddess;
The husband of the cows, the young calves’ father, may be secure us thousandfold abundance.
Masculine, prégnant, stedfast. full of vigour, the Bull sustains a trunk of goodly treasure.
May Agni Jātavedas bear him offered, on pathways traversed by the Gods, to Indra.
The husband of the cows, the young calves’ father, father is he of mighty water-eddies.
Calf, after-birth, new milk drawn hot, and biestings, curds, butter, that is his best genial humour.
He is the Gods’ allotted share and bundle, essence of waters, and of plants, and butter.
Sakra elected him, the draught of Soma. What was his body was a lofty mountain.
A beaker filled with Soma juice thou bearest. framer of forms, begetter of the cattle.
Kindly to us be these thy wombs here present, and stay for us,
O Axe, those that are yonder.
He bears oblation, and his seed is butter. Thousand-fold plenty; sacrifice they call him.
May he, the Bull, wearing the shape of Indra, come unto us, O Gods, bestowed, with blessing.
Both arms of Varuna, and Indra’s vigour, the Maruts’ hump is he, the Asvins’ shoulders.
They who are sages, bards endowed with wisdom, call him Brihaspati compact and heightened.
Thou, vigorous, reachest to the tribes of heaven. Thee they call Indra, thee they call Sarasvān.
Turned to one aim, that Brāhman gives a thousand who offers up the Bull as his oblation.
Brihaspati, Savitar gave thee vital vigour: thy breath was brought from Tvashtar and from Vāyu.
In thought I offer thee in air’s mid-region. Thy sacrificial grass be Earth and Heaven!
Let the priest joyfully extol the limbs and members of the Bull Who moved and roared among the kine as Indra moves among the Gods.
The sides must be Anumati’s, and both rib-pieces Bhaga’s share,
Of the knee-bones hath Mitra said, Both these are mine, and only mine.
The Ādityas claim the hinder parts, the loins must be Brihas-pati’s.
Vāta, the God, receives the tail: he stirs the plants and herbs therewith,
To Sūryā they assigned the skin, to Sinivāli inward parts.
The Slaughterer hath the feet, they said, when they distributed the Bull.
They made a jest of kindred’s curse: a jar of Soma juice was set,
What time the deities, convened, assigned the Bull’s divided parts.
They gave the hooves to tortoises, to Saramā scraps of the feet:
His undigested food they gave to worms and things that creep and crawl.
That Bull, the husband of the kine, pierces the demons with his horns,
Banishes famine with his eye, and hears good tidings with his ears.
With hundred sacrifices he worships: the fires consume him not:
All Gods promote the Braman who offers the Bull in sacrifice.
He who hath given away the Bull to Brāhmans frees and cheers his soul.
In his own cattle-pen he sees the growth and increase of his cows.
Let there be cattle, let there be bodily strength and progeny:
All this may the Gods kindly grant to him who gives away the Bull.
Indra here verily hath rejoiced: let him bestow conspicuous wealth.
May he draw forth at will from yonder side of heaven a deft cow, good to milk, whose calf is never wanting.
With close connexion mingle with the cows in this our cattle-pen:
Mingle, the Bull’s prolific flow, and, Indra! thine heroic strength!
Here we restore this Bull, your youthful leader: sporting with him, go, wander at your pleasure.
Ne’er, wealthy ones! may he be reft of offspring; and do ye favour us with growth of riches.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पां यो अग्ने॑ प्रति॒मा ब॒भूव॑ प्र॒भूः सर्व॑स्मै पृथि॒वीव॑ दे॒वी ।
पि॒ता व॒त्सानां॒ पति॑र॒घ्न्यानां॑ साह॒स्रे पोषे॒ अपि॑ नः कृणोतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
apāṃ yo agne pratimā babhūva prabhūḥ sarvasmai pṛthivīva devī |
pitā vatsānāṃ patiraghnyānāṃ sāhasre poṣe api naḥ kṛṇotu ||

verses.sanskrit:
पुमा॑न॒न्तर्वा॒न्त्स्थवि॑रः॒ पय॑स्वा॒न् वसोः॒ कब॑न्धमृष॒भो बि॑भर्ति ।
तमिन्द्रा॑य प॒थिभि॑र्देव॒यानै॑र्हु॒तम॒ग्निर्व॑हतु जा॒तवे॑दाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
pumānantarvāntsthaviraḥ payasvān vasoḥ kabandhamṛṣabho bibharti |
tamindrāya pathibhirdevayānairhutamagnirvahatu jātavedāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
पि॒ता व॒त्सानां॒ पति॑र॒घ्न्याना॒मथो॑ पि॒ता म॑ह॒तां गर्ग॑राणाम् ।
व॒त्सो ज॒रायु॑ प्रति॒धुक् पी॒यूष॑ आ॒मिक्षा॑ घृ॒तं तद् व॑स्य॒ रेतः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pitā vatsānāṃ patiraghnyānāmatho pitā mahatāṃ gargarāṇām |
vatso jarāyu pratidhuk pīyūṣa āmikṣā ghṛtaṃ tad vasya retaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वानां॑ भा॒ग उ॑पना॒ह ए॒षो॒३पां रस॒ ओष॑धीनां घृ॒तस्य॑ ।
सोम॑स्य भ॒क्षम॑वृणीत श॒क्रो बृ॒हन्नद्रि॑रभव॒द् यच्छरी॑रम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
devānāṃ bhāga upanāha eṣopāṃ rasa oṣadhīnāṃ ghṛtasya |
somasya bhakṣamavṛṇīta śakro bṛhannadrirabhavad yaccharīram ||

verses.sanskrit:
सोमे॑न पू॒र्णं क॒लशं॑ बिभर्षि॒ त्वष्टा॑ रु॒पाणां॑ जनि॒ता प॑शू॒नाम् ।
शि॒वास्ते॑ सन्तु प्रज॒न्वऽ इ॒ह या इ॒मा न्य॑स्मभ्यं॑ स्वधिते यच्छ॒ या अ॒मूः ॥
verses.transliteration:
somena pūrṇaṃ kalaśaṃ bibharṣi tvaṣṭā rupāṇāṃ janitā paśūnām |
śivāste santu prajanva' iha yā imā nyasmabhyaṃ svadhite yaccha yā amūḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
आज्यं बिभर्ति घृ॒तम॑स्य॒ रेतः॑ साह॒स्रः पोष॒स्तमु॑ य॒ज्ञमा॑हुः ।
इन्द्र॑स्य रू॒पमृ॑ष॒भो वसा॑नः॒ सो अ॒स्मान् दे॑वाः शि॒व ऐतु॑ द॒त्तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ājyaṃ bibharti ghṛtamasya retaḥ sāhasraḥ poṣastamu yajñamāhuḥ |
indrasya rūpamṛṣabho vasānaḥ so asmān devāḥ śiva aitu dattaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॒स्यौजो॒ वरु॑णस्य बा॒हू अ॒श्विनो॒रंसौ॑ म॒रुता॑मि॒यं क॒कुत् ।
बृह॒स्पतिं॒ संभृ॑तमे॒तमा॑हु॒र्ये धीरा॑सः क॒वयो॒ ये म॑नी॒षिणः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrasyaujo varuṇasya bāhū aśvinoraṃsau marutāmiyaṃ kakut |
bṛhaspatiṃ saṃbhṛtametamāhurye dhīrāsaḥ kavayo ye manīṣiṇaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
दैवी॒र्विशः॒ पय॑स्वा॒ना त॑नोषि॒ त्वामिन्द्रं॒ त्वां सर॑स्वन्तमाहुः ।
स॒हस्रं॒ स एक॑मुखा ददाति॒ यो ब्रा॑ह्म॒ण ऋ॑ष॒भमा॑जु॒होति॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
daivīrviśaḥ payasvānā tanoṣi tvāmindraṃ tvāṃ sarasvantamāhuḥ |
sahasraṃ sa ekamukhā dadāti yo brāhmaṇa ṛṣabhamājuhoti ||

verses.sanskrit:
बृह॒स्पतिः॑ सवि॒ता ते॒ वयो॑ दधौ॒ त्वष्टु॑र्वा॒योः पर्या॒त्मा त॒ आभृ॑तः ।
अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ मन॑सा त्वा जुहोमि ब॒र्हिष्टे॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी उ॒भे स्ता॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
bṛhaspatiḥ savitā te vayo dadhau tvaṣṭurvāyoḥ paryātmā ta ābhṛtaḥ |
antarikṣe manasā tvā juhomi barhiṣṭe dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām ||

verses.sanskrit:
य इन्द्र॑ इव दे॒वेषु॒ गोष्वेति॑ वि॒वाव॑दत् ।
तस्य॑ ऋष॒भस्याङ्गा॑नि ब्र॒ह्मा सं स्तौ॑तु भ॒द्रया॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya indra iva deveṣu goṣveti vivāvadat |
tasya ṛṣabhasyāṅgāni brahmā saṃ stautu bhadrayā ||

verses.sanskrit:
पा॒र्श्वे आ॑स्ता॒मनु॑मत्या॒ भग॑स्यास्तामनू॒वृजौ॑ ।
अ॒ष्ठी॒वन्ता॑वब्रवीन्मि॒त्रो ममै॒तौ केव॑ला॒विति॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pārśve āstāmanumatyā bhagasyāstāmanūvṛjau |
aṣṭhīvantāvabravīnmitro mamaitau kevalāviti ||

verses.sanskrit:
भ॒सदा॑सीदादि॒त्यानां॒ श्रोणी॑ आस्तां॒ बृह॒स्पतेः॑ ।
पुच्छं॒ वात॑स्य दे॒वस्य॒ तेन॑ धूनो॒त्योष॑धीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhasadāsīdādityānāṃ śroṇī āstāṃ bṛhaspateḥ |
pucchaṃ vātasya devasya tena dhūnotyoṣadhīḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
गुदा॑ आसन्त्सिनीवा॒ल्याः सू॒र्याया॒स्त्वच॑मब्रुवन् ।
उ॒त्था॒तुर॑ब्रुवन् प॒द ऋ॑ष॒भं यदक॑ल्पयन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
gudā āsantsinīvālyāḥ sūryāyāstvacamabruvan |
utthāturabruvan pada ṛṣabhaṃ yadakalpayan ||

verses.sanskrit:
क्रो॒ड आ॑सीज्जामिशं॒सस्य॒ सोम॑स्य क॒लशो॑ धृ॒तः ।
दे॒वाः सं॒गत्य॒ यत् सर्व॑ ऋष॒भं व्यक॑ल्पयन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
kroḍa āsījjāmiśaṃsasya somasya kalaśo dhṛtaḥ |
devāḥ saṃgatya yat sarva ṛṣabhaṃ vyakalpayan ||

verses.sanskrit:
ते कुष्ठि॑काः स॒रमा॑यै कू॒र्मेभ्यो॑ अदधुः श॒फान् ।
ऊब॑ध्यमस्य की॒टेभ्यः॑ श्वव॒र्तेभ्यो॑ अधारयन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
te kuṣṭhikāḥ saramāyai kūrmebhyo adadhuḥ śaphān |
ūbadhyamasya kīṭebhyaḥ śvavartebhyo adhārayan ||

verses.sanskrit:
शृङ्गा॑भ्यां॒ रक्ष॑ ऋष॒त्यव॑र्तिं हन्ति॒ चक्षु॑षा ।
शृ॒णोति॑ भ॒द्रं कर्णा॑भ्यां॒ गवां॒ यः पति॑र॒घ्न्यः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śṛṅgābhyāṃ rakṣa ṛṣatyavartiṃ hanti cakṣuṣā |
śṛṇoti bhadraṃ karṇābhyāṃ gavāṃ yaḥ patiraghnyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
श॒त॒याजं॒ स य॑जते॒ नैनं॑ दुन्वन्त्य॒ग्नयः॑ ।
जिन्व॑न्ति॒ विश्वे॒ तं दे॒वा यो ब्रा॑ह्म॒ण ऋ॑ष॒भमा॑जु॒होति॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
śatayājaṃ sa yajate nainaṃ dunvantyagnayaḥ |
jinvanti viśve taṃ devā yo brāhmaṇa ṛṣabhamājuhoti ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रा॒ह्म॒णेभ्य॑ ऋष॒भं द॒त्त्वा वरी॑यः कृणुते॒ मनः॑ ।
पुष्टिं॒ सो अ॒घ्न्यानां॒ स्वे गो॒ष्ठेऽव॑ पश्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
brāhmaṇebhya ṛṣabhaṃ dattvā varīyaḥ kṛṇute manaḥ |
puṣṭiṃ so aghnyānāṃ sve goṣṭhe'va paśyate ||

verses.sanskrit:
गावः॑ सन्तु प्र॒जाः स॒न्त्वथो॑ अस्तु तनूब॒लम् ।
तत् सर्व॒मनु॑ मन्यन्तां दे॒वा ऋ॑षभदा॒यिने॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
gāvaḥ santu prajāḥ santvatho astu tanūbalam |
tat sarvamanu manyantāṃ devā ṛṣabhadāyine ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यं पिपा॑न॒ इन्द्र॒ इद् र॒यिं द॑धातु चेत॒नीम् ।
अ॒यं धे॒नुं सु॒दुघां॒ नित्य॑वत्सां॒ वशं॑ दुहां विप॒श्चितं॑ प॒रो दि॒वः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ayaṃ pipāna indra id rayiṃ dadhātu cetanīm |
ayaṃ dhenuṃ sudughāṃ nityavatsāṃ vaśaṃ duhāṃ vipaścitaṃ paro divaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
पि॒शङ्ग॑रूपो नभ॒सो व॑यो॒धा ऐ॒न्द्रः शुष्मो॑ वि॒श्वरू॑पो न॒ आग॑न् ।
आयु॑र॒स्मभ्यं॒ दध॑त् प्र॒जां च॑ रा॒यश्च॒ पोषै॑र॒भि नः॑ सचताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
piśaṅgarūpo nabhaso vayodhā aindraḥ śuṣmo viśvarūpo na āgan |
āyurasmabhyaṃ dadhat prajāṃ ca rāyaśca poṣairabhi naḥ sacatām ||

verses.sanskrit:
उपे॒होप॑पर्चना॒स्मिन् गो॒ष्ठ उप॑ पृञ्च नः ।
उप॑ ऋष॒भस्य॒ यद् रेत॒ उपे॑न्द्र॒ तव॑ वी॒र्यऽम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
upehopaparcanāsmin goṣṭha upa pṛñca naḥ |
upa ṛṣabhasya yad reta upendra tava vīrya'm ||

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒तं वो॒ युवा॑नं॒ प्रति॑ दध्मो॒ अत्र॒ तेन॒ क्रीड॑न्तीश्चरत॒ वशाँ॒ अनु॑ ।
मा नो॑ हासिष्ट ज॒नुषा॑ सुभागा रा॒यश्च॒ पोषै॑र॒भि नः॑ सचध्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
etaṃ vo yuvānaṃ prati dadhmo atra tena krīḍantīścarata vaśām̐ anu |
mā no hāsiṣṭa januṣā subhāgā rāyaśca poṣairabhi naḥ sacadhvam ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ न॑यै॒तमा र॑भस्व सु॒कृतां॑ लो॒कमपि॑ गच्छतु प्रजा॒नन् ।
ती॒र्त्वा तमां॑सि बहु॒धा म॒हान्त्य॒जो नाक॒मा क्र॑मतां तृ॒तीय॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā nayaitamā rabhasva sukṛtāṃ lokamapi gacchatu prajānan |
tīrtvā tamāṃsi bahudhā mahāntyajo nākamā kramatāṃ tṛtīyam ||
verses.translation:
A glorification of a sacrificial goat
Seize him and bring him hither. Let him travel. foreknowing, to the regions of the pious.
Crossing in many a place the mighty darkness, let the Goat mount to the third heaven above us.
I bring thee hither as a share for Indra; prince, at this sacrifice,. for him who worships.
Grasp firmly from behind all those who hate us: so let the sacri-ficer’s men be sinless.
Wash from his feet all trace of evil-doing: foreknowing, with cleansed hooves let him go upward.
Gazing on many a spot, crossing the darkness, let the Goat mount to the third heaven above us.
Cut up this skin with the grey knife, Dissector! dividing joint from joint, and mangle nothing Do him no injury: limb by limb arrange him, and send him up to the third cope of heaven.
With verse upon the fire I set the caldron: pour in the water; lay him down within it!
Encompass him with fire, ye Immolators. Cooked, let him reach the world where dwell the righteous.
Hence come thou forth, vexed by no pain or torment. Mount to the third heaven from the heated vessel.
As fire out of the fire hast thou arisen. Conquer and win this lucid world of splendour.
The Goat is Agni: light they call him, saying that living man must give him to the Brāhman.
Given in this world by a devout believer, the Goat dispels and drives afar the darkness.
Let the Panchaudana Goat, about to visit the three lights, pass away in five divisions.
Go midst the pious who have paid their worship, and parted, dwell on the third cope of heaven.
Rise to that world, O Goat, where dwell the righteous: pass, like a Sarabha veiled, all difficult places.
The Goat Panchaudana, given to a Brāhman, shall with all ful-ness satisfy the giver.
The Goat Panchaudana, given to a Brāhman, sets the bestower on the pitch of heaven,
In the third vault, third sky, third ridge. One only Cow omni-form art thou, that yields all wishes.
That is the third light that is yours, ye Fathers. He gives the Goat Panchaudana to the Brāhman.
Given in this world by the devout believer, the Goat dispels and drives afar the darkness.
Seeking the world of good men who have worshipped, he gives the Goat Panchaudana to the Brāhman.
Win thou this world as thy complete possession. Auspicious unto us be he, accepted!
Truly the Goat sprang from the glow of Agni, inspired as sage with all a sage’s power.
Sacrifice, filled, filled full, offered with Vashat—this let the Gods arrange.at proper seasons.
Home-woven raiment let him give, and gold as guerdon to the priests.
So he obtains completely all celestial and terrestrial worlds.
Near to thee, Goat! approach these streams of Soma, divine, distilling meath, bedecked with butter!
Stay thou the earth and sky and fix them firmly up on the seven-rayed pitch and height of heaven.
Unborn art thou, O Goat: to heaven thou goest. Though thee Angirases knew that radiant region.
So may I know that holy world.
Convey our sacrifice to heaven, that it may reach the Gods, with that Whereby thou, Agni, bearest wealth in thousands, and all pre-cious things.
The Goat Panchaudana, when cooked, transporteth, repelling Nirriti, to the world of Svarga.
By him may we win worlds which Sūrya brightens.
The droppings of the Odanas attending the Goat which I have lodged with priest or people May all this know us in the world of virtue, O Agni, at the meeting of the pathways.
This Unborn cleft apart in the beginning: his breast became the earth, his back was heaven.
His middle was the air, his sides the regions; the hollows of his belly formed both oceans.
His eyes were Truth and Right. The whole together was Truth:
Virāj his head and Faith his breathing.
This Goat Panchaudana was indeed a sacrifice unlimited.
A boundless sacrifice he performs, he wins himself a boundless world:
Who gives the Goat Panchaudana illumined with a priestly fee.
Let him not break the victim’s bones, let him not suck the marrow out.
Let the man, taking him entire, here, even here deposit him.
This, even this is his true form: the man uniteth him therewith.
Food, greatness, strength he bringeth him who giveth the Goat Panchaudana illumed with guerdon.
The five gold pieces, and the five new garments, and the five milch-kine yield him all his wishes.
Who gives the Goat Panchaudana illumined with a priestly fee.
The five gold pieces, area light to light him, robes become armour to defend his body;
He winneth Svarga as his home who giveth the Goat Panchaud-ana illumed with bountry.
When she who hath been wedded finds a second husband after-ward,
The twain shall not be parted if they give the Goat Panchaud-ana.
One world with the re-wedded wife becomes the second hus-band’s home.
Who gives the Goat Panchaudana illumined with the priestly fee.
They who have given a cow who drops a calf each season, or an ox,
A coverlet, a robe, or gold, go to the loftiest sphere of heaven.
Himself, the father and the son, the grandson, and the father’s sire,
Mother, wife, her who bore his babes, all the beloved ones I call.
The man who knows the season named the Scorching—the Goat Pafichaudana is this scorching season He lives himself, he verily burns up his hated rival’s fame,
Who gives the Goat Panchaudana illumined with the priestly fee.
The man who knows the season called the Working takes to himself the active fame, his hated rival’s active fame.
The Goat Panchaudana is this Working season.
He lives himself, etc.
The man who knows the season called the Meeting takes to him-self the gathering fame, his hated rival’s gathering fame.
The Goat Panchaudana is this Meeting season.
The man who knows the called the Swelling takes to himself the swelling fame, his hated rival’s swelling fame.
The Goat Panchaudana is this Swelling season.
He lives himself, etc.
The man who knows the season called the Rising takes to him-self the rising fame, his hated rival’s rising fame.
The Goat Panchaudana in this Rising season.
The man who knows the season called Surpassing takes to him-self thé conquering fame, his hated rival’s conquering fame.
The Goat Panchaudana is this Conquering season.
He lives himself, he verily burns up his hated rival’s fame Who gives the Goat Panchaudana illumined with a priestly fee.
He cooks the Goat and the five boiled rice messes. May the uni-ted Quarters, all accordant, and intermediate points, accept him from thee.
May these preserve him for thee. Here I offer t o these the molten butter as oblation.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रा॑य भा॒गं परि॑ त्वा नयाम्य॒स्मिन् य॒ज्ञे यज॑मानाय सू॒रिम् ।
ये नो॑ द्वि॒षन्त्यनु तान् र॑भ॒स्वाना॑गसो॒ यज॑मानस्य वी॒राः ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrāya bhāgaṃ pari tvā nayāmyasmin yajñe yajamānāya sūrim |
ye no dviṣantyanu tān rabhasvānāgaso yajamānasya vīrāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र प॒दोऽव॑ नेनिग्धि॒ दुश्च॑रितं॒ यच्च॒चार॑ शु॒द्धैः श॒फैरा क्र॑मतां प्रजा॒नन् ।
ती॒र्त्वा तमां॑सि बहु॒धा वि॒पश्य॑न्न॒जो नाक॒मा क्र॑मतां तृ॒तीय॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra pado'va nenigdhi duścaritaṃ yaccacāra śuddhaiḥ śaphairā kramatāṃ prajānan |
tīrtvā tamāṃsi bahudhā vipaśyannajo nākamā kramatāṃ tṛtīyam ||

verses.sanskrit:
अनु॑च्छ्य श्या॒मेन॒ त्वच॑मे॒तां वि॑शस्तर्यथाप॒र्व॑१सिना॒ माभि मं॑स्थाः ।
माभि द्रु॑हः परु॒शः क॑ल्पयैनं तृ॒तीये॒ नाके॒ अधि॒ वि श्र॑यैनम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
anucchya śyāmena tvacametāṃ viśastaryathāparvasinā mābhi maṃsthāḥ |
mābhi druhaḥ paruśaḥ kalpayainaṃ tṛtīye nāke adhi vi śrayainam ||

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒चा कु॒म्भीमध्य॒ग्नौ श्र॑या॒म्या सि॑ञ्चोद॒कमव॑ धेह्येनम् ।
प॒र्याध॑त्ता॒ग्निना॑ शमितारः शृ॒तो ग॑च्छतु सु॒कृतां॒ यत्र॑ लो॒कः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛcā kumbhīmadhyagnau śrayāmyā siñcodakamava dhehyenam |
paryādhattāgninā śamitāraḥ śṛto gacchatu sukṛtāṃ yatra lokaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
उत् क्रा॒मातः॒ परि॒ चेदत॑प्तस्त॒प्ताच्च॒रोरधि॒ नाकं॑ तृ॒तीय॑म् ।
अ॒ग्नेर॒ग्निरधि॒ सं ब॑भूविथ॒ ज्योति॑ष्मन्तम॒भि लो॒कं ज॑यै॒तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ut krāmātaḥ pari cedataptastaptāccaroradhi nākaṃ tṛtīyam |
agneragniradhi saṃ babhūvitha jyotiṣmantamabhi lokaṃ jayaitam ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒जो अ॒ग्निर॒जमु॒ ज्योति॑राहुर॒जं जीव॑ता ब्र॒ह्मणे॒ देय॑माहुः ।
अ॒जस्तमां॒स्यप॑ हन्ति दू॒रम॒स्मिंल्लो॒के श्र॒द्दधा॑नेन द॒त्तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ajo agnirajamu jyotirāhurajaṃ jīvatā brahmaṇe deyamāhuḥ |
ajastamāṃsyapa hanti dūramasmiṃlloke śraddadhānena dattaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
पञ्चौ॑दनः पञ्च॒धा वि क्र॑मतामाक्रं॒स्यमा॑न॒स्त्रीणि॒ ज्योतीं॑षि ।
ई॒जा॒नानां॑ सु॒कृतां॒ प्रेहि॒ मध्यं॑ तृ॒तीये॒ नाके॒ अधि॒ वि श्र॑यस्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
pañcaudanaḥ pañcadhā vi kramatāmākraṃsyamānastrīṇi jyotīṃṣi |
ījānānāṃ sukṛtāṃ prehi madhyaṃ tṛtīye nāke adhi vi śrayasva ||

verses.sanskrit:
अजा रो॑ह सु॒कृतां॒ यत्र॑ लो॒कः श॑र॒भो न च॒त्तोऽति॑ दु॒र्गान्ये॑षः ।
पञ्चौ॑दनो ब्र॒ह्मणे॑ दी॒यमा॑नः॒ स दा॒तारं॒ तृप्त्या॑ तर्पयाति ॥
verses.transliteration:
ajā roha sukṛtāṃ yatra lokaḥ śarabho na catto'ti durgānyeṣaḥ |
pañcaudano brahmaṇe dīyamānaḥ sa dātāraṃ tṛptyā tarpayāti ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒जस्त्रि॑ना॒के त्रि॑दि॒वे त्रि॑पृ॒ष्ठे नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठे द॑दि॒वांसं॑ दधाति ।
पञ्चौ॑दनो ब्र॒ह्मणे॑ दी॒यमा॑नो वि॒श्वरू॑पा धे॒नुः का॑म॒दुघा॒स्येका॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ajastrināke tridive tripṛṣṭhe nākasya pṛṣṭhe dadivāṃsaṃ dadhāti |
pañcaudano brahmaṇe dīyamāno viśvarūpā dhenuḥ kāmadughāsyekā ||

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒तद् वो॒ ज्योतिः॑ पितरस्तृ॒तीयं॒ पञ्चौ॑दनं ब्र॒ह्मणे॒ऽजं द॑दाति ।
अ॒जस्तमां॒स्यप॑ हन्ति दू॒रम॒स्मिंल्लो॒के श्र॒द्दधा॑नेन द॒त्तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
etad vo jyotiḥ pitarastṛtīyaṃ pañcaudanaṃ brahmaṇe'jaṃ dadāti |
ajastamāṃsyapa hanti dūramasmiṃlloke śraddadhānena dattaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ई॒जा॒नानां॑ सु॒कृतां॑ लो॒कमीप्स॒न् पञ्चौ॑दनं ब्र॒ह्मणे॒ऽजं द॑दाति ।
स व्याऽप्तिम॒भि लो॒कं ज॑यै॒तं शि॒वो॒३ऽस्मभ्यं॒ प्रति॑गृहीतो अस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
ījānānāṃ sukṛtāṃ lokamīpsan pañcaudanaṃ brahmaṇe'jaṃ dadāti |
sa vyā'ptimabhi lokaṃ jayaitaṃ śivo'smabhyaṃ pratigṛhīto astu ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒जो ह्य॑१ग्नेरज॑निष्ट॒ शोका॒द् विप्रो॒ विप्र॑स्य॒ सह॑सो विप॒श्चित् ।
इ॒ष्टं पू॒र्तम॒भिपू॑र्तं॒ वष॑ट्कृतं॒ तद् दे॒वा ऋ॑तु॒शः क॑ल्पयन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
ajo hyagnerajaniṣṭa śokād vipro viprasya sahaso vipaścit |
iṣṭaṃ pūrtamabhipūrtaṃ vaṣaṭkṛtaṃ tad devā ṛtuśaḥ kalpayantu ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒मो॒तं वासो॑ दद्या॒द्धिर॑ण्य॒मपि॒ दक्षि॑णाम् ।
तथा॑ लो॒कान्त्समा॑प्नोति॒ ये दि॒व्या ये च॒ पार्थि॑वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
amotaṃ vāso dadyāddhiraṇyamapi dakṣiṇām |
tathā lokāntsamāpnoti ye divyā ye ca pārthivāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒तास्त्वा॒जोप॑ यन्तु॒ धाराः॑ सो॒म्या दे॒वीर्घृ॒तपृ॑ष्ठा मधु॒श्चुतः॑ ।
स्त॒भा॒न पृ॑थि॒वीमु॒त द्यां नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठेऽधि॑ स॒प्तर॑श्मौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
etāstvājopa yantu dhārāḥ somyā devīrghṛtapṛṣṭhā madhuścutaḥ |
stabhāna pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ nākasya pṛṣṭhe'dhi saptaraśmau ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒जो॒३स्यज॑ स्वर्गोऽसि॒ त्वया॑ लो॒कमङ्गि॑रसः॒ प्राजा॑नन् ।
तं लो॒कं पुण्यं॒ प्र ज्ञे॑षम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ajosyaja svargo'si tvayā lokamaṅgirasaḥ prājānan |
taṃ lokaṃ puṇyaṃ pra jñeṣam ||

verses.sanskrit:
येना॑ स॒हस्रं॒ वह॑सि॒ येना॑ग्ने सर्ववेद॒सम् ।
तेने॒मं य॒ज्ञं नो॑ वह॒ स्वऽर्दे॒वेषु॒ गन्त॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration:
yenā sahasraṃ vahasi yenāgne sarvavedasam |
tenemaṃ yajñaṃ no vaha sva'rdeveṣu gantave ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒जः प॒क्वः स्व॒र्गे लो॒के द॑धाति॒ पञ्चौ॑दनो॒ निरृ॑तिं॒ बाध॑मानः ।
तेन॑ लो॒कान्त्सूर्य॑वतो जयेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
ajaḥ pakvaḥ svarge loke dadhāti pañcaudano nirṛtiṃ bādhamānaḥ |
tena lokāntsūryavato jayema ||

verses.sanskrit:
यं ब्रा॑ह्म॒णे नि॑द॒धे यं च॑ वि॒क्षु या वि॒प्रुष॑ ओद॒नाना॑म॒जस्य॑ ।
सर्वं॒ तद॑ग्ने सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒के जा॑नी॒तान्नः॑ सं॒गम॑ने पथी॒नाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaṃ brāhmaṇe nidadhe yaṃ ca vikṣu yā vipruṣa odanānāmajasya |
sarvaṃ tadagne sukṛtasya loke jānītānnaḥ saṃgamane pathīnām ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒जो वा इ॒दमग्ने॒ व्यऽक्रमत॒ तस्योर॑ इ॒यम॑भव॒द् द्यौः पृ॒ष्ठम् ।
अ॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ मध्यं॒ दिशः॑ पा॒र्श्वे स॑मु॒द्रौ कु॒क्षी ॥
verses.transliteration:
ajo vā idamagne vya'kramata tasyora iyamabhavad dyauḥ pṛṣṭham |
antarikṣaṃ madhyaṃ diśaḥ pārśve samudrau kukṣī ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒त्यं च॒र्तं च॒ चक्षु॑षी॒ विश्वं॑ स॒त्यं श्र॒द्धा प्रा॒णो वि॒राट् शिरः॑ ।
ए॒ष वा अप॑रिमितो य॒ज्ञो यद॒जः पञ्चौ॑दनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
satyaṃ cartaṃ ca cakṣuṣī viśvaṃ satyaṃ śraddhā prāṇo virāṭ śiraḥ |
eṣa vā aparimito yajño yadajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अप॑रिमितमे॒व य॒ज्ञमा॒प्नोत्यप॑रिमितं लो॒कमव॑ रुन्धे ।
यो॒३ऽजं पञ्चौ॑दनं॒ दक्षि॑णाज्योतिषं॒ ददा॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
aparimitameva yajñamāpnotyaparimitaṃ lokamava rundhe |
yo'jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti ||

verses.sanskrit:
नास्यास्थी॑नि भिन्द्या॒न्न म॒ज्ज्ञो निर्ध॑येत् ।
सर्व॑मेनं समा॒दाये॒दमि॑दं॒ प्र वे॑शयेत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
nāsyāsthīni bhindyānna majjño nirdhayet |
sarvamenaṃ samādāyedamidaṃ pra veśayet ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दमि॑दमे॒वास्य॑ रू॒पं भ॑वति॒ तेनै॑नं॒ सं ग॑मयति ।
इषं॒ मह॒ ऊर्ज॑मस्मै दुहे॒ यो॒३ऽजं पञ्चौ॑दनं दक्षि॑णाज्योतिषं॒ ददा॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
idamidamevāsya rūpaṃ bhavati tenainaṃ saṃ gamayati |
iṣaṃ maha ūrjamasmai duhe yo'jaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti ||

verses.sanskrit:
पञ्च॑ रु॒क्मा पञ्च॒ नवा॑नि॒ वस्त्रा॒ पञ्चा॑स्मै धे॒नवः॑ काम॒दुघा॑ भवन्ति ।
यो॒३जं पञ्चौ॑दनं॒ दक्षि॑णाज्योतिषं॒ ददा॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
pañca rukmā pañca navāni vastrā pañcāsmai dhenavaḥ kāmadughā bhavanti |
yojaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti ||

verses.sanskrit:
पञ्च॑ रु॒क्मा ज्योति॑रस्मै भवन्ति॒ वर्म॒ वासां॑सि त॒न्वेऽ भवन्ति ।
स्व॒र्गं लो॒कम॑श्नुते॒ यो॒३जं पञ्चौ॑दनं॒ दक्षि॑णाज्योतिषं॒ ददा॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
pañca rukmā jyotirasmai bhavanti varma vāsāṃsi tanve' bhavanti |
svargaṃ lokamaśnute yojaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti ||

verses.sanskrit:
या पूर्वं॒ पतिं॑ वि॒त्त्वाथा॒न्यं वि॒न्दतेऽप॑रम् ।
पञ्चौ॑दनं च॒ ताव॒जं ददा॑तो॒ न वि यो॑षतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yā pūrvaṃ patiṃ vittvāthānyaṃ vindate'param |
pañcaudanaṃ ca tāvajaṃ dadāto na vi yoṣataḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒मा॒नलो॑को भवति पुन॒र्भुवाप॑रः॒ पतिः॑ ।
यो॒३जं पञ्चौ॑दनं॒ दक्षि॑णाज्योतिषं॒ ददा॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
samānaloko bhavati punarbhuvāparaḥ patiḥ |
yojaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒नु॒पूर्व॒व॑त्सां धे॒नुम॑न॒ड्वाह॑मुप॒बर्ह॑णम् ।
वासो॒ हिर॑ण्यं द॒त्त्वा ते य॑न्ति॒ दिव॑मुत्त॒माम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
anupūrvavatsāṃ dhenumanaḍvāhamupabarhaṇam |
vāso hiraṇyaṃ dattvā te yanti divamuttamām ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒त्मानं॑ पि॒तरं॑ पु॒त्रं पौत्रं॑ पिताम॒हम् ।
जा॒यां जनि॑त्रीं मा॒तरं॒ ये प्रि॒यास्तानुप॑ ह्वये ॥
verses.transliteration:
ātmānaṃ pitaraṃ putraṃ pautraṃ pitāmaham |
jāyāṃ janitrīṃ mātaraṃ ye priyāstānupa hvaye ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो वै नैदा॑घं॒ नाम॒र्तुं वेद॑ । ए॒ष वै नैदा॑घो॒ नाम॒र्तुर्यद॒जः पञ्चौ॑दनः ।
निरे॒वाप्रि॑यस्य॒ भ्रातृ॑व्यस्य॒ श्रियं॑ दहति॒ भव॑त्या॒त्मना॑ ।
यो॒३जं पञ्चौ॑दनं॒ दक्षि॑णाज्योतिषं॒ ददा॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo vai naidāghaṃ nāmartuṃ veda | eṣa vai naidāgho nāmarturyadajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ |
nirevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyaṃ dahati bhavatyātmanā |
yojaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो वै कु॒र्वन्तं॒ नाम॒र्तुं वेद॑ । कु॒र्व॒तींकु॑र्वतीमे॒वाप्रि॑यस्य॒ भ्रातृ॑व्यस्य॒ श्रिय॒मा द॑त्ते ।
ए॒ष वै कु॒र्वन्नाम॒र्तुर्यद॒जः पञ्चौ॑दनः ।
निरे॒वाप्रि॑यस्य॒ भ्रातृ॑व्यस्य॒ श्रियं॑ दहति॒ भव॑त्या॒त्मना॑ ।
यो॒३जं पञ्चौ॑दनं॒ दक्षि॑नाज्योतिषं॒ ददा॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo vai kurvantaṃ nāmartuṃ veda | kurvatīṃkurvatīmevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyamā datte |
eṣa vai kurvannāmarturyadajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ |
nirevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyaṃ dahati bhavatyātmanā |
yojaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣinājyotiṣaṃ dadāti ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो वै सं॒यन्तं॒ नाम॒र्तुं वेद॑ । सं॒य॒तींसं॑यतीमे॒वाप्रि॑यस्य॒ भ्रातृ॑व्यस्य॒ श्रिय॒मा द॑त्ते ।
ए॒ष वै सं॒यन्नाम॒र्तुर्यद॒जः पञ्चौ॑दनः ।
निरे॒वाप्रि॑यस्य॒ भ्रातृ॑व्यस्य॒ श्रियं॑ दहति॒ भव॑त्या॒त्मना॑ ।
यो॒३जं पञ्चौ॑दनं॒ दक्षि॑णाज्योतिषं॒ ददा॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo vai saṃyantaṃ nāmartuṃ veda | saṃyatīṃsaṃyatīmevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyamā datte |
eṣa vai saṃyannāmarturyadajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ |
nirevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyaṃ dahati bhavatyātmanā |
yojaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो वै पि॒न्वन्तं॒ नाम॒र्तुं वेद॑ ।
पि॒न्व॒तींपि॑न्वतीमे॒वाप्रि॑यस्य॒ भ्रातृ॑व्यस्य॒ श्रिय॒मा द॑त्ते ।
ए॒ष वै पि॒न्वन्नाम॒र्तुर्यद॒जः पञ्चौ॑दनः ।
निरे॒वाप्रि॑यस्य॒ भ्रातृ॑व्यस्य॒ श्रियं॑ दहति॒ भव॑त्या॒त्मना॑ ।
यो॒३जं पञ्चौ॑दनं॒ दक्षि॑णाज्योतिषं॒ ददा॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo vai pinvantaṃ nāmartuṃ veda |
pinvatīṃpinvatīmevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyamā datte |
eṣa vai pinvannāmarturyadajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ |
nirevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyaṃ dahati bhavatyātmanā |
yojaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो वा उ॒द्यन्तं॒ नाम॒र्तुं वेद॑ ।
उ॒द्य॒तीमु॑द्यतीमे॒वाप्रि॑यस्य॒ भ्रातृ॑व्यस्य॒ श्रिय॒मा द॑त्ते ।
ए॒ष वा उ॒द्यन्न्नाम॒र्तुर्यद॒जः पञ्चौ॑दनः ।
निरे॒वाप्रि॑यस्य॒ भ्रातृ॑व्यस्य॒ श्रियं॑ दहति॒ भव॑त्या॒त्मना॑ ।
यो॒३जं पञ्चौ॑दनं॒ दक्षि॑णाज्योतिषं ददा॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo vā udyantaṃ nāmartuṃ veda |
udyatīmudyatīmevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyamā datte |
eṣa vā udyannnāmarturyadajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ |
nirevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyaṃ dahati bhavatyātmanā |
yojaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadāti ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो वा अ॑भि॒भुवं॒ नाम॒र्तुं वेद॑ ।
अ॒भि॒भव॑न्तीमभिभवन्तीमे॒वाप्रि॑यस्य भ्रातृ॑व्यस्य॒ श्रिय॒मा द॑त्ते ।
ए॒ष वा अ॑भि॒भूर्नाम॒र्तुर्यद॒जः पञ्चौ॑दनः ।
निरे॒वाप्रि॑यस्य॒ भ्रातृ॑व्यस्य॒ श्रियं॑ दहति॒ भव॑त्या॒त्मना ।
यो॒३जं पञ्चौ॑दनं॒ दक्षि॑नाज्योतिषं॒ ददा॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo vā abhibhuvaṃ nāmartuṃ veda |
abhibhavantīmabhibhavantīmevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyamā datte |
eṣa vā abhibhūrnāmarturyadajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ |
nirevāpriyasya bhrātṛvyasya śriyaṃ dahati bhavatyātmanā |
yojaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣinājyotiṣaṃ dadāti ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒जं च॒ पच॑त॒ पञ्च॑ चौद॒नान् ।
सर्वा॒ दिशः॒ संम॑नसः स॒ध्रीचीः॒ सान्त॑र्देशाः॒ प्रति॑ गृह्णन्तु त ए॒तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ajaṃ ca pacata pañca caudanān |
sarvā diśaḥ saṃmanasaḥ sadhrīcīḥ sāntardeśāḥ prati gṛhṇantu ta etam ||

verses.sanskrit: तास्ते॑ रक्षन्तु॒ तव॒ तुभ्य॑मे॒तं ताभ्य॒ आज्यं॒ ह॒विरि॒दं जु॑होमि ॥
verses.transliteration: tāste rakṣantu tava tubhyametaṃ tābhya ājyaṃ haviridaṃ juhomi ||

verses.sanskrit: यो वि॒द्याद् ब्रह्म॑ प्र॒त्यक्षं॒ परूं॑षि॒ यस्य॑ संभा॒रा ऋचो॒ यस्या॑नू॒क्यऽम् ॥
verses.transliteration: yo vidyād brahma pratyakṣaṃ parūṃṣi yasya saṃbhārā ṛco yasyānūkya'm ||
verses.translation:
A glorification of hospitable reception of guests
Whoso will know Prayer with immediate knowledge, whose mem-bers are the stuff, whose spine the verses:
Whose hairs are psalms, whose heart is called the Yajus, whose coverlet is verily oblation—
Verily when a host looks at his guests he looks at the place of sacrifice to the Gods.
When he salutes them reverently he undergoes preparation for a religious ceremony: when he calls for water, he solemnly brings sacrificial water.
The water that is solemnly brought at a sacrifice is this same water.
The libation which they bring; the sacrificial victim dedicated to Agni and Soma which is tied to the post, that, verily, is this man.
When they arrange dwelling-rooms they arrange the sacred chamber and the shed for housing the Soma cars.
What they spread upon the floor is just Sacrificial Grass.
With the couch that the men bring, he wins for himself the world of Svarga.
The pillow-coverings that they bring are the green sticks that surround the sacrificial altar.
The ointment that they bring for injunction is just clarified liquid butter.
The food they bring before the general distribution represents the two sacrificial cakes of rice meal.
When they call the man who prepares food they summon the preparer of oblation.
The grains of rice and barley that are selected are just filaments of the Soma plant.
The pestle and mortar are really the stones of the Soma press.
The winnowing-basket is the filter, the chaff the Soma dregs, the water, the pressing-gear.
Spoon, ladle, fork, stirring-prong are the wooden Soma tubs; the earthen cooking-pots are the mortar-shaped Soma vessels; this earth is just the black-antelope’s skin.
Or the host acts in this way to a Yajamāna’s Brāhman: when he looks at the furniture and utensils he says, More here t yet more here.
When he says, Bring out more, he lengthens his life thereby.
He brings oblations: he makes the men sit down.
As the guest of the seated company he himself offers up sacrifice.
With ladle, with hand, in life, at the sacrificial post, with cry of Ladle! with exclamation of Vashat!
Now these guests, as priests beloved or not beloved, bring one to the world of Svarga.
He who hath this knowledge should not eat hating, should not eat the food of one who hates him, nor of one who is doubt-ful, nor of one who is undecided.
This man whose food they eat hath all his wickedness blotted out.
All that man’s sin whose food they do not eat remains unblot-ted out.
The man who supplies food hath always pressing stones adjusted, a wet Soma filter, well prepared religious rites, and mental power to complete the arranged sacrifice.
The arranged sacrifice of the man who offers food is a sacrifice to Prajāpati.
The man who offers food follows the steps of Prajāpati.
The fire of the guests is the Āhavaniya, the fire in the dwelling is the Gārhapatya, that whereon they cook food is the South-ern Sacrificial Fire.
Now that man who eats before the guest eats up the sacrifice and the merit of the house.
He devours the milk and the sap:
And the vigour and prosperity.
And the progeny and the cattle:
And the fame and reputation.
The man who eats before the guest eats up the glory and the understanding of the house.
The man should not eat before the guest who is a Brāhman versed in holy lore.
When the guest hath eaten he should eat. This is the rule for the animation of the sacrifice and the preservation of its continuity.
Now the sweetest portion, the produce of the cow, milk, or flesh, that verily he should not eat.
The man who having this knowledge pours out milk and offers it wins for himself as much thereby as he gains by the perfor-mance of a very successful Agnishtoma sacrifice.
The man who having this knowledge pours out clarified butter and offers it wins for himself thereby as much as he gains by the performance of a very successful Atirātra sacrifice.
He who pours out mead and offers it wins for himself thereby as much as he gains by the performance of a very successful Sattrasadya sacrifice.
He who having this knowledge besprinkles flesh and offers it wins for himself thereby as much as he gains by the perfor-mance of a very successful Twelve-Day sacrifice.
The man who having this knowledge pours out water and offers it obtains a resting-place for the procreation of living beings and becomes dear to living beings, even the man who having this knowledge pours out water and offers it. or him Dawn murmurs, and Savitar sings the prelude; Brihas-pati chants with vigour, and Tvashtar joins in with increase; the Visve Devāh take up conclusion. He who hath this knowledge is the abiding-place of welfare, of progeny, and of cattle.
For him the rising Sun murmurs, and Early Morning sings the prelude; Noon chants the psalm, Afternoon joins in; the setting Sun takes up the conclusion. He who hath this knowledge is the abiding place of welfare, of progeny, and of cattle.
For him the Rain-cloud murmurs when present, sings the pre-lude when thundering, joins in when lightening, chants the psalm when raining, and takes up the conclusion when it stays the downpour. He who hath this knowledge is the abiding-place of welfare, of progeny, and of cattle.
He looks at the guests, he utters a gentle sound; he speaks, he signs the prelude; he calls for water, he chants the psalm; he offers the residue of the sacrifice, he takes up the conclusion.
When he summons the door-keeper he gives instruction.
He (the door-keeper) pronounces the sacrificial formula in his answer to what he hears.
When the attendants with vessels in their hands, foremost and hindmost, come in, they are just the priests who manage the Soma cups.
Not one of them is incompetent to sacrifice.
Or if the host, having offered food to his guest, goes up to the house, he virtually enters the bath of purification.
When he distributes food he distributes priestly fees; what he performs he asks as favour.
He having been invited on earth, regales, invited in that, which wears all various forms on earth.
He, having been invited in air, regales, invited, in that which wears all various forms in air.
He having been invited in the sky, regales, invited, in that which wears all various forms in the sky.
He, having been invited among the gods, regales, invited in that which wears all various forms among the Gods.
He, having been invited in the worlds, regales, invited, in that which wears all various forms in the worlds.
He, having been invited hath been invited.
He gains this world and the world yonder.
He who hath this knowledge wins the luminous spheres.

verses.sanskrit: सामा॑नि॒ यस्य॒ लोमा॑नि॒ यजु॒र्हृद॑यमु॒च्यते॑ परि॒स्तर॑णा॒मिद्ध॒विः ॥
verses.transliteration: sāmāni yasya lomāni yajurhṛdayamucyate paristaraṇāmiddhaviḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: यद् वा अति॑थिपति॒रति॑थीन् प्रति॒पश्य॑ति देव॒यज॑नं॒ प्रेक्ष॑ते ॥
verses.transliteration: yad vā atithipatiratithīn pratipaśyati devayajanaṃ prekṣate ||

verses.sanskrit: यद॑भि॒वद॑ति दी॒क्षामुपै॑ति॒ यदु॑द॒कं याच॑त्य॒पः प्र ण॑यति ॥
verses.transliteration: yadabhivadati dīkṣāmupaiti yadudakaṃ yācatyapaḥ pra ṇayati ||

verses.sanskrit: या ए॒व य॒ज्ञ आपः॑ प्रणी॒यन्ते॒ ता ए॒व ताः ॥
verses.transliteration: yā eva yajña āpaḥ praṇīyante tā eva tāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: यत् तर्प॑णमा॒हर॑न्ति॒ य ए॒वाग्नी॑षो॒मीयः॑ प॒शुर्ब॒ध्यते॒ स ए॒व सः ॥
verses.transliteration: yat tarpaṇamāharanti ya evāgnīṣomīyaḥ paśurbadhyate sa eva saḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: यदा॑वस॒थान् क॒ल्पय॑न्ति सदोहविर्धा॒नान्ये॒व तत् क॑ल्पयन्ति ॥
verses.transliteration: yadāvasathān kalpayanti sadohavirdhānānyeva tat kalpayanti ||

verses.sanskrit: यदु॑पस्तृ॒णन्ति॑ ब॒र्हिरे॒व तत् ॥
verses.transliteration: yadupastṛṇanti barhireva tat ||

verses.sanskrit: यदु॑परिशय॒नमा॒हर॑न्ति स्व॒र्गमे॒व तेन॑ लो॒कमव॑ रुन्द्धे ॥
verses.transliteration: yadupariśayanamāharanti svargameva tena lokamava runddhe ||

verses.sanskrit: यत् क॑शिपूपबर्ह॒णमा॒हर॑न्ति परि॒धय॑ ए॒व ते ॥
verses.transliteration: yat kaśipūpabarhaṇamāharanti paridhaya eva te ||

verses.sanskrit: यदा॑ञ्जनाभ्यञ्ज॒नमा॒हर॒न्त्याज्य॑मे॒व तत् ॥
verses.transliteration: yadāñjanābhyañjanamāharantyājyameva tat ||

verses.sanskrit: यत् पु॒रा प॑रि॒वेषात् स्वा॒दमा॒हर॑न्ति पुरो॒डाशा॑वे॒व तौ ॥
verses.transliteration: yat purā pariveṣāt svādamāharanti puroḍāśāveva tau ||

verses.sanskrit: यद॑शन॒कृतं॒ ह्वय॑न्ति हवि॒ष्कृत॑मे॒व तद्ध्व॑यन्ति ॥
verses.transliteration: yadaśanakṛtaṃ hvayanti haviṣkṛtameva taddhvayanti ||

verses.sanskrit: ये व्री॒हयो॒ यवा॑ निरु॒प्यन्तें॒ऽशव॑ ए॒व ते ॥
verses.transliteration: ye vrīhayo yavā nirupyanteṃ'śava eva te ||

verses.sanskrit: यान्यु॑लूखलमुस॒लानि॒ ग्रावा॑ण ए॒व ते ॥
verses.transliteration: yānyulūkhalamusalāni grāvāṇa eva te ||

verses.sanskrit: शूर्पं॑ प॒वित्रं॒ तुषा॑ ऋजी॒षाभि॒षव॑णी॒रापः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: śūrpaṃ pavitraṃ tuṣā ṛjīṣābhiṣavaṇīrāpaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: स्रुग् दर्वि॒र्नेक्ष॑णमा॒यव॑नं द्रोणकल॒शाः कु॒म्भ्योऽ वाय॒व्या॒ऽनि॒ पात्रा॑णी॒यमे॒व कृ॑ष्णाजि॒नम् ॥
verses.transliteration: srug darvirnekṣaṇamāyavanaṃ droṇakalaśāḥ kumbhyo' vāyavyā'ni pātrāṇīyameva kṛṣṇājinam ||

verses.sanskrit: य॒ज॒मा॒न॒ब्रा॒ह्म॒णं वा ए॒तदति॑थिपतिः कुरुते॒ यदा॑हा॒र्याऽणि॒ प्रेक्ष॑त इ॒दं भू॑या३ इ॒दा३मिति॑ ।१  ॥
verses.transliteration: yajamānabrāhmaṇaṃ vā etadatithipatiḥ kurute yadāhāryā'ṇi prekṣata idaṃ bhūyā idāmiti |  ||

verses.sanskrit: यदाह॒ भूय॒ उद्ध॒रेति॑ प्रा॒णमे॒व तेन॒ वर्षी॑यांसं कुरुते ।२  ॥
verses.transliteration: yadāha bhūya uddhareti prāṇameva tena varṣīyāṃsaṃ kurute |  ||

verses.sanskrit: उप॑ हरति ह॒वींष्या सा॑दयति ।३  ॥
verses.transliteration: upa harati havīṃṣyā sādayati |  ||

verses.sanskrit: तेषा॒मास॑न्नाना॒मति॑थिरा॒त्मन् जु॑होति ।४  ॥
verses.transliteration: teṣāmāsannānāmatithirātman juhoti |  ||

verses.sanskrit: स्रु॒चा हस्ते॑न प्रा॒णे यूपे॑ स्रुक्का॒रेण॑ वषट्का॒रेण॑ ।५  ॥
verses.transliteration: srucā hastena prāṇe yūpe srukkāreṇa vaṣaṭkāreṇa |  ||

verses.sanskrit: ए॒ते वै प्रि॒याश्चाप्रि॑याश्च॒र्त्विजः॑ स्व॒र्गं लो॒कं ग॑मयन्ति॒ यदति॑थयः ।६  ॥
verses.transliteration: ete vai priyāścāpriyāścartvijaḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ gamayanti yadatithayaḥ |  ||

verses.sanskrit: स य ए॒वं वि॒द्वान् न द्वि॒षन्न॑श्नीया॒न्न द्वि॑ष॒तोऽन्न॑मश्नीया॒न्न मी॑मांसि॒तस्य॒ न मी॑मां॒समा॑नस्य ।७  ॥
verses.transliteration: sa ya evaṃ vidvān na dviṣannaśnīyānna dviṣato'nnamaśnīyānna mīmāṃsitasya na mīmāṃsamānasya |  ||

verses.sanskrit: सर्वो॒ वा ए॒ष ज॒ग्धपा॑प्मा॒ यस्यान्न॑म॒श्नन्ति॑ ।८  ॥
verses.transliteration: sarvo vā eṣa jagdhapāpmā yasyānnamaśnanti |  ||

verses.sanskrit: सर्वो॒ वा ए॒षोऽज॑ग्धपाप्मा॒ यस्यान्नं॒ नाश्नन्ति॑ ।९  ॥
verses.transliteration: sarvo vā eṣo'jagdhapāpmā yasyānnaṃ nāśnanti |  ||

verses.sanskrit: स॒र्व॒दा वा ए॒ष यु॒क्तग्रा॑वा॒र्द्रप॑वित्रो॒ वित॑ताध्वर॒ आहृ॑तयज्ञक्रतु॒र्य उ॑पहर॑ति ।१०  ॥
verses.transliteration: sarvadā vā eṣa yuktagrāvārdrapavitro vitatādhvara āhṛtayajñakraturya upaharati |  ||

verses.sanskrit: प्रा॒जा॒प॒त्यो वा ए॒तस्य॑ य॒ज्ञो वित॑तो॒ य उ॑प॒हर॑ति ।११  ॥
verses.transliteration: prājāpatyo vā etasya yajño vitato ya upaharati |  ||

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒जाप॑ते॒र्वा ए॒ष वि॑क्र॒मान॑नु॒विक्र॑मते॒ य उ॑प॒हर॑ति ।१२  ॥
verses.transliteration: prajāpatervā eṣa vikramānanuvikramate ya upaharati |  ||

verses.sanskrit: योऽति॑थीनां॒ स आ॑हव॒नीयो॒ यो वेश्म॑नि॒ स गार्ह॑पत्यो॒ यस्मि॒न् पच॑न्ति॒ स द॑क्षिणा॒ग्निः ।१३  ॥
verses.transliteration: yo'tithīnāṃ sa āhavanīyo yo veśmani sa gārhapatyo yasmin pacanti sa dakṣiṇāgniḥ |  ||

verses.sanskrit: इ॒ष्टं च॒ वा ए॒ष पू॒र्तं च॑ गृ॒हाणा॑मश्नाति॒ यः पूर्वोऽति॑थेर॒श्नाति॑ ।१  ॥
verses.transliteration: iṣṭaṃ ca vā eṣa pūrtaṃ ca gṛhāṇāmaśnāti yaḥ pūrvo'titheraśnāti |  ||

verses.sanskrit: पय॑श्च॒ वा ए॒ष रसं॑ च॒ गृ॒हाणा॑मश्नाति॒ यः पूर्वोऽति॑थेर॒श्नाति॑ ।२  ॥
verses.transliteration: payaśca vā eṣa rasaṃ ca gṛhāṇāmaśnāti yaḥ pūrvo'titheraśnāti |  ||

verses.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्जां च॒ वा ए॒ष स्फा॒तिं च॑ गृ॒हाणा॑मश्नाति॒ यः पूर्वोऽति॑थेर॒श्नाति॑ ।३  ॥
verses.transliteration: ūrjāṃ ca vā eṣa sphātiṃ ca gṛhāṇāmaśnāti yaḥ pūrvo'titheraśnāti |  ||

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒जां च॒ वा ए॒ष प॒शूंश्च॑ गृ॒हाणा॑मश्नाति॒ यः पूर्वोऽति॑थेर॒श्नाति॑ ।४  ॥
verses.transliteration: prajāṃ ca vā eṣa paśūṃśca gṛhāṇāmaśnāti yaḥ pūrvo'titheraśnāti |  ||

verses.sanskrit: की॒र्तिं च॒ वा ए॒ष यश॑श्च गृ॒हाणा॑मश्नाति॒ यः पूर्वोऽति॑थेर॒श्नाति॑ ।५  ॥
verses.transliteration: kīrtiṃ ca vā eṣa yaśaśca gṛhāṇāmaśnāti yaḥ pūrvo'titheraśnāti |  ||

verses.sanskrit: श्रियं॑ च॒ वा ए॒ष सं॒विदं॑ च गृ॒हाणा॑मश्नाति॒ यः पूर्वोऽति॑थेर॒श्नाति॑ ।६  ॥
verses.transliteration: śriyaṃ ca vā eṣa saṃvidaṃ ca gṛhāṇāmaśnāti yaḥ pūrvo'titheraśnāti |  ||

verses.sanskrit: ए॒ष वा अति॑थि॒र्यच्छ्रोत्रि॑य॒स्तस्मा॒त् पूर्वो॒ नाश्नी॑यात् ।७  ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa vā atithiryacchrotriyastasmāt pūrvo nāśnīyāt |  ||

verses.sanskrit: अ॒शि॒ताव॒त्यति॑थावश्नीयाद् य॒ज्ञस्य॑ सात्म॒त्वाय॑ य॒ज्ञस्यावि॑च्छेदाय॒ तद् व्र॒त॑म् ।८  ॥
verses.transliteration: aśitāvatyatithāvaśnīyād yajñasya sātmatvāya yajñasyāvicchedāya tad vratam |  ||

verses.sanskrit: ए॒तद् वा उ॒ स्वादी॑यो॒ यद॑धिग॒वं क्षी॒रं वा॑ मां॒सं वा॒ तदे॒व नाश्नी॑यात् ।९  ॥
verses.transliteration: etad vā u svādīyo yadadhigavaṃ kṣīraṃ vā māṃsaṃ vā tadeva nāśnīyāt |  ||

verses.sanskrit:
स य ए॒वं वि॒द्वान् क्षी॒रमु॑प॒सिच्यो॑प॒हर॑ति ।१ ।
याव॑दग्निष्टो॒मेने॒ष्ट्वा सुस॑मृद्धेनावरु॒न्धे ताव॑देने॒नाव॑ रुन्धे ।२  ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa ya evaṃ vidvān kṣīramupasicyopaharati | |
yāvadagniṣṭomeneṣṭvā susamṛddhenāvarundhe tāvadenenāva rundhe |  ||

verses.sanskrit:
स य ए॒वं वि॒द्वान्त्स॒र्पिरु॑प॒सिच्यो॑प॒हर॑ति ।३ ।
याव॑दतिरा॒त्रेणे॒ष्ट्वा सुस॑मृद्धेनावरु॒न्धे ताव॑देने॒नाव॑ रुन्धे ।४  ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa ya evaṃ vidvāntsarpirupasicyopaharati | |
yāvadatirātreṇeṣṭvā susamṛddhenāvarundhe tāvadenenāva rundhe |  ||

verses.sanskrit:
स य ए॒वं वि॒द्वान् मधू॑प॒सिच्यो॑प॒हर॑ति ।५ ।
याव॑त् सत्त्र॒सद्ये॑ने॒ष्ट्वा सुस॑मृद्धेनावरु॒न्धे ताव॑देने॒नाव॑ रुन्धे ।६  ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa ya evaṃ vidvān madhūpasicyopaharati | |
yāvat sattrasadyeneṣṭvā susamṛddhenāvarundhe tāvadenenāva rundhe |  ||

verses.sanskrit:
स य ए॒वं वि॒द्वान् मां॒समु॑प॒सिच्यो॑प॒हर॑ति ।७ ।
याव॑द् द्वादशा॒हेने॒ष्ट्वा सुस॑मृद्धेनावरु॒न्धे ताव॑देनेनाव॑ रुन्धे ।८  ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa ya evaṃ vidvān māṃsamupasicyopaharati | |
yāvad dvādaśāheneṣṭvā susamṛddhenāvarundhe tāvadenenāva rundhe |  ||

verses.sanskrit:
स य ए॒वं वि॒द्वानु॑द॒कमु॑प॒सिच्यो॑प॒हर॑ति ।९ ।
प्र॒जानां॑ प्र॒जन॑नाय गच्छति प्रति॒ष्ठां प्रि॒यः प्र॒जानां॑ भवति॒ य ए॒वं वि॒द्वानु॑द॒कमु॑प॒सिच्यो॑प॒हर॑ति ।१०  ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa ya evaṃ vidvānudakamupasicyopaharati | |
prajānāṃ prajananāya gacchati pratiṣṭhāṃ priyaḥ prajānāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ vidvānudakamupasicyopaharati |  ||

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मा॑ उ॒षा हिङ्कृ॑णोति सवि॒ता प्र स्तौ॑ति ।१ ।
बृह॒स्पति॑रू॒र्जयोद्गा॑यति॒ त्वष्टा॒ पुष्ट्या॒ प्रति॑ हरति॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वा नि॒धन॑म् ।२ ।
नि॒धनं॒ भूत्याः॑ प्र॒जायाः॑ पशू॒नां भ॑वति॒ य ए॒वं वेद॑ ।३  ॥
verses.transliteration:
tasmā uṣā hiṅkṛṇoti savitā pra stauti | |
bṛhaspatirūrjayodgāyati tvaṣṭā puṣṭyā prati harati viśve devā nidhanam | |
nidhanaṃ bhūtyāḥ prajāyāḥ paśūnāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda |  ||

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मा॑ उ॒द्यन्त्सूर्यो॒ हिङ्कृ॑णोति संग॒वः प्र स्तौ॑ति ।४ ।
म॒ध्यन्दि॑न॒ उद्गा॑यत्यपरा॒ह्णः प्रति॑ हरत्यस्तं॒यन् नि॒धन॑म् ।
नि॒धनं॒ भूत्याः॑ प्र॒जायाः॑ पशू॒नां भ॑वति॒ य ए॒वं वेद॑ ।५  ॥
verses.transliteration:
tasmā udyantsūryo hiṅkṛṇoti saṃgavaḥ pra stauti | |
madhyandina udgāyatyaparāhṇaḥ prati haratyastaṃyan nidhanam |
nidhanaṃ bhūtyāḥ prajāyāḥ paśūnāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda |  ||

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मा॑ अ॒भ्रो भव॒न् हिङ्कृ॑णोति स्त॒नय॒न् प्र स्तौ॑ति ।६ ।
वि॒द्योत॑मानः॒ प्रति॑ हरति॒ वर्ष॒न्नुद्गा॑यत्युद्गृह्णन् नि॒धन॑म् ।
नि॒धनं॒ भूत्याः॑ प्र॒जायाः॑ पशू॒नां भ॑वति॒ य ए॒वं वेद॑ ।७ ।
अति॑थी॒न् प्रति॑ पश्यति॒ हिङ्कृ॑णोत्य॒भि व॑दति॒ प्र स्तौ॑त्युद॒कं याच॒त्युद्गा॑यति ।८  ॥
verses.transliteration:
tasmā abhro bhavan hiṅkṛṇoti stanayan pra stauti | |
vidyotamānaḥ prati harati varṣannudgāyatyudgṛhṇan nidhanam |
nidhanaṃ bhūtyāḥ prajāyāḥ paśūnāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda | |
atithīn prati paśyati hiṅkṛṇotyabhi vadati pra stautyudakaṃ yācatyudgāyati |  ||

verses.sanskrit:
उप॑ हरति॒ प्रति॑ हर॒त्युच्छि॑ष्टं नि॒धन॑म् ।९ ।
नि॒धनं॒ भूत्याः॑ प्र॒जायाः॑ पशू॒नां भ॑वति॒ य ए॒वं वेद॑ ।१०  ॥
verses.transliteration:
upa harati prati haratyucchiṣṭaṃ nidhanam | |
nidhanaṃ bhūtyāḥ prajāyāḥ paśūnāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda |  ||

verses.sanskrit: यत् क्ष॒त्तारं॒ ह्वय॒त्या श्रा॑वयत्ये॒व तत् ।१  ॥
verses.transliteration: yat kṣattāraṃ hvayatyā śrāvayatyeva tat |  ||

verses.sanskrit: यत् प्र॑तिशृ॒णोति॑ प्र॒त्याश्रा॑वयत्ये॒व तत् ।२  ॥
verses.transliteration: yat pratiśṛṇoti pratyāśrāvayatyeva tat |  ||

verses.sanskrit: यत् प॑रिवे॒ष्टारः॒ पात्र॑हस्ताः॒ पूर्वे॒ चाप॑रे च प्र॒पद्य॑न्ते चम॒साध्व॑र्यव ए॒व ते ।३  ॥
verses.transliteration: yat pariveṣṭāraḥ pātrahastāḥ pūrve cāpare ca prapadyante camasādhvaryava eva te |  ||

verses.sanskrit: तेषां॒ न कश्च॒नाहो॑ता ।४  ॥
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ na kaścanāhotā |  ||

verses.sanskrit: यद् वा अति॑थिपति॒रति॑थीन् परि॒विष्य॑ गृ॒हानु॑पो॒दैत्य॑व॒भृथ॑मे॒व तदु॒पावै॑ति ।५  ॥
verses.transliteration: yad vā atithipatiratithīn pariviṣya gṛhānupodaityavabhṛthameva tadupāvaiti |  ||

verses.sanskrit: यत् स॑भा॒गय॑ति॒ दक्षि॑णाः सभागयति॒ यद॑नु॒तिष्ठ॑त उ॒दव॑स्यत्ये॒व तत् ।६  ॥
verses.transliteration: yat sabhāgayati dakṣiṇāḥ sabhāgayati yadanutiṣṭhata udavasyatyeva tat |  ||

verses.sanskrit: स उप॑हूतः पृथि॒व्यां भ॑क्षय॒त्युप॑हूत॒स्तस्मि॒न् यत् पृ॑थि॒व्यां वि॒श्वरू॑पम् ।७  ॥
verses.transliteration: sa upahūtaḥ pṛthivyāṃ bhakṣayatyupahūtastasmin yat pṛthivyāṃ viśvarūpam |  ||

verses.sanskrit: स उप॑हूतो॒ऽन्तरि॑क्षे भक्षय॒त्युप॑हूत॒स्तस्मि॒न् यद॒न्तरि॑क्षे वि॒श्वरू॑पम् ।८  ॥
verses.transliteration: sa upahūto'ntarikṣe bhakṣayatyupahūtastasmin yadantarikṣe viśvarūpam |  ||

verses.sanskrit: स उप॑हूतो दि॒वि भ॑क्षय॒त्युप॑हूत॒स्तस्मि॒न् यद् दि॒वि वि॒श्वरू॑पम् ।९  ॥
verses.transliteration: sa upahūto divi bhakṣayatyupahūtastasmin yad divi viśvarūpam |  ||

verses.sanskrit: स उप॑हूतो दे॒वेषु॑ भक्षय॒त्युप॑हूत॒स्तस्मिन् यद् दे॒वेषु॑ वि॒श्वरू॑पम् ।१०  ॥
verses.transliteration: sa upahūto deveṣu bhakṣayatyupahūtastasmin yad deveṣu viśvarūpam |  ||

verses.sanskrit: स उप॑हूतो लो॒केषु॑ भक्षय॒त्युप॑हूत॒स्तस्मि॒न्य यल्लो॒केषु॑ वि॒श्वरू॑पम् ।११  ॥
verses.transliteration: sa upahūto lokeṣu bhakṣayatyupahūtastasminya yallokeṣu viśvarūpam |  ||

verses.sanskrit: स उप॑हूत॒ उप॑हूतः ।१२  ॥
verses.transliteration: sa upahūta upahūtaḥ |  ||

verses.sanskrit: आ॒प्नोती॒मं लो॒कमा॒प्नोत्य॒मुम् ।१३  ॥
verses.transliteration: āpnotīmaṃ lokamāpnotyamum |  ||

verses.sanskrit: ज्योति॑ष्मतो लो॒कान् ज॑यति॒ य ए॒वं वेद॑ ।१४  ॥
verses.transliteration: jyotiṣmato lokān jayati ya evaṃ veda |  ||

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒जाप॑तिश्च परमे॒ष्ठी च॒ शृङ्गे॒ इन्द्रः॒ शिरो॑ अ॒ग्निर्ल॒लाटं॑ य॒मः कृका॑टम् ॥
verses.transliteration: prajāpatiśca parameṣṭhī ca śṛṅge indraḥ śiro agnirlalāṭaṃ yamaḥ kṛkāṭam ||
verses.translation:
A glorification of the typically bull and cow
Prajapati and Parameshthin are the two horns, Indra is the head, Agni the forehead, Yama the joint of the neck.
King Soma is the brain, Sky is the upper jaw, Earth is the lower jaw.
Lightning is the tongue, the Maruts are the teeth, Revati is the neck, the Krittikās are the shoulders, the Gharma s the shoulder-bar.
His universe is Vāyu, Svarga is his world, Krishpadram is the tendons and Vertebrae.
The Syena ceremony is the breast, Air is the region of the belly,.
Brihaspati is the hump, Brihatī the breast-bone and cartilages of the ribs.
The consorts of the Gods are the ribs, the attendants are ribs.
Mitra and Varuna are the shoulder-blades. Tvashtar and Arya-man the fore-arms, Mahādeva is the arms.
Indrāni is the hinder parts, Vāyu the tail, Pavamāna the hair.
Priestly rank and princely power are the hips, and strength is. the thigh.
Dhātar and Savitar are the two knee-bones, the Gandharvas are the legs the Apsarases are bits of the feet, Aditi is the hooves.
Thought is the heart, intelligence is the liver, law the pericar-dium.
Hunger is the belly, refreshing drink is the rectum, mountains. are the inward parts.
Wrath is the kidneys, anger the testes, offspring the generative organ.
The river is the womb, the Lords of the Rain are the breasts,. the thunder is the udder.
The All-embracing (Aditi) is the hide, the herbs are her hair,. and the Lunar Mansions her form.
The hosts of Gods are her entrails, man are her bowels, and demons her abdomen.
Rākshasas are the blood, the Other Folk are the contents of the Stomach.
The rain-cloud is her fat, her resting-place her marrow.
Sitting he is Agni, when he hath stood up he is the Asvins.
Standing east-wards he is Indra, standing southwards, Yama.
Standing westwards he is Dhātar, standing northwards Savitar.
When he hath got his grass he is King Soma.
He is Mitra when he looks about him, and when he hath turned round he is joy.
When he is yoking he belongs to the All-Gods, when yoked he is Prajāpati, when unyoked he is All.
This verily is omniform, wearing all forms, bovine-formed.
Upon him wait omniform beasts, wearing every shape, each one who hath this knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: सोमो॒ राजा॑ म॒स्तिष्को॒ द्यौरु॑त्तरह॒नुः पृ॑थि॒व्यऽधरह॒नुः ॥
verses.transliteration: somo rājā mastiṣko dyauruttarahanuḥ pṛthivya'dharahanuḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: वि॒द्युज्जि॒ह्वा म॒रुतो॒ दन्ता॑ रे॒वति॑र्ग्री॒वाः कृत्ति॑का स्क॒न्धा घ॒र्मो वहः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: vidyujjihvā maruto dantā revatirgrīvāḥ kṛttikā skandhā gharmo vahaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: विश्वं॑ वा॒युः स्व॒र्गो लो॒कः कृ॑ष्ण॒द्रं वि॒धर॑णी निवे॒ष्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: viśvaṃ vāyuḥ svargo lokaḥ kṛṣṇadraṃ vidharaṇī niveṣyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: श्ये॒नः क्रो॒डो॒३ऽन्तरि॑क्षं पाज॒स्यं॑१ बृह॒स्पतिः॑ क॒कुद् बृ॑ह॒तीः कीक॑साः ॥
verses.transliteration: śyenaḥ kroḍo'ntarikṣaṃ pājasyaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ kakud bṛhatīḥ kīkasāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: दे॒वानां॒ पत्नीः॑ पृ॒ष्टय॑ उप॒सदः॒ पर्श॑वः ॥
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ patnīḥ pṛṣṭaya upasadaḥ parśavaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: मि॒त्रश्च॒ वरु॑ण॒श्चांसौ॒ त्वष्टा॑ चार्य॒मा च॑ दो॒षणी॑ महादे॒वो बा॒हू ॥
verses.transliteration: mitraśca varuṇaścāṃsau tvaṣṭā cāryamā ca doṣaṇī mahādevo bāhū ||

verses.sanskrit: इ॒न्द्रा॒णी भ॒सद् वा॒युः पुच्छं॒ पव॑मानो॒ बालाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: indrāṇī bhasad vāyuḥ pucchaṃ pavamāno bālāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्म॑ च क्ष॒त्रं च॒ श्रोणी॒ बल॑मू॒रू ॥
verses.transliteration: brahma ca kṣatraṃ ca śroṇī balamūrū ||

verses.sanskrit: धा॒ता च॑ सवि॒ता चा॑ष्ठी॒वन्तौ॒ जङ्घा॑ गन्ध॒र्वा अ॑प्स॒रसः॒ कुष्ठि॑का॒ अदि॑तिः श॒फाः ॥
verses.transliteration: dhātā ca savitā cāṣṭhīvantau jaṅghā gandharvā apsarasaḥ kuṣṭhikā aditiḥ śaphāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: चेतो॒ हृद॑यं॒ यकृ॑न्मे॒धा व्र॒तं पु॑री॒तत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ceto hṛdayaṃ yakṛnmedhā vrataṃ purītat ||

verses.sanskrit: क्षुत् कु॒क्षिरिरा॑ वनि॒ष्ठुः पर्व॑ताः प्ला॒शयः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣut kukṣirirā vaniṣṭhuḥ parvatāḥ plāśayaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: क्रोधो॑ वृ॒क्कौ म॒न्युरा॒ण्डौ प्र॒जा शेपः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: krodho vṛkkau manyurāṇḍau prajā śepaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: न॒दी सू॒त्री व॒र्षस्य॒ पत॑य॒ स्तना॑ स्तनयि॒त्नुरूधः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: nadī sūtrī varṣasya pataya stanā stanayitnurūdhaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: वि॒श्वव्य॑चा॒स्चर्मौष॑धयो॒ लोमा॑नि॒ नक्ष॑त्राणि रू॒पम् ॥
verses.transliteration: viśvavyacāscarmauṣadhayo lomāni nakṣatrāṇi rūpam ||

verses.sanskrit: दे॒व॒ज॒ना गुदा॑ मनु॒ष्याऽ आ॒न्त्राण्य॒त्रा उ॒दर॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: devajanā gudā manuṣyā' āntrāṇyatrā udaram ||

verses.sanskrit: रक्षां॑सि॒ लोहि॑तमितरज॒ना ऊब॑ध्यम् ॥
verses.transliteration: rakṣāṃsi lohitamitarajanā ūbadhyam ||

verses.sanskrit: अ॒भ्रं पीबो॑ म॒ज्जा नि॒धन॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: abhraṃ pībo majjā nidhanam ||

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निरासी॑न॒ उत्थि॑तो॒ऽश्विना॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: agnirāsīna utthito'śvinā ||

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः॒ प्राङ् तिष्ठ॑न् दक्षि॒णा तिष्ठ॑न् य॒मः ॥
verses.transliteration: indraḥ prāṅ tiṣṭhan dakṣiṇā tiṣṭhan yamaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒त्यङ् तिष्ठ॑न् धा॒तोद॒ङ् तिष्ठ॑न्त्सवि॒ता ॥
verses.transliteration: pratyaṅ tiṣṭhan dhātodaṅ tiṣṭhantsavitā ||

verses.sanskrit: तृणा॑नि प्राप्तः॒ सोमो॒ राजा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: tṛṇāni prāptaḥ somo rājā ||

verses.sanskrit: मि॒त्र ईक्ष॑माण॒ आवृ॑त्त आन॒न्दः ॥
verses.transliteration: mitra īkṣamāṇa āvṛtta ānandaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: यु॒ज्यमा॑नो वैश्वदे॒वो यु॒क्तः प्र॒जाप॑ति॒र्विमु॑क्तः॒ सर्व॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: yujyamāno vaiśvadevo yuktaḥ prajāpatirvimuktaḥ sarvam ||

verses.sanskrit: ए॒तद् वै वि॒श्वरू॑पं॒ सर्व॑रूपं गोरू॒पम् ॥
verses.transliteration: etad vai viśvarūpaṃ sarvarūpaṃ gorūpam ||

verses.sanskrit: उपै॑नं वि॒श्वरू॑पाः॒ सर्व॑रूपाः प॒शव॑स्तिष्ठन्ति॒ य ए॒वं वेद॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: upainaṃ viśvarūpāḥ sarvarūpāḥ paśavastiṣṭhanti ya evaṃ veda ||

verses.sanskrit:
शी॒र्ष॒क्तिं शी॑र्षाम॒यं क॑र्णशू॒लं वि॑लोहि॒तम् ।
सर्वं॑ शीर्ष॒ण्यंऽ ते॒ रोगं॑ ब॒हिर्निर्म॑न्त्रयामहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
śīrṣaktiṃ śīrṣāmayaṃ karṇaśūlaṃ vilohitam |
sarvaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ' te rogaṃ bahirnirmantrayāmahe ||
verses.translation:
A charm for the cure of various diseases connected with Consumption
Each pain and ache that racks the head, earache, and erysipelas,.
All malady that wrings thy brow we charm away with this our spell.
From both thine ears, from parts thereof, thine earache, and the throbbing pain,
All malady that wrings thy brow we charm away with this our spell.
So that Consumption may depart forth from thine ears and from. thy mouth,
All malady that wrings thy brow we charm away with this our spell.
The malady that makes one deaf, the malady that makes one blind,
All malady that wrings thy brow we charm away with this our spell.
The throbbing pain in all thy limbs that rends thy frame with fever-throes,
All malady that wrings thy brow we charm away with this our spell.
The malady whose awful look makes a man quiver with alarm,
Fever whom every Autumn brings we charm away with this our spell.
Disease that creeps about the thighs and, after, reaches both the groins,
Consumption from thine inward parts we charm away with this our spell.
If the disease originates from love, from hatred, from the heart,
Forth from the heart and from the limbs we charm the wasting malady.
The yellow Jaundice from thy limbs, and Colic from the parts within,
And Phthisis from thine inward soul we charm away with this our spell.
Let wasting malady turn to dust, become the water of disease.
I have evoked the poison-taint of all Consumptions out of thee.
Forth from the hollow let it run, and rumbling sounds from thine inside.
I have evoked the poison-taint of all Consumptions out of thee.
Forth from thy belly and thy lungs, forth from thy navel and thy heart.
I have evoked the poison taint of all Consumptions out of thee.
The penetrating stabs of pain which rend asunder crown and head,
Let them depart and pass away, free from disease and harming not.
The pangs that stab the heart and reach the breast-bone and connected parts,
Let them depart and pass away, free from disease and harming not.
The stabs that penetrate the sides and pierce their way along the ribs,
Let them depart and pass away, free from disease and harming not.
The penetrating pangs that pierce thy stomach as they shoot across,
Let them depart and pass away, free from disease and harming not.
The pains that through the bowels creep, disordering the inward parts,
Let them depart and pass away, free from disease and harming not.
The pains that suck the marrow out, and rend and tear the bones apart,
May they speed forth and pass away, free from disease and harming not.
Consumptions with their Colic pains which make thy limbs insensible I have evoked the poison-taint of all Consumptions out of thee.
Of piercing pain, of abscesses, rheumatic ache, ophthalmia—
I have evoked the poison-taint of all Consumptions out of thee.
I have dispelled the piercing pains from feet, knees, hips, and hinder parts,
And spine, and from the neck and nape the malady that racked the head.
Sound are the skull-bones of thy head and thy heart’s beat is regular.
Thou, Sun, arising with thy beams hast chased away the head’s disease, hast stilled the pain that racked the limbs.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्णा॑भ्यां ते॒ कङ्कू॑षेभ्यः कर्णशू॒लं वि॒सल्पकम् ।
सर्वं॑ शीर्ष॒ण्यंऽ ते॒ रोगं॑ ब॒हिर्निर्म॑न्त्रयामहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
karṇābhyāṃ te kaṅkūṣebhyaḥ karṇaśūlaṃ visalpakam |
sarvaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ' te rogaṃ bahirnirmantrayāmahe ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य॑ हे॒तोः प्र॒च्यव॑ते॒ यक्ष्मः॑ कर्ण॒त आ॑स्य॒तः ।
सर्वं॑ शीर्ष॒ण्यंऽ ते॒ रोगं॑ ब॒हिर्निर्म॑न्त्रयामहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasya hetoḥ pracyavate yakṣmaḥ karṇata āsyataḥ |
sarvaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ' te rogaṃ bahirnirmantrayāmahe ||

verses.sanskrit:
यः कृ॒णोति॑ प्र॒मोत॑म॒न्धं कृ॒णोति॒ पूरु॑षम् ।
सर्वं॑ शीर्ष॒ण्यंऽ ते॒ रोगं॑ ब॒हिर्निर्म॑न्त्रयामहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaḥ kṛṇoti pramotamandhaṃ kṛṇoti pūruṣam |
sarvaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ' te rogaṃ bahirnirmantrayāmahe ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ङ्ग॒भे॒दम॑ङ्गज्व॒रं वि॑श्वा॒ङ्ग्यंऽ वि॒सल्प॑कम् ।
सर्वं॑ शीर्ष॒ण्यंऽ ते॒ रोगं॑ ब॒हिर्निर्म॑न्त्रयामहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
aṅgabhedamaṅgajvaraṃ viśvāṅgyaṃ' visalpakam |
sarvaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ' te rogaṃ bahirnirmantrayāmahe ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य॑ भी॒मः प्र॑तीका॒श उ॑द्वे॒पय॑ति॒ पूरु॑षम् ।
त॒क्मानं॑ वि॒श्वशा॑रदं ब॒हिर्निर्म॑न्त्रयामहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasya bhīmaḥ pratīkāśa udvepayati pūruṣam |
takmānaṃ viśvaśāradaṃ bahirnirmantrayāmahe ||

verses.sanskrit:
य ऊ॒रू अ॑नु॒सर्प॒त्यथो॒ एति॑ ग॒वीनि॑के ।
यक्ष्मं॑ ते अ॒न्तरङ्गे॑भ्यो ब॒हिर्निर्म॑न्त्रयामहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya ūrū anusarpatyatho eti gavīnike |
yakṣmaṃ te antaraṅgebhyo bahirnirmantrayāmahe ||

verses.sanskrit:
यदि॒ कामा॑दपका॒माद्धृद॑या॒ज्जाय॑ते॒ परि॑ ।
हृ॒दो ब॒लास॒मङ्गे॑भ्यो ब॒हिर्निर्म॑न्त्रयामहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadi kāmādapakāmāddhṛdayājjāyate pari |
hṛdo balāsamaṅgebhyo bahirnirmantrayāmahe ||

verses.sanskrit:
ह॒रि॒माणं॑ ते॒ अङ्गे॑भ्यो॒ऽप्वाम॑न्त॒रोदरा॑त् ।
य॒क्ष्मो॒धाम॒न्तरा॒त्मनो॑ ब॒हिर्निर्म॑न्त्रयामहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
harimāṇaṃ te aṅgebhyo'pvāmantarodarāt |
yakṣmodhāmantarātmano bahirnirmantrayāmahe ||

verses.sanskrit:
आसो॑ ब॒लासो॒ भव॑तु॒ मूत्रं॑ भवत्वा॒मय॑त् ।
यक्ष्मा॑णां॒ सर्वे॑षां वि॒षं निर॑वोचम॒हं त्वत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
āso balāso bhavatu mūtraṃ bhavatvāmayat |
yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ niravocamahaṃ tvat ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब॒हिर्बिलं॒ निर्द्र॑वतु॒ काहा॑बाहं॒ तवो॒दरा॑त् ।
यक्ष्मा॑णां॒ सर्वे॑षां वि॒षं निर॑वोचम॒हं त्वत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
bahirbilaṃ nirdravatu kāhābāhaṃ tavodarāt |
yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ niravocamahaṃ tvat ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒दरा॑त् ते क्लो॒म्नो नाभ्या॒ हृद॑या॒दधि॑ ।
यक्ष्मा॑णां॒ सर्वे॑षां वि॒षं निर॑वोचम॒हं त्वत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
udarāt te klomno nābhyā hṛdayādadhi |
yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ niravocamahaṃ tvat ||

verses.sanskrit:
याः सी॒मानं॑ विरु॒जन्ति॑ मू॒र्धानं॒ प्रत्य॑र्ष॒नीः ।
अहिं॑सन्तीरनाम॒या निर्द्र॑वन्तु ब॒हिर्बिल॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāḥ sīmānaṃ virujanti mūrdhānaṃ pratyarṣanīḥ |
ahiṃsantīranāmayā nirdravantu bahirbilam ||

verses.sanskrit:
या हृद॑यमुप॒र्षन्त्य॑नुत॒न्वन्ति॒ कीक॑साः ।
अहिं॑सन्तीरनाम॒या निर्द्र॑वन्तु ब॒हिर्बिल॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yā hṛdayamuparṣantyanutanvanti kīkasāḥ |
ahiṃsantīranāmayā nirdravantu bahirbilam ||

verses.sanskrit:
याः पा॒र्श्वे उ॑प॒र्षन्त्य॑नु॒निक्ष॑न्ति पृ॒ष्टीः ।
अहिं॑सन्तीरनाम॒या निर्द्र॑वन्तु ब॒हिर्बिल॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāḥ pārśve uparṣantyanunikṣanti pṛṣṭīḥ |
ahiṃsantīranāmayā nirdravantu bahirbilam ||

verses.sanskrit:
यास्ति॒रश्ची॑रुप॒र्षन्त्य॑र्ष॒णीर्व॒क्षणा॑सु ते ।
अहिं॑सन्तीरनाम॒या निर्द्र॑वन्तु ब॒हिर्बिल॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāstiraścīruparṣantyarṣaṇīrvakṣaṇāsu te |
ahiṃsantīranāmayā nirdravantu bahirbilam ||

verses.sanskrit:
या गुदा॑ अनु॒सर्प॑न्त्या॒न्त्राणि॑ मो॒हय॑न्ति च ।
अहिं॑सन्तीरनाम॒या निर्द्र॑वन्तु ब॒हिर्बिल॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yā gudā anusarpantyāntrāṇi mohayanti ca |
ahiṃsantīranāmayā nirdravantu bahirbilam ||

verses.sanskrit:
या म॒ज्ज्ञो नि॒र्धय॑न्ति॒ परूं॑षि विरु॒जन्ति॑ च ।
अहिं॑सन्तीरनाम॒या निर्द्र॑वन्तु ब॒हिर्बिल॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yā majjño nirdhayanti parūṃṣi virujanti ca |
ahiṃsantīranāmayā nirdravantu bahirbilam ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये अङ्गा॑नि॒ म॒दय॑न्ति॒ यक्ष्मा॑सो रोप॒णास्तव॑ ।
यक्ष्मा॑णां॒ सर्वे॑षां वि॒षं निर॑वोचम॒हं त्वत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye aṅgāni madayanti yakṣmāso ropaṇāstava |
yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ niravocamahaṃ tvat ||

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒स॒ल्पस्य॑ विद्र॒धस्य॑ वातीका॒रस्य॑ वाल॒जेः ।
यक्ष्मा॑णां॒ सर्वे॑षां वि॒षं निर॑वोचम॒हं त्वत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
visalpasya vidradhasya vātīkārasya vālajeḥ |
yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ niravocamahaṃ tvat ||

verses.sanskrit:
पादा॑भ्यां ते॒ जानु॑भ्यां॒ श्रोणि॑भ्यां॒ परि॒ भंस॑सः ।
अनू॑कादर्ष॒णीरु॒ष्णिहा॑भ्यः शी॒र्ष्णो रोग॑मनीनशम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pādābhyāṃ te jānubhyāṃ śroṇibhyāṃ pari bhaṃsasaḥ |
anūkādarṣaṇīruṣṇihābhyaḥ śīrṣṇo rogamanīnaśam ||

verses.sanskrit:
सं ते॑ शी॒र्ष्णः क॒पाला॑नि॒ हृद॑यस्य च॒ यो वि॒धुः ।
उ॒द्यन्ना॑दित्य र॒श्मिभिः॑ शी॒र्ष्णो रोग॑मनीनशोऽङ्गभे॒दम॑शीशमः ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ te śīrṣṇaḥ kapālāni hṛdayasya ca yo vidhuḥ |
udyannāditya raśmibhiḥ śīrṣṇo rogamanīnaśo'ṅgabhedamaśīśamaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒स्य वा॒मस्य॑ पलि॒तस्य॒ होतु॒स्तस्य॒ भ्राता॑ मध्य॒मो अ॒स्त्यश्नः॑ ।
तृ॒तीयो॒ भ्राता॑ घृ॒तपृ॑ष्ठो अ॒स्यात्रा॑पश्यं वि॒श्पतिं॑ स॒प्तपु॑त्रम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
asya vāmasya palitasya hotustasya bhrātā madhyamo astyaśnaḥ |
tṛtīyo bhrātā ghṛtapṛṣṭho asyātrāpaśyaṃ viśpatiṃ saptaputram ||
verses.translation:
Enunciation of mystico-theological and cosmological doctrine
The second brother of this lovely Hotar, hoary with eld, is the voracious Lightning.
The third is he whose back is balmed with butter. Here have I seen the King with seven male children.
The seven make the one-wheeled chariot ready: bearing seven names the single Courser draws it.
The wheel, three-naved, is sound and undecaying: thereon these worlds of life are all dependent.
The seven who on this seven-wheeled car are mounted have horses, seven in tale, who draw them onward.
Seven sisters utter songs of praise together, in whom the Cows’ seven names are held and treasured.
Who hath beheld at birth the Primal Being, when She who hath no bone supports the bony?
Where is the blood of earth, the life, the spirit? Who may ap-proach the man who knows, to ask it?
Let him who knoweth presently declare it, this lovely Bird’s securely-founded station.
Forth from his head the Cows draw milk, and wearing his ves-ture with their foot have drunk the water.
Unripe in mind, in spirit undiscerning, I ask of these the Gods’ established places.
High up above the yearling Calf the sages, to form a web, their own seven threads have woven.
Here, ignorant, I ask the wise who know it, as one who knows not, for the sake of knowledge,
What is That One, who in the Unborn’s image hath stablished and fixed firm this world’s six regions.
The Mother gave the Sire his share of Order. With thought at first she wedded him in spirit.
She, coyly loth, was filled with dew prolific. With adoration men approached to praise her.
Yoked was the Mother to the boon Cow’s car-pole; in humid folds of cloud the infant rested.
Then the Calf lowed and looked upon the Mother, the Cow who wears all shapes in three directions.
Bearing three mothers and three fathers, single he stood erect: they never made him weary.
On yonder heaven’s high ridge they speak together in speech not known to all, themselves all-knowing.
Upon the five-spoked wheel revolving ever, whereon all crea-tures rest and are dependent,
The axle, heavy-laden, is not heated: the nave from ancient time remains unheated.
They call him in the farther half of heaven the Sire five-footed, of twelve forms, wealthy in watery store.
These others, later still, say that he takes his stand upon a seven-wheeled car, six-spoked, whose sight is clear.
Formed with twelve spokes, too strong for age to weaken, this wheel of during Order rolls round heaven.
Herein established, joined in pairs together, seven hundred sons and twenty stand, O Agni.
The wheel revolves, unwasting, with its felly: ten draw it, yoked to the far-stretching carpole.
Girt by the region moves the eye of Sūrya, on whom dependent rest all living creatures.
They told me these were males, though truly females. He who hath eyes sees this, the blind discerns not.
The son who is a sage hath comprehended: who knows this rightly is his father’s father.
Of the co-born they call the seventh single-born: the six twin, pairs are called the Rishis, sons of Gods.
Their good gifts sought of men are ranged in order due, and, various, form by form, move for their guiding Lord.
Beneath the upper realm, above this lower, bearing her Calf at foot, the Cow hath risen.
Whitherward, to what place hath she departed? Where doth she calve? Not in this herd of cattle.
Who, that the father of this Calf discerneth beneath the upper realm, above the lower,
Showing himself a sage, may here declare him? Whence hath the godlike spirit had its rising?
Those that come hitherward they call departing, those that depart they call directed hither.
Whatever ye have made, Indra and Soma! steeds draw, as’ twere, yoked to the region’s carpole.
Two Birds with fair wings, knit with bonds of friendship, in the same sheltering tree have found a refuge,
One of the twain eats the sweet Fig-tree’s berry: the other, eat-ing not, regardeth only.
The tree whereon the fine Birds eat the sweetness, where they all rest and procreate their offspring Upon the top, they say the fruit is luscious: none gaineth it who knoweth not the Father.
Where the fine birds hymn ceaselessly their portion of life eter-nal, and the sacred synods.
There is the Universe’s Guard and Keeper who, wise hath entered into me the simple.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒प्त यु॑ञ्जन्ति॒ रथ॒मेक॑चक्र॒मेको॒ अश्वो॑ वहति स॒प्तना॑मा ।
त्रि॒नाभि॑ च॒क्रम॒जर॑मन॒र्वं यत्रे॒मा विश्वा॒ भुव॒नाधि॑ त॒स्थुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sapta yuñjanti rathamekacakrameko aśvo vahati saptanāmā |
trinābhi cakramajaramanarvaṃ yatremā viśvā bhuvanādhi tasthuḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मं रथ॒मधि॒ ये स॒प्त त॒स्थुः स॒प्तच॑क्रं स॒प्त व॑ह॒न्त्यश्वाः॑ ।
स॒प्त स्वसा॑रो अ॒भि सं न॑वन्त॒ यत्र॒ गवां॒ निहि॑ता स॒प्त नामा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
imaṃ rathamadhi ye sapta tasthuḥ saptacakraṃ sapta vahantyaśvāḥ |
sapta svasāro abhi saṃ navanta yatra gavāṃ nihitā sapta nāmā ||

verses.sanskrit:
को द॑दर्श प्रथ॒मं जाय॑मानमस्थ॒न्वन्तं॒ यद॑न॒स्था बिभ॑र्ति ।
भूम्या॒ असु॒रसृ॑गा॒त्मा क्वऽस्वित् को वि॒द्वांस॒मुप॑ गा॒त् प्रष्टु॑मे॒तत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ko dadarśa prathamaṃ jāyamānamasthanvantaṃ yadanasthā bibharti |
bhūmyā asurasṛgātmā kva'svit ko vidvāṃsamupa gāt praṣṭumetat ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒ह ब्र॑वीतु॒ य ई॑म॒ङ्ग वेदा॒स्य वा॒मस्य॒ निहि॑तं प॒दं वेः ।
शी॒र्ष्णः क्षी॒रं दु॑ह्रते॒ गावो॑ अस्य व॒व्रिं वसा॑ना उद॒कं प॒दापुः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
iha bravītu ya īmaṅga vedāsya vāmasya nihitaṃ padaṃ veḥ |
śīrṣṇaḥ kṣīraṃ duhrate gāvo asya vavriṃ vasānā udakaṃ padāpuḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
पाकः॑ पृच्छामि॒ मन॒सावि॑जानन् दे॒वाना॑मे॒ना निहि॑ता प॒दानि॑ ।
व॒त्से ब॒ष्कयेऽधि॑ स॒प्त तन्तू॒न् वि त॑त्निरे क॒वय॒ ओत॒वा उ॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pākaḥ pṛcchāmi manasāvijānan devānāmenā nihitā padāni |
vatse baṣkaye'dhi sapta tantūn vi tatnire kavaya otavā u ||

verses.sanskrit:
अचि॑कित्वांस्चिकि॒तुष॑श्चि॒दत्र॑ क॒वीन् पृ॑च्छामि वि॒द्वनो॒ न वि॒द्वान् ।
वि यस्त॒स्तम्भ षडि॒मा रजां॑स्य॒जस्य॑ रू॒पे किमपि॑ स्वि॒देक॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
acikitvāṃscikituṣaścidatra kavīn pṛcchāmi vidvano na vidvān |
vi yastastambha ṣaḍimā rajāṃsyajasya rūpe kimapi svidekam ||

verses.sanskrit:
मा॒ता पि॒तर॑मृ॒त आ ब॑भाज धी॒त्यग्रे॒ मन॑सा॒ सं हि ज॒ग्मे ।
सा बी॑भ॒त्सुर्गर्भ॑रसा॒ निवि॑द्धा॒ नम॑स्वन्त॒ इदु॑पवा॒कमी॑युः ॥
verses.transliteration:
mātā pitaramṛta ā babhāja dhītyagre manasā saṃ hi jagme |
sā bībhatsurgarbharasā nividdhā namasvanta idupavākamīyuḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यु॒क्ता मा॒तासि॑द्धु॒रि दक्षि॑णाया॒ अति॑ष्ठ॒द् गर्भो॑ वृज॒नीष्व॒न्तः ।
अमी॑मेद् व॒त्सो अनु॒ गाम॑पश्यद् विश्वरू॒प्यंऽ त्रि॒षु योज॑नेषु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yuktā mātāsiddhuri dakṣiṇāyā atiṣṭhad garbho vṛjanīṣvantaḥ |
amīmed vatso anu gāmapaśyad viśvarūpyaṃ' triṣu yojaneṣu ||

verses.sanskrit:
ति॒स्रो मा॒तॄस्त्रीन् पि॒तॄन् बिभ्र॒देक॑ ऊ॒र्ध्वस्त॑स्थौ॒ नेमव॑ ग्लापयन्त ।
म॒न्त्रय॑न्ते दि॒वो अ॒मुष्य॑ पृ॒ष्ठे वि॑श्व॒विदो॒ वाच॒मवि॑श्वविन्नाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tisro mātṝstrīn pitṝn bibhradeka ūrdhvastasthau nemava glāpayanta |
mantrayante divo amuṣya pṛṣṭhe viśvavido vācamaviśvavinnām ||

verses.sanskrit:
पञ्चा॑रे च॒क्रे प॑रि॒वर्त॑माने॒ यस्मि॑न्नात॒स्थुर्भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
तस्य॒ नाक्ष॑स्तप्यते॒ भूरि॑भारः स॒नादे॒व न च्छि॑द्यते॒ सना॑भिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
pañcāre cakre parivartamāne yasminnātasthurbhuvanāni viśvā |
tasya nākṣastapyate bhūribhāraḥ sanādeva na cchidyate sanābhiḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
पञ्च॑पादं पि॒तरं॒ द्वाद॑शाकृतिं दि॒व आ॑हुः परे॒ अर्धे॑ पुरी॒षिण॑म् ।
अथे॒मे अ॒न्य उप॑रे विचक्ष॒णे स॒प्तच॑क्रे॒ षड॑र आहु॒रर्पि॑तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pañcapādaṃ pitaraṃ dvādaśākṛtiṃ diva āhuḥ pare ardhe purīṣiṇam |
atheme anya upare vicakṣaṇe saptacakre ṣaḍara āhurarpitam ||

verses.sanskrit:
द्वाद॑शारं न॒हि तज्जरा॑य॒ वर्व॑र्ति च॒क्रं परि॒ द्यामृ॒तस्य॑ ।
आ पु॒त्रा अ॑ग्ने मिथु॒नासो॒ अत्र॑ स॒प्त श॒तानि॑ विंश॒तिश्च॑ तस्थुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
dvādaśāraṃ nahi tajjarāya varvarti cakraṃ pari dyāmṛtasya |
ā putrā agne mithunāso atra sapta śatāni viṃśatiśca tasthuḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
सने॑मि च॒क्रम॒जरं॒ वि वा॑वृत उत्ता॒नायां॒ दश॑ यु॒क्ता व॑हन्ति ।
सूर्य॑स्य॒ चक्षू॒ रज॑सै॒त्यावृ॑तं॒ यस्मि॑न्नात॒स्थुर्भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sanemi cakramajaraṃ vi vāvṛta uttānāyāṃ daśa yuktā vahanti |
sūryasya cakṣū rajasaityāvṛtaṃ yasminnātasthurbhuvanāni viśvā ||

verses.sanskrit:
स्त्रियः॑ स॒तीस्ताँ उ॑ मे पुं॒सः आ॑हुः॒ पश्य॑दक्ष॒ण्वान् न वि चे॑तद॒न्धः ।
क॒विर्यः पु॒त्रः स ई॒मा चि॑केत॒ यस्ता वि॑जा॒नात् स पि॒तुष्पि॒तास॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
striyaḥ satīstām̐ u me puṃsaḥ āhuḥ paśyadakṣaṇvān na vi cetadandhaḥ |
kaviryaḥ putraḥ sa īmā ciketa yastā vijānāt sa pituṣpitāsat ||

verses.sanskrit:
सा॒कं॒जानां॑ स॒प्तथ॑माहुरेक॒जं षडिद् य॒मा ऋष॑यो देव॒जा इति॑ ।
तेषा॑मि॒ष्टानि॒ विहि॑तानि धाम॒श स्था॒त्रे रे॑जन्ते॒ विकृ॑तानि रूप॒शः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sākaṃjānāṃ saptathamāhurekajaṃ ṣaḍid yamā ṛṣayo devajā iti |
teṣāmiṣṭāni vihitāni dhāmaśa sthātre rejante vikṛtāni rūpaśaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒वः परे॑ण प॒र ए॒नाव॑रेण प॒दा व॒त्सं बिभ्र॑ती॒ गौरुद॑स्थात् ।
सा क॒द्रीची॒ कं स्वि॒दर्धं॒ परा॑गा॒त् क्वऽस्वित्सूते न॒हि यू॒थे अ॒स्मिन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
avaḥ pareṇa para enāvareṇa padā vatsaṃ bibhratī gaurudasthāt |
sā kadrīcī kaṃ svidardhaṃ parāgāt kva'svitsūte nahi yūthe asmin ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒वः परे॑ण पि॒तरं॒ यो अ॑स्य॒ वेदा॒वः परे॑ण प॒र ए॒ना व॑रेण ।
क॒वी॒यमा॑नः॒ क इ॒ह प्र वो॑चद् दे॒वं मनः॒ कुतो॒ अधि॒ प्रजा॑तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
avaḥ pareṇa pitaraṃ yo asya vedāvaḥ pareṇa para enā vareṇa |
kavīyamānaḥ ka iha pra vocad devaṃ manaḥ kuto adhi prajātam ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये अ॒र्वाञ्च॒स्ताँ उ॒ परा॑च आहु॒र्ये परा॑ञ्च॒स्ताँ उ॑ अ॒र्वाच॑ आहुः ।
इन्द्र॑श्च॒ या च॒क्रथुः॑ सोम॒ तानि॑ धु॒रा न यु॒क्ता रज॑सो वहन्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye arvāñcastām̐ u parāca āhurye parāñcastām̐ u arvāca āhuḥ |
indraśca yā cakrathuḥ soma tāni dhurā na yuktā rajaso vahanti ||

verses.sanskrit:
द्वा सु॑प॒र्णा स॒युजा॒ सखा॑या समा॒नं वृ॒क्षं परि॑ षस्वजाते ।
तयो॑र॒न्यः पिप्प॑लं स्वा॒द्वत्त्यन॑श्नन्न॒न्यो अ॒भि चा॑कशीति ॥
verses.transliteration:
dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pari ṣasvajāte |
tayoranyaḥ pippalaṃ svādvattyanaśnannanyo abhi cākaśīti ||

verses.sanskrit:
