Those I give up to thee with all their children. Force them to tribute, but to me be gracious.
Rise to the altar: bless this dame with offspring. Promote this woman; drive away the demons.
May we surpass in glory all our rivals. I cast beneath my feet the men who hate us.
Approach this woman here with store of cattle: together with the deities come to meet her.
Let not a curse or imprecation reach thee: in thine own seat shine forth exempt from sickness.
Fashioned at first by Right, set by the spirit, this altar of Brahmau-dana was appointed.
Place the pure boiler on it, woman! set thou therein the rice mess of Celestial Beings.
This second hand of Aditi, this ladle which the Seven Rishis, world-creators, fashioned.
May this scoop deftly pile upon the altar, therein, the members of the rice-oblation.
Let the dressed offering and divine Ones serve thee: creep from. the fire again, own these as masters.
Made pure with Soma rest within the Brāhmans: let not thine eaters, Rishis’ sons, be injured.
Give understanding unto these, King Soma! all the good Brāh mans who attend and serve thee.
Oft, in Brahmaudana, and well I call on: Rishis, their sons, and those who sprang from Fervour.
Here I set singly in the hands of Brāhmans these cleansed and. purifie d and holy Women,
May Indra, Marut girt, grant me the blessing which as I sprinkle you, my heart desireth.
Here is my gold, a light immortal: ripened grain from the field this Cow of Plenty give me!
This wealth I place among the Brāhmans, making a path that leads to heaven among the Fathers.
Lay thou the chaff in Agni Jātavedas: remove the husks and drive them to a distance.
That, we have heard, that is the House-Lord’s portion: we know the share allotted to Destruction.
Mark him who toils and cooks and pours oblation: make this man climb the path that leads to heaven,
That he may mount and reach life that is highest, ascending to the loftiest vault above us.
Adhvaryu, cleanse that face of the Supporter. Make room, well knowing, for the molten butter.
Purify duly all the limbs with fatness. I make a path to heaven amid the Fathers.
Supporter, send to those men fiends and battle, to all non-Brah-mans who attend and serve thee.
Famous and foremost, with their great possessions, let not these here, the Rishis sons, be injured.
I set thee, Odana, with Rishis’ children: naught here belongs to men not sprung from Rishis.
Let Agni my protector, all the Maruts, the Visve Devas guard the cooked oblation.
May we adore thee, Sacrifice that yieldeth an everlasting son, cow, home of treasures,
Together with increasing store of riches, long life and immor-tality of children.
Thou art a Bull that mounts to heaven: to Rishis and their off-spring go.
Rest in the world of pious men: there is the place prepared for us.
Level the ways: go thitherward, O Agni. Make ready thou the Godward-leading pathways.
By these our pious actions may we follow sacrifice dwelling in the seven-rayed heaven.
May we invested with that light go upward, ascending to the sky’s most lofty summit.
Wherewith the Gods, what time they had made ready Brahmaudana, mounted to the world of virtue.

verses.sanskrit:
कृ॒णु॒त धू॒मं वृ॑षणः सखा॒योऽद्रो॑घाविता॒ वाच॒मच्छ॑ ।
अ॒यम॒ग्निः पृ॑तना॒षाट् सु॒वीरो॑ येन॑ दे॒वा अस॑हन्त॒ दस्यू॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
kṛṇuta dhūmaṃ vṛṣaṇaḥ sakhāyo'droghāvitā vācamaccha |
ayamagniḥ pṛtanāṣāṭ suvīro yena devā asahanta dasyūn ||

verses.sanskrit:
अग्नेऽज॑निष्ठा मह॒ते वी॒र्याऽय ब्रह्मौद॒नाय॒ पक्त॑वे जातवेदः ।
स॒प्त॒ऋ॒षयो॑ भूत॒कृत॒स्ते त्वा॑जीजनन्न॒स्यै र॒यिं सर्व॑वीरं॒ नि य॑च्छ ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne'janiṣṭhā mahate vīryā'ya brahmaudanāya paktave jātavedaḥ |
saptaṛṣayo bhūtakṛtaste tvājījanannasyai rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ ni yaccha ||

verses.sanskrit:
समि॑द्धो अग्ने स॒मिधा॒ समि॑ध्यस्व वि॒द्वान् दे॒वान् य॒ज्ञियाँ॒ एह व॑क्षः ।
तेभ्यो॑ ह॒विः श्र॒पयं॑ जातवेद उत्त॒मं नाक॒मधि॑ रोहये॒मम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
samiddho agne samidhā samidhyasva vidvān devān yajñiyām̐ eha vakṣaḥ |
tebhyo haviḥ śrapayaṃ jātaveda uttamaṃ nākamadhi rohayemam ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्रे॒धा भा॒गो निहि॑तो॒ यः पु॒रा वो॑ दे॒वानां॑ पितॄ॒णां मर्त्या॑नाम् ।
अंशा॑न् जानीध्वं॒ वि भ॑जामि॒ तान् वो॒ यो दे॒वानां॒ स इ॒मां पा॑रयाति ॥
verses.transliteration:
tredhā bhāgo nihito yaḥ purā vo devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ martyānām |
aṃśān jānīdhvaṃ vi bhajāmi tān vo yo devānāṃ sa imāṃ pārayāti ||

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ सह॑स्वानभि॒भूर॒भीद॑सि॒ नीचो॒ न्युऽब्ज द्विष॒तः स॒पत्ना॑न् ।
इ॒यं मात्रा॑ मी॒यमा॑ना मि॒ता च॑ सजा॒तांस्ते॑ बलि॒हृतः॑ कृणोतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne sahasvānabhibhūrabhīdasi nīco nyu'bja dviṣataḥ sapatnān |
iyaṃ mātrā mīyamānā mitā ca sajātāṃste balihṛtaḥ kṛṇotu ||

verses.sanskrit:
सा॒कं स॑जा॒तैः पय॑सा स॒हैध्युदु॑ब्जैनां मह॒ते वी॒र्याऽय ।
ऊ॒र्ध्वो नाक॒स्याधि॑ रोह वि॒ष्टपं॑ स्व॒र्गो लो॒क इति॒ यं वद॑न्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
sākaṃ sajātaiḥ payasā sahaidhyudubjaināṃ mahate vīryā'ya |
ūrdhvo nākasyādhi roha viṣṭapaṃ svargo loka iti yaṃ vadanti ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒यं म॒ही प्रति॑ गृह्णातु॒ चर्म॑ पृथि॒वी दे॒वी सु॑मन॒स्यमा॑ना ।
अथ॑ गच्छेम सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
iyaṃ mahī prati gṛhṇātu carma pṛthivī devī sumanasyamānā |
atha gacchema sukṛtasya lokam ||

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒तौ ग्रावा॑णौ स॒युजा॑ युङ्ग्धि॒ चर्म॑णि॒ निर्भि॑न्ध्यं॒शून् यज॑मानाय सा॒धु ।
अ॒व॒घ्न॒ती नि ज॑हि॒ य इ॒मां पृ॑त॒न्यव॑ ऊ॒र्ध्वं प्र॒जामु॒द्भर॒न्त्युदू॑ह ॥
verses.transliteration:
etau grāvāṇau sayujā yuṅgdhi carmaṇi nirbhindhyaṃśūn yajamānāya sādhu |
avaghnatī ni jahi ya imāṃ pṛtanyava ūrdhvaṃ prajāmudbharantyudūha ||

verses.sanskrit:
गृ॒हा॒ण ग्रावा॑णौ स॒कृतौ॑ वीर॒ हस्त॒ आ ते॑ दे॒वा य॒ज्ञिया॑ य॒ज्ञम॑गुः ।
त्रयो॒ वरा॑ यत॒मांस्त्वं वृ॑णी॒षे तास्ते॒ समृ॑द्धीरि॒ह रा॑धयामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
gṛhāṇa grāvāṇau sakṛtau vīra hasta ā te devā yajñiyā yajñamaguḥ |
trayo varā yatamāṃstvaṃ vṛṇīṣe tāste samṛddhīriha rādhayāmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒यं ते॑ धी॒तिरि॒दमु॑ ते ज॒नित्रं॑ गृ॒ह्णातु॒ त्वामदि॑तिः॒ शूर॑पुत्रा ।
परा॑ पुनीहि॒ य इ॒मां पृ॑त॒न्यवो॒ऽस्यै र॒यिं सर्व॑वीरं॒ नि य॑च्छ ॥
verses.transliteration:
iyaṃ te dhītiridamu te janitraṃ gṛhṇātu tvāmaditiḥ śūraputrā |
parā punīhi ya imāṃ pṛtanyavo'syai rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ ni yaccha ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒श्व॒से द्रु॒वये॑ सीदता यू॒यं वि वि॑च्यध्वं यज्ञियास॒स्तुषैः॑ ।
श्रि॒या स॑मा॒नानति॒ सर्वा॑न्त्स्यामाधस्प॒दं द्वि॑ष॒तस्पा॑दयामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
upaśvase druvaye sīdatā yūyaṃ vi vicyadhvaṃ yajñiyāsastuṣaiḥ |
śriyā samānānati sarvāntsyāmādhaspadaṃ dviṣataspādayāmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
परे॑हि नारि॒ पुन॑रेहि॑ क्षि॒प्रम॒पां त्वा॑ गो॒ष्ठोऽध्य॑रुक्ष॒द् भरा॑य ।
तासां॑ गृह्णीताद् यत॒मा य॒ज्ञिया॒ अस॑न् वि॒भाज्य॑ धी॒रीत॑रा जहीतात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
parehi nāri punarehi kṣipramapāṃ tvā goṣṭho'dhyarukṣad bharāya |
tāsāṃ gṛhṇītād yatamā yajñiyā asan vibhājya dhīrītarā jahītāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
एमा अ॑गुर्यो॒षितः॒ शुम्भ॑माना॒ उत्ति॑ष्ठ नारि त॒वसं॑ रभस्व ।
सु॒पत्नी॒ पत्या॑ प्र॒जया॑ प्र॒जाव॒त्या त्वा॑गन् यज्ञः प्रति॑ कु॒म्भं गृ॑भाय ॥
verses.transliteration:
emā aguryoṣitaḥ śumbhamānā uttiṣṭha nāri tavasaṃ rabhasva |
supatnī patyā prajayā prajāvatyā tvāgan yajñaḥ prati kumbhaṃ gṛbhāya ||

verses.sanskrit:
ऊ॒र्जो भा॒गो निहि॑तो॒ यः पु॒रा व॒ ऋषि॑प्रशिष्टा॒प आ भ॑रै॒ताः ।
अ॒यं य॒जो गा॑तु॒विन्ना॑थ॒वित् प्र॑जा॒विदु॒ग्रः प॑शु॒विद् वी॑र॒विद् वो॑ अस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
ūrjo bhāgo nihito yaḥ purā va ṛṣipraśiṣṭāpa ā bharaitāḥ |
ayaṃ yajo gātuvinnāthavit prajāvidugraḥ paśuvid vīravid vo astu ||

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॑ च॒रुर्य॒ज्ञिय॒स्त्वाध्य॑रुक्ष॒च्छुचि॒स्तपि॑ष्ठ॒स्तप॑सा तपैनम् ।
आ॒र्षे॒या दै॒वा अ॑भिसं॒गत्य॒ भा॒गमि॒मं तपि॑ष्ठा ऋ॒तुभि॑स्तपन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne caruryajñiyastvādhyarukṣacchucistapiṣṭhastapasā tapainam |
ārṣeyā daivā abhisaṃgatya bhāgamimaṃ tapiṣṭhā ṛtubhistapantu ||

verses.sanskrit:
शु॒द्धाः पू॒ता यो॒षितो॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑ इ॒मा आप॑श्च॒रुमव॑ सर्पन्तु शु॒भ्राः ।
अदुः॑ प्र॒जां ब॑हु॒लान् प॒शून् नः॑ प॒क्तौद॒नस्य॑ सु॒कृता॑मेतु लो॒कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śuddhāḥ pūtā yoṣito yajñiyā imā āpaścarumava sarpantu śubhrāḥ |
aduḥ prajāṃ bahulān paśūn naḥ paktaudanasya sukṛtāmetu lokam ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्म॑णा शु॒द्धा उ॒त पू॒ता घृ॒तेन॑ सोम॑स्यां॒शव॑स्तण्डु॒ला य॒ज्ञिया॑ इ॒मे ।
अ॒पः प्र वि॑शत॒ प्रति॑ गृह्णातु वश्च॒रुरि॒मं प॒क्त्वा सु॒कृता॑मेत लो॒कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmaṇā śuddhā uta pūtā ghṛtena somasyāṃśavastaṇḍulā yajñiyā ime |
apaḥ pra viśata prati gṛhṇātu vaścarurimaṃ paktvā sukṛtāmeta lokam ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒रुः प्र॑थस्व मह॒ता म॑हि॒म्ना स॒हस्र॑पृष्ठः सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒के ।
पि॒ता॒म॒हाः पि॒तरः॑ प्र॒जोप॒जाहं प॒क्ता प॑ञ्चद॒शस्ते॑ अस्मि ॥
verses.transliteration:
uruḥ prathasva mahatā mahimnā sahasrapṛṣṭhaḥ sukṛtasya loke |
pitāmahāḥ pitaraḥ prajopajāhaṃ paktā pañcadaśaste asmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒हस्र॑पृष्ठः श॒तधा॑रो॒ अक्षि॑तो ब्रह्मौद॒नो दे॑व॒यानः॑ स्व॒र्गः ।
अ॒मूंस्त॒ आ द॑धामि प्र॒जया॑ रेषयैनान् बलिहा॒राय॑ मृडता॒न्मह्य॑मे॒व ॥
verses.transliteration:
sahasrapṛṣṭhaḥ śatadhāro akṣito brahmaudano devayānaḥ svargaḥ |
amūṃsta ā dadhāmi prajayā reṣayainān balihārāya mṛḍatānmahyameva ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒देहि॒ वेदिं॑ प्र॒जया॑ वर्धयैनां नु॒दस्व॒ रक्षः॑ प्रत॒रं धे॑ह्येनाम् ।
श्रि॒या स॑मा॒नानति॒ सर्वा॑न्त्स्यामाधस्प॒दं द्वि॑ष॒तस्पा॑दयामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
udehi vediṃ prajayā vardhayaināṃ nudasva rakṣaḥ prataraṃ dhehyenām |
śriyā samānānati sarvāntsyāmādhaspadaṃ dviṣataspādayāmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भ्याव॑र्तस्व प॒शुभिः॑ स॒हैनां॑ प्र॒त्यङे॑नां दे॒वता॑भिः स॒हैधि॑ ।
मा त्वा॒ प्राप॑च्छ॒पथो॒ माभि॑चा॒रः स्वे क्षेत्रे॑ अनमी॒वा वि रा॑ज ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhyāvartasva paśubhiḥ sahaināṃ pratyaṅenāṃ devatābhiḥ sahaidhi |
mā tvā prāpacchapatho mābhicāraḥ sve kṣetre anamīvā vi rāja ||

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒तेन॑ त॒ष्टा मन॑सा हि॒तैषा ब्र॑ह्मौद॒नस्य॒ विहि॑ता॒ वेदि॒रग्रे॑ ।
अं॒स॒द्रीं शु॒द्धामुप॑ धेहि नारि॒ तत्रौ॑द॒नं सा॑दय दै॒वाना॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛtena taṣṭā manasā hitaiṣā brahmaudanasya vihitā vediragre |
aṃsadrīṃ śuddhāmupa dhehi nāri tatraudanaṃ sādaya daivānām ||

verses.sanskrit:
अदि॑ते॒र्हस्तां॒ स्रुच॑मे॒तां द्वि॒तीयां॑ सप्तऋ॒षयो॑ भूत॒कृतो॒ यामकृ॑ण्वन् ।
सा गात्रा॑णि वि॒दुष्यो॑द॒नस्य॒ दर्वि॒र्वेद्या॒मध्ये॑नं चिनोतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
aditerhastāṃ srucametāṃ dvitīyāṃ saptaṛṣayo bhūtakṛto yāmakṛṇvan |
sā gātrāṇi viduṣyodanasya darvirvedyāmadhyenaṃ cinotu ||

verses.sanskrit:
शृ॒तं त्वा॑ ह॒व्यमुप॑ सीदन्तु दै॒वा निः॒सृप्या॒ग्नेः पुन॑रेना॒न् प्र सी॑द ।
सोमे॑न पू॒तो ज॒ठरे॑ सीद ब्र॒ह्म॑णामार्षे॒यास्ते॒ मा रि॑षन् प्राशि॒तारः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
śṛtaṃ tvā havyamupa sīdantu daivā niḥsṛpyāgneḥ punarenān pra sīda |
somena pūto jaṭhare sīda brahmaṇāmārṣeyāste mā riṣan prāśitāraḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
सोम॑ राजन्त्सं॒ज्ञान॒मा व॑पैभ्यः॒ सुब्रा॑ह्मणा यत॒मे त्वो॑प॒सीदा॑न् ।
ऋषी॑नार्षे॒यांस्तप॒सोऽधि॑ जा॒तान् ब्र॑ह्मौद॒ने सु॒हवा॑ जोहवीमि ॥
verses.transliteration:
soma rājantsaṃjñānamā vapaibhyaḥ subrāhmaṇā yatame tvopasīdān |
ṛṣīnārṣeyāṃstapaso'dhi jātān brahmaudane suhavā johavīmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
शु॒द्धाः पू॒ता यो॒षितो॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑ इ॒मा ब्र॒ह्मणां॒ हस्ते॑षु प्रपृ॒थक् सा॑दयामि ।
यत् का॑म इ॒दम॑भिषि॒ञ्चामि॑ वो॒ऽहमिन्द्रो॑ म॒रुत्वा॒न्त्स द॑दादि॒दं मे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
śuddhāḥ pūtā yoṣito yajñiyā imā brahmaṇāṃ hasteṣu prapṛthak sādayāmi |
yat kāma idamabhiṣiñcāmi vo'hamindro marutvāntsa dadādidaṃ me ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं मे॒ ज्योति॑र॒मृतं॒ हिर॑ण्यं प॒क्वं क्षेत्रा॑त् काम॒दुघा॑ म ए॒षा ।
इ॒दं ध॒नं नि द॑धे ब्राह्म॒णेषु॑ कृ॒ण्वे पन्थां॑ पि॒तृषु॒ यः स्व॒र्गः ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ me jyotiramṛtaṃ hiraṇyaṃ pakvaṃ kṣetrāt kāmadughā ma eṣā |
idaṃ dhanaṃ ni dadhe brāhmaṇeṣu kṛṇve panthāṃ pitṛṣu yaḥ svargaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्नौ तुषा॒ना व॑प जा॒तवे॑दसि प॒रः क॒म्बूकाँ॒ अप॑ मृड्ढि दू॒रम् ।
ए॒तं शु॑श्रुम गृहरा॒जस्य॑ भा॒गमथो॑ विद्म॒ निरृ॑तेर्भाग॒धेय॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnau tuṣānā vapa jātavedasi paraḥ kambūkām̐ apa mṛḍḍhi dūram |
etaṃ śuśruma gṛharājasya bhāgamatho vidma nirṛterbhāgadheyam ||

verses.sanskrit:
श्राम्य॑तः॒ पच॑तो विद्धि सुन्व॒तः पन्थां॑ स्व॒र्गमधि॑ रोहयैनम् ।
येन॒ रोहा॒त् पर॑मा॒पद्य॒ यद् वय॑ उत्त॒मं नाकं॑ पर॒मं व्योऽम ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrāmyataḥ pacato viddhi sunvataḥ panthāṃ svargamadhi rohayainam |
yena rohāt paramāpadya yad vaya uttamaṃ nākaṃ paramaṃ vyo'ma ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब॒भ्रेर॑ध्वर्यो॒ मुख॑मे॒तद् वि मृ॒ड्ढ्याज्या॑य लो॒कं कृ॑णुहि प्रवि॒द्वान् ।
घृ॒तेन॒ गात्रानु॒ सर्वा॒ वि मृ॑ड्ढि कृ॒ण्वे पन्थां॑ पि॒तृषु॒ यः स्व॒र्गः ॥
verses.transliteration:
babhreradhvaryo mukhametad vi mṛḍḍhyājyāya lokaṃ kṛṇuhi pravidvān |
ghṛtena gātrānu sarvā vi mṛḍḍhi kṛṇve panthāṃ pitṛṣu yaḥ svargaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
बभ्रे॒ रक्षः॑ स॒मद॒मा व॑पै॒भ्योऽब्रा॑ह्मणा यत॒मे त्वो॑प॒सीदा॑न् ।
पु॒री॒षिणः॒ प्रथ॑मानाः पु॒रस्ता॑दार्षे॒यास्ते॒ मा रि॑षन् प्राशि॒तारः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
babhre rakṣaḥ samadamā vapaibhyo'brāhmaṇā yatame tvopasīdān |
purīṣiṇaḥ prathamānāḥ purastādārṣeyāste mā riṣan prāśitāraḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒र्षे॒येषु॒ नि द॑ध ओदन त्वा॒ नाना॑र्षेयाणा॒मप्य॒स्त्यत्र॑ ।
अ॒ग्निर्मे॑ गो॒प्ता म॒रुत॑श्च॒ सर्वे॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अ॒भि र॑क्षन्तु प॒क्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ārṣeyeṣu ni dadha odana tvā nānārṣeyāṇāmapyastyatra |
agnirme goptā marutaśca sarve viśve devā abhi rakṣantu pakvam ||

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञं दुहा॑नं॒ सद॒मित् प्रपी॑नं॒ पुमां॑सं धे॒नुं सद॑नं रयी॒णाम् ।
प्र॒जा॒मृ॒त॒त्वमु॒त दी॒र्घमायू॑ रा॒यश्च॒ पोषै॒रुप॑ त्वा सदेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
yajñaṃ duhānaṃ sadamit prapīnaṃ pumāṃsaṃ dhenuṃ sadanaṃ rayīṇām |
prajāmṛtatvamuta dīrghamāyū rāyaśca poṣairupa tvā sadema ||

verses.sanskrit:
वृ॒ष॒भोऽसि स्व॒र्ग ऋषी॑नार्षे॒यान् ग॑च्छ ।
सु॒कृतां॑ लो॒के सी॑द॒ तत्र॑ नौ संस्कृ॒तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vṛṣabho'si svarga ṛṣīnārṣeyān gaccha |
sukṛtāṃ loke sīda tatra nau saṃskṛtam ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒माचि॑नुष्वानुस॒म्प्रया॑ह्यग्ने प॒थः क॑ल्पय देव॒याना॑न् ।
ए॒तैः सु॑कृ॒तैरनु॑ गच्छेम य॒ज्ञं नाके॒ तिष्ठ॑न्त॒मधि॑ स॒प्तर॑श्मौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
samācinuṣvānusamprayāhyagne pathaḥ kalpaya devayānān |
etaiḥ sukṛtairanu gacchema yajñaṃ nāke tiṣṭhantamadhi saptaraśmau ||

verses.sanskrit:
येन॑ दे॒वा ज्योति॑षा॒ द्यामु॒दाय॑न् ब्रह्मौद॒नं प॒क्त्वा सु॑कृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒कम् ।
तेन॑ गेष्म सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒कं स्वऽरा॒रोह॑न्तो अ॒भि नाक॑मुत्त॒मम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yena devā jyotiṣā dyāmudāyan brahmaudanaṃ paktvā sukṛtasya lokam |
tena geṣma sukṛtasya lokaṃ sva'rārohanto abhi nākamuttamam ||

verses.sanskrit:
भवा॑शर्वौ मृ॒डतं॒ माभि या॑तं॒ भूत॑पती॒ पशु॑पती॒ नमो॑ वाम् ।
प्रति॑हिता॒माय॑तां॒ मा वि स्रा॑ष्टं॒ मा नो॑ हिंसिष्टं द्वि॒पदो॒ मा चतु॑ष्पदः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhavāśarvau mṛḍataṃ mābhi yātaṃ bhūtapatī paśupatī namo vām |
pratihitāmāyatāṃ mā vi srāṣṭaṃ mā no hiṃsiṣṭaṃ dvipado mā catuṣpadaḥ ||
verses.translation:
Prayer and praise to Bhava, Sarva and Rudra
Bhava and Sarva, spare us, be not hostile. Homage to you, twin Lords of beasts and spirits!
Shoot not the arrow aimed and drawn against us: forbear to harm our quadrupeds and bipeds.
Cast not our bodies to the dog or jackal, nor, Lord of Beasts! to carrion-kites or vultures.
Let not thy black voracious flies attack them; let not thy birds obtain them for their banquet.
We offer homage to thy shout, Bhava! thy breath, thy racking pains:
Homage, Immortal One! to thee, to Rudra of the thousand eyes.
We offer reverence to thee from eastward, and from north and south,
From all the compass of the sky, to thee and to the firmament.
Homage, O Bhava, Lord of Beasts, unto thy face and all thine eyes,
To skin, and hue, and aspect, and to thee when looked at from behind!
We offer homage to thy limbs, thy belly, and thy tongue, and mouth we offer homage to thy smell.
Never may we contend with him, the mighty archer, thousand-eyed.
Rudra who wears black tufts of hair, the slaughterer of Ardhaka.
May he, may Bhava from all sides avoid us, avoid us even as fire avoids the waters. Let him not threaten us. To him be homage!
Four times, eight times be homage paid to Bhava, yea, Lord of Beasts, ten times be reverence paid thee!
Thine are these animals, five several classes, oxen, and goats and sheep, and men, and horses Thine the four regions, thine are earth and heaven, thine,
Mighty One, this firmament between them;
Thine everything with soul and breath here on the surface of the land.
Thine is this ample wealth-containing storehouse that holds with-in it all these living creatures.
Favour us, Lord of Beasts, to thee be homage! Far from us go ill-omens, dogs, and jackals, and wild-haired women with their horrid shrieking!
A yellow bow of gold thou wieldest, slaying its hundred, tufted God! smiting its thousand.
Weapon of Gods, far flies the shaft of Rudra: wherever it may be, we pay it homage.
Thou, Rudra, followest close the foe who lies in wait to conquer thee.
Even as a hunter who pursues the footsteps of the wounded game.
Accordant and allies, Bhava and Rudra, with mighty strength ye go to deeds of valour.
Wherever they may be, we pay them homage.
Be homage, Rudra, unto thee approaching and departing hence!
Homage to thee when standing still, to thee when seated and at rest!
Homage at evening and at morn, homage at night, homage by day .
To Bhava and to Sarva, both, have I paid lowly reverence,
Let us not outrage with our tongue far-seeing Rudra, thousand-eyed,
Inspired with varied lore, who shoots his arrows forward, far away.
Foremost we go to meet his car, the chariot of the long-haired God,
Drawn by brown horses, dusky, black, o’erthrowing, slaying, terrible. Let reverence be paid to him.
Cast not thy club at us, thy heavenly weapon. Lord of Beasts, be not wroth with us. Let reverence be paid to thee.
Shake thy celestial branch above some others elsewhere, not o’er us.
Do us no harm, but comfort us: avoid thou us, and be not wroth. Never let us contend with thee.
Covet not thou our kine or men, covet not thou our goats or sheep.
Elsewhither, strong One! turn thine aim: destroy the mockers’ family.
Homage to him whose weapon, Cough or Fever, assails one like the neighing of a stallion; to him who draws one forth and then another!
Homage be paid him with ten Sakvari verses who stands established in the air’s mid-region, slaying non-sacrificing God-despisers!
For thee were forest beasts and sylvan creatures placed in the wood, and small birds, swans, and eagles.
Floods, Lord of Beasts! contain thy living beings: to swell thy strength flow the celestial Waters.
Porpoises, serpents, strange aquatic monsters, fishes, and things unclean at which thou shootest.
Nothing is far for thee, naught checks thee, Bhava! The whole earth in a moment thou surveyest. From the east sea thou smitest in the northern.
O’erwhelm us not with Fever or with poison, nor, Rudra! with the fire that comes from heaven. Elsewhere, and not on us, cast down this lightning.
Ruler of heaven and Lord of earth is Bhava: Bhava hath filled the spacious air’s mid-region.
Where’er he be, to him be paid our homage!
King Bhava, favour him who offers worship, for thou art Pasupati, Lord of victims.
Be gracious to the quadruped and biped of the believer in the Gods’ existence.
Harm thou among us neither great nor little, not one who bears us, not our future bearers.
Injure no sire among us, harm no mother. Forbear to injure our own bodies, Rudra.
This lowly reverence have I paid to Rudra’s dogs with mighty mouths,
Hounds terrible with bark and howl, who gorge unmasticated food.
Homage to thy loud-shouting hosts and thy long-haired followers!
Homage to hosts that are adored, homage to armies that enjoy Homage to all thy troops, O God. Security and bliss be ours!

verses.sanskrit:
शुने॑ क्रो॒ष्ट्रे मा शरी॑राणि॒ कर्त॑म॒लिक्ल॑वेभ्यो॒ गृध्रे॑भ्यो॒ ये च॑ कृ॒ष्णा अ॑वि॒ष्यवः॑ ।
मक्षि॑कास्ते पशुपते॒ वयां॑सि ते विघ॒से मा वि॑दन्त ॥
verses.transliteration:
śune kroṣṭre mā śarīrāṇi kartamaliklavebhyo gṛdhrebhyo ye ca kṛṣṇā aviṣyavaḥ |
makṣikāste paśupate vayāṃsi te vighase mā vidanta ||

verses.sanskrit:
क्रन्दा॑य ते प्रा॒णाय॒ याश्च॑ ते भव॒ रोप॑यः ।
नम॑स्ते रुद्र कृण्मः सहस्रा॒क्षाया॑मर्त्य ॥
verses.transliteration:
krandāya te prāṇāya yāśca te bhava ropayaḥ |
namaste rudra kṛṇmaḥ sahasrākṣāyāmartya ||

verses.sanskrit:
पु॒रस्ता॑त् ते नमः॑ कृण्म उत्त॒राद॑ध॒रादु॒त ।
अ॒भी॒व॒र्गाद् दि॒वस्पर्य॒न्तरि॑क्षाय ते॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
purastāt te namaḥ kṛṇma uttarādadharāduta |
abhīvargād divasparyantarikṣāya te namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
मुखा॑य ते पशुपते॒ यानि॒ चक्षूं॑षि ते भव ।
त्व॒चे रू॒पाय॑ सं॒दृशे॑ प्रती॒चीना॑य ते॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
mukhāya te paśupate yāni cakṣūṃṣi te bhava |
tvace rūpāya saṃdṛśe pratīcīnāya te namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गे॑भ्यस्त उ॒दरा॑य जि॒ह्वाया॑ आ॒स्याऽय ते ।
द॒द्भ्यो ग॒न्धाय॑ ते॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
aṅgebhyasta udarāya jihvāyā āsyā'ya te |
dadbhyo gandhāya te namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अस्त्रा॒ नील॑शिखण्डेन सहस्रा॒क्षेण॑ वा॒जिना॑ ।
रु॒द्रेणा॑र्धकघा॒तिना॒ तेन॒ मा सम॑रामहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
astrā nīlaśikhaṇḍena sahasrākṣeṇa vājinā |
rudreṇārdhakaghātinā tena mā samarāmahi ||

verses.sanskrit:
स नो॑ भ॒वः परि॑ वृणक्तु वि॒श्वत॒ आप॑ इवा॒ग्निः परि॑ वृणक्तु नो भ॒वः ।
मा नो॒ऽभि मां॑स्त॒ नमो॑ अस्त्वस्मै ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa no bhavaḥ pari vṛṇaktu viśvata āpa ivāgniḥ pari vṛṇaktu no bhavaḥ |
mā no'bhi māṃsta namo astvasmai ||

verses.sanskrit:
च॒तुर्नमो॑ अष्ट॒कृत्वो॑ भ॒वाय॒ दश॒ कृत्वः॑ पशुपते॒ नम॑स्ते ।
तवे॒मे पञ्च॑ प॒शवो॒ विभ॑क्ता॒ गावो॒ अश्वाः॒ पुरु॑षा अजा॒वयः ॥
verses.transliteration:
caturnamo aṣṭakṛtvo bhavāya daśa kṛtvaḥ paśupate namaste |
taveme pañca paśavo vibhaktā gāvo aśvāḥ puruṣā ajāvayaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
तव॒ चत॑स्रः प्र॒दिश॒स्तव॒ द्यौस्तव॑ पृथि॒वी तवे॒दमु॑ग्रो॒र्व॑१न्तरि॑क्षम् ।
तवे॒दं सर्व॑मात्म॒न्वद् यत् प्रा॒णत् पृ॑थि॒वीमनु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tava catasraḥ pradiśastava dyaustava pṛthivī tavedamugrorvantarikṣam |
tavedaṃ sarvamātmanvad yat prāṇat pṛthivīmanu ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒रुः कोशो॑ वसु॒धान॒स्तवा॒यं यस्मि॑न्नि॒मा विश्वा॒ भुव॑नान्य॒न्तः ।
स नो॑ मृड पशुपते॒ नम॑स्ते प॒रः क्रो॒ष्टारो॑ अभि॒भाः श्वानः॑ प॒रो य॑न्त्वघ॒रुदो॑ विके॒श्यःऽ ॥
verses.transliteration:
uruḥ kośo vasudhānastavāyaṃ yasminnimā viśvā bhuvanānyantaḥ |
sa no mṛḍa paśupate namaste paraḥ kroṣṭāro abhibhāḥ śvānaḥ paro yantvagharudo vikeśyaḥ' ||

verses.sanskrit:
धनु॑र्बिभर्षि॒ हरि॑तं हिर॒ण्ययं॑ सहस्र॒घ्नि श॒तव॑धं शिखण्डिनम् ।
रु॒द्रस्येषु॑श्चरति देवहे॒तिस्तस्यै॒ नमो॑ यत॒मस्यां॑ दि॒शी॒३तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhanurbibharṣi haritaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ sahasraghni śatavadhaṃ śikhaṇḍinam |
rudrasyeṣuścarati devahetistasyai namo yatamasyāṃ diśītaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो॒३भिया॑तो नि॒लय॑ते॒ त्वां रु॑द्र नि॒चिकी॑र्षति ।
प॒श्चाद॑नु॒प्रयु॑ङ्क्षे॒ तं वि॒द्धस्य॑ पद॒नीरि॑व ॥
verses.transliteration:
yobhiyāto nilayate tvāṃ rudra nicikīrṣati |
paścādanuprayuṅkṣe taṃ viddhasya padanīriva ||

verses.sanskrit:
भ॒वा॒रु॒द्रौ स॒युजा॑ संविदा॒नावु॒भावु॒ग्रौ च॑रतो वी॒र्याऽय ।
तभ्यां॒ नमो॑ यत॒मस्यां॑ दिशी३तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhavārudrau sayujā saṃvidānāvubhāvugrau carato vīryā'ya |
tabhyāṃ namo yatamasyāṃ diśītaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
नम॑स्ते ऽस्त्वाय॒ते नमो॑ अस्तु पराय॒ते ।
नम॑स्ते रुद्र॒ तिष्ठ॑त॒ आसी॑नायो॒त ते॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
namaste 'stvāyate namo astu parāyate |
namaste rudra tiṣṭhata āsīnāyota te namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
नमः॑ सा॒यं नमः॑ प्रा॒तर्नमो॒ रात्र्या॒ नमो॒ दिवा॑ ।
भ॒वाय॑ च श॒र्वाय॑ चो॒भाभ्या॑मकरं॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
namaḥ sāyaṃ namaḥ prātarnamo rātryā namo divā |
bhavāya ca śarvāya cobhābhyāmakaraṃ namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒ह॒स्रा॒क्षम॑तिप॒श्यं पु॒रस्ता॑द् रु॒द्रमस्य॑न्तं बहु॒धा वि॑प॒श्चित॑म् ।
मोपा॑राम जि॒ह्वयेय॑मानम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sahasrākṣamatipaśyaṃ purastād rudramasyantaṃ bahudhā vipaścitam |
mopārāma jihvayeyamānam ||

verses.sanskrit:
श्या॒वाश्वं॑ कृ॒ष्णमसि॑तं मृ॒णन्तं॑ भी॒मं रथं॑ के॒शिनः॑ पा॒दय॑न्तम् ।
पूर्वे॒ प्रती॑मो॒ नमो॑ अस्त्वस्मै ॥
verses.transliteration:
śyāvāśvaṃ kṛṣṇamasitaṃ mṛṇantaṃ bhīmaṃ rathaṃ keśinaḥ pādayantam |
pūrve pratīmo namo astvasmai ||

verses.sanskrit:
मा नो॒ऽभि स्रा॑ म॒त्यं देवहे॒तिं मा नः॑ क्रुधः पशुपते॒ नम॑स्ते ।
अ॒न्यत्रा॒स्मद् दि॒व्यां शाखां॒ वि धू॑नु ॥
verses.transliteration:
mā no'bhi srā matyaṃ devahetiṃ mā naḥ krudhaḥ paśupate namaste |
anyatrāsmad divyāṃ śākhāṃ vi dhūnu ||

verses.sanskrit:
मा नो॑ हिंसी॒रधि॑ नो ब्रूहि॒ परि॑ णो वृङ्ग्धि॒ मा क्रु॑धः ।
मा त्वया॒ सम॑रामहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
mā no hiṃsīradhi no brūhi pari ṇo vṛṅgdhi mā krudhaḥ |
mā tvayā samarāmahi ||

verses.sanskrit:
मा नो॒ गोषु॒ पुरु॑षेषु॒ मा गृ॑धो नो अजा॒विषु॑ ।
अ॒न्यत्रो॑ग्र॒ वि व॑र्तय॒ पिया॑रूणां प्र॒जां ज॑हि ॥
verses.transliteration:
mā no goṣu puruṣeṣu mā gṛdho no ajāviṣu |
anyatrogra vi vartaya piyārūṇāṃ prajāṃ jahi ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य॑ त॒क्मा कासि॑का हे॒तिरेक॒मश्व॑स्येव॒ वृष॑णः॒ क्रन्द॒ एति॑ ।
अ॒भि॒पू॒र्वं नि॒र्णय॑ते॒ नमो॑ अस्त्वस्मै ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasya takmā kāsikā hetirekamaśvasyeva vṛṣaṇaḥ kranda eti |
abhipūrvaṃ nirṇayate namo astvasmai ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो॒३न्तरि॑क्षे॒ तिष्ठ॑ति॒ विष्ट॑भि॒तोऽय॑ज्वनः प्रमृ॒णन् दे॑वपी॒यून् ।
तस्मै॒ नमो॑ द॒शभिः॒ शक्व॑रीभिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yontarikṣe tiṣṭhati viṣṭabhito'yajvanaḥ pramṛṇan devapīyūn |
tasmai namo daśabhiḥ śakvarībhiḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
तुभ्य॑मार॒ण्याः प॒शवो॑ मृ॒गा वने॑ हि॒ता हं॒साः सु॑प॒र्णाः श॑कु॒ना वयां॑सि ।
तव॑ य॒क्षं प॑शुपते अ॒प्स्व॑१न्तस्तुभ्यं॑ क्षरन्ति दि॒व्या आपो॑ वृ॒धे ॥
verses.transliteration:
tubhyamāraṇyāḥ paśavo mṛgā vane hitā haṃsāḥ suparṇāḥ śakunā vayāṃsi |
tava yakṣaṃ paśupate apsvantastubhyaṃ kṣaranti divyā āpo vṛdhe ||

verses.sanskrit:
शि॒शु॒मारा॑ अजग॒राः पु॑री॒कया॑ ज॒षा मत्स्या॑ रज॒सा येभ्यो॒ अस्य॑सि ।
न ते॑ दू॒रं न प॑रि॒ष्ठास्ति॑ ते भव स॒द्यः सर्वा॒न् परि॑
पश्यसि॒ भूमिं॒ पूर्व॑स्माद्धं॒स्युत्त॑रस्मिन्समु॒द्रे ॥
verses.transliteration:
śiśumārā ajagarāḥ purīkayā jaṣā matsyā rajasā yebhyo asyasi |
na te dūraṃ na pariṣṭhāsti te bhava sadyaḥ sarvān pari
paśyasi bhūmiṃ pūrvasmāddhaṃsyuttarasminsamudre ||

verses.sanskrit:
मा नो॑ रुद्र त॒क्मना॒ मा वि॒षेण॒ मा नः॒ सं स्रा॑ दि॒व्येना॒ग्निना॑ ।
अ॒न्यत्रा॒स्मद् वि॒द्युतं॑ पातयै॒ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
mā no rudra takmanā mā viṣeṇa mā naḥ saṃ srā divyenāgninā |
anyatrāsmad vidyutaṃ pātayaitām ||

verses.sanskrit:
भ॒वो दि॒वो भ॒व ई॑शे पृथि॒व्या भ॒व आ प॑प्र उ॒र्व॑न्तरि॑क्षम् ।
तस्मै॒ नमो॑ यत॒मस्यां॑ दि॒शी॒३तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhavo divo bhava īśe pṛthivyā bhava ā papra urvantarikṣam |
tasmai namo yatamasyāṃ diśītaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
भव॑ राज॒न् यज॑मानाय मृड पशू॒नां हि प॑शु॒पति॑र्ब॒भूथ॑ ।
यः श्र॒द्दधा॑ति॒ सन्ति॑ दे॒वा इति॒ चतु॑ष्पदे द्वि॒पदे॑ऽस्य मृड ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhava rājan yajamānāya mṛḍa paśūnāṃ hi paśupatirbabhūtha |
yaḥ śraddadhāti santi devā iti catuṣpade dvipade'sya mṛḍa ||

verses.sanskrit:
मा नो॑ म॒हान्त॑मु॒त मा नो॑ अर्भ॒कं मा नो॒ वह॑न्तमु॒त मा नो॑ वक्ष्य॒तः ।
मा नो॑ हिंसीः पि॒तरं॑ मा॒तरं॑ च॒ स्वां त॒न्वंऽ रुद्र॒ मा री॑रिषो नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
mā no mahāntamuta mā no arbhakaṃ mā no vahantamuta mā no vakṣyataḥ |
mā no hiṃsīḥ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca svāṃ tanvaṃ' rudra mā rīriṣo naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
रु॒द्रस्यै॑लबका॒रेभ्यो॑ऽसंसूक्तगि॒लेभ्यः॑ ।
इ॒दं म॒हास्ये॑भ्यः॒ श्वभ्यो॑ अकरं॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
rudrasyailabakārebhyo'saṃsūktagilebhyaḥ |
idaṃ mahāsyebhyaḥ śvabhyo akaraṃ namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
नम॑स्ते घो॒षिणी॑भ्यो॒ नम॑स्ते के॒शिनी॑भ्यः ।
नमो॒ नम॑स्कृताभ्यो॒ नमः॑ संभुञ्ज॒तीभ्यः॑ ।
नम॑स्ते देव॒ सेना॑भ्यः स्व॒स्ति नो॒ अभ॑यं च नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
namaste ghoṣiṇībhyo namaste keśinībhyaḥ |
namo namaskṛtābhyo namaḥ saṃbhuñjatībhyaḥ |
namaste deva senābhyaḥ svasti no abhayaṃ ca naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: तस्यौ॑द॒नस्य॒ बृहस्पतिः॒ शिरो॒ ब्रह्म॒ मुख॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: tasyaudanasya bṛhaspatiḥ śiro brahma mukham ||
verses.translation:
A glorification of the Odana or oblation of boiled rice
1.Of that Odana Brihaspati is the head, Brahma the mouth.
2. Heaven and Earth are the ears, the Sun and Moon are the eyes, the seven Rishis are the vital airs inhaled and exhaled.
3. Vision is the pestle, Desire the mortar. 4. Diti is the winnowing basket, Aditi is she who holds it, Vāta is the sifter.
5. Horses are the grains, oxen the winnowed ricegrains, gnats the husks. 6. Kabru is the husked grain, the rain cloud is the reed. 7. Grey iron is its flesh, copper its blood. 8. Tin is its ashes, gold its colour, the blue lotus flower its scent. 9. The threshing-floor is its dish, the wooden swords its shoulders, the car-shafts its backbones. 10. Collar-bones are its entrails, straps its intestines. 11. This earth, verily becomes the jar, and heaven the cover of the Odana as it is cooking.
12. Furrows are its ribs, sandy soils the undigested contents of its stomach. 13. Law is its water for the hands and family custom its aspersion. 14. The jar covered with the Rich has been solemnly directed by the priestly office. 15. Received by the Brāhman, it has been carried round. 16. The Brihat is, the stirring-spoon, the Rathantara the ladle. 17. The Seasons are the dressers, the Groups of Seasons kindle the fire.
18. The caldron flames round the oblation (charu) whose mouth consists of five openings.
19. The sacrificial word, all worlds are to be won with Odana.
20. Whereon in order rest the three, the ocean, and the heaven, and earth.
21. Within the residue whereof the Gods arranged six eightieth parts—
22. I ask thee, of this Odana what is the mighty magnitude.
23. He who may know the magnitude of the Odana. 24. Would say,
Not small, nor devoid of moistening sauce; not this, nor any-thing whatever. 25. He would not declare it to be greater than the giver imagines it to be. 26. The theologians say, Thou hast eaten the averted Odana and the Odana turned hither-ward. 27. Thou hast eaten the Odana and the Odana will eat thee. 28. Thou hast eaten this averted; thy inward breath will leave thee; so he said to this one. 29. Thou hast eaten this turned hitherward; thy downward breath will leave thee; so he said to this one. 30. I indeed have not eaten the Odana, nor has the Odana eaten me. 31. The Odana has just eaten the Odana.
2 32. And thence he said to this one, Thou hast eaten this with a different head from that with which the ancient Rishis ate: thy offspring, reckoning from the eldest, will die. I have eaten it neither turned downward, nor turned away, nor turned hitherward. With Brihaspati as head: with him I have eaten, with him have I come to it. Now this Odana is complete with all members, joints, and body. Complete, verily, with all his members, joints, and body is he who possess this knowledge.
33. And thence he said to him, Thou hast eaten this with other ears than those with which the ancient Rishis ate it.
Thou wilt be deaf. I have eaten it neither, etc. (as in verse 32).
With Heaven and Earth as ears, with these I have eaten it, with these I have come to it. Now this Odana, etc. (as in 32).
34. And thence he said to him. Thou hast eaten this with other eyes . . . thou wilt be blind.
With Sun and Moon, etc.
35. And thence, etc. . . with other month. Thy offspring will die, reckoning from the head . . .
With Brahma as mouth.
36. And thence, etc. . . . with other tongue . . . Thy tongue will die . . . With the tongue of Agni. 37. And thence, etc. . .
With other teeth . . . Thy teeth will fall out . . . With the Seasons as teeth. 38. And thence, etc. . . . with other vital airs. . . . Thy vital airs will leave thee . . . With the Seven Rishis as the vital airs. 39. And thence, etc. . . . with other expanse . . . Consumption will destroy thee . . . With the firmament as expanse. 40 And thence, etc. . . . with other back. . . .
Lightning will slay thee. . . With the heaven as back. 41. And thence, etc. . . . with other breast . . . Thou wilt fail in agriculture. . . . With the earth as breast. 42. And thence, etc. . . . with other belly . . . colic will destroy thee . . .
With truth as belly. 43. And thence, etc. . . . with other abdomen . . . Thou wilt die in the water . . . With the sea as abdomen. 44. And thence, etc. . . . with other thighs . . .
Thy thigh will perish . . . With Mitra-Varuna as thighs.
45. And thence, etc. . . . with other knees . . . Thou wilt become a sick man . . . With the knees of Tvashtar. 46. And thence, etc. . . . with other feet . . . Thou wilt become a wanderer . . . With the feet of the Asvins. 47. And thence, etc. . . with other fore-parts of the feet . . . A serpent will kill thee . . . With the fore-parts of Savitar’s feet. 48. And thence, etc. . . . with other hands . . . The Brāhmana (divine power) will kill thee . . . With the hands of Right. 49.
And thence, etc. . . . with other basis . . . Without standing-ground and resting-place thou wilt die . . . Having taken my stand on truth. With this I ate it, with this I came to it. Now this Odana is complete with all members, joints, and body.
Complete, verily, with all his members, joints, and body is he who possesses this knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी श्रोत्रे॑ सूर्याचन्द्र॒मसा॒वक्षि॑णी सप्तऋ॒षयः॑ प्राणापा॒नाः ॥
verses.transliteration: dyāvāpṛthivī śrotre sūryācandramasāvakṣiṇī saptaṛṣayaḥ prāṇāpānāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: चक्षु॒र्मुस॑लं॒ काम॑ उ॒लूख॑लम् ॥
verses.transliteration: cakṣurmusalaṃ kāma ulūkhalam ||

verses.sanskrit: दितिः॒ शूर्प॒मदि॑तिः शूर्पग्रा॒ही वातोऽपा॑विनक् ॥
verses.transliteration: ditiḥ śūrpamaditiḥ śūrpagrāhī vāto'pāvinak ||

verses.sanskrit: अश्वाः॒ कणा॒ गाव॑स्तण्डु॒ला म॒शका॒स्तुषाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: aśvāḥ kaṇā gāvastaṇḍulā maśakāstuṣāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: कब्रु॑ फली॒कर॑णाः॒ शरो॒ऽभ्रम् ॥
verses.transliteration: kabru phalīkaraṇāḥ śaro'bhram ||

verses.sanskrit: श्या॒ममयो॑ऽस्य मां॒सानि॒ लोहि॑तमस्य॒ लोहि॑तम् ॥
verses.transliteration: śyāmamayo'sya māṃsāni lohitamasya lohitam ||

verses.sanskrit: त्रपु॒ भस्म॒ हरि॑तं॒ वर्णः॒ पुष्क॑रमस्य ग॒न्धः ॥
verses.transliteration: trapu bhasma haritaṃ varṇaḥ puṣkaramasya gandhaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: खलः॒ पात्रं॒ स्फ्यावंसा॑वी॒षे अ॑नू॒क्येऽ ॥
verses.transliteration: khalaḥ pātraṃ sphyāvaṃsāvīṣe anūkye' ||

verses.sanskrit: आ॒न्त्राणि॑ ज॒त्रवो॒ गुदा॑ वर॒त्राः ॥
verses.transliteration: āntrāṇi jatravo gudā varatrāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: इ॒यमे॒व पृ॑थि॒वी कु॒म्भी भ॑वति॒ राध्य॑मानस्यौद॒नस्य॒ द्यौर॑पि॒धान॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: iyameva pṛthivī kumbhī bhavati rādhyamānasyaudanasya dyaurapidhānam ||

verses.sanskrit: सीताः॒ पर्श॑वः॒ सिक॑ता॒ ऊब॑ध्यम् ॥
verses.transliteration: sītāḥ parśavaḥ sikatā ūbadhyam ||

verses.sanskrit: ऋ॒तं ह॑स्ताव॒नेज॑नं कु॒ल्योऽप॒सेच॑नम् ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtaṃ hastāvanejanaṃ kulyo'pasecanam ||

verses.sanskrit: ऋ॒चा कु॒म्भ्यधि॑हि॒तार्त्विज्येन॒ प्रेषि॑ता ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛcā kumbhyadhihitārtvijyena preṣitā ||

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्म॑णा॒ परि॑गृहीता॒ साम्ना॒ पर्यू॑ढा ॥
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇā parigṛhītā sāmnā paryūḍhā ||

verses.sanskrit: बृ॒हदा॒यव॑नं रथन्त॒रं दर्विः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛhadāyavanaṃ rathantaraṃ darviḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: ऋ॒तवः॑ प॒क्तार॑ आर्त॒वाः समि॑न्धते ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtavaḥ paktāra ārtavāḥ samindhate ||

verses.sanskrit: च॒रुं पञ्च॑बिलमु॒खं घ॒र्मो॒३भी॑न्धे ॥
verses.transliteration: caruṃ pañcabilamukhaṃ gharmobhīndhe ||

verses.sanskrit: ओ॒द॒नेन॑ यज्ञव॒चः सर्वे॑ लो॒काः स॑मा॒प्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: odanena yajñavacaḥ sarve lokāḥ samāpyāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: यस्मि॑न्त्समु॒द्रो द्यौर्भूमि॒स्त्रयो॑ऽवरप॒रं श्रि॒ताः ॥
verses.transliteration: yasmintsamudro dyaurbhūmistrayo'varaparaṃ śritāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: यस्य॑ दे॒वा अक॑ल्प॒न्तोच्छि॑ष्टे॒ षड॑शी॒तयः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yasya devā akalpantocchiṣṭe ṣaḍaśītayaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वौ॑द॒नस्य॑ पृच्छामि॒ यो अ॑स्य महि॒मा म॒हान् ॥
verses.transliteration: taṃ tvaudanasya pṛcchāmi yo asya mahimā mahān ||

verses.sanskrit: स य ओ॑द॒नस्य॑ महि॒मानं॑ वि॒द्यात् ॥
verses.transliteration: sa ya odanasya mahimānaṃ vidyāt ||

verses.sanskrit: नाल्प॒ इति॑ ब्रूया॒न्नानु॑पसेच॒न इति॒ नेदं च॒ किं चेति॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: nālpa iti brūyānnānupasecana iti nedaṃ ca kiṃ ceti ||

verses.sanskrit: याव॑द् दा॒ताभि॑मन॒स्येत॒ तन्नाति॑ वदेत् ॥
verses.transliteration: yāvad dātābhimanasyeta tannāti vadet ||

verses.sanskrit: ब्र॒ह्म॒वा॒दिनो॑ वदन्ति॒ परा॑ञ्चमोद॒नं प्राशीः३ प्र॒त्यञ्चा३मिति॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: brahmavādino vadanti parāñcamodanaṃ prāśīḥ pratyañcāmiti ||

verses.sanskrit: त्वमो॑द॒नं प्राशी३स्त्वामो॑द॒ना३ इति॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: tvamodanaṃ prāśīstvāmodanā iti ||

verses.sanskrit: परा॑ञ्चं चैनं॒ प्राशीः॑ प्रा॒णास्त्वा॑ हास्य॒न्तीत्ये॑नमाह ॥
verses.transliteration: parāñcaṃ cainaṃ prāśīḥ prāṇāstvā hāsyantītyenamāha ||

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒त्यञ्चं॑ चैनं॒ प्राशी॑रपा॒नास्त्वा॑ हास्य॒न्तीत्ये॑नमाह ॥
verses.transliteration: pratyañcaṃ cainaṃ prāśīrapānāstvā hāsyantītyenamāha ||

verses.sanskrit: नैवाहमो॑द॒नं न मामो॑द॒नः ॥
verses.transliteration: naivāhamodanaṃ na māmodanaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: ओ॒द॒न ए॒वौद॒नं प्राशी॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration: odana evaudanaṃ prāśīt ||

verses.sanskrit:
तत॑श्चैनम॒न्येन॑ शी॒र्ष्णा प्राशी॒र्येन॑ चै॒तं पूर्व॒ ऋष॑यः॒ प्राश्न॑न्
ज्ये॒ष्ठ॒तस्ते॑ प्र॒जा म॑रिष्य॒तीत्ये॑नमाह
तं वा अ॒हं नार्वाञ्चं॑ न परा॑ञ्चं॒ न प्र॒त्यञ्च॑म्
बृह॒स्पति॑ना शी॒र्ष्णा
तेनै॑नं॒ प्राशि॑षं॒ तेनै॑नमजीगमम्
ए॒ष वा ओ॑द॒नः सर्वा॑ङ्गः॒ सर्व॑परुः॒ सर्व॑तनूः
सर्वा॑ङ्ग ए॒व सर्व॑परुः॒ सर्व॑तनूः॒ सं भ॑वति॒ य ए॒वं वेद॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tataścainamanyena śīrṣṇā prāśīryena caitaṃ pūrva ṛṣayaḥ prāśnan
jyeṣṭhataste prajā mariṣyatītyenamāha
taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam
bṛhaspatinā śīrṣṇā
tenainaṃ prāśiṣaṃ tenainamajīgamam
eṣa vā odanaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ
sarvāṅga eva sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ saṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||

verses.sanskrit:
तत॑श्चैनम॒न्याभ्यां॒ श्रोत्रा॑भ्यां॒ प्राशी॒र्याभ्यां॑ चै॒तं पूर्व॒ ऋष॑यः॒ प्राश्न॑न्
ब॒धि॒रो भ॑विष्य॒सीत्ये॑नमाह
तं वा अ॒हं नार्वाञ्चं॒ न परा॑ञ्चं॒ न प्र॒त्यञ्च॑म्
द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्यां॒ श्रोत्रा॑भ्याम्
ताभ्या॑मेनं॒ प्राशि॑षं॒ ताभ्या॑मेनमजीगमम्
ए॒ष वा ओ॑द॒नः सर्वा॑ङ्गः॒ सर्व॑परुः॒ सर्व॑तनूः
सर्वा॑ङ्ग ए॒व सर्व॑परुः॒ सर्व॑तनूः॒ सं भ॑वति॒ य ए॒वं वेद॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tataścainamanyābhyāṃ śrotrābhyāṃ prāśīryābhyāṃ caitaṃ pūrva ṛṣayaḥ prāśnan
badhiro bhaviṣyasītyenamāha
taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam
dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ śrotrābhyām
tābhyāmenaṃ prāśiṣaṃ tābhyāmenamajīgamam
eṣa vā odanaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ
sarvāṅga eva sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ saṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||

verses.sanskrit:
तत॑श्चैनम॒न्याभ्या॑म॒क्षीभ्यां॒ प्राशी॒र्याभ्यां॑ चै॒तं पूर्व॒ ऋष॑यः॒ प्राश्न॑न्
अ॒न्धो भ॑वि॒ष्य॒सीत्ये॑नमाह
तं वा अ॒हं नार्वाञ्चं॒ न परा॑ञ्चं॒ न प्र॒त्यञ्च॑म्
सू॒र्या॒च॒न्द्र॒म॒साभ्या॑म॒क्षीभ्या॑म्
ताभ्या॑मेनं॒ प्राशि॑षं॒ ताभ्या॑मेनमजीगमम्
ए॒ष वा ओ॑द॒नः सर्वा॑ङ्गः॒ सर्वपरुः॒ सर्व॑तनूः
सर्वा॑ङ्ग ए॒व सर्व॑परुः॒ सर्व॑तनूः॒ सं भ॑वति॒ य ए॒वं वेद॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tataścainamanyābhyāmakṣībhyāṃ prāśīryābhyāṃ caitaṃ pūrva ṛṣayaḥ prāśnan
andho bhaviṣyasītyenamāha
taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam
sūryācandramasābhyāmakṣībhyām
tābhyāmenaṃ prāśiṣaṃ tābhyāmenamajīgamam
eṣa vā odanaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ
sarvāṅga eva sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ saṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||

verses.sanskrit:
तत॑श्चैनम॒न्येन॒ मुखे॑न॒ प्राशी॒र्येन॑ चै॒तं पूर्व॒ ऋष॑यः॒ प्राश्न॑न्
मु॒ख॒तस्ते॑ प्र॒जा म॑रिष्य॒तीत्ये॑नमाह
तं वा अ॒हं नार्वाञ्चं॒ न परा॑ञ्चं॒ न प्र॒त्यञ्च॑म्
ब्रह्म॑णा॒ मुखे॑न
तेनै॑नं॒ प्राशि॑षं॒ तेनै॑नमजीगमम्
ए॒ष वा ओ॑द॒नः सर्वा॑ङ्गः॒ सर्व॑परुः॒ सर्व॑तनूः

sarvāṅga eva sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ saṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||

verses.sanskrit:
तत॑श्चैनम॒न्याभ्यां॒ हस्ता॑भ्यां॒ प्राशी॒र्याभ्यां॑ चै॒तं पूर्व॒ ऋष॑यः॒ प्राश्न॑न्
ब्रा॒ह्म॒णं ह॑निष्य॒सीत्ये॑नमाह
तं वा अ॒हं नार्वाञ्चं॒ न परा॑ञ्चं॒ न प्र॒त्यञ्च॑म्
ऋ॒तस्य॒ हस्ता॑भ्याम्
ताभ्या॑मेनं॒ प्राशि॑षं॒ ताभ्या॑मेनमजीगमम्
ए॒ष वा ओ॑द॒नः सर्वा॑ङ्गः॒ सर्व॑परुः॒ सर्व॑तनूः
सर्वा॑ङ्ग ए॒व सर्व॑परुः॒ सर्व॑तनूः॒ सं भ॑वति॒ य ए॒वं वेद॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tataścainamanyābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ prāśīryābhyāṃ caitaṃ pūrva ṛṣayaḥ prāśnan
brāhmaṇaṃ haniṣyasītyenamāha
taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam
ṛtasya hastābhyām
tābhyāmenaṃ prāśiṣaṃ tābhyāmenamajīgamam
eṣa vā odanaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ
sarvāṅga eva sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ saṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||

verses.sanskrit:
तत॑श्चैनम॒न्यया॑ प्रति॒ष्ठया॒ प्राशी॒र्यया॑ चै॒तं पूर्व॒ ऋष॑यः॒ प्राश्न॑न्
अ॒प्र॒ति॒ष्ठा॒नोऽनायत॒नो म॑रिष्य॒सीत्ये॑नमाह
तं वा अ॒हं नार्वाञ्चं॒ न परा॑ञ्चं॒ न प्र॒त्यञ्च॑म्
स॒त्ये प्र॑ति॒ष्ठाय॑
तयै॑नं॒ प्राशि॑षं॒ तयै॑नमजीगमम्
ए॒ष वा ओ॑द॒नः सर्वा॑ङ्गः॒ सर्व॑परुः॒ सर्व॑तनूः
सर्वा॑ङ्ग ए॒व सर्व॑परुः॒ सर्व॑तनूः॒ सं भ॑वति॒ य ए॒वं वेद॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tataścainamanyayā pratiṣṭhayā prāśīryayā caitaṃ pūrva ṛṣayaḥ prāśnan
apratiṣṭhāno'nāyatano mariṣyasītyenamāha
taṃ vā ahaṃ nārvāñcaṃ na parāñcaṃ na pratyañcam
satye pratiṣṭhāya
tayainaṃ prāśiṣaṃ tayainamajīgamam
eṣa vā odanaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ
sarvāṅga eva sarvaparuḥ sarvatanūḥ saṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||

verses.sanskrit: ए॒तद् वै ब्र॒ध्नस्य॑ वि॒ष्टपं॒ यदो॑द॒नः ॥
verses.transliteration: etad vai bradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ yadodanaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: ब्र॒ध्नलो॑को भवति ब्र॒ध्नस्य॑ वि॒ष्टपि॑ श्रयते॒ य ए॒वं वेद॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: bradhnaloko bhavati bradhnasya viṣṭapi śrayate ya evaṃ veda ||

verses.sanskrit: ए॒तस्मा॒द् वा ओ॑द॒नात् त्रय॑स्त्रिंशतं लो॒कान् निर॑मिमीत प्र॒जाप॑तिः ॥
verses.transliteration: etasmād vā odanāt trayastriṃśataṃ lokān niramimīta prajāpatiḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: तेषां॑ प्र॒ज्ञाना॑य य॒ज्ञम॑सृजत ॥
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ prajñānāya yajñamasṛjata ||

verses.sanskrit: स य ए॒वं वि॒दुष॑ उपद्र॒ष्टा भ॑वति प्रा॒णं रु॑णद्धि ॥
verses.transliteration: sa ya evaṃ viduṣa upadraṣṭā bhavati prāṇaṃ ruṇaddhi ||

verses.sanskrit: न च॑ प्रा॒णं रु॒णद्धि॑ सर्वज्या॒निं जी॑यते ॥
verses.transliteration: na ca prāṇaṃ ruṇaddhi sarvajyāniṃ jīyate ||

verses.sanskrit: न च॑ सर्वज्या॒निं जी॒यते॑ पु॒रैनं॑ ज॒रसः॑ प्रा॒णो ज॑हाति ॥
verses.transliteration: na ca sarvajyāniṃ jīyate purainaṃ jarasaḥ prāṇo jahāti ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒णाय॒ नमो॒ यस्य॒ सर्व॑मि॒दं वशे॑ ।
यो भू॒तः सर्व॑स्येश्व॒रो यस्मि॒न्त्सर्वं॒ प्रति॑ष्ठितम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prāṇāya namo yasya sarvamidaṃ vaśe |
yo bhūtaḥ sarvasyeśvaro yasmintsarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||
verses.translation:
A glorification of Prāna, Breath or Vital Spirit
Homage to Prāna, him who hath dominion o’er the universe,
Who hath become the Sovran Lord of all, on whom the whole depends!
Homage, O Prāna, to thy roar, to thunder-peal and lightning flash!
Homage, O Prāna, unto thee what time thou sendest down thy rain!
When Prāna with a thunderous voice shouts his loud message to the plants,
They straightway are impregnate, they conceive, and bear abundantly.
When the due season hath arrived and Prāna shouteth to herbs,
Then all is joyful, yea, each thing upon the surface of the earth.
When Prāna hath poured down his flood of rain upon the mighty land.
Cattle and beasts rejoice thereat: Now great will he our strength, they cry.
Watered by Prāna’s rain the plants have raised their voices in accord:
Thou hast prolonged our life, they say, and given fragrance to us all.
Homage to thee when coming nigh, homage to thee departing hence!
Homage, O Prāna, be to thee when standing and when sitting still.
Homage to thee at every breath thou drawest in and sendest forth!
Homage to thee when turned away, homage to thee seen face to face! This reverence be to all of thee!
Prāna, communicate to us thy dear, thy very dearest form.
Whatever healing balm thou hast, give us thereof that we may live.
Prāna robes living creatures as a father his beloved son. Prāna is sovran Lord of all, of all that breathes not, all that breathes Prāna is Fever, he is Death. Prāna is worshipped by the Gods.
Prāna sets in the loftiest sphere the man who speaks the words of truth.
Prāna is Deshtri, and Virāj Prāna is reverenced by all. He is the Sun, he is the Moon. Prāna is called Prajāpati.
Both breaths are rice and barley, and Prāna is called the toiling ox:
In barley is the inbreath laid, and rice is named the outward breath.
The human infant in the womb draws vital breath and sends it Lout:
When thou, O Prāna, quickenest the babe it springs anew to life.
The name of Prāna is bestowed on Mātarisvan and on Wind.
On Prāna, past and future, yea, on Prāna everything depends.
All herbs and plants spring forth and grow when thou, O Prāna quickenest,
Plants of Atharvan, Angiras, plants of the deities and men.
When Prāna hath poured down his flood of rain upon the mighty earth,
The plants are wakened into life, and every herd that grows on ground.
The man who knows this truth of thee, O Prāna, and what bears thee up To him will all present their gift of tribute in that loftiest will all present their gift of tribute in that loftiest world.
As all these living creatures are thy tributaries, Prāna, so Shall they bring tribute unto him who hears thee with attentive ears.
Filled with a babe, mid deities he wanders: grown; near at hand, he springs again to being.
That Father, grown the present and the future, hath past into the son with mighty powers.
Hansa, what time he rises up, leaves in the flood one foot un-moved.
If he withdrew it there would be no more tomorrow or to-day,
Never would there be night, no more would daylight shine or morning flush.
It rolleth on, eight-wheeled and single-fellied, and with a thousand eyes, forward and backward.
With one half it engendered all creation. What sign is there to tell us of the other?
Homage, O Prāna unto thee armed with swift bow among the rest,
In whose dominion is this All of varied sort that stirs and works!
May he who rules this Universe of varied sort, that stirs and works,
Prāna, alert and resolute, assist me through the prayer I pray.
Erect among the sleepers he wakes, and is never laid at length,
No one hath ever heard that he hath been asleep while others slept.
Thou, Prāna, never shalt be hid, never shalt be estranged from me.
I bind thee on myself for life, O Prāna, like the Waters’ germ.

verses.sanskrit:
नम॑स्ते प्राण॒ क्रन्दा॑य॒ नम॑स्ते स्तनयि॒त्नवे॑ ।
नम॑स्ते प्राण वि॒द्युते॒ नम॑स्ते प्राण॒ वर्ष॑ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
namaste prāṇa krandāya namaste stanayitnave |
namaste prāṇa vidyute namaste prāṇa varṣate ||

verses.sanskrit:
यत् प्रा॒ण स्त॑नयि॒त्नुना॑भि॒क्रन्द॒त्योष॑धीः ।
प्र वी॑यन्ते॒ गर्भा॑न् दध॒तेऽथो॑ ब॒ह्वीर्वि जा॑यन्ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
yat prāṇa stanayitnunābhikrandatyoṣadhīḥ |
pra vīyante garbhān dadhate'tho bahvīrvi jāyante ||

verses.sanskrit:
यत् प्रा॒ण ऋ॒तावाग॑तेऽभि॒क्रन्द॒त्योष॑धीः ।
सर्वं॑ त॒दा प्र मो॑दते॒ यत् किं च॒ भूम्या॒मधि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yat prāṇa ṛtāvāgate'bhikrandatyoṣadhīḥ |
sarvaṃ tadā pra modate yat kiṃ ca bhūmyāmadhi ||

verses.sanskrit:
य॒दा प्रा॒णो अ॒भ्यव॑र्षीद् व॒र्षेण॑ पृथि॒वीं म॒हीम् ।
प॒शव॒स्तत् प्र मो॑दन्ते॒ महो॒ वै नो॑ भविष्यति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadā prāṇo abhyavarṣīd varṣeṇa pṛthivīṃ mahīm |
paśavastat pra modante maho vai no bhaviṣyati ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भिवृ॑ष्टा॒ ओष॑धयः प्रा॒णेन॒ सम॑वादिरन् ।
आयु॒र्वै नः॒ प्राती॑तरः॒ सर्वा॑ नः सुर॒भीर॑कः ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhivṛṣṭā oṣadhayaḥ prāṇena samavādiran |
āyurvai naḥ prātītaraḥ sarvā naḥ surabhīrakaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
नम॑स्ते अस्त्वाय॒ते नमो॑ अस्तु पराय॒ते ।
नम॑स्ते प्राण॒ तिष्ठ॑त॒ आसी॑नायो॒त ते॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
namaste astvāyate namo astu parāyate |
namaste prāṇa tiṣṭhata āsīnāyota te namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
नम॑स्ते प्राण प्राण॒ते नमो॑ अस्त्वपान॒ते ।
प॒रा॒चीना॑य ते॒ नमः॑ प्रती॒चीना॑य ते॒ नमः॑ सर्व॑स्मै त इ॒दं नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
namaste prāṇa prāṇate namo astvapānate |
parācīnāya te namaḥ pratīcīnāya te namaḥ sarvasmai ta idaṃ namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
या ते॑ प्राण प्रि॒या त॒नूर्यो ते॑ प्राण॒ प्रेय॑सी ।
अथो॒ यद् भे॑ष॒जं तव॒ तस्य॑ नो धेहि जी॒वसे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yā te prāṇa priyā tanūryo te prāṇa preyasī |
atho yad bheṣajaṃ tava tasya no dhehi jīvase ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒णः प्र॒जा अनु॑ वस्ते पि॒ता पु॒त्रमि॑व प्रि॒यम् ।
प्रा॒णो ह॒ सर्व॑स्येश्व॒रो यच्च॑ प्रा॒णति॒ यच्च॒ न ॥
verses.transliteration:
prāṇaḥ prajā anu vaste pitā putramiva priyam |
prāṇo ha sarvasyeśvaro yacca prāṇati yacca na ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒णो मृ॒त्युः प्रा॒णस्त॒क्मा प्रा॒णं दे॒वा उपा॑सते ।
प्रा॒णो ह॒ सत्यवा॒दिन॑मुत्त॒मे लो॒क आ द॑धत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prāṇo mṛtyuḥ prāṇastakmā prāṇaṃ devā upāsate |
prāṇo ha satyavādinamuttame loka ā dadhat ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒णो वि॒राट् प्रा॒णो देष्ट्री॑ प्रा॒णं सर्व॒ उपा॑सते ।
प्रा॒णो ह॒ सूर्य॑श्च॒न्द्रमाः॑ प्रा॒णमा॑हुः प्र॒जाप॑तिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prāṇo virāṭ prāṇo deṣṭrī prāṇaṃ sarva upāsate |
prāṇo ha sūryaścandramāḥ prāṇamāhuḥ prajāpatim ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒णा॒पा॒नौ व्री॑हिय॒वाव॑न॒ड्वान् प्रा॒ण उ॑च्यते ।
यवे॑ ह प्रा॒ण आहि॑तोऽपा॒नो व्री॒हिरु॑च्यते ॥
verses.transliteration:
prāṇāpānau vrīhiyavāvanaḍvān prāṇa ucyate |
yave ha prāṇa āhito'pāno vrīhirucyate ||

verses.sanskrit:
अपा॑नति॒ प्राण॑ति॒ पुरु॑षो॒ गर्भे॑ अन्त॒रा ।
य॒दा त्वं प्रा॑ण॒ जिन्व॒स्यथ॒ स जा॑यते॒ पुनः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
apānati prāṇati puruṣo garbhe antarā |
yadā tvaṃ prāṇa jinvasyatha sa jāyate punaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒णमा॑हुर्मात॒रिश्वा॑नं॒ वातो॑ ह प्रा॒ण उ॑च्यते ।
प्रा॒णे ह॑ भू॒तं भव्यं॑ च प्रा॒णे सर्वं॑ प्रति॑ष्ठितम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prāṇamāhurmātariśvānaṃ vāto ha prāṇa ucyate |
prāṇe ha bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ ca prāṇe sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒थ॒र्व॒णीरा॑ङ्गिर॒सीर्दैवी॑र्मनुष्य॒जा उ॒त ।
ओष॑धयः॒ प्र जा॑यन्ते य॒दा त्वं प्रा॑ण॒ जिन्व॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ātharvaṇīrāṅgirasīrdaivīrmanuṣyajā uta |
oṣadhayaḥ pra jāyante yadā tvaṃ prāṇa jinvasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
य॒दा प्रा॒णो अ॒भ्यव॑र्षीद् व॒र्षेण॑ पृथि॒वीं म॒हीम् ।
ओष॑धयः॒ प्र जा॑य॒न्तेऽथो॒ याः काश्च॑ वी॒रुधः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadā prāṇo abhyavarṣīd varṣeṇa pṛthivīṃ mahīm |
oṣadhayaḥ pra jāyante'tho yāḥ kāśca vīrudhaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ते॑ प्राणे॒दं वेद॒ यस्मिं॒श्चासि॒ प्रति॑ष्ठितः ।
सर्वे॒ तस्मै॑ ब॒लिं ह॑रान॒मुष्मिंल्लो॒क उ॑त्त॒मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaste prāṇedaṃ veda yasmiṃścāsi pratiṣṭhitaḥ |
sarve tasmai baliṃ harānamuṣmiṃlloka uttame ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॑ प्राण बलि॒हृत॒स्तुभ्यं॒ सर्वाः॑ प्र॒जा इ॒माः ।
ए॒वा तस्मै॑ ब॒लिं ह॑रा॒न् यस्त्वा॑ शृ॒णव॑त् सुश्रवः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā prāṇa balihṛtastubhyaṃ sarvāḥ prajā imāḥ |
evā tasmai baliṃ harān yastvā śṛṇavat suśravaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न्तर्गर्भ॑श्चरति दे॒वता॒स्वाभू॑तो भू॒तः स उ॑ जायते॒ पुनः॑ ।
स भू॒तो भव्यं॑ भवि॒ष्यत् पि॒ता पु॒त्रं प्र वि॑वेशा॒ शची॑भिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
antargarbhaścarati devatāsvābhūto bhūtaḥ sa u jāyate punaḥ |
sa bhūto bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyat pitā putraṃ pra viveśā śacībhiḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
एकं॒ पादं॒ नोत्खि॑दति सलि॒लाद्धंस उ॒च्चर॑न् ।
यद॒ङ्ग स तमु॑त्खि॒देन्नैवाद्य न श्वः स्या॒न्न रात्री॒ नाहः॑ स्या॒न्न व्युऽछेत् क॒दा च॒न ॥
verses.transliteration:
ekaṃ pādaṃ notkhidati salilāddhaṃsa uccaran |
yadaṅga sa tamutkhidennaivādya na śvaḥ syānna rātrī nāhaḥ syānna vyu'chet kadā cana ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ष्टाच॑क्रं वर्तत॒ एक॑नेमि स॒हस्रा॑क्षरं॒ प्र पु॒रो नि प॒श्चा ।
अ॒र्धेन॒ विश्वं॒ भुव॑नं ज॒जान॒ यद॑स्या॒र्धं क॑त॒मः स के॒तुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
aṣṭācakraṃ vartata ekanemi sahasrākṣaraṃ pra puro ni paścā |
ardhena viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ jajāna yadasyārdhaṃ katamaḥ sa ketuḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो अ॒स्य वि॒श्वज॑न्मन॒ ईशे॒ विश्व॑स्य॒ चेष्ट॑तः ।
अन्ये॑षु क्षि॒प्रध॑न्वने॒ तस्मै॑ प्राण॒ नमो॑ऽस्तु ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo asya viśvajanmana īśe viśvasya ceṣṭataḥ |
anyeṣu kṣipradhanvane tasmai prāṇa namo'stu te ||

verses.sanskrit:
यो अ॒स्य स॒र्वज॑न्मन॒ ईशे॒ सर्व॑स्य॒ चेष्ट॑तः ।
अत॑न्द्रो॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ धीरः॑ प्रा॒णो मानु॑ तिष्ठातु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo asya sarvajanmana īśe sarvasya ceṣṭataḥ |
atandro brahmaṇā dhīraḥ prāṇo mānu tiṣṭhātu ||

verses.sanskrit:
ऊ॒र्ध्वः सु॒प्तेषु॑ जागार न॒नु ति॒र्यङ् नि प॑द्यते ।
न सु॒प्तम॑स्य सु॒प्तेष्वनु॑ शुश्राव॒ कश्च॒न ॥
verses.transliteration:
ūrdhvaḥ supteṣu jāgāra nanu tiryaṅ ni padyate |
na suptamasya supteṣvanu śuśrāva kaścana ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्राण॒ मा म॑त् प॒र्यावृ॑तो॒ न मद॒न्यो भ॑विष्यसि ।
अ॒पां गर्भ॑मिव जी॒वसे॒ प्राण॑ ब॒ध्नामि॑ त्वा॒ मयि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
prāṇa mā mat paryāvṛto na madanyo bhaviṣyasi |
apāṃ garbhamiva jīvase prāṇa badhnāmi tvā mayi ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्र॒ह्म॒चा॒रीष्णंश्च॑रति॒ रोद॑सी उ॒भे तस्मि॑न् दे॒वाः संम॑नसो भवन्ति ।
स दा॑धार पृथि॒वीं दिवं॑ च॒ स आ॑चा॒र्यं१ तप॑सा पिपर्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmacārīṣṇaṃścarati rodasī ubhe tasmin devāḥ saṃmanaso bhavanti |
sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ divaṃ ca sa ācāryaṃ tapasā piparti ||
verses.translation:
A glorification of the Brahmachgri or religious student
Stirring both worlds the Brahmachāri moveth: in him the deities are all one-minded.
He hath established firmly earth and heaven: he satisfies his Master with his Fervour.
After the Brahmachārī go the Fathers, the heavenly hosts, all Gods in separate order.
After him too have the Gandharvas followed, thirty and three, three hundred, and six thousand. He satisfies all Gods with his devotion.
The Master, welcoming his new disciple, into his bowels takes the Brahmachāri.
Three nights he holds and bears him in this belly. When he is born, the Gods convene to see him.
This log is earth, the second log is heaven: he fills the air’s mid region with the fuel.
With fuel, with his zone the Brahmachāri contents the worlds, with labour and with Fervour.
The Brahmachāri, earlier born than Brahma, sprang up through Fervour, robed in hot libation.
From him sprang heavenly lore, the highest Brahma, and all the Gods, with life that lasts for ever.
Lighted by fuel goes the Brahmachāri, clad in black-buck skin, consecrate, long-bearded.
Swiftly he goes from east to northern ocean, grasping the worlds, oft bringing them anear him.
The Brahmachāri, fathering Prayer, world, Waters, Virāj, Prajā-pati, and Parameshthin,
Lay as a germ within the Immortal’s bosom, then became Indra and destroyed the demons.
The Master fashioned both these cloudy regions, profound and spacious pair, the earth and heaven.
The Brahmachāri guards them with his Fervour. In him the deities are all one-minded.
The Brahmachāri first of all brought hither this ample earth as alms, and heaven above it.
He makes these twain two fuel-logs, and worships, On these sup-ported rest all living creatures.
Both treasuries of sacred lore lie hidden, one hitherward, beyond heaven’s ridge the other.
The Brahmachārī with his Fervour guards them. He makes this all his own as knowing Brahma.
Hitherward one, hence from the earth the other, two Agnis meet between these cloudy regions.
Close to these two firm rays of light are clinging. The Brahma-chāri enters them through Fervour.
Thundering, shouting, ruddy-hued, and pallid, he bears along the earth great manly vigour.
Down on the ridge of earth the Brahmachāri pours seed, and this gives life to heaven’s four regions.
The Brahmachāri stores with fuel Waters, and Fire, and Sun, and Moon, and Mātarisvan.
The Water’s lights move separate in the rain-cloud, Man, rain, and water are their molten butter.
The Master is Death, Varuna, Soma, the plants of earth, and milk.
The thunder-clouds were men of war. By these this heavenly light was brought.
Varuna, made a Master, takes at home the butter to himself.
Whatever with Prajāpati he sought, the Brahmachāri gave like Mitra from his loftiest soul.
The pupil is the Master, yea, the pupil is Prajāpati.
Prajāpati shines bright; the bright Virāj grew potent Indra’s self.
By Fervour and by self-restraint the King protects the realm he rules.
By self-restraint the Master seeks a Brahmachari to instruct.
By self-restraint a maiden finds a youth to be her wedded lord.
By self-restraint the ox and horse seek to win fodder for them-selves.
By Fervour and by self-restraint the Gods draye Death away from them,
And Indra brought by self-restraint heaven’s lustre to the deities.
The plants, what is and what shall be, day, night, the tall tree of the wood,
The year with seasons of the year, all from the Brahmachāri sprang.
All creatures of the earth and heaven, tame animals and sylvan beasts,
Winged and wingless creatures, from the Brahmachāri sprang to life,
All children of Prajāpati have breath distinctly in themselves.
The Brahma that is stored within the Brahmachāri guards them all.
Piled up on high, but never yet ascended, that power of deities is brightly shining.
From that sprang heavenly lore, the loftiest Brahma, and all the Gods with, life that lasts for ever.
The Brahmachāri wields the radiant Brahma wherein all Gods are woven close together;
Creating breath, inhaling and exhaling, voice, mind, and heart,
Brahma and holy wisdom.
Bestow on us the power of sight and hearing, glory and food and seed and blood and belly.
These, standing on the flood, the Brahmachāri formed practising in sea his hot devotion.
When he hath bathed, brown, yellow-hued, he shines exceedingly on earth.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्र॒ह्म॒चा॒रिणं॑ पि॒तरो॑ देवज॒नाः पृथ॑ग् दे॒वा अ॑नु॒संय॑न्ति॒ सर्वे॑ ।
ग॒न्ध॒र्वा ए॑न॒मन्वा॑य॒न् त्रय॑स्त्रिंशत् त्रिश॒ताः ष॑ट्सह॒स्राः सर्वा॒न्त्स दे॒वांस्तप॑सा पिपर्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmacāriṇaṃ pitaro devajanāḥ pṛthag devā anusaṃyanti sarve |
gandharvā enamanvāyan trayastriṃśat triśatāḥ ṣaṭsahasrāḥ sarvāntsa devāṃstapasā piparti ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒चा॒र्यऽ उप॒नय॑मानो ब्रह्मचा॒रिणं॑ कृणुते॒ गर्भ॑म॒न्तः ।
तं रात्री॑स्ति॒स्र उ॒दरे॑ बिभर्ति॒ तं जा॒तं द्रष्टु॑मभि॒संय॑न्ति दे॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ācārya' upanayamāno brahmacāriṇaṃ kṛṇute garbhamantaḥ |
taṃ rātrīstisra udare bibharti taṃ jātaṃ draṣṭumabhisaṃyanti devāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒यं स॒मित् पृ॑थि॒वी द्यौर्द्वितीयो॒तान्तरि॑क्षं स॒मिधा॑ पृणाति ।
ब्र॒ह्म॒चा॒री स॒मिधा॒ मेख॑लया॒ श्रमे॑ण लो॒कांस्तप॑सा पिपर्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
iyaṃ samit pṛthivī dyaurdvitīyotāntarikṣaṃ samidhā pṛṇāti |
brahmacārī samidhā mekhalayā śrameṇa lokāṃstapasā piparti ||

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वो॑ जा॒तो ब्रह्म॑णो ब्रह्मचा॒री घ॒र्मं वसा॑न॒स्तप॒सोद॑तिष्ठत् ।
तस्मा॑ज्जा॒तं ब्राह्म॑णं॒ ब्रह्म॑ ज्ये॒ष्ठं दे॒वाश्च॒ सर्वे॑ अ॒मृते॑न सा॒कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pūrvo jāto brahmaṇo brahmacārī gharmaṃ vasānastapasodatiṣṭhat |
tasmājjātaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ brahma jyeṣṭhaṃ devāśca sarve amṛtena sākam ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्र॒ह्म॒चा॒र्येऽति स॒मिधा॒ समि॑द्धः कार्ष्णं॒ वसा॑नो दीक्षि॒तो दी॒र्घश्म॑श्रुः ।
स स॒द्य ए॑ति॒ पूर्व॑स्मा॒दुत्त॑रं समु॒द्रं लो॒कान्त्सं॒गृभ्य॒ मुहु॑रा॒चरि॑क्रत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmacārye'ti samidhā samiddhaḥ kārṣṇaṃ vasāno dīkṣito dīrghaśmaśruḥ |
sa sadya eti pūrvasmāduttaraṃ samudraṃ lokāntsaṃgṛbhya muhurācarikrat ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्र॒ह्म॒चा॒री ज॒नय॒न् ब्रह्मा॒पो लो॒कं प्र॒जाप॑तिं परमे॒ष्ठिनं॑ वि॒राज॑म् ।
गर्भो॑ भू॒त्वामृत॑स्य॒ योना॒विन्द्रो॑ ह भू॒त्वासु॑रांस्ततर्ह ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmacārī janayan brahmāpo lokaṃ prajāpatiṃ parameṣṭhinaṃ virājam |
garbho bhūtvāmṛtasya yonāvindro ha bhūtvāsurāṃstatarha ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒चा॒र्यऽ स्ततक्ष॒ नभ॑सी उ॒भे इ॒मे उ॒र्वी ग॑म्भी॒रे पृ॑थि॒वीं दिवं॑ च ।
ते र॑क्षति॒ तप॑सा ब्रह्मचा॒री तस्मि॑न् देवाः संम॑नसो भवन्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
ācārya' statakṣa nabhasī ubhe ime urvī gambhīre pṛthivīṃ divaṃ ca |
te rakṣati tapasā brahmacārī tasmin devāḥ saṃmanaso bhavanti ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मां भूमिं॑ पृथि॒वीं ब्र॑ह्मचा॒री भि॒क्षामा ज॑भार प्रथ॒मो दिवं॑ च ।
ते कृ॒त्वा स॒मिधा॒वुपा॑स्ते॒ तयो॒रार्पि॑ता॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
imāṃ bhūmiṃ pṛthivīṃ brahmacārī bhikṣāmā jabhāra prathamo divaṃ ca |
te kṛtvā samidhāvupāste tayorārpitā bhuvanāni viśvā ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒र्वाग॒न्यः प॒रो अ॒न्यो दि॒वस्पृ॒ष्ठाद् गुहा॑ नि॒धी निहि॑तौ॒ ब्राह्म॑णस्य ।
तौ र॑क्षति॒ तप॑सा ब्रह्मचा॒री तत् केव॑लं कृणुते॒ ब्रह्म॑ वि॒द्वान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
arvāganyaḥ paro anyo divaspṛṣṭhād guhā nidhī nihitau brāhmaṇasya |
tau rakṣati tapasā brahmacārī tat kevalaṃ kṛṇute brahma vidvān ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒र्वाग॒न्य इ॒तो अ॒न्यः पृ॑थि॒व्या अ॒ग्नी स॒मेतो॒ नभ॑सी अन्त॒रमे ।
तयोः॑ श्रयन्ते र॒श्मयोऽधि॑ दृ॒ढास्ताना ति॑ष्ठति॒ तप॑सा ब्रह्मचा॒री ॥
verses.transliteration:
arvāganya ito anyaḥ pṛthivyā agnī sameto nabhasī antarame |
tayoḥ śrayante raśmayo'dhi dṛḍhāstānā tiṣṭhati tapasā brahmacārī ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भि॒क्रन्द॑न् स्त॒नय॑न्नरु॒णः शि॑ति॒ङ्गो बृ॒हच्छेपोऽनु॒ भूमौ॑ जभार ।
ब्र॒ह्म॒चा॒री सि॑ञ्चति॒ सानौ॒ रेतः॑ पृथि॒व्यां तेन॑ जीवन्ति प्र॒दिश॒श्चत॑स्रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhikrandan stanayannaruṇaḥ śitiṅgo bṛhacchepo'nu bhūmau jabhāra |
brahmacārī siñcati sānau retaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tena jīvanti pradiśaścatasraḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्नौ सूर्ये॑ च॒न्द्रम॑सि मात॒रिश्व॑न् ब्रह्मचा॒र्य॑१प्सु स॒मिध॒मा द॑धाति ।
तासा॑म॒र्चींषि॒ पृथ॑ग॒भ्रे च॑रन्ति॒ तासा॒माज्यं॒ पुरु॑षो व॒र्षमापः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnau sūrye candramasi mātariśvan brahmacāryapsu samidhamā dadhāti |
tāsāmarcīṃṣi pṛthagabhre caranti tāsāmājyaṃ puruṣo varṣamāpaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒चा॒र्योऽ मृ॒त्युर्वरु॑णः॒ सोम॒ ओष॑धयः॒ पयः॑ ।
जी॒भूता॑ आस॒न्त्सत्वा॑न॒स्तैरि॒दं स्व॑१राभृ॑तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ācāryo' mṛtyurvaruṇaḥ soma oṣadhayaḥ payaḥ |
jībhūtā āsantsatvānastairidaṃ svarābhṛtam ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒मा घृ॒तं कृ॑णुते॒ केव॑लमाचा॒र्यो भू॒त्वा वरु॑णो॒ यद्य॒दैच्छत् प्र॒जाप॑तौ ।
तद् ब्र॑ह्मचा॒री प्राय॑च्छत् स्वन् मि॒त्रो अध्या॒त्मनः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
amā ghṛtaṃ kṛṇute kevalamācāryo bhūtvā varuṇo yadyadaicchat prajāpatau |
tad brahmacārī prāyacchat svan mitro adhyātmanaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒चा॒र्योऽ ब्रह्मचा॒री ब्र॑ह्मच॒री प्र॒जाप॑तिः ।
प्र॒जाप॑ति॒र्वि रा॑जति वि॒राडिन्द्रो॑ऽभवद् व॒शी ॥
verses.transliteration:
ācāryo' brahmacārī brahmacarī prajāpatiḥ |
prajāpatirvi rājati virāḍindro'bhavad vaśī ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्र॒ह्म॒चर्ये॑ण॒ तप॑सा॒ राजा॑ रा॒ष्ट्रं वि र॑क्षति ।
आ॒चा॒र्योऽ ब्रह्म॒चर्ये॑ण ब्रह्मचा॒रिण॑मिच्छते ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmacaryeṇa tapasā rājā rāṣṭraṃ vi rakṣati |
ācāryo' brahmacaryeṇa brahmacāriṇamicchate ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्र॒ह्म॒चर्ये॑ण क॒न्या॒३ युवा॑नं विन्दते॒ पति॑म् ।
अ॒न॒ड्वान् ब्र॑ह्म॒चर्ये॒णाश्वो॑ घा॒सं जि॑गीर्षति ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmacaryeṇa kanyā yuvānaṃ vindate patim |
anaḍvān brahmacaryeṇāśvo ghāsaṃ jigīrṣati ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्र॒ह्म॒चर्ये॑ण॒ तप॑सा दे॒वा मृ॒त्युमपा॑घ्नत ।
इन्द्रो॑ ह ब्र॒ह्मचर्ये॑ण दे॒वेभ्यः॒ स्व॑१राभ॑रत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmacaryeṇa tapasā devā mṛtyumapāghnata |
indro ha brahmacaryeṇa devebhyaḥ svarābharat ||

verses.sanskrit:
ओष॑धयो भूतभ॒व्यम॑होरा॒त्रे वन॒स्पतिः॑ ।
सं॒व॒त्स॒रः स॒हर्तुभि॒स्ते जा॒ता ब्र॑ह्मचा॒रिणः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
oṣadhayo bhūtabhavyamahorātre vanaspatiḥ |
saṃvatsaraḥ sahartubhiste jātā brahmacāriṇaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
पार्थि॑वा दि॒व्याः प॒शव॑ आर॒ण्या ग्रा॒म्याश्च॒ ये ।
अ॒प॒क्षाः प॒क्षिण॑श्च॒ ये ते जा॒ता ब्र॑ह्मचा॒रिणः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pārthivā divyāḥ paśava āraṇyā grāmyāśca ye |
apakṣāḥ pakṣiṇaśca ye te jātā brahmacāriṇaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
पृथ॒क् सर्वे॑ प्राजाप॒त्याः प्रा॒णाना॒त्मसु॑ बिभ्रति ।
तान्त्सर्वा॒न् ब्रह्म॑ रक्षति ब्रह्मचा॒रिण्याभृ॑तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pṛthak sarve prājāpatyāḥ prāṇānātmasu bibhrati |
tāntsarvān brahma rakṣati brahmacāriṇyābhṛtam ||

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वाना॑मे॒तत् प॑रिषू॒तमन॑भ्यारूढं चरति॒ रोच॑मानम् ।
तस्मा॑ज्जा॒तं ब्राह्म॑णं॒ ब्रह्म॑ ज्ये॒ष्ठं दे॒वाश्च॒ सर्वे॑ अ॒मते॑न सा॒कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
devānāmetat pariṣūtamanabhyārūḍhaṃ carati rocamānam |
tasmājjātaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ brahma jyeṣṭhaṃ devāśca sarve amatena sākam ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्र॒ह्म॒चा॒री ब्रह्म॒ भ्राज॑द् बिभर्ति॒ तस्मि॑न् दे॒वा अधि॒ विश्वे॑ स॒मोताः॑ ।
प्रा॒णा॒पा॒नौ ज॒नय॒न्नाद् व्या॒नं वाचं॒ मनो॒ हृद॑यं॒ ब्रह्म॑ मे॒धाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmacārī brahma bhrājad bibharti tasmin devā adhi viśve samotāḥ |
prāṇāpānau janayannād vyānaṃ vācaṃ mano hṛdayaṃ brahma medhām ||

verses.sanskrit: चक्षुः॒ श्रोत्रं॒ यशो॑ अ॒स्मासु॑ धे॒ह्यन्नं॒ रेतो॒ लोहि॑तमु॒दर॑म्  ॥
verses.transliteration: cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ yaśo asmāsu dhehyannaṃ reto lohitamudaram  ||

verses.sanskrit:
तानि॒ कल्प॑द् ब्रह्मचा॒री स॑लि॒लस्य॑ पृ॒ष्ठे तपो॑ऽतिष्ठत् त॒प्यमा॑नः समु॒द्रे ।
स स्ना॒तो ब॒भ्रुः पि॑ङ्ग॒लः पृ॑थि॒व्यां ब॒हु रो॑चते ॥
verses.transliteration:
tāni kalpad brahmacārī salilasya pṛṣṭhe tapo'tiṣṭhat tapyamānaḥ samudre |
sa snāto babhruḥ piṅgalaḥ pṛthivyāṃ bahu rocate ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निं ब्रू॑मो॒ वन॒स्पती॒नोष॑धीरु॒त वी॒रुधः॑ ।
इन्द्रं॒ बृह॒स्पतिं॒ सूर्यं॒ ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
agniṃ brūmo vanaspatīnoṣadhīruta vīrudhaḥ |
indraṃ bṛhaspatiṃ sūryaṃ te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to all Divinities and Sanctities for deliverance from distress
We call on Agni, on the trees lords of the forest, herbs and. plants,
Indra, Sūrya, Brihaspati: may they deliver us from woe.
We call on Vishnu, Bhaga, on Mitra and Varuna the King,
Ansa Vivasvān we address: may they deliver us from woe.
We call on Savitar the God, on Pūshan the establisher,
Tvashtar the foremost we address: may they deliver us from woe.
Gandharvas and Apsarases; the Asvins, Brāhmanaspati,
Aryaman, God, by name we call: may they deliver us from woe.
This word of ours to Day and Night, and to the Sun and Moon we speak,
All the Ādityas we address: may they deliver us from woe.
Vāta, Parjanya we address, the Quarters, and the Firmament,
And all the Regions of the sky: may they deliver us from woe.
From all that brings a curse may Day and Night and Dawn deliver me,
May Soma free me, God to whom they give the name of Chan-dramās.
All creatures both of heaven and earth, wild beasts and sylvan animals,
And winged birds of air we call: may they deliver us from woe.
Bhava and Sarva we address, and Rudra who is Lord of Beasts,
Their arrows which we feel and know: may they be ever kind to us.
We speak to Constellations, Heaven, to Earth, to Genii, and to Hills,
To Seas, to Rivers, and to Lakes: may they deliver us from woe.
Or the Seven Rishis we address, Waters divine, Prajāpati,
Fathers with Yama at their head: may they deliver us from woe.
Gods whose abode is in the heaven and those who dwell in middle air,
And Mighty ones who rest on earth: may they deliver us from. woe.
Ādityas, Rudra, Vasus, Gods aloft in heaven, Atharvan’s sons,
The sages, sons of Angiras: may they deliver us from woe.
To sacrifice, to worshipper, hymns, songs, and healing charms, we speak,
To priestly acts and Yajus texts: may they deliver us from woe.
To the five kingdoms of the plants which Soma rules as Lord we speak.
Darbha, hemp, barley, mighty power: may these deliver us from woe,
To demons and fierce fiends we speak, to Holy Genii, Fathers,.
Snakes,
And to the hundred deaths and one: may these deliver us from woe.
We speak to Seasons, Season-Lords, to years and sections of the year,
To Months, half-months, and years complete: may they deliver us from woe.
Come hither from the south, ye Gods, rise and come forward from the west.
Gathered together, all ye Gods, ye mighty Ones, from east and and north: may they deliver us from woe.
This we address to all the Gods, faithful, maintainers of the Right,
With all their Consorts by their side: may they deliver us from woe.
We speak to the collected Gods, faithful, maintainers of the Right.
Present with their collective Dames: may these deliver us from woe.
The spirit, yea, the spirits’ Lord, ruler of spirits, we address.
Together let all spirits meet: may these deliver us from woe.
The five Sky regions, Goddesses, and the twelve Seasons which are Gods.
The teeth of the completed year, may these deliver us from woe.
The deathless balm that Mātalī knows, purchased at a chariot’s price,
Indra effused into the floods. Waters, give us that healing balm!

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रू॒मो राजा॑नं॒ वरु॑णं मि॒त्रं विष्णु॒मथो॒ भग॑म् ।
अंशं॒ विव॑स्वन्तं ब्रूम॒स्ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
brūmo rājānaṃ varuṇaṃ mitraṃ viṣṇumatho bhagam |
aṃśaṃ vivasvantaṃ brūmaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रू॒मो दे॒वं स॑वि॒तारं॑ धा॒तार॑मु॒त पू॒षण॑म् ।
त्वष्टा॑रमग्रि॒यं ब्रू॑म॒स्ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
brūmo devaṃ savitāraṃ dhātāramuta pūṣaṇam |
tvaṣṭāramagriyaṃ brūmaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ग॒न्ध॒र्वा॒प्स॒रसो॑ ब्रूमो अ॒श्विना॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑म् ।
अ॒र्य॒मा नाम॒ यो दे॒वस्ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
gandharvāpsaraso brūmo aśvinā brahmaṇaspatim |
aryamā nāma yo devaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒हो॒रा॒त्रे इ॒दं ब्रू॑मः सूर्याचन्द्र॒मसा॑वु॒भा ।
विश्वा॑नादि॒त्यान् ब्रू॑म॒स्ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahorātre idaṃ brūmaḥ sūryācandramasāvubhā |
viśvānādityān brūmaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
वातं॑ ब्रूमः प॒र्जन्य॑म॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒मथो॒ दिशः॑ ।
आशा॑श्च॒ सर्वा॑ ब्रूम॒स्ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
vātaṃ brūmaḥ parjanyamantarikṣamatho diśaḥ |
āśāśca sarvā brūmaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
मु॒ञ्चन्तु॑ मा शप॒थ्याऽदहोरा॒त्रे अथो॑ उ॒षाः ।
सोमो॑ मा दे॒वो मु॑ञ्चतु॒ यमा॒हुश्च॒न्द्रमा॒ इति॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
muñcantu mā śapathyā'dahorātre atho uṣāḥ |
somo mā devo muñcatu yamāhuścandramā iti ||

verses.sanskrit:
पार्थि॑वा दि॒व्यः प॒शव॑ आर॒ण्या उ॒त ये मृ॒गाः ।
श॒कुन्ता॑न् प॒क्षिणो॑ ब्रूम॒स्ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
pārthivā divyaḥ paśava āraṇyā uta ye mṛgāḥ |
śakuntān pakṣiṇo brūmaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
भ॒वा॒श॒र्वावि॒दं ब्रू॑मो रु॒द्रं प॑शु॒पति॑श्च॒ यः ।
इषू॒र्या ए॑षां संवि॒द्म ता नः॑ सन्तु॒ सदा॑ शि॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhavāśarvāvidaṃ brūmo rudraṃ paśupatiśca yaḥ |
iṣūryā eṣāṃ saṃvidma tā naḥ santu sadā śivāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
दिवं॑ ब्रूमो॒ नक्ष॑त्राणि॒ भूमिं॑ य॒क्षाणि॒ पर्व॑तान् ।
स॒मु॒द्रा न॒द्योऽ वेश॒न्तास्ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
divaṃ brūmo nakṣatrāṇi bhūmiṃ yakṣāṇi parvatān |
samudrā nadyo' veśantāste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒प्त॒र्षीन् वा इ॒दं ब्रू॑मो॒ऽपो दे॒वीः प्र॒जाप॑तिम् ।
पि॒तॄन् य॒मश्रे॑ष्ठान् ब्रूम॒स्ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
saptarṣīn vā idaṃ brūmo'po devīḥ prajāpatim |
pitṝn yamaśreṣṭhān brūmaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये दे॒वा दि॑वि॒षदो॑ अन्तरिक्ष॒सद॑श्च॒ ये ।
पृ॒थि॒व्यां श॒क्रा ये श्रि॒तास्ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye devā diviṣado antarikṣasadaśca ye |
pṛthivyāṃ śakrā ye śritāste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒दि॒त्या रु॒द्रा वस॑वो दि॒वि दे॒वा अथ॑र्वाणः ।
अङ्गि॑रसो मनी॒षिण॒स्ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ādityā rudrā vasavo divi devā atharvāṇaḥ |
aṅgiraso manīṣiṇaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञं ब्रू॑मो॒ यज॑मान॒मृचः॒ सामा॑नि भेष॒जा ।
यजूं॑षि॒ होत्रा॑ ब्रूम॒स्ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yajñaṃ brūmo yajamānamṛcaḥ sāmāni bheṣajā |
yajūṃṣi hotrā brūmaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
पञ्च॑ रा॒ज्यानि॑ वी॒रुधां॒ सोम॑श्रेष्ठानि ब्रूमः ।
द॒र्भो भङ्गो यवः॒ सह॒स्ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
pañca rājyāni vīrudhāṃ somaśreṣṭhāni brūmaḥ |
darbho bhaṅgo yavaḥ sahaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒राया॑न् ब्रूमो॒ रक्षां॑सि स॒र्पान् पु॑ण्यज॒नान् पि॒तृन् ।
मृ॒त्यूनेक॑शतं ब्रूम॒स्ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
arāyān brūmo rakṣāṃsi sarpān puṇyajanān pitṛn |
mṛtyūnekaśataṃ brūmaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒तून् ब्रू॑म ऋतु॒पती॑नार्त॒वानु॒त हा॑य॒नान् ।
समाः॑ संवत्स॒रान् मासां॒स्ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛtūn brūma ṛtupatīnārtavānuta hāyanān |
samāḥ saṃvatsarān māsāṃste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
एत॑ देवा दक्षिण॒तः प॒श्चात् प्राञ्च॑ उ॒देत॑ ।
पु॒रस्ता॑दुत्त॒राच्छ॒क्रा विश्वे॑ दे॒वाः स॒मेत्य॒ ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
eta devā dakṣiṇataḥ paścāt prāñca udeta |
purastāduttarācchakrā viśve devāḥ sametya te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वा॑न् दे॒वानि॒दं ब्रू॑मः स॒त्यसं॑धानृता॒वृधः॑ ।
विश्वा॑भिः॒ पत्नी॑भिः स॒ह ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvān devānidaṃ brūmaḥ satyasaṃdhānṛtāvṛdhaḥ |
viśvābhiḥ patnībhiḥ saha te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वा॑न् दे॒वानि॒दं ब्रू॑मः स॒त्यसं॑धानृता॒वृधः॑ ।
सर्वा॑भिः॒ पत्नी॑भिः स॒ह ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarvān devānidaṃ brūmaḥ satyasaṃdhānṛtāvṛdhaḥ |
sarvābhiḥ patnībhiḥ saha te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
भू॒तं ब्रू॑मो भूत॒पतिं॑ भू॒ताना॑मु॒त यो व॒शी ।
भू॒तानि॒ सर्वा॑ सं॒गत्य॒ ते नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वंह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhūtaṃ brūmo bhūtapatiṃ bhūtānāmuta yo vaśī |
bhūtāni sarvā saṃgatya te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
या दे॒वीः पञ्च॑ प्र॒दिशो॒ ये दे॒वा द्वाद॑श॒र्तवः॑ ।
सं॒व॒त्स॒रस्य॒ ये दंष्ट्रा॒स्ते नः॑ सन्तु॒ सदा॑ शि॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yā devīḥ pañca pradiśo ye devā dvādaśartavaḥ |
saṃvatsarasya ye daṃṣṭrāste naḥ santu sadā śivāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यन्मात॑ली रथक्री॒तम॒मृतं॒ वेद॑ भेष॒जम् ।
तदिन्द्रो॑ अ॒प्सु प्रावे॑शय॒त् तदापो॑ दत्त भेष॒जम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yanmātalī rathakrītamamṛtaṃ veda bheṣajam |
tadindro apsu prāveśayat tadāpo datta bheṣajam ||

verses.sanskrit:
उच्छि॑ष्टे॒ नाम॑ रू॒पं चोच्छि॑ष्टे लो॒क आहि॑तः ।
उच्छि॑ष्ट॒ इन्द्र॑श्चा॒ग्निश्च॒ विश्व॑म॒न्तः स॒माहि॑तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ucchiṣṭe nāma rūpaṃ cocchiṣṭe loka āhitaḥ |
ucchiṣṭa indraścāgniśca viśvamantaḥ samāhitam ||
verses.translation:
A glorification of the Uchchhishta or Residue of Sacrifice
The Residue of Sacrifice containeth name, and from, and world:
Indra and Agni and the whole universe are comprised therein.
The Residue of Sacrifice holdeth Earth, Heaven, and all that is:
The Residue of Sacrifice holdeth sea, waters, Moon, and Wind.
Real, non-real, both are there, Prajāpati, and Death, and strength:
Thereon depend the worldly ones: in me are glory Dra and Vra.
The firm, the fast, the strong, the hard, Brahma, the All-creating Ten.
Gods, as a wheel about the nave, are fixed all round the Residue.
Verse, Song, and Sacrificial Text, chanting, the prelude, and the laud,
The hum is in the Residue, the tone, the murmur of the psalm.
Within the Residue, like babes unborn, the parts of sacrifice,
Aindrāgne Pāvamāna lie. Mahānāmnī, Mahavrata.
The Vājapeya, Royal Rite, the Agnishoma and its forms,
Hymns, joyfullest with living grass the Asvamedha, are therein,
Dikshā and Agnyādheya rite that sates the wish, with magic-hymn,
Suspended rites, long sessions, are contained within the Residue.
Faith fire-oblation, fervent zeal, service, and sacrificial cry,
Guerdon, good works and their reward, are stored within the Residue.
Sacrifice of one night, or two, Sadya1 kri, Ukthya, and Prakri,
Call, deep-toned summons are therein, fine parts, through lore, of sacrifice,
Sacrifice of four nights, of five, of six nights, day and night conjoined,
Shodai, seven-night sacrifice, all these sprang from the Residue, these which the Immortal One contains.
Pratihāra and Nidhanam, the Visvajit, the Abhijit,
The two Sāhnātirātrās and Twelve-day rite are stored therein.
Pleasantness, reverence, peace, and power, strength, vigour, immortality All forward wishes are with love satisfied in the Residue.
Nine several oceans, earths, and skies are set within, the Residue,
Bright shines the Sun therein, in me, the Residue, are Day and Night.
The Residue the Father’s sire, who bears this universe, supports Vishūvān, Upahavya, and all worship offered secretly.
The Father’s sire, the Residue, grandson of Spirit, primal Sire,
Lord of the universe, the Bull, dwells on the earth victorious.
Right, truth, dominion, fervent zeal, toil, duty, action, future, past,
Valour; prosperity, and strength dwell in the Residue in strength.
Welfare, resolve and energy, the six expanses, kingship, sway,
Prayer, and direction, and the year, oblation, planets, are there-in;
And the four Hotars, Apri hymns, the Nivids, and Four-monthly rites,
Oblations, sacrifices, and animal offerings, and their forms.
Months, half-months, sections of the year, seasons are in the Residue,
The waters resonant afar, the thunder, and the mighty noise.
Pebbles, sand, stones, and herbs, and plants, and grass are in the Residue,
Closely embraced and laid therein are lightnings and the clouds and rain.
Gain, acquisition, and success, fulness, complete prosperity.
Great gain and wealth, are laid, concealed and treasured, in the Residue.
All things that breathe the breath of life, all creatures that have eyes to see,
All the celestial Gods whose home is heaven sprang from the Residue.
Verses, and Songs, and magic hymns, Purāna, sacrificial text.
All the celestial Gods whose home is heaven sprang from the Residue.
Inbreath and outbreath, eye and ear, decay and freedom from decay,
All the celestial Gods whose home is heaven sprang from the Residue.
All pleasures and enjoyments, all delights and rapturous ecsta-sies,
All the celestial Gods whose home is heaven sprang from the Residue.
The Deities, the Fathers, men, Gandharvas, and Apsarases.
All the celestial Gods whose home is heaven sprang from the Residue.

verses.sanskrit:
उच्छि॑ष्टे॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी विश्वं॑ भू॒तं स॒माहि॑तम् ।
आपः॑ समु॒द्र उच्छि॑ष्टे च॒न्द्रमा॒ वात॒ आहि॑तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ucchiṣṭe dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaṃ bhūtaṃ samāhitam |
āpaḥ samudra ucchiṣṭe candramā vāta āhitaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
सन्नुच्छि॑ष्टे॒ असं॑श्चो॒भौ मृ॒त्युर्वाजः॑ प्र॒जाप॑तिः ।
लै॒क्या उच्छि॑ष्ट॒ आय॑त्ता॒ व्रश्च॒ द्रश्चापि॒ श्रीर्मयि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sannucchiṣṭe asaṃścobhau mṛtyurvājaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
laikyā ucchiṣṭa āyattā vraśca draścāpi śrīrmayi ||

verses.sanskrit:
दृ॒ढो दृं॑हस्थि॒रो न्यो ब्रह्म॑ विश्व॒सृजो दश॑ ।
नाभि॑मिव स॒र्वत॑श्च॒क्रमुच्छि॑ष्टे दे॒वताः॑ श्रि॒ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
dṛḍho dṛṃhasthiro nyo brahma viśvasṛjo daśa |
nābhimiva sarvataścakramucchiṣṭe devatāḥ śritāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ऋक् साम॒ यजु॒रुच्छि॑ष्ट उद्गी॒थः प्रस्तु॑तं स्तु॒तम् ।
हि॒ङ्का॒र उच्छि॑ष्टे॒ स्वरः॒ साम्नो॑ मे॒डिश्च॒ तन्मयि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛk sāma yajurucchiṣṭa udgīthaḥ prastutaṃ stutam |
hiṅkāra ucchiṣṭe svaraḥ sāmno meḍiśca tanmayi ||

verses.sanskrit:
ऐ॒न्द्रा॒ग्नं पा॑वमा॒नं म॒हाना॑म्नीर्महाव्र॒तम् ।
उच्छि॑ष्टे य॒ज्ञस्याङ्गा॑न्य॒न्तर्गर्भ॑ इव मा॒तरि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
aindrāgnaṃ pāvamānaṃ mahānāmnīrmahāvratam |
ucchiṣṭe yajñasyāṅgānyantargarbha iva mātari ||

verses.sanskrit:
रा॒ज॒सूयं॑ वाज॒पेय॑मग्निष्टो॒मस्तद॑ध्व॒रः ।
अ॒र्का॒श्व॒मे॒धावुच्छि॑ष्टे जी॒वब॑र्हिर्म॒दिन्त॑मः ॥
verses.transliteration:
rājasūyaṃ vājapeyamagniṣṭomastadadhvaraḥ |
arkāśvamedhāvucchiṣṭe jīvabarhirmadintamaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्न्या॒धेय॒मथो॑ दी॒क्षा का॑म॒प्रश्छन्द॑सा स॒ह ।
उत्स॑न्ना य॒ज्ञाः स॒त्राण्युच्छि॒ष्टेऽधि॑ स॒माहि॑ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnyādheyamatho dīkṣā kāmapraśchandasā saha |
utsannā yajñāḥ satrāṇyucchiṣṭe'dhi samāhitāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्नि॒हो॒त्रं च॑ श्र॒द्धा च॑ वषट्का॒रो व्र॒तं तपः॑ ।
दक्षि॑णे॒ष्टं पू॒र्तं चोच्छि॒ष्टेऽधि॑ स॒माहि॑ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnihotraṃ ca śraddhā ca vaṣaṭkāro vrataṃ tapaḥ |
dakṣiṇeṣṭaṃ pūrtaṃ cocchiṣṭe'dhi samāhitāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒क॒रा॒त्रो द्वि॑रा॒त्रः स॑द्यः॒क्रीः प्र॒क्रीरु॒क्थ्यः ।
ओतं॒ निहि॑त॒मुच्छि॑ष्टे य॒ज्ञस्या॒णूनि॑ वि॒द्यया॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ekarātro dvirātraḥ sadyaḥkrīḥ prakrīrukthyaḥ |
otaṃ nihitamucchiṣṭe yajñasyāṇūni vidyayā ||

verses.sanskrit:
च॒तू॒रा॒त्रः प॑ञ्चरा॒त्रः ष॑ड्रा॒त्रश्चो॒भयः॑ स॒ह ।
षो॒ड॒शी स॑प्तरा॒त्रश्चोच्छि॑ष्टाज्जज्ञिरे॒ सर्वे॒ ये य॒ज्ञा अ॒मृते॑ हि॒ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
catūrātraḥ pañcarātraḥ ṣaḍrātraścobhayaḥ saha |
ṣoḍaśī saptarātraścocchiṣṭājjajñire sarve ye yajñā amṛte hitāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒ती॒हा॒रो नि॒धनं॑ विश्व॒जिच्चा॑भि॒जिच्च॒ यः ।
सा॒ह्ना॒ति॒रा॒त्रावुच्छि॑ष्टे द्वादशा॒होऽपि॒ तन्मयि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pratīhāro nidhanaṃ viśvajiccābhijicca yaḥ |
sāhnātirātrāvucchiṣṭe dvādaśāho'pi tanmayi ||

verses.sanskrit:
सू॒नृता॒ संन॑तिः॒ क्षेमः॑ स्व॒धोर्जामृतं॒ सहः॑ ।
उच्छि॑ष्टे॒ सर्वे॑ प्र॒त्यञ्चः॒ कामाः॒ कामे॑न ततृपुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sūnṛtā saṃnatiḥ kṣemaḥ svadhorjāmṛtaṃ sahaḥ |
ucchiṣṭe sarve pratyañcaḥ kāmāḥ kāmena tatṛpuḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
नव॒ भूमीः॑ समु॒द्रा उच्छि॒ष्टेऽअधि॑ श्रि॒ता दिवः॑ ।
आ सूर्यो॑ भा॒त्युच्छि॑ष्टेऽहोरा॒त्रे अपि॒ तन्मयि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
nava bhūmīḥ samudrā ucchiṣṭe'adhi śritā divaḥ |
ā sūryo bhātyucchiṣṭe'horātre api tanmayi ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒हव्यं॑ विषू॒वन्तं॒ ये च॑ य॒ज्ञा गुहा॑ हि॒ताः ।
बिभ॑र्ति भ॒र्ता विश्व॒स्योच्छि॑ष्टो जनि॒तुः पि॒ता ॥
verses.transliteration:
upahavyaṃ viṣūvantaṃ ye ca yajñā guhā hitāḥ |
bibharti bhartā viśvasyocchiṣṭo janituḥ pitā ||

verses.sanskrit:
पि॒ता ज॑नि॒तुरुच्छि॒ष्टोऽसोः॒ पौत्रः॑ पिताम॒हः ।
स क्षि॑यति॒ विश्व॒स्येशा॑नो॒ वृषा॒ भूम्या॑मति॒घ्न्यः ॥
verses.transliteration:
pitā janiturucchiṣṭo'soḥ pautraḥ pitāmahaḥ |
sa kṣiyati viśvasyeśāno vṛṣā bhūmyāmatighnyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒तं स॒त्यं तपो॑ रा॒स्ट्रं श्रमो॒ धर्म॑श्च॒ कर्म॑ च ।
भू॒तं भ॑वि॒ष्यदुच्छि॑ष्टे वी॒र्यं ल॒क्ष्मीर्बलं॒ बले॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛtaṃ satyaṃ tapo rāsṭraṃ śramo dharmaśca karma ca |
bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyaducchiṣṭe vīryaṃ lakṣmīrbalaṃ bale ||

verses.sanskrit:
समृ॑द्धि॒रोज॒ आकू॑तिः क्ष॒त्रं रा॒ष्ट्रं षडु॒र्व्यः ।
सं॒व॒त्स॒रोऽध्युच्छि॑ष्ट इडा॑ प्रै॒षा ग्रहा॑ ह॒विः ॥
verses.transliteration:
samṛddhiroja ākūtiḥ kṣatraṃ rāṣṭraṃ ṣaḍurvyaḥ |
saṃvatsaro'dhyucchiṣṭa iḍā praiṣā grahā haviḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
चतु॑र्होतार आ॒प्रिय॑श्चातुर्मा॒स्यानि॑ नी॒विदः॑ ।
उच्छि॑ष्टे य॒ज्ञाः होत्राः॑ पशुब॒न्धास्तदिष्ट॑यः ॥
verses.transliteration:
caturhotāra āpriyaścāturmāsyāni nīvidaḥ |
ucchiṣṭe yajñāḥ hotrāḥ paśubandhāstadiṣṭayaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒र्ध॒मा॒साश्च॒ मासा॑श्चार्त॒वा ऋ॒तुभिः॑ स॒ह ।
