Hail to the Fathers who inhabit earth!
Hail to the Fathers who inhabit the firmament!
Hail to the Fathers who dwell in heaven!
Hail, Fathers, to your energy! Hail, Fathers, to your sap!
Hail Father; to your wrath! Hail, Fathers, to your ardour!
Hail, Fathers, to what is awful! Hail to what is terrible in you!’
Hail, Fathers, to all that is propitious! Hail to all that is plea-sant in you!
Homage to you Fathers! Hail to you, Fathers!
All Fathers who are here, the Fathers here are you: let then-follow you. May ye be the most excellent of these.
All living fathers who are here are we here: let them follow us.
May we be the most excellent of these.
Bright Agni, we will kindle thee, rich in thy splendour, fading. not.
So that this glorious fuel may send forth to heaven its light for thee. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
Within the waters runs the Moon, the strong-winged Eagle soars. in heaven.
Ye Lightnings with your golden wheels, men find not your abid-ing-place. Hear this my call,
O Heaven and Earth.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वा य॒ज्ञमृ॒तवः॑ कल्पयन्ति ह॒विः पु॑रो॒डाशं॑ स्रु॒चो य॑ज्ञायु॒धानि॑ ।
तेभि॑र्याहि प॒थिभि॑र्देव॒यानै॒र्यैरी॑जा॒नाः स्व॒र्गं यन्ति॑ लो॒कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
devā yajñamṛtavaḥ kalpayanti haviḥ puroḍāśaṃ sruco yajñāyudhāni |
tebhiryāhi pathibhirdevayānairyairījānāḥ svargaṃ yanti lokam ||

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒तस्य॒ पन्था॒मनु॑ पश्य सा॒ध्वङ्गि॑रसः सु॒कृतो॑ येन॒ यन्ति॑ ।
तेभि॑र्याहि प॒थिभिः॑ स्व॒र्गं यत्रा॑दि॒त्या मधु॑ भ॒क्षय॑न्ति तृ॒तीये॒ नाके॒ अधि॒ वि श्र॑यस्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛtasya panthāmanu paśya sādhvaṅgirasaḥ sukṛto yena yanti |
tebhiryāhi pathibhiḥ svargaṃ yatrādityā madhu bhakṣayanti tṛtīye nāke adhi vi śrayasva ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्रयः॑ सुप॒र्णा उप॑रस्य मा॒यू नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठे अधि॑ वि॒ष्टपि॑ श्रि॒ताः ।
स्व॒र्गा लो॒का अ॒मृते॑न वि॒ष्ठा इष॒मूर्जं॒ यज॑मानाय दुह्राम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
trayaḥ suparṇā uparasya māyū nākasya pṛṣṭhe adhi viṣṭapi śritāḥ |
svargā lokā amṛtena viṣṭhā iṣamūrjaṃ yajamānāya duhrām ||

verses.sanskrit:
जु॒हूर्दा॑धार॒ द्यामु॑प॒भृद॒न्तरि॑क्षं ध्रु॒वा दा॑धार पृथि॒वीं प्र॑ति॒ष्ठाम् ।
प्रती॒मां लो॒का घृ॒तपृ॑ष्ठाः स्व॒र्गाः कामं॑कामं॒ यज॑मानाय दुह्राम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
juhūrdādhāra dyāmupabhṛdantarikṣaṃ dhruvā dādhāra pṛthivīṃ pratiṣṭhām |
pratīmāṃ lokā ghṛtapṛṣṭhāḥ svargāḥ kāmaṃkāmaṃ yajamānāya duhrām ||

verses.sanskrit:
ध्रुव॒ आ रो॑ह पृथि॒वीं वि॒श्वभो॑जसम॒न्तरि॑क्षमुपभृदा क्र॑मस्व ।
जुहु॒ द्यां ग॑च्छ॒ यज॑मानेन सा॒कं स्रु॒वेण॑ व॒त्सेन॒ दिशः॒ प्रपी॑नाः॒ सर्वा॑ धु॒क्ष्वाहृ॑ण्यमानः ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhruva ā roha pṛthivīṃ viśvabhojasamantarikṣamupabhṛdā kramasva |
juhu dyāṃ gaccha yajamānena sākaṃ sruveṇa vatsena diśaḥ prapīnāḥ sarvā dhukṣvāhṛṇyamānaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ती॒र्थैस्त॑रन्ति प्र॒वतो॑ म॒हीरिति॑ यज्ञ॒कृतः॑ सु॒कृतो॒ येन॒ यन्ति॑ ।
अत्रा॑दधु॒र्यज॑मानाय लो॒कं दिशो॑ भू॒तानि॒ यदक॑ल्पयन्त ॥
verses.transliteration:
tīrthaistaranti pravato mahīriti yajñakṛtaḥ sukṛto yena yanti |
atrādadhuryajamānāya lokaṃ diśo bhūtāni yadakalpayanta ||

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गि॑रसा॒मय॑नं॒ पूर्वो॑ अ॒ग्निरा॑दि॒त्याना॒मय॑नं॒ गार्ह॑पत्यो॒ दक्षि॑णाना॒मय॑नं दक्षिणा॒ग्निः ।
म॒हि॒मान॑म॒ग्नेर्विहि॑तस्य॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ सम॑ङ्गः॒ सर्व॒ उप॑ याहि श॒ग्मः ॥
verses.transliteration:
aṅgirasāmayanaṃ pūrvo agnirādityānāmayanaṃ gārhapatyo dakṣiṇānāmayanaṃ dakṣiṇāgniḥ |
mahimānamagnervihitasya brahmaṇā samaṅgaḥ sarva upa yāhi śagmaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
पूर्वो॑ अ॒ग्निष्ट्वा॑ तपतु॒ शं पु॒रस्ता॒च्छं प॒श्चात् त॑पतु॒ गार्ह॑पत्यः ।
द॒क्षि॒णा॒ग्निष्टे॑ तपतु॒ शर्म॒ वर्मो॑त्तर॒तो म॑ध्य॒तो अ॒न्तरि॑क्षाद् दि॒शोदि॑शो अग्ने॒ परि॑ पाहि घो॒रात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pūrvo agniṣṭvā tapatu śaṃ purastācchaṃ paścāt tapatu gārhapatyaḥ |
dakṣiṇāgniṣṭe tapatu śarma varmottarato madhyato antarikṣād diśodiśo agne pari pāhi ghorāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
यू॒यम॑ग्ने॒ शंत॑माभिस्त॒नूभि॑रीजा॒नम॒भि लो॒कं स्व॒र्गम् ।
अश्वा॑ भू॒त्वा पृ॑ष्टि॒वाहो॑ वहाथ॒ यत्र॑ दे॒वैः स॑ध॒मादं॒ मद॑न्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yūyamagne śaṃtamābhistanūbhirījānamabhi lokaṃ svargam |
aśvā bhūtvā pṛṣṭivāho vahātha yatra devaiḥ sadhamādaṃ madanti ||

verses.sanskrit:
शम॑ग्ने प॒श्चात् त॑प॒ शं पु॒रस्ता॒च्छमु॑त्त॒राच्छम॑ध॒रात् त॑पैनम् ।
एक॑स्त्रे॒धा विहि॑तो जातवेदः स॒म्यगे॑नं धेहि सु॒कृता॑मु लो॒के ॥
verses.transliteration:

verses.sanskrit:
शम॒ग्नयः॒ समि॑द्धा॒ आ र॑भन्तां प्राजाप॒त्यं मेध्यं॑ जा॒तवे॑दसः ।
शृ॒तं कृ॒ण्वन्त॑ इ॒ह माव॑ चिक्षिपन् ॥
verses.transliteration:

śṛtaṃ kṛṇvanta iha māva cikṣipan ||

तम॒ग्नयः॒ सर्व॑हुतं जुषन्तां प्राजाप॒त्यं मेध्यं॑ जा॒तवे॑दसः ॥
verses.transliteration:

tamagnayaḥ sarvahutaṃ juṣantāṃ prājāpatyaṃ medhyaṃ jātavedasaḥ ||

तस्मै॒ प्र भा॑ति॒ नभ॑सो॒ ज्योति॑षीमान्त्स्व॒र्गः पन्थाः॑ सु॒कृते॑ देव॒यानः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:

tasmai pra bhāti nabhaso jyotiṣīmāntsvargaḥ panthāḥ sukṛte devayānaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निर्होता॑ध्व॒र्युष्टे॒ बह॒स्पति॒रिन्द्रो॑ ब्र॒ह्मा द॑क्षिण॒तस्ते॑ अस्तु ।
हु॒तोऽयं संस्थि॑तो य॒ज्ञ ए॑ति॒ यत्र॒ पूर्व॒मय॑नं हु॒ताना॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnirhotādhvaryuṣṭe bahaspatirindro brahmā dakṣiṇataste astu |
huto'yaṃ saṃsthito yajña eti yatra pūrvamayanaṃ hutānām ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पू॒पवा॑न् क्षी॒रवां॑श्च॒रुरेह सी॑दतु ।
लो॒क॒कृतः॑ पथि॒कृतो॑ यजामहे॒ ये दे॒वानां॑ हु॒तभा॑गा इ॒ह स्थ ॥

लो॒क॒कृतः॑ पथि॒कृतो॑ यजामहे॒ ये दे॒वानां॑ हु॒तभा॑गा इ॒ह स्थ ॥

verses.transliteration:

अ॒पू॒पवा॒नप॑वांश्च॒रुरेह सी॑दतु ।
लो॒क॒कृतः॑ पथि॒कृतो॑ यजामहे॒ ये दे॒वानां॑ हु॒तभा॑गा इ॒ह स्थ ॥
verses.transliteration:
apūpavānapavāṃścarureha sīdatu |
lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पू॒पापि॑हितान् कु॒म्भान् यांस्ते॑ दे॒वा अधा॑रयन् ।
ते ते॑ सन्तु स्व॒धाव॑न्तो॒ मधु॑मन्तो घृत॒श्चुतः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
apūpāpihitān kumbhān yāṃste devā adhārayan |
te te santu svadhāvanto madhumanto ghṛtaścutaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यास्ते॑ धा॒ना अ॑नुकि॒रामि॑ ति॒लमि॑श्राः स्व॒धाव॑तीः ।
तास्ते॑ सन्तू॒द्भ्वीः प्र॒भ्वीस्तास्ते॑ य॒मो राजानु॑ मन्यताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāste dhānā anukirāmi tilamiśrāḥ svadhāvatīḥ |
tāste santūdbhvīḥ prabhvīstāste yamo rājānu manyatām ||

verses.sanskrit: अक्षि॑तिं॒ भूय॑सीम् ॥
verses.transliteration: akṣitiṃ bhūyasīm ||

verses.sanskrit:
द्र॒प्सश्च॑स्कन्द पृथि॒वीमनु॒ द्यामि॒मं च॒ योनि॒मनु॒ यश्च॒ पूर्वः॑ ।
स॒मा॒नं योनि॒मनु॑ सं॒चर॑न्तं द्र॒प्सं जु॑हो॒म्यनु॑ स॒प्त होत्राः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
drapsaścaskanda pṛthivīmanu dyāmimaṃ ca yonimanu yaśca pūrvaḥ |
samānaṃ yonimanu saṃcarantaṃ drapsaṃ juhomyanu sapta hotrāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
श॒तधा॑रं वा॒युम॒र्कं स्व॒र्विदं॑ नृ॒चक्ष॑स॒स्ते अ॒भि च॑क्षते र॒यिम् ।
ये पृ॒णन्ति॒ प्र च॒ यच्छ॑न्ति सर्व॒दा ते दु॑ह्रते॒ दक्षि॑णां स॒प्तमा॑तरम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śatadhāraṃ vāyumarkaṃ svarvidaṃ nṛcakṣasaste abhi cakṣate rayim |
ye pṛṇanti pra ca yacchanti sarvadā te duhrate dakṣiṇāṃ saptamātaram ||

verses.sanskrit:
कोशं॑ दुहन्ति क॒लशं॒ चतु॑र्बिल॒मिडां॑ धे॒नुं मधु॑मतीं स्व॒स्तये॑ ।
ऊर्जं॒ मद॑न्ती॒मदि॑तिं॒ जने॒ष्वग्ने॒ मा हिं॑सीः पर॒मे व्योऽमन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
kośaṃ duhanti kalaśaṃ caturbilamiḍāṃ dhenuṃ madhumatīṃ svastaye |
ūrjaṃ madantīmaditiṃ janeṣvagne mā hiṃsīḥ parame vyo'man ||

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒तत् ते॑ दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता वासो॑ ददाति॒ भर्त॑वे ।
तत् त्वं य॒मस्य॒ राज्ये॒ वसा॑नस्ता॒र्प्यंऽ चर ॥
verses.transliteration:
etat te devaḥ savitā vāso dadāti bhartave |
tat tvaṃ yamasya rājye vasānastārpyaṃ' cara ||

verses.sanskrit:
धा॒ना धे॒नुर॑भवद् व॒त्सो अ॑स्यास्ति॒लोऽभवत् ।
तां वै य॒मस्य॒ राज्ये॒ अक्षि॑ता॒मुप॑ जीवति ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhānā dhenurabhavad vatso asyāstilo'bhavat |
tāṃ vai yamasya rājye akṣitāmupa jīvati ||

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒तास्ते॑ असौ धे॒नवः॑ काम॒दुघा॑ भवन्तु ।
एनीः॒ श्येनीः॒ सरू॑पा॒ विरू॑पास्ति॒लव॑त्सा॒ उप॑ तिष्ठन्तु॒ त्वात्र॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
etāste asau dhenavaḥ kāmadughā bhavantu |
enīḥ śyenīḥ sarūpā virūpāstilavatsā upa tiṣṭhantu tvātra ||

verses.sanskrit:
एनी॒र्धा॒ना हरि॑णीः॒ श्येनी॑रस्य कृ॒ष्णा धा॒ना रोहि॑णीर्धे॒नव॑स्ते ।
ति॒लव॑त्सा॒ ऊर्ज॑म॒स्मै दुहा॑ना वि॒श्वाहा॑ सन्त्वनप॒स्फुर॑न्तीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
enīrdhānā hariṇīḥ śyenīrasya kṛṣṇā dhānā rohiṇīrdhenavaste |
tilavatsā ūrjamasmai duhānā viśvāhā santvanapasphurantīḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रे ह॒विरि॒दं जु॑होमि साह॒स्रं श॒तधा॑र॒मुत्स॑म् ।
स बि॑भर्ति पि॒तरं॑ पिताम॒हान् प्र॑पिताम॒हान् बि॑भर्ति॒ पिन्व॑मानः ॥
verses.transliteration:
vaiśvānare haviridaṃ juhomi sāhasraṃ śatadhāramutsam |
sa bibharti pitaraṃ pitāmahān prapitāmahān bibharti pinvamānaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒हस्र॑धारं श॒तधा॑र॒मुत्स॒मक्षि॑तं व्य॒च्यमा॑नं सलि॒लस्य॑ पृ॒ष्ठे ।
ऊर्जं॒ दुहा॑नमनप॒स्फुर॑न्त॒मुपा॑सते पि॒तरः॑ स्व॒धाभिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sahasradhāraṃ śatadhāramutsamakṣitaṃ vyacyamānaṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe |
ūrjaṃ duhānamanapasphurantamupāsate pitaraḥ svadhābhiḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं कसा॑म्बु॒ चय॑नेन चि॒तं तत् स॑जाता॒ अव॑ पश्य॒तेत॑ ।
मर्त्यो॒ऽयम॑मृत॒त्वमे॑ति॒ तस्मै॑ गृ॒हान् कृ॑णुत याव॒त्सब॑न्धु ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ kasāmbu cayanena citaṃ tat sajātā ava paśyateta |
martyo'yamamṛtatvameti tasmai gṛhān kṛṇuta yāvatsabandhu ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒हैवैधि॑ धन॒सनि॑रि॒हचि॑त्त इ॒हक्र॑तुः ।
इ॒हैधि॑ वी॒र्यऽवत्तरो वयो॒धा अप॑राहतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ihaivaidhi dhanasanirihacitta ihakratuḥ |
ihaidhi vīrya'vattaro vayodhā aparāhataḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
पु॒त्रं पौत्र॑मभित॒र्पय॑न्ती॒रापो॒ मधु॑मतीरि॒माः ।
स्व॒धां पि॒तृभ्यो॑ अ॒मृतं॒ दुहा॑ना॒ आपो॑ दे॒वीरु॒भयां॑स्तर्पयन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
putraṃ pautramabhitarpayantīrāpo madhumatīrimāḥ |
svadhāṃ pitṛbhyo amṛtaṃ duhānā āpo devīrubhayāṃstarpayantu ||

verses.sanskrit:
आपो॑ अ॒ग्निं प्र हि॑णुत पि॒तॄंरुपे॒मं य॒ज्ञं पि॒तरो॑ मे जुषन्ताम् ।
आसी॑ना॒मूर्ज॒मुप॒ ये सच॑न्ते॒ ते नो॑ र॒यिं सर्व॑वीरं॒ नि य॑च्छान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
āpo agniṃ pra hiṇuta pitṝṃrupemaṃ yajñaṃ pitaro me juṣantām |
āsīnāmūrjamupa ye sacante te no rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ ni yacchān ||

verses.sanskrit:
समि॑न्धते॒ अम॑र्त्यं हव्य॒वाहं॑ घृत॒प्रिय॑म् ।
स वे॑द॒ निहि॑तान्नि॒धीन् पि॒तॄ॒न् प॑रा॒वतो॑ ग॒तान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
samindhate amartyaṃ havyavāhaṃ ghṛtapriyam |
sa veda nihitānnidhīn pitṝn parāvato gatān ||

verses.sanskrit:
यं ते॑ म॒न्थं यमो॑द॒नं यन्मां॒सं नि॑पृ॒णामि॑ ते ।
ते ते॑ सन्तु स्व॒धाव॑न्तो॒ मधु॑मन्तो घृत॒श्चुतः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaṃ te manthaṃ yamodanaṃ yanmāṃsaṃ nipṛṇāmi te |
te te santu svadhāvanto madhumanto ghṛtaścutaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यास्ते॑ धा॒ना अ॑नुकि॒रामि॑ ति॒लमि॑श्राः स्व॒धाव॑तीः ।
तास्ते॑ सन्तू॒द्भ्वीः प्र॒भ्वीस्तास्ते॑ य॒मो राजानु॑ मन्यताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāste dhānā anukirāmi tilamiśrāḥ svadhāvatīḥ |
tāste santūdbhvīḥ prabhvīstāste yamo rājānu manyatām ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं पूर्व॒मप॑रं नि॒यानं॒ येना॑ ते॒ पूर्वे॑ पि॒तरः॒ परे॑ताः ।
पु॒रो॒ग॒वा ये अ॑भि॒शाचो॑ अस्य॒ ते त्वा॑ वहन्ति सु॒कृता॑मु लो॒कम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ pūrvamaparaṃ niyānaṃ yenā te pūrve pitaraḥ paretāḥ |
purogavā ye abhiśāco asya te tvā vahanti sukṛtāmu lokam ||

verses.sanskrit:
सर॑स्वतीं देव॒यन्तो॑ हवन्ते॒ सर॑स्वतीमध्व॒रे ता॒यमा॑ने ।
सर॑स्वतीं सु॒कृतो॑ हवन्ते॒ सर॑स्वती दा॒शुषे॑ वार्यं॑ दात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarasvatīṃ devayanto havante sarasvatīmadhvare tāyamāne |
sarasvatīṃ sukṛto havante sarasvatī dāśuṣe vāryaṃ dāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
सर॑स्वतीं पि॒तरो॑ हवन्ते दक्षि॒णा य॒ज्ञम॑भि॒नक्ष॑माणाः ।
आ॒सद्या॒स्मिन् ब॒र्हिषि॑ मादयध्वमनमी॒वा इष॒ आ धे॑ह्य॒स्मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarasvatīṃ pitaro havante dakṣiṇā yajñamabhinakṣamāṇāḥ |
āsadyāsmin barhiṣi mādayadhvamanamīvā iṣa ā dhehyasme ||

verses.sanskrit:
सर॑स्वति॒ या स॒रथं॑ य॒याथो॒क्थैः स्व॒धाभि॑र्देवि पि॒तृभि॒र्मद॑न्ती ।
स॒ह॒स्रा॒र्घमि॒डो अत्र॑ भा॒गं रा॒यस्पोषं॒ यज॑मानाय धेहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarasvati yā sarathaṃ yayāthokthaiḥ svadhābhirdevi pitṛbhirmadantī |
sahasrārghamiḍo atra bhāgaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ yajamānāya dhehi ||

verses.sanskrit:
पृ॒थि॒वीं त्वा॑ पृथि॒व्यामा वे॑शयामि दे॒वो नो॑ धा॒ता प्र ति॑रा॒त्यायुः॑ ।
परा॑परैता वसु॒विद् वो अ॒स्त्वधा॑ मृ॒ताः पि॒तृषु॒ सं भ॑वन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
pṛthivīṃ tvā pṛthivyāmā veśayāmi devo no dhātā pra tirātyāyuḥ |
parāparaitā vasuvid vo astvadhā mṛtāḥ pitṛṣu saṃ bhavantu ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ प्र च्य॑वेथा॒मप॒ तन्मृ॑जेथां॒ यद् वा॑मभि॒भा अत्रो॒चुः ।
अ॒स्मादेत॑म॒घ्न्यौ तद् वशी॑यो दा॒तुः पि॒तृष्वि॒हभो॑जनौ॒ मम॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā pra cyavethāmapa tanmṛjethāṃ yad vāmabhibhā atrocuḥ |
asmādetamaghnyau tad vaśīyo dātuḥ pitṛṣvihabhojanau mama ||

verses.sanskrit:
एयम॑ग॒न् दक्षि॑णा भद्र॒तो नो॑ अ॒नेन॑ द॒त्ता सु॒दुघा॑ वयो॒धाः ।
यौव॑ने जी॒वानु॑प॒पृञ्च॑ती ज॒रा पि॒तृभ्य॑ उप॒संप॑राणयादि॒मान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
eyamagan dakṣiṇā bhadrato no anena dattā sudughā vayodhāḥ |
yauvane jīvānupapṛñcatī jarā pitṛbhya upasaṃparāṇayādimān ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं पि॒तृभ्यः॒ प्र भ॑रामि ब॒र्हिर्जी॒वं दे॒वेभ्य॒ उत्त॑रं स्तृणामि ।
तदा रो॑ह पुरुष॒ मेध्यो॒ भव॒न् प्रति॑ त्वा जानन्तु पि॒तरः॒ परे॑तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ pra bharāmi barhirjīvaṃ devebhya uttaraṃ stṛṇāmi |
tadā roha puruṣa medhyo bhavan prati tvā jānantu pitaraḥ paretam ||

verses.sanskrit:
एदं ब॒र्हिर॑सदो॒ मेध्यो॑ऽभूः॒ प्रति॑ त्वा जानन्तु पि॒तरः॒ परे॑तम् ।
य॒था॒प॒रु त॒न्वं॑१ सं भ॑रस्व॒ गात्रा॑णि ते॒ ब्रह्म॑णा कल्पयामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
edaṃ barhirasado medhyo'bhūḥ prati tvā jānantu pitaraḥ paretam |
yathāparu tanvaṃ saṃ bharasva gātrāṇi te brahmaṇā kalpayāmi ||

verses.sanskrit:
प॒र्णो राजा॑पि॒धानं॑ चरू॒णामू॒र्जो बलं॒ सह॒ ओजो॑ न॒ आग॑न् ।
आयु॑र्जी॒वेभ्यो॒ विद॑धद् दीर्घायु॒त्वाय॑ श॒तशा॑रदाय ॥
verses.transliteration:
parṇo rājāpidhānaṃ carūṇāmūrjo balaṃ saha ojo na āgan |
āyurjīvebhyo vidadhad dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya ||

verses.sanskrit:
ऊ॒र्जो भा॒गो य इ॒मं ज॒जानाश्मान्ना॑ना॒माधि॑पत्यं ज॒गाम॑ ।
तम॑र्चत वि॒श्वमि॑त्रा ह॒विर्भिः॒ स नो॑ य॒मः प्र॑त॒रं जी॒वसे॑ धात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ūrjo bhāgo ya imaṃ jajānāśmānnānāmādhipatyaṃ jagāma |
tamarcata viśvamitrā havirbhiḥ sa no yamaḥ prataraṃ jīvase dhāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
यथा॑ य॒माय॑ ह॒र्म्यमव॑प॒न् पञ्च॑ मान॒वाः ।
ए॒वा व॑पामि ह॒र्म्यं यथा॑ मे॒ भूर॒योऽस॑त ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathā yamāya harmyamavapan pañca mānavāḥ |
evā vapāmi harmyaṃ yathā me bhūrayo'sata ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं हिर॑ण्यं बिभृहि॒ यत् ते॑ पि॒ताबि॑भः पु॒रा ।
स्व॒र्गं य॒तः पि॒तुर्हस्तं॒ निर्मृ॑ड्ढि॒ दक्षि॑णम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ hiraṇyaṃ bibhṛhi yat te pitābibhaḥ purā |
svargaṃ yataḥ piturhastaṃ nirmṛḍḍhi dakṣiṇam ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये च॑ जी॒वा ये च॑ मृ॒ता ये जा॒ता ये च॑ य॒ज्ञियाः॑ ।
तेभ्यो॑ घृ॒तस्य॑ कु॒ल्यैऽतु॒ मधु॑धारा व्युन्द॒ती ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye ca jīvā ye ca mṛtā ye jātā ye ca yajñiyāḥ |
tebhyo ghṛtasya kulyai'tu madhudhārā vyundatī ||

verses.sanskrit:
वृषा॑ मती॒नां प॑वते विचक्ष॒णः सूरो॒ अह्नां॑ प्र॒तरी॑तो॒षसां॑ दि॒वः ।
प्रा॒णः सिन्धू॑नां क॒लशाँ॑ अचिक्रद॒दिन्द्र॑स्य॒ हार्दि॑मावि॒शन् म॑नी॒षया॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vṛṣā matīnāṃ pavate vicakṣaṇaḥ sūro ahnāṃ pratarītoṣasāṃ divaḥ |
prāṇaḥ sindhūnāṃ kalaśām̐ acikradadindrasya hārdimāviśan manīṣayā ||

verses.sanskrit:
त्वे॒षस्ते॑ धू॒म ऊ॑र्णोतु दि॒वि षंच्छु॒क्र आत॑तः ।
सूरो॒ न हि द्यु॒ता त्वं कृ॒पा पावक॒ रोच॑से ॥
verses.transliteration:
tveṣaste dhūma ūrṇotu divi ṣaṃcchukra ātataḥ |
sūro na hi dyutā tvaṃ kṛpā pāvaka rocase ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र वा ए॒तीन्दु॒रिन्द्र॑स्य॒ निष्कृ॑तिं॒ सखा॒ सख्यु॒र्न प्र मि॑नाति संगि॒रः ।
मर्य॑ इव॒ योषाः॒ सम॑र्षसे॒ सोमः॑ क॒लशे॑ श॒तया॑मना प॒था ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra vā etīndurindrasya niṣkṛtiṃ sakhā sakhyurna pra mināti saṃgiraḥ |
marya iva yoṣāḥ samarṣase somaḥ kalaśe śatayāmanā pathā ||

verses.sanskrit:
अक्ष॒न्नमी॑मदन्त॒ ह्यव॑ प्रि॒यां अ॑धूषत ।
अस्तो॑षत॒ स्वभा॑नवो॒ विप्रा॒ यवि॑ष्ठा ईमहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
akṣannamīmadanta hyava priyāṃ adhūṣata |
astoṣata svabhānavo viprā yaviṣṭhā īmahe ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ या॑त पितरः सो॒म्यासो॑ गम्भी॒रैः प॒थिभिः॑ पितृ॒याणैः॑ ।
आयु॑र॒स्मभ्यं॒ दध॑तः प्र॒जां च॑ रा॒यश्च॒ पोषै॑र॒भि नः॑ सचध्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā yāta pitaraḥ somyāso gambhīraiḥ pathibhiḥ pitṛyāṇaiḥ |
āyurasmabhyaṃ dadhataḥ prajāṃ ca rāyaśca poṣairabhi naḥ sacadhvam ||

verses.sanskrit:
परा॑ यात पितरः सो॒म्यासो॑ गम्भी॒रैः प॒थिभिः॑ पू॒र्याणैः॑ ।
अधा॑ मा॒सि पुन॒रा या॑त नो गृ॒हान् ह॒विरत्तुं॑ सुप्र॒जसः॑ सु॒वीराः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
parā yāta pitaraḥ somyāso gambhīraiḥ pathibhiḥ pūryāṇaiḥ |
adhā māsi punarā yāta no gṛhān havirattuṃ suprajasaḥ suvīrāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यद् वो अ॒ग्निरज॑हा॒देक॒मङ्गं॑ पितृलो॒कं ग॒मयं॑ जा॒तवे॑दाः ।
तद् व॑ ए॒तत् पुन॒रा प्या॑ययामि सा॒ङ्गाः स्व॒र्गे पि॒तरो॑ मादयध्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yad vo agnirajahādekamaṅgaṃ pitṛlokaṃ gamayaṃ jātavedāḥ |
tad va etat punarā pyāyayāmi sāṅgāḥ svarge pitaro mādayadhvam ||

verses.sanskrit:
अभू॑द् दू॒तः प्रहि॑तो जा॒तवे॑दाः सा॒यं न्यह्न॑ उप॒वन्द्यो॒ नृभिः॑ ।
प्रादाः॑ पि॒तृभ्यः॑ स्व॒धया॒ ते अ॑क्षन्न॒द्धि त्वं दे॑व॒ प्रय॑ता ह॒वींषि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhūd dūtaḥ prahito jātavedāḥ sāyaṃ nyahna upavandyo nṛbhiḥ |
prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣannaddhi tvaṃ deva prayatā havīṃṣi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒सौ हा इ॒ह ते॒ मनः॒ ककु॑त्सलमिव जा॒मयः॑ ।
अ॒भ्येऽनं भूम ऊर्णुहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
asau hā iha te manaḥ kakutsalamiva jāmayaḥ |
abhye'naṃ bhūma ūrṇuhi ||

verses.sanskrit: शुम्भ॑न्तां लो॒काः पि॑तृ॒षद॑नाः पितृ॒षद॑ने त्वा लो॒क आ सा॑दयामि ॥
verses.transliteration: śumbhantāṃ lokāḥ pitṛṣadanāḥ pitṛṣadane tvā loka ā sādayāmi ||

verses.sanskrit: ये॒३स्माकं॑ पि॒तर॒स्तेषां॑ ब॒र्हिर॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration: yesmākaṃ pitarasteṣāṃ barhirasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
उदु॑त्त॒मं व॑रुण॒ पाश॑म॒स्मदवा॑ध॒मं वि म॑ध्य॒मं श्र॑थाय ।
अधा॑ व॒यमा॑दित्य व्र॒ते तवाना॑गसो॒ अदि॑तये स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration:
uduttamaṃ varuṇa pāśamasmadavādhamaṃ vi madhyamaṃ śrathāya |
adhā vayamāditya vrate tavānāgaso aditaye syāma ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्रास्मत् पाशा॑न् वरुण मुञ्च॒ सर्वा॒न् यैः स॑मा॒मे ब॒ध्यते॒ यैर्व्या॒मे ।
अधा॑ जीवेम श॒रदं॑ श॒तानि॒ त्वया॑ राजन् गुपि॒ता रक्ष॑माणाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
prāsmat pāśān varuṇa muñca sarvān yaiḥ samāme badhyate yairvyāme |
adhā jīvema śaradaṃ śatāni tvayā rājan gupitā rakṣamāṇāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नये॑ कव्य॒वाह॑नाय स्व॒धा नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: सोमा॑य पि॒तृम॑ते स्व॒धा नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: somāya pitṛmate svadhā namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: पि॒तृभ्यः॒ सोम॑वद्भ्यः स्व॒धा नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: pitṛbhyaḥ somavadbhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: य॒माय॑ पि॒तृम॑ते स्व॒धा नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yamāya pitṛmate svadhā namaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: ए॒तत् ते॑ प्रततामह स्व॒धा ये च॒ त्वामनु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: etat te pratatāmaha svadhā ye ca tvāmanu ||

verses.sanskrit: ए॒त् ते॑ ततामह स्व॒धा ये च॒ त्वामनु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: et te tatāmaha svadhā ye ca tvāmanu ||

verses.sanskrit: ए॒तत् ते॑ तत स्व॒धा ॥
verses.transliteration: etat te tata svadhā ||

verses.sanskrit: स्व॒धा पि॒तृभ्यः॑ पृथिवि॒षद्भ्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ pṛthiviṣadbhyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: स्व॒धा पि॒तृभ्यो॑ अन्तरिक्ष॒सद्भ्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: svadhā pitṛbhyo antarikṣasadbhyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: स्व॒धा पि॒तृभ्यो॑ दिवि॒षद्भ्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: svadhā pitṛbhyo diviṣadbhyaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ वः पितर ऊ॒र्जे नमो॑ वः पितरो॒ रसा॑य ॥
verses.transliteration: namo vaḥ pitara ūrje namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya ||

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ वः पितरो॒ भामा॑य॒ नमो॑ वः पितरो म॒न्यवे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: namo vaḥ pitaro bhāmāya namo vaḥ pitaro manyave ||

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ वः पितरो॒ यद् घोरं तस्मै॒ नमो॑ वः पितरो॒ यत् क्रू॒रं तस्मै॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: namo vaḥ pitaro yad ghoraṃ tasmai namo vaḥ pitaro yat krūraṃ tasmai ||

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ वः पितरो॒ यच्छि॒वं तस्मै॒ नमो॑ वः पितरो॒ यत् स्यो॒नं तस्मै॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: namo vaḥ pitaro yacchivaṃ tasmai namo vaḥ pitaro yat syonaṃ tasmai ||

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ वः पितरः स्व॒धा वः॑ पितरः ॥
verses.transliteration: namo vaḥ pitaraḥ svadhā vaḥ pitaraḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: येऽत्र॑ पि॒तरः॑ पि॒तरो॒ येऽत्र॑ यू॒यं स्थ यु॒ष्मांस्तेऽनु॑ यू॒यं तेषां॒ श्रेष्ठा॑ भूयास्थ ॥
verses.transliteration: ye'tra pitaraḥ pitaro ye'tra yūyaṃ stha yuṣmāṃste'nu yūyaṃ teṣāṃ śreṣṭhā bhūyāstha ||

verses.sanskrit:
य इ॒ह पि॒तरो॑ जी॒वा इ॒ह व॒यं स्मः॑ ।
अ॒स्मांस्तेऽनु॑ व॒यं तेषां॒ श्रेष्ठा॑ भूयास्म ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya iha pitaro jīvā iha vayaṃ smaḥ |
asmāṃste'nu vayaṃ teṣāṃ śreṣṭhā bhūyāsma ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ त्वा॑ग्न इधीमहि द्यु॒मन्तं॑ देवा॒जर॑म् ।
यद् घ॒ सा ते॒ पनी॑यसी स॒मिद् दी॒दय॑ति॒ द्यवि॑ ।
इषं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā tvāgna idhīmahi dyumantaṃ devājaram |
yad gha sā te panīyasī samid dīdayati dyavi |
iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||

verses.sanskrit:
च॒न्द्रमा॑ अ॒प्स्व॑१न्तरा सु॑प॒र्णो धा॑वते दि॒वि ।
न वो॑ हिरण्यनेमयः प॒दं वि॑न्दन्ति विद्युतो वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी ॥
verses.transliteration:
candramā apsvantarā suparṇo dhāvate divi |
na vo hiraṇyanemayaḥ padaṃ vindanti vidyuto vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

verses.sanskrit:
सं सं स्र॑वन्तु न॒द्यः॑१ सं वाताः॒ सं प॑त॒त्रिणः॑ ।
य॒ज्ञमि॒मं व॑र्धयता गिरः संस्रा॒व्येऽण ह॒विषा॑ जुहोमि ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ saṃ sravantu nadyaḥ saṃ vātāḥ saṃ patatriṇaḥ |
yajñamimaṃ vardhayatā giraḥ saṃsrāvye'ṇa haviṣā juhomi ||
verses.translation:
An accompaniment to the offering of a Mixt Oblation
Let the streams flow together, let the winds and birds assembled come.
Strengthen this sacrifice of mine, ye singers. I offer up a duly mixt oblation.
O Burnt Oblations, aid, and ye, Blent Offerings, this my sacrifice.
Strengthen this sacrifice of mine, ye singers. I offer up a duly mixt oblation.
Each several form, each several force I seize, and compass round this man.
May the Four Quarters strengthen this my sacrifice. I offer up a duly mixt oblation.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मं होमा॑ य॒ज्ञम॑वते॒मं सं॑स्रावणा उ॒त ।
य॒ज्ञमि॒मं व॑र्धयता गिरः संस्रा॒व्येऽण ह॒विषा॑ जुहोमि ॥
verses.transliteration:
imaṃ homā yajñamavatemaṃ saṃsrāvaṇā uta |
yajñamimaṃ vardhayatā giraḥ saṃsrāvye'ṇa haviṣā juhomi ||

verses.sanskrit:
रू॒पंरू॑पं॒ वयो॑वयः सं॒रभ्यै॑नं॒ परि॑ ष्वजे ।
य॒ज्ञमि॒मं चत॑स्रः प्र॒दिशो॑ वर्धयन्तु संस्रा॒व्येऽण ह॒विषा॑ जुहोमि ॥
verses.transliteration:
rūpaṃrūpaṃ vayovayaḥ saṃrabhyainaṃ pari ṣvaje |
yajñamimaṃ catasraḥ pradiśo vardhayantu saṃsrāvye'ṇa haviṣā juhomi ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं त॒ आपो॑ हैमव॒तीः शमु॑ ते सन्तू॒त्स्याः ।
शं ते॑ सनि॒ष्यदा॒ आपः॒ शमु॑ ते सन्तु व॒र्ष्याः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ ta āpo haimavatīḥ śamu te santūtsyāḥ |
śaṃ te saniṣyadā āpaḥ śamu te santu varṣyāḥ ||
verses.translation:
A hymn to all waters
Blest be the Streams from hills of snow, sweet be spring Waters unto thee.
Sweet be swift-running Waters, sweet to thee be Water of the Rains.
Sweet unto thee be Waters of the waste and Waters of the pool.
Sweet be the Waters dug from earth, to thee, and Waters brought in jars.
To those who delve without a tool to dig, the wise, the deeply moved,
To Waters better healers than physicians we address our prayer.
Bathed in the Waters verily divine, in water of the streams,
Bathed in the Waters verily, O Horses, be ye fleet and strong.
Blest be the Waters unto thee, suspicious Waters, bringing. health.
They cure the injured place for thee even as thy comfort craveth it.

verses.sanskrit:
शं त॒ आपो॑ धन्व॒न्याः॒३ शं ते॑ सन्त्वनू॒प्याः ।
शं ते॑ खनि॒त्रिमा॒ आपः॒ शं याः कु॒म्भेभि॒राभृ॑ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ ta āpo dhanvanyāḥ śaṃ te santvanūpyāḥ |
śaṃ te khanitrimā āpaḥ śaṃ yāḥ kumbhebhirābhṛtāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न॒भ्रयः॒ खन॑माना॒ विप्रा॑ गम्भी॒रे अ॒पसः॑ ।
भि॒षग्भ्यो॑ भि॒षक्त॑रा॒ आपो॒ अच्छा॑ वदामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
anabhrayaḥ khanamānā viprā gambhīre apasaḥ |
bhiṣagbhyo bhiṣaktarā āpo acchā vadāmasi ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पामह॑ दि॒व्याऽनाम॒पां स्रो॑त॒स्याऽनाम् ।
अ॒पामह॑ प्र॒णेज॒नेऽश्वा॑ भवथ वा॒जिनः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
apāmaha divyā'nāmapāṃ srotasyā'nām |
apāmaha praṇejane'śvā bhavatha vājinaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ता अ॒पः शि॒वा अ॒पोऽय॑क्ष्मं॒कर॑णीर॒पः ।
यथै॒व तृ॑प्यते॒ मय॒स्तास्त॒ आ द॑त्त भेष॒जीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tā apaḥ śivā apo'yakṣmaṃkaraṇīrapaḥ |
yathaiva tṛpyate mayastāsta ā datta bheṣajīḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
दि॒वस्पृ॑थि॒व्याः पर्य॒न्तरि॑क्षा॒द् वन॒स्पति॑भ्यो॒ अध्योष॑धीभ्यः ।
यत्र॑यत्र॒ विभृ॑तो जा॒तवे॑दा॒स्तत॑ स्तु॒तो जु॒षमा॑णो न॒ एहि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
divaspṛthivyāḥ paryantarikṣād vanaspatibhyo adhyoṣadhībhyaḥ |
yatrayatra vibhṛto jātavedāstata stuto juṣamāṇo na ehi ||
verses.translation:
A hymn to Agni for protection and prosperity
Whithersoe’er, from sky, earth, air’s mid-regions from plants ands herbs, from tall trees,
Jātavedas.
Is carried here and there to divers places, even thence come thou to us with loving-kindness.
All majesty of thine in floods, in forest, in plants, in cattle, in the depths of waters Closely uniting all thy forms, O Agni, come unto us wealth-giv-ing, undecaying.
Thy majesty among the Gods in Svarga, thy body which hath past into the Fathers.
Thy plenty far-diffused mid human beings, even with this, O Agni, give us riches.
To him the wise, the famous, swift to listen, with words and verses I come nigh for bounty.
May we be safe from threatening danger. Soften by sacrifice the-wrath of Gods, O Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ते॑ अ॒प्सु म॑हि॒मा यो वने॑षु॒ य ओष॑धीषु प॒शुष्व॒प्स्व॑१न्तः ।
अग्ने॒ सर्वा॑स्त॒न्वः॑१ सं र॑भस्व॒ ताभि॑र्न॒ एहि॑ द्रविणो॒दा अज॑स्रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaste apsu mahimā yo vaneṣu ya oṣadhīṣu paśuṣvapsvantaḥ |
agne sarvāstanvaḥ saṃ rabhasva tābhirna ehi draviṇodā ajasraḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ते॑ दे॒वेषु॑ महि॒मा स्व॒र्गो या ते॑ त॒नूः पि॒तृष्वा॑वि॒वेश॑ ।
पुष्टि॒र्या ते॑ मनु॒ष्येऽषु पप्र॒थेऽग्ने॒ तया॑ र॒यिम॒स्मासु॑ धेहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaste deveṣu mahimā svargo yā te tanūḥ pitṛṣvāviveśa |
puṣṭiryā te manuṣye'ṣu paprathe'gne tayā rayimasmāsu dhehi ||

verses.sanskrit:
श्रुत्क॑र्णाय क॒वये॒ वेद्या॑य॒ वचो॑भिर्वा॒कैरुप॑ यामि रा॒तिम् ।
यतो॑ भ॒यमभ॑यं॒ तन्नो॑ अ॒स्त्वव॑ दे॒वानां॑ यज॒ हेडो॑ अग्ने ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrutkarṇāya kavaye vedyāya vacobhirvākairupa yāmi rātim |
yato bhayamabhayaṃ tanno astvava devānāṃ yaja heḍo agne ||

verses.sanskrit:
यामाहु॑तिं प्रथ॒मामथ॑र्वा॒ या जा॒ता या ह॒व्यमकृ॑णोज्जा॒तवे॑दाः ।
तां त॑ ए॒तां प्र॑थ॒मो जो॑हवीमि॒ ताभि॑ष्टु॒प्तो व॑हतु ह॒व्यम॒ग्निर॒ग्नये॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāmāhutiṃ prathamāmatharvā yā jātā yā havyamakṛṇojjātavedāḥ |
tāṃ ta etāṃ prathamo johavīmi tābhiṣṭupto vahatu havyamagniragnaye svāhā ||
verses.translation:
A prayer, accompanying sacrifice, for the attainment of a wish
The first oblation that Atharvan oared, earliest sacrifice paid by Jātavedas,
Even this I, foremost, with repeated worship, now offer unto thee. May Agni carry the sacrificer’s present. Hail to Agni!
In front I set Intention, blessed Goddess. Mother of thought, may she be prompt to hear us.
Mine, and mine only, be the hope I fashion! May I gain this that hath possessed my spirit.
With Purpose, O Prajāpati, with Purpose come thou near to us.
Bestow on us a share of luck, and so be swift to hear our call.
Prajāpati Angirasa with favour regard this word and this my settled purpose!
May he, whence Gods and Deities had being Kāma attend us with his gentle guidance.

verses.sanskrit:
आकू॑तिं दे॒वीं सु॒भगां॑ पु॒रो द॑धे चि॒त्तस्य॑ मा॒ता सु॒हवा॑ नो अस्तु ।
यामा॒शामे॑मि॒ केव॑ली॒ सा मे॑ अस्तु॒ विदे॑यमेनां॒ मन॑सि॒ प्रवि॑ष्टाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ākūtiṃ devīṃ subhagāṃ puro dadhe cittasya mātā suhavā no astu |
yāmāśāmemi kevalī sā me astu videyamenāṃ manasi praviṣṭām ||

verses.sanskrit:
आकू॑त्या नो बृहस्पत॒ आकू॑त्या न॒ उपा ग॑हि ।
अथो॒ भग॑स्य नो धे॒ह्यथो॑ नः सु॒हवो॑ भव ॥
verses.transliteration:
ākūtyā no bṛhaspata ākūtyā na upā gahi |
atho bhagasya no dhehyatho naḥ suhavo bhava ||

verses.sanskrit:
बृह॒स्पति॑र्म॒ आकू॑तिमाङ्गिर॒सः प्रति॑ जानातु॒ वाच॑मे॒ताम् ।
यस्य॑ दे॒वा दे॒वताः॑ संबभू॒वुः स सु॒प्रणी॑ताः॒ कामो॒ अन्वे॑त्व॒स्मान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
bṛhaspatirma ākūtimāṅgirasaḥ prati jānātu vācametām |
yasya devā devatāḥ saṃbabhūvuḥ sa supraṇītāḥ kāmo anvetvasmān ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रो॒ राजा॒ जग॑तश्चर्षणी॒नामधि॒ क्षमि॒ विषु॑रूपं॒ यदस्ति॑ ।
ततो॑ ददाति दा॒शुषे॒ वसू॑नि॒ चोद॒द् राध॒ उप॑स्तुतश्चिद॒र्वाक् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indro rājā jagataścarṣaṇīnāmadhi kṣami viṣurūpaṃ yadasti |
tato dadāti dāśuṣe vasūni codad rādha upastutaścidarvāk ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for riches
King of the living world and men is Indra, of all in varied form that earth containeth.
Thence to the worshipper he giveth riches: may he enrich even us when we have praised him.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒हस्र॑बाहुः॒ पुरु॑षः सहस्रा॒क्षः स॒हस्र॑पात् ।
स भूमिं॑ वि॒श्वतो॑ वृ॒त्वात्य॑तिष्ठद् दशाङ्गु॒लम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sahasrabāhuḥ puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt |
sa bhūmiṃ viśvato vṛtvātyatiṣṭhad daśāṅgulam ||
verses.translation:
The purusha-Sūkta, on the mystical Sacrifice of Purusha
Purusha hath a thousand arms, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet.
On every side pervading earth he fills a space ten fingers wide.
He with three quarters rose to heaven here reappeared a fourth of him.
Thence he strode forth on every side to all that eats not and that eats.
So mighty is his grandeur, yea, greater than this is Purusha.
All creatures are one-fourth of him, three-fourths what dieth not in heaven.
Purusha is in truth this All, what hath been and what yet shall; be Lord, too, of immortality—and what hath grown with some-what else.
When they divided Purusha how many portions did they make?
What was his mouth? what were his arms? what are the names of thighs and feet?
The Brāhman was his mouth, of both his arms was the Rājanya made.
His waist became the Vaisya, from his feet the Sūdra was produced.
The Moon was gendered from his mind, and from his eye the Sun had birth.
Indra and Agni from his mouth were born and Vāyu from his breath.
Forth from his navel come mid-air; the sky was fashioned from his head.
Earth from his feet, and from his ear the regions. Thus they formed the worlds.
In the beginning rose Virāj: Purusha from Virāj was born.
As soon as he was born he spread westward and eastward o’er the earth.
When Gods performed the sacrifice with Purusha as their offering.
Spring was the butter, summer was the fuel, autumn was the gift.
That sacrifice, first-born Purusha, they hallowed with the sprink-led Rains.
The Deities, the Sādhyas, all the Vasus sacrificed with him.
From it were horses born, from it all creatures with two rows of teeth.
From it were generated kine, from it were goats and sheep produced.
From that great general sacrifice Richas and Sāma hymns were born;
Therefrom the metres were produced: the Yajus had its birth from it.
From that great general sacrifice the dripping fat was gathered up:
It formed the creatures fleet as wind, and animals both wild and tame.
Seven fencing-logs had he, thrice seven layers of fuel were prepared.
When, offering sacrifice, the Gods bound as their victim Purusha.
Forth from head of the high God seven-and-seventy bright beams.
Sprang into being, of the King Soma produced from Purusha.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रि॒भिः प॒द्भिर्द्याम॑रोह॒त् पाद॑स्ये॒हाभ॑व॒त् पुनः॑ ।
तथा॒ व्यऽक्राम॒द् विष्व॑ङशनानश॒ने अनु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tribhiḥ padbhirdyāmarohat pādasyehābhavat punaḥ |
tathā vya'krāmad viṣvaṅaśanānaśane anu ||

verses.sanskrit:
ताव॑न्तो अस्य महि॒मान॒स्ततो॒ ज्यायां॑श्च॒ पूरु॑षः ।
पादो॑ऽस्य॒ विश्वा॑ भू॒तानि॑ त्रि॒पाद॑स्यृ॒तं॑ दि॒वि ॥
verses.transliteration:
tāvanto asya mahimānastato jyāyāṃśca pūruṣaḥ |
pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripādasyṛtaṃ divi ||

verses.sanskrit:
पुरु॑ष ए॒वेदं सर्वं॒ यद् भू॒तं यच्च॑ भा॒व्यम् ।
उ॒तामृ॑त॒त्वस्ये॑श्व॒रो यद॒न्येनाभ॑वत् स॒ह ॥
verses.transliteration:
puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yad bhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam |
utāmṛtatvasyeśvaro yadanyenābhavat saha ||

verses.sanskrit:
यत् पुरु॑षं॒ व्यद॑धुः कति॒धा व्यऽकल्पयन् ।
मुखं॒ किम॑स्य॒ किं बा॒हू किमू॒रू पादा॑ उच्येते ॥
verses.transliteration:
yat puruṣaṃ vyadadhuḥ katidhā vya'kalpayan |
mukhaṃ kimasya kiṃ bāhū kimūrū pādā ucyete ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रा॒ह्म॒णोऽस्य॒ मुख॑मासीद् बा॒हू रा॑ज॒न्योऽभवत् ।
मध्यं॒ तद॑स्य॒ यद् वैश्यः॑ प॒द्भ्यां शू॒द्रो अ॑जायत ॥
verses.transliteration:
brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamāsīd bāhū rājanyo'bhavat |
madhyaṃ tadasya yad vaiśyaḥ padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyata ||

verses.sanskrit:
चन्द्र॑मा म॑नसो जात॑श्च॑क्षोः सू॑र्यो अजायत ।
मुखा॒दिन्द्र॑श्चा॒ग्निश्च॑ प्रा॒णाद् वा॒युर॑जायत ॥
verses.transliteration:
candramā manaso jātaścakṣoḥ sūryo ajāyata |
mukhādindraścāgniśca prāṇād vāyurajāyata ||

verses.sanskrit:
नाभ्या॑ आसीद॒न्तरि॑क्षं शी॒र्ष्णो द्यौः सम॑वर्तत ।
प॒द्भ्यां भूमि॒र्दिशः॒ श्रोत्रा॒त् तथा॑ लो॒कां अ॑कल्पयन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
nābhyā āsīdantarikṣaṃ śīrṣṇo dyauḥ samavartata |
padbhyāṃ bhūmirdiśaḥ śrotrāt tathā lokāṃ akalpayan ||

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒राडग्रे॒ सम॑भवद् वि॒राजो॒ अधि॒ पूरु॑षः ।
स जा॒तो अत्य॑रिच्यत प॒श्चाद् भूमि॒मथो॑ पु॒रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
virāḍagre samabhavad virājo adhi pūruṣaḥ |
sa jāto atyaricyata paścād bhūmimatho puraḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
यत् पुरु॑षेण ह॒विषा॑ दे॒वा य॒ज्ञमत॑न्वत ।
व॒स॒न्तो अ॑स्यासी॒दाज्यं॑ ग्री॒ष्म इ॒ध्मः श॒रद्ध॒विः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yat puruṣeṇa haviṣā devā yajñamatanvata |
vasanto asyāsīdājyaṃ grīṣma idhmaḥ śaraddhaviḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
तं य॒ज्ञं प्रा॒वृषा॒ प्रौक्ष॒न् पुरु॑षं जा॒तम॑ग्र॒शः ।
तेन॑ दे॒वा अ॑यजन्त सा॒ध्या वस॑वश्च॒ ये ॥
verses.transliteration:
taṃ yajñaṃ prāvṛṣā praukṣan puruṣaṃ jātamagraśaḥ |
tena devā ayajanta sādhyā vasavaśca ye ||

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मा॒दश्वा॑ अजायन्त॒ ये च॒ के चो॑भ॒याद॑तः ।
गावो॑ ह जज्ञिरे॒ तस्मा॒त् तस्मा॑ज्जा॒ता अ॑जा॒वयः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tasmādaśvā ajāyanta ye ca ke cobhayādataḥ |
gāvo ha jajñire tasmāt tasmājjātā ajāvayaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मा॑द् य॒ज्ञात् स॑र्व॒हुत॒ ऋचः॒ सामा॑नि जज्ञिरे ।
छन्दो॑ ह जज्ञिरे॒ तस्मा॒द् यजु॒स्तस्मा॑दजायत ॥
verses.transliteration:
tasmād yajñāt sarvahuta ṛcaḥ sāmāni jajñire |
chando ha jajñire tasmād yajustasmādajāyata ||

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मा॑द् य॒ज्ञात् स॑र्व॒हुतः॒ संभृ॑तं पृषदा॒ज्यऽम् ।
प॒शूंस्तांश्च॑क्रे वाय॒व्याऽनार॒ण्या ग्रा॒म्याश्च॒ ये ॥
verses.transliteration:
tasmād yajñāt sarvahutaḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ pṛṣadājya'm |
paśūṃstāṃścakre vāyavyā'nāraṇyā grāmyāśca ye ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒प्तास्या॑सन् परि॒धय॒स्त्रिः स॒प्त स॒मिधः॑ कृ॒ताः ।
दे॒वा यद् य॒ज्ञं त॑न्वा॒ना अब॑ध्न॒न् पुरु॑षं प॒शुम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
saptāsyāsan paridhayastriḥ sapta samidhaḥ kṛtāḥ |
devā yad yajñaṃ tanvānā abadhnan puruṣaṃ paśum ||

verses.sanskrit:
मू॒र्ध्नो दे॒वस्य॑ बृह॒तो अं॒शवः॑ स॒प्त स॑प्त॒तीः ।
राज्ञः॒ सोम॑स्याजायन्त जा॒तस्य॒ पुरु॑षा॒दधि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
mūrdhno devasya bṛhato aṃśavaḥ sapta saptatīḥ |
rājñaḥ somasyājāyanta jātasya puruṣādadhi ||

verses.sanskrit:
चि॒त्राणि॑ सा॒कं दि॒वि रो॑च॒नानि॑ सरीसृ॒पाणि॒ भुव॑ने ज॒वानि॑ ।
तु॒र्मिशं॑ सुम॒तिमि॒च्छमा॑नो॒ अहा॑नि गी॒र्भिः स॑प॒र्यामि॒ नाक॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
citrāṇi sākaṃ divi rocanāni sarīsṛpāṇi bhuvane javāni |
turmiśaṃ sumatimicchamāno ahāni gīrbhiḥ saparyāmi nākam ||
verses.translation:
A Prayer to the Lunar Mansions and other Powers for protection and prosperity
The brilliant lights shining in heaven together, which through the world glide on with rapid motion.
And Days, and Firmament with songs I worship, seeking the Twenty-eight-fold for its favour.
Krittikās, Rohinī be swift to hear me! Let Mrigasiras bless me, help me Ārdrā!
Punarvasu and Sūnritā, fair Pushya, the Sun, Asleshās, Maghā lead me onward!
My bliss be Svāti and benignant Chitrā, my right First Phalgunis and present Hasta.
Rādhas, Visākhas, gracious Anurādhā, Jyeshthā and happy-starred uninjured Mūla.
Food shall be earlier Ashādhas grant me; let those that follow bring me strength and vigour;
With virtuous merit Abhijit endow me! Sravana and Sravishthās make me prosper.
Satabhishak afford me ample freedom, and both the Proshtha-padas guard me safely.
Revati and the Asvayujas bring me luck, and the Bharanis abundant riches!
Benign to me be all those Lunar Mansions to which the Moon as he moves on doth honour.
All that are in the sky, the air, the waters, on earth, on moun-tains, in the heavenly regions.
Propitious, mighty, let the eight-and-twenty together deal me out my share of profit.
Profit and wealth be mine, and wealth and profit! To Day and Night be adoration rendered!
Fair be my sunset, fair my morn and evening and day with. lucky chase and happy omens;
With blessing and success, immortal Agni, go to the mortal and. return rejoicing.
Excitement and invoking cry, ill-omened sneezing and reproof,
All sounds of empty pitchers send into the distance, Savitar!
May we escape an evil sneeze, enjoy the sneeze of happy luck,
And may our nostrils smelling what is pleasant pour forth fragrant scent.
These flames of Brāhmanaspati borne to all quarters in the-wind,
Turn them all hither, Indra, and make them most gracious unto, me.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒हव॑मग्ने॒ कृत्ति॑का॒ रोहि॑णी॒ चास्तु॑ भ॒द्रं मृ॒गशि॑रः॒ शमा॒र्द्रा ।
पुन॑र्वसू सू॒नृता॒ चारु॒ पुष्यो॑ भा॒नुरा॑श्ले॒षा अय॑नं म॒घा मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
suhavamagne kṛttikā rohiṇī cāstu bhadraṃ mṛgaśiraḥ śamārdrā |
punarvasū sūnṛtā cāru puṣyo bhānurāśleṣā ayanaṃ maghā me ||

verses.sanskrit:
पुण्यं॒ पूर्वा॒ फल्गु॑न्यौ॒ चात्र॒ हस्त॑श्चि॒त्रा शि॒वा स्वा॒ति सु॒खो मे॑ अस्तु ।
राधे॑ वि॒शाखे॑ सु॒हवा॑नुरा॒धा ज्येष्ठा॑ सु॒नक्ष॑त्र॒मरि॑ष्ट॒ मूल॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
puṇyaṃ pūrvā phalgunyau cātra hastaścitrā śivā svāti sukho me astu |
rādhe viśākhe suhavānurādhā jyeṣṭhā sunakṣatramariṣṭa mūlam ||

verses.sanskrit:
अन्नं॒ पूर्वा॑ रासतां मे अषा॒ढा ऊर्जं॑ दे॒व्युत्त॑रा॒ आ व॑हन्तु ।
अ॒भि॒जिन्मे॑ रासतां॒ पुण्य॑मे॒व श्रव॑णः॒ श्रवि॑ष्ठाः कुर्वतां सुपु॒ष्टिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
annaṃ pūrvā rāsatāṃ me aṣāḍhā ūrjaṃ devyuttarā ā vahantu |
abhijinme rāsatāṃ puṇyameva śravaṇaḥ śraviṣṭhāḥ kurvatāṃ supuṣṭim ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ मे॑ म॒हच्छ॒तभि॑ष॒ग् वरी॑य॒ आ मे॑ द्व॒या प्रोष्ठ॑पदा सु॒शर्म॑ ।
आ रे॒वती॑ चाश्व॒युजौ॒ भगं॑ म॒ आ मे॑ र॒यिं भर॑ण्य॒ आ व॑हन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā me mahacchatabhiṣag varīya ā me dvayā proṣṭhapadā suśarma |
ā revatī cāśvayujau bhagaṃ ma ā me rayiṃ bharaṇya ā vahantu ||

verses.sanskrit:
यानि॒ नक्ष॑त्राणि दि॒व्य॑१न्तरि॑क्षे अ॒प्सु भूमौ॒ यानि॒ नगे॑षु दि॒क्षु ।
प्रक॑ल्पयंश्च॒न्द्रमा॒ यान्येति॒ सर्वा॑णि॒ ममै॒तानि॑ शि॒वानि॑ सन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāni nakṣatrāṇi divyantarikṣe apsu bhūmau yāni nageṣu dikṣu |
prakalpayaṃścandramā yānyeti sarvāṇi mamaitāni śivāni santu ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ष्टा॒विं॒शानि॑ शि॒वानि॑ श॒ग्मानि॑ स॒ह योगं॑ भजन्तु मे ।
योगं॒ प्र प॑द्ये॒ क्षेमं॑ च॒ क्षेमं॒ प्र प॑द्ये॒ योगं॑ च॒ नमो॑ऽहोरा॒त्राभ्या॑मस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
aṣṭāviṃśāni śivāni śagmāni saha yogaṃ bhajantu me |
yogaṃ pra padye kṣemaṃ ca kṣemaṃ pra padye yogaṃ ca namo'horātrābhyāmastu ||

verses.sanskrit:
स्वस्ति॑तं मे सुप्रा॒तः सु॑सा॒यं सु॑दि॒वं सु॑मृ॒गं सु॑श॒कुनं॑ मे अस्तु ।
सु॒हव॑मग्ने स्व॒स्त्य॑१मर्त्यं॑ ग॒त्वा पुन॒राया॑भि॒नन्द॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
svastitaṃ me suprātaḥ susāyaṃ sudivaṃ sumṛgaṃ suśakunaṃ me astu |
suhavamagne svastyamartyaṃ gatvā punarāyābhinandan ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒नु॒ह॒वं प॑रिह॒वं प॑रिवा॒दं प॑रिक्ष॒वम् ।
सर्वै॑र्मे रिक्तकु॒म्भान् परा॒ तान् स॑वितः सुव ॥
verses.transliteration:
anuhavaṃ parihavaṃ parivādaṃ parikṣavam |
sarvairme riktakumbhān parā tān savitaḥ suva ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒प॒पा॒पं प॑रिक्ष॒वं पुण्यं॑ भक्षी॒महि॒ क्षव॑म् ।
शि॒वा ते॑ पाप॒ नासि॑कां॒ पुण्य॑गश्चा॒भि मे॑हताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
apapāpaṃ parikṣavaṃ puṇyaṃ bhakṣīmahi kṣavam |
śivā te pāpa nāsikāṃ puṇyagaścābhi mehatām ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मा या ब्र॑ह्मणस्पते॒ विषु॑ची॒र्वात॒ ईर॑ते ।
स॒ध्रीची॑रिन्द्र॒ ताः कृ॒त्वा मह्यं॑ शि॒वत॑मास्कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration:
imā yā brahmaṇaspate viṣucīrvāta īrate |
sadhrīcīrindra tāḥ kṛtvā mahyaṃ śivatamāskṛdhi ||

verses.sanskrit: स्व॒स्ति नो॑ अ॒स्त्वभ॑यं नो अस्तु॒ नमो॑ऽहोर॒त्राभ्या॑मस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration: svasti no astvabhayaṃ no astu namo'horatrābhyāmastu ||

verses.sanskrit:
शा॒न्ता द्यौः शा॒न्ता पृ॑थि॒वी शा॒न्तमि॒दमु॒र्व॑१न्तरि॑क्षम् ।
शा॒न्ता उ॑द॒न्वती॒रापः॑ शा॒न्ता नः॑ स॒न्त्वोष॑धीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śāntā dyauḥ śāntā pṛthivī śāntamidamurvantarikṣam |
śāntā udanvatīrāpaḥ śāntā naḥ santvoṣadhīḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for general protection and prosperity
Gentle be heaven, gentle be earth, gentle this spacious, atmosphere.
Gentle be waters as they flow, gentle to us be plants and herbs!
Gentle be signs of coming change, and that which is and is not. done!
Gentle be past and future, yea, let all be gracious unto us.
Quickened by Prayer, this Goddess Vāk who standeth in the highest place,
By whom the awful spell was made, even through her to us be peace!
Or, made more keen by Prayer, this mind that standeth in the highest place,
Whereby the awful spell was made, even through this be peace to us!
These five sense-organs with the mind as sixth, sharpened by Prayer, abiding in my heart,
By which the awful spell was made, even by these be peace to us.
Favour us Mitra, Varuna, and Vishnu, and Prajāpati! Gracious• to us be Indra and Brihaspati and Aryaman.
Favour us Mitra, Varuna, Vivasvān, and the Finisher,
Portents on earth and in the air, and planets wandering in heaven!
Gracious to us be trembling earth, gracious the flaming meteor stroke!
Gracious be kine who yield red milk, gracious be earth when sinking down!
Gracious be meteor-stricken constellation, gracious to us be magic spells and witchcraft!
Gracious to us be buried charms, and gracious the meteors and the portents of the region!
Kind be the Powers who seize the Moon, with Rāhu be Ādityas kind!
Favour us Death and Cornet, and Rudras with penetrating. might!
Rudras and Vasus favour us, Ādityas, Agnis favour us!
Favour us mighty Rishis, Gods, Goddesses, and Brihaspati!
Brahma, Dhātar, Prajāpati, Worlds, Vedas, Agnis, Rishis Seven.
All these have blessed my happy way. May Indra be my guardian, may Brahmā protect and shelter me.
May all the Gods protect me, may the Gods united shield me well.
May all alleviations in the world which the Seven Rishis know.
Be kind and gracious unto me. Bliss and security be mine!
Earth alleviation, air alleviation, heaven alleviation, waters alleviation, plants alleviation, trees alleviation, all Gods my al-leviation, collective Gods my alleviation, alleviation by allevia-tions. By these alleviations, these universal alleviations, I allay all that is terrific here, all that is cruel, all that is wicked. This hath been calmed, this is now auspicious.
Let all be favourable to us.

verses.sanskrit:
शा॒न्तानि॑ पूर्वरू॒पाणि॑ शा॒न्तं नो॑ अस्तु कृताकृ॒तम् ।
शा॒न्तं भू॒तं च॒ भव्यं॑ च॒ सर्व॑मे॒व शम॑स्तु नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śāntāni pūrvarūpāṇi śāntaṃ no astu kṛtākṛtam |
śāntaṃ bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca sarvameva śamastu naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒यं या प॑रमे॒ष्ठिनी॒ वाग् दे॒वी ब्रह्म॑संशिता ।
ययै॒व स॑सृ॒जे घो॒रं तयै॒व शान्ति॑रस्तु नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
iyaṃ yā parameṣṭhinī vāg devī brahmasaṃśitā |
yayaiva sasṛje ghoraṃ tayaiva śāntirastu naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं यत् प॑रमे॒ष्ठिनं॒ मनो॑ वां॒ ब्रह्म॑संशितम् ।
येनै॒व स॑सृ॒जे घो॒रं तेनै॒व शान्ति॑रस्तु नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ yat parameṣṭhinaṃ mano vāṃ brahmasaṃśitam |
yenaiva sasṛje ghoraṃ tenaiva śāntirastu naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मानि॒ यानि॒ पञ्चे॑न्द्रि॒याणि॒ मनः॑षष्ठानि मे हृ॒दि ब्रह्म॑णा॒ संशि॑तानि ।
यैरे॒व स॑सृ॒जे घो॒रं तैरे॒व शान्ति॑रस्तु नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
imāni yāni pañcendriyāṇi manaḥṣaṣṭhāni me hṛdi brahmaṇā saṃśitāni |
yaireva sasṛje ghoraṃ taireva śāntirastu naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॑ मि॒त्रः शं वरु॑णः॒ शं विष्णुः॒ शं प्र॒जाप॑तिः ।
शं न॒ इन्द्रो॒ बृह॒स्पतिः॒ शं नो॑ भवत्वर्य॒मा ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃ viṣṇuḥ śaṃ prajāpatiḥ |
śaṃ na indro bṛhaspatiḥ śaṃ no bhavatvaryamā ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॑ मि॒त्रः शं वरु॑णः॒ शं वि॒वस्वां॒छमन्त॑कः ।
उत्पाताः॒ पार्थि॑वा॒न्तरि॑क्षाः॒ शं नो॑ दि॒विच॑रा॒ ग्रहाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃ vivasvāṃchamantakaḥ |
utpātāḥ pārthivāntarikṣāḥ śaṃ no divicarā grahāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॒ भूमि॑र्वेप्यमा॒ना शमु॒ल्का निर्ह॑तं च॒ यत् ।
शं गावो॒ लोहि॑तक्षीराः॒ शं भूमि॒रव॑ तीर्य॒तीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no bhūmirvepyamānā śamulkā nirhataṃ ca yat |
śaṃ gāvo lohitakṣīrāḥ śaṃ bhūmirava tīryatīḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
नक्ष॑त्रमु॒ल्काभिह॑तं॒ शम॑स्तु नः॒ शं नो॑ऽभिचा॒राः शमु॑ सन्तु कृ॒त्याः ।
शं नो॒ निखा॑ता व॒ल्गाः शमु॒ल्का दे॑शोपस॒र्गाः शमु॑ नो भवन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
nakṣatramulkābhihataṃ śamastu naḥ śaṃ no'bhicārāḥ śamu santu kṛtyāḥ |
śaṃ no nikhātā valgāḥ śamulkā deśopasargāḥ śamu no bhavantu ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॒ ग्रहा॑श्चान्द्रम॒साः शमा॑दि॒त्यश्च॑ राहु॒णा ।
शं नो॑ मृ॒त्युर्धू॒मके॑तुः॒ शं रु॒द्रास्ति॒ग्मते॑जसः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no grahāścāndramasāḥ śamādityaśca rāhuṇā |
śaṃ no mṛtyurdhūmaketuḥ śaṃ rudrāstigmatejasaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं रु॒द्राः शं वसवः॒ शमा॑दि॒त्याः शम॒ग्नयः॑ ।
शं नो॑ मह॒र्षयो॑ दे॒वाः शं दे॒वाः शं बृह॒स्पतिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ rudrāḥ śaṃ vasavaḥ śamādityāḥ śamagnayaḥ |
śaṃ no maharṣayo devāḥ śaṃ devāḥ śaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्म॑ प्र॒जाप॑तिर्धा॒ता लो॒का वे॒दाः स॑प्तऋ॒षयो॒ऽग्नयः॑ ।
तैर्मे॑ कृ॒तं स्व॒स्त्यय॑न॒मिन्द्रो॑ मे॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतु ब्र॒ह्मा मे॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतु ।
विश्वे॑ मे दे॒वाः शर्म॑ यच्छन्तु॒ सर्वे॑ मे दे॒वाः शर्म॑ यच्छन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahma prajāpatirdhātā lokā vedāḥ saptaṛṣayo'gnayaḥ |
tairme kṛtaṃ svastyayanamindro me śarma yacchatu brahmā me śarma yacchatu |
viśve me devāḥ śarma yacchantu sarve me devāḥ śarma yacchantu ||

verses.sanskrit:
यानि॒ कानि॑ चिच्छा॒न्तानि॑ लो॒के स॑प्तऋ॒षयो॑ वि॒दुः ।
सर्वा॑णि॒ शं भ॑वन्तु मे॒ शं मे॑ अ॒स्त्वभ॑यं मे अस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāni kāni cicchāntāni loke saptaṛṣayo viduḥ |
sarvāṇi śaṃ bhavantu me śaṃ me astvabhayaṃ me astu ||

verses.sanskrit:
पृ॒थि॒वी शान्ति॑र॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ शान्ति॒र्द्यौः शान्ति॒रापः॒ शान्ति॒रोष॑धयः॒ शान्ति॒र्वन॒स्पत॑यः॒ शान्ति॒र्विश्वे॑ मे दे॒वाः शान्तिः॒ सर्वे॑ मे दे॒वाः शान्तिः॒ शान्तिः॒ शान्तिः॒ शान्ति॑भिः ।
ताभिः॒ शान्ति॑भिः॒ सर्व॒ शान्ति॑भिः॒ शम॑यामो॒ऽहं यदि॒ह घो॒रं यदि॒ह क्रू॒रं यदि॒ह पा॒पं तच्छा॒न्तं तच्छि॒वं सर्व॑मे॒व शम॑स्तु नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
pṛthivī śāntirantarikṣaṃ śāntirdyauḥ śāntirāpaḥ śāntiroṣadhayaḥ śāntirvanaspatayaḥ śāntirviśve me devāḥ śāntiḥ sarve me devāḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntibhiḥ |
tābhiḥ śāntibhiḥ sarva śāntibhiḥ śamayāmo'haṃ yadiha ghoraṃ yadiha krūraṃ yadiha pāpaṃ tacchāntaṃ tacchivaṃ sarvameva śamastu naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं न॑ इन्द्रा॒ग्नी भ॑वता॒मवो॑भिः॒ शं न॒ इन्द्रा॒वरु॑णा रा॒तह॑व्या ।
शमिन्द्रा॒सोमा॑ सुवि॒ताय॒ शं योः शं न॒ इन्द्रा॑पू॒षणा॒ वाज॑सातौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ na indrāgnī bhavatāmavobhiḥ śaṃ na indrāvaruṇā rātahavyā |
śamindrāsomā suvitāya śaṃ yoḥ śaṃ na indrāpūṣaṇā vājasātau ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for the same
Befriend us with their aids Indra and Agni, Indra and Varuna who receive oblations!
Indra and Soma give health, wealth and comfort, Indra and Pūshan be our strength in battle!
Auspicious friends to us be Bhaga. Sansa, auspicious be Pur-andhi and all Riches,
The blessing of the true and well-conducted and Aryaman in many forms apparent.
Kind unto us be Maker and Sustainer and the far-reaching One with godlike nature.
Auspicious unto us be Earth and Heaven, the Mountain and the Gods’ fair invocations.
Favour us Agni with his face of splendour, and Varuna and’
Mitra and the Asvins.
Favour us noble actions of the pious; impetuous Vāta blow on, us with favour!
Early invoked may Heaven and Earth be friendly, and Air’s mid-region good for us to look on.
To us may herbs and forest trees be gracious, gracious the Lord victorious of the region.
Be the God Indra with the Vasus friendly, and with Ādityas Varuna who blesseth.
Kind with the Rudras be the healer Rudra, and with the Dames here Tvashtar kindly hear us.
Kind unto us be Soma and Devotions, kind be the sacrifice and Stones for pressing.
Kind be the fixing of the Sacred Pillars, kind be the tender Grass, and kind the Altar.
May the far-seeing Sun rise up to bless us: be the four quarters-of the heaven auspicious.
Auspicious be the firmly-seated Mountains, auspicious be the Rivers and the Waters.
May Aditi through holy works be gracious, and may the Maruts,_ loud in song, be friendly.
May Vishnu give felicity, and, Pūshan, and Air that cherisheth. our lives, and Vāyu.
Prosper us Savitar, the God who rescues, and let the radiant.
Mornings be propitious.
Propitious to our children be Pārjanya, kind to us be the field’s benign Protector!

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॒ भगः॒ शमु॑ नः॒ शंसो॑ अस्तु॒ शं नः॒ पुरं॑धिः॒ शमु॑ सन्तु॒ रायः॑ ।
शं नः॑ स॒त्यस्य॑ सु॒यम॑स्य॒ शंसः॒ शं नो॑ अर्य॒मा पु॑रुजा॒तो अ॑स्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no bhagaḥ śamu naḥ śaṃso astu śaṃ naḥ puraṃdhiḥ śamu santu rāyaḥ |
śaṃ naḥ satyasya suyamasya śaṃsaḥ śaṃ no aryamā purujāto astu ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॑ धा॒ता शमु॑ ध॒र्ता नो॑ अस्तु॒ शं न॑ उरू॒ची भ॑वतु स्व॒धाभिः॑ ।
शं रोद॑सी बृह॒ती शं नो॒ अद्रिः॒ शं नो॑ दे॒वानां॑ सु॒हवा॑नि सन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no dhātā śamu dhartā no astu śaṃ na urūcī bhavatu svadhābhiḥ |
śaṃ rodasī bṛhatī śaṃ no adriḥ śaṃ no devānāṃ suhavāni santu ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॑ अ॒ग्निर्ज्योति॑रनीको अस्तु॒ शं नो॑ मि॒त्रावरु॑णाव॒श्विना॒ शम् ।
शं नः॑ सु॒कृतां॑ सुकृ॒तानि॑ सन्तु॒ शं न॑ इषि॒रो अ॒भि वा॑तु॒ वातः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no agnirjyotiranīko astu śaṃ no mitrāvaruṇāvaśvinā śam |
śaṃ naḥ sukṛtāṃ sukṛtāni santu śaṃ na iṣiro abhi vātu vātaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी पू॒र्वहू॑तौ॒ शम॒न्तरि॑क्षं दृ॒शये॑ नो अस्तु ।
शं न॒ ओष॑धीर्व॒निनो॑ भवन्तु॒ शं नो॒ रज॑स॒स्पति॑रस्तु जि॒ष्णुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī pūrvahūtau śamantarikṣaṃ dṛśaye no astu |
śaṃ na oṣadhīrvanino bhavantu śaṃ no rajasaspatirastu jiṣṇuḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं न॒ इन्द्रो॒ वसु॑भिर्दे॒वो अ॑स्तु॒ शमा॑दि॒त्येभि॒र्वरु॑णः सु॒शंसः॑ ।
शं नो॑ रु॒द्रो रु॒द्रेभि॒र्जला॑षः॒ शं न॒स्त्वष्टा॒ ग्नाभि॑रि॒ह शृ॑णोतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ na indro vasubhirdevo astu śamādityebhirvaruṇaḥ suśaṃsaḥ |
śaṃ no rudro rudrebhirjalāṣaḥ śaṃ nastvaṣṭā gnābhiriha śṛṇotu ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं नः॒ सोमो॑ भवतु॒ ब्रह्म॒ शं नः॒ शं नो॒ ग्रावा॑णः॒ शमु॑ सन्तु य॒ज्ञाः ।
शं नः॒ स्वरू॑णा मि॒तयो॑ भवन्तु॒ शं नः॑ प्र॒स्वः॑१ शम्व॑स्तु॒ वेदिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ naḥ somo bhavatu brahma śaṃ naḥ śaṃ no grāvāṇaḥ śamu santu yajñāḥ |
śaṃ naḥ svarūṇā mitayo bhavantu śaṃ naḥ prasvaḥ śamvastu vediḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं नः॒ सूर्य॑ उरु॒चक्षा॒ उदे॑तु॒ शं नो॑ भवन्तु प्र॒दिश॒श्चत॑स्रः ।
शं नः॒ पर्व॑ता ध्रु॒वयो॑ भवन्तु॒ शं नः॒ सिन्ध॑वः॒ शमु॑ स॒न्त्वापः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ naḥ sūrya urucakṣā udetu śaṃ no bhavantu pradiśaścatasraḥ |
śaṃ naḥ parvatā dhruvayo bhavantu śaṃ naḥ sindhavaḥ śamu santvāpaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॒ अदि॑तिर्भवतु व्र॒तेभिः॒ शं नो॑ भवन्तु म॒रुतः॑ स्व॒र्काः ।
शं नो॒ विष्णुः॒ शमु॑ पू॒षा नो॑ अस्तु॒ शं नो॑ भ॒वित्रं॒ शम्व॑स्तु वा॒युः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no aditirbhavatu vratebhiḥ śaṃ no bhavantu marutaḥ svarkāḥ |
śaṃ no viṣṇuḥ śamu pūṣā no astu śaṃ no bhavitraṃ śamvastu vāyuḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॑ दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता त्राय॑माणः॒ शं नो॑ भवन्तू॒षसो॑ विभा॒तीः ।
शं नः॑ प॒र्जन्यो॑ भवतु प्र॒जाभ्यः॒ शं नः॒ क्षेत्र॑स्य॒ पति॑रस्तु शं॒भुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no devaḥ savitā trāyamāṇaḥ śaṃ no bhavantūṣaso vibhātīḥ |
śaṃ naḥ parjanyo bhavatu prajābhyaḥ śaṃ naḥ kṣetrasya patirastu śaṃbhuḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं नः॑ स॒त्यस्य॒ पत॑यो भवन्तु॒ शं नो॒ अर्व॑न्तः॒ शमु॑ सन्तु॒ गावः॑ ।
शं न॑ ऋ॒भवः॑ सु॒कृतः॑ सु॒हस्ताः॒ शं नो॑ भवतु पि॒तरो॒ हवे॑षु ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ naḥ satyasya patayo bhavantu śaṃ no arvantaḥ śamu santu gāvaḥ |
śaṃ na ṛbhavaḥ sukṛtaḥ suhastāḥ śaṃ no bhavatu pitaro haveṣu ||
verses.translation:
A continuation of Hymn 10
May the great Lords of Truth protect and aid us: blest to us be our horses and our cattle.
Kind be the pious, skilful-handed Ribhus, kind be the Fathers at our invocations Kind to us be the Gods and Visve Devas, Sarasvati with Holy Thoughts be gracious.
Friendly be they, the Liberal Ones, who seek us, yea, those who dwell in-heaven, on earth, in waters.
May Aja-Ekapād the God be gracious, gracious the Dragon of the Deep, and Ocean.
Gracious be he, the swelling Child of Waters, gracious be Prisni who hath Gods to guard her.
So may the Rudras, Vasus, and Ādityas accept the new hymn we now are making.
May all the Holy Ones of earth and heaven, and the Cow’s off-spring hear our invocation.
Priests of the Gods, worthy of sacrifices, immortal, knowing Law, whom man must worship.
May these to-day give us broad paths to travel. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॑ दे॒वा वि॒श्वदे॑वा भवन्तु॒ शं सर॑स्वती स॒ह धी॒भिर॑स्तु ।
शम॑भि॒षाचः॒ शमु॑ राति॒षाचः॒ शं नो॑ दि॒व्याः पार्थि॑वाः॒ शं नो॒ अप्याः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no devā viśvadevā bhavantu śaṃ sarasvatī saha dhībhirastu |
śamabhiṣācaḥ śamu rātiṣācaḥ śaṃ no divyāḥ pārthivāḥ śaṃ no apyāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॑ अ॒ज एक॑पाद् दे॒वो अ॑स्तु॒ शमहि॑र्बु॒ध्न्यः॑१ शं स॑मु॒द्रः ।
शं नो॑ अ॒पां नपा॑त् पे॒रुर॑स्तु॒ शं नः॒ पृश्नि॑र्भवतु दे॒वगो॑पा ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no aja ekapād devo astu śamahirbudhnyaḥ śaṃ samudraḥ |
śaṃ no apāṃ napāt perurastu śaṃ naḥ pṛśnirbhavatu devagopā ||

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒दि॒त्या रु॒द्रा वस॑वो जुषन्तामि॒दं ब्रह्म॑ क्रि॒यमा॑णं॒ नवी॑यः ।
शृ॒ण्वन्तु॑ नो दि॒व्याः पार्थि॑वासो॒ गोजा॑ता उ॒त ये य॒ज्ञिया॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ādityā rudrā vasavo juṣantāmidaṃ brahma kriyamāṇaṃ navīyaḥ |
śṛṇvantu no divyāḥ pārthivāso gojātā uta ye yajñiyāsaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
ये दे॒वाना॑मृ॒त्विजो॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑सो॒ मनो॒र्यज॑त्रा अ॒मृता॑ ऋत॒ज्ञाः ।
ते नो॑ रासन्तामुरुगा॒यम॒द्य यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभिः॒ सदा॑ नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye devānāmṛtvijo yajñiyāso manoryajatrā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ |
te no rāsantāmurugāyamadya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
तद॑स्तु मित्रावरुणा॒ तद॑ग्ने॒ शं योर॒स्मभ्य॑मि॒दम॑स्तु श॒स्तम् ।
अ॒शी॒महि॑ गा॒धमु॒त प्र॑ति॒ष्ठां नमो॑ दि॒वे बृ॑ह॒ते साद॑नाय ॥
verses.transliteration:
tadastu mitrāvaruṇā tadagne śaṃ yorasmabhyamidamastu śastam |
aśīmahi gādhamuta pratiṣṭhāṃ namo dive bṛhate sādanāya ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒षा अप॒ स्वसु॒स्तमः॒ सं व॑र्तयति वर्त॒निं सु॑जा॒तता॑ ।
अ॒या वाजं॑ दे॒वहि॑तं सनेम॒ मदे॑म श॒तहि॑माः सु॒वीराः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
uṣā apa svasustamaḥ saṃ vartayati vartaniṃ sujātatā |
ayā vājaṃ devahitaṃ sanema madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer to Ushas or Dawn for wealth and long life
Dawn drives away her sister’s gloom, and through her excellence makes her retrace her path.
Through her may we gain God-appointed treasure, and with brave sons be glad through hundred winters.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑स्य बा॒हू स्थवि॑रौ॒ वृषा॑णौ चि॒त्रा इ॒मा वृ॑ष॒भौ पा॑रयि॒ष्णू ।
तौ यो॑क्षे प्रथ॒मो योग॒ आग॑ते॒ याभ्यां॑ जि॒तमसु॑राणां॒ स्व॑१र्यत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrasya bāhū sthavirau vṛṣāṇau citrā imā vṛṣabhau pārayiṣṇū |
tau yokṣe prathamo yoga āgate yābhyāṃ jitamasurāṇāṃ svaryat ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for aid and victory in battle
These the two sturdy, manly arms of Indra, these that are won-drous, mighty, and successful First, when the need hath come will I employ them by which the heaven of Asuras was conquered.
Swift, like a dread bull sharpening his weapons, rapidly striking, stirring up the people,
Loud shouting, vigilant, the one sole Hero, Indra subdued a hundred hosts together.
With him loud-roaring, ever watchful, victor bold, hard to over-throw, whom none may vanquish,
Indra the strong whose hand bears arrows, conquer, ye heroes now, now vanquish in the combat.
He rules with those who carry shafts and quivers, Indra who with his hand brings hosts together,
Foe-conquering, strong of arm, the Soma-drinker, with mighty bow, shooting with well-laid arrows.
Conspicuous by thy strength, firm, foremost fighter, mighty and fierce, victorious, allsubduing,
O’ercoming might, excelling men and heroes, mount the kine-winning conquering car, O Indra.
Troop-vanquisher, kine-winner, armed with thunder, who quells an army and with might destroys it,
Follow him, comrades! quit yourselves like heroes, and like this Indra show your zeal and courage.
Piercing the cow-stalls with surpassing vigour, Indra the pitiless hero, wild with anger,
Victor in fight, unshaken and resistless,—may he protect our armies in our battles.
Brihaspati, fly with thy chariot hither, slayer of demons, driving. off our foemen.
Be thou protector of our bodies, crushing our enemies, destroy-ing those who hate us.
Indra guide these! Brihaspati, the Guerdon, and Soma, and the Sacrifice precede them!
And let the banded Maruts march in forefront of heavenly hosts that conquer and demolish.
Ours be the potent host of mighty Indra, King Varuna, and Maruts and Ādityas.
Uplifted is the shout of Gods who conquer, high-minded God who cause the world to tremble.
May Indra aid us when our flags are gathered: victorious be th arrows of our army.
May our brave men of war prevail in battle. Ye Gods, protect u in the shouts of onset.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒शुः शिशा॑नो वृष॒भो न भी॒मो घ॑नाघ॒नः क्षोभ॑णश्चर्षणी॒नाम् ।
सं॒क्रन्द॑नोऽनिमि॒ष ए॑कवी॒रः श॒तं सेना॑ अजयत् सा॒कमिन्द्रः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
āśuḥ śiśāno vṛṣabho na bhīmo ghanāghanaḥ kṣobhaṇaścarṣaṇīnām |
saṃkrandano'nimiṣa ekavīraḥ śataṃ senā ajayat sākamindraḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
सं॒क्रन्द॑नेनानिमि॒षेण॑ जि॒ष्णुना॑ऽयो॒ध्येन॑ दुश्च्यव॒नेन॑ धृ॒ष्णुना॑ ।
तदिन्द्रे॑ण जयत॒ तत् स॑हध्वं॒ युधो॑ नर॒ इषु॑हस्तेन॒ वृष्णा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃkrandanenānimiṣeṇa jiṣṇunā'yodhyena duścyavanena dhṛṣṇunā |
tadindreṇa jayata tat sahadhvaṃ yudho nara iṣuhastena vṛṣṇā ||

verses.sanskrit:
स इषु॑हस्तैः॒ स नि॑ष॒ङ्गिभि॑र्व॒शी संस्र॑ष्टा॒ स युध॒ इन्द्रो॑ ग॒णेन॑ ।
सं॒सृ॒ष्ट॒जित् सो॑म॒पा बा॑हुश॒र्ध्यु॑१ग्रध॑न्वा॒ प्रति॑हिताभि॒रस्ता॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa iṣuhastaiḥ sa niṣaṅgibhirvaśī saṃsraṣṭā sa yudha indro gaṇena |
saṃsṛṣṭajit somapā bāhuśardhyugradhanvā pratihitābhirastā ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब॒ल॒वि॒ज्ञा॒यः स्थवि॑रः॒ प्रवी॑रः॒ सह॑स्वान् वा॒जी सह॑मान उ॒ग्रः ।
अ॒भिवी॑रो अ॒भिष॑त्वा सहो॒जिज्जैत्र॑मिन्द्र॒ रथ॒मा ति॑ष्ठ गो॒विद॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
balavijñāyaḥ sthaviraḥ pravīraḥ sahasvān vājī sahamāna ugraḥ |
abhivīro abhiṣatvā sahojijjaitramindra rathamā tiṣṭha govidam ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मं वी॒रमनु॑ हर्षध्वमु॒ग्रमिन्द्रं॑ सखायो॒ अनु॒ सं र॑भध्वम् ।
ग्रा॒म॒जितं॑ गो॒जितं॒ वज्र॑बाहुं॒ जय॑न्त॒मज्म॑ प्रमृ॒णन्त॒मोज॑सा ॥
verses.transliteration:
imaṃ vīramanu harṣadhvamugramindraṃ sakhāyo anu saṃ rabhadhvam |
grāmajitaṃ gojitaṃ vajrabāhuṃ jayantamajma pramṛṇantamojasā ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भि गो॒त्राणि॒ सह॑सा॒ गाह॑मानोऽदा॒य उ॒ग्रः श॒तम॑न्यु॒रिन्द्रः॑ ।
दु॒श्च्य॒व॒नः पृ॑तना॒षाड॑यो॒ध्यो३ऽस्माकं॒ सेना॑ अवतु॒ प्र यु॒त्सु ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhi gotrāṇi sahasā gāhamāno'dāya ugraḥ śatamanyurindraḥ |
duścyavanaḥ pṛtanāṣāḍayodhyo'smākaṃ senā avatu pra yutsu ||

verses.sanskrit:
बृह॑स्पते॒ परि॑ दीया॒ रथे॑न रक्षो॒हामित्राँ॑ अप॒बाध॑मानः ।
प्र॒भ॒ञ्जंछत्रू॑न् प्रमृ॒णन्न॒मित्रा॑न॒स्माक॑मेध्यवि॒ता त॒नूना॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
bṛhaspate pari dīyā rathena rakṣohāmitrām̐ apabādhamānaḥ |
prabhañjaṃchatrūn pramṛṇannamitrānasmākamedhyavitā tanūnām ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑ एषां ने॒ता बृह॒स्पति॒र्दक्षि॑णा य॒ज्ञः पु॒र ए॑तु॒ सोमः॑ ।
दे॒व॒से॒नाना॑मभिभञ्जती॒नां जय॑न्तीनां म॒रुतो॑ यन्तु॒ मध्ये॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
indra eṣāṃ netā bṛhaspatirdakṣiṇā yajñaḥ pura etu somaḥ |
devasenānāmabhibhañjatīnāṃ jayantīnāṃ maruto yantu madhye ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ वृष्णो॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ राज्ञ॑ आदि॒त्यानां॑ म॒रुतां॒ शर्ध॑ उ॒ग्रम् ।
म॒हाम॑नसां भुवनच्य॒वानां॒ घोषो॑ दे॒वानां॒ जय॑ता॒मुद॑स्थात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrasya vṛṣṇo varuṇasya rājña ādityānāṃ marutāṃ śardha ugram |
mahāmanasāṃ bhuvanacyavānāṃ ghoṣo devānāṃ jayatāmudasthāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒स्माक॒मिन्द्रः॒ समृ॑तेषु ध्व॒जेष्व॒स्माक॒ या इष॑व॒स्ता ज॑यन्तु ।
अ॒स्माकं॑ वी॒रा उत्त॑रे भवन्त्व॒स्मान् दे॑वासोऽवता॒ हवे॑षु ॥
verses.transliteration:
asmākamindraḥ samṛteṣu dhvajeṣvasmāka yā iṣavastā jayantu |
asmākaṃ vīrā uttare bhavantvasmān devāso'vatā haveṣu ||

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दमु॒च्छ्रेयो॑ऽव॒सान॒मागां॑ शि॒वे मे॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॑भूताम् ।
अ॒स॒प॒त्नाः प्र॒दिशो॑ मे भवन्तु॒ न वै त्वा॑ द्विष्मो॒ अभ॑यं नो अस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
idamucchreyo'vasānamāgāṃ śive me dyāvāpṛthivī abhūtām |
asapatnāḥ pradiśo me bhavantu na vai tvā dviṣmo abhayaṃ no astu ||
verses.translation:
A hymn after victory
I have attained this goodliest place to rest in. Both Heaven and,
Earth have shown me grace and favour.
Without a foe for me be all the regions! We hate thee not. May we have peace and safety.

verses.sanskrit:
यत॑ इन्द्र॒ भया॑महे॒ ततो॑ नो॒ अभ॑यं कृधि ।
मघ॑वंछ॒ग्धि तव॒ त्वं न॑ ऊ॒तिभि॒र्वि द्विषो॒ वि मृधो॑ जहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
yata indra bhayāmahe tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi |
maghavaṃchagdhi tava tvaṃ na ūtibhirvi dviṣo vi mṛdho jahi ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for peace and security
Indra, give us security from that whereof we are afraid.
Help us, O Maghavan, let thy succour grant us this: drive foes and enemies afar.
We call on Indra, on the liberal giver: we will be prosperous in men and cattle.
Let not the hosts of cruel fiends approach us. Drive of the Druhs to every side, O Indra.
Best, making household wealth increase. Indra our saviour, kills the foe.
May he from outmost point be our potector, and from the centre and from west and eastward.
Lead us to ample room. O thou who knowest, to happiness security, and sunlight.
Strong, Indra, are the arms of thee the mighty: may we betake us to their lofty shelter.
May air’s mid-region give us peace and safety, safety may both these, Heaven and Earth, afford us.
Security be ours from west, from eastward, from north and south may we be free from danger.
Safety be ours from friend and from the unfriendly, safety from what we know and what we know not.
Safety be ours by night and in the day-time! friendly to me be all my hopes and wishes!

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रं॑ व॒यम॑नूरा॒धं ह॑वाम॒हेऽनु॑ राध्यास्म द्वि॒पदा॒ चतु॑ष्पदा ।
मा नः॒ सेना॒ अर॑रुषी॒रुप॑ गु॒र्विषू॑चीरिन्द्र द्रु॒हो वि ना॑शय ॥
verses.transliteration:
indraṃ vayamanūrādhaṃ havāmahe'nu rādhyāsma dvipadā catuṣpadā |
mā naḥ senā araruṣīrupa gurviṣūcīrindra druho vi nāśaya ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑स्त्रा॒तोत वृ॑त्र॒हा प॑र॒स्फानो॒ वरे॑ण्यः ।
स र॑क्षि॒ता च॑रम॒तः स म॑ध्य॒तः स प॒श्चात् स पु॒रस्ता॑न्नो अस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrastrātota vṛtrahā parasphāno vareṇyaḥ |
sa rakṣitā caramataḥ sa madhyataḥ sa paścāt sa purastānno astu ||

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒रुं नो॑ लो॒कमनु॑ नेषि वि॒द्वान्त्स्व॑१र्यज्ज्योति॒रभ॑यं स्व॒स्ति ।
उ॒ग्रा त॑ इन्द्र॒ स्थवि॑रस्य बा॒हू उप॑ क्षयेम शर॒णा बृ॒हन्ता॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
uruṃ no lokamanu neṣi vidvāntsvaryajjyotirabhayaṃ svasti |
ugrā ta indra sthavirasya bāhū upa kṣayema śaraṇā bṛhantā ||

verses.sanskrit:
अभ॑यं नः करत्य॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒मभ॑यं॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी उ॒भे इ॒मे ।
अभ॑यं प॒श्चादभ॑यं पु॒रस्ता॑दुत्त॒राद॑ध॒रादभ॑यं नो अस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhayaṃ naḥ karatyantarikṣamabhayaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe ime |
abhayaṃ paścādabhayaṃ purastāduttarādadharādabhayaṃ no astu ||

verses.sanskrit:
अभ॑यं मि॒त्रादभ॑यम॒मित्रा॒दभ॑यं ज्ञा॒तादभ॑यं पु॒रो यः ।
अभ॑यं॒ नक्त॒मभ॑यं॒ दिवा॑ नः॒ सर्वा॒ आशा॒ मम॑ मि॒त्रं भ॑वन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhayaṃ mitrādabhayamamitrādabhayaṃ jñātādabhayaṃ puro yaḥ |
abhayaṃ naktamabhayaṃ divā naḥ sarvā āśā mama mitraṃ bhavantu ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒स॒प॒त्नं पु॒रस्ता॑त् प॒श्चान्नो॒ अभ॑यं कृतम् ।
स॒वि॒ता मा॑ दक्षिण॒त उ॑त्त॒रान्मा॒ शची॒पतिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
asapatnaṃ purastāt paścānno abhayaṃ kṛtam |
savitā mā dakṣiṇata uttarānmā śacīpatiḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for security from danger
Peace hath been given us from the east, and from the west security.
Savitar guard me from the south, and from the north the Lord of Might.
May the Ādityas from the sky protect me, Agni from the earth.
May Indra-Agni guard me from the eastward, on all sides may the Asvins give me shelter.
May Jātavedas guard, sidelong, our cattle.
Our shield on all sides be the World-Creators!

verses.sanskrit:
दि॒वो मा॑दि॒त्या र॑क्षन्तु॒ भूम्या॑ रक्षन्त्व॒ग्नयः॑ ।
इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्नी र॑क्षतां मा पु॒रस्ता॑द॒श्विना॑व॒भितः॒ शर्म॑ यच्छताम् ।
ति॒र॒श्चीन॒घ्न्या र॑क्षतु जा॒तवे॑दा भूत॒कृतो॑ मे स॒र्वतः॑ सन्तु॒ वर्म॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
divo mādityā rakṣantu bhūmyā rakṣantvagnayaḥ |
indrāgnī rakṣatāṃ mā purastādaśvināvabhitaḥ śarma yacchatām |
tiraścīnaghnyā rakṣatu jātavedā bhūtakṛto me sarvataḥ santu varma ||

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निर्मा॑ पातु॒ वसु॑भिः पु॒रस्ता॒त् तस्मि॑न् क्रमे॒ तस्मिं॑छ्रये॒ तां पुरं॒ प्रैमि॑ ।
स मा॑ रक्षतु॒ स मा॑ गोपायतु॒ तस्मा॑ आ॒त्मानं॒ परि॑ ददे॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnirmā pātu vasubhiḥ purastāt tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi |
sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for protection from dangers in all directions
Agni from eastward guard me with the Vasus! To him I go, in him I rest: this fort I seek for refuge.
May he protect me, may he be my guardian. I give my soul—All hail! into his keeping.
Vāyu with Air protect me from this region. To him I go, etc.
May Soma from the south, with Rudras, guard me. To him, etc.
Varuna with Ādityas guard me from this region! To him etc.
Sūrya with Earth and Heaven from the western region guard me well. To him, etc.
May Waters joined with Plants protect me from this region. To them I go, in them I rest: this fort I seek for refuge.
May they protect me, may they be my guardians. I give my soul—All hail! —into their keeping.
May Visvakarman with the Seven Rishis be my protector from the northern region. To him, etc.
May Indra, Marut-girt, protect me from this region. To him, etc.
Prajāpati, of generative power, with the Pratishlhā save me from the nadir! To him, etc.
Brihaspati, joined by the Visvedevas, protect me from the region of the zenith! To him, I go, in him I rest; this fort I seek for refuge.
May he protect me, may he be my guardian. I give my soul—
All hail!—into his keeping.

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒युर्मा॒न्तरि॑क्षेणै॒तस्या॑ दि॒शः पा॑तु॒ तस्मि॑न् क्रमे॒ तस्मिं॑छ्रये॒ तां पुरं॒ प्रैमि॑ ।
स मा॑ रक्षतु॒ स मा॑ गोपायतु॒ तस्मा॑ आ॒त्मानं॒ परि॑ ददे॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vāyurmāntarikṣeṇaitasyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi |
sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
सोमो॑ मा रु॒द्रैर्दक्षि॑णाया दि॒शः पा॑तु॒ तस्मि॑न् क्रमे॒ तस्मिं॑छ्रये॒ तां पुरं॒ प्रैमि॑ ।
स मा॑ रक्षतु॒ स मा॑ गोपायतु॒ तस्मा॑ आ॒त्मानं॒ परि॑ ददे॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
somo mā rudrairdakṣiṇāyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi |
sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
वरु॑णो मादि॒त्यैरे॒तस्या॑ दि॒शः पा॑तु॒ तस्मि॑न् क्रमे॒ तस्मिं॑छ्रये॒ तां पुरं॒ प्रैमि॑ ।
स मा॑ रक्षतु॒ स मा॑ गोपायतु॒ तस्मा॑ आ॒त्मानं॒ परि॑ ददे॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
varuṇo mādityairetasyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi |
sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
सूर्यो॑ मा॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्यां॑ प्र॒तीच्या॑ दि॒शः पा॑तु॒ तस्मि॑न् क्रमे॒ तस्मिं॑छ्रये॒ तां पुरं॒ प्रैमि॑ ।
स मा॑ रक्षतु॒ स मा॑ गोपायतु॒ तस्मा॑ आ॒त्मानं॒ परि॑ ददे॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sūryo mā dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ pratīcyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi |
sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
आपो॒ मौष॑धीमतीरे॒तस्या॑ दि॒शः पा॑न्तु॒ तासु॑ क्रमे॒ तासु॑ श्रये॒ तां पुरं॒ प्रैमि॑ ।
ता मा॑ रक्षन्तु॒ ता मा॑ गोपायन्तु॒ ताभ्य॑ आ॒त्मानं॒ परि॑ ददे॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
āpo mauṣadhīmatīretasyā diśaḥ pāntu tāsu krame tāsu śraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi |
tā mā rakṣantu tā mā gopāyantu tābhya ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒श्वक॑र्मा मा सप्तऋ॒षिभि॒रुदी॑च्या दि॒शः पा॑तु॒ तस्मि॑न् क्रमे॒ तस्मिं॑छ्रये॒ तां पुरं॒ प्रैमि॑ ।
स मा॑ रक्षतु॒ स मा॑ गोपायतु॒ तस्मा॑ आ॒त्मानं॑ परि॑ ददे॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvakarmā mā saptaṛṣibhirudīcyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi |
sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रो॑ मा म॒रुत्वा॑ने॒तस्या॑ दि॒शः पा॑तु॒ तस्मि॑न् क्रमे॒ तस्मिं॑छ्रये॒ तां पुरं॒ प्रैमि॑ ।
स मा॑ रक्षतु॒ स मा॑ गोपायतु॒ तस्मा॑ आ॒त्मानं॒ परि॑ ददे॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
indro mā marutvānetasyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi |
sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒जाप॑तिर्मा प्र॒जन॑नवान्त्स॒ह प्र॒तिष्ठा॑या ध्रु॒वाया॑ दि॒शः पा॑तु॒ तस्मि॑न् क्रमे॒ तस्मिं॑छ्रये॒ तां पुरं॒ प्रैमि॑ ।
स मा॑ रक्षतु॒ स मा॑ गोपायतु॒ तस्मा॑ आ॒त्मानं॒ परि॑ ददे॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
prajāpatirmā prajananavāntsaha pratiṣṭhāyā dhruvāyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi |
sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
बृह॒स्पति॑र्मा॒ विश्वै॑र्दे॒वैरू॒र्ध्वाया॑ दि॒शः पा॑तु॒ तस्मि॑न् क्रमे॒ तस्मिं॑छ्रये॒ तां पुरं॒ प्रैमि॑ ।
स मा॑ रक्षतु॒ स मा॑ गोपायतु॒ तस्मा॑ आ॒त्मानं॒ परि॑ ददे॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
bṛhaspatirmā viśvairdevairūrdhvāyā diśaḥ pātu tasmin krame tasmiṃchraye tāṃ puraṃ praimi |
sa mā rakṣatu sa mā gopāyatu tasmā ātmānaṃ pari dade svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं ते वसु॑वन्तमृच्छन्तु ।ये मा॑घा॒यवः॒ प्राच्या॑ दि॒शोऽभि॒दासा॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration: agniṃ te vasuvantamṛcchantu |ye māghāyavaḥ prācyā diśo'bhidāsāt ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for security and peace on all sides
Let those who vex me from the eastern region, sinners, praise Agni followed by the Vasus.
Let those who vex me from this quarter, sinners, praise Vāyu compassed by the Air’s mid region.
Let those who vex me from the southern quarter, sinners, sing praise to Soma with the Rudras.
Let those who vex me from this quarter, sinners, praise Varuna connected with Ādityas.
Let those who vex me from the western quarter, sinners, praise Sūrya linked with Earth and Heaven.
Let those who vex me from this quarter, sinners give praise to plants’ associates the Waters.
Let those who from the north side vex me, sinners, praise Visvakarman with the Seven Rishis.
Let those who vex me from this quarter, sinners, praise Indra with the Marut host about him.
Let those who vex me from the nadir, sinners, extol Prajāpati of genial power.
Let those who vex me from the zenith, sinners, extol Brihaspati with the Visve Devas.

verses.sanskrit: वा॒युं ते॒३ऽन्तरि॑क्षवन्तमृछन्तु । ये मा॑घा॒यवः॑ ए॒तस्या॑ दि॒शोऽभि॒दासा॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration: vāyuṃ te'ntarikṣavantamṛchantu | ye māghāyavaḥ etasyā diśo'bhidāsāt ||

verses.sanskrit: सोमं॒ ते रु॒द्रव॑न्तमृछन्तु । ये मा॑घा॒यवो॒ दक्षि॑णाया दि॒शोऽभि॒दासा॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration: somaṃ te rudravantamṛchantu | ye māghāyavo dakṣiṇāyā diśo'bhidāsāt ||

verses.sanskrit: वरु॑णं॒ त आ॑दि॒त्यव॑न्तमृच्छन्तु ।ये मा॑घा॒यव॑ ए॒तस्या॑ दि॒शोऽभि॒दासा॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration: varuṇaṃ ta ādityavantamṛcchantu |ye māghāyava etasyā diśo'bhidāsāt ||

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यं॒ ते द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीव॑न्तमृच्छन्तु । ये मा॑घा॒यव॑ प्र॒तीच्याः॑ दि॒शोऽभि॒दासा॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration: sūryaṃ te dyāvāpṛthivīvantamṛcchantu | ye māghāyava pratīcyāḥ diśo'bhidāsāt ||

verses.sanskrit: अ॒पस्त ओष॑धीमतीरृछन्तु । ये मा॑घा॒यव॑ ए॒तस्या॑ दि॒शोऽभि॒दासा॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration: apasta oṣadhīmatīrṛchantu | ye māghāyava etasyā diśo'bhidāsāt ||

verses.sanskrit: वि॒श्वक॑र्माणं॒ ते स॑प्तऋ॒षिव॑न्तमृच्छन्तु । ये मा॑घा॒यव॒ उदी॑च्या दि॒शोऽभि॒दासा॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration: viśvakarmāṇaṃ te saptaṛṣivantamṛcchantu | ye māghāyava udīcyā diśo'bhidāsāt ||

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॒ ते म॒रुत्व॑न्तमृच्छन्तु । ये मा॑घा॒यव॑ ए॒तस्या॑ दि॒शोऽभि॒दासा॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration: indraṃ te marutvantamṛcchantu | ye māghāyava etasyā diśo'bhidāsāt ||

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒जाप॑तिं॒ ते प्र॒जन॑नवन्तमृच्छन्तु । ये मा॑घा॒यवो॑ ध्रु॒वाया॑ दि॒शोऽभि॒दासा॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration: prajāpatiṃ te prajananavantamṛcchantu | ye māghāyavo dhruvāyā diśo'bhidāsāt ||

verses.sanskrit: बृह॒स्पतिं॒ ते वि॒श्वदे॑ववन्तमृच्छन्तु । ये मा॑घा॒यव॑ ऊ॒र्ध्वाया॑ दि॒शोऽभि॒दासा॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatiṃ te viśvadevavantamṛcchantu | ye māghāyava ūrdhvāyā diśo'bhidāsāt ||

verses.sanskrit:
मि॒त्रः पृ॑थि॒व्योद॑क्राम॒त् तां पुरं॒ प्र ण॑यामि वः ।
तामा वि॑शत॒ तां प्र वि॑शत॒ सा वः॒ शर्म॑ च॒ वर्म॑ च यच्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
mitraḥ pṛthivyodakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ |
tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||
verses.translation:
A hymn recommending the protection of various Gods
Mitra arose with Earth. To that fort I lead you: enter it, occupy it. Let it give you protection and defence.
Vāyu arose with Air. To that fort, etc.
Sūrya arose with Heaven. To that fort, etc.
Chandramās arose with the Constellation. To that fort, etc.
Sacrifice arose with Priestly Fees. To that fort, etc.
Ocean arose with the Rivers. To that fort, etc.
Brahma arose with the Brahmachārīs. To that fort, etc.
Indra arose with Might. To that fort, etc.
The Gods arose with Immortality. To that fort, etc.
Prajāpati arose with Creatures. To that fort I lead you: enter it, occupy it give you protection and defence.

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒युर॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒णोद॑क्राम॒त् तां पुरं॒ प्र ण॑यामि वः ।
तामा वि॑शत॒ तां प्र वि॑शत॒ सा वः॒ शर्म॑ च॒ वर्म॑ च यच्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
vāyurantarikṣeṇodakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ |
tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
सूर्यो॑ दि॒वोद॑क्राम॒त् तां पुरं॒ प्र ण॑यामि वः ।
तामा वि॑शत॒ तां प्र वि॑शत॒ सा वः॒ शर्म॑ च॒ वर्म॑ च यच्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
sūryo divodakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ |
tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
च॒न्द्रमा॒ नक्ष॑त्रै॒रुद॑क्राम॒त् तां पुरं॒ प्र ण॑यामि वः ।
तामा वि॑शत॒ तां प्र वि॑शत॒ सा वः॒ शर्म॑ च॒ वर्म॑ च यच्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
candramā nakṣatrairudakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ |
tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
सोम॒ ओष॑धीभि॒रुद॑क्राम॒त् तां पुरं॒ प्र ण॑यामि वः ।
तामा वि॑शत॒ तां प्र वि॑शत॒ सा वः॒ शर्म॑ च॒ वर्म॑ च यच्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
soma oṣadhībhirudakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ |
tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञो दक्षि॑णाभि॒रुद॑क्राम॒त् तां पुरं॒ प्र ण॑यामि वः ।
तामा वि॑शत॒ तां प्र वि॑शत॒ सा वः॒ शर्म॑ च॒ वर्म॑ च यच्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yajño dakṣiṇābhirudakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ |
tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
स॒मु॒द्रो न॒दीभि॒रुद॑क्राम॒त् तां पुरं॒ प्र ण॑यामि वः ।
तामा वि॑शत॒ तां प्र वि॑शत॒ सा वः॒ शर्म॑ च॒ वर्म॑ च यच्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
samudro nadībhirudakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ |
tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्म॑ ब्रह्मचा॒रिभि॒रुद॑क्राम॒त् पुरं॒ प्र ण॑यामि वः ।
तामा वि॑शत॒ तां प्र वि॑शत॒ सा वः॒ शर्म॑ च॒ वर्म॑ च यच्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahma brahmacāribhirudakrāmat puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ |
tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रो॑ वी॒र्ये॒३णोद॑क्राम॒त् तां पुरं॒ प्र ण॑यामि वः ।
तामा वि॑शत॒ तां प्र वि॑शत॒ सा वः॒ शर्म॑ च॒ वर्म॑ च यच्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
indro vīryeṇodakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ |
tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वा अ॒मृते॒नोद॑क्रामं॒स्तां पुरं॒ प्र ण॑यामि वः ।
तामा वि॑शत॒ तां प्र वि॑शत॒ सा वः॒ शर्म॑ च॒ वर्म॑ च यच्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
devā amṛtenodakrāmaṃstāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ |
tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒जाप॑तिः प्र॒जाभि॒रुद॑क्राम॒त् तां पुरं॒ प्र ण॑यामि वः ।
तामा वि॑शत॒ तां प्र वि॑शत॒ सा वः॒ शर्म॑ च॒ वर्म॑ च यच्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
prajāpatiḥ prajābhirudakrāmat tāṃ puraṃ pra ṇayāmi vaḥ |
tāmā viśata tāṃ pra viśata sā vaḥ śarma ca varma ca yacchatu ||

verses.sanskrit:
अप॒ न्यधुः॒ पौरु॑षेयं व॒धं यमि॑न्द्रा॒ग्नी धा॒ता स॑वि॒ता बृह॒स्पतिः॑ ।
सोमो॒ राजा॒ वरु॑णो अ॒श्विना॑ य॒मः पू॒षास्मान् परि॑ पातु मृ॒त्योः ॥
verses.transliteration:
apa nyadhuḥ pauruṣeyaṃ vadhaṃ yamindrāgnī dhātā savitā bṛhaspatiḥ |
somo rājā varuṇo aśvinā yamaḥ pūṣāsmān pari pātu mṛtyoḥ ||
verses.translation:
A prayer for protection from death and misfortune
May Soma, Varuna the King, both Asvins, Yama and Pūshan guard us well from Mrityu—
Death caused by men, which Indra-Agni, Dhātar, Brihaspati and Savitar appointed.
All that the World’s Lord made, all that for creatures Prajāpati and Mātarisvan fashioned,
All things within the quarters and their spaces, let all these be my manifold defences.
That which the Gods bound on them when they battled for their royal sway.
What Indra made his shield, may that protect us well on every side,
My shield is Heaven and Earth, my shield is the bright Day, my shield the Sun.
The Visva Devas made my shield. Let not misfortune fall on me.

verses.sanskrit:
या॑नि॑ च॒कार॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ यस्पतिः॑ प्र॒जाप॑तिर्मात॒रिश्वा॑ प्र॒जाभ्यः॑ ।
प्र॒दिशो॒ यानि॑ वस॒ते दिश॑श्च॒ तानि॑ मे॒ वर्मा॑णि बहु॒लानि॑ सन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāni cakāra bhuvanasya yaspatiḥ prajāpatirmātariśvā prajābhyaḥ |
pradiśo yāni vasate diśaśca tāni me varmāṇi bahulāni santu ||

verses.sanskrit:
यत् ते त॒नूष्वन॑ह्यन्त दे॒वा द्युरा॑जयो दे॒हिनः॑ ।
इन्द्रो॒ यच्चक्रे वर्म॒ तद॒स्मान् पा॑तु वि॒श्वतः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yat te tanūṣvanahyanta devā dyurājayo dehinaḥ |
indro yaccakre varma tadasmān pātu viśvataḥ ||

verses.sanskrit:
वर्म॑ मे॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी वर्माह॒र्वर्म॒ सूर्यः॑ ।
वर्म॑ मे॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वाः क्र॒न् मा मा प्राप॑त् प्रतीचि॒का ॥
verses.transliteration:
varma me dyāvāpṛthivī varmāharvarma sūryaḥ |
varma me viśve devāḥ kran mā mā prāpat pratīcikā ||

verses.sanskrit: गा॒य॒त्र्यु॑१ष्णिग॑नु॒ष्टुब् बृ॑ह॒ती प॒ङ्क्तिस्त्रि॒ष्टुब् जग॑त्यै ॥
verses.transliteration: gāyatryuṣṇiganuṣṭub bṛhatī paṅktistriṣṭub jagatyai ||
verses.translation:
A single line giving the names of the chief Vedic metres
Gāyatri, Ushnih, Anushtup, Brihatī, Trishtup, Jagatī.

verses.sanskrit: आ॒ङ्गि॒र॒साना॑मा॒द्यैः पञ्चा॑नुवा॒कैः स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: āṅgirasānāmādyaiḥ pañcānuvākaiḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation:
A prose hymn of homage to various portions of the Atharva-veda, to the Rishis, and to
Brahma With the first five chapters of the Angirases, Hail!
To the sixth, Hail!
To the seventh and eight, Hail!
The black-clawed ones, Hail!
To the golden-hued ones, Hail!
To the small ones, Hail!
To those composed in strophes, Hail!
To the first shells, Hail!
To the second shells, Hail!
To the third shells, Hail!
To the penultimates, Hail.
To the last ones, Hail!
To the latter ones, Hail!
To the Rishis, Hail!
To those with hair in tufts, Hail!
To the Ganas, Hail!
To the great Ganas, Hail!
To all the Vidagana Angirases, Hail!
To those two with separate thousands, Hail!
To Brahma, Hail!
Collected manly powers are topped by Brahma. Brahma at first spread out the loftiest heaven.
Brahma was born first of all things existing. Who then is meet to be that Brahma’s rival?

verses.sanskrit: ष॒ष्ठाय॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhāya svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: स॒प्त॒मा॒ष्ट॒माभ्यां॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: saptamāṣṭamābhyāṃ svāhā ||

verses.transliteration: nīlanakhebhyaḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: ह॒रि॒तेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: haritebhyaḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: क्षु॒द्रेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣudrebhyaḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: प॒र्या॒यि॒केभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: paryāyikebhyaḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒थ॒मेभ्यः॑ श॒ङ्खेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: prathamebhyaḥ śaṅkhebhyaḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: द्वि॒ती॒येभ्यः॑ श॒ङ्खेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: dvitīyebhyaḥ śaṅkhebhyaḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: तृ॒ती॒येभ्यः॑ श॒ङ्खेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyebhyaḥ śaṅkhebhyaḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: उ॒पो॒त्त॒मेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: upottamebhyaḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: उ॒त्त॒मेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: uttamebhyaḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: उ॒त्त॒रेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: uttarebhyaḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: ऋ॒षिभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛṣibhyaḥ svāhā ||
śikhibhyaḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: ग॒णेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: gaṇebhyaḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: म॒हा॒ग॒णेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: mahāgaṇebhyaḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे॒भ्योऽङ्गि॑रोभ्यो विदग॒णेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: sarvebhyo'ṅgirobhyo vidagaṇebhyaḥ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: पृ॒थ॒क्स॒ह॒स्राभ्यां॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛthaksahasrābhyāṃ svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit: ब्र॒ह्मणे॑ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇe svāhā ||

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्म॑ज्येष्ठा॒ संभृ॑ता वि॒र्याऽणि॒ ब्रह्माग्रे॒ ज्येष्ठं॒ दिव॒मा त॑तान ।
भूतानां॑ ब्र॒ह्मा प्र॑थ॒मोत॑ जज्ञे॒ तेना॑र्हति॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ स्पर्धि॑तुं॒ कः ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmajyeṣṭhā saṃbhṛtā viryā'ṇi brahmāgre jyeṣṭhaṃ divamā tatāna |
bhūtānāṃ brahmā prathamota jajñe tenārhati brahmaṇā spardhituṃ kaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: आ॒थ॒र्व॒णानां चतुरृ॒चेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: ātharvaṇānāṃ caturṛcebhyaḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation:
A prose hymn of homage to various portions of the Atharva-vada classed according to the number of verses which their hymns contain
Hail to the four-verse strophes of the Atharvanas!
